text: In the raashayath (beginning) Alahayam baraa (created) the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) and the aratz (Earth/land).

Now the aratz (Earth/land) was formless and empty. Chashak (darkness) panayam (was) on the surface of the thahawam (depths). Alahayam (Alahayam) rawach (spirit / wind) was hovering over the surface of the mayam (Waters).
Alahayam amar (spoke), "Let there be awar (light)," and there was awar (light).
Alahayam raah (see) the awar (light), and saw that it was tawab (pleasant/functional). Alahayam divided the awar (light) from the chashak (darkness).
Alahayam qaraa (called) the awar (light) "yawam (day)," and the chashak (darkness) he qaraa (called) "layal (night)." There was irab (evening) and there was baqar (morning), achad (one) yawam (day).
Alahayam amar (spoke), Let there be an expanse in the thawak (midst) of the mayam (Waters), and let it badal (separated) the mayam (Waters) from the mayam (Waters).
Alahayam ishah (make) the expanse, and badal (separated) the mayam (Waters) which were under the expanse from the mayam (Waters) which were il (over) the expanse; and it was so.
Alahayam qaraa (called) the expanse "sky." There was irab (evening) and there was baqar (morning), a shanay (second) yawam (day).
Alahayam amar (spoke), "Let the mayam (Waters) under the sky be qawah (gather/wait) together to achad (one) maqawam (place), and let the yabashah (dry land) land raah (see);" and it was so.

Alahayam qaraa (called) the yabashah (dry land) aratz (Earth/land) "earth," and the maqawah (gathering/collection) together of the mayam (Waters) he qaraa (called) "yam (sea/waters)." Alahayam raah (see) that it was tawab (pleasant/functional).

Alahayam amar (spoke), "Let the aratz (Earth/land) yield dashaa (grass), ishab (herbs) zarai (yielding) zarai (seed), and paray (fruit) itz (trees) ishah (make) paray (fruit) after their mayan (species), with its zarai (seed) in it, on the aratz (Earth/land);" and it was so.

The aratz (Earth/land) yielded dashaa (grass), ishab (herbs) zarai (yielding) zarai (seed) after their mayan (species), and itz (trees) ishah (make) paray (fruit), with its zarai (seed) in it, after their mayan (species); and Alahayam raah (see) that it was tawab (pleasant/functional).
There was irab (evening) and there was baqar (morning), a shalayashay (third) yawam (day).

Alahayam amar (spoke), "Let there be maawar (Maawar/(Luminary)) in the expanse of sky to badal (separated) the yawam (day) from the layal (night); and let them be for awath (sign / mark / miracle), and for mawaid (Feast/Holy Day), and for yawam (day) and shanah (years);
And let them be for maawar (Maawar/(Luminary)) in the expanse of sky to give awar (light) on the aratz (Earth/land);" and it was so.

Alahayam ishah (make) the shanayam (two) gadawal (very great/important/mighty) maawar (Maawar/(Luminary)): the greater maawar (Maawar/(Luminary)) to mamashalah (rule) the yawam (day), and the qatan (small/young/least) maawar (Maawar/(Luminary)) to mamashalah (rule) the layal (night). He also made the kawakab (star).
Alahayam nathan (give) them in the expanse of sky to give awar (light) to the aratz (Earth/land),

And to mashal (rule/have dominion) over the yawam (day) and over the layal (night), and to badal (separated) the awar (light) from the chashak (darkness). Alahayam raah (see) that it was tawab (pleasant/functional).
There was irab (evening) and there was baqar (morning), a rabayaiy (fourth) yawam (day).
Alahayam amar (spoke), Let the mayam (Waters) swarm with swarms of chay (life) creatures, and let iwap (flying) iwap (flying) il (over) the aratz (Earth/land) in the panayam (open) expanse of sky.

Alahayam baraa (created) the large thanayan (sea) creatures, and every chay (life) napash (living being/soul) that ramash (moves), with which the mayam (Waters) swarmed, after their mayan (species), and every kanap (winged) iwap (flying) after its mayan (species). Alahayam raah (see) that it was tawab (pleasant/functional).

Alahayam barak (blessed) them, amar (spoke), Be parah (fruitful), and rabah (multiply), and malaa (fill) the mayam (Waters) in the yam (sea/waters), and let iwap (flying) rabah (multiply) on the aratz (Earth/land).
There was irab (evening) and there was baqar (morning), a chamayashay (fifth) yawam (day).

Alahayam amar (spoke), "Let the aratz (Earth/land) produce chay (life) napash (living being/soul) after their mayan (species), livestock, ramash (creeping) things, and animals of the aratz (Earth/land) after their mayan (species);" and it was so.

Alahayam ishah (make) the animals of the aratz (Earth/land) after their mayan (species), and the livestock after their mayan (species), and everything that creeps on the adamah (ground) after its mayan (species). Alahayam raah (see) that it was tawab (pleasant/functional).

Alahayam amar (spoke), Let us ishah (make) adam (man) in our tzalam (likeness), after our damawath (likeness): and let them radah (rule over / have dominion of / subdue) dominion over the dagah (fish) of the yam (sea/waters), and over the iwap (flying) of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the aratz (Earth/land), and over every ramash (creeping) thing that ramash (creeps) on the aratz (Earth/land).

Alahayam baraa (created) adam (man) in his own tzalam (likeness). In alahayam (Alahayam) tzalam (likeness) he baraa (created) him; zakar (remembrance/memory) and naqabah (female) he baraa (created) them.

Alahayam barak (blessed) them. Alahayam amar (spoke) to them, Be parah (fruitful), rabah (multiply), malaa (fill) the aratz (Earth/land), and kabash (subdue) it. Radah (rule over / have dominion of / subdue) dominion over the dagah (fish) of the yam (sea/waters), over the iwap (flying) of the sky, and over every chay (life) thing that ramash (moves) on the aratz (Earth/land).

Alahayam amar (spoke), "hanah (Behold), I nathan (give) given you every ishab (herb) zarai (yielding) zarai (seed), which is on the surface of all the aratz (Earth/land), and every itz (tree), which bears paray (fruit) zarai (yielding) zarai (seed). It will be your akalah (food).

To every animal of the aratz (Earth/land), and to every iwap (flying) of the sky, and to everything that ramash (creeps) on the aratz (Earth/land), in which there is chay (life), I have given every yaraq (green) ishab (herb) for akalah (food);" and it was so.
Alahayam raah (see) everything that he ishah (make) made, and, behold, it was very tawab (pleasant/functional). There was irab (evening) and there was baqar (morning), a shashay (sixth) yawam (day).
The shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) and the aratz (Earth/land) were kalah (complete / finish), and all their vast array.

On the shabayaiy (seventh) yawam (day) Alahayam kalah (complete / finish) his malaakah (work) which he ishah (make) made; and he shabath (shabath/rest) on the shabayaiy (seventh) yawam (day) from all his malaakah (work) which he ishah (make) made.

Alahayam barak (blessed) the shabayaiy (seventh) yawam (day), and made it qadash (set apart/make holy), kay (surely) he shabath (shabath/rest) in it from all his malaakah (work) which he had baraa (created) and ishah (make).

This is the history of the thawaladah (generation) of the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) and of the aratz (Earth/land) when they were baraa (created), in the yawam (day) that Yahawah Alahayam ishah (make) the aratz (Earth/land) and the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)).

No shayach (plant) of the shadah (field) was yet in the aratz (Earth/land), and no ishab (herb) of the shadah (field) had yet tzamach (sprung) up; for Yahawah Alahayam had not caused it to matar (rain) on the aratz (Earth/land). There was not a adam (man) to ibad (servant) the adamah (ground),
But a ad (mist) ilah (go up / offer) up from the aratz (Earth/land), and shaqah (watered) the whole surface of the adamah (ground).

Yahawah Alahayam yatzar (formed) adam (man) from the ipar (dust) of the adamah (ground), and napach (breathed) into his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) the nashamah (breathing thing) of chay (life); and adam (man) became a chay (life) napash (living being/soul).
Yahawah Alahayam natai (planted) a gan (garden) eastward, in Idan (Eden), and there he shawam (place / establish / appoint) the adam (man) whom he had yatzar (formed).

Out of the adamah (ground) Yahawah Alahayam tzamach (made) every itz (tree) to tzamach (grow) that is chamad (pleasant) to the maraah (sight), and tawab (pleasant/functional) for maakal (food); the itz (tree) of chay (life) also in the thawak (midst) of the gan (garden), and the itz (tree) of the daith (knowledge) of tawab (pleasant/functional) and rai (evil).
A nahar (river) yatzaa (go out / come out) out of Idan (Eden) to shaqah (water) the gan (garden); and from there it was parad (parted), and became arabai (four) raash (head).

The sham (name) of the achad (one) is Payashawan (Pishon): hawaa (which/who/that is) is the sabab (one) which flows through the whole aratz (Earth/land) of Chawayalah (Havilah), ashar (who/that) there is zahab (gold);
And the zahab (gold) of that aratz (Earth/land) is tawab (pleasant/functional). There is aromatic resin and the shaham (Onyx) aban (stone).
The sham (name) of the shanay (second) nahar (river) is Gayachawan (Gihon): the same sabab (river) that flows through the whole aratz (Earth/land) of Kawash (Cush).

The sham (name) of the shalayashay (third) nahar (river) is Chadaqal (Hiddekel): this is the halak (move) which flows in front of Ashawar (Assyria). The rabayaiy (fourth) nahar (river) is the Parath (Euphrates).
Yahawah Alahayam laqach (take / seized) the adam (man), and yanach (put) him into the gan (garden) of Idan (Eden) to ibad (servant) it and to shamar (keep/guard) it.
Yahawah Alahayam tzawah (commanded) the adam (man), amar (spoke), Of every itz (tree) of the gan (garden) you may akal (eat) akal (eat);

But of the itz (tree) of the daith (knowledge) of tawab (pleasant/functional) and rai (evil), you shall not akal (eat) of it; for in the yawam (day) that you akal (eat) of it you will mawath (death) mawath (death).
Yahawah Alahayam amar (spoke), It is not tawab (pleasant/functional) that the adam (man) should be alone; I will ishah (make) him a helper suitable for him.

Out of the adamah (ground) Yahawah Alahayam yatzar (formed) every animal of the shadah (field), and every iwap (flying) of the sky, and bawaa (come) them to the adam (man) to raah (see) what he would qaraa (called) them. Whatever the adam (man) qaraa (called) every chay (life) napash (living being/soul), that was its sham (name).

The adam (man) gave sham (name) to all livestock, and to the iwap (flying) of the sky, and to every animal of the shadah (field); but for adam (man) there was not matzaa (found) a helper suitable for him.

Yahawah Alahayam napal (fall / be cast down) a tharadamah (deep) sleep to napal (fall / be cast down) on the man, and he yashan (slept); and he laqach (take / seized) achad (one) of his tzalai (ribs), and sagar (closed) up the bashar (flesh) in its place.
He banah (made) the tzalai (rib), which Yahawah Alahayam had laqach (take / seized) from the adam (man), into a ashah (wife/individual woman), and bawaa (come) her to the adam (man).

The adam (man) amar (spoke), zaath (this) is paim (now) itzam (bone) of my itzam (bones), and bashar (flesh) of my bashar (flesh). She will be qaraa (called) ‘ashah (wife/individual woman),’ because she was laqach (take / seized) out of ayash (husband/individual man).
Therefore a ayash (husband/individual man) will izab (leave) his ab (father) and his am (mother), and will join with his ashah (wife/individual woman), and they will be achad (one) bashar (flesh).
They were shanayam (two) irawam (naked), the adam (man) and his ashah (wife/individual woman), and were not bawash (ashamed).

Now the nachash (serpent) was more subtle than any animal of the shadah (field) which Yahawah Alahayam ishah (make) made. He amar (spoke) to the ashah (wife/individual woman), Has Alahayam really amar (spoke), ‘You shall not akal (eat) of any itz (tree) of the gan (garden)?’
The ashah (wife/individual woman) amar (spoke) to the nachash (serpent), Of the paray (fruit) of the itz (trees) of the gan (garden) we may akal (eat),

But of the paray (fruit) of the itz (tree) which is in the thawak (midst) of the gan (garden), Alahayam has amar (spoke), ‘You shall not akal (eat) of it, neither shall you nagai (touch) it, lest you mawath (death).’
The nachash (serpent) amar (spoke) to the ashah (wife/individual woman), You won't mawath (death) mawath (death),

For Alahayam yadai (knows) that in the yawam (day) you akal (eat) it, your iyan (eye) will be paqach (opened), and you will be like Alahayam, yadai (knowing) tawab (pleasant/functional) and rai (evil).

When the ashah (wife/individual woman) raah (see) that the itz (tree) was tawab (pleasant/functional) for maakal (food), and that it was a delight to the iyan (eye), and that the itz (tree) was to be chamad (desired) to shakal (make) one wise, she laqach (take / seized) of its fruit, and akal (eat); and she nathan (give) some to her ayash (husband/individual man) with her, and he akal (eat).

The iyan (eye) of shanayam (two) of them were paqach (opened), and they yadai (knew) that they were iyaram (naked). They thapar (sewed) thaan (fig) leaves together, and ishah (make) themselves chagawar (aprons).

They shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah Alahayam halak (move) in the gan (garden) in the rawach (spirit / wind) of the yawam (day), and the adam (man) and his ashah (wife/individual woman) chabaa (hid) themselves from the panayam (presence) of Yahawah Alahayam among the itz (trees) of the gan (garden).
Yahawah Alahayam qaraa (called) to the adam (man), and amar (spoke) to him, ay (where) are you?
The man amar (spoke), I shamai (hearken / hear) your qawal (sound / voice) in the gan (garden), and I was yaraa (fear / be afraid), because I was iyaram (naked); and I chabaa (hid) myself.
Alahayam said, Who nagad (told) you that you were iyaram (naked)? Have you akal (eat) from the itz (tree) that I commanded you not to akal (eat) from?
The adam (man) amar (spoke), The ashah (wife/individual woman) whom you nathan (give) to be with me, she nathan (give) me of the itz (tree), and I ate.

Yahawah Alahayam amar (spoke) to the ashah (wife/individual woman), "What is this you ishah (make) done?" The ashah (wife/individual woman) amar (spoke), The nachash (serpent) nashaa (lift) me, and I akal (eat).

Yahawah Alahayam amar (spoke) to the nachash (serpent), Because you ishah (make) done this, you are arar (cursed) above all livestock, and above every animal of the shadah (field). On your gachawan (belly) you shall yalak (go), and you shall akal (eat) dust all the yawam (day) of your chay (life).

I will shayath (put / appoint / make) enmity between you and the ashah (wife/individual woman), and between your zarai (offspring) and her zarai (offspring). He will shawap (bruise) your raash (head), and you will shawap (bruise) his iqab (heel).

To the ashah (wife/individual woman) he amar (spoke), I will greatly rabah (multiply) your pain in childbirth. In pain you will yalad (birth / begot) ban (son). Your thashawaqah (desire) will be for your ayash (husband/individual man), and he will mashal (rule/have dominion) over you.

To Adam (Adam) he amar (spoke), Because you have shamai (hearken / hear) to your ashah (wife/individual woman) qawal (sound / voice), and have akal (eat) of the itz (tree), of which I tzawah (commanded) you, amar (spoke), ‘You shall not akal (eat) of it,’ arar (cursed) is the adamah (ground) for your sake. In itzabawan (toil) you will akal (eat) of it kal (every) the yawam (day) of your chay (life).
It will yield qawatz (thorns) and daradar (thistles) to you; and you will akal (eat) the ishab (herb) of the shadah (field).

By the zaih (sweat) of your ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) will you akal (eat) lacham (bread) until you shawab (turn back / repent) to the adamah (ground), for out of it you were laqach (take / seized). For you are ipar (dust), and to dust you shall shawab (turn back / repent).
The adam (man) qaraa (called) his wife Chawah (Eve), because she was the am (mother) of all chay (life).
Yahawah Alahayam ishah (make) kathanath (coats) of iwar (skins) for Adam and for his ashah (wife/individual woman), and labash (clothed) them.

Yahawah Alahayam amar (spoke), han (behold), the adam (man) has become like achad (one) of us, yadai (knowing) tawab (pleasant/functional) and rai (evil). Now, lest he shalach (send) out his yad (hand), and also laqach (take / seized) of the itz (tree) of chay (life), and akal (eat), and chayay (life) iwalam (forever)...
Therefore Yahawah Alahayam shalach (send) him out from the gan (garden) of Idan (Eden), to ibad (servant) the adamah (ground) from which he was laqach (take / seized).

So he garash (drove) out the adam (man); and he shakan (placed) Idan (Cherubs) at the qadam (east) of the gan (garden) of Idan (Eden), and the lahat (flame) of a charab (sword) which turned every hapak (way), to guard the darak (way) to the itz (tree) of chay (life).

The adam (man) yadai (knew) Chawah (Eve) his ashah (wife/individual woman). She harah (conceived), and gave yalad (birth / begot) to Qayan (Cain), and amar (spoke), I have qanah (gotten) a ayash (husband/individual man) with yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) help.
Again she gave yalad (birth / begot), to Cain's ach (brother/kinsman) Habal (Abel). Habal (Abel) was a raih (keeper) of tzaan (sheep), but Qayan (Cain) was a ibad (servant) of the adamah (ground).
As yawam (day) passed, it happened that Qayan (Cain) bawaa (come) an manachah (offering) to Yahawah from the paray (fruit) of the adamah (ground).
Habal (Abel) also bawaa (come) some of the bakawarah (firstborn) of his tzaan (flock) and of its chalab (fat). Yahawah shaih (respected) Habal (Abel) and his manachah (offering),
But he didn't respect Qayan (Cain) and his manachah (offering). Qayan (Cain) was very charah (hot with anger), and the expression on his panayam (face) napal (fall / be cast down).
Yahawah amar (spoke) to Qayan (Cain), Why are you charah (hot with anger)? Why has the expression of your panayam (face) napal (fall / be cast down)?

If you yatab (do) well, will it not be lifted up? If you don't yatab (do) well, chataah (sin) crouches at the pathach (door). Its thashawaqah (desire) is for you, but you are to mashal (rule/have dominion) over it.

Qayan (Cain) amar (spoke) to Habal (Abel), his ach (brother/kinsman), "Let's go into the shadah (field)." It happened when they were in the field, that Qayan (Cain) qawam (rise up) up al (against) Habal (Abel), his ach (brother/kinsman), and harag (killed) him.
Yahawah amar (spoke) to Qayan (Cain), "ay (where) is Habal (Abel), your ach (brother/kinsman)?" He amar (spoke), I don't yadai (know). Am I my ach (brother/kinsman) keeper?
Yahawah said, mah (what) ishah (make) you done? The qawal (sound / voice) of your ach (brother/kinsman) dam (blood) tzaiq (cries) to me from the adamah (ground).
Now you are arar (cursed) because of the adamah (ground), which has patzah (opened) its pah (mouth) to laqach (take / seized) your ach (brother/kinsman) dam (blood) from your yad (hand).

From kay (surely) on, when you ibad (servant) the adamah (ground), it won't nathan (give) its kach (strength / mighty / power) to you. You shall be a nawai (fugitive) and a wanderer in the aratz (Earth/land).
Qayan (Cain) amar (spoke) to Yahawah, My iwan (guilt/iniquity) is greater than I can nashaa (lift).

Behold, you have garash (driven) me out this yawam (day) from the surface of the ground. I will be sathar (hidden) from your panayam (face), and I will be a nawai (fugitive) and a wanderer in the aratz (Earth/land). It will hayah (came to pass) that whoever matzaa (finds) me will harag (kill) me.

Yahawah amar (spoke) to him, "Therefore whoever harag (slays) Qayan (Cain), naqam (vengeance) will be taken on him sevenfold." Yahawah shawam (place / establish / appoint) a awath (sign / mark / miracle) for Qayan (Cain), balathay (lest) any matzaa (finding) him should nakah (strike) him.
Qayan (Cain) yatzaa (go out / come out) out from yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) panayam (presence), and lived in the aratz (Earth/land) of Nawad (Nod), qadamah (east) of Idan (Eden).

Qayan (Cain) yadai (knew) his ashah (wife/individual woman). She harah (conceived), and gave yalad (birth / begot) to Chanawak (Enoch). He banah (built) a iyar (city), and qaraa (called) the sham (name) of the iyar (city), after the sham (name) of his ban (son), Chanawak (Enoch).

To Chanawak (Enoch) was yalad (birth / begot) Iyarad (Irad). Iyarad (Irad) became the father of Machawayaal (Mehujael). Machawayaal (Mehujael) became the father of Mathawashaal (Methushael). Mathawashaal (Methushael) became the father of Lamak (Lamech).
Lamak (Lamech) laqach (take / seized) shanayam (two) wives: the sham (name) of the achad (one) was Idah (Adah), and the sham (name) of the other Tzalah (Zillah).
Idah (Adah) gave yalad (birth / begot) to Yabal (Jabal), who was the ab (father) of those who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in ahal (tents) and have livestock.
His ach (brother/kinsman) sham (name) was Yawabal (Jubal), who was the ab (father) of all who thapash (handle) the kanawar (harp) and pipe.

Tzalah (Zillah) also gave yalad (birth / begot) to Thawabalaqayan (Tubal) Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of nachashath (brass) and barazal (iron). Thawabalaqayan (Tubal) Cain's achawath (sister) was Naimah (Naamah).

Lamak (Lamech) amar (spoke) to his wives, Idah (Adah) and Tzalah (Zillah), shamai (hearken / hear) my qawal (sound / voice). You wives of Lamak (Lamech), listen to my amarah (sayings), for I have harag (slain) a yalad (birth / begot) for patzai (wounding) me, a young yalad (birth / begot) for chabawarah (bruising) me.
If Qayan (Cain) will be naqam (avenged) shabaithayam (seven) times, truly Lamak (Lamech) seventy-seven shabai (seven).

Adam yadai (knew) his ashah (wife/individual woman) again. She gave yalad (birth / begot) to a ban (son), and sham (name) him Shath (Seth), for Alahayam has shayath (put / appoint / make) me achar (other) zarai (child) thachath (under) of Habal (Abel), for Qayan (Cain) harag (killed) him.
There was also yalad (birth / begot) a ban (son) to Shath (Seth), and he sham (name) him Anawash (Enosh). Then men began to qaraa (called) on yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) sham (name).

Zah (this/that/these) is the sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawaladah (generation) of Adam (Adam). In the yawam (day) that Alahayam baraa (created) adam (man), he ishah (make) him in alahayam (Alahayam) damawath (likeness).
He baraa (created) them zakar (remembrance/memory) and naqabah (female), and barak (blessed) them, and qaraa (called) their sham (name) "Adam," in the yawam (day) when they were baraa (created).

Adam (Adam) chayah (lived) one maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) shanah (years), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of a son in his own damawath (likeness), after his tzalam (likeness), and sham (name) him Shath (Seth).

The yawam (day) of Adam (Adam) achar (other) he became the yalad (birth / begot) of Shath (Seth) were shamanah (eight) maah (hundred) shanah (years), and he became the yalad (birth / begot) of ban (son) and bath (daughter).
All the yawam (day) that Adam (Adam) chayay (life) were thashai (nine) maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) shanah (years), then he mawath (death).
Shath (Seth) chayah (lived) one maah (hundred) chamash (five) shanah (years), and became the yalad (birth / begot) Anawash (of) Enosh.

Shath (Seth) chayah (lived) achar (other) he became the yalad (birth / begot) Anawash (of) Enosh shamanah (eight) maah (hundred) shabai (seven) shanah (years), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of ban (son) and bath (daughter).
All the yawam (day) of Shath (Seth) were thashai (nine) maah (hundred) ishar (-teen) shanah (years), then he mawath (death).
Anawash (Enosh) chayah (lived) thashaiyam (ninety) shanah (years), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of Qayanan (Kenan).

Anawash (Enosh) chayah (lived) achar (other) he became the yalad (birth / begot) of Qayanan (Kenan), shamanah (eight) maah (hundred) fifteen shanah (years), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of ban (son) and bath (daughter).
All the yawam (day) Anawash (of) Enosh were thashai (nine) maah (hundred) chamash (five) shanah (years), then he mawath (death).
Qayanan (Kenan) chayah (lived) shabaiyam (seventy) shanah (years), and became the yalad (birth / begot) Mahalalaal (of) Mahalalel.

Qayanan (Kenan) chayah (lived) achar (other) he became the yalad (birth / begot) Mahalalaal (of) Mahalalel shamanah (eight) maah (hundred) arabaiyam (forty) shanah (years), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of ban (son) and bath (daughter)
And all the yawam (day) of Qayanan (Kenan) were thashai (nine) maah (hundred) ishar (ten) shanah (years), then he mawath (death).
Mahalalaal (Mahalalel) chayah (lived) shashayam (sixty)- chamash (five) shanah (years), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of Yarad (Jared).

Mahalalaal (Mahalalel) chayah (lived) achar (other) he became the yalad (birth / begot) of Yarad (Jared) shamanah (eight) maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) shanah (years), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of ban (son) and bath (daughter).
All the yawam (day) Mahalalaal (of) Mahalalel were shamanah (eight) maah (hundred) thashaiyam (ninety)- chamash (five) shanah (years), then he mawath (death).
Yarad (Jared) chayah (lived) one maah (hundred) shashayam (sixty) shanayam (two) shanah (years), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of Chanawak (Enoch).

Yarad (Jared) chayah (lived) achar (other) he became the yalad (birth / begot) of Chanawak (Enoch) shamanah (eight) maah (hundred) shanah (years), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of ban (son) and bath (daughter).
All the yawam (day) of Yarad (Jared) were thashai (nine) maah (hundred) shashayam (sixty) shanayam (two) shanah (years), then he mawath (death).
Chanawak (Enoch) chayah (lived) shashayam (sixty) chamash (five) shanah (years), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of Mathawashalach (Methuselah).

Chanawak (Enoch) halak (move) with Alahayam achar (other) he became the yalad (birth / begot) of Mathawashalach (Methuselah) shalawash (three) maah (hundred) shanah (years), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of ban (son) and bath (daughter).
All the yawam (day) of Chanawak (Enoch) were shalawash (three) maah (hundred) shashayam (sixty) chamash (five) shanah (years).
Chanawak (Enoch) halak (move) with Alahayam, and he was not, for Alahayam laqach (take / seized) him.
Mathawashalach (Methuselah) chayah (lived) one maah (hundred) shamanayam (eighty) shabai (seven) shanah (years), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of Lamak (Lamech).

Mathawashalach (Methuselah) chayah (lived) achar (other) he became the yalad (birth / begot) of Lamak (Lamech) shabai (seven) maah (hundred) shamanayam (eighty) shanayam (two) shanah (years), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of ban (son) and bath (daughter).
All the yawam (day) of Mathawashalach (Methuselah) were thashai (nine) maah (hundred) shashayam (sixty) thashai (nine) shanah (years), then he mawath (death).
Lamak (Lamech) chayah (lived) one maah (hundred) shamanayam (eighty) shanayam (two) shanah (years), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of a ban (son),

And he sham (name) him Nach (Noah), amar (spoke), This same will nacham (turn away / repent) us in our maishah (work) and in the itzabawan (toil) of our yad (hand), man (from) of the adamah (ground) which Yahawah has arar (cursed).

Lamak (Lamech) chayah (lived) achar (other) he became the yalad (birth / begot) of Nach (Noah) chamash (five) maah (hundred) thashaiyam (ninety) chamash (five) shanah (years), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of ban (son) and bath (daughter).
All the yawam (day) of Lamak (Lamech) were shabai (seven) maah (hundred) shabaiyam (seventy) shabai (seven) shanah (years), then he mawath (death).
Nach (Noah) was chamash (five) maah (hundred) shanah (years) ban (son), and Nach (Noah) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Sham (Shem), Cham (Ham), and Yapath (Japheth).
It happened, when adam (men) chalal (began) to rabab (multiply) on the surface of the adamah (ground), and bath (daughter) were yalad (birth / begot) to them,
That God's ban (son) raah (see) that adam (men's) bath (daughter) were tawab (pleasant/functional), and they laqach (take / seized) for themselves wives of all that they bachar (chose).

Yahawah amar (spoke), My rawach (spirit / wind) will not strive with adam (man) iwalam (forever), because he also is bashar (flesh); yet will his yawam (day) be one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) shanah (years).

The Nephilim were in the aratz (Earth/land) in those yawam (day), and also achar (other) that, when alahayam (Alahayam) ban (son) bawaa (come) in to adam (men's) bath (daughter). They yalad (birth / begot) children to them. Ham (those) were the gabawar (mighty) men who were of iwalam (forever), ban (son) of sham (name).

Yahawah raah (see) that the rai (wickedness) of adam (man) was rab (great) in the aratz (Earth/land), and that every yatzar (imagination) of the machashabah (thoughts) of his lab (heart) was only rai (evil) yawam (day).
Yahawah was sorry that he ishah (make) made adam (man) on the aratz (Earth/land), and it itzab (grieved) him in his lab (heart).

Yahawah amar (spoke), I will machah (destroy) adam (man) whom I have baraa (created) from the surface of the adamah (ground); adam (man), along with animals, ramash (creeping) things, and iwap (flying) of the sky; for I am sorry that I ishah (make) made them.
But Nach (Noah) matzaa (found) favor in yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) iyan (eye).

This is the history of the thawaladah (generation) of Nach (Noah). Nach (Noah) was a tzadayaq (righteous) ayash (husband/individual man), blameless among the dawar (generation / age / period) of his time. Nach (Noah) halak (move) with Alahayam.
Nach (Noah) became the yalad (birth / begot) of shalawash (three) ban (son): Sham (Shem), Cham (Ham), and Yapath (Japheth).
The aratz (Earth/land) was shachath (corrupt) panayam (before) Alahayam, and the aratz (Earth/land) was malaa (filled) with chamas (violence).
Alahayam raah (see) the aratz (Earth/land), and saw that it was shachath (corrupt), for all bashar (flesh) had shachath (corrupted) their darak (way) on the aratz (Earth/land).

Alahayam amar (spoke) to Nach (Noah), The qatz (end) of all bashar (flesh) bawaa (come) come panayam (before) me, for the aratz (Earth/land) is malaa (filled) with chamas (violence) panayam (through) them. Behold, I will shachath (destroy) them with the aratz (Earth/land).
Ishah (make) a ship of gopher wood. You shall make rooms in the ship, and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch.

This is how you shall ishah (make) it. The arak (length) of the ship will be shalawash (three) maah (hundred) amah (cubits), its rachab (breadth) chamashayam (fifty) amah (cubits), and its qawamah (height) shalawashayam (thirty) amah (cubits).

You shall ishah (make) a roof in the ship, and you shall kalah (complete / finish) it to a amah (cubit) upward. You shall shawam (place / establish / appoint) the pathach (door) of the ship in its tzad (side). You shall ishah (make) it with lower, shanay (second), and shalayashay (third) levels.

I, even I, do bawaa (come) the mabawal (flood) of mayam (Waters) on this aratz (Earth/land), to shachath (destroy) all bashar (flesh) having the rawach (spirit / wind) of chay (life) from under the sky. Everything that is in the aratz (Earth/land) will gawai (die).
But I will qawam (rise up) my barayath (covenant) with you. You shall bawaa (come) into the ship, you, your ban (son), your ashah (wife/individual woman), and your ban (son)' wives with you.

Of every chay (life) thing of all bashar (flesh), you shall bawaa (come) shanayam (two) of every sort into the ship, to chayah (keep) them alive with you. They shall be zakar (remembrance/memory) and naqabah (female).

Of the iwap (flying) after their mayan (species), of the livestock after their mayan (species), of every ramash (creeping) thing of the adamah (ground) after its mayan (species), shanayam (two) of every sort shall bawaa (come) to you, to chayah (keep) them alive.
Laqach (take / seized) with you of all maakal (food) that is akal (eat), and asap (gather) it to yourself; and it will be for akalah (food) for you, and for them.
Thus Nach (Noah) ishah (make). According to all that Alahayam tzawah (commanded) him, so he ishah (make).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Nach (Noah), bawaa (come) with all of your bayath (house) into the ship, for I raah (see) seen your tzadayaq (righteous) panayam (before) me in zah (this/that/these) dawar (generation / age / period).

You shall laqach (take / seized) seven pairs of every tahawar (clean) animal with you, the male and his ashah (wife/individual woman). Of the animals that are not tahawar (clean), take shanayam (two), the male and his ashah (wife/individual woman).

Also of the iwap (flying) of the sky, shabai (seven) and seven, zakar (remembrance/memory) and naqabah (female), to chayah (keep) zarai (seed) chayah (alive) on the surface of all the aratz (Earth/land).

In shabai (seven) yawam (day), I will cause it to matar (rain) on the aratz (Earth/land) for arabaiyam (forty) yawam (day) and arabaiyam (forty) layal (nights). Kal (every) living thing that I ishah (make) made, I will machah (destroy) from the surface of the panayam (ground).
Nach (Noah) ishah (make) everything that Yahawah tzawah (commanded) him.
Nach (Noah) was shash (six) maah (hundred) shanah (years) ban (son) when the mabawal (flood) of mayam (Waters) came on the aratz (Earth/land).
Nach (Noah) went into the ship with his ban (son), his ashah (wife/individual woman), and his ban (son)' wives, panayam (because) of the mayam (Waters) of the mabawal (flood).
Tahawar (clean) animals, animals that are not tahawar (clean), iwap (flying), and everything that ramash (creeps) on the adamah (ground)
Bawaa (come) by pairs to Nach (Noah) into the ship, zakar (remembrance/memory) and naqabah (female), as Alahayam tzawah (commanded) Nach (Noah).
It happened after the shabai (seven) yawam (day), that the mayam (Waters) of the mabawal (flood) came on the aratz (Earth/land).

In the shash (six) hundredth shanah (year) of Nach (Noah's) chay (life), in the shanay (second) chadash (month), on the seventeenth yawam (day) of the chadash (month), on the same yawam (day) all the maiyan (fountains) of the rab (great) thahawam (depths) were baqai (burst) open, and the sky's arabah (windows) were pathach (opened).
The gasham (rain) was on the aratz (Earth/land) arabaiyam (forty) yawam (day) and arabaiyam (forty) layal (nights).

In the same yawam (day) Nach (Noah), and Sham (Shem), Cham (Ham), and Yapath (Japheth), the ban (son) of Nach (Noah), and Nach (Noah's) ashah (wife/individual woman), and the shalawash (three) wives of his ban (son) with them, entered into the ship;

They, and every animal after its mayan (species), all the livestock after their mayan (species), every ramash (creeping) thing that ramash (creeps) on the aratz (Earth/land) after its mayan (species), and every iwap (flying) after its mayan (species), every tzapawar (bird) of every kanap (sort).
They went to Nach (Noah) into the ship, by pairs of all bashar (flesh) with the rawach (spirit / wind) of chay (life) in them.
Those who bawaa (come) in, bawaa (come) in zakar (remembrance/memory) and naqabah (female) of all bashar (flesh), as Alahayam tzawah (commanded) him; and Yahawah sagar (shut) him in.

The mabawal (flood) was arabaiyam (forty) yawam (day) on the aratz (Earth/land). The mayam (Waters) rabah (increased), and nashaa (lift) up the ship, and it was rawam (will lift up) up above the aratz (Earth/land).
The mayam (Waters) gabar (prevailed), and rabah (increased) maad (greatly) on the aratz (Earth/land); and the ship floated on the surface of the mayam (Waters).
The mayam (Waters) gabar (prevailed) maad (exceedingly) on the aratz (Earth/land). All the gabah (high) har (mountain) that were under the whole sky were kasah (covered).
The mayam (Waters) prevailed fifteen amah (cubits) upward, and the har (mountain) were kasah (covered).

All bashar (flesh) gawai (died) that ramash (moved) on the aratz (Earth/land), including iwap (flying), livestock, animals, every sharatz (creeping) thing that sharatz (swarm as many) on the aratz (Earth/land), and every adam (man).
All in whose ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) was the nashamah (breathing thing) of the spirit of chay (life), of all that was on the charabah (dry) land, mawath (death).

Every living thing was machah (destroyed) that panayam (was) on the surface of the adamah (ground), including adam (man), livestock, ramash (creeping) things, and iwap (flying) of the sky. They were machah (destroyed) from the aratz (Earth/land). Only Nach (Noah) was shaar (left), and those who were with him in the ship.
The mayam (Waters) gabar (prevailed) on the aratz (Earth/land) one maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) yawam (day).

Alahayam zakar (remembrance/memory) Nach (Noah), all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and Alahayam ibar (pass over/through) a rawach (spirit / wind) to ibar (pass over/through) over the aratz (Earth/land). The mayam (Waters) subsided.
The thahawam (depths) maiyan (fountains) and the sky's arabah (windows) were also sakar (stopped), and the gasham (rain) from the sky was kalaa (restrained).

The mayam (Waters) receded from the aratz (Earth/land) halak (move). Qatzah (end / extremity / border) the end of one maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) yawam (day) the mayam (Waters) chasar (decreased).
The ship nawach (rested) in the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month), on the seventeenth yawam (day) of the chadash (month), on Ararat (Ararat's) har (mountain).

The mayam (Waters) receded halak (move) id (until) the ishayaray (tenth) chadash (month). In the ishayaray (tenth) month, on the achad (one) day of the chadash (month), the raash (head) of the har (mountain) were raah (see).
It happened at the qatz (end) of arabaiyam (forty) yawam (day), that Nach (Noah) pathach (opened) the chalawan (window) of the ship which he ishah (make) made,
And he shalach (send) out a irab (evening). It yatzaa (go out / come out) back and forth, until the mayam (Waters) were yabash (dry land) up from the aratz (Earth/land).
He shalach (send) out a yawanah (dove) from him, to raah (see) if the mayam (Waters) were qalal (abated) from the surface of the adamah (ground),

But the yawanah (dove) matzaa (found) no place to manawach (rest) her ragal (feet / foot), and she shawab (turn back / repent) to him into the ship; for the mayam (Waters) were on the surface of the whole aratz (Earth/land). He shalach (send) out his yad (hand), and laqach (take / seized) her, and brought her to him into the ship.
He chawal (stayed) yet achar (other) shabai (seven) yawam (day); and again he sent the yawanah (dove) out of the ship.

The yawanah (dove) bawaa (come) back to him at ith (evening), and, behold, in her pah (mouth) was an zayath (olive) ilah (leaf) plucked off. So Nach (Noah) yadai (knew) that the mayam (Waters) were qalal (abated) from the aratz (Earth/land).
He yachal (stayed) yet another shabai (seven) yawam (day), and shalach (send) out the yawanah (dove); and she didn't shawab (turn back / repent) to him any more.

It happened in the shash (six) maah (hundred) first shanah (year), in the raashawan (first) month, the achad (one) day of the chadash (month), the mayam (Waters) were charab (dried) up from the aratz (Earth/land). Nach (Noah) sawar (removed) the makasah (covering) of the ship, and raah (see). He saw that the surface of the adamah (ground) was charab (dried).
In the shanay (second) chadash (month), on the twenty-seventh yawam (day) of the chadash (month), the aratz (Earth/land) was yabash (dry land).
Alahayam dabar (word / matter) to Nach (Noah), amar (spoke),
Yatzaa (go out / come out) out of the ship, you, and your ashah (wife/individual woman), and your ban (son), and your ban (son)' wives with you.

Yatzaa (go out / come out) out with you every chay (life) thing that is with you of all bashar (flesh), including iwap (flying), livestock, and every ramash (creeping) thing that ramash (creeps) on the aratz (Earth/land), that they may sharatz (swarm as many) abundantly in the aratz (Earth/land), and be parah (fruitful), and rabah (multiply) on the aratz (Earth/land).
Nach (Noah) went out, with his ban (son), his ashah (wife/individual woman), and his ban (son)' wives with him.

Every animal, every ramash (creeping) thing, and every iwap (flying), whatever ramash (moves) on the aratz (Earth/land), after their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family), yatzaa (go out / come out) out of the ship.

Nach (Noah) banah (built) an mazabach (altar) to Yahawah, and laqach (take / seized) of every tahawar (clean) animal, and of every tahawar (clean) iwap (flying), and ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilah (offerings) on the mazabach (altar).

Yahawah rawach (spirit / wind) the pleasant aroma. Yahawah amar (spoke) in his lab (heart), I will not again qalal (curse) the adamah (ground) any more for adam (man's) ibawar (sake), because the yatzar (imagination) of adam (man's) lab (heart) is rai (evil) from his naiwar (youth); neither will I ever again nakah (strike) everything chay (life), as I ishah (make) done.

While the aratz (Earth/land) remains, zarai (seed) time and qatzayar (harvest), and qar (cold) and cham (heat), and qayatz (summer) and charap (winter), and yawam (day) and layal (night) shall not shabath (shabath/rest).
Alahayam barak (blessed) Nach (Noah) and his ban (son), and amar (spoke) to them, Be parah (fruitful), and rabah (multiply), and malaa (replenish) the aratz (Earth/land).

The mawaraa (fear) of you and the chath (dread) of you will be on every animal of the aratz (Earth/land), and on every iwap (flying) of the sky. Everything that the adamah (ground) teems with, and all the dag (fish) of the yam (sea/waters) are nathan (give) into your yad (hand).
Every moving thing that chay (life) will be akalah (food) for you. As the yaraq (green) ishab (herb), I nathan (give) given everything to you.
But bashar (flesh) with its napash (living being/soul), its dam (blood), you shall not akal (eat).

I will ak (surely) darash (require) your dam (blood) of your lives. At the yad (hand) of every animal I will darash (require) it. At the yad (hand) of adam (man), even at the yad (hand) of every adam (man's) ach (brother/kinsman), I will darash (require) the napash (living being/soul) of adam (man).
Whoever shapak (sheds) adam (man's) dam (blood), his dam (blood) will be shapak (shed) by adam (man), for Alahayam ishah (make) adam (man) in his own tzalam (likeness).
Be parah (fruitful) and rabah (multiply). Sharatz (swarm as many) abundantly in the aratz (Earth/land), and rabah (multiply) in it.
Alahayam amar (spoke) to Nach (Noah) and to his ban (son) with him, amar (spoke),
As for me, behold, I qawam (rise up) my barayath (covenant) with you, and with your zarai (offspring) achar (other) you,

And with every chay (life) napash (living being/soul) that is with you: the iwap (flying), the livestock, and every animal of the aratz (Earth/land) with you, of all that yatzaa (go out / come out) out of the ship, even every animal of the aratz (Earth/land).

I will qawam (rise up) my barayath (covenant) with you: all bashar (flesh) will not be karath (cut) off any more by the mayam (Waters) of the mabawal (flood), neither will there ever again be a mabawal (flood) to shachath (destroy) the aratz (Earth/land).

Alahayam amar (spoke), This is the awath (sign / mark / miracle) of the barayath (covenant) which I nathan (give) between me and you and every chay (life) napash (living being/soul) that is with you, for iwalam (forever) dawar (generation / age / period):
I nathan (give) my rainbow in the inan (cloud), and it will be for a awath (sign / mark / miracle) of a barayath (covenant) between me and the aratz (Earth/land).
It will happen, when I inan (cloud intepreting / soothsaying / astrology) a inan (cloud) over the aratz (Earth/land), that the rainbow will be raah (see) in the inan (cloud),

And I will zakar (remembrance/memory) my barayath (covenant), which is between me and you and every chay (life) napash (living being/soul) of all bashar (flesh), and the mayam (Waters) will no more become a mabawal (flood) to shachath (destroy) all bashar (flesh).

The rainbow will be in the inan (cloud). I will raah (see) at it, that I may zakar (remembrance/memory) the iwalam (forever) barayath (covenant) bayan (between) Alahayam and every chay (life) napash (living being/soul) of all bashar (flesh) that is on the aratz (Earth/land).

Alahayam amar (spoke) to Nach (Noah), This is the awath (sign / mark / miracle) of the barayath (covenant) which I have qawam (rise up) between me and all bashar (flesh) that is on the aratz (Earth/land).
The ban (son) of Nach (Noah) who yatzaa (go out / come out) out from the ship were Sham (Shem), Cham (Ham), and Yapath (Japheth). Cham (Ham) is the ab (father) of Kanain (Canaan).
These shalawash (three) were the ban (son) of Noah, and from these, the whole aratz (Earth/land) was populated.
Nach (Noah) chalal (began) to be a farmer, and natai (planted) a karam (vineyard).
He shathah (drinks) of the yayan (wine) and got shakar (drunk). He was galah (uncovered) thawak (midst) his ahal (tent).
Cham (Ham), the ab (father) of Kanain (Canaan), raah (see) the irawah (nakedness) of his ab (father), and nagad (told) his shanayam (two) ach (brother/kinsman) outside.

Sham (Shem) and Yapath (Japheth) laqach (take / seized) a shamalah (garment), and shawam (place / establish / appoint) it on shanayam (two) their shakam (shoulders), yalak (went) in backwards, and kasah (covered) the irawah (nakedness) of their ab (father). Their panayam (faces) were backwards, and they didn't raah (see) their ab (father) irawah (nakedness).
Nach (Noah) awoke from his yayan (wine), and yadai (knew) what his youngest ban (son) ishah (make) done to him.
He amar (spoke), Kanain (Canaan) is arar (cursed). He will be ibad (servant) of ibad (servant) to his ach (brother/kinsman).
He amar (spoke), barak (blessed) be Yahawah, the Alahayam of Sham (Shem). Let Kanain (Canaan) be his ibad (servant).
May Alahayam pathah (enlarge) Yapath (Japheth). Let him shakan (dwell) in the ahal (tents) of Sham (Shem). Let Kanain (Canaan) be his ibad (servant).
Nach (Noah) chayah (lived) shalawash (three) maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) shanah (years) achar (other) the mabawal (flood).
All the yawam (day) of Nach (Noah) were thashai (nine) maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) shanah (years), then he mawath (death).

Now this is the history of the thawaladah (generation) of the ban (son) of Nach (Noah) and of Sham (Shem), Cham (Ham), and Yapath (Japheth). Ban (son) were yalad (birth / begot) to them achar (other) the mabawal (flood).
The ban (son) of Yapath (Japheth): Gamar (Gomer), Magawag (Magog), Maday (Madai), Yawan (Javan), Thawabal (Tubal), Mashak (Meshech), and Thayaras (Tiras).
The ban (son) of Gamar (Gomer): Ashakanaz (Ashkenaz), Rayapath (Riphath), and Thawagaramah (Togarmah).
The ban (son) of Yawan (Javan): Alayashah (Elishah), Tharashayash (Tarshish), Kathay (Kittim), and Dadanayam (Dodanim).

Of these were the ay (islands) of the gaway (nation / people) parad (divided) in their aratz (Earth/land), everyone after his lashawan (tongue/language), after their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family), in their gaway (nation / people).
The ban (son) of Cham (Ham): Kawash (Cush), Matzarayam (Mizraim), Pawat (Put), and Kanain (Canaan).
The ban (son) of Kawash (Cush): Sabaa (Seba), Chawayalah (Havilah), Sabathaa (Sabtah), Raimah (Raamah), and Sabathakaa (Sabteca). The ban (son) of Raimah (Raamah): Shabaa (Sheba) and Dadan (Dedan).
Kawash (Cush) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Namarawad (Nimrod). He chalal (began) to be a gabawar (mighty) one in the aratz (Earth/land).
He was a gabawar (mighty) tzayad (hunter) panayam (before) Yahawah. Therefore it is amar (spoke), Like Namarawad (Nimrod), a gabawar (mighty) tzayad (hunter) panayam (before) Yahawah.
The raashayath (beginning) of his mamalakah (kingdom) was Babal (Babel), Arak (Erech), Akad (Accad), and Kalanah (Calneh), in the aratz (Earth/land) of Shanair (Shinar).
Out of that aratz (Earth/land) he yatzaa (go out / come out) into Ashawar (Assyria), and banah (built) Nayanawah (Nineveh), Rachabawath (Rehoboth)- Ir, Kalach (Calah),
And Rasan (Resen) between Nayanawah (Nineveh) and Kalach (Calah) (the same is the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) iyar (city)).
Matzarayam (Mizraim) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Lawaday (Ludim), inamayam (anamim), lahabayam (lehabim), Naphtuhim,
Patharasay (pathrusim), kasalachayam (casluhim) (which the Palashathay (Philistines) descended from), and Kapatharay (Caphtorim).
Kanain (Canaan) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Tzayadawan (Sidon) (his bakawar (firstborn)), Chath (Heth),
The Yabawasay (Jebusite), the Amaray (Amorite), the Garagashay (Girgashite),
The Chaway (Hivite), the iraqay (arkite), the sayanay (sinite),
The arawaday (arvadite), the tzamaray (zemarite), and the chamathay (hamathite). Afterward the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Kanainay (Canaanites) were pawatz (spread) abroad.

The gabawal (border/boundary) of the Kanainay (Canaanites) was from Tzayadawan (Sidon), as you bawaa (come) toward Garar (Gerar), to Izah (Gaza); as you bawaa (come) toward Sadam (Sodom), Imarah (Gomorrah), Adamah (Admah), and Tzabaayam (Zeboiim), to Lashai (Lasha).
These are the ban (son) of Cham (Ham), after their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family), after their lashawan (tongue/language), in their aratz (Earth/land), in their gaway (nation / people).
To Sham (Shem), the ab (father) of all the children of Ibar (Eber), the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) ach (brother/kinsman) of Yapath (Japheth), to him also were yalad (birth / begot) born.
The ban (son) of Sham (Shem): Iyalam (Elam), Ashawar (Asshur), Arapakashad (Arpachshad), Lawad (Lud), and Aram (Aram).
The ban (son) of Aram (Aram): Iwatz (Uz), Chawal (Hul), Gathar (Gether), and Mash (Mash).
Arapakashad (Arpachshad) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Shalach (Shelah). Shalach (Shelah) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Ibar (Eber).

To Ibar (Eber) were yalad (birth / begot) shanayam (two) ban (son). The sham (name) of the achad (one) was Palag (Peleg), for in his yawam (day) the aratz (Earth/land) was palag (divided). His ach (brother/kinsman) sham (name) was Yaqatan (Joktan).
Yaqatan (Joktan) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Alamawadad (Almodad), Shalap (Sheleph), Chatzaramawath (Hazarmaveth), Yarach (Jerah),
Hadawaram (Hadoram), Awazal (Uzal), Daqalah (Diklah),
Iwabal (Obal), Abayamaal (Abimael), Shabaa (Sheba),
Awapayar (Ophir), Chawayalah (Havilah), and Yawabab (Jobab). All these were the ban (son) of Yaqatan (Joktan).
Their mawashab (dwelling) was from Mashaa (Mesha), as you bawaa (come) toward Sapar (Sephar), the har (mountain) of the qadam (east).
These are the ban (son) of Sham (Shem), after their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family), after their lashawan (tongue/language), in their aratz (Earth/land), after their gaway (nation / people).

These are the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the ban (son) of Nach (Noah), after their thawaladah (generation), in their gaway (nation / people). Of these were the gaway (nation / people) parad (divided) in the aratz (Earth/land) achar (other) the mabawal (flood).
The whole aratz (Earth/land) was of achad (one) shapah (language) and of achad (one) dabar (word / matter).
It happened, as they traveled qadam (east), that they matzaa (found) a baqaih (plain) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Shanair (Shinar), and they lived there.

They amar (spoke) ayash (husband/individual man) to rai (neigbor/another person), "yahab (come), let's laban (make) labanah (bricks), and sharap (burn) them thoroughly." They had labanah (brick) for aban (stone), and they used tar for mortar.

They amar (spoke), yahab (come), let's banah (build) ourselves a iyar (city), and a magadal (tower) whose raash (head) reaches to the sky, and let's ishah (make) ourselves a sham (name), lest we be pawatz (scattered) abroad on the surface of the whole aratz (Earth/land).
Yahawah yarad (came) down to raah (see) the iyar (city) and the magadal (tower), which the ban (son) of adam (men) banah (built).

Yahawah amar (spoke), Behold, they are achad (one) im (people / nation), and they have all achad (one) shapah (language), and this is what they chalal (begin) to ishah (make). Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to ishah (make).
Yahab (come), yarad (let's) go down, and there confuse their shapah (language), that they may not shamai (hearken / hear) ayash (husband/individual man) rai (neigbor/another person) shapah (speech).
So Yahawah pawatz (scattered) them abroad from there on the surface of all the aratz (Earth/land). They stopped banah (building) the iyar (city).

Therefore its qaraa (called) was called Babal (Babel), because there Yahawah confused the shapah (language) of all the aratz (Earth/land). From there, Yahawah pawatz (scattered) them pawatz (abroad) on the surface of all the aratz (Earth/land).

This is the history of the thawaladah (generation) of Sham (Shem). Sham (Shem) was one maah (hundred) shanah (years) ban (son) and became the yalad (birth / begot) Arapakashad (of) Arpachshad two shanah (years) achar (other) the mabawal (flood).

Sham (Shem) chayah (lived) chamash (five) maah (hundred) shanah (years) achar (other) he became the yalad (birth / begot) Arapakashad (of) Arpachshad, and became the yalad (birth / begot) of ban (son) and bath (daughter).
Arapakashad (Arpachshad) chayah (lived) shalawashayam (thirty)- chamash (five) shanah (years) and became the yalad (birth / begot) of Shalach (Shelah).

Arapakashad (Arpachshad) chayah (lived) arabai (four) maah (hundred) shalawash (three) shanah (years) achar (other) he became the yalad (birth / begot) of Shalach (Shelah), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of ban (son) and bath (daughter).
Shalach (Shelah) chayah (lived) shalawashayam (thirty) shanah (years), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of Ibar (Eber):

And Shalach (Shelah) chayah (lived) arabai (four) maah (hundred) shalawash (three) shanah (years) achar (other) he became the yalad (birth / begot) of Ibar (Eber), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of ban (son) and bath (daughter).
Ibar (Eber) chayah (lived) shalawashayam (thirty)- arabai (four) shanah (years), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of Palag (Peleg).

Ibar (Eber) chayah (lived) arabai (four) maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) shanah (years) achar (other) he became the yalad (birth / begot) of Palag (Peleg), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of ban (son) and bath (daughter).
Palag (Peleg) chayah (lived) shalawashayam (thirty) shanah (years), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of Raiw (Reu).

Palag (Peleg) chayah (lived) two maah (hundred) thashai (nine) shanah (years) achar (other) he became the yalad (birth / begot) of Raiw (Reu), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of ban (son) and bath (daughter).
Raiw (Reu) chayah (lived) shalawashayam (thirty)- shanayam (two) shanah (years), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of Sharawag (Serug).

Raiw (Reu) chayah (lived) two maah (hundred) shabai (seven) shanah (years) achar (other) he became the yalad (birth / begot) of Sharawag (Serug), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of ban (son) and bath (daughter).
Sharawag (Serug) chayah (lived) shalawashayam (thirty) shanah (years), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of Nachawar (Nahor).

Sharawag (Serug) chayah (lived) two maah (hundred) shanah (years) achar (other) he became the yalad (birth / begot) of Nachawar (Nahor), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of ban (son) and bath (daughter).
Nachawar (Nahor) chayah (lived) isharayam (twenty)- thashai (nine) shanah (years), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of Tharach (Terah).

Nachawar (Nahor) chayah (lived) one maah (hundred) nineteen shanah (years) achar (other) he became the yalad (birth / begot) of Tharach (Terah), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of ban (son) and bath (daughter).
Tharach (Terah) chayah (lived) shabaiyam (seventy) shanah (years), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of Abaram (Abram), Nachawar (Nahor), and Haran (Haran).

Now this is the history of the thawaladah (generation) of Tharach (Terah). Tharach (Terah) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Abaram (Abram), Nachawar (Nahor), and Haran (Haran). Haran (Haran) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Lawat (Lot).
Haran (Haran) mawath (death) panayam (before) his ab (father) Tharach (Terah) in the aratz (Earth/land) of his birth, in Awar (Ur) of the Kashaday (Chaldees).

Abaram (Abram) and Nachawar (Nahor) laqach (take / seized) wives. The sham (name) of Abaram (Abram's) ashah (wife/individual woman) was Sharay (Sarai), and the sham (name) of Nachawar (Nahor's) ashah (wife/individual woman), Malakah (Milcah), the bath (daughter) of Haran (Haran) who was also the ab (father) of Yasakah (Iscah).
Sharay (Sarai) was iqar (barren). She had no walad (child).

Tharach (Terah) laqach (take / seized) Abaram (Abram) his ban (son), Lawat (Lot) the ban (son) of Haran (Haran), his ban (son) ban (son), and Sharay (Sarai) his kalah (complete / finish), his ban (son) Abaram (Abram's) ashah (wife/individual woman). They yatzaa (go out / come out) from Awar (Ur) of the Kashaday (Chaldees), to yalak (go) into the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan). They bawaa (come) to Charan (Haran) and lived there.
The yawam (day) of Tharach (Terah) were two maah (hundred) chamash (five) shanah (years). Tharach (Terah) mawath (death) in Charan (Haran).

Now Yahawah amar (spoke) to Abaram (Abram), yalak (get) out of your aratz (Earth/land), and from your relatives, and from your ab (father) bayath (house), to the aratz (Earth/land) that I will show you.
I will ishah (make) of you a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) gaway (nation / people). I will barak (bless) you and gadal (make) your sham (name) gadal (great). You will be a barakah (blessing).
I will barak (bless) those who barak (bless) you, and I will arar (curse) him who arar (curses) you. All of the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the adamah (earth) will be barak (blessed) in you.

So Abaram (Abram) yalak (went), as Yahawah had dabar (word / matter) to him. Lawat (Lot) yalak (went) with him. Abaram (Abram) was shabaiyam (seventy)- chamash (five) shanah (years) ban (son) when he departed out of Charan (Haran).

Abaram (Abram) laqach (take / seized) Sharay (Sarai) his ashah (wife/individual woman), Lawat (Lot) his ach (brother/kinsman) ban (son), all their rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions) that they had rakash (gathered), and the napash (living being/soul) whom they ishah (make) gotten in Charan (Haran), and they yatzaa (go out / come out) to yalak (go) into the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan). Into the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan) they bawaa (come).

Abaram (Abram) ibar (pass over/through) through the aratz (Earth/land) to the maqawam (place) of Shakam (Shechem), to the oak of Mawarah (Moreh). The Kanainay (Canaanite) was then in the aratz (Earth/land).

Yahawah raah (see) to Abaram (Abram) and amar (spoke), "I will nathan (give) zaath (this) aratz (Earth/land) to your zarai (seed)." He banah (built) an mazabach (altar) there to Yahawah, who raah (see) to him.

He ithaq (left) from there to the har (mountain) on the qadam (east) of Bayathaal (Bethel), and natah (pitched) his ahal (tent), having Bayathaal (Bethel) on the yam (sea/waters), and Iy (Ai) on the qadam (east). There he banah (built) an mazabach (altar) to Yahawah and qaraa (called) on the sham (name) of Yahawah.
Abaram (Abram) traveled, halak (move) on still toward the nagab (south).
There was a raib (famine) in the aratz (Earth/land). Abaram (Abram) yarad (went) down into Matzarayam (Egypt) to live as a foreigner there, for the raib (famine) was severe in the aratz (Earth/land).

It happened, when he had qarab (come close) near to bawaa (come) Matzarayam (Egypt), that he amar (spoke) to Sharay (Sarai) his ashah (wife/individual woman), hanah (Behold) naa (now), I yadai (know) that you are a yapah (beautiful) ashah (wife/individual woman) to maraah (look) at.

It will happen, when the Matzaray (Egyptians) will raah (see) you, that they will amar (spoke), ‘This is his ashah (wife/individual woman).’ They will harag (kill) me, but they will chayah (save) you alive.
Please amar (spoke) that you are my achawath (sister), that it may be yatab (well) with me for your sake, and that my napash (living being/soul) may chayah (live) galal (because) of you.
It happened that when Abaram (Abram) bawaa (come) come into Matzarayam (Egypt), the Matzaray (Egyptians) raah (see) that the ashah (wife/individual woman) was very yapah (beautiful).

The shar (prince / ruler) of Paraih (Pharaoh) raah (see) her, and halal (praise) her to Paraih (Pharaoh); and the ashah (wife/individual woman) was laqach (take / seized) into Paraih (Pharaoh's) bayath (house).
He dealt yatab (well) with Abaram (Abram) for her sake. He had tzaan (sheep), cattle, male donkeys, male ibad (servant), female shapachah (servants), female donkeys, and gamal (camels).

Yahawah nagai (plagued) Paraih (Pharaoh) and his bayath (house) with gadawal (very great/important/mighty) nagai (plagues) dabar (word / matter) of Sharay (Sarai), Abaram (Abram's) ashah (wife/individual woman).
Paraih (Pharaoh) qaraa (called) Abaram (Abram) and amar (spoke), What is this that you ishah (make) done to me? Why didn't you nagad (tell) me that she was your ashah (wife/individual woman)?

Why did you say, ‘She is my achawath (sister),’ so that I laqach (take / seized) her to be my ashah (wife/individual woman)? Now therefore, see your ashah (wife/individual woman), laqach (take / seized) her, and go your yalak (way).
Paraih (Pharaoh) tzawah (commanded) ayash (husband/individual man) concerning him, and they shalach (send) him on the way with his ashah (wife/individual woman) and all that he had.
Abaram (Abram) ilah (go up / offer) up out of Matzarayam (Egypt): he, his ashah (wife/individual woman), all that he had, and Lawat (Lot) with him, into the nagab (south).
Abaram (Abram) was very kabad (rich) in livestock, in kasap (silver), and in zahab (gold).

He yalak (went) on his masai (journeys) from the nagab (south) even to Bayathaal (Bethel), to the maqawam (place) where his ahal (tent) hayah (came to pass) been at the thachalah (beginning), between Bayathaal (Bethel) and Iy (Ai),
To the maqawam (place) of the mazabach (altar), which he ishah (make) made there at the raashawan (first). There Abaram (Abram) qaraa (called) on the sham (name) of Yahawah.
Lawat (Lot) also, who halak (move) with Abaram (Abram), had tzaan (flocks), and baqar (morning), and ahal (tents).

The aratz (Earth/land) was not nashaa (lift) to bear them, that they might live yachad (together): for their rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions) was rab (great), so that they yakal (could) not live yachad (together).

There was a rayab (strife) between the herdsmen of Abaram (Abram's) livestock and the herdsmen of Lawat (Lot's) livestock: and the Kanainay (Canaanite) and the Parazay (Perizzite) lived in the aratz (Earth/land) at that time.
Abaram (Abram) amar (spoke) to Lawat (Lot), Please, let there be no marayabah (strife) between me and you, and between my herdsmen and your herdsmen; for we are relatives.

Isn't the whole aratz (Earth/land) panayam (before) you? Please parad (separate) yourself from me. If you go to the left shamaawal (left hand), then I will yaman (go) to the right. Or if you go to the right yamayan (right hand), then I will shamaal (go) to the left.

Lawat (Lot) nashaa (lift) up his iyan (eye), and raah (see) all the kakar (plain) of the Yaradan (Jordan), that it was well-watered everywhere, panayam (before) Yahawah shachath (destroyed) Sadam (Sodom) and Imarah (Gomorrah), like the gan (garden) of Yahawah, like the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), as you bawaa (come) to Tzair (Zoar).

So Lawat (Lot) bachar (chose) the kakar (plain) of the Yaradan (Jordan) for himself. Lawat (Lot) traveled qadam (east), and they parad (separated) themselves the ayash (husband/individual man) from the other.
Abaram (Abram) lived in the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan), and Lawat (Lot) lived in the iyar (cities) of the kakar (plain), and moved his ahal (tent) as far as Sadam (Sodom).
Now the ayash (husband/individual man) of Sadam (Sodom) were maad (exceedingly) rai (wicked) and chataa (sinners) against Yahawah.

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Abaram (Abram), achar (other) Lawat (Lot) was parad (separated) from him, Now, nashaa (lift) up your iyan (eye), and raah (see) from the maqawam (place) where you are, northward and southward and eastward and westward,
For all the aratz (Earth/land) which you raah (see), I will nathan (give) to you, and to your zarai (offspring) iwalam (forever).

I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) your zarai (offspring) as the ipar (dust) of the aratz (Earth/land), so that if a ayash (husband/individual man) yakal (can) manah (number) the ipar (dust) of the aratz (Earth/land), then your zarai (seed) may also be manah (numbered).
Qawam (rise up), halak (move) through the aratz (Earth/land) in its arak (length) and in its rachab (breadth); for I will nathan (give) it to you.
Abaram (Abram) moved his ahal (tent), and bawaa (come) and lived by the oaks of Mamaraa (Mamre), which are in Chabarawan (Hebron), and banah (built) an mazabach (altar) there to Yahawah.

It happened in the yawam (day) of Amarapal (Amraphel), malak (king) of Shanair (Shinar), Arayawak (Arioch), malak (king) of Alasar (Ellasar), Kadaralaimar (Chedorlaomer), malak (king) of Iyalam (Elam), and Thadail (Tidal), malak (king) of Goiim,

That they ishah (make) malachamah (war) with Barai (Bera), malak (king) of Sadam (Sodom), and with Barashai (Birsha), malak (king) of Imarah (Gomorrah), Shanaab (Shinab), malak (king) of Adamah (Admah), and Shamaabar (Shemeber), malak (king) of Tzabaayam (Zeboiim), and the malak (king) of Balai (Bela) (the same is Tzair (Zoar)).
All these chabar (joined) together in the imaq (valley) of Shadayam (Siddim) (the same is the malach (salt) yam (sea/waters)).
Ishar (-teen) shanah (years) they ibad (servant) Kadaralaimar (Chedorlaomer), and in the thirteenth shanah (year), they marad (rebelled).

In the fourteenth shanah (year) Kadaralaimar (Chedorlaomer) bawaa (come), and the malak (king) who were with him, and nakah (struck) the Rapaa (Rephaim) in Ashteroth ishatharathaqaranayam (karnaim), and the Zawazayam (Zuzim) in Ham (Ham), and the Ayamayam (Emim) in shawah (shaveh) Kiriathaim,
And the Charay (Horites) in their har (mountain) Shaiyar (Seir), to Ayalapaaran (Elparan), which is by the madabar (wilderness).

They shawab (turn back / repent), and bawaa (come) to Iyanamashapat (En) Mishpat (the same is Qadash (Kadesh)), and nakah (struck) all the shadah (country) of the Imalaqay (Amalekites), and also the Amaray (Amorites), that lived in Hazazon Chatzatzawanathamar (Tamar).

The malak (king) of Sadam (Sodom), and the malak (king) of Imarah (Gomorrah), and the malak (king) of Adamah (Admah), and the malak (king) of Tzabaayam (Zeboiim), and the malak (king) of Balai (Bela) (the same is Tzair (Zoar)) yatzaa (go out / come out) out; and they irak (set) the malachamah (battle) in array against them in the imaq (valley) of Shadayam (Siddim);

Against Kadaralaimar (Chedorlaomer) malak (king) of Iyalam (Elam), and Thadail (Tidal) malak (king) of Goiim, and Amarapal (Amraphel) malak (king) of Shanair (Shinar), and Arayawak (Arioch) malak (king) of Alasar (Ellasar); arabai (four) malak (king) against the chamash (five).

Now the imaq (valley) of Shadayam (Siddim) was full of tar baar (pits); and the malak (king) of Sadam (Sodom) and Imarah (Gomorrah) nawas (fled), and they napal (fall / be cast down) there, and those who shaar (remained) nawas (fled) to the har (mountain).
They laqach (take / seized) all the rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions) of Sadam (Sodom) and Imarah (Gomorrah), and all their akal (food), and went their yalak (way).
They laqach (take / seized) Lawat (Lot), Abaram (Abram's) ach (brother/kinsman) ban (son), who lived in Sadam (Sodom), and his rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions), and departed.

One who had palayat (escaped) bawaa (come) and nagad (told) Abaram (Abram), the ibaray (hebrew). Now he lived by the oaks of Mamaraa (Mamre), the Amaray (Amorite), ach (brother/kinsman) of Ashakal (Eshcol), and ach (brother/kinsman) of Inar (Aner); and these were allies of Abaram (Abram).

When Abaram (Abram) shamai (hearken / hear) that his relative was shabah (taken) captive, he led out his chanayak (trained) men, yalayad (born) in his bayath (house), shalawash (three) maah (hundred) and eighteen, and radap (pursued) as Dan (far) as Dan.

He chalaq (divided) himself against them by layal (night), he and his ibad (servant), and nakah (struck) them, and radap (pursued) them to Chawabah (Hobah), which is on the left shamaawal (left hand) of Damashaq (Damascus).

He shawab (turn back / repent) back all the rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions), and also shawab (turn back / repent) back his relative, Lawat (Lot), and his rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions), and the ashah (wife/individual woman) also, and the im (people / nation).

The malak (king) of Sadam (Sodom) yatzaa (go out / come out) out to qaraah (meet) him, achar (other) his shawab (turn back / repent) from the nakah (slaughter) of Kadaralaimar (Chedorlaomer) and the malak (king) who were with him, at the imaq (valley) of Shawah (Shaveh) (that is, the malak (king) imaq (valley)).
Malakayatzadaq (Melchizedek) malak (king) of Shalam (Salem) yatzaa (go out / come out) out lacham (bread) and yayan (wine): and he was kahan (priest) of Al Most ilayawan (high).
He barak (blessed) him, and amar (spoke), "barak (blessed) be Abaram (Abram) of Al Most ilayawan (high), qanah (possessor) of shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) and aratz (Earth/land):
And barak (blessed) be Al Most ilayawan (high), who has magan (delivered) your tzar (oppressor / distressor) into your yad (hand)." Abram nathan (give) him a maishar (tenth) of all.

The malak (king) of Sadam (Sodom) amar (spoke) to Abaram (Abram), nathan (give) me the napash (living being/soul), and laqach (take / seized) the rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions) to yourself.

Abaram (Abram) amar (spoke) to the malak (king) of Sadam (Sodom), I have rawam (will lift up) up my yad (hand) to Yahawah, Al Most ilayawan (high), qanah (possessor) of shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) and aratz (Earth/land),
That I will not laqach (take / seized) a chawat (thread) nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should amar (spoke), ‘I have ishar (made) Abaram (Abram) ishar (rich).’

I will accept nothing from you except that which the young ayash (husband/individual man) have akal (eat), and the chalaq (portion) of the ayash (husband/individual man) who halak (move) with me: Inar (Aner), Ashakal (Eshcol), and Mamaraa (Mamre). Let them laqach (take / seized) their chalaq (portion).

Achar (other) these things the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah hayah (came to pass) to Abaram (Abram) in a machazah (vision), amar (spoke), Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid), Abaram (Abram). I am your magan (shield), your maad (exceedingly) rabah (great) shakar (reward).

Abaram (Abram) amar (spoke), Adanay Yahawah, what will you nathan (give) me, since I halak (move) irayaray (childless), and he who will inherit my estate is Alayaizar (Eliezer) of Damashaq (Damascus)?
Abaram (Abram) amar (spoke), Behold, to me you nathan (give) given no zarai (seed): and, behold, one ban (son) in my bayath (house) is my heir.
Behold, the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to him, amar (spoke), This yarash (man) will not be your heir, but he who will yatzaa (go out / come out) out of your own body will be your heir.

Yahawah brought him outside, and amar (spoke), "nabat (look) now toward the sky, and sapar (book) the kawakab (star), if you are yakal (able) to sapar (book) them." He amar (spoke) to Abram, So shall your zarai (seed) be.
He aman (believe / have faith) in Yahawah; and he chashab (reckoned) it to him for tzadaqah (righteousness).
He amar (spoke) to him, I am Yahawah who yatzaa (go out / come out) you out of Awar (Ur) of the Kashaday (Chaldees), to nathan (give) you this aratz (Earth/land) to yarash (inherit) it.
He amar (spoke), Adanay Yahawah, mah (how) yadai (will) I know that I will yarash (inherit) it?

He amar (spoke) to him, laqach (take / seized) me a igalah (heifer) shalash (three) years old, a female iz (goat) shalash (three) years old, a ayal (ram) shalash (three) years old, a turtledove, and a gawazal (young) pigeon.

He laqach (take / seized) him all of these, and bathar (divided) them in the thawak (midst), and nathan (give) ayash (husband/individual man) half opposite the other; but he didn't bathar (divide) the tzapawar (birds).
The iyat (birds) of prey yarad (came) down on the carcasses, and Abaram (Abram) nashab (drove) them away.

When the shamash (sun) was bawaa (come) down, a tharadamah (deep) sleep napal (fall / be cast down) on Abaram (Abram). Now ayamah (terror) and gadawal (very great/important/mighty) chashakah (darkness) napal (fall / be cast down) on him.

He amar (spoke) to Abaram (Abram), yadai (know) for yadai (sure) that your zarai (seed) will live as foreigners in a aratz (Earth/land) that is not theirs, and will ibad (servant) them. They will inah (oppress / afflict) them arabai (four) maah (hundred) shanah (years).
I will also dayan (judge) that gaway (nation / people), whom they will ibad (servant). Afterward they will yatzaa (go out / come out) out with gadawal (very great/important/mighty) wealth,
But you will bawaa (come) to your ab (father) in shalawam (peace / safety). You will be qabar (bury) in a tawab (pleasant/functional) shayabah (old age / white hair (due to age)) age.
In the rabayaiy (fourth) dawar (generation / age / period) they will come here again, for the iwan (guilt/iniquity) of the Amaray (Amorite) is not yet shalam (full / whole / complete).

It came to pass that, when the shamash (sun) bawaa (come) down, and it was ilatah (dark), behold, a ishan (smoking) thanawar (furnace), and a ash (fire) lapayad (torch) ibar (pass over/through) bayan (between) these gazar (pieces).

In that yawam (day) Yahawah karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) with Abaram (Abram), amar (spoke), To your zarai (seed) I nathan (give) given this aratz (Earth/land), from the nahar (river) of Matzarayam (Egypt) to the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) nahar (river), the nahar (river) Parath (Euphrates):
The Qayanay (Kenites), the Qanazay (Kenizzites), the Qadamanay (Kadmonites),
The Chathay (Hittites), the Parazay (Perizzites), the Rapaa (Rephaim),
The Amaray (Amorites), the Kanainay (Canaanites), the Garagashay (Girgashites), and the Yabawasay (Jebusites).

Now Sharay (Sarai), Abaram (Abram's) ashah (wife/individual woman), yalad (birth / begot) him no yalad (birth / begot). She had a handmaid, an Matzaray (Egyptian), whose sham (name) was Hagar (Hagar).

Sharay (Sarai) amar (spoke) to Abaram (Abram), "See now, Yahawah has itzar (restrained) me from yalad (birth / begot). Please bawaa (come) in to my handmaid. It awalay (perhaps) be that I will banah (obtain) children by her." Abaram (Abram) shamai (hearken / hear) to the qawal (sound / voice) of Sharay (Sarai).

Sharay (Sarai), Abaram (Abram's) ashah (wife/individual woman), laqach (take / seized) Hagar (Hagar) the Matzaray (Egyptian), her handmaid, qatz (after) Abaram (Abram) had lived ishar (ten) shanah (years) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan), and nathan (give) her to Abaram (Abram) her ayash (husband/individual man) to be his ashah (wife/individual woman).
He bawaa (come) in to Hagar (Hagar), and she harah (conceived). When she raah (see) that she had harah (conceived), her gabarath (mistress) was qalal (despised) in her iyan (eye).

Sharay (Sarai) amar (spoke) to Abaram (Abram), This chamas (wrong) is your fault. I nathan (give) my handmaid into your chayaq (bosom), and when she raah (see) that she had harah (conceived), I was qalal (despised) in her iyan (eye). Yahawah shapat (judge) between me and you.

But Abaram (Abram) amar (spoke) to Sharay (Sarai), "Behold, your shapachah (maid) is in your yad (hand). Ishah (make) to her whatever is tawab (pleasant/functional) in your eyes." Sharay (Sarai) dealt harshly with her, and she barach (fled) from her panayam (face).
The malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah matzaa (found) her by a iyan (eye) of mayam (Waters) in the madabar (wilderness), by the iyan (eye) in the darak (way) to Shawar (Shur).

He amar (spoke), "Hagar (Hagar), Sharay (Sarai's) handmaid, ay (where) did you yalak (come) from? Where are you going?" She amar (spoke), I am fleeing from the panayam (face) of my gabarath (mistress) Sharay (Sarai).
The malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah amar (spoke) to her, shawab (turn back / repent) to your gabarath (mistress), and inah (oppress / afflict) yourself under her yad (hand).
The malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah amar (spoke) to her, I will greatly rabah (multiply) your zarai (seed), that they will not be sapar (book) for rab (multitude).

The malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah amar (spoke) to her, hanah (Behold), you are with harah (child), and will yalad (birth / begot) a ban (son). You shall qaraa (called) his sham (name) Yashamaial (Ishmael), because Yahawah has shamai (hearken / hear) your inay (affliction).
He will be like a paraa (wild) donkey among men. His yad (hand) will be against every man, and every man's yad (hand) against him. He will live opposite all of his ach (brother/kinsman).
She qaraa (called) the sham (name) of Yahawah who dabar (word / matter) to her, "You are a Al who raay (sees)," for she amar (spoke), Have I even stayed alive after seeing him?
Therefore the baar (well) was qaraa (called) Baaralachayaraay (Beer) Lahai Roi. Behold, it is between Qadash (Kadesh) and Barad (Bered).
Hagar (Hagar) yalad (birth / begot) a ban (son) for Abaram (Abram). Abaram (Abram) qaraa (called) the sham (name) of his ban (son), whom Hagar (Hagar) bore, Yashamaial (Ishmael).
Abaram (Abram) was shamanayam (eighty) shash (six) shanah (years) ban (son) when Hagar (Hagar) yalad (birth / begot) Yashamaial (Ishmael) to Abaram (Abram).

When Abaram (Abram) was thashaiyam (ninety)- thashai (nine) shanah (years) ban (son), Yahawah raah (see) to Abaram (Abram), and amar (spoke) to him, I am Al Shaday. Halak (move) panayam (before) me, and be blameless.
I will nathan (give) my barayath (covenant) between me and you, and will rabah (multiply) you maad (exceedingly).
Abaram (Abram) napal (fall / be cast down) on his panayam (face). Alahayam dabar (word / matter) with him, amar (spoke),
As for me, behold, my barayath (covenant) is with you. You will be the ab (father) of a hamawan (multitude) of gaway (nation / people).

Neither will your sham (name) any more be qaraa (called) Abaram (Abram), but your sham (name) will be Abaraham (Abraham); for I nathan (give) made you the ab (father) of a hamawan (multitude) of gaway (nation / people).
