Al is not a ayash (husband/individual man), that he should kazab (lie), nor the ban (son) of adam (man), that he should nacham (turn away / repent). Has he amar (spoke), and will he not ishah (make) it? Or has he dabar (word / matter), and will he not make it qawam (rise up)?
Behold, I have laqach (take / seized) a command to barak (bless). He has barak (blessed), and I can't shawab (turn back / repent) it.

He nabat (has) not seen awan (iniquity) in Yaiqab (Jacob). Neither raah (see) he seen imal (perverseness) in Yasharaal (Israel). Yahawah his Alahayam is with him. The tharawaih (shout) of a malak (king) is among them.
Al yatzaa (go out / come out) them out of Matzarayam (Egypt). He has as it were the thawaipah (strength) of the wild ox.

Surely there is no nachash (enchantment) with Yaiqab (Jacob); Neither is there any qasam (divination) with Yasharaal (Israel). Now it shall be amar (spoke) of Yaiqab (Jacob) and of Yasharaal (Israel), What has Al pail (done)!

Behold, the im (people / nation) qawam (rise up) up as a labayaa (lioness), As a labayaa (lion) he nashaa (lift) himself up. He shall not shakab (lie) down until he akal (eat) of the tarap (prey), and shathah (drinks) the dam (blood) of the chalal (slain).
Balaq (Balak) amar (spoke) to Balaim (Balaam), Neither naqab (curse) them at qabab (all), nor barak (bless) them at qabab (all).
But Balaim (Balaam) inah (answer / respond) Balaq (Balak), Didn't I dabar (word / matter) you, amar (spoke), ‘All that Yahawah dabar (word / matter), that I must ishah (make)?’

Balaq (Balak) amar (spoke) to Balaim (Balaam), yalak (come) now, I will laqach (take / seized) you to achar (other) maqawam (place); perhaps it will yashar (please) Alahayam that you may qabab (curse) me them from there.
Balaq (Balak) laqach (take / seized) Balaim (Balaam) to the raash (head) of Paiwar (Peor), that shaqap (looks) down on the yashayamawan (desert).
Balaim (Balaam) amar (spoke) to Balaq (Balak), banah (build) me here shabai (seven) mazabach (altars), and kawan (prepare) me here shabai (seven) par (bulls) and shabai (seven) ayal (rams).
Balaq (Balak) ishah (make) as Balaim (Balaam) had amar (spoke), and ilah (go up / offer) up a par (bull) and a ayal (ram) on every mazabach (altar).

When Balaim (Balaam) raah (see) that it iyan (eye) Yahawah to barak (bless) Yasharaal (Israel), he didn't halak (move), as at the other paim (times), to qaraah (meet) with nachash (enchantments), but he shayath (put / appoint / make) his panayam (face) toward the madabar (wilderness).
Balaim (Balaam) nashaa (lift) up his iyan (eye), and he raah (see) Yasharaal (Israel) shakan (dwelling) according to their shabat (tribes); and the rawach (spirit / wind) of Alahayam came on him.
He nashaa (lift) up his mashal (parable), and amar (spoke), Balaim (Balaam) the ban (son) of Baiwar (Beor) amar (spoke), the gabar (man) whose iyan (eye) was closed naam (declares (prophetically));

He naam (declares (prophetically)), who shamai (hearken / hear) the amar (spoke) of Al, who chazah (sees) the machazah (vision) of the Shaday, napal (fall / be cast down) down, and having his iyan (eye) galah (open):
How tawab (pleasant/functional) are your ahal (tents), Yaiqab (Jacob), and your mashakan (tents), Yasharaal (Israel)!
As nachal (stream / river) they are natah (spread) forth, as ganah (gardens) by the riverside, as ahalayam (aloes) which Yahawah has natai (planted), as araz (cedar) trees beside the mayam (Waters).

Mayam (Waters) shall nazal (flow) from his dalay (buckets). His zarai (seed) shall be in many mayam (Waters). His malak (king) shall be higher than Agag (Agag). His malakawath (kingdom) shall be nashaa (lift).

Al yatzaa (go out / come out) him out of Matzarayam (Egypt). He has as it were the thawaipah (strength) of the wild ox. He shall akal (eat) up the gaway (nation / people) his tzar (oppressor / distressor), shall garam (break) their itzam (bones) in pieces, and machatz (crush / shatter) them with his chatz (arrows).

He karai (couched), he shakab (lay) down as a aray (lion), as a labayaa (lioness); who shall qawam (rise up) him up? Everyone who blesses you is barak (blessed). Everyone who arar (curses) you is cursed.

Balaq (Balak's) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) was charah (hot with anger) against Balaim (Balaam), and he sapaq (struck) his kap (hands) together; and Balaq (Balak) amar (spoke) to Balaim (Balaam), I qaraa (called) you to qabab (curse) my ayab (enemy), and, behold, you have barak (altogether) barak (blessed) them these shalawash (three) paim (times).
Therefore now barach (flee) you to your maqawam (place)! I amar (spoke) to kabad (promote) you to kabad (great) honor; but, behold, Yahawah has manai (kept) you back from honor.
Balaim (Balaam) amar (spoke) to Balaq (Balak), Didn't I also dabar (word / matter) your malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) who you shalach (send) to me, amar (spoke),

‘If Balaq (Balak) nathan (give) give me his bayath (house) malaa (full) of kasap (silver) and zahab (gold), I can't ibar (pass over/through) beyond the pah (word) of Yahawah, to ishah (make) either tawab (pleasant/functional) or rai (bad) of my own lab (heart). I will dabar (word / matter) what Yahawah dabar (word / matter)’?

Now, behold, I halak (move) to my im (people / nation): yalak (come), I will inform you what this im (people / nation) shall ishah (make) to your im (people / nation) in the acharayath (latter) yawam (day).
He nashaa (lift) up his mashal (parable), and amar (spoke), Balaim (Balaam) the ban (son) of Baiwar (Beor) amar (spoke), the gabar (man) whose iyan (eye) was closed naam (declares (prophetically));

He naam (declares (prophetically)), who shamai (hearken / hear) the amar (spoke) of Al, yadai (knows) the daith (knowledge) of the Most ilayawan (high), and who chazah (sees) the machazah (vision) of the Shaday, napal (fall / be cast down) down, and having his iyan (eye) galah (open):

I raah (see) him, but not now. I raah (see) him, but not qarawab (near). A kawakab (star) will darak (come) out of Yaiqab (Jacob). A scepter will qawam (rise up) out of Yasharaal (Israel), and shall machatz (crush / shatter) through the paah (corners) of Mawaab (Moab), and qawar (break) down all the ban (son) of Shath (Sheth).

Adam (Edom) shall be a yarashah (possession). Shaiyar (Seir), his ayab (enemy), also shall be a yarashah (possession), while Yasharaal (Israel) ishah (make) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor).
Out of Yaiqab (Jacob) shall one radah (rule over / have dominion of / subdue) dominion, and shall abad (destroy/perish) the sharayad (remnant) from the iyar (city).

He raah (see) at Imalaq (Amalek), and nashaa (lift) up his mashal (parable), and amar (spoke), Imalaq (Amalek) was the raashayath (beginning) of the gaway (nation / people), But his acharayath (latter) id (end) shall come to destruction.

He raah (see) at the Qayanay (Kenite), and nashaa (lift) up his mashal (parable), and amar (spoke), Your mawashab (dwelling) place is ayathan (strong). Your qan (nest) is shawam (place / establish / appoint) in the salai (rock).
Qayan (Nevertheless) Kain shall be bair (wasted), until Ashawar (Asshur) shabah (carries) you away captive.
He nashaa (lift) up his mashal (parable), and amar (spoke), away (alas), who shall chayah (live) when Al shawam (place / establish / appoint) this?

But tzay (ships) shall come from the yad (hand) of Kathay (Kittim). They shall inah (oppress / afflict) Ashawar (Asshur), and shall inah (oppress / afflict) Ibar (Eber). He also shall come to destruction.
Balaim (Balaam) qawam (rise up) up, and yalak (went) and shawab (turn back / repent) to his maqawam (place); and Balaq (Balak) also halak (move) his darak (way).
Yasharaal (Israel) stayed in Shatayam (Shittim); and the im (people / nation) chalal (began) to zanah (play) the prostitute with the bath (daughter) of Mawaab (Moab):
For they qaraa (called) the im (people / nation) to the zabach (sacrifices) of their Alahayam; and the im (people / nation) akal (eat), and shachah (bowed) down to their Alahayam.
Yasharaal (Israel) tzamad (joined) himself to Bailapaiwar (Baal) Peor: and the ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah was charah (hot with anger) against Yasharaal (Israel).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), laqach (take / seized) all the raash (head) of the im (people / nation), and yaqai (hang) them up to Yahawah before the shamash (sun), that the charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah may shawab (turn back / repent) away from Yasharaal (Israel).

Mashah (Moses) amar (spoke) to the shapat (judges) of Yasharaal (Israel), ayash (husband/individual man) ayash (husband/individual man) harag (kill) his ayash (husband/individual man) who have tzamad (joined) themselves to Bailapaiwar (Baal) Peor.

Behold, ayash (husband/individual man) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) bawaa (come) and qarab (come close) to his ach (brother/kinsman) a Madayanay (Midianite) woman in the iyan (eye) of Mashah (Moses), and in the iyan (eye) of all the idah (congregation) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), while they were bakah (weeping) at the pathach (door) of the ahal (tent) of Meeting.

When Payanachas (Phinehas), the ban (son) of Alaizar (Eleazar), the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron) the kahan (priest), raah (see) it, he qawam (rise up) up from the thawak (midst) of the idah (congregation), and laqach (take / seized) a ramach (spear) in his yad (hand);

And he bawaa (come) achar (other) the ayash (husband/individual man) of Yasharaal (Israel) into the pavilion, and thrust shanayam (two) of them through, the ayash (husband/individual man) of Yasharaal (Israel), and the ashah (wife/individual woman) al (through) her body. So the magapah (plague) was itzar (stayed) from the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel).
Those who mawath (death) by the magapah (plague) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

Payanachas (Phinehas), the ban (son) of Alaizar (Eleazar), the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron) the kahan (priest), has shawab (turn back / repent) my chamah (wrath) shawab (turn back / repent) from the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), in that he was qanaa (jealous) with my qanaah (jealousy) thawak (midst) them, so that I didn't kalah (complete / finish) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) in my qanaah (jealousy).
Therefore amar (spoke), ‘Behold, I nathan (give) to him my barayath (covenant) of shalawam (peace / safety):

And it shall be to him, and to his zarai (seed) achar (other) him, the barayath (covenant) of an iwalam (forever) kahanah (priesthood); ashar (who/that) he was qanaa (jealous) for his Alahayam, and made kapar (atonement) for the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel).’

Now the sham (name) of the ayash (husband/individual man) of Israel that was nakah (slain), who was nakah (slain) with the Madayanay (Midianite) woman, was Zamaray (Zimri), the ban (son) of Salaw (Salu), a nashayaa (prince) of a ab (father)' bayath (house) among the Shamainay (Simeonites).

The sham (name) of the Madayanay (Midianite) ashah (wife/individual woman) who was nakah (slain) was Kazabay (Cozbi), the bath (daughter) of Tzawar (Zur); he was raash (head) of the amah (people) of a ab (father)' bayath (house) in Madayan (Midian).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),
Harass the Madayanay (Midianites), and nakah (strike) them;

For they harassed you with their nakal (wiles), with which they have deceived you in the dabar (word / matter) of Paiwar (Peor), and in the dabar (word / matter) of Kazabay (Cozbi), the bath (daughter) of the nashayaa (prince) of Madayan (Midian), their achawath (sister), who was nakah (slain) on the yawam (day) of the magapah (plague) in the dabar (word / matter) of Paiwar (Peor).
It happened al (after) the plague, that Yahawah amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses) and to Alaizar (Eleazar) the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron) the kahan (priest), amar (spoke),

Nashaa (lift) a census of all the idah (congregation) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, by their ab (father)' bayath (house), all who are yatzaa (go out / come out) to go forth to tzabaa (troop) in Yasharaal (Israel).
Mashah (Moses) and Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest) dabar (word / matter) with them in the irabah (plains) of Mawaab (Moab) by the Yaradan (Jordan) at Yarayachaw (Jericho), amar (spoke),

"Take a census, from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward; as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses) and the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel)." These are those that yatzaa (go out / come out) out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt).

Raawaban (Reuben), the bakawar (firstborn) of Yasharaal (Israel); the ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben): of Chanawak (Hanoch), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the chanakay (hanochites); of Palawaa (Pallu), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the palaay (palluites);
Of Chatzarawan (Hezron), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the chatzarawanay (hezronites); of Karamay (Carmi), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the karamay (carmites).

These are the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Raawabanay (Reubenites); and those who were paqad (visit) of them were arabaiyam (forty) - shalawash (three) alap (thousand) shabai (seven) maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty).
The ban (son) of Palawaa (Pallu): Alayaab (Eliab).

The ban (son) of Alayaab (Eliab): Namawaal (Nemuel), and Dathan (Dathan), and Abayaram (Abiram). These are that Dathan (Dathan) and Abayaram (Abiram), who were called of the idah (congregation), who natzah (strove) against Mashah (Moses) and against Aharawan (Aaron) in the idah (company) of Qarach (Korah), when they natzah (strove) against Yahawah,

And the aratz (Earth/land) pathach (opened) its pah (mouth), and balai (swallowed) them up together with Qarach (Korah), when that idah (company) mawath (death); what time the ash (fire) akal (eat) two maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) ayash (husband/individual man), and they became a nas (sign).
Notwithstanding, the ban (son) of Qarach (Korah) didn't mawath (death).

The ban (son) of Shamaiwan (Simeon) after their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family): of Namawaal (Nemuel), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the namawaalay (nemuelites); of Yamayan (Jamin), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the yamayanay (jaminites); of Yakayan (Jachin), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the yakayanay (jachinites);
Of Zarach (Zerah), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Zerahites; of Shaawal (Shaul), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the shaawalay (shaulites).
These are the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Shamainay (Simeonites), isharayam (twenty) - shanayam (two) alap (thousand) two maah (hundred).

The ban (son) of Gad (Gad) after their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family): of Tzapawan (Zephon), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the tzapawanay (zephonites); of Chagay (Haggi), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Chagay (Haggites); of Shawanay (Shuni), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the shawanay (shunites);
Of azanay (ozni), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the azanay (oznites); of Iray (Eri), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the iray (erites);
Of Arawad (Arod), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the arawaday (arodites); of Araalay (Areli), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Araalay (Arelites).
These are the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the ban (son) of Gad (Gad) according to those who were paqad (visit) of them, arabaiyam (forty) alap (thousand) and chamash (five) maah (hundred).
The ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah): Ir (Er) and Awanan (Onan); and Ir (Er) and Awanan (Onan) mawath (death) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan).

The ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah) after their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) were: of Shalah (Shelah), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the shalanay (shelanites); of Paratz (Perez), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Perezites; of Zarach (Zerah), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Zerahites.

The ban (son) of Paratz (Perez) were: of Chatzarawan (Hezron), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the chatzarawanay (hezronites); of Chamawal (Hamul), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the chamawalay (hamulites).
These are the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of Yahawadah (Judah) according to those who were paqad (visit) of them, shabaiyam (seventy) - six alap (thousand) chamash (five) maah (hundred).

The ban (son) of Yashashakar (Issachar) after their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family): of Thawalai (Tola), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the thawalaiy (tolaites); Pawaah (of) Puvah, the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the pawanay (punites);
Of Yashawab (Jashub), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the yashabay (jashubites); of Shamarawan (Shimron), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the shamaranay (shimronites).

These are the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of Yashashakar (Issachar) according to those who were paqad (visit) of them, shashayam (sixty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand) shalawash (three) maah (hundred).

The ban (son) of Zabawalawan (Zebulun) after their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family): of Sarad (Sered), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Seredites; of Ayalawan (Elon), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the alawanay (elonites); of Yachalaal (Jahleel), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the yachalaalay (jahleelites).
These are the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Zabawalanay (Zebulunites) according to those who were paqad (visit) of them, shashayam (sixty) alap (thousand) chamash (five) maah (hundred).
The ban (son) of Yawasap (Joseph) after their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family): Manashah (Manasseh) and Aparayam (Ephraim).

The ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh): of Makayar (Machir), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Machirites; and Makayar (Machir) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Galaid (Gilead); of Galaid (Gilead), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Galaiday (Gileadites).
These are the ban (son) of Galaid (Gilead): Ayaizar (of) Iezer, the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Iezerites; of Chalaq (Helek), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Helekites;
And Asharayaal (Asriel), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the asharaalay (asrielites); and Shakam (Shechem), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Shakamay (Shechemites);
And Shamayadai (Shemida), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the shamayadaiy (shemidaites); and Chapar (Hepher), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the chaparay (hepherites).

Tzalapachad (Zelophehad) the ban (son) of Chapar (Hepher) had no ban (son), but bath (daughter): and the sham (name) of the bath (daughter) of Tzalapachad (Zelophehad) were Machalah (Mahlah), and Naih (Noah), Chagalah (Hoglah), Malakah (Milcah), and Tharatzah (Tirzah).
These are the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of Manashah (Manasseh); and those who were paqad (visit) of them were chamashayam (fifty) - shanayam (two) alap (thousand) shabai (seven) maah (hundred).

These are the ban (son) of Aparayam (Ephraim) after their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family): of Shawathalach (Shuthelah), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Shuthelahites; of Bakar (Becher), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Becherites; of Thachan (Tahan), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the thachanay (tahanites).
These are the ban (son) of Shawathalach (Shuthelah): of Iran (Eran), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the iranay (eranites).

These are the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the ban (son) of Aparayam (Ephraim) according to those who were paqad (visit) of them, shalawashayam (thirty) - shanayam (two) alap (thousand) chamash (five) maah (hundred). These are the ban (son) of Yawasap (Joseph) after their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family).

The ban (son) of Banayamayan (Benjamin) after their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family): of Balai (Bela), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the balaiy (belaites); of Ashabal (Ashbel), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the ashabalay (ashbelites); of Achayaram (Ahiram), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the achayaramay (ahiramites);
Shapawapam (of) Shephupham, the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the shawapamay (shuphamites); of Chawapam (Hupham), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the chawapamay (huphamites).

The ban (son) of Balai (Bela) were Arad (Ard) and Naiman (Naaman): the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the araday (ardites); of Naiman (Naaman), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the naimay (naamites).

These are the ban (son) of Banayamayan (Benjamin) after their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family); and those who were paqad (visit) of them were arabaiyam (forty) - chamash (five) alap (thousand) shash (six) maah (hundred).

These are the ban (son) Dan (of) Dan after their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family): of Shawacham (Shuham), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the shawachamay (shuhamites). These are the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) Dan (of) Dan after their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family).

All the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the shawachamay (shuhamites), according to those who were paqad (visit) of them, were shashayam (sixty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand) arabai (four) maah (hundred).

The ban (son) of Ashar (Asher) after their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family): of Yamanah (Imnah), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) Yamanah (of) the Imnites; of Ishvi, the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Ishvites; of Barayaih (Beriah), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Berites.

Of the ban (son) of Barayaih (Beriah): of Chabar (Heber), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the chabaray (heberites); of Malakayaal (Malchiel), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the malakayaalay (malchielites).
The sham (name) of the bath (daughter) of Ashar (Asher) was Sharach (Serah).

These are the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the ban (son) of Ashar (Asher) according to those who were paqad (visit) of them, chamashayam (fifty) - shalawash (three) alap (thousand) and arabai (four) maah (hundred).

The ban (son) of Napathalay (Naphtali) after their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family): of Yachatzaal (Jahzeel), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the yachatzaalay (jahzeelites); of Gawanay (Guni), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the gawanay (gunites);
Of Yatzar (Jezer), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the yatzaray (jezerites); of Shalam (Shillem), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the shalamay (shillemites).

These are the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of Napathalay (Naphtali) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family); and those who were paqad (visit) of them were arabaiyam (forty) - chamash (five) alap (thousand) arabai (four) maah (hundred).
These are those who were paqad (visit) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), shash (six) maah (hundred) alap (one) alap (thousand) shabai (seven) maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),
To these the aratz (Earth/land) shall be chalaq (divided) for an nachalah (inheritance) according to the masapar (number) of sham (name).

To the more you shall rabah (give) the more nachalah (inheritance), and to the fewer you shall mait (give) the less nachalah (inheritance): to everyone pah (according) to those who were paqad (visit) of him shall his nachalah (inheritance) be nathan (give).
Notwithstanding, the aratz (Earth/land) shall be chalaq (divided) by gawaral (lot): according to the sham (name) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of their ab (father) they shall nachal (inherit).
Pah (according) to the gawaral (lot) shall their nachalah (inheritance) be chalaq (divided) between the more and the fewer.

These are those who were paqad (visit) of the Lawayay (Levites) after their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family): of Garashawan (Gershon), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the garashanay (gershonites); of Qahath (Kohath), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Qahathay (Kohathites); of Mararay (Merari), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Mararay (Merarites).

These are the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of Levi: the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the labanay (libnites), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the chabarawanay (hebronites), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the machalay (mahlites), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the mawashay (mushites), the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the qarachay (korahites). Qahath (Kohath) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Imaram (Amram).

The sham (name) of Imaram (Amram's) ashah (wife/individual woman) was Yawakabad (Jochebed), the bath (daughter) of Laway (Levi), who was yalad (birth / begot) to Laway (Levi) in Matzarayam (Egypt): and she yalad (birth / begot) to Imaram (Amram) Aharawan (Aaron) and Mashah (Moses), and Marayam (Miriam) their achawath (sister).
To Aharawan (Aaron) were yalad (birth / begot) Nadab (Nadab) and Abayahawaa (Abihu), Alaizar (Eleazar) and Ayathamar (Ithamar).
Nadab (Nadab) and Abayahawaa (Abihu) mawath (death), when they qarab (come close) zawar (strange) ash (fire) panayam (before) Yahawah.

Those who were paqad (visit) of them were isharayam (twenty) - shalawash (three) alap (thousand), every zakar (remembrance/memory) from a chadash (month) ban (son) and upward: for they were not paqad (visit) thawak (midst) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), because there was no nachalah (inheritance) nathan (give) them thawak (midst) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel).

These are those who were paqad (visit) by Mashah (Moses) and Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), who paqad (visit) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) in the irabah (plains) of Mawaab (Moab) by the Yaradan (Jordan) at Yarayachaw (Jericho).

But among these there was not a ayash (husband/individual man) of them who were paqad (visit) by Mashah (Moses) and Aharawan (Aaron) the kahan (priest), who paqad (visit) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) in the madabar (wilderness) of Sayanay (Sinai).

For Yahawah had amar (spoke) of them, They shall mawath (death) mawath (death) in the madabar (wilderness). There was not yathar (left) a ayash (husband/individual man) of them, except Kalab (Caleb) the ban (son) of Yapanah (Jephunneh), and Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun).

Then qarab (come close) near the bath (daughter) of Tzalapachad (Zelophehad), the ban (son) of Chapar (Hepher), the ban (son) of Galaid (Gilead), the ban (son) of Makayar (Machir), the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh), of the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of Manashah (Manasseh) the ban (son) of Yawasap (Joseph); and these are the sham (name) of his bath (daughter): Machalah (Mahlah), Naih (Noah), and Chagalah (Hoglah), and Malakah (Milcah), and Tharatzah (Tirzah).

They imad (stood) panayam (before) Mashah (Moses), and panayam (before) Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), and panayam (before) the nashayaa (princes) and all the idah (congregation), at the pathach (door) of the ahal (tent) of Meeting, amar (spoke),

Our ab (father) mawath (death) in the madabar (wilderness), and he was not thawak (midst) the idah (company) of those who yaid (gathered) themselves together against Yahawah in the idah (company) of Qarach (Korah): but he mawath (death) in his own chataa (sin); and he had no ban (son).

Why should the sham (name) of our ab (father) be taken garai (away) from thawak (midst) his mashapachah (tribe/clan/family), because he had no ban (son)? Nathan (give) to us a achazah (possession) thawak (midst) the ach (brother/kinsman) of our ab (father).
Mashah (Moses) qarab (come close) their cause panayam (before) Yahawah.
Yahawah amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

The bath (daughter) of Tzalapachad (Zelophehad) dabar (word / matter) kan (for sure): you shall nathan (give) nathan (give) them a achazah (possession) of an nachalah (inheritance) thawak (midst) their ab (father) ach (brother/kinsman); and you shall cause the nachalah (inheritance) of their ab (father) to ibar (pass over/through) to them.

You shall dabar (word / matter) to the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), amar (spoke), ‘If a ayash (husband/individual man) mawath (death), and has no ban (son), then you shall cause his nachalah (inheritance) to ibar (pass over/through) to his bath (daughter).
If he has no bath (daughter), then you shall nathan (give) his nachalah (inheritance) to his ach (brother/kinsman).
If he has no ach (brother/kinsman), then you shall nathan (give) his nachalah (inheritance) to his ab (father) ach (brother/kinsman).

If his ab (father) has no ach (brother/kinsman), then you shall nathan (give) his nachalah (inheritance) to his kinsman who is qarawab (next) to him of his mashapachah (tribe/clan/family), and he shall yarash (possess) it: and it shall be to the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) a chaqah (statute) and mashapat (ordinance), as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses).’

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), "ilah (go up / offer) up into this har (mountain) of Ibarayam (Abarim), and raah (see) the aratz (Earth/land) which I nathan (give) given to the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel).
When you raah (see) seen it, you also shall be asap (gathered) to your im (people / nation), as Aharawan (Aaron) your ach (brother/kinsman) was asap (gathered);

Because you marah (rebelled) against my pah (word) in the madabar (wilderness) of Tzan (Zin), in the marayabah (strife) of the idah (congregation), to qadash (set apart/make holy) me at the mayam (Waters) before their iyan (eye)." (These are the mayam (Waters) of Marayabah (Meribah) of Qadash (Kadesh) in the madabar (wilderness) of Tzan (Zin).)
Mashah (Moses) dabar (word / matter) to Yahawah, amar (spoke),
Let Yahawah, the Alahayam of the rawach (spirit / wind) of all bashar (flesh), paqad (visit) a ayash (husband/individual man) over the idah (congregation),

Who may yatzaa (go out / come out) out panayam (before) them, and who may bawaa (come) in panayam (before) them, and who may yatzaa (go out / come out) them out, and who may bawaa (come) them in; that the idah (congregation) of Yahawah not be as tzaan (sheep) which have no raih (shepherd).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), laqach (take / seized) Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun), a ayash (husband/individual man) in whom is the rawach (spirit / wind), and samak (lay) your yad (hand) on him;
And imad (set) him panayam (before) Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), and panayam (before) all the idah (congregation); and commission him in their iyan (eye).
You shall nathan (give) of your honor on him, that all the idah (congregation) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) may shamai (hearken / hear).

He shall imad (stand) panayam (before) Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), who shall inquire for him by the mashapat (judgment) of the awarayam (urim) panayam (before) Yahawah: at his pah (word) shall they yatzaa (go out / come out) out, and at his pah (word) they shall bawaa (come) in, both he, and all the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) with him, even all the idah (congregation).

Mashah (Moses) ishah (make) as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) him; and he laqach (take / seized) Yahawashawai (Joshua), and imad (set) him panayam (before) Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), and panayam (before) all the idah (congregation):
And he samak (laid) his yad (hand) on him, and commissioned him, as Yahawah dabar (word / matter) by Mashah (Moses).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

Tzawah (command) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), and amar (spoke) them, ‘My qaraban (offering), my food for my qaraban (offerings) made by ashah (wife/individual woman), of a pleasant aroma to me, you shall shamar (keep/guard) to qarab (come close) to me in their mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) season.’

You shall amar (spoke) them, ‘This is the ashah (wife/individual woman) made by fire which you shall qarab (come close) to Yahawah: male kabash (lambs) a shanah (year) old thamayam (complete / whole) blemish, shanayam (two) yawam (day) by day, for a thamayad (continual) burnt ilah (offering).
You shall ishah (make) the achad (one) kabash (lamb) in the baqar (morning), and you shall ishah (make) the other kabash (lamb) at irab (evening);

With the ishayaray (tenth) part of an ayapah (ephah) of fine salath (flour) for a meal manachah (offering), balal (mixed) with the rabayaiy (fourth) part of a hayan (hin) of kathayath (beaten) shaman (oil).
It is a thamayad (continual) burnt ilah (offering), which was ordained in har (mountain) Sayanay (Sinai) for a pleasant aroma, an ashah (wife/individual woman) made by fire to Yahawah.

Its drink nasak (offering) shall be the rabayaiy (fourth) part of a hayan (hin) for the achad (one) kabash (lamb). You shall nasak (pour) out a drink nasak (offering) of shakar (strong) drink to Yahawah in the qadash (set apart/make holy) place.

The other kabash (lamb) you shall ishah (make) at irab (evening): as the meal manachah (offering) of the baqar (morning), and as the drink nasak (offering) of it, you shall ishah (make) it, an ashah (wife/individual woman) made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahawah.

‘On the shabath (shabath/rest) yawam (day) shanayam (two) male kabash (lambs) a shanah (year) old thamayam (complete / whole) blemish, and shanayam (two) isharawan (tenth) parts of an ephah of fine salath (flour) for a meal manachah (offering), balal (mixed) with shaman (oil), and the drink nasak (offering) of it:
This is the burnt ilah (offering) of every shabath (shabath/rest), besides the thamayad (continual) burnt ilah (offering), and the drink nasak (offering) of it.

‘In the raash (head) of your chadash (month) you shall qarab (come close) a burnt ilah (offering) to Yahawah: shanayam (two) young par (bulls), and achad (one) ayal (ram), shabai (seven) male kabash (lambs) a shanah (year) old thamayam (complete / whole) blemish;

And shalawash (three) isharawan (tenth) parts of an ephah of fine salath (flour) for a meal manachah (offering), balal (mixed) with shaman (oil), for achad (one) par (bull); and shanayam (two) isharawan (tenth) parts of fine salath (flour) for a meal manachah (offering), balal (mixed) with shaman (oil), for the achad (one) ayal (ram);

And a isharawan (tenth) part of fine salath (flour) balal (mixed) with shaman (oil) for a meal manachah (offering) to achad (one) kabash (lamb); for a burnt ilah (offering) of a pleasant aroma, an ashah (wife/individual woman) made by fire to Yahawah.

Their drink nasak (offerings) shall be chatzay (half) a hayan (hin) of yayan (wine) for a par (bull), and the shalayashay (third) part of a hayan (hin) for the ayal (ram), and the rabayaiy (fourth) part of a hayan (hin) for a kabash (lamb): this is the burnt ilah (offering) of every chadash (month) throughout the chadash (month) of the shanah (year).
Achad (one) male iz (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering to Yahawah; it shall be ishah (make) besides the thamayad (continual) burnt ilah (offering), and the drink ilah (offering) of it.
‘In the raashawan (first) chadash (month), on the fourteenth yawam (day) of the month, is yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) pasach (passover).
On the fifteenth yawam (day) of this chadash (month) shall be a chag (feast/festival): shabai (seven) yawam (day) shall unleavened matzah (bread) be akal (eat).
In the raashawan (first) yawam (day) shall be a qadash (set apart/make holy) maqaraa (convocation): you shall ishah (make) no servile malaakah (work);

But you shall qarab (come close) an ashah (wife/individual woman) made by fire, a burnt ilah (offering) to Yahawah: shanayam (two) young par (bulls), and achad (one) ayal (ram), and shabai (seven) male kabash (lambs) a shanah (year) old; they shall be to you thamayam (complete / whole) blemish;

And their meal manachah (offering), fine salath (flour) balal (mixed) with shaman (oil): you shall ishah (make) shalawash (three) isharawan (tenth) parts for a par (bull), and shanayam (two) isharawan (tenth) parts for the ayal (ram).
You shall ishah (make) a isharawan (tenth) part for achad (one) kabash (lamb) of the shabai (seven) kabash (lambs);
And achad (one) male shaiyar (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering, to make kapar (atonement) for you.
You shall ishah (make) these besides the burnt ilah (offering) of the baqar (morning), which is for a thamayad (continual) burnt ilah (offering).

In this way you shall ishah (make) yawam (day), for shabai (seven) yawam (day), the lacham (food) of the ashah (wife/individual woman) made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahawah: it shall be ishah (make) besides the thamayad (continual) burnt ilah (offering), and the drink ilah (offering) of it.
On the shabayaiy (seventh) yawam (day) you shall have a qadash (set apart/make holy) maqaraa (convocation): you shall ishah (make) no servile malaakah (work).

‘Also in the yawam (day) of the bakawar (first) fruits, when you qarab (come close) a chadash (new) meal manachah (offering) to Yahawah in your feast of shabawai (weeks), you shall have a qadash (set apart/make holy) maqaraa (convocation); you shall ishah (make) no servile malaakah (work);

But you shall qarab (come close) a burnt ilah (offering) for a pleasant aroma to Yahawah: shanayam (two) young par (bulls), achad (one) ayal (ram), shabai (seven) male kabash (lambs) a shanah (year) old;

And their meal manachah (offering), fine salath (flour) balal (mixed) with shaman (oil), shalawash (three) isharawan (tenth) parts for achad (one) par (bull), shanayam (two) isharawan (tenth) parts for the achad (one) ayal (ram),
A isharawan (tenth) part for achad (one) kabash (lamb) of the shabai (seven) kabash (lambs);
Achad (one) male shaiyar (goat), to make kapar (atonement) for you.

Besides the thamayad (continual) burnt ilah (offering), and the meal ilah (offering) of it, you shall ishah (make) them (they shall be to you thamayam (complete / whole) blemish), and their drink nasak (offerings).

‘In the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month), on the achad (one) day of the chadash (month), you shall have a qadash (set apart/make holy) maqaraa (convocation); you shall ishah (make) no servile malaakah (work): it is a yawam (day) of tharawaih (blowing) of trumpets to you.

You shall ishah (make) a burnt ilah (offering) for a pleasant aroma to Yahawah: achad (one) young par (bull), achad (one) ayal (ram), shabai (seven) male kabash (lambs) a shanah (year) old thamayam (complete / whole) blemish;

And their meal manachah (offering), fine salath (flour) balal (mixed) with shaman (oil), shalawash (three) isharawan (tenth) parts for the par (bull), shanayam (two) isharawan (tenth) parts for the ayal (ram),
And achad (one) isharawan (tenth) part for achad (one) kabash (lamb) of the shabai (seven) kabash (lambs);
And achad (one) male shaiyar (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering, to make kapar (atonement) for you;

Besides the burnt ilah (offering) of the new chadash (month), and the meal manachah (offering) of it, and the thamayad (continual) burnt ilah (offering) and the meal manachah (offering) of it, and their drink nasak (offerings), according to their mashapat (ordinance), for a pleasant aroma, an ashah (wife/individual woman) made by fire to Yahawah.

‘On the ishawar (tenth) day of this shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month) you shall have a qadash (set apart/make holy) maqaraa (convocation); and you shall inah (oppress / afflict) your napash (living being/soul): you shall ishah (make) no kind of malaakah (work);

But you shall qarab (come close) a burnt ilah (offering) to Yahawah for a pleasant aroma: achad (one) young par (bull), achad (one) ayal (ram), shabai (seven) male kabash (lambs) a shanah (year) old; they shall be to you thamayam (complete / whole) blemish;

And their meal manachah (offering), fine salath (flour) balal (mixed) with shaman (oil), shalawash (three) isharawan (tenth) parts for the par (bull), shanayam (two) isharawan (tenth) parts for the achad (one) ayal (ram),
A isharawan (tenth) part for achad (one) kabash (lamb) of the shabai (seven) kabash (lambs):

Achad (one) male shaiyar (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering; besides the chataah (sin) offering of kapar (atonement), and the thamayad (continual) burnt chataah (sin), and the meal ilah (offering) of it, and their drink manachah (offerings).

‘On the fifteenth yawam (day) of the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month) you shall have a qadash (set apart/make holy) maqaraa (convocation); you shall ishah (make) no servile malaakah (work), and you shall chagag (keep) a chag (feast/festival) to Yahawah shabai (seven) yawam (day):

And you shall qarab (come close) a burnt ilah (offering), an ashah (wife/individual woman) made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahawah; thirteen young par (bulls), shanayam (two) ayal (rams), fourteen male kabash (lambs) a shanah (year) old; they shall be thamayam (complete / whole) blemish;

And their meal manachah (offering), fine salath (flour) balal (mixed) with shaman (oil), shalawash (three) isharawan (tenth) parts for achad (one) par (bull) of the thirteen par (bulls), shanayam (two) isharawan (tenth) parts for achad (one) ayal (ram) of the shanayam (two) ayal (rams),
And a isharawan (tenth) part for achad (one) kabash (lamb) of the fourteen kabash (lambs);
And achad (one) male iz (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering, besides the thamayad (continual) burnt chataah (sin), the meal chataah (sin) of it, and the drink nasak (offering) of it.

‘On the shanay (second) yawam (day) you shall offer shanayam (two) ban (son) par (bulls), shanayam (two) ayal (rams), fourteen male kabash (lambs) a shanah (year) old thamayam (complete / whole) blemish;

And their meal manachah (offering) and their drink nasak (offerings) for the par (bulls), for the ayal (rams), and for the kabash (lambs), according to their masapar (number), after the mashapat (ordinance);
And achad (one) male iz (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering; besides the thamayad (continual) burnt chataah (sin), and the meal ilah (offering) of it, and their drink manachah (offerings).
‘On the shalayashay (third) yawam (day) ishathay (eleven) par (bulls), shanayam (two) ayal (rams), fourteen male kabash (lambs) a shanah (year) old thamayam (complete / whole) blemish;

And their meal manachah (offering) and their drink nasak (offerings) for the par (bulls), for the ayal (rams), and for the kabash (lambs), according to their masapar (number), after the mashapat (ordinance);
And achad (one) male shaiyar (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering; besides the thamayad (continual) burnt chataah (sin), and the meal ilah (offering) of it, and the drink nasak (offering) of it.
‘On the rabayaiy (fourth) yawam (day) ishar (ten) par (bulls), shanayam (two) ayal (rams), fourteen male kabash (lambs) a shanah (year) old thamayam (complete / whole) blemish;

Their meal manachah (offering) and their drink nasak (offerings) for the par (bulls), for the ayal (rams), and for the kabash (lambs), according to their masapar (number), after the mashapat (ordinance);
And achad (one) male iz (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering; besides the thamayad (continual) burnt chataah (sin), the meal chataah (sin) of it, and the drink nasak (offering) of it.
‘On the chamayashay (fifth) yawam (day) thashai (nine) par (bulls), shanayam (two) ayal (rams), fourteen male kabash (lambs) a shanah (year) old thamayam (complete / whole) blemish;

And their meal manachah (offering) and their drink nasak (offerings) for the par (bulls), for the ayal (rams), and for the kabash (lambs), according to their masapar (number), after the mashapat (ordinance);
And achad (one) male shaiyar (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering, besides the thamayad (continual) burnt ilah (offering), and the meal manachah (offering) of it, and the drink nasak (offering) of it.
‘On the shashay (sixth) yawam (day) shamanah (eight) par (bulls), shanayam (two) ayal (rams), fourteen male kabash (lambs) a shanah (year) old thamayam (complete / whole) blemish;

And their meal manachah (offering) and their drink nasak (offerings) for the par (bulls), for the ayal (rams), and for the kabash (lambs), according to their masapar (number), after the mashapat (ordinance);
And achad (one) male shaiyar (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering; besides the thamayad (continual) burnt ilah (offering), the meal manachah (offering) of it, and the drink nasak (offerings) of it.
‘On the shabayaiy (seventh) yawam (day) shabai (seven) par (bulls), shanayam (two) ayal (rams), fourteen male kabash (lambs) a shanah (year) old thamayam (complete / whole) blemish;

And their meal manachah (offering) and their drink nasak (offerings) for the par (bulls), for the ayal (rams), and for the kabash (lambs), according to their masapar (number), after the mashapat (ordinance);
And achad (one) male shaiyar (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering; besides the thamayad (continual) burnt ilah (offering), the meal manachah (offering) of it, and the drink nasak (offering) of it.
‘On the shamayanay (eighth) yawam (day) you shall have a solemn itzarah (assembly): you shall ishah (make) no servile malaakah (work);

But you shall qarab (come close) a burnt ilah (offering), an ashah (wife/individual woman) made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahawah: achad (one) par (bull), achad (one) ayal (ram), shabai (seven) male kabash (lambs) a shanah (year) old thamayam (complete / whole) blemish;

Their meal manachah (offering) and their drink nasak (offerings) for the par (bull), for the ayal (ram), and for the kabash (lambs), shall be according to their masapar (number), after the mashapat (ordinance):
And achad (one) male shaiyar (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering, besides the thamayad (continual) burnt chataah (sin), and the meal ilah (offering) of it, and the drink nasak (offering) of it.

‘You shall ishah (make) these to Yahawah in your mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) feasts, besides your nadar (vow), and your freewill nadabah (voluntary / freewill offering), for your burnt ilah (offerings), and for your meal manachah (offerings), and for your drink nasak (offerings), and for your shalam (peace) offerings.’
Mashah (Moses) amar (spoke) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) according to all that Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses).
Mashah (Moses) amar (spoke) to the heads of the tribes of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), amar (spoke), This is the thing which Yahawah has tzawah (commanded).

When a raash (head) vows a vow to Yahawah, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his dabar (word / matter); he shall dabar (word / matter) according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.
Also when a woman nadar (make vow) a nadar (vow) to Yahawah, and asar (binds) herself by a asar (bond), being in her father's house, in her youth,

And her ab (father) hears her nadar (vow), and her asar (bond) with which she has asar (bound) her soul, and her ab (father) holds his peace at her; then all her nadar (vow) shall stand, and every asar (bond) with which she has asar (bound) her soul shall stand.

But if her ab (father) disallow her in the day that he shamai (hearken / hear), none of her nadar (vow), or of her asar (bonds) with which she has asar (bound) her napash (living being/soul), shall qawam (rise up): and Yahawah will forgive her, because her ab (father) disallowed her.
If she has a husband, while her nadar (vow) are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has asar (bound) her napash (living being/soul),

And her ayash (husband/individual man) hears it, and hold his peace at her in the hayah (came to pass) that he hears it; then her nadar (vow) shall stand, and her asar (bonds) with which she has asar (bound) her napash (living being/soul) shall stand.

But if her ayash (husband/individual man) forbids her in the yawam (day) that he shamai (hearken / hear) it, then he shall make void her nadar (vow) which is on her, and the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has asar (bound) her napash (living being/soul): and Yahawah will forgive her.
But the nadar (vow) of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has asar (bound) her napash (living being/soul), shall stand against her.
If she nadar (vow) in her husband's alamanah (house), or asar (bound) her napash (living being/soul) by a asar (bond) with an oath,

And her ayash (husband/individual man) heard it, and held his peace at her, and didn't disallow her; then all her nadar (make vow) shall stand, and every asar (bond) with which she asar (bound) her napash (living being/soul) shall stand.

But if her ayash (husband/individual man) shamai (hearken / hear) them null and void in the day that he shamai (hearken / hear) them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her nadar (vow), or concerning the asar (bond) of her napash (living being/soul), shall not qawam (rise up): her ayash (husband/individual man) has shamai (hearken / hear) them void; and Yahawah will forgive her.

Every nadar (vow), and every asar (binding) oath to afflict the napash (living being/soul), her ayash (husband/individual man) may qawam (rise up) it, or her ayash (husband/individual man) may parar (make) it void.

But if her ayash (husband/individual man) kal (every) hold his peace at her from shabawaih (day) to shabawaih (day), then he establishes all her nadar (vow), or all her asar (bonds), which are on her: he has qawam (rise up) them, because he held his peace at her in the shabawaih (day) that he heard them.
But if he shall qawam (rise up) them null and void al (after) that he has shamai (hearken / hear) them, then he shall bear her iniquity.
These are the statutes, which Yahawah commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father's house.
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),
Naqam (avenge) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) for the Madayanay (Midianites). Afterward you shall be asap (gathered) to your im (people / nation).

Mashah (Moses) dabar (word / matter) to the im (people / nation), amar (spoke), chalatz (arm) im (people / nation) from among you for the tzabaa (troop), that they may go against Madayan (Midian), to execute yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) vengeance on Madayan (Midian).
Of every matah (staff / rod / tribe) one alap (thousand), throughout all the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Yasharaal (Israel), you shall shalach (send) to the tzabaa (troop).

So there were masar (delivered), out of the alap (thousands) of Yasharaal (Israel), a alap (thousand) of every matah (staff / rod / tribe), shanayam (two) alap (thousand) chalatz (armed) for tzabaa (troop).

Mashah (Moses) shalach (send) them, one alap (thousand) of every matah (staff / rod / tribe), to the tzabaa (troop), them and Payanachas (Phinehas) the ban (son) of Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), to the tzabaa (troop), with the kalay (vessels) of the qadash (set apart/make holy) and the chatzatzarah (trumpets) for the tharawaih (alarm) in his yad (hand).
They tzabaa (troop) against Madayan (Midian), as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses); and they harag (killed) every zakar (remembrance/memory).

They harag (killed) the malak (king) of Madayan (Midian) with the rest of their chalal (slain): Away (Evi), and Raqam (Rekem), and Tzawar (Zur), and Chawar (Hur), and Rabai (Reba), the chamash (five) malak (king) of Madayan (Midian): Balaim (Balaam) also the ban (son) of Baiwar (Beor) they harag (killed) with the charab (sword).

The ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) shabah (took) captive the ashah (wife/individual woman) of Madayan (Midian) and their little tap (ones); and all their livestock, and all their maqanah (flocks), and all their chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), they bazaz (took) for a prey.
All their iyar (cities) in the mawashab (places) in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burnt with ash (fire).
They laqach (take / seized) all the shalal (spoil), and all the malaqawach (prey), both of adam (man) and of animal.

They bawaa (come) the shabay (captives), and the malaqawach (prey), and the shalal (spoil), to Mashah (Moses), and to Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), and to the idah (congregation) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), to the machanah (camp) at the irabah (plains) of Mawaab (Moab), which are by the Yaradan (Jordan) at Yarayachaw (Jericho).

Mashah (Moses), and Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), and all the nashayaa (princes) of the idah (congregation), yatzaa (go out / come out) forth to qaraah (meet) them outside of the machanah (camp).

Mashah (Moses) was qatzap (angry) with the paqad (visit) of the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), the shar (prince / ruler) of alap (thousands) and the shar (prince / ruler) of maah (hundred), who bawaa (come) from the service of the malachamah (war).
Mashah (Moses) amar (spoke) to them, Have you chayah (saved) all the women chayah (alive)?

Behold, these hayah (came to pass) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), through the dabar (word / matter) of Balaim (Balaam), to masar (commit) mail (top/above) against Yahawah in the dabar (word / matter) of Paiwar (Peor), and so the magapah (plague) was among the idah (congregation) of Yahawah.

Now therefore harag (kill) every zakar (remembrance/memory) among the little tap (ones), and harag (kill) every ashah (wife/individual woman) who yadai (has) known ayash (husband/individual man) by lying with him.
But all the girls, who yadai (have) not known zakar (remembrance/memory) by lying with him, chayah (keep) alive for yourselves.

Chanah (encamp) outside of the machanah (camp) shabai (seven) yawam (day): whoever has harag (killed) any napash (living being/soul), and whoever has nagai (touched) any chalal (slain), chataa (purify) yourselves on the shalayashay (third) yawam (day) and on the shabayaiy (seventh) yawam (day), you and your shabay (captives).
As to every bagad (garment), and all that is kalay (made) of iwar (skin), and all maishah (work) of iz (goats)' hair, and all things kalay (made) of itz (wood), you shall chataa (purify) yourselves.

Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest) amar (spoke) to the ayash (husband/individual man) of tzabaa (troop) who bawaa (come) to the malachamah (battle), This is the chaqah (statute) of the thawarah (instruction) which Yahawah has tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses):
However the zahab (gold), and the kasap (silver), the nachashath (brass), the barazal (iron), the badayal (divide), and the iwaparath (lead),

Everything that may withstand the ash (fire), you shall ibar (pass over/through) to go through the ash (fire), and it shall be tahar (clean); nevertheless it shall be chataa (purified) with the mayam (Waters) for impurity: and all that doesn't withstand the ash (fire) you shall ibar (pass over/through) to go through the mayam (Waters).
You shall kabas (wash) your clothes on the shabayaiy (seventh) yawam (day), and you shall be tahar (clean); and afterward you shall bawaa (come) into the machanah (camp).
Yahawah amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

Nashaa (lift) the raash (head) of the malaqawach (prey) that shabay (was) taken, both of adam (man) and of animal, you, and Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), and the raash (head) of the ab (father)' households of the idah (congregation);

And chatzah (divide) the malaqawach (prey) into chatzah (two) parts: between the men skilled in malachamah (war), who yatzaa (go out / come out) out to tzabaa (troop), and all the idah (congregation).

Rawam (will lift up) a makas (tribute) to Yahawah of the ayash (husband/individual man) of malachamah (war) who yatzaa (go out / come out) out to tzabaa (troop): achad (one) napash (living being/soul) of chamash (five) maah (hundred); of the adam (persons), of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the tzaan (flocks).
Laqach (take / seized) it of their machatzayath (half), and nathan (give) it to Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), for yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) wave tharawamah (offering).

Of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel's) machatzayath (half), you shall laqach (take / seized) achad (one) drawn out of every chamashayam (fifty), of the adam (persons), of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the tzaan (flocks), of all the livestock, and nathan (give) them to the Lawayay (Levites), who perform the duty of the mashakan (tabernacle) of Yahawah.
Mashah (Moses) and Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest) ishah (make) as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses).

Now the baz (prey), over and above the malaqawach (booty) which the im (people / nation) of tzabaa (troop) bazaz (took), was shash (six) maah (hundred) shabaiyam (seventy) - chamash (five) alap (thousand) tzaan (sheep),
And shabaiyam (seventy) - two alap (thousand) baqar (morning) of cattle,
And shashayam (sixty) - achad (one) alap (thousand) donkeys,

And shalawashayam (thirty) - shanayam (two) alap (thousand) napash (living being/soul) in kal (every), of the ashah (wife/individual woman) who yadai (had) not known zakar (remembrance/memory) by lying with him.

The machatzah (half), which was the chalaq (portion) of those who yatzaa (go out / come out) out to tzabaa (troop), was in masapar (number) shalawash (three) maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) - shabai (seven) alap (thousand) chamash (five) maah (hundred) tzaan (sheep):
And yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) makas (tribute) of the tzaan (sheep) was shash (six) maah (hundred) shabaiyam (seventy) - five.
The cattle were shalawashayam (thirty) - shash (six) alap (thousand); of which yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) makas (tribute) was shabaiyam (seventy) - two.
The donkeys were shalawashayam (thirty) alap (thousand) chamash (five) maah (hundred); of which yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) makas (tribute) was shashayam (sixty) - achad (one).
The adam (persons) were sixteen alap (thousand); of whom yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) makas (tribute) was shalawashayam (thirty) - shanayam (two) napash (living being/soul).

Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) the makas (tribute), which was yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) wave tharawamah (offering), to Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses).
Of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel's) machatzayath (half), which Mashah (Moses) chatzah (divided) off from the ban (son) who tzabaa (troop)
(Now the idah (congregation's) machatzah (half) was shalawash (three) maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) - shabai (seven) alap (thousand) chamash (five) maah (hundred) tzaan (sheep),
And shalawashayam (thirty) - shash (six) alap (thousand) baqar (morning) of cattle,
And shalawashayam (thirty) alap (thousand) chamash (five) maah (hundred) donkeys,
And sixteen alap (thousand) napash (living being/soul)),

Even of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel's) machatzayath (half), Mashah (Moses) laqach (take / seized) achad (one) drawn out of every chamashayam (fifty), both of adam (man) and of animal, and nathan (give) them to the Lawayay (Levites), who performed the duty of the mashakan (tabernacle) of Yahawah; as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses).

The paqad (visit) who were over the alap (thousands) of the tzabaa (troop), the shar (prince / ruler) of alap (thousands), and the shar (prince / ruler) of maah (hundred), qarab (come close) near to Mashah (Moses);

And they amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), Your ibad (servant) have nashaa (lift) the raash (head) of the raash (head) of malachamah (war) who are under our command, and there paqad (visit) not one ayash (husband/individual man) of us.

We have qarab (come close) yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) qaraban (offering), what every ayash (husband/individual man) matzaa (has) gotten, of kalay (jewels) of zahab (gold), armlets, and tzamayad (bracelets), signet tabaith (rings), igayal (earrings), and necklaces, to make kapar (atonement) for our napash (living being/soul) panayam (before) Yahawah.
Mashah (Moses) and Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest) laqach (take / seized) their zahab (gold), even all maishah (worked) kalay (jewels).

All the zahab (gold) of the wave tharawamah (offering) that they rawam (will lift up) up to Yahawah, of the shar (prince / ruler) of alap (thousands), and of the shar (prince / ruler) of maah (hundred), was sixteen alap (thousand) shabai (seven) maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) shaqal (shekels).
(The ayash (husband/individual man) of tzabaa (troop) had bazaz (taken) booty, every ayash (husband/individual man) for himself.)

Mashah (Moses) and Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest) laqach (take / seized) the zahab (gold) of the shar (prince / ruler) of alap (thousands) and of maah (hundred), and bawaa (come) it into the ahal (tent) of Meeting, for a zakarawan (memorial) for the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) panayam (before) Yahawah.

Now the ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben) and the ban (son) of Gad (Gad) had a very itzawam (great) rab (multitude) of livestock: and when they raah (see) the aratz (Earth/land) of Yaizayar (Jazer), and the aratz (Earth/land) of Galaid (Gilead), that behold, the maqawam (place) was a maqawam (place) for livestock;

The ban (son) of Gad (Gad) and the ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben) bawaa (come) and amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), and to Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), and to the nashayaa (princes) of the idah (congregation), amar (spoke),
Itarawath (Ataroth), and Dayabawan (Dibon), and Yaizayar (Jazer), and Namarah (Nimrah), and Chashabawan (Heshbon), and Alailaa (Elealeh), and Shabam (Sebam), and Nabaw (Nebo), and Bain (Beon),
The aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah nakah (struck) panayam (before) the idah (congregation) of Yasharaal (Israel), is a aratz (Earth/land) for livestock; and your ibad (servant) have livestock.

They amar (spoke), If we matzaa (have) found favor in your iyan (eye), let this aratz (Earth/land) be nathan (give) to your ibad (servant) for a achazah (possession); don't ibar (pass over/through) us over the Yaradan (Jordan).

Mashah (Moses) amar (spoke) to the ban (son) of Gad (Gad), and to the ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben), Shall your ach (brother/kinsman) bawaa (come) to the malachamah (war), and shall you yashab (inhabit/dwell) here?
Why do you discourage the lab (heart) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) from ibar (pass over/through) over into the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah nathan (give) given them?
Your ab (father) ishah (make) so when I shalach (send) them Qadashabaranai (from) Kadesh Barnea to raah (see) the aratz (Earth/land).

For when they ilah (go up / offer) up to the nachal (stream / river) of Ashakal (Eshcol), and raah (see) the aratz (Earth/land), they nawaa (discouraged) the lab (heart) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), that they should not bawaa (come) into the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah nathan (give) given them.
Yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) was charah (hot with anger) in that yawam (day), and he shabai (swear / take oath), amar (spoke),

‘Am (mother) none of the ayash (husband/individual man) who ilah (go up / offer) up out of Matzarayam (Egypt), from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, shall raah (see) the adamah (land) which I shabai (swear / take oath) to Abaraham (Abraham), to Yatzachaq (Isaac), and to Yaiqab (Jacob); because they malaa (have) not wholly achar (other) me:
Except Kalab (Caleb) the ban (son) of Yapanah (Jephunneh) the Qanazay (Kenizzite), and Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun); because they have achar (other) Yahawah completely.’

Yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) was charah (hot with anger) against Yasharaal (Israel), and he nawai (made) them wander back and forth in the madabar (wilderness) arabaiyam (forty) shanah (years), until all the dawar (generation / age / period), who ishah (make) done rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, was thamam (consumed).

Behold, you have qawam (rise up) up in your ab (father)' place, an tharabawath (increase) of chataa (sinful) ayash (husband/individual man), to sapah (augment) yet the charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah toward Yasharaal (Israel).
For if you shawab (turn back / repent) away from achar (other) him, he will yet again yanach (leave) them in the madabar (wilderness); and you will shachath (destroy) all this im (people / nation).
They nagash (came) near to him, and amar (spoke), We will banah (build) sheepfolds here for our livestock, and iyar (cities) for our little tap (ones):

But we anachanaw (ourselves) will be chawash (ready) chalatz (armed) to go panayam (before) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), until we bawaa (come) brought them to their maqawam (place): and our little tap (ones) shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the fortified iyar (cities) panayam (because) of the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the aratz (Earth/land).
We will not shawab (turn back / repent) to our bayath (house), until the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) nachal (have) inherited every ayash (husband/individual man) his nachalah (inheritance).

For we will not nachal (inherit) with them on the other ibar (side) of the Yaradan (Jordan), and halaah (forward); because our nachalah (inheritance) is bawaa (come) to us on ibar (this) side of the Yaradan (Jordan) eastward.
Mashah (Moses) amar (spoke) to them, If you will ishah (make) this thing, if you will chalatz (arm) yourselves to go panayam (before) Yahawah to the malachamah (war),
And every chalatz (armed) ibar (pass over/through) of you will pass over the Yaradan (Jordan) panayam (before) Yahawah, until he has yarash (driven) out his ayab (enemy) from panayam (before) him,

And the aratz (Earth/land) is kabash (subdued) panayam (before) Yahawah; then afterward you shall shawab (turn back / repent), and be naqay (guiltless) towards Yahawah, and towards Yasharaal (Israel); and this aratz (Earth/land) shall be to you for a achazah (possession) panayam (before) Yahawah.
But if you will not ishah (make) so, behold, you have chataa (sinned) against Yahawah; and be yadai (sure) your chataah (sin) will matzaa (find) you out.
Banah (build) iyar (cities) for your little tap (ones), and folds for your tzanaa (sheep); and ishah (make) that which yatzaa (go out / come out) proceeded out of your pah (mouth).
The ban (son) of Gad (Gad) and the ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben) amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke), Your ibad (servant) will ishah (make) as my Adawan tzawah (commands).
Our little tap (ones), our wives, our maqanah (flocks), and all our livestock, shall be there in the iyar (cities) of Galaid (Gilead);
But your ibad (servant) will ibar (pass over/through) over, every chalatz (man) who is armed for tzabaa (troop), panayam (before) Yahawah to malachamah (battle), as my Adawan dabar (word / matter).

So Mashah (Moses) tzawah (commanded) concerning them to Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), and to Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun), and to the raash (head) of the ab (father)' households of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel).

Mashah (Moses) amar (spoke) to them, If the ban (son) of Gad (Gad) and the ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben) will ibar (pass over/through) with you over the Yaradan (Jordan), every chalatz (man) who is armed to malachamah (battle), panayam (before) Yahawah, and the aratz (Earth/land) shall be kabash (subdued) panayam (before) you; then you shall nathan (give) them the aratz (Earth/land) of Galaid (Gilead) for a achazah (possession):
But if they will not ibar (pass over/through) over with you chalatz (armed), they shall have achaz (possessions) thawak (midst) you in the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan).
The ban (son) of Gad (Gad) and the ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben) inah (answer / respond), amar (spoke), As Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) to your ibad (servant), so will we ishah (make).

We will ibar (pass over/through) over chalatz (armed) panayam (before) Yahawah into the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan), and the achazah (possession) of our nachalah (inheritance) shall remain with us ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan).

Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) to them, even to the ban (son) of Gad (Gad), and to the ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben), and to the chatzay (half) - shabat (tribe) of Manashah (Manasseh) the ban (son) of Yawasap (Joseph), the mamalakah (kingdom) of Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of the Amaray (Amorites), and the mamalakah (kingdom) of Iwag (Og) malak (king) of Bashan (Bashan), the aratz (Earth/land), according to its iyar (cities) and gabawalah (borders), even the iyar (cities) of the surrounding aratz (Earth/land).
The ban (son) of Gad (Gad) banah (built) Dayabawan (Dibon), and Itarawath (Ataroth), and Irawair (Aroer),
And Itarawathashawapan (Atrothshophan), and Yaizayar (Jazer), and Yagabahah (Jogbehah),
And Bayathanamarah (Beth) Nimrah, and Bayathaharan (Beth) Haran: fortified iyar (cities), and folds for tzaan (sheep).
The ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben) banah (built) Chashabawan (Heshbon), and Alailaa (Elealeh), and Qarayathayam (Kiriathaim),
And Nabaw (Nebo), and Bailamaiwan (Baal) Meon, (their sham (name) being changed), and Shabam (Sibmah): and they gave other sham (name) to the iyar (cities) which they banah (built).
The ban (son) of Makayar (Machir) the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh) yalak (went) to Galaid (Gilead), and lakad (took) it, and yarash (dispossessed) the Amaray (Amorites) who were therein.
Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) Galaid (Gilead) to Makayar (Machir) the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh); and he lived therein.
Yaayar (Jair) the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh) halak (move) and lakad (took) its chawah (town/named location), and qaraa (called) them Havvoth chawawathayaiyar (jair).
Nabach (Nobah) halak (move) and lakad (took) Qanath (Kenath), and its bath (daughter), and qaraa (called) it Nabach (Nobah), after his own sham (name).

These are the masai (journeys) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), when they yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) by their tzabaa (troop) under the yad (hand) of Mashah (Moses) and Aharawan (Aaron).

Mashah (Moses) kathab (wrote) their mawatzaa (goings) out according to their masai (journeys) by the commandment of Yahawah: and these are their masai (journeys) according to their mawatzaa (goings) out.

They traveled from Raimasas (Rameses) in the raashawan (first) chadash (month), on the fifteenth yawam (day) of the raashawan (first) chadash (month); on the next macharath (day) after the pasach (passover) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) yatzaa (go out / come out) out with a rawam (will lift up) yad (hand) in the iyan (eye) of all the Ban (Egyptians),
While the Matzaray (Egyptians) were qabar (bury) all their bakawar (firstborn), whom Yahawah had nakah (struck) among them: on their Alahayam also Yahawah ishah (make) shapat (judgments).
The ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) traveled from Raimasas (Rameses), and chanah (encamped) in Sakawath (Succoth).
They traveled from Sakawath (Succoth), and chanah (encamped) in Atham (Etham), which is in the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the madabar (wilderness).

They traveled from Atham (Etham), and shawab (turn back / repent) back to Payahachayarath (Pihahiroth), which is before Bailatzapawan (Baal) Zephon: and they chanah (encamped) panayam (before) Magadawal (Migdol).

They traveled from panayam (before) Hahiroth, and passed ibar (pass over/through) the thawak (midst) of the yam (sea/waters) into the madabar (wilderness): and they yalak (went) shalawash (three) yawam (day)' darak (journey) in the madabar (wilderness) of Atham (Etham), and chanah (encamped) in Marah (Marah).

They traveled from Marah (Marah), and bawaa (come) to Ayalam (Elim): and in Ayalam (Elim) were shanayam (two) springs of mayam (Waters), and shabaiyam (seventy) thamar (palm) trees; and they chanah (encamped) there.
They traveled from Ayalam (Elim), and chanah (encamped) by the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters).
They traveled from the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters), and chanah (encamped) in the madabar (wilderness) of sayan (sin).
They traveled from the madabar (wilderness) of sayan (sin), and chanah (encamped) in Dapaqah (Dophkah).
They traveled from Dapaqah (Dophkah), and chanah (encamped) in Alawash (Alush).
They traveled from Alawash (Alush), and chanah (encamped) in Rapayadayam (Rephidim), where there was no mayam (Waters) for the im (people / nation) to shathah (drinks).
They traveled from Rapayadayam (Rephidim), and chanah (encamped) in the madabar (wilderness) of Sayanay (Sinai).
They traveled from the madabar (wilderness) of Sayanay (Sinai), and chanah (encamped) in Qabarawathahathaawah (Kibroth) Hattaavah.
They traveled from Qabarawathahathaawah (Kibroth) Hattaavah, and chanah (encamped) in Chatzarawath (Hazeroth).
They traveled from Chatzarawath (Hazeroth), and chanah (encamped) in Rathamah (Rithmah).
They traveled from Rathamah (Rithmah), and chanah (encamped) in Ramanaparatz (Rimmon) Perez.
They traveled from Ramanaparatz (Rimmon) Perez, and chanah (encamped) in Labanah (Libnah).
They traveled from Labanah (Libnah), and chanah (encamped) in Rasah (Rissah).
They traveled from Rasah (Rissah), and chanah (encamped) in Qahalathah (Kehelathah).
They traveled from Qahalathah (Kehelathah), and chanah (encamped) in har (mountain) Shapar (Shepher).
They traveled from har (mountain) Shapar (Shepher), and chanah (encamped) in Charadah (Haradah).
They traveled from Charadah (Haradah), and chanah (encamped) in Maqahalath (Makheloth).
They traveled from Maqahalath (Makheloth), and chanah (encamped) in Thachath (Tahath).
They traveled from Thachath (Tahath), and chanah (encamped) in Tharach (Terah).
They traveled from Tharach (Terah), and chanah (encamped) Mathaqah (in) Mithkah.
They traveled Mathaqah (from) Mithkah, and chanah (encamped) in Chashamanah (Hashmonah).
They traveled from Chashamanah (Hashmonah), and chanah (encamped) in Mawasarah (Moseroth).
They traveled from Mawasarah (Moseroth), and chanah (encamped) in Banayayaiqan (Bene) Jaakan.
They traveled from Banayayaiqan (Bene) Jaakan, and chanah (encamped) in Charahagadagad (Hor) Haggidgad.
They traveled from Charahagadagad (Hor) Haggidgad, and chanah (encamped) in Yatabathah (Jotbathah).
They traveled from Yatabathah (Jotbathah), and chanah (encamped) Ibaranah (in) Abronah.
They traveled Ibaranah (from) Abronah, and chanah (encamped) in Itzayawanagabar (Ezion) Geber.
They traveled from Itzayawanagabar (Ezion) Geber, and chanah (encamped) in the madabar (wilderness) of Tzan (Zin) (the same is Qadash (Kadesh)).
They traveled from Qadash (Kadesh), and chanah (encamped) in har (mountain) Har (Hor), in the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the aratz (Earth/land) of Adam (Edom).

Aharawan (Aaron) the kahan (priest) ilah (go up / offer) up into har (mountain) Har (Hor) at the commandment of Yahawah, and mawath (death) there, in the fortieth shanah (year) after the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) yatzaa (go out / come out) come out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), in the chamayashay (fifth) chadash (month), on the achad (one) day of the month.
Aharawan (Aaron) was one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shalawash (three) shanah (years) ban (son) when he mawath (death) in har (mountain) Har (Hor).

The Kanainay (Canaanite), the malak (king) of Irad (Arad), who lived in the nagab (south) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan), shamai (hearken / hear) of the bawaa (come) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel).
They traveled from har (mountain) Har (Hor), and chanah (encamped) in Tzalamanah (Zalmonah).
They traveled from Tzalamanah (Zalmonah), and chanah (encamped) in Pawanan (Punon).
They traveled from Pawanan (Punon), and chanah (encamped) in Abath (Oboth).
They traveled from Abath (Oboth), and chanah (encamped) in Iye Iyayahaibarayam (Abarim), in the gabawal (border/boundary) of Mawaab (Moab).
They traveled Iyayam (from) Iyim, and chanah (encamped) in Dayabawan (Dibon) Gad.
They traveled from Dayabawan (Dibon) Gad, and chanah (encamped) Ilamanadabalathayamah (in) Almon Diblathaim.
They traveled Ilamanadabalathayamah (from) Almon Diblathaim, and chanah (encamped) in the har (mountain) of Ibarayam (Abarim), panayam (before) Nabaw (Nebo).
They traveled from the har (mountain) of Ibarayam (Abarim), and chanah (encamped) in the irabah (plains) of Mawaab (Moab) by the Yaradan (Jordan) at Yarayachaw (Jericho).
They chanah (encamped) by the Yaradan (Jordan), from Bayathahayashayamawath (Beth) Jeshimoth Abalahashatayam (even) to Abel Shittim in the irabah (plains) of Mawaab (Moab).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses) in the irabah (plains) of Mawaab (Moab) by the Yaradan (Jordan) at Yarayachaw (Jericho), amar (spoke),
Dabar (word / matter) to the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), and amar (spoke) them, When you ibar (pass over/through) over the Yaradan (Jordan) into the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan),

Then you shall yarash (drive) out all the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the aratz (Earth/land) from panayam (before) you, abad (destroy/perish) all their mashakayath (idol/carved image) idols, abad (destroy/perish) all their masakah (molten) tzalam (likeness), and demolish all their bamah (high) places.
You shall take yarash (possession) of the aratz (Earth/land), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein; for I nathan (give) given the aratz (Earth/land) to you to yarash (possess) it.

You shall nachal (inherit) the aratz (Earth/land) by gawaral (lot) according to your mashapachah (tribe/clan/family); to the more you shall give the more nachalah (inheritance), and to the fewer you shall mait (give) the less nachalah (inheritance): wherever the gawaral (lot) yatzaa (go out / come out) to any man, that shall be his. You shall nachal (inherit) according to the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of your ab (father).

But if you do not yarash (drive) out the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the aratz (Earth/land) from panayam (before) you, then those you yathar (let) remain of them will be as shak (pricks) in your iyan (eye) and as tzanayan (thorns) in your tzad (sides), and they will harass you in the aratz (Earth/land) in which you yashab (inhabit/dwell).
It shall happen that as I damah (thought) to ishah (make) to them, so will I ishah (make) to you.
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

Tzawah (command) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), and amar (spoke) them, ‘When you bawaa (come) into the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan) (this is the aratz (Earth/land) that shall napal (fall / be cast down) to you for an nachalah (inheritance), even the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan) according to its gabawalah (borders)),

Then your nagab (south) paah (quarter) shall be from the madabar (wilderness) of Tzan (Zin) along by the yad (hand) of Adam (Edom), and your nagab (south) gabawal (border/boundary) shall be from the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the malach (salt) yam (sea/waters) eastward;

And your gabawal (border/boundary) shall sabab (turn) about southward of the mailahaiqarabayam (ascent) of mailahaiqarabayam (akrabbim), and ibar (pass over/through) along to Tzan (Zin); and the thawatzaah (goings) out of it shall be southward Qadashabaranai (of) Kadesh Barnea; and it shall yatzaa (go out / come out) forth to Chatzaraadar (Hazar) Addar, and ibar (pass over/through) along to Itzamawan (Azmon);

And the gabawal (border/boundary) shall sabab (turn) about from Itzamawan (Azmon) to the nachal (stream / river) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and the thawatzaah (goings) out of it shall be at the yam (sea/waters).
