‘For the western gabawal (border/boundary), you shall have the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) yam (sea/waters) and its gabawal (border/boundary): this shall be your yam (sea/waters) gabawal (border/boundary).
‘This shall be your tzapawan (north) gabawal (border/boundary): from the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) yam (sea/waters) you shall mark out for you har (mountain) Har (Hor);
From har (mountain) Har (Hor) you shall mark out to the entrance of Chamath (Hamath); and the thawatzaah (goings) out of the gabawal (border/boundary) shall be at Tzadad (Zedad);

And the gabawal (border/boundary) shall yatzaa (go out / come out) forth to Zaparan (Ziphron), and the thawatzaah (goings) out of it shall be at Chatzaraiyanan (Hazar) Enan: this shall be your tzapawan (north) gabawal (border/boundary).
‘You shall mark out your qadam (east) gabawal (border/boundary) from Chatzaraiyanan (Hazar) Enan to Shapam (Shepham);

And the gabawal (border/boundary) shall yarad (go) down from Shapam (Shepham) to Rabalah (Riblah), on the qadam (east) side of Iyan (Ain); and the gabawal (border/boundary) shall yarad (go) down, and shall machah (reach) to the kathap (side) of the yam (sea/waters) of Kanarawath (Chinnereth) eastward;

And the gabawal (border/boundary) shall yarad (go) down to the Yaradan (Jordan), and the thawatzaah (goings) out of it shall be at the malach (salt) yam (sea/waters). This shall be your aratz (Earth/land) according to its gabawalah (borders) around it.’

Mashah (Moses) tzawah (commanded) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), amar (spoke), This is the aratz (Earth/land) which you shall nachal (inherit) by gawaral (lot), which Yahawah has tzawah (commanded) to nathan (give) to the thashai (nine) matah (staff / rod / tribe), and to the chatzay (half) - matah (staff / rod / tribe);

For the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of raawabanay (reuben) according to their ab (father)' bayath (house), and the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of gaday (gad) according to their ab (father)' bayath (house), have laqach (take / seized), and the chatzay (half) - matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Manashah (Manasseh) have laqach (take / seized), their nachalah (inheritance):

The shanayam (two) matah (staff / rod / tribe) and the chatzay (half) - matah (staff / rod / tribe) have laqach (take / seized) their nachalah (inheritance) ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) at Yarayachaw (Jericho) eastward, toward the sunrise.
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

These are the sham (name) of the ayash (husband/individual man) who shall nachal (divide) the aratz (Earth/land) to you for inheritance: Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), and Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun).
You shall laqach (take / seized) achad (one) nashayaa (prince) of every matah (staff / rod / tribe), to nachal (divide) the aratz (Earth/land) for nachal (inheritance).
These are the sham (name) of the ayash (husband/individual man): Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Yahawadah (Judah), Kalab (Caleb) the ban (son) of Yapanah (Jephunneh).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Shamaiwan (Simeon), Shamawaal (Shemuel) the ban (son) of Imayahawad (Ammihud).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Banayamayan (Benjamin), Alayadad (Elidad) the ban (son) of Kasalawan (Chislon).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) Dan (of) Dan a nashayaa (prince), Baqay (Bukki) the ban (son) of Yagalay (Jogli).
Of the ban (son) of Yawasap (Joseph): of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh) a nashayaa (prince), Chanayaal (Hanniel) the ban (son) of apad (ephod).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Aparayam (Ephraim) a nashayaa (prince), Qamawaal (Kemuel) the ban (son) of Shapatan (Shiphtan).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Zabawalawan (Zebulun) a nashayaa (prince), Alayatzapan (Elizaphan) the ban (son) of Paranak (Parnach).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Yashashakar (Issachar) a nashayaa (prince), Palatayaal (Paltiel) the ban (son) of Izan (Azzan).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Ashar (Asher) a nashayaa (prince), Achayahawad (Ahihud) the ban (son) of Shalamay (Shelomi).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Napathalay (Naphtali) a nashayaa (prince), Padahaal (Pedahel) the ban (son) of Imayahawad (Ammihud).
These are they whom Yahawah tzawah (commanded) to divide the nachal (inheritance) to the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses) in the irabah (plains) of Mawaab (Moab) by the Yaradan (Jordan) at Yarayachaw (Jericho), amar (spoke),

Tzawah (command) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) that they nathan (give) to the Lawayay (Levites) of the nachalah (inheritance) of their achazah (possession) iyar (cities) to yashab (inhabit/dwell) in; and you shall nathan (give) magarash (suburbs) for the iyar (cities) around them to the Lawayay (Levites).

The iyar (cities) shall they have to yashab (inhabit/dwell) in; and their magarash (suburbs) shall be for their livestock, and for their rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions), and for all their animals.

The magarash (suburbs) of the iyar (cities), which you shall nathan (give) to the Lawayay (Levites), shall be from the qayar (wall) of the iyar (city) and outward one alap (thousand) amah (cubits) around it.

You shall madad (measure) outside of the iyar (city) for the qadam (east) paah (side) two alap (thousand) amah (cubits), and for the nagab (south) paah (side) two alap (thousand) amah (cubits), and for the yam (sea/waters) paah (side) two alap (thousand) amah (cubits), and for the tzapawan (north) paah (side) two alap (thousand) amah (cubits), the iyar (city) being in the thawak (midst). This shall be to them the magarash (suburbs) of the iyar (cities).

The iyar (cities) which you shall nathan (give) to the Lawayay (Levites), they shall be the shash (six) iyar (cities) of maqalat (refuge), which you shall nathan (give) for the manslayer to nawas (flee) to: and besides them you shall nathan (give) arabaiyam (forty) - shanayam (two) iyar (cities).
All the iyar (cities) which you shall nathan (give) to the Lawayay (Levites) shall be arabaiyam (forty) - shamanah (eight) iyar (cities) together with their magarash (suburbs).

Concerning the iyar (cities) which you shall nathan (give) of the achazah (possession) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), from the many you shall take many; and from the mait (few) you shall take mait (few): everyone pah (according) to his nachalah (inheritance) which he nachal (inherits) shall nathan (give) of his iyar (cities) to the Lawayay (Levites).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),
Dabar (word / matter) to the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), and amar (spoke) them, ‘When you ibar (pass over/through) over the Yaradan (Jordan) into the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan),

Then you shall qarah (appoint) you iyar (cities) to be iyar (cities) of maqalat (refuge) for you, that the manslayer who nakah (kills) any napash (living being/soul) shagagah (unwittingly) may nawas (flee) there.

The iyar (cities) shall be to you for maqalat (refuge) from the gaal (avenger), that the manslayer not mawath (death), until he imad (stands) panayam (before) the idah (congregation) for mashapat (judgment).
The iyar (cities) which you shall nathan (give) shall be for you shash (six) iyar (cities) of maqalat (refuge).

You shall nathan (give) shalawash (three) iyar (cities) ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan), and you shall nathan (give) shalawash (three) iyar (cities) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan); they shall be iyar (cities) of maqalat (refuge).

For the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), and for the gar (sojourner / stranger / foreigner) and for the foreigner living thawak (midst) them, shall these shash (six) iyar (cities) be for maqalat (refuge); that everyone who nakah (kills) any napash (living being/soul) shagagah (unwittingly) may nawas (flee) there.

‘But if he nakah (struck) him with an kalay (instrument) of barazal (iron), so that he mawath (death), he is a ratzach (murderer): the ratzach (murderer) shall mawath (death) be put to mawath (death).

If he nakah (struck) him with a aban (stone) in the yad (hand), by which a mawath (death) may die, and he mawath (death), he is a ratzach (murderer): the ratzach (murderer) shall mawath (death) be put to mawath (death).

Or if he nakah (struck) him with a kalay (weapon) of itz (wood) in the yad (hand), by which a mawath (death) may die, and he mawath (death), he is a ratzach (murderer): the ratzach (murderer) shall mawath (death) be put to mawath (death).
The avenger of dam (blood) shall himself ratzach (put) the murderer to mawath (death): when he pagai (meets) him, he shall put him to mawath (death).
If he hadap (thrust) him of hatred, or shalak (hurled) at him, tzadayah (lying) in wait, so that he mawath (death),

Or in enmity nakah (struck) him with his yad (hand), so that he mawath (death); he who nakah (struck) him shall mawath (death) be put to mawath (death); he is a ratzach (murderer): the gaal (avenger) of dam (blood) shall ratzach (put) the murderer to mawath (death), when he pagai (meets) him.
‘But if he hadap (thrust) him pathai (suddenly) laa (NOT) enmity, or shalak (hurled) on him anything without tzadayah (lying) in wait,

Or with any aban (stone), by which a mawath (death) may die, not seeing him, and napal (fall / be cast down) it on him, so that he mawath (death), and he was not his ayab (enemy), neither baqash (sought) his rai (harm);
Then the idah (congregation) shall shapat (judge) between the striker and the gaal (avenger) of dam (blood) according to these mashapat (ordinances);

And the idah (congregation) shall natzal (deliver) the manslayer out of the yad (hand) of the gaal (avenger) of dam (blood), and the idah (congregation) shall shawab (turn back / repent) him to his iyar (city) of maqalat (refuge), where he was nawas (fled): and he shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein until the mawath (death) of the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest), who was mashach (anointed) with the qadash (set apart/make holy) shaman (oil).
‘But if the manslayer shall at any yatzaa (go out / come out) yatzaa (go out / come out) beyond the gabawal (border/boundary) of his iyar (city) of maqalat (refuge), where he nawas (flees),

And the gaal (avenger) of dam (blood) matzaa (find) him outside of the gabawal (border/boundary) of his iyar (city) of maqalat (refuge), and the gaal (avenger) of dam (blood) ratzach (kill) the manslayer; he shall not be guilty of dam (blood),

Because he should have yashab (inhabit/dwell) in his iyar (city) of maqalat (refuge) until the mawath (death) of the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest): but achar (other) the mawath (death) of the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest) the manslayer shall shawab (turn back / repent) into the aratz (Earth/land) of his achazah (possession).
‘These things shall be for a chaqah (statute) and mashapat (ordinance) to you throughout your dawar (generation / age / period) in all your mawashab (dwellings).

‘Whoever nakah (kills) any napash (living being/soul), the ratzach (murderer) shall be ratzach (slain) at the pah (mouth) of witnesses: but achad (one) id (witness) shall not inah (answer / respond) against any napash (living being/soul) that he mawath (death).

‘Moreover you shall laqach (take / seized) no kapar (ransom) for the napash (living being/soul) of a ratzach (murderer) who is rashai (guilty) of mawath (death); but he shall mawath (death) be put to mawath (death).

‘You shall laqach (take / seized) no kapar (ransom) for him who is nawas (fled) to his iyar (city) of maqalat (refuge), that he may shawab (turn back / repent) again to yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the aratz (Earth/land), until the mawath (death) of the kahan (priest).

‘So you shall not chanap (pollute) the aratz (Earth/land) in which you are: for dam (blood), it chanap (pollutes) the aratz (Earth/land); and no expiation can be made for the aratz (Earth/land) for the dam (blood) that is shapak (shed) therein, but by the dam (blood) of him who shapak (shed) it.

You shall not tamaa (defile) the aratz (Earth/land) which you yashab (inhabit/dwell), in the thawak (midst) of which I shakan (dwell): for I, Yahawah, shakan (dwell) in the midst of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel).’

The raash (head) of the ab (father)' households of the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the ban (son) of Galaid (Gilead), the ban (son) of Makayar (Machir), the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh), of the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the ban (son) of Yawasap (Joseph), qarab (come close) near, and dabar (word / matter) panayam (before) Mashah (Moses), and panayam (before) the nashayaa (princes), the raash (head) of the ab (father)' households of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel):

And they amar (spoke), Yahawah tzawah (commanded) my Adawan to nathan (give) the aratz (Earth/land) for nachalah (inheritance) by gawaral (lot) to the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel): and my Adawan was tzawah (commanded) by Yahawah to nathan (give) the nachalah (inheritance) of Tzalapachad (Zelophehad) our ach (brother/kinsman) to his bath (daughter).

If they are married to any of the ban (son) of the other shabat (tribes) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), then will their nachalah (inheritance) be taken away from the nachalah (inheritance) of our ab (father), and will be yasap (added) to the nachalah (inheritance) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) whereunto they shall belong: so will it be taken away from the gawaral (lot) of our nachalah (inheritance).

When the yawabal (jubilee) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) shall be, then will their nachalah (inheritance) be yasap (added) to the nachalah (inheritance) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) whereunto they shall belong: so will their nachalah (inheritance) be taken garai (away) from the nachalah (inheritance) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of our ab (father).

Mashah (Moses) tzawah (commanded) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) according to the pah (word) of Yahawah, amar (spoke), The matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Yawasap (Joseph) dabar (word / matter) right.

This is the thing which Yahawah does tzawah (command) concerning the bath (daughter) of Tzalapachad (Zelophehad), amar (spoke), Let them be married to whom they iyan (eye) tawab (pleasant/functional); only into the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of their ab (father) shall they be married.

So shall no nachalah (inheritance) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) sabab (remove) from matah (staff / rod / tribe) to matah (staff / rod / tribe); for the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) shall all dabaq (keep) the nachalah (inheritance) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of his ab (father).

Every bath (daughter) who possesses an nachalah (inheritance) in any matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) shall be ashah (wife/individual woman) to achad (one) of the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of her ab (father), that the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) may yarash (possess) every ayash (husband/individual man) the nachalah (inheritance) of his ab (father).

So shall no nachalah (inheritance) sabab (remove) from one matah (staff / rod / tribe) to achar (other) matah (staff / rod / tribe); for the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) shall ayash (husband/individual man) dabaq (keep) his own nachalah (inheritance).
The bath (daughter) of Tzalapachad (Zelophehad) ishah (make) as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses):

For Machalah (Mahlah), Tharatzah (Tirzah), and Chagalah (Hoglah), and Malakah (Milcah), and Naih (Noah), the bath (daughter) of Tzalapachad (Zelophehad), were married to their dawad (father's) brothers' ban (son).

They were married into the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh) the ban (son) of Yawasap (Joseph); and their nachalah (inheritance) remained in the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of their ab (father).

These are the matzawah (commandments) and the mashapat (ordinances) which Yahawah tzawah (commanded) by Mashah (Moses) to the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) in the irabah (plains) of Mawaab (Moab) by the Yaradan (Jordan) at Yarayachaw (Jericho).

These are the dabar (word / matter) which Mashah (Moses) dabar (word / matter) to all Yasharaal (Israel) ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) in the madabar (wilderness), in the irabah (arabah) over mawal (against) Suph, between Paaran (Paran), and Thapal (Tophel), and Laban (Laban), and Chatzarawath (Hazeroth), and Dayazahab (Dizahab).
It is achad (one) yawam (day)' journey from Charab (Horeb) by the darak (way) of har (mountain) Shaiyar (Seir) Qadashabaranai (to) Kadesh Barnea.

It happened in the fortieth shanah (year), in the ishathay (eleven) chadash (month), on the achad (one) day of the chadash (month), that Mashah (Moses) dabar (word / matter) to the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), according to all that Yahawah had tzawah (given) him in commandment to them;

Achar (other) he had nakah (struck) Sayachawan (Sihon) the malak (king) of the Amaray (Amorites), who lived in Chashabawan (Heshbon), and Iwag (Og) the malak (king) of Bashan (Bashan), who lived Ishatharawath (in) Ashtaroth, at Adaraiy (Edrei).
Ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan), in the aratz (Earth/land) of Mawaab (Moab), yaal (began) Mashah (Moses) to baar (declare) this thawarah (instruction), amar (spoke),
Yahawah our Alahayam dabar (word / matter) to us in Charab (Horeb), amar (spoke), You have lived rab (long) enough in this har (mountain):

Panah (turn), and take your nasai (journey), and bawaa (come) to the har (mountain) country of the Amaray (Amorites), and to all the places near there, in the irabah (arabah), in the har (mountain) shapalah (country), and in the lowland, and in the nagab (south), and by the seashore, the aratz (Earth/land) of the Kanainay (Canaanites), and Labanawan (Lebanon), as gadawal (very great/important/mighty) as the great nahar (river), the nahar (river) Parath (Euphrates).

Raah (see), I nathan (give) set the aratz (Earth/land) panayam (before) you: bawaa (come) in and yarash (possess) the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah shabai (swear / take oath) to your ab (father), to Abaraham (Abraham), to Yatzachaq (Isaac), and to Yaiqab (Jacob), to nathan (give) to them and to their zarai (seed) achar (other) them.
I amar (spoke) to you at that ith (time), amar (spoke), I am not yakal (able) to nashaa (lift) you myself bad (alone):
Yahawah your Alahayam rabah (has) multiplied you, and behold, you are this yawam (day) as the kawakab (star) of the sky for rab (multitude).
Yahawah, the Alahayam of your ab (father), make you a alap (thousand) paim (times) as many as you are, and barak (bless) you, as he has dabar (word / matter) you!
Ayak (how) can I myself alone nashaa (lift) your encumbrance, and your mashaa (burden), and your rayab (strife)?

Yahab (take) chakam (wise) ayash (husband/individual man) of bayan (between) and well yadai (known) according to your shabat (tribes), and I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) them raash (head) over you.
You inah (answer / respond) me, and amar (spoke), The thing which you have amar (spoke) is tawab (pleasant/functional) to ishah (make).

So I laqach (take / seized) the raash (head) of your shabat (tribes), chakam (wise) raash (head), and yadai (known), and nathan (give) them raash (head) over you, shar (prince / ruler) of alap (thousands), and shar (prince / ruler) of maah (hundred), and shar (prince / ruler) of chamashayam (fifties), and shar (prince / ruler) of ishar (tens), and shatar (officers), according to your shabat (tribes).

I tzawah (commanded) your shapat (judges) at that ith (time), amar (spoke), shamai (hearken / hear) cases between your ach (brother/kinsman), and shapat (judge) righteously between a ayash (husband/individual man) and his ach (brother/kinsman), and the foreigner who is living with him.

You shall not show partiality in mashapat (judgment); you shall shamai (hearken / hear) the qatan (small/young/least) and the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) alike; you shall not be gawar (afraid) of the panayam (face) of ayash (husband/individual man); for the mashapat (judgment) is alahayam (Alahayam). The dabar (word / matter) that is too qashah (rough / hard) for you, you shall qarab (come close) to me, and I will shamai (hearken / hear) it.
I tzawah (commanded) you at that ith (time) all the things which you should ishah (make).

We traveled from Charab (Horeb), and yalak (went) through all that gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and yaraa (fear / be afraid) madabar (wilderness) which you raah (see), by the darak (way) to the har (mountain) country of the Amaray (Amorites), as Yahawah our Alahayam tzawah (commanded) us; and we bawaa (come) Qadashabaranai (to) Kadesh Barnea.
I amar (spoke) to you, You bawaa (come) come to the har (mountain) country of the Amaray (Amorites), which Yahawah our Alahayam nathan (give) to us.

Raah (see), Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) set the aratz (Earth/land) panayam (before) you: ilah (go up / offer) up, take yarash (possession), as Yahawah, the Alahayam of your ab (father), has dabar (word / matter) to you; don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid), neither be chathath (dismayed).

You qarab (come close) near to me everyone of you, and amar (spoke), shalach (send) us send ayash (husband/individual man) panayam (before) us, that they may chapar (search) the aratz (Earth/land) for us, and shawab (turn back / repent) us dabar (word / matter) again of the darak (way) by which we must ilah (go up / offer) up, and the iyar (cities) to which we shall bawaa (come).

The thing yatab (pleased) me well; and I laqach (take / seized) shanayam (two) ayash (husband/individual man) of you, achad (one) ayash (husband/individual man) for ayash (husband/individual man) tribe:
And they panah (turned) and ilah (go up / offer) up into the har (mountain) country, and bawaa (come) to the nachal (stream / river) of Ashakal (Eshcol), and ragal (spied) it out.

They laqach (take / seized) of the paray (fruit) of the aratz (Earth/land) in their yad (hand), and yarad (brought) it down to us, and shawab (turn back / repent) us dabar (word / matter) again, and amar (spoke), It is a tawab (pleasant/functional) aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah our Alahayam nathan (give) to us.
Yet you wouldn't ilah (go up / offer) up, but marah (rebelled) against the commandment of Yahawah your Alahayam:

And you ragan (murmured) in your ahal (tents), and amar (spoke), Because Yahawah shanaah (hated) us, he yatzaa (go out / come out) brought us forth out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), to nathan (give) us into the yad (hand) of the Amaray (Amorites), to shamad (destroy) us.

Where are we ilah (go up / offer) up? Our ach (brother/kinsman) have made our labab (heart) to masas (melt), amar (spoke), ‘The im (people / nation) are greater and rawam (will lift up) than we; the iyar (cities) are gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and batzar (fortified) up to the sky; and moreover we raah (see) seen the ban (son) of the inaqay (anakim) there.’
Then I amar (spoke) to you, Don't iratz (dread), neither be yaraa (fear / be afraid) of them.
Yahawah your Alahayam who halak (move) panayam (before) you, he will lacham (fight) for you, according to all that he ishah (make) for you in Matzarayam (Egypt) before your iyan (eye),

And in the madabar (wilderness), where you raah (see) seen how that Yahawah your Alahayam nashaa (lift) you, as a ayash (husband/individual man) does nashaa (lift) his ban (son), in all the darak (way) that you halak (move), until you bawaa (come) to this maqawam (place).
Yet in this thing you didn't aman (believe / have faith) Yahawah your Alahayam,

Who halak (move) panayam (before) you in the darak (way), to thawar (seek) you out a maqawam (place) to pitch your chanah (tents) in, in ash (fire) by layal (night), to show you by what darak (way) you should yalak (go), and in the inan (cloud) by yawamam (by day).
Yahawah shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of your dabar (word / matter), and was qatzap (angry), and shabai (swear / take oath), amar (spoke),

Surely not ayash (husband/individual man) of these ayash (husband/individual man) of this rai (evil) dawar (generation / age / period) shall raah (see) the tawab (pleasant/functional) aratz (Earth/land), which I shabai (swear / take oath) to nathan (give) to your ab (father),

Except Kalab (Caleb) the ban (son) of Yapanah (Jephunneh): he shall raah (see) it; and to him will I nathan (give) the aratz (Earth/land) that he has darak (trodden) on, and to his ban (son), because he malaa (has) wholly achar (other) Yahawah.
Also Yahawah was anap (angry) with me for your sakes, amar (spoke), You also shall not bawaa (come) in there:

Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun), who imad (stands) panayam (before) you, he shall bawaa (come) in there: chazaq (encourage) you him; for he shall cause Yasharaal (Israel) to nachal (inherit) it.

Moreover your little tap (ones), whom you amar (spoke) should be a baz (prey), and your ban (son), who this yawam (day) have no yadai (knowledge) of tawab (pleasant/functional) or rai (evil), they shall bawaa (come) in there, and to them will I nathan (give) it, and they shall yarash (possess) it.
But as for you, panah (turn), and take your nasai (journey) into the madabar (wilderness) by the darak (way) to the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters).

Then you inah (answer / respond) and amar (spoke) to me, "We have chataa (sinned) against Yahawah, we will ilah (go up / offer) up and lacham (fight), according to all that Yahawah our Alahayam tzawah (commanded) us." Every ayash (husband/individual man) of you chagar (put) on his kalay (weapons) of malachamah (war), and presumed to ilah (go up / offer) up into the har (mountain) country.

Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, amar (spoke) them, ‘Don't ilah (go up / offer) up, neither lacham (fight); for I am not qarab (among / near) you; lest you be nagap (struck) panayam (before) your ayab (enemy).’

So I dabar (word / matter) to you, and you didn't shamai (hearken / hear); but you marah (rebelled) against the commandment of Yahawah, and were presumptuous, and ilah (go up / offer) up into the har (mountain) country.

The Amaray (Amorites), who lived in that har (mountain) country, yatzaa (go out / come out) out qaraah (against) you, and radap (chased) you, as dabawarah (bees) ishah (make), and kathath (beat) you down in Shaiyar (Seir), even to Charamah (Hormah).
You shawab (turn back / repent) and bakah (wept) panayam (before) Yahawah; but Yahawah didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to your qawal (sound / voice), nor azan (gave) ear to you.
So you stayed in Qadash (Kadesh) many yawam (day), according to the yawam (day) that you yashab (inhabit/dwell).

Then we panah (turned), and took our nasai (journey) into the madabar (wilderness) by the darak (way) to the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters), as Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to me; and we encircled har (mountain) Shaiyar (Seir) many yawam (day).
Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, amar (spoke),
You have encircled this har (mountain) rab (long) enough. Panah (turn) northward.

Tzawah (command) the im (people / nation), amar (spoke), ‘You are to ibar (pass over/through) through the gabawal (border/boundary) of your ach (brother/kinsman) the ban (son) of Ishaw (Esau), who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in Shaiyar (Seir); and they will be yaraa (fear / be afraid) of you: take maad (good) shamar (keep/guard) to yourselves therefore;

Don't garah (contend) with them; for I will not nathan (give) you of their aratz (Earth/land), no, not so much as for the sole of the ragal (feet / foot) to tread on; because I nathan (give) given har (mountain) Shaiyar (Seir) to Ishaw (Esau) for a yarashah (possession).
You shall purchase akal (food) of them for kasap (money), that you may akal (eat); and you shall also karah (buy) mayam (Waters) of them for kasap (money), that you may shathah (drinks).’

For Yahawah your Alahayam has barak (blessed) you in all the maishah (work) of your yad (hand); he yadai (has) known your yalak (walking) through this gadawal (very great/important/mighty) madabar (wilderness): these arabaiyam (forty) shanah (years) Yahawah your Alahayam has been with you; you have chasar (lacked) nothing.

So we ibar (pass over/through) by from our ach (brother/kinsman) the ban (son) of Ishaw (Esau), who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in Shaiyar (Seir), from the darak (way) of the irabah (arabah) from Ayalawath (Elath) and from Itzayawanagabar (Ezion) Geber. We panah (turned) and ibar (pass over/through) by the darak (way) of the madabar (wilderness) of Mawaab (Moab).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, Don't bother Mawaab (Moab), neither garah (contend) with them in malachamah (battle); for I will not nathan (give) you of his aratz (Earth/land) for a yarashah (possession); because I nathan (give) given Ir (Ar) to the ban (son) of Lawat (Lot) for a yarashah (possession).
(The Ayamayam (Emim) lived therein panayam (before), a im (people / nation) gadawal (very great/important/mighty), and many, and rawam (will lift up), as the inaqay (anakim):
These also are chashab (accounted) Rapaa (Rephaim), as the inaqay (anakim); but the Mawaabay (Moabites) qaraa (called) them Ayamayam (Emim).

The Charay (Horites) also lived in Shaiyar (Seir) panayam (before), but the ban (son) of Ishaw (Esau) yarash (succeeded) them; and they destroyed them from panayam (before) them, and lived in their place; as Yasharaal (Israel) ishah (make) to the aratz (Earth/land) of his yarashah (possession), which Yahawah nathan (give) to them.)
"Now qawam (rise up) up, and cross over the nachal (stream / river) Zarad (Zered)." We ibar (pass over/through) over the nachal (stream / river) Zarad (Zered).

The yawam (day) in which we halak (move) Qadashabaranai (from) Kadesh Barnea, until we had halak (move) over the nachal (stream / river) Zarad (Zered), were shalawashayam (thirty) - shamanah (eight) shanah (years); until all the dawar (generation / age / period) of the halak (move) of malachamah (war) were thamam (consumed) from the qarab (among / near) of the machanah (camp), as Yahawah shabai (swear / take oath) to them.
Moreover the yad (hand) of Yahawah was against them, to hamam (destroy) them from the qarab (among / near) of the machanah (camp), until they were thamam (consumed).
So it happened, when all the ayash (husband/individual man) of malachamah (war) were thamam (consumed) and mawath (death) from qarab (among / near) the im (people / nation),
That Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to me, amar (spoke),
You are this day to ibar (pass over/through) over Ir (Ar), the gabawal (border/boundary) of Mawaab (Moab):

And when you qarab (come close) near over mawal (against) the ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon), don't bother them, nor garah (contend) with them; for I will not nathan (give) you of the aratz (Earth/land) of the ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon) for a yarashah (possession); because I nathan (give) given it to the ban (son) of Lawat (Lot) for a yarashah (possession).
(That also is chashab (accounted) a aratz (Earth/land) of Rapaa (Rephaim): Rapaa (Rephaim) lived therein panayam (before); but the Imawanay (Ammonites) qaraa (called) them Zamazam (Zamzummim),

A im (people / nation) gadawal (very great/important/mighty), and many, and rawam (will lift up), as the inaqay (anakim); but Yahawah destroyed them panayam (before) them; and they yarash (succeeded) them, and lived in their yashab (inhabit/dwell);

As he ishah (make) for the ban (son) of Ishaw (Esau), who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in Shaiyar (Seir), when he destroyed the Charay (Horites) from panayam (before) them; and they yarash (succeeded) them, and lived in their place even to this yawam (day):

And the Iwayam (Avvim), who lived in villages as far as Izah (Gaza), the Kapatharay (Caphtorim), who yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of Kapathar (Caphtor), destroyed them, and lived in their yashab (inhabit/dwell).)

Qawam (rise up) up, take your nasai (journey), and ibar (pass over/through) over the nachal (stream / river) of the Aranawan (Arnon): raah (see), I nathan (give) given into your yad (hand) Sayachawan (Sihon) the Amaray (Amorite), malak (king) of Chashabawan (Heshbon), and his aratz (Earth/land); chalal (begin) to yarash (possess) it, and garah (contend) with him in malachamah (battle).

This yawam (day) will I chalal (begin) to nathan (give) the pachad (fear / dread) of you and the yaraah (fear) of you on the panayam (peoples) who are under the whole sky, who shall shamai (hearken / hear) the shamai (report) of you, and shall ragaz (tremble), and be in anguish panayam (because) of you.

I shalach (send) malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) out of the madabar (wilderness) of Qadamawath (Kedemoth) to Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of Chashabawan (Heshbon) with dabar (word / matter) of shalawam (peace / safety), amar (spoke),

Let me ibar (pass over/through) through your aratz (Earth/land): I will yalak (go) darak (along) by the highway, I will sawar (turn) neither to the right yamayan (right hand) nor to the shamaawal (left hand).

You shall shabar (sell) me akal (food) for kasap (money), that I may akal (eat); and nathan (give) me mayam (Waters) for kasap (money), that I may shathah (drinks): only let me ibar (pass over/through) through on my ragal (feet / foot),

As the ban (son) of Ishaw (Esau) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in Shaiyar (Seir), and the Mawaabay (Moabites) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in Ir (Ar), ishah (make) to me; until I shall ibar (pass over/through) over the Yaradan (Jordan) into the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah our Alahayam nathan (give) us.

But Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of Chashabawan (Heshbon) would not let us ibar (pass over/through) by him; for Yahawah your Alahayam hardened his rawach (spirit / wind), and made his labab (heart) amatz (obstinate), that he might nathan (give) him into your yad (hand), as at this yawam (day).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, raah (see), I have chalal (begun) to nathan (give) up Sayachawan (Sihon) and his aratz (Earth/land) panayam (before) you: chalal (begin) to yarash (possess), that you may yarash (inherit) his aratz (Earth/land).
Then Sayachawan (Sihon) yatzaa (go out / come out) out qaraah (against) us, he and all his im (people / nation), to malachamah (battle) at Yahatz (Jahaz).
Yahawah our Alahayam nathan (give) him up panayam (before) us; and we nakah (struck) him, and his ban (son), and all his im (people / nation).

We lakad (took) all his iyar (cities) at that ith (time), and charam (utterly) destroyed every inhabited iyar (city), with the ashah (wife/individual woman) and the little tap (ones); we shaar (left) none sharayad (remaining):
Only the livestock we bazaz (took) for a prey to ourselves, with the shalal (spoil) of the iyar (cities) which we had lakad (taken).

From Irawair (Aroer), which is on the shapah (edge) of the nachal (stream / river) of the Aranawan (Arnon), and the iyar (city) that is in the nachal (stream / river), even to Galaid (Gilead), there was not a qarayah (city) shagab (too) high for us; Yahawah our Alahayam nathan (give) up all panayam (before) us:

Only to the aratz (Earth/land) of the ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon) you didn't qarab (come close) yad (hand); all the side of the nachal (stream / river) Yabaq (Jabbok), and the iyar (cities) of the har (mountain) country, and wherever Yahawah our Alahayam forbade us.

Then we panah (turned), and ilah (go up / offer) up the darak (way) to Bashan (Bashan): and Iwag (Og) the malak (king) of Bashan (Bashan) yatzaa (go out / come out) out qaraah (against) us, he and all his im (people / nation), to malachamah (battle) at Adaraiy (Edrei).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, Don't yaraa (fear / be afraid) him; for I nathan (give) delivered him, and all his im (people / nation), and his aratz (Earth/land), into your yad (hand); and you shall ishah (make) to him as you ishah (make) to Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of the Amaray (Amorites), who lived at Chashabawan (Heshbon).

So Yahawah our Alahayam nathan (give) into our yad (hand) Iwag (Og) also, the malak (king) of Bashan (Bashan), and all his im (people / nation): and we nakah (struck) him until none was shaar (left) to him sharayad (remaining).

We lakad (took) all his iyar (cities) at that ith (time); there was not a qarayah (city) which we didn't laqach (take / seized) from them; shashayam (sixty) iyar (cities), all the chabal (region) of Aragab (Argob), the mamalakah (kingdom) of Iwag (Og) in Bashan (Bashan).
All these were iyar (cities) batzar (fortified) with gabah (high) chawamah (walls), dalath (gates), and barayach (bars); besides the unwalled iyar (towns) a maad (great) many.

We charam (utterly) destroyed them, as we ishah (make) to Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of Chashabawan (Heshbon), charam (utterly) destroying every inhabited iyar (city), with the ashah (wife/individual woman) and the little tap (ones).
But all the livestock, and the shalal (spoil) of the iyar (cities), we bazaz (took) for a prey to ourselves.

We laqach (take / seized) the aratz (Earth/land) at that ith (time) out of the yad (hand) of the shanayam (two) malak (king) of the Amaray (Amorites) who were ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan), from the nachal (stream / river) of the Aranawan (Arnon) to har (mountain) Charamawan (Hermon).
(The Tzayadanay (Sidonians) qaraa (called) Charamawan (Hermon) Sharayawan (Sirion), and the Amaray (Amorites) qaraa (called) it Shanayar (Senir).)

We took all the iyar (cities) of the mayashawar (plain), and all Galaid (Gilead), and all Bashan (Bashan), Salakah (to) Salecah and Adaraiy (Edrei), iyar (cities) of the mamalakah (kingdom) of Iwag (Og) in Bashan (Bashan).

(For only Iwag (Og) malak (king) of Bashan (Bashan) shaar (remained) of the yathar (remnant) of the Rapaa (Rephaim); behold, his irash (bedstead) was a irash (bedstead) of barazal (iron); isn't it in Rabah (Rabbah) of the ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon)? Thashai (nine) amah (cubits) was its arak (length), and arabai (four) amah (cubits) its rachab (breadth), after the amah (cubit) of a ayash (husband/individual man).)

This aratz (Earth/land) we took in yarash (possession) at that ith (time): from Irawair (Aroer), which is by the nachal (stream / river) of the Aranawan (Arnon), and chatzay (half) the har (mountain) country of Galaid (Gilead), and its iyar (cities), nathan (give) I to the Raawabanay (Reubenites) and to the Gaday (Gadites):

And the yathar (rest) of Galaid (Gilead), and all Bashan (Bashan), the mamalakah (kingdom) of Iwag (Og), nathan (give) I to the chatzay (half) - shabat (tribe) of Manashah (Manasseh); all the chabal (region) of Aragab (Argob), even all Bashan (Bashan). (The same is qaraa (called) the aratz (Earth/land) of Rapaa (Rephaim).

Yaayar (Jair) the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh) laqach (take / seized) all the chabal (region) of Aragab (Argob), to the gabawal (border/boundary) of the Gashawaray (Geshurites) and the Maikathay (Maacathites), and qaraa (called) them, even Bashan (Bashan), after his own sham (name), Havvoth Jair, to this yawam (day).)
I nathan (give) Galaid (Gilead) to Makayar (Machir).

To the Raawabanay (Reubenites) and to the Gaday (Gadites) I nathan (give) from Galaid (Gilead) even to the nachal (stream / river) of the Aranawan (Arnon), the thawak (midst) of the nachal (stream / river), and its gabawal (border/boundary), even to the nachal (stream / river) Yabaq (Jabbok), which is the gabawal (border/boundary) of the ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon);

The irabah (arabah) also, and the Yaradan (Jordan) and its gabawal (border/boundary), from Kanarawath (Chinnereth) even to the yam (sea/waters) of the irabah (arabah), the malach (salt) yam (sea/waters), under the slopes of pasagah (pisgah) eastward.

I tzawah (commanded) you at that ith (time), amar (spoke), Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) given you this aratz (Earth/land) to yarash (possess) it: you shall ibar (pass over/through) over chalatz (armed) panayam (before) your ach (brother/kinsman) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), all the ban (son) of valor.
But your wives, and your little tap (ones), and your livestock, (I yadai (know) that you rab (have) much livestock), shall live in your iyar (cities) which I nathan (give) given you,

Until Yahawah gives nawach (rest) to your ach (brother/kinsman), as to you, and they also yarash (possess) the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) them ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan): then you shall shawab (turn back / repent) every ayash (husband/individual man) to his yarashah (possession), which I nathan (give) given you.

I tzawah (commanded) Yahawashawai (Joshua) at that ith (time), amar (spoke), Your iyan (eye) raah (see) seen all that Yahawah your Alahayam ishah (make) done to these shanayam (two) malak (king): so shall Yahawah ishah (make) to all the mamalakah (kingdoms) where you ibar (pass over/through) over.
You shall not yaraa (fear / be afraid) them; for Yahawah your Alahayam, he it is who lacham (fights) for you.
I begged Yahawah at that ith (time), amar (spoke),

Adanay Yahawah, you have chalal (begun) to show your ibad (servant) your gadal (greatness), and your chazaq (strong) yad (hand): for what Al is there in shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) or in aratz (Earth/land), that can ishah (make) according to your maishah (works), and according to your gabawarah (mighty) acts?

Please let me ibar (pass over/through) over and raah (see) the tawab (pleasant/functional) aratz (Earth/land) that is ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan), that goodly har (mountain), and Labanawan (Lebanon).

But Yahawah was angry with me for your sakes, and didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to me; and Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, Let it rab (suffice) you; dabar (word / matter) no more to me of this dabar (word / matter).

Ilah (go up / offer) up to the raash (head) of Pasagah (Pisgah), and nashaa (lift) up your iyan (eye) westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and raah (see) with your iyan (eye): for you shall not ibar (pass over/through) over this Yaradan (Jordan).

But commission Yahawashawai (Joshua), and chazaq (encourage) him, and amatz (strengthen) him; for he shall ibar (pass over/through) over panayam (before) this im (people / nation), and he shall nachal (cause) them to inherit the aratz (Earth/land) which you shall raah (see).
So we stayed in the gayaa (valley) over mawal (against) Bayathapaiwar (Beth) Peor.

Now, Yasharaal (Israel), shamai (hearken / hear) to the chaq (statute) and to the mashapat (ordinances), which I lamad (teach/instruct) you, to ishah (make) them; that you may chayah (live), and bawaa (come) in and yarash (possess) the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah, the Alahayam of your ab (father), nathan (give) you.

You shall not yasap (add) to the dabar (word / matter) which I tzawah (command) you, neither shall you garai (diminish) from it, that you may shamar (keep/guard) the matzawah (commandments) of Yahawah your Alahayam which I tzawah (command) you.

Your iyan (eye) raah (see) seen what Yahawah ishah (make) because of Bailapaiwar (Baal) Peor; for all the ayash (husband/individual man) who achar (other) Bailapaiwar (Baal) Peor, Yahawah your Alahayam has destroyed them from the qarab (among / near) of you.
But you who were dabaq (faithful) to Yahawah your Alahayam are all chay (life) this yawam (day).

Raah (see), I have lamad (teach/instruct) you chaq (statute) and mashapat (ordinances), even as Yahawah my Alahayam tzawah (commanded) me, that you should ishah (make) so in the midst of the aratz (Earth/land) where you bawaa (come) in to yarash (possess) it.

Shamar (keep/guard) therefore and ishah (make) them; for this is your chakamah (wisdom) and your bayanah (understanding) in the iyan (eye) of the im (people / nation), who shall shamai (hearken / hear) all these chaq (statute), and amar (spoke), Surely this gadawal (very great/important/mighty) gaway (nation / people) is a chakam (wise) and bayan (between) im (people / nation).
For what gadawal (very great/important/mighty) gaway (nation / people) is there, that has a Alahayam so qarawab (near) to them, as Yahawah our Alahayam is whenever we qaraa (called) on him?

What gadawal (very great/important/mighty) gaway (nation / people) is there, that has chaq (statute) and mashapat (ordinances) so tzadayaq (righteous) as all this thawarah (instruction), which I nathan (give) panayam (before) you this yawam (day)?

Only shamar (keep/guard) heed to yourself, and shamar (keep/guard) your napash (living being/soul) maad (diligently), lest you shakach (forget) the things which your iyan (eye) raah (see), and lest they sawar (depart) from your labab (heart) all the yawam (day) of your chay (life); but yadai (make) them known to your ban (son) and your ban (son) ban (son);

The yawam (day) that you imad (stood) panayam (before) Yahawah your Alahayam in Charab (Horeb), when Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, qahal (assemble) me the im (people / nation), and I will shamai (hearken / hear) them hear my dabar (word / matter), that they may lamad (teach/instruct) to yaraa (fear / be afraid) me all the yawam (day) that they chay (life) on the adamah (earth), and that they may lamad (teach/instruct) their ban (son).

You qarab (come close) near and imad (stood) under the har (mountain); and the har (mountain) bair (burned) with ash (fire) to the lab (heart) of the sky, with irapal (darkness), cloud, and thick chashak (darkness).

Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to you out of the thawak (midst) of the ash (fire): you shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of dabar (word / matter), but you raah (see) no form; you only heard a qawal (sound / voice).

He nagad (declared) to you his barayath (covenant), which he tzawah (commanded) you to ishah (make), even the ishar (ten) commandments; and he kathab (wrote) them on shanayam (two) lawach (tables) of aban (stone).

Yahawah tzawah (commanded) me at that ith (time) to lamad (teach/instruct) you chaq (statute) and mashapat (ordinances), that you might ishah (make) them in the aratz (Earth/land) where you ibar (pass over/through) over to yarash (possess) it.

Take therefore maad (good) shamar (keep/guard) to yourselves; for you raah (see) no kind of form on the yawam (day) that Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to you in Charab (Horeb) out of the thawak (midst) of the ash (fire).

Lest you shachath (corrupt) yourselves, and ishah (make) yourself an engraved pasal (idol/graven image) in the form of any samal (figure), the thabanayath (likeness) of zakar (remembrance/memory) or naqabah (female),
The thabanayath (likeness) of any animal that is on the aratz (Earth/land), the thabanayath (likeness) of any kanap (winged) tzapawar (bird) that flies in the sky,
The thabanayath (likeness) of anything that ramash (creeps) on the adamah (ground), the thabanayath (likeness) of any dagah (fish) that is in the mayam (Waters) under the aratz (Earth/land);

And lest you nashaa (lift) up your iyan (eye) to the sky, and when you raah (see) the shamash (sun) and the yarach (moon) and the kawakab (star), even all the tzabaa (troop) of the sky, you are nadach (drawn) away and shachah (worship) them, and ibad (servant) them, which Yahawah your Alahayam chalaq (has) allotted to all the im (people / nation) under the whole sky.

But Yahawah has laqach (take / seized) you, and yatzaa (go out / come out) you forth out of the barazal (iron) kawar (furnace), out of Matzarayam (Egypt), to be to him a im (people / nation) of nachalah (inheritance), as at this yawam (day).

Furthermore Yahawah was anap (angry) with me for your dabar (word / matter), and shabai (swear / take oath) that I should not ibar (pass over/through) over the Yaradan (Jordan), and that I should not bawaa (come) in to that tawab (pleasant/functional) aratz (Earth/land), which Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) you for an nachalah (inheritance):

But I must mawath (death) in this aratz (Earth/land), I must not ibar (pass over/through) over the Yaradan (Jordan); but you shall ibar (pass over/through) over, and yarash (possess) that tawab (pleasant/functional) aratz (Earth/land).

Shamar (keep/guard) heed to yourselves, lest you shakach (forget) the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah your Alahayam, which he karath (cut) with you, and ishah (make) you an engraved pasal (idol/graven image) in the form of anything which Yahawah your Alahayam has forbidden you.
For Yahawah your Alahayam is a akal (eat) ash (fire), a qanaa (jealous) Alahayam.

When you shall yalad (birth / begot) ban (son), and ban (son) ban (son), and you shall have been yashan (long) in the aratz (Earth/land), and shall shachath (corrupt) yourselves, and ishah (make) an engraved pasal (idol/graven image) in the form of anything, and shall ishah (make) that which is rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah your Alahayam, to provoke him to kais (anger);

I iwad (admonish/bear witness against) shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) and aratz (Earth/land) to iwad (admonish/bear witness against) against you this yawam (day), that you shall mahar (soon) abad (destroy/perish) abad (destroy/perish) from off the aratz (Earth/land) whereunto you ibar (pass over/through) over the Yaradan (Jordan) to yarash (possess) it; you shall not prolong your yawam (day) on it, but shall shamad (utterly) be destroyed.

Yahawah will pawatz (scatter) you among the im (people / nation), and you shall be shaar (left) math (few) in masapar (number) among the gaway (nation / people), where Yahawah shall nahag (lead) you away.

There you shall ibad (servant) Alahayam, the maishah (work) of adam (men's) yad (hand), itz (wood) and aban (stone), which neither raah (see), nor shamai (hearken / hear), nor akal (eat), nor rawach (spirit / wind).

But from there you shall baqash (seek) Yahawah your Alahayam, and you shall matzaa (find) him, when you darash (search) after him with all your labab (heart) and with all your napash (living being/soul).

When you are in oppression, and all these things matzaa (have) come on you, in the acharayath (latter) yawam (day) you shall shawab (turn back / repent) to Yahawah your Alahayam, and shamai (hearken / hear) to his qawal (sound / voice):

For Yahawah your Alahayam is a rachawam (merciful) Alahayam; he will not rapah (fail) you, neither shachath (destroy) you, nor shakach (forget) the barayath (covenant) of your ab (father) which he shabai (swear / take oath) to them.

For shaal (ask) now of the yawam (day) that are raashawan (past), which were panayam (before) you, since the yawam (day) that Alahayam baraa (created) adam (man) on the aratz (Earth/land), and from the one qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the sky to the other, whether there has been anything as this gadawal (very great/important/mighty) thing is, or has been shamai (hearken / hear) like it?

Did a im (people / nation) ever shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Alahayam dabar (word / matter) out of the thawak (midst) of the ash (fire), as you have shamai (hearken / hear), and chayah (live)?

Or has Alahayam nasah (tried) to bawaa (come) and laqach (take / seized) a gaway (nation / people) for himself from the qarab (among / near) of another gaway (nation / people), by masah (trials), by awath (sign / mark / miracle), and by mawapath (wonders), and by malachamah (war), and by a chazaq (mighty) yad (hand), and by an natah (outstretched) zarawai (arm), and by gadawal (very great/important/mighty) mawaraa (terrors), according to all that Yahawah your Alahayam ishah (make) for you in Matzarayam (Egypt) before your iyan (eye)?
It was shown to you so that you might yadai (know) that Yahawah is Alahayam. There is no one iwad (more/again) bad (besides) him.

Out of shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) he shamai (hearken / hear) you to hear his qawal (sound / voice), that he might yasar (instruct) you: and on aratz (Earth/land) he made you to raah (see) his gadawal (very great/important/mighty) ash (fire); and you shamai (hearken / hear) his dabar (word / matter) out of the thawak (midst) of the ash (fire).

Because he ahab (love) your ab (father), therefore he bachar (chose) their zarai (seed) achar (other) them, and yatzaa (go out / come out) you out with his panayam (presence), with his gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kach (strength / mighty / power), out of Matzarayam (Egypt);

To yarash (drive) out gaway (nation / people) from panayam (before) you greater and mightier than you, to bawaa (come) you in, to nathan (give) you their aratz (Earth/land) for an nachalah (inheritance), as at this yawam (day).

Yadai (know) therefore this yawam (day), and shawab (turn back / repent) it to your labab (heart), that Yahawah he is Alahayam in shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) mail (top/above) and on the aratz (Earth/land) beneath; there is none else.

You shall shamar (keep/guard) his chaq (statute), and his matzawah (commandments), which I tzawah (command) you this yawam (day), that it may yatab (go) well with you, and with your ban (son) achar (other) you, and that you may prolong your yawam (day) in the adamah (land), which Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) you, forever.
Then Mashah (Moses) set apart shalawash (three) iyar (cities) ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) toward the sunrise;

That the manslayer might nawas (flee) there, who ratzach (kills) his neighbor unawares, and didn't shanaa (hate) him in thamawal (time) shalashawam (past); and that fleeing to achad (one) of these iyar (cities) he might chayay (life):

Batzar (Bezer) in the madabar (wilderness), in the mayashawar (plain) aratz (Earth/land), for the Raawabanay (Reubenites); and Raamawath (Ramoth) in Galaid (Gilead), for the Gaday (Gadites); and Gawalan (Golan) in Bashan (Bashan), for the Manashay (Manassites).
This is the thawarah (instruction) which Mashah (Moses) shawam (place / establish / appoint) panayam (before) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel):

These are the idah (testimonies), and the chaq (statute), and the mashapat (ordinances), which Mashah (Moses) dabar (word / matter) to the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), when they yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of Matzarayam (Egypt),

Ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan), in the gayaa (valley) over mawal (against) Bayathapaiwar (Beth) Peor, in the aratz (Earth/land) of Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of the Amaray (Amorites), who lived at Chashabawan (Heshbon), whom Mashah (Moses) and the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) nakah (struck), when they yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of Matzarayam (Egypt).

They took his aratz (Earth/land) in yarash (possession), and the aratz (Earth/land) of Iwag (Og) malak (king) of Bashan (Bashan), the shanayam (two) malak (king) of the Amaray (Amorites), who were ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) toward the sunrise;
From Irawair (Aroer), which is on the shapah (edge) of the nachal (stream / river) of the Aranawan (Arnon), even to har (mountain) Shayaan (Sion) (the same is Charamawan (Hermon)),
And all the irabah (arabah) ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) eastward, even to the yam (sea/waters) of the irabah (arabah), under the slopes of Pasagah (Pisgah).

Mashah (Moses) qaraa (called) to all Yasharaal (Israel), and amar (spoke) to them, shamai (hearken / hear), Yasharaal (Israel), the chaq (statute) and the mashapat (ordinances) which I dabar (word / matter) in your azan (ears) this yawam (day), that you may lamad (teach/instruct) them, and shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) them.
Yahawah our Alahayam karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) with us in Charab (Horeb).
Yahawah didn't karath (cut) this barayath (covenant) with our ab (father), but with us, even us, who are all of us here chay (life) this yawam (day).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) with you panayam (face) to panayam (face) on the har (mountain) out of the thawak (midst) of the ash (fire),

(I imad (stood) between Yahawah and you at that ith (time), to show you the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah: for you were yaraa (fear / be afraid) panayam (because) of the ash (fire), and didn't ilah (go up / offer) up onto the har (mountain);) amar (spoke),
I am Yahawah your Alahayam, who yatzaa (go out / come out) you out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), out of the bayath (house) of ibad (servant).
You shall have no other Alahayam panayam (before) me.

You shall not ishah (make) an engraved pasal (idol/graven image) for yourself, any thamawanah (form) of what is in shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) mail (top/above), or what is in the aratz (Earth/land) beneath, or that is in the mayam (Waters) under the aratz (Earth/land):

You shall not shachah (bow) down yourself to them, nor ibad (servant) them; for I, Yahawah, your Alahayam, am a qanaa (jealous) Alahayam, paqad (visit) the iwan (guilt/iniquity) of the ab (father) on the ban (son), and on the shalash (three) and on the rabai (fourth) generation of those who shanaa (hate) me;
And showing loving chasad (grace) to alap (thousands) of those who ahab (love) me and shamar (keep/guard) my matzawah (commandments).
You shall not nashaa (lift) the sham (name) of Yahawah your Alahayam in shawaa (vanity): for Yahawah will not hold him naqah (clean/innocent) who nashaa (lift) his sham (name) in shawaa (vanity).
Shamar (keep/guard) the shabath (shabath/rest) yawam (day), to shamar (keep/guard) it holy, as Yahawah your Alahayam tzawah (commanded) you.
You shall ibad (servant) shash (six) yawam (day), and ishah (make) all your malaakah (work);

But the shabayaiy (seventh) yawam (day) is a shabath (shabath/rest) to Yahawah your Alahayam, in which you shall not ishah (make) any malaakah (work), you, nor your ban (son), nor your bath (daughter), nor your male ibad (servant), nor your female amah (servant), nor your shawar (ox), nor your donkey, nor any of your livestock, nor your gar (sojourner / stranger / foreigner) who is within your shair (gates); that your male ibad (servant) and your female amah (servant) may nawach (rest) as well as you.

You shall zakar (remembrance/memory) that you were a ibad (servant) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and Yahawah your Alahayam yatzaa (go out / come out) you out of there by a chazaq (mighty) yad (hand) and by an natah (outstretched) zarawai (arm): therefore Yahawah your Alahayam tzawah (commanded) you to ishah (make) the shabath (shabath/rest) yawam (day).

Honor your ab (father) and your am (mother), as Yahawah your Alahayam tzawah (commanded) you; that your yawam (day) may be arak (long), and that it may yatab (go) well with you, in the adamah (land) which Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) you.
You shall not ratzach (murder).
Neither shall you naap (commit) adultery.
Neither shall you ganab (steal).
Neither shall you inah (answer / respond) shawaa (vanity) id (testimony) against your neighbor.

Neither shall you chamad (covet) your neighbor's ashah (wife/individual woman); neither shall you awah (desire) your neighbor's bayath (house), his shadah (field), or his male ibad (servant), or his female amah (servant), his shawar (ox), or his donkey, or anything that is your neighbor's.

These dabar (word / matter) Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to all your qahal (assembly) on the har (mountain) out of the thawak (midst) of the ash (fire), of the inan (cloud), and of the irapal (thick) darkness, with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qawal (sound / voice): and he yasap (added) no more. He kathab (wrote) them on shanayam (two) lawach (tables) of aban (stone), and nathan (give) them to me.

It happened, when you shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) out of the thawak (midst) of the chashak (darkness), while the har (mountain) was bair (burning) with ash (fire), that you qarab (come close) near to me, even all the raash (head) of your shabat (tribes), and your zaqan (elders);

And you amar (spoke), Behold, Yahawah our Alahayam raah (see) shown us his kabawad (glory) and his gadal (greatness), and we have shamai (hearken / hear) his qawal (sound / voice) out of the thawak (midst) of the ash (fire): we raah (see) seen this yawam (day) that Alahayam does dabar (word / matter) with adam (man), and he chayay (life).

Now therefore why should we mawath (death)? For this gadawal (very great/important/mighty) ash (fire) will akal (eat) us: if we shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah our Alahayam any more, then we shall mawath (death).

For who is there of all bashar (flesh), that has shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of the chay (life) Alahayam dabar (word / matter) out of the thawak (midst) of the ash (fire), as we have, and chayah (lived)?

Qarab (come close) near, and shamai (hearken / hear) all that Yahawah our Alahayam shall amar (spoke): and amar (spoke) us all that Yahawah our Alahayam shall dabar (word / matter) you; and we will shamai (hearken / hear) it, and ishah (make) it.

Yahawah shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of your dabar (word / matter), when you dabar (word / matter) to me; and Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to me, I have shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of the dabar (word / matter) of this im (people / nation), which they have dabar (word / matter) to you: they yatab (have) well dabar (word / matter) all that they have spoken.

Oh that there were such a labab (heart) in them, that they would yaraa (fear / be afraid) me, and shamar (keep/guard) all my matzawah (commandments) yawam (day), that it might be yatab (well) with them, and with their ban (son) iwalam (forever)!
Yalak (go) amar (spoke) them, shawab (turn back / repent) to your ahal (tents).

But as for you, imad (stand) here by me, and I will dabar (word / matter) you all the matzawah (commandment), and the chaq (statute), and the mashapat (ordinances), which you shall lamad (teach/instruct) them, that they may ishah (make) them in the aratz (Earth/land) which I nathan (give) them to yarash (possess) it.

You shall shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) therefore as Yahawah your Alahayam has tzawah (commanded) you: you shall not sawar (turn) aside to the right yamayan (right hand) or to the shamaawal (left hand).

You shall yalak (walk) in all the darak (way) which Yahawah your Alahayam has tzawah (commanded) you, that you may chayah (live), and that it may be tawab (pleasant/functional) with you, and that you may prolong your yawam (day) in the aratz (Earth/land) which you shall yarash (possess).

Now this is the matzawah (commandment), the chaq (statute), and the mashapat (ordinances), which Yahawah your Alahayam tzawah (commanded) to lamad (teach/instruct) you, that you might ishah (make) them in the aratz (Earth/land) where you ibar (pass over/through) over to yarash (possess) it;

That you might yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah your Alahayam, to shamar (keep/guard) all his chaqah (statutes) and his matzawah (commandments), which I tzawah (command) you, you, and your ban (son), and your ban (son) ban (son), all the yawam (day) of your chay (life); and that your yawam (day) may be prolonged.

Shamai (hearken / hear) therefore, Yasharaal (Israel), and shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) it; that it may be yatab (well) with you, and that you may rabah (increase) mightily, as Yahawah, the Alahayam of your ab (father), has dabar (word / matter) to you, in a aratz (Earth/land) zawab (flow) with chalab (milk) and dabash (honey).
Shamai (hearken / hear), Yasharaal (Israel): Yahawah is our Alahayam; Yahawah is achad (one):
And you shall ahab (love) Yahawah your Alahayam with all your labab (heart), and with all your napash (living being/soul), and with all your maad (might).
These dabar (word / matter), which I tzawah (command) you this yawam (day), shall be on your labab (heart);

And you shall shanan (teach) them diligently to your ban (son), and shall dabar (word / matter) of them when you yashab (inhabit/dwell) in your bayath (house), and when you yalak (walk) by the darak (way), and when you shakab (lie) down, and when you qawam (rise up) up.
You shall qashar (bind) them for a awath (sign / mark / miracle) on your yad (hand), and they shall be for symbols between your iyan (eye).
You shall kathab (write) them on the mazawazah (door) posts of your bayath (house), and on your shair (gates).

It shall be, when Yahawah your Alahayam shall bawaa (come) you into the aratz (Earth/land) which he shabai (swear / take oath) to your ab (father), to Abaraham (Abraham), to Yatzachaq (Isaac), and to Yaiqab (Jacob), to nathan (give) you, gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and goodly iyar (cities), which you didn't banah (build),

And bayath (house) malaa (full) of all tawab (pleasant/functional) things, which you didn't malaa (fill), and bawar (cisterns) chatzab (dug) out, which you didn't chatzab (dig), karam (vineyards) and zayath (olive) trees, which you didn't natai (plant), and you shall akal (eat) and be shabai (full);
Then beware lest you shakach (forget) Yahawah, who yatzaa (go out / come out) you forth out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), out of the bayath (house) of ibad (servant).
You shall yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah your Alahayam; and you shall ibad (servant) him, and shall shabai (swear / take oath) by his sham (name).
You shall not yalak (go) achar (other) other Alahayam, of the Alahayam of the im (people / nation) who are around you;

For Yahawah your Alahayam in the qarab (among / near) of you is a qanaa (jealous) Al; lest the ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah your Alahayam be charah (hot with anger) against you, and he shamad (destroy) you from off the panayam (face) of the adamah (earth).
You shall not nasah (tempt) Yahawah your Alahayam, as you nasah (tempted) him in Masah (Massah).
You shall diligently shamar (keep/guard) the matzawah (commandments) of Yahawah your Alahayam, and his idah (testimonies), and his chaq (statute), which he has tzawah (commanded) you.

You shall ishah (make) that which is yashar (right) and tawab (pleasant/functional) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah; that it may be yatab (well) with you, and that you may bawaa (come) in and yarash (possess) the tawab (pleasant/functional) aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah shabai (swear / take oath) to your ab (father),
To hadap (thrust) out all your ayab (enemy) from panayam (before) you, as Yahawah has dabar (word / matter).

When your ban (son) shaal (asks) you in machar (time) to come, amar (spoke), What do the idah (testimonies), the chaq (statute), and the mashapat (ordinances), which Yahawah our Alahayam has tzawah (commanded) you mean?

Then you shall amar (spoke) your ban (son), We were Paraih (Pharaoh's) ibad (servant) in Matzarayam (Egypt): and Yahawah yatzaa (go out / come out) us out of Matzarayam (Egypt) with a chazaq (mighty) yad (hand);

And Yahawah showed gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and awesome awath (sign / mark / miracle) and mawapath (wonders) on Matzarayam (Egypt), on Paraih (Pharaoh), and on all his bayath (house), before our iyan (eye);
And he yatzaa (go out / come out) us out from there, that he might bawaa (come) us in, to nathan (give) us the aratz (Earth/land) which he shabai (swear / take oath) to our ab (father).

Yahawah tzawah (commanded) us to ishah (make) all these chaq (statute), to yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah our Alahayam, for our tawab (pleasant/functional) yawam (day), that he might chayah (preserve) us alive, as at this yawam (day).
It shall be tzadaqah (righteousness) to us, if we shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) all zaath (this) matzawah (commandment) panayam (before) Yahawah our Alahayam, as he has tzawah (commanded) us.

When Yahawah your Alahayam shall bawaa (come) you into the aratz (Earth/land) where you bawaa (come) to yarash (possess) it, and shall nashal (cast) out many gaway (nation / people) panayam (before) you, the Chathay (Hittite), and the Garagashay (Girgashite), and the Amaray (Amorite), and the Kanainay (Canaanite), and the Parazay (Perizzite), and the Chaway (Hivite), and the Yabawasay (Jebusite), shabai (seven) gaway (nation / people) greater and mightier than you;

And when Yahawah your Alahayam shall nathan (give) them up panayam (before) you, and you shall nakah (strike) them; then you shall charam (utterly) charam (destroy) them: you shall karath (cut) no barayath (covenant) with them, nor show chanan (mercy) to them;
Neither shall you chathan (make) marriages with them; your bath (daughter) you shall not nathan (give) to his ban (son), nor shall you laqach (take / seized) his bath (daughter) for your ban (son).

For he will sawar (turn) away your ban (son) from achar (other) me, that they may ibad (servant) other Alahayam: so the ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah would be charah (hot with anger) against you, and he would shamad (destroy) you mahar (quickly).

But you shall ishah (make) with them like this: you shall shabar (break) down their mazabach (altars), and dash their matzabah (pillars) in pieces, and gadai (cut) down their Asharah (Asherim), and sharap (burn) their engraved pasayal (images) with ash (fire).

For you are a qadawash (holy) im (people / nation) to Yahawah your Alahayam: Yahawah your Alahayam has bachar (chosen) you to be a im (people / nation) for his own sagalah (possession), above all im (people / nation) who are on the panayam (face) of the adamah (earth).
Yahawah didn't set his chashaq (love) on you, nor bachar (choose) you, because you were more in number than any im (people / nation); for you were the fewest of all im (people / nation):

But because Yahawah loves you, and because he would shamar (keep/guard) the shabawaih (oath) which he shabai (swear / take oath) to your ab (father), has Yahawah yatzaa (go out / come out) you out with a chazaq (mighty) yad (hand), and padah (redeemed) you out of the bayath (house) of ibad (servant), from the yad (hand) of Paraih (Pharaoh) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt).

Yadai (know) therefore that Yahawah your Alahayam, he is Alahayam, the aman (believe / have faith) Alahayam, who shamar (keep/guard) barayath (covenant) and loving chasad (grace) with them who ahab (love) him and shamar (keep/guard) his matzawah (commandments) to a alap (thousand) dawar (generation / age / period),

And shalam (repays) those who shanaa (hate) him to their panayam (face), to abad (destroy/perish) them: he will not be slack to him who shanaa (hate) him, he will shalam (repay) him to his panayam (face).
You shall therefore shamar (keep/guard) the matzawah (commandment), and the chaq (statute), and the mashapat (ordinances), which I tzawah (command) you this yawam (day), to ishah (make) them.

It shall happen, iqab (award / effect after the cause) you shamai (hearken / hear) to these mashapat (ordinances), and shamar (keep/guard) and ishah (make) them, that Yahawah your Alahayam will shamar (keep/guard) with you the barayath (covenant) and the loving chasad (grace) which he shabai (swear / take oath) to your ab (father):

And he will ahab (love) you, and barak (bless) you, and rabah (multiply) you; he will also barak (bless) the paray (fruit) of your batan (body) and the paray (fruit) of your adamah (ground), your grain and your new thayarawash (wine) and your yatzahar (fresh oil), the shagar (increase) of your livestock and the Ishatharah (young) of your tzaan (flock), in the adamah (land) which he shabai (swear / take oath) to your ab (father) to nathan (give) you.
You shall be barak (blessed) above all im (people / nation): there shall not be male or female iqar (barren) among you, or among your livestock.

Yahawah will sawar (take) away from you all chalay (sickness); and none of the rai (evil) madawah (diseases) of Matzarayam (Egypt), which you yadai (know), he will shawam (place / establish / appoint) on you, but will nathan (give) them on all those who shanaa (hate) you.

You shall akal (eat) all the im (people / nation) whom Yahawah your Alahayam shall nathan (give) to you; your iyan (eye) shall not chawas (pity) them: neither shall you ibad (servant) their Alahayam; for that will be a mawaqash (snare) to you.
If you shall amar (spoke) in your labab (heart), These gaway (nation / people) are more than I; ayak (how) yakal (can) I yarash (dispossess) them?

You shall not be yaraa (fear / be afraid) of them: you shall zakar (remembrance/memory) zakar (remembrance/memory) what Yahawah your Alahayam ishah (make) to Paraih (Pharaoh), and to all Matzarayam (Egypt);

The gadawal (very great/important/mighty) masah (trials) which your iyan (eye) raah (see), and the awath (sign / mark / miracle), and the mawapath (wonders), and the chazaq (mighty) yad (hand), and the natah (outstretched) zarawai (arm), by which Yahawah your Alahayam yatzaa (go out / come out) you out: so shall Yahawah your Alahayam ishah (make) to all the im (people / nation) of whom you are yaraa (afraid).
Moreover Yahawah your Alahayam will shalach (send) the tzaraih (hornet) among them, until those who are shaar (left), and sathar (hide) themselves, abad (destroy/perish) from panayam (before) you.
You shall not be scared of them; for Yahawah your Alahayam is in the qarab (among / near) of you, a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and awesome Al.

Yahawah your Alahayam will nashal (cast) out al (those) gaway (nation / people) panayam (before) you by mait (little) and mait (little): you may not kalah (complete / finish) them at mahar (once), lest the animals of the shadah (field) rabah (increase) on you.
But Yahawah your Alahayam will nathan (give) them up panayam (before) you, and will confuse them with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) mahawamah (confusion), until they be destroyed.

He will nathan (give) their malak (king) into your yad (hand), and you shall make their sham (name) to abad (destroy/perish) from under the sky: no ayash (husband/individual man) shall be yatzab (able) to stand panayam (before) you, until you have destroyed them.

You shall sharap (burn) the engraved pasayal (images) of their Alahayam with ash (fire). You shall not chamad (covet) the kasap (silver) or the zahab (gold) that is on them, nor laqach (take / seized) it for yourself, lest you be yaqash (snared) in it; for it is an thawaibah (abomination) to Yahawah your Alahayam.

You shall not bawaa (come) an thawaibah (abomination) into your bayath (house), and become a charam (devoted) thing like it. You shall shaqatz (utterly) shaqatz (detest) it, and you shall shaqatz (utterly) thaib (abhor) it; for it is a charam (devoted) thing.

You shall shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) all the matzawah (commandment) which I tzawah (command) you this yawam (day), that you may chayah (live), and rabah (multiply), and bawaa (come) in and yarash (possess) the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah shabai (swear / take oath) to your ab (father).

You shall zakar (remembrance/memory) all the darak (way) which Yahawah your Alahayam has yalak (led) you these arabaiyam (forty) shanah (years) in the madabar (wilderness), that he might inah (oppress / afflict) you, to nasah (prove) you, to yadai (know) what was in your labab (heart), whether you would shamar (keep/guard) his matzawah (commandments), or not.

He inah (oppress / afflict) you, and allowed you to be raib (hungry), and akal (eat) you with man (from), which you didn't yadai (know), neither did your ab (father) yadai (know); that he might yadai (make) you know that adam (man) does not chayah (live) by lacham (bread) only, but adam (man) chayah (lives) by everything that proceeds out of the pah (mouth) of Yahawah.
Your shamalah (clothing) didn't grow balah (old) on you, neither did your ragal (feet / foot) batzaq (swell), these arabaiyam (forty) shanah (years).
You shall yadai (consider) in your labab (heart) that as a ayash (husband/individual man) yasar (chastens) his ban (son), so Yahawah your Alahayam yasar (chastens) you.
You shall shamar (keep/guard) the matzawah (commandments) of Yahawah your Alahayam, to yalak (walk) in his darak (ways), and to yaraa (fear / be afraid) him.

For Yahawah your Alahayam bawaa (come) you into a tawab (pleasant/functional) aratz (Earth/land), a aratz (Earth/land) of nachal (stream / river) of mayam (Waters), of springs, and underground mayam (Waters) flowing into baqaih (valleys) and har (mountain);
A aratz (Earth/land) of chatah (wheat) and shairah (barley), and gapan (vines) and thaan (fig) trees and ramawan (pomegranates); a aratz (Earth/land) of zayath (olive) trees and dabash (honey);

A aratz (Earth/land) in which you shall akal (eat) lacham (bread) laa (NOT) masakanath (scarceness), you shall not chasar (lack) anything in it; a aratz (Earth/land) whose aban (stone) are barazal (iron), and out of whose harar (hills) you may chatzab (dig) nachashath (copper).
You shall akal (eat) and be shabai (full), and you shall barak (bless) Yahawah your Alahayam for the tawab (pleasant/functional) aratz (Earth/land) which he nathan (give) given you.

Beware lest you shakach (forget) Yahawah your Alahayam, in not shamar (keep/guard) his matzawah (commandments), and his mashapat (ordinances), and his chaqah (statutes), which I tzawah (command) you this yawam (day):
Lest, when you have akal (eat) and are shabai (full), and have banah (built) goodly bayath (house), and lived therein;
And when your baqar (morning) and your tzaan (flocks) rabah (multiply), and your kasap (silver) and your zahab (gold) is rabah (multiplied), and all that you rabah (have) is multiplied;

Then your labab (heart) be rawam (will lift up) up, and you shakach (forget) Yahawah your Alahayam, who yatzaa (go out / come out) you forth out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), out of the bayath (house) of ibad (servant);

Who yalak (led) you through the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and yaraa (fear / be afraid) madabar (wilderness), with sharap (fiery) nachash (serpents) and iqarab (scorpions), and tzamaawan (thirsty) ground where there was no mayam (Waters); who yatzaa (go out / come out) you forth mayam (Waters) out of the tzawar (rock) of chalamayash (flint);

Who akal (eat) you in the madabar (wilderness) with man (from), which your ab (father) didn't yadai (know); that he might inah (oppress / afflict) you, and that he might nasah (prove) you, to do you yatab (good) at your acharayath (latter) end:
And lest you amar (spoke) in your labab (heart), My kach (strength / mighty / power) and the itzam (might) of my yad (hand) ishah (make) gotten me this wealth.

But you shall zakar (remembrance/memory) Yahawah your Alahayam, for it is he who nathan (give) you kach (strength / mighty / power) to ishah (make) wealth; that he may qawam (rise up) his barayath (covenant) which he shabai (swear / take oath) to your ab (father), as at this yawam (day).

It shall be, if you shall shakach (forget) Yahawah your Alahayam, and halak (move) achar (other) other Alahayam, and ibad (servant) them, and shachah (worship) them, I iwad (admonish/bear witness against) against you this yawam (day) that you shall abad (destroy/perish) abad (destroy/perish).

As the gaway (nation / people) that Yahawah makes to abad (destroy/perish) panayam (before) you, so you shall abad (destroy/perish); iqab (award / effect after the cause) you wouldn't shamai (hearken / hear) to the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah your Alahayam.
