Of Napathalay (Naphtali) he amar (spoke), Napathalay (Naphtali), shabai (satisfied) with favor, malaa (full) of the barakah (blessing) of Yahawah, yarash (possess) the yam (sea/waters) and the darawam (south).

Of Ashar (Asher) he amar (spoke), Ashar (Asher) is barak (blessed) with ban (son). Let him be ratzah (acceptable) to his ach (brother/kinsman). Let him tabal (dip) his ragal (feet / foot) in shaman (oil).
Your bars shall be barazal (iron) and nachashath (brass). As your yawam (day), so your dabaa (strength) will be.
There is none like Al, Yasharawan (Jeshurun), who rakab (rides) on the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) for your izar (help), In his gaawah (excellency) on the shachaq (skies).

The qadam (eternal) Alahayam is your dwelling place. Underneath are the iwalam (forever) zarawai (arms). He garash (thrust) out the ayab (enemy) from panayam (before) you, and amar (spoke), ‘shamad (destroy)!’

Yasharaal (Israel) shakan (dwells) in safety; the iyan (eye) of Yaiqab (Jacob) badad (alone), In a aratz (Earth/land) of grain and new thayarawash (wine). Yes, his shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) irap (drop) down tal (dew).

You are ashar (who/that), Yasharaal (Israel). Who is like you, a im (people / nation) yashai (salvation) by Yahawah, the magan (shield) of your izar (help), the charab (sword) of your gaawah (excellency)! Your ayab (enemy) shall kachash (submit) themselves to you. You shall darak (tread) on their bamah (high) places.

Mashah (Moses) ilah (go up / offer) up from the irabah (plains) of Mawaab (Moab) to har (mountain) Nabaw (Nebo), to the raash (head) of Pasagah (Pisgah), that is over panayam (against) Yarayachaw (Jericho). Yahawah showed him all the aratz (Earth/land) of Galaid (Gilead), Dan (to) Dan,
And all Napathalay (Naphtali), and the aratz (Earth/land) of Aparayam (Ephraim) and Manashah (Manasseh), and all the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah), to the hinder yam (sea/waters),
And the nagab (south), and the kakar (plain) of the baqaih (valley) of Yarayachaw (Jericho) the iyar (city) of thamar (palm) trees, to Tzair (Zoar).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to him, This is the aratz (Earth/land) which I shabai (swear / take oath) to Abaraham (Abraham), to Yatzachaq (Isaac), and to Yaiqab (Jacob), amar (spoke), ‘I will nathan (give) it to your zarai (seed).’ I raah (see) caused you to see it with your iyan (eye), but you shall not ibar (pass over/through) over there.
So Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah mawath (death) there in the aratz (Earth/land) of Mawaab (Moab), according to the pah (word) of Yahawah.

He qabar (bury) him in the gayaa (valley) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Mawaab (Moab) over mawal (against) Bayathapaiwar (Beth) Peor: but no ayash (husband/individual man) yadai (knows) of his tomb to this yawam (day).
Mashah (Moses) was one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) when he mawath (death): his iyan (eye) was not kahah (dim), nor his lach (natural) force nawas (abated).

The ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) bakah (wept) for Mashah (Moses) in the irabah (plains) of Mawaab (Moab) shalawashayam (thirty) yawam (day): so the yawam (day) of bakay (weeping) in the abal (mourning) for Mashah (Moses) were thamam (ended).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun) malaa (was) full of the rawach (spirit / wind) of chakamah (wisdom); for Mashah (Moses) had samak (laid) his yad (hand) on him: and the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) shamai (hearken / hear) to him, and ishah (make) as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses).
There has not arisen a nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) iwad (more/again) in Yasharaal (Israel) like Mashah (Moses), whom Yahawah yadai (knew) panayam (face) to panayam (face),

In all the awath (sign / mark / miracle) and the mawapath (wonders), which Yahawah shalach (send) him to ishah (make) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), to Paraih (Pharaoh), and to all his ibad (servant), and to all his aratz (Earth/land),
And in all the chazaq (mighty) yad (hand), and in all the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) mawaraa (terror), which Mashah (Moses) ishah (make) in the iyan (eye) of all Yasharaal (Israel).

Now it happened achar (other) the mawath (death) of Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah, that Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun), Mashah (Moses)' sharath (servant), amar (spoke),

Mashah (Moses) my ibad (servant) is mawath (death); now therefore qawam (rise up), ibar (pass over/through) over this Yaradan (Jordan), you, and all this im (people / nation), to the aratz (Earth/land) which I nathan (give) to them, even to the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel).
I nathan (give) given you every maqawam (place) that the kap (sole) of your ragal (feet / foot) will darak (tread) on, as I dabar (word / matter) Mashah (Moses).

From the madabar (wilderness), and this Labanawan (Lebanon), even to the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) nahar (river), the nahar (river) Parath (Euphrates), all the aratz (Earth/land) of the Chathay (Hittites), and to the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) yam (sea/waters) toward the mabawaa (going) down of the shamash (sun), shall be your gabawal (border/boundary).

No ayash (husband/individual man) will be yatzab (able) to stand panayam (before) you all the yawam (day) of your chay (life). As I was with Mashah (Moses), so I will be with you. I will not rapah (fail) you nor izab (forsake) you.

Be chazaq (strong) and amatz (courageous); for you shall cause this im (people / nation) to nachal (inherit) the aratz (Earth/land) which I shabai (swear / take oath) to their ab (father) to nathan (give) them.

Only be chazaq (strong) and very amatz (courageous), to shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) according to all the thawarah (instruction), which Mashah (Moses) my ibad (servant) tzawah (commanded) you. Don't sawar (turn) from it to the right yamayan (right hand) or to the shamaawal (left hand), that you may have shakal (good) success wherever you yalak (go).

This sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction) shall not depart out of your pah (mouth), but you shall hagah (meditate) on it yawamam (by day) and layal (night), that you may shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) according to all that is kathab (written) therein: for then you shall tzalach (make) your darak (way) prosperous, and then you shall have shakal (good) success.
Haven't I tzawah (commanded) you? Be chazaq (strong) and amatz (courageous). Don't be iratz (afraid), neither be chathath (dismayed): for Yahawah your Alahayam is with you wherever you yalak (go).
Then Yahawashawai (Joshua) tzawah (commanded) the shatar (officers) of the im (people / nation), amar (spoke),

Ibar (pass over/through) qarab (among / near) the midst of the machanah (camp), and tzawah (command) the im (people / nation), amar (spoke), ‘kawan (prepare) food; for within shalawash (three) yawam (day) you are to ibar (pass over/through) over this Yaradan (Jordan), to bawaa (come) in to yarash (possess) the aratz (Earth/land), which Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) you to yarash (possess) it.’
Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to the Raawabanay (Reubenites), and to the Gaday (Gadites), and to the chatzay (half) - shabat (tribe) of Manashah (Manasseh), amar (spoke),

Zakar (remembrance/memory) the dabar (word / matter) which Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah tzawah (commanded) you, amar (spoke), ‘Yahawah your Alahayam gives you nawach (rest), and will nathan (give) you this aratz (Earth/land).

Your wives, your little tap (ones), and your livestock, shall live in the aratz (Earth/land) which Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) you ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan); but you shall ibar (pass over/through) over panayam (before) your ach (brother/kinsman) chamash (armed), all the gabawar (mighty) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of valor, and shall izar (help) them

Until Yahawah nawach (has) given your ach (brother/kinsman) nawach (rest), as he nawach (has) given you, and they have also yarash (possessed) the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) them. Then you shall shawab (turn back / repent) to the aratz (Earth/land) of your yarashah (possession), and possess it, which Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah nathan (give) you ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) toward the sunrise.’
They inah (answer / respond) Yahawashawai (Joshua), amar (spoke), All that you have tzawah (commanded) us we will ishah (make), and wherever you shalach (send) us we will yalak (go).
Just as we shamai (hearken / hear) to Mashah (Moses) in all things, so will we shamai (hearken / hear) to you. Only may Yahawah your Alahayam be with you, as he was with Mashah (Moses).

Ayash (husband/individual man) marah (rebels) against your commandment, and doesn't shamai (hearken / hear) to your dabar (word / matter) in all that you tzawah (command) him, he shall be put to mawath (death). Only be chazaq (strong) and amatz (courageous).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun) charash (secretly) shalach (send) shanayam (two) ban (son) out of Shatayam (Shittim) as ragal (spies), amar (spoke), "yalak (go), raah (see) the aratz (Earth/land), including Yarayachaw (Jericho)." They yalak (went) and bawaa (come) into the ashah (wife/individual woman) of a prostitute whose sham (name) was Rachab (Rahab), and shakab (slept) there.

The malak (king) of Yarayachaw (Jericho) was amar (spoke), Behold, ayash (husband/individual man) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) bawaa (come) in here tonight to spy out the aratz (Earth/land).

The malak (king) of Yarayachaw (Jericho) shalach (send) to Rachab (Rahab), amar (spoke), yatzaa (go out / come out) out the ayash (husband/individual man) who bawaa (come) come to you, who bawaa (come) entered into your bayath (house); for they bawaa (come) come to spy out all the aratz (Earth/land).

The ashah (wife/individual woman) laqach (take / seized) the shanayam (two) ayash (husband/individual man) and tzapan (hid) them. Then she amar (spoke), Yes, the ayash (husband/individual man) bawaa (come) to me, but I didn't yadai (know) ayan (where) they came from.

It happened about the time of the sagar (shutting) of the shair (gate), when it was chashak (darkness), that the ayash (husband/individual man) yatzaa (go out / come out) out. Where the ayash (husband/individual man) halak (move), I don't yadai (know). Radap (pursue) them mahar (quickly); for you will nashag (overtake) them.
But she had ilah (go up / offer) them up to the gag (roof), and taman (hid) them with the itz (stalks) of pashathah (flax), which she had irak (laid) in order on the gag (roof).

The ayash (husband/individual man) radap (pursued) them the darak (way) to the Yaradan (Jordan) to the maibar (fords): and as soon as those who radap (pursued) them yatzaa (go out / come out) gone out, they sagar (shut) the shair (gate).
Before they had shakab (laid) down, she ilah (go up / offer) up to them on the gag (roof);

And she amar (spoke) to the ayash (husband/individual man), I yadai (know) that Yahawah nathan (give) given you the aratz (Earth/land), and that the ayamah (fear) of you napal (fall / be cast down) fallen on us, and that all the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the aratz (Earth/land) mawag (melt) away panayam (before) you.

For we have shamai (hearken / hear) how Yahawah yabash (dry land) up the mayam (Waters) of the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters) panayam (before) you, when you yatzaa (go out / come out) out of Matzarayam (Egypt); and what you ishah (make) to the shanayam (two) malak (king) of the Amaray (Amorites), who were ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan), to Sayachawan (Sihon) and to Iwag (Og), whom you charam (utterly) destroyed.

As soon as we had shamai (hearken / hear) it, our labab (hearts) masas (melted), neither did there qawam (rise up) any more rawach (spirit / wind) in any ayash (husband/individual man), panayam (because) of you: for Yahawah your Alahayam, he is Alahayam in shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) mail (top/above), and on aratz (Earth/land) beneath.

Now therefore, please shabai (swear / take oath) to me by Yahawah, kay (surely) I ishah (make) dealt chasad (grace) with you, that you also will ishah (make) chasad (grace) with my ab (father) bayath (house), and nathan (give) me a amath (truth) awath (sign / mark / miracle);

And that you will chayah (save) alive my ab (father), my am (mother), my ach (brother/kinsman), and my achawath (sisters), and natzal (all) that they have, and will deliver our lives from mawath (death).

The ayash (husband/individual man) amar (spoke) to her, Our napash (living being/soul) for yours, if you don't talk about this dabar (word / matter) of ours; and it shall be, when Yahawah nathan (give) us the aratz (Earth/land), that we will ishah (make) chasad (grace) and truly with you.
Then she yarad (let) them down by a chabal (cord) baid (through) the chalawan (window); for her bayath (house) was on the qayar (side) of the chawamah (wall), and she lived on the chawamah (wall).

She amar (spoke) to them, yalak (go) to the har (mountain), lest the radap (pursuers) find you; and chabah (hide) yourselves there shalawash (three) yawam (day), until the radap (pursuers) have shawab (turn back / repent). Afterward, you may yalak (go) your darak (way).
The ayash (husband/individual man) amar (spoke) to her, We will be naqay (guiltless) of this your shabawaih (oath) which you have made us to shabai (swear / take oath).

Behold, when we bawaa (come) into the aratz (Earth/land), you shall qashar (bind) this line of shanay (second) chawat (thread) in the chalawan (window) which you used to let us down. You shall asap (gather) to yourself into the bayath (house) your ab (father), your am (mother), your ach (brother/kinsman), and all your ab (father) bayath (house).

It shall be that whoever yatzaa (go out / come out) out of the dalath (doors) of your bayath (house) into the chawatz (street), his dam (blood) will be on his raash (head), and we will be naqay (guiltless). Whoever is with you in the bayath (house), his dam (blood) shall be on our raash (head), if any yad (hand) is on him.
But if you talk about this dabar (word / matter) of ours, then we shall be naqay (guiltless) of your shabawaih (oath) which you have made us to shabai (swear / take oath).
She amar (spoke), "According to your dabar (word / matter), so be it." She shalach (send) them away, and they departed. She tied the shanay (second) line in the chalawan (window).

They yalak (went), and bawaa (come) to the har (mountain), and stayed there shalawash (three) yawam (day), until the radap (pursuers) had shawab (turn back / repent). The radap (pursuers) baqash (sought) them throughout all the darak (way), but didn't matzaa (find) them.

Then the shanayam (two) ayash (husband/individual man) shawab (turn back / repent), descended from the har (mountain), ibar (pass over/through) over, and bawaa (come) to Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun); and they sapar (book) him all that matzaa (had) happened to them.

They amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), kay (surely) Yahawah nathan (give) delivered into our yad (hand) all the aratz (Earth/land). Moreover, all the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the aratz (Earth/land) mawag (melt) away panayam (before) us.

Yahawashawai (Joshua) shakam (rose) up early in the baqar (morning); and they moved from Shatayam (Shittim), and bawaa (come) to the Yaradan (Jordan), he and all the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel). They lawan (lodged) there before they ibar (pass over/through) over.
It happened qatzah (end / extremity / border) shalawash (three) yawam (day), that the shatar (officers) ibar (pass over/through) qarab (among / near) the midst of the machanah (camp);

And they tzawah (commanded) the im (people / nation), amar (spoke), When you raah (see) the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah your Alahayam, and the kahan (priest) the Lawayay (Levites) nashaa (lift) it, then you shall move from your maqawam (place), and halak (move) it.

Yet there shall be a rachawaq (space) between you and it, about two alap (thousand) amah (cubits) by madah (measure). Don't qarab (come close) near to it, that you may yadai (know) the darak (way) by which you must yalak (go); for you ibar (pass over/through) not passed this darak (way) thamawal (before).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to the im (people / nation), qadash (set apart/make holy) yourselves; for machar (tomorrow) Yahawah will ishah (make) palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) qarab (among / near) you.

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to the kahan (priest), amar (spoke), "nashaa (lift) up the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant), and ibar (pass over/through) over panayam (before) the im (people / nation)." They nashaa (lift) up the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant), and yalak (went) panayam (before) the im (people / nation).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), Today I will chalal (begin) to gadal (magnify) you in the iyan (eye) of all Yasharaal (Israel), that they may yadai (know) that as I was with Mashah (Moses), so I will be with you.

You shall tzawah (command) the kahan (priest) who nashaa (lift) the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant), amar (spoke), ‘When you bawaa (come) to the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the mayam (Waters) of the Yaradan (Jordan), you shall imad (stand) still in the Yaradan (Jordan).’
Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), nagash (come) here, and shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah your Alahayam.

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke), Hereby you shall yadai (know) that the chay (life) Al is qarab (among / near) you, and that he will yarash (without) fail drive the Kanainay (Canaanite), and the Chathay (Hittite), and the Chaway (Hivite), and the Parazay (Perizzite), and the Garagashay (Girgashite), and the Amaray (Amorite), and the Yabawasay (Jebusite) out from panayam (before) you.
Behold, the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of the Adawan of all the aratz (Earth/land) passes over panayam (before) you into the Yaradan (Jordan).
Now therefore laqach (take / seized) shanayam (two) ayash (husband/individual man) out of the shabat (tribes) of Yasharaal (Israel), for achad (one) shabat (tribe) a ayash (husband/individual man).

It shall come to pass, when the kap (soles) of the ragal (feet / foot) of the kahan (priest) who nashaa (lift) the arawan (ark) of Yahawah, the Adawan of all the aratz (Earth/land), nawach (rest) in the mayam (Waters) of the Yaradan (Jordan), that the mayam (Waters) of the Yaradan (Jordan) will be karath (cut) off, even the mayam (Waters) that yarad (come) down from mail (top/above); and they shall imad (stand) in achad (one) nad (heap).

It happened, when the im (people / nation) moved from their ahal (tents) to ibar (pass over/through) over the Yaradan (Jordan), the kahan (priest) who nashaa (lift) the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) being panayam (before) the im (people / nation),

And when those who nashaa (lift) the arawan (ark) bawaa (come) come to the Yaradan (Jordan), and the ragal (feet / foot) of the kahan (priest) who nashaa (lift) the arawan (ark) had tabal (dipped) in the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the mayam (Waters) (for the Yaradan (Jordan) malaa (overflows) all its gadah (banks) all the yawam (day) of qatzayar (harvest)),

That the mayam (Waters) which yarad (came) down from mail (top/above) imad (stood), and qawam (rise up) up in achad (one) nad (heap), a maad (great) rachaq (way) off, at Adam (Adam), the iyar (city) that is tzad (beside) Tzarathan (Zarethan); and those that yarad (went) down toward the yam (sea/waters) of the irabah (arabah), even the malach (salt) yam (sea/waters), were wholly karath (cut) off. Then the im (people / nation) ibar (pass over/through) over right against Yarayachaw (Jericho).

The kahan (priest) who nashaa (lift) the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah imad (stood) kawan (firm) on dry charabah (ground) in the thawak (midst) of the Yaradan (Jordan); and all Yasharaal (Israel) ibar (pass over/through) over on dry charabah (ground), until all the gaway (nation / people) ibar (pass over/through) passed completely over the Yaradan (Jordan).
It happened, when all the gaway (nation / people) thamam (had) completely ibar (pass over/through) over the Yaradan (Jordan), that Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), amar (spoke),
Laqach (take / seized) shanayam (two) im (people / nation) out of the im (people / nation), out of achad (one) shabat (tribe) a ayash (husband/individual man),

And tzawah (command) them, amar (spoke), ‘nashaa (lift) from out of the thawak (midst) of the Yaradan (Jordan), out of the place where the kahan (priest)’ ragal (feet / foot) matzab (stood) kawan (firm), shanayam (two) aban (stone), and ibar (pass over/through) them over with you, and yanach (lay) them down in the malawan (lodging) place, where you will lawan (lodge) tonight.'

Then Yahawashawai (Joshua) qaraa (called) the shanayam (two) ayash (husband/individual man), whom he had kawan (prepared) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), out of achad (one) shabat (tribe) a ayash (husband/individual man).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to them, ibar (pass over/through) over panayam (before) the arawan (ark) of Yahawah your Alahayam into the thawak (midst) of the Yaradan (Jordan), and achad (one) of you pick up a aban (stone) and put it on your shakam (shoulder), according to the masapar (number) of the shabat (tribes) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel);
That this may be a awath (sign / mark / miracle) qarab (among / near) you, that when your ban (son) shaal (ask) in machar (time) to come, amar (spoke), ‘What do you mean by these aban (stone)?’

Then you shall amar (spoke) them, ‘Because the mayam (Waters) of the Yaradan (Jordan) were karath (cut) off panayam (before) the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah. When it ibar (pass over/through) over the Yaradan (Jordan), the mayam (Waters) of the Yaradan (Jordan) were karath (cut) off. These aban (stone) shall be for a zakarawan (memorial) to the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) iwalam (forever).’

The ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) ishah (make) as Yahawashawai (Joshua) tzawah (commanded), and nashaa (lift) up shanayam (two) aban (stone) out of the thawak (midst) of the Yaradan (Jordan), as Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), according to the masapar (number) of the shabat (tribes) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel); and they ibar (pass over/through) them over with them to the malawan (place) where they lodged, and yanach (laid) them down there.

Yahawashawai (Joshua) qawam (rise up) up shanayam (two) aban (stone) in the thawak (midst) of the Yaradan (Jordan), in the place where the ragal (feet / foot) of the kahan (priest) who nashaa (lift) the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) matzab (stood); and they are there to this yawam (day).

For the kahan (priest) who nashaa (lift) the arawan (ark) imad (stood) in the thawak (midst) of the Yaradan (Jordan), until everything was finished that Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Yahawashawai (Joshua) to dabar (word / matter) to the im (people / nation), according to all that Mashah (Moses) tzawah (commanded) Yahawashawai (Joshua); and the im (people / nation) hurried and ibar (pass over/through) over.

It happened, when all the im (people / nation) thamam (had) completely ibar (pass over/through) over, that the arawan (ark) of Yahawah ibar (pass over/through) over, with the kahan (priest), in the panayam (presence) of the im (people / nation).

The ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben), and the ban (son) of Gad (Gad), and the chatzay (half) - shabat (tribe) of Manashah (Manasseh), ibar (pass over/through) over chamash (armed) panayam (before) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), as Mashah (Moses) dabar (word / matter) to them.

About arabaiyam (forty) alap (thousand) chalatz (men), ready and armed for tzabaa (troop) ibar (pass over/through) over panayam (before) Yahawah to malachamah (battle), to the irabah (plains) of Yarayachaw (Jericho).

On that yawam (day), Yahawah gadal (magnified) Yahawashawai (Joshua) in the iyan (eye) of all Yasharaal (Israel); and they yaraa (fear / be afraid) him, as they yaraa (fear / be afraid) Mashah (Moses), all the yawam (day) of his chay (life).
Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), amar (spoke),
Tzawah (command) the kahan (priest) who nashaa (lift) the arawan (ark) of the idawath (testimony), that they ilah (go up / offer) up out of the Yaradan (Jordan).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) therefore tzawah (commanded) the kahan (priest), amar (spoke), ilah (go up / offer) up out of the Yaradan (Jordan)!

It happened, when the kahan (priest) who nashaa (lift) the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah had ilah (go up / offer) up out of the thawak (midst) of the Yaradan (Jordan), and the kap (soles) of the kahan (priest)' ragal (feet / foot) were nathaq (lifted) up to the dry charabah (ground), that the mayam (Waters) of the Yaradan (Jordan) shawab (turn back / repent) to their maqawam (place), and yalak (went) over all its gadah (banks), as shalashawam (before).

The im (people / nation) ilah (go up / offer) up out of the Yaradan (Jordan) on the ishawar (tenth) day of the raashawan (first) chadash (month), and chanah (encamped) in Galagal (Gilgal), on the mazarach (east) qatzah (end / extremity / border) of Yarayachaw (Jericho).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) qawam (rise up) up those shanayam (two) aban (stone), which they laqach (take / seized) out of the Yaradan (Jordan), in Galagal (Gilgal).
He amar (spoke) to the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), amar (spoke), When your ban (son) shaal (ask) their ab (father) in machar (time) to come, amar (spoke), ‘What do these aban (stone) mean?’
Then you shall let your ban (son) yadai (know), amar (spoke), ‘Yasharaal (Israel) ibar (pass over/through) over this Yaradan (Jordan) on dry yabashah (dry land).

For Yahawah your Alahayam yabash (dry land) up the mayam (Waters) of the Yaradan (Jordan) from panayam (before) you, until you ibar (pass over/through) passed over, as Yahawah your Alahayam ishah (make) to the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters), which he yabash (dry land) up from panayam (before) us, until we ibar (pass over/through) passed over;

That all the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land) may yadai (know) the yad (hand) of Yahawah, that it is chazaq (mighty); that you may yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah your Alahayam yawam (day).’

It happened, when all the malak (king) of the Amaray (Amorites), who were ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) westward, and all the malak (king) of the Kanainay (Canaanites), who were by the yam (sea/waters), shamai (hearken / hear) how that Yahawah had yabash (dry land) up the mayam (Waters) of the Yaradan (Jordan) from panayam (before) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), until we ibar (pass over/through) passed over, that their labab (heart) masas (melted), neither was there rawach (spirit / wind) in them any more, panayam (because) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel).
At that ith (time), Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), ishah (make) flint knives, and mawal (circumcise) again the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) the shanay (second) time.
Yahawashawai (Joshua) ishah (make) himself flint knives, and mawal (circumcised) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) at the gabaih (hill) of the iralah (foreskins).

This is the dabar (word / matter) Yahawashawai (Joshua) mawal (circumcised): all the im (people / nation) who yatzaa (go out / come out) out of Matzarayam (Egypt), who were zakar (remembrance/memory), even all the zah (this/that/these) of malachamah (war), mawath (death) in the madabar (wilderness) by the darak (way), yatzaa (go out / come out) they came out of Matzarayam (Egypt).

For all the im (people / nation) who yatzaa (go out / come out) out were mawal (circumcised); but all the im (people / nation) who were yalawad (born) in the madabar (wilderness) by the darak (way) as they yatzaa (go out / come out) out of Matzarayam (Egypt) had not been mawal (circumcised).

For the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) halak (move) arabaiyam (forty) shanah (years) in the madabar (wilderness), until all the gaway (nation / people), even the halak (move) of malachamah (war) who yatzaa (go out / come out) out of Matzarayam (Egypt), were thamam (consumed), because they didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah. Yahawah shabai (swear / take oath) to them that he wouldn't raah (see) them see the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah shabai (swear / take oath) to their ab (father) that he nathan (give) give us, a aratz (Earth/land) zawab (flow) with chalab (milk) and dabash (honey).

Their ban (son), whom he qawam (rise up) up in their place, were mawal (circumcised) by Yahawashawai (Joshua); for they were iral (uncircumcised), because they had not mawal (circumcised) them on the darak (way).
It happened, when they were thamam (done) mawal (circumcising) all the gaway (nation / people), that they stayed in their places in the machanah (camp) until they were healed.

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), "Today I have galal (rolled) away the charapah (reproach) of Matzarayam (Egypt) from off you." Therefore the sham (name) of that maqawam (place) was qaraa (called) Galagal (Gilgal), to this yawam (day).

The ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) chanah (encamped) in Galagal (Gilgal). They ishah (make) the pasach (passover) on the fourteenth yawam (day) of the chadash (month) at irab (evening) in the irabah (plains) of Yarayachaw (Jericho).
They akal (eat) unleavened matzah (cakes) and parched grain of the produce of the aratz (Earth/land) on the next macharath (day) after the pasach (passover), in the same yawam (day).

The man (from) shabath (shabath/rest) on the next macharath (day), after they had akal (eat) of the produce of the aratz (Earth/land). The ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) didn't have man (from) any more; but they akal (eat) of the thabawaah (fruit) of the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan) that shanah (year).

It happened, when Yahawashawai (Joshua) was by Yarayachaw (Jericho), that he nashaa (lift) up his iyan (eye) and raah (see), and behold, a ayash (husband/individual man) imad (stood) in front of him with his charab (sword) shalap (drawn) in his yad (hand). Yahawashawai (Joshua) yalak (went) to him, and amar (spoke) to him, Are you for us, or for our tzar (oppressor / distressor)?

He amar (spoke), "No; but I bawaa (come) come now as commander of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) tzabaa (troop)." Yahawashawai (Joshua) napal (fall / be cast down) on his panayam (face) to the aratz (Earth/land), and shachah (worshipped), and amar (spoke) to him, What does my Adawan amar (spoke) to his ibad (servant)?

The shar (prince / ruler) of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) tzabaa (troop) amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), "Take your nail (shoes) off of your ragal (feet / foot); for the maqawam (place) on which you imad (stand) is qadash (set apart/make holy)." Yahawashawai (Joshua) ishah (make) so.
Now Yarayachaw (Jericho) was tightly sagar (shut) up panayam (because) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel). No one yatzaa (go out / come out) out, and no one bawaa (come) in.
Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), raah (see), I nathan (give) given Yarayachaw (Jericho) into your yad (hand), with its malak (king) and the gabawar (mighty) men of valor.
All your ayash (husband/individual man) of malachamah (war) shall march around the iyar (city), naqap (going) around the iyar (city) paim (once). You shall ishah (make) this shash (six) yawam (day).

Shabai (seven) kahan (priest) shall nashaa (lift) shabai (seven) shawapar (Shawapar(Shofar) - Ram's horn (instrument)) of rams' yawabal (horns) panayam (before) the arawan (ark). On the shabayaiy (seventh) yawam (day), you shall march around the iyar (city) shabai (seven) paim (times), and the kahan (priest) shall thaqai (blow / sound alarm) the shawapar (Shawapar(Shofar) - Ram's horn (instrument)).

It shall be that when they mashak (make) a long blast with the yawabal (ram's) qaran (horn), and when you shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of the shawapar (Shawapar(Shofar) - Ram's horn (instrument)), all the im (people / nation) shall rawai (shout) with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) rawai (shout); and the chawamah (wall) of the iyar (city) shall napal (fall / be cast down) down thachath (under), and the im (people / nation) shall ilah (go up / offer) up every ayash (husband/individual man) straight before him.

Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun) qaraa (called) the kahan (priest), and amar (spoke) to them, nashaa (lift) up the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant), and let shabai (seven) kahan (priest) nashaa (lift) shabai (seven) shawapar (Shawapar(Shofar) - Ram's horn (instrument)) of rams' yawabal (horns) panayam (before) the arawan (ark) of Yahawah.

They amar (spoke) to the im (people / nation), Advance! March around the iyar (city), and let the chalatz (armed) ibar (pass over/through) pass on panayam (before) yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) arawan (ark).

It was so, that when Yahawashawai (Joshua) had amar (spoke) to the im (people / nation), the shabai (seven) kahan (priest) nashaa (lift) the shabai (seven) shawapar (Shawapar(Shofar) - Ram's horn (instrument)) of rams' yawabal (horns) panayam (before) Yahawah advanced, and thaqai (blow / sound alarm) the shawapar (Shawapar(Shofar) - Ram's horn (instrument)); and the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah halak (move) them.

The chalatz (armed) halak (move) went panayam (before) the kahan (priest) who thaqai (blow / sound alarm) the shawapar (Shawapar(Shofar) - Ram's horn (instrument)), and the arawan (ark) halak (move) achar (other) them. The shawapar (Shawapar(Shofar) - Ram's horn (instrument)) thaqai (blow / sound alarm) as they halak (move).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) tzawah (commanded) the im (people / nation), amar (spoke), You shall not rawai (shout), nor let your qawal (sound / voice) be shamai (hearken / hear), neither shall any dabar (word / matter) yatzaa (go out / come out) out of your pah (mouth), until the yawam (day) I amar (spoke) you to rawai (shout). Then you shall rawai (shout).

So he caused the arawan (ark) of Yahawah to sabab (go) around the iyar (city), naqap (going) about it paim (once). Then they bawaa (come) into the machanah (camp), and lawan (lodged) in the machanah (camp).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) shakam (rose) early in the baqar (morning), and the kahan (priest) nashaa (lift) up the arawan (ark) of Yahawah.

The shabai (seven) kahan (priest) nashaa (lift) the shabai (seven) shawapar (Shawapar(Shofar) - Ram's horn (instrument)) of rams' yawabal (horns) panayam (before) the arawan (ark) of Yahawah halak (move) on halak (move), and thaqai (blow / sound alarm) the shawapar (Shawapar(Shofar) - Ram's horn (instrument)): and the chalatz (armed) men halak (move) panayam (before) them. The rear guard halak (move) achar (other) the arawan (ark) of Yahawah. The shawapar (Shawapar(Shofar) - Ram's horn (instrument)) thaqai (blow / sound alarm) as they halak (move).
The shanay (second) yawam (day) they marched around the iyar (city) paim (once), and shawab (turn back / repent) into the machanah (camp). They ishah (make) this shash (six) yawam (day).

It happened on the shabayaiy (seventh) yawam (day), that they shakam (rose) early at the ilah (go up / offer) of the shachar (day), and marched around the iyar (city) in the same mashapat (way) shabai (seven) paim (times). Only on this yawam (day) they marched around the iyar (city) shabai (seven) paim (times).

It happened at the shabayaiy (seventh) paim (time), when the kahan (priest) thaqai (blow / sound alarm) the shawapar (Shawapar(Shofar) - Ram's horn (instrument)), Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to the im (people / nation), rawai (shout), for Yahawah nathan (give) given you the iyar (city)!

The iyar (city) shall be charam (devoted), even it and all that is in it, to Yahawah. Only Rachab (Rahab) the prostitute shall chayah (live), she and all who are with her in the bayath (house), because she chabaa (hid) the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) that we shalach (send).

But as for you, only shamar (keep/guard) yourselves from the charam (devoted) thing, lest when you charam (have) devoted it, you laqach (take / seized) of the charam (devoted) thing; so would you shawam (place / establish / appoint) the machanah (camp) of Yasharaal (Israel) charam (accursed), and ikar (trouble) it.

But all the kasap (silver), and zahab (gold), and kalay (vessels) of nachashath (brass) and barazal (iron), are qadash (set apart/make holy) to Yahawah. They shall bawaa (come) into yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) awatzar (treasury).

So the im (people / nation) rawai (shouted), and the priests thaqai (blow / sound alarm) the shawapar (Shawapar(Shofar) - Ram's horn (instrument)). It happened, when the im (people / nation) shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of the shawapar (Shawapar(Shofar) - Ram's horn (instrument)), that the im (people / nation) rawai (shouted) with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) tharawaih (shout), and the chawamah (wall) napal (fall / be cast down) down flat, so that the im (people / nation) ilah (go up / offer) up into the iyar (city), every ayash (husband/individual man) straight before him, and they lakad (took) the iyar (city).

They charam (utterly) destroyed all that was in the iyar (city), both ayash (husband/individual man) and ashah (wife/individual woman), both nair (young) and zaqan (old), and shawar (ox), and shah (sheep), and donkey, with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to the shanayam (two) ayash (husband/individual man) who had ragal (spied) out the aratz (Earth/land), bawaa (come) into the prostitute's bayath (house), and yatzaa (go out / come out) out from there the ashah (wife/individual woman) and all that she has, as you shabai (swear / take oath) to her.

The nair (young) men who were ragal (spies) bawaa (come) in, and yatzaa (go out / come out) out Rachab (Rahab) with her ab (father), her am (mother), her ach (brother/kinsman), and all that she yatzaa (go out / come out). They also brought out all her relatives, and they yanach (set) them outside of the machanah (camp) of Yasharaal (Israel).

They burnt the iyar (city) with ash (fire), and all that was in it. Only they nathan (give) the kasap (silver), the zahab (gold), and the kalay (vessels) of nachashath (brass) and of barazal (iron) into the awatzar (treasury) of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) bayath (house).

But Rachab (Rahab) the prostitute, her ab (father) bayath (house), and all that she had, Yahawashawai (Joshua) chayah (saved) chayah (alive). She lived in the midst of Yasharaal (Israel) to this yawam (day), because she chabaa (hid) the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah), whom Yahawashawai (Joshua) shalach (send) to ragal (spy) out Yarayachaw (Jericho).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) commanded them with an oath at that ith (time), amar (spoke), arar (cursed) is the ayash (husband/individual man) panayam (before) Yahawah, who qawam (rise up) up and banah (builds) this iyar (city) Yarayachaw (Jericho). With the loss of his bakawar (firstborn) shall he yasad (lay) its foundation, and with the loss of his youngest son shall he natzab (set) up its dalath (gates).
So Yahawah was with Yahawashawai (Joshua); and his shamai (fame) was in all the aratz (Earth/land).

But the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) mail (top/above) a mail (top/above) in the charam (devoted) things; for Ikan (Achan), the ban (son) of Karamay (Carmi), the ban (son) of Zabaday (Zabdi), the ban (son) of Zarach (Zerah), of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Yahawadah (Judah), laqach (take / seized) some of the charam (devoted) things. Therefore yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) charah (hot with anger) against the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) shalach (send) ayash (husband/individual man) from Yarayachaw (Jericho) to Iy (Ai), which is im (beside) Bayathaawan (Beth) Aven, on the qadam (east) side of Bayathaal (Bethel), and amar (spoke) to them, amar (spoke), "ilah (go up / offer) up and ragal (spy) out the aratz (Earth/land)." The ayash (husband/individual man) ilah (go up / offer) up and ragal (spied) out Iy (Ai).

They shawab (turn back / repent) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), and amar (spoke) to him, Don't let all the im (people / nation) ilah (go up / offer) up; but let about two or shalawash (three) alap (thousand) ayash (husband/individual man) ilah (go up / offer) up and nakah (strike) Iy (Ai). Don't make all the im (people / nation) to toil there, for there are only a mait (few) of them.

So about shalawash (three) alap (thousand) ayash (husband/individual man) of the im (people / nation) ilah (go up / offer) up there, and they nawas (fled) panayam (before) the ayash (husband/individual man) of Iy (Ai).

The ayash (husband/individual man) of Iy (Ai) nakah (struck) about shalawashayam (thirty) - shash (six) ayash (husband/individual man) of them, and they radap (chased) them from panayam (before) the shair (gate) even to Shabarayam (Shebarim), and nakah (struck) them at the descent. The labab (hearts) of the im (people / nation) masas (melted), and became like mayam (Waters).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) qarai (tore) his clothes, and napal (fall / be cast down) to the aratz (Earth/land) on his panayam (face) panayam (before) the arawan (ark) of Yahawah until the irab (evening), he and the zaqan (elders) of Yasharaal (Israel); and they ilah (go up / offer) ipar (dust) on their raash (head).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke), ahah (alas), Adanay Yahawah, why ibar (pass over/through) you brought this im (people / nation) over the Yaradan (Jordan) at ibar (pass over/through), to nathan (give) us into the yad (hand) of the Amaray (Amorites), to cause us to abad (destroy/perish)? I wish that we had been yaal (content) and lived ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan)!
Oh, Adanay, what shall I amar (spoke), achar (other) that Yasharaal (Israel) has hapak (turned) their irap (neck) panayam (before) their ayab (enemy)!

For the Kanainay (Canaanites) and all the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the aratz (Earth/land) will shamai (hearken / hear) of it, and will surround us, and karath (cut) off our sham (name) from the aratz (Earth/land). What will you ishah (make) for your gadawal (very great/important/mighty) sham (name)?
Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), qawam (rise up) up! Why are you napal (fall / be cast down) on your panayam (face) like that?

Yasharaal (Israel) has chataa (sinned). Yes, they ibar (pass over/through) even transgressed my barayath (covenant) which I tzawah (commanded) them. Yes, they have even laqach (take / seized) of the charam (devoted) things, and have also ganab (stolen), and also kachash (deceived). They have even shawam (place / establish / appoint) it among their own kalay (stuff).

Therefore the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) can't qawam (rise up) panayam (before) their ayab (enemy). They panah (turn) their irap (neck) panayam (before) their ayab (enemy), because they charam (have) become devoted for destruction. I will not be with you any more, unless you shamad (destroy) the charam (devoted) things from qarab (among / near) you.

Qawam (rise up) up! Qadash (set apart/make holy) the im (people / nation), and amar (spoke), ‘qadash (set apart/make holy) yourselves for machar (tomorrow), for Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), amar (spoke), There is a charam (devoted) thing in the qarab (among / near) of you, Yasharaal (Israel). You cannot qawam (rise up) panayam (before) your ayab (enemy) until you sawar (take) away the charam (devoted) thing from qarab (among / near) you.

‘In the baqar (morning) therefore you shall be qarab (come close) near by your shabat (tribes). It shall be that the shabat (tribe) which Yahawah selects shall qarab (come close) near by mashapachah (tribe/clan/family). The mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) which Yahawah selects shall qarab (come close) near by bayath (house). The bayath (house) which Yahawah selects shall qarab (come close) near gabar (man) by gabar (man).

It shall be, that he who is lakad (taken) with the charam (devoted) thing shall be burnt with ash (fire), he and ibar (pass over/through) that he has, because he has transgressed the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah, and because he ishah (make) done a disgraceful thing in Yasharaal (Israel).’
So Yahawashawai (Joshua) shakam (rose) up early in the baqar (morning) and qarab (come close) Yasharaal (Israel) near by their shabat (tribes). The shabat (tribe) of Yahawadah (Judah) was selected.

He qarab (come close) near the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of Yahawadah (Judah); and he selected the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Zerahites. He qarab (come close) near the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Zerahites gabar (man) by gabar (man), and Zabaday (Zabdi) was selected.

He qarab (come close) near his bayath (house) gabar (man) by gabar (man), and Ikan (Achan), the ban (son) of Karamay (Carmi), the ban (son) of Zabaday (Zabdi), the ban (son) of Zarach (Zerah), of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Yahawadah (Judah), was selected.

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to Ikan (Achan), My ban (son), please shawam (place / establish / appoint) kabawad (glory) to Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), and nathan (give) thawadah (confession) to him. Nagad (tell) me now what you ishah (make) done! Don't kachad (hide) it from me!
Ikan (Achan) inah (answer / respond) Yahawashawai (Joshua), and amar (spoke), I have truly chataa (sinned) against Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), and this is what I ishah (make) done.

When I raah (see) among the shalal (spoil) a tawab (pleasant/functional) Shanair (Babylonian) adarath (robe), two maah (hundred) shaqal (shekels) of kasap (silver), and a lashawan (tongue/language) of zahab (gold) weighing chamashayam (fifty) shaqal (shekels), then I chamad (coveted) them and laqach (take / seized) them. Behold, they are taman (hidden) in the aratz (Earth/land) in the thawak (midst) of my ahal (tent), with the kasap (silver) under it.

So Yahawashawai (Joshua) shalach (send) malaak (angel / messenger of Yah), and they rawatz (ran) to the ahal (tent). Behold, it was taman (hidden) in his ahal (tent), with the kasap (silver) under it.

They laqach (take / seized) them from the thawak (midst) of the ahal (tent), and bawaa (come) them to Yahawashawai (Joshua) and to all the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel). They yatzaq (laid) them down panayam (before) Yahawah.

Yahawashawai (Joshua), and all Yasharaal (Israel) with him, laqach (take / seized) Ikan (Achan) the ban (son) of Zarach (Zerah), the kasap (silver), the adarath (robe), the lashawan (tongue/language) of zahab (gold), his ban (son), his bath (daughter), his cattle, his donkeys, his tzaan (sheep), his ahal (tent), and all that he had; and they ilah (go up / offer) them up to the imaq (valley) of Ikawar (Achor).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke), "mah (why) have you ikar (troubled) us? Yahawah will ikar (trouble) you this yawam (day)." All Yasharaal (Israel) ragam (stoned) him with aban (stone), and they sharap (burned) them with ash (fire) and saqal (stoned) them with aban (stone).

They qawam (rise up) over him a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) gal (heap) of aban (stone) that remains to this yawam (day). Yahawah shawab (turn back / repent) from the charawan (fierceness) of his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting). Therefore the sham (name) of that maqawam (place) was qaraa (called) "The imaq (valley) of Ikawar (Achor)" to this yawam (day).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid), neither be chathath (dismayed). Laqach (take / seized) all the im (people / nation) of malachamah (war) with you, and qawam (rise up), ilah (go up / offer) up to Iy (Ai). Raah (see), I nathan (give) given into your yad (hand) the malak (king) of Iy (Ai), with his im (people / nation), his iyar (city), and his aratz (Earth/land).

You shall ishah (make) to Iy (Ai) and her malak (king) as you ishah (make) to Yarayachaw (Jericho) and her malak (king), except its shalal (spoil) and its livestock, you shall bazaz (take) for a plunder for yourselves. Shawam (place / establish / appoint) an arab (ambush) for the iyar (city) achar (other) it.

So Yahawashawai (Joshua) qawam (rise up), and all the im (people / nation) of malachamah (war), to ilah (go up / offer) up to Iy (Ai). Yahawashawai (Joshua) bachar (chose) shalawashayam (thirty) alap (thousand) men, the gabawar (mighty) ayash (husband/individual man) of valor, and shalach (send) them out by layal (night).

He tzawah (commanded) them, amar (spoke), raah (see), you shall lie in arab (ambush) against the iyar (city), achar (other) the iyar (city). Don't rachaq (go) very rachaq (far) from the iyar (city), but all of you be kawan (ready).

I, and all the im (people / nation) who are with me, will qarab (come close) to the iyar (city). It shall happen, when they yatzaa (go out / come out) out qaraah (against) us, as at the raashawan (first), that we will nawas (flee) panayam (before) them.

They will yatzaa (go out / come out) out achar (other) us, until we have nathaq (drawn) them away from the iyar (city); for they will amar (spoke), ‘They nawas (flee) panayam (before) us, like the raashawan (first) time.’ So we will nawas (flee) panayam (before) them,
And you shall qawam (rise up) up from the arab (ambush), and take yarash (possession) of the iyar (city); for Yahawah your Alahayam will nathan (give) it into your yad (hand).

It shall be, when you have seized on the iyar (city), that you shall yatzath (set) the iyar (city) on ash (fire). You shall ishah (make) this according to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah. Raah (see), I have tzawah (commanded) you.

Yahawashawai (Joshua) shalach (send) them out; and they yalak (went) to set up the maarab (ambush), and stayed between Bayathaal (Bethel) and Iy (Ai), on the yam (sea/waters) side of Iy (Ai); but Yahawashawai (Joshua) stayed thawak (midst) the im (people / nation) that layal (night).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) shakam (rose) up early in the baqar (morning), mustered the im (people / nation), and ilah (go up / offer) up, he and the zaqan (elders) of Yasharaal (Israel), panayam (before) the im (people / nation) to Iy (Ai).

All the im (people / nation), even the men of malachamah (war) who were with him, ilah (go up / offer) up, and nagash (drew) near, and bawaa (come) before the iyar (city), and chanah (encamped) on the tzapawan (north) side of Iy (Ai). Now there was a gayaa (valley) between him and Iy (Ai).

He laqach (take / seized) about chamash (five) alap (thousand) ayash (husband/individual man), and shawam (place / establish / appoint) them in arab (ambush) between Bayathaal (Bethel) and Iy (Ai), on the yam (sea/waters) side Iy (of) the city.

So they shawam (place / establish / appoint) the im (people / nation), even all the machanah (army) who was on the tzapawan (north) of the iyar (city), and their ambush on the yam (sea/waters) of the iyar (city); and Yahawashawai (Joshua) yalak (went) that layal (night) into the thawak (midst) of the imaq (valley).

It happened, when the malak (king) of Iy (Ai) raah (see) it, that they hurried and shakam (rose) up early, and the ayash (husband/individual man) of the iyar (city) yatzaa (go out / come out) out qaraah (against) Yasharaal (Israel) to malachamah (battle), he and all his im (people / nation), at the mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) appointed, panayam (before) the irabah (arabah); but he didn't yadai (know) that there was an arab (ambush) against him achar (other) the iyar (city).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) and all Yasharaal (Israel) made as if they were nagai (beaten) panayam (before) them, and nawas (fled) by the darak (way) of the madabar (wilderness).

All the im (people / nation) who were in the city were zaiq (called) together to radap (pursue) achar (other) them. They radap (pursued) Yahawashawai (Joshua), and were nathaq (drawn) away from the iyar (city).

There was not a ayash (husband/individual man) shaar (left) in Iy (Ai) or Bayathaal (Beth) El who didn't yatzaa (go out / come out) out achar (other) Yasharaal (Israel). They izab (left) the iyar (city) pathach (open), and radap (pursued) Yasharaal (Israel).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), "natah (stretch) out the javelin that is in your yad (hand) toward Iy (Ai), for I will nathan (give) it into your yad (hand)." Yahawashawai (Joshua) natah (stretched) out the javelin that was in his yad (hand) toward the iyar (city).

The arab (ambush) qawam (rise up) maharah (quickly) out of their maqawam (place), and they rawatz (ran) as soon as he had natah (stretched) out his yad (hand), and bawaa (come) into the iyar (city), and lakad (took) it. They hurried and yatzath (set) the iyar (city) on ash (fire).

When the ayash (husband/individual man) of Iy (Ai) panah (looked) achar (other) them, they saw, and behold, the ishan (smoke) of the iyar (city) ilah (go up / offer) up to shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), and they had no yad (hand) to nawas (flee) this hanah (here) or that way. The im (people / nation) who nawas (fled) to the madabar (wilderness) hapak (turned) back on the radap (pursuers).

When Yahawashawai (Joshua) and all Yasharaal (Israel) raah (see) that the arab (ambush) had lakad (taken) the iyar (city), and that the ishan (smoke) of the iyar (city) ilah (go up / offer), then they shawab (turn back / repent) again, and nakah (killed) the ayash (husband/individual man) of Iy (Ai).

The others yatzaa (go out / come out) out of the iyar (city) qaraah (against) them, so they were in the thawak (midst) of Yasharaal (Israel), some on this side, and some on that side. They nakah (struck) them, so that they shaar (let) none of them sharayad (remain) or palayat (escape).
They captured the malak (king) of Iy (Ai) chay (life), and qarab (come close) him to Yahawashawai (Joshua).

It happened, when Yasharaal (Israel) kalah (complete / finish) made an end of harag (killing) all the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Iy (Ai) in the shadah (field), in the madabar (wilderness) in which they radap (pursued) them, and they napal (fall / be cast down) all fallen by the pah (edge) of the charab (sword), until they were thamam (consumed), that all Yasharaal (Israel) shawab (turn back / repent) to Iy (Ai), and nakah (struck) it with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword).

All that napal (fall / be cast down) that yawam (day), both of ayash (husband/individual man) and ashah (wife/individual woman), were shanayam (two) alap (thousand), even all the ayash (husband/individual man) of Iy (Ai).

For Yahawashawai (Joshua) didn't shawab (turn back / repent) shawab (turn back / repent) his yad (hand), with which he natah (stretched) out the javelin, until he charam (had) utterly destroyed all the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Iy (Ai).

Only the livestock and the shalal (spoil) of that iyar (city) Yasharaal (Israel) bazaz (took) for prey to themselves, according to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah which he tzawah (commanded) Yahawashawai (Joshua).
So Yahawashawai (Joshua) burnt Iy (Ai), and shawam (place / establish / appoint) it a thal (heap) iwalam (forever), even a shamamah (desolation), to this yawam (day).

He hanged the malak (king) of Iy (Ai) on a itz (tree) until the ith (evening), and at the sundown Yahawashawai (Joshua) tzawah (commanded), and they yarad (took) his nabalah (body) down from the itz (tree), and shalak (threw) it at the pathach (entrance) of the shair (gate) of the iyar (city), and qawam (rise up) a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) gal (heap) of aban (stone) on it that remains to this yawam (day).
Then Yahawashawai (Joshua) banah (built) an mazabach (altar) to Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), in har (mountain) Iyabal (Ebal),

As Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah tzawah (commanded) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), as it is kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction) of Mashah (Moses), an mazabach (altar) of uncut aban (stone), on which no man had nawap (lifted) up any barazal (iron). They ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilah (offerings) on it to Yahawah, and zabach (sacrificed) peace ilah (offerings).

He kathab (wrote) there on the aban (stone) a mashanah (copy) of the thawarah (instruction) of Mashah (Moses), which he kathab (wrote) in the panayam (presence) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel).

All Yasharaal (Israel), and their zaqan (elders) and shatar (officers), and their shapat (judges), imad (stood) on this side of the arawan (ark) and on that side before the kahan (priest) the Lawayay (Levites), who nashaa (lift) the arawan (ark) of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) barayath (covenant), the foreigner as well as the native; chatzay (half) of them in mawal (front) of har (mountain) Garazayam (Gerizim), and chatzay (half) of them in mawal (front) of har (mountain) Iyabal (Ebal), as Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah had tzawah (commanded) at the raashawan (first), that they should barak (bless) the im (people / nation) of Yasharaal (Israel).

Afterward he qaraa (called) all the dabar (word / matter) of the thawarah (instruction), the barakah (blessing) and the qalalah (curse), according to all that is kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction).

There was not a dabar (word / matter) of all that Mashah (Moses) tzawah (commanded), which Yahawashawai (Joshua) didn't qaraa (called) before all the qahal (assembly) of Yasharaal (Israel), with the ashah (wife/individual woman), the little tap (ones), and the foreigners who were qarab (among / near) them.

It happened, when all the malak (king) who were ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan), in the har (mountain) country, and in the lowland, and on all the chawap (shore) of the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) yam (sea/waters) in mawal (front) of Labanawan (Lebanon), the Chathay (Hittite), the Amaray (Amorite), the Kanainay (Canaanite), the Parazay (Perizzite), the Chaway (Hivite), and the Yabawasay (Jebusite), shamai (hearken / hear) of it
That they qabatz (gathered) themselves yachad (together) to lacham (fight) with Yahawashawai (Joshua) and with Yasharaal (Israel), with achad (one) pah (accord).
But when the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Gabaiwan (Gibeon) shamai (hearken / hear) what Yahawashawai (Joshua) ishah (make) done to Yarayachaw (Jericho) and to Iy (Ai),

They also resorted to a ruse, and yalak (went) and tzayar (made) as if they had been ambassadors, and laqach (take / seized) balah (old) shaq (sacks) on their donkeys, and wineskins, balah (old) and baqai (torn) and tzarar (bound) up,

And balah (old) and patched nail (shoes) on their ragal (feet / foot), and wore balah (old) shalamah (Shalamah/(Solomon) - Patriarch). All the lacham (bread) of their provision was yabash (dry land) and moldy.

They yalak (went) to Yahawashawai (Joshua) to the machanah (camp) at Galagal (Gilgal), and amar (spoke) to him, and to the ayash (husband/individual man) of Yasharaal (Israel), We bawaa (come) come from a rachawaq (far) aratz (Earth/land). Now therefore karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) with us.
The ayash (husband/individual man) of Yasharaal (Israel) amar (spoke) to the Chaway (Hivites), What if you live qarab (among / near) us. How could we karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) with you?
They amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), "We are your ibad (servant)." Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to them, Who are you? Ayan (where) do you bawaa (come) from?

They amar (spoke) to him, Your ibad (servant) bawaa (come) come from a very rachawaq (far) aratz (Earth/land) because of the sham (name) of Yahawah your Alahayam; for we have shamai (hearken / hear) of his shamai (fame), all that he ishah (make) in Matzarayam (Egypt),

And all that he ishah (make) to the shanayam (two) malak (king) of the Amaray (Amorites) who were ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan), to Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of Chashabawan (Heshbon) and to Iwag (Og) malak (king) of Bashan (Bashan), who was Ishatharawath (at) Ashtaroth.

Our zaqan (elders) and all the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of our aratz (Earth/land) amar (spoke) to us, amar (spoke), ‘laqach (take / seized) tzayadah (provision) in your hand for the darak (journey), and yalak (go) to qaraah (meet) them, and amar (spoke) them, "We are your ibad (servant). Now karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) with us."’

This our lacham (bread) we took cham (hot) for our provision out of our bayath (house) on the yawam (day) we yatzaa (go out / come out) out to yalak (go) to you; but now, behold, it is yabash (dry land), and has become moldy.

These wineskins, which we malaa (filled), were chadash (new); and behold, they are baqai (torn). These our shalamah (Shalamah/(Solomon) - Patriarch) and our nail (shoes) have balah (become) old because of the very rab (long) darak (journey).
The ayash (husband/individual man) sampled their provisions, and didn't shaal (ask) counsel from the pah (mouth) of Yahawah.

Yahawashawai (Joshua) ishah (make) shalawam (peace / safety) with them, and ishah (make) a barayath (covenant) with them, to chayah (let) them live. The nashayaa (princes) of the idah (congregation) shabai (swear / take oath) to them.

It happened at the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of shalawash (three) yawam (day) achar (other) they had karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) with them, that they shamai (hearken / hear) that they were their neighbors, and that they lived qarab (among / near) them.

The ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) traveled and bawaa (come) to their iyar (cities) on the shalayashay (third) yawam (day). Now their iyar (cities) were Gabaiwan (Gibeon), Kapayarah (Chephirah), Baarawath (Beeroth), and Kiriath Qarayathayairayam (Jearim).

The ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) didn't nakah (strike) them, because the nashayaa (princes) of the idah (congregation) had shabai (swear / take oath) to them by Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel). All the idah (congregation) lawan (murmured) against the nashayaa (princes).

But all the nashayaa (princes) amar (spoke) to all the idah (congregation), We have shabai (swear / take oath) to them by Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): now therefore we may not nagai (touch) them.
This we will ishah (make) to them, and chayah (let) them live; lest qatzap (wrath) be on us, because of the shabawaih (oath) which we shabai (swear / take oath) to them.

The nashayaa (princes) amar (spoke) to them, chayah (let) them live, so they became itz (wood) cutters and drawers of mayam (Waters) for all the idah (congregation), as the nashayaa (princes) had dabar (word / matter) to them.

Yahawashawai (Joshua) qaraa (called) for them, and he dabar (word / matter) to them, amar (spoke), Why have you ramah (deceived) us, amar (spoke), ‘We are very rachawaq (far) from you,’ when you live qarab (among / near) us?
Now therefore you are arar (cursed), and some of you will never karath (cut) to be ibad (servant), both itz (wood) cutters and drawers of mayam (Waters) for the bayath (house) of my Alahayam.

They inah (answer / respond) Yahawashawai (Joshua), and amar (spoke), Because your ibad (servant) were nagad (certainly) nagad (told) how Yahawah your Alahayam tzawah (commanded) his ibad (servant) Mashah (Moses) to nathan (give) you all the aratz (Earth/land), and to shamad (destroy) all the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the aratz (Earth/land) from panayam (before) you. Therefore we were very yaraa (fear / be afraid) for our lives panayam (because) of you, and ishah (make) done this thing.
Now, han (behold), we are in your yad (hand). Ishah (make) to us as it seems tawab (pleasant/functional) and yashar (right) to you to ishah (make).
He ishah (make) so to them, and natzal (delivered) them out of the yad (hand) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), so that they didn't harag (kill) them.

That yawam (day) Yahawashawai (Joshua) nathan (give) them itz (wood) cutters and drawers of mayam (Waters) for the idah (congregation) and for the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah, to this yawam (day), in the maqawam (place) which he should bachar (choose).

Adanayatzadaq (Now) it happened when Adoni-Zedek malak (king) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) shamai (hearken / hear) kay (surely) Yahawashawai (Joshua) had lakad (taken) Iy (Ai), and charam (had) utterly destroyed it; as he ishah (make) done to Yarayachaw (Jericho) and her malak (king), so he ishah (make) done to Iy (Ai) and her malak (king); and how the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Gabaiwan (Gibeon) had made shalam (peace) with Yasharaal (Israel), and were qarab (among / near) them;

That they were very yaraa (fear / be afraid), because Gabaiwan (Gibeon) was a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) iyar (city), as achad (one) of the mamalakah (royal) iyar (cities), and because it was greater than Iy (Ai), and all its gadawal (very great/important/mighty) were gabawar (mighty).

Adanayatzadaq (Therefore) Adoni-Zedek malak (king) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) shalach (send) to Hawaham (Hoham) malak (king) of Chabarawan (Hebron), to Paraam (Piram) malak (king) of Yaramawath (Jarmuth), to Yapayai (Japhia) malak (king) of Lakayash (Lachish), and to Dabayar (Debir) malak (king) of Igalawan (Eglon), amar (spoke),
Ilah (go up / offer) up to me, and izar (help) me, and let us nakah (strike) Gabaiwan (Gibeon); for it has made shalam (peace) with Yahawashawai (Joshua) and with the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel).

Therefore the chamash (five) malak (king) of the Amaray (Amorites), the malak (king) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), the malak (king) of Chabarawan (Hebron), the malak (king) of Yaramawath (Jarmuth), the malak (king) of Lakayash (Lachish), the malak (king) of Igalawan (Eglon), asap (gathered) themselves together, and ilah (go up / offer) up, they and all their machanah (armies), and chanah (encamped) against Gabaiwan (Gibeon), and made lacham (war) against it.

The ayash (husband/individual man) of Gabaiwan (Gibeon) shalach (send) to Yahawashawai (Joshua) to the machanah (camp) to Galagal (Gilgal), amar (spoke), Don't abandon your ibad (servant)! Ilah (go up / offer) up to us maharah (quickly), and yashai (salvation) us, and izar (help) us; for all the malak (king) of the Amaray (Amorites) that yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the har (mountain) country have qabatz (gathered) together against us.

So Yahawashawai (Joshua) ilah (go up / offer) up from Galagal (Gilgal), he, and all the im (people / nation) of malachamah (war) with him, and all the gabawar (mighty) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of valor.

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), Don't yaraa (fear / be afraid) them, for I nathan (give) delivered them into your yad (hand). Not a ayash (husband/individual man) of them will imad (stand) panayam (before) you.
Yahawashawai (Joshua) therefore bawaa (come) on them pathaawam (suddenly). He ilah (go up / offer) up from Galagal (Gilgal) all layal (night).

Yahawah confused them panayam (before) Yasharaal (Israel), and he nakah (killed) them with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) makah (slaughter) at Gabaiwan (Gibeon), and radap (chased) them by the darak (way) of the ascent of Bayathachawarawan (Beth) Horon, and nakah (struck) them to Izaqah (Azekah) and to Maqadah (Makkedah).

It happened, as they nawas (fled) from panayam (before) Yasharaal (Israel), while they were at the descent of Bayathachawarawan (Beth) Horon, that Yahawah cast down gadawal (very great/important/mighty) aban (stone) from the sky on them to Izaqah (Azekah), and they mawath (death). There were more who mawath (death) from the hailstones than who the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) harag (killed) with the charab (sword).

Then Yahawashawai (Joshua) dabar (word / matter) to Yahawah in the yawam (day) when Yahawah nathan (give) up the Amaray (Amorites) panayam (before) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel); and he amar (spoke) in the iyan (eye) of Yasharaal (Israel), shamash (sun), stand still on Gabaiwan (Gibeon)! You, yarach (moon), stop in the imaq (valley) of Ayalawan (Aijalon)!

The shamash (sun) stood still, and the yarach (moon) imad (stayed), until the gaway (nation / people) had naqam (avenged) themselves of their ayab (enemy). Isn't hawaa (which/who/that is) kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of Jashar? The shamash (sun) imad (stayed) in the chatzay (midst) of the sky, and didn't hurry to bawaa (come) down about a thamayam (complete / whole) yawam (day).

There was no yawam (day) like that panayam (before) it or achar (other) it, that Yahawah shamai (hearken / hear) to the qawal (sound / voice) of a ayash (husband/individual man); for Yahawah lacham (fought) for Yasharaal (Israel).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) shawab (turn back / repent), and all Yasharaal (Israel) with him, to the machanah (camp) to Galagal (Gilgal).
These chamash (five) malak (king) nawas (fled), and chabaa (hid) themselves in the mairah (cave) at Maqadah (Makkedah).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) was nagad (told), amar (spoke), The chamash (five) malak (king) are matzaa (found), chabaa (hidden) in the mairah (cave) at Maqadah (Makkedah).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke), galal (roll) large aban (stone) to the pah (mouth) of the mairah (cave), and paqad (visit) gadawal (very great/important/mighty) by it to guard them;

But don't imad (stay). Radap (pursue) your ayab (enemy), and strike them from the rear. Don't allow them to bawaa (come) into their iyar (cities); for Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) delivered them into your yad (hand).

It happened, when Yahawashawai (Joshua) and the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) kalah (complete / finish) finished nakah (killing) them with a very gadawal (very great/important/mighty) makah (slaughter) until they were thamam (consumed), and the sharayad (remnant) which sharad (remained) of them bawaa (come) entered into the fortified iyar (cities),

That all the im (people / nation) shawab (turn back / repent) to the machanah (camp) to Yahawashawai (Joshua) at Maqadah (Makkedah) in shalawam (peace / safety). None charatz (moved) his lashawan (tongue/language) against any of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel).
Then Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke), pathach (open) the pah (mouth) of the mairah (cave), and bring those chamash (five) malak (king) out of the mairah (cave) to me.

They ishah (make) so, and brought those chamash (five) malak (king) out of the mairah (cave) to him: the malak (king) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), the malak (king) of Chabarawan (Hebron), the malak (king) of Yaramawath (Jarmuth), the malak (king) of Lakayash (Lachish), and the malak (king) of Igalawan (Eglon).

It happened, when they brought those malak (king) out to Yahawashawai (Joshua), that Yahawashawai (Joshua) qaraa (called) for all the ayash (husband/individual man) of Yasharaal (Israel), and amar (spoke) to the chiefs of the ayash (husband/individual man) of malachamah (war) who halak (move) with him, "qarab (come close) near, shawam (place / establish / appoint) your ragal (feet / foot) on the tzawaar (necks) of these malak (king)." They qarab (come close) near, and shawam (place / establish / appoint) their ragal (feet / foot) on their tzawaar (necks).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to them, Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid), nor be chathath (dismayed). Be chazaq (strong) and amatz (courageous), for Yahawah will ishah (make) this to all your ayab (enemy) against whom you lacham (fight).
Afterward Yahawashawai (Joshua) nakah (struck) them, put them to mawath (death), and hanged them on chamash (five) itz (trees). They were thalah (hanging) on the itz (trees) until the irab (evening).

It happened at the ith (time) of the bawaa (come) down of the shamash (sun), that Yahawashawai (Joshua) tzawah (commanded), and they yarad (took) them down off the itz (trees), and shalak (cast) them into the mairah (cave) in which they had chabaa (hidden) themselves, and shawam (place / establish / appoint) gadawal (very great/important/mighty) aban (stone) on the pah (mouth) of the mairah (cave), which remain to this very yawam (day).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) lakad (took) Maqadah (Makkedah) on that yawam (day), and nakah (struck) it with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword), with its malak (king). He charam (utterly) destroyed them and all the napash (living being/soul) who were in it. He shaar (left) none sharayad (remaining). He ishah (make) to the malak (king) of Maqadah (Makkedah) as he ishah (make) done to the malak (king) of Yarayachaw (Jericho).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) ibar (pass over/through) from Maqadah (Makkedah), and all Yasharaal (Israel) with him, to Labanah (Libnah), and lacham (fought) against Labanah (Libnah).

Yahawah nathan (give) it also, with its malak (king), into the yad (hand) of Yasharaal (Israel). He nakah (struck) it with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword), and all the napash (living being/soul) who were in it. He shaar (left) none sharayad (remaining) in it. He ishah (make) to its malak (king) as he ishah (make) done to the malak (king) of Yarayachaw (Jericho).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) ibar (pass over/through) from Labanah (Libnah), and all Yasharaal (Israel) with him, to Lakayash (Lachish), and chanah (encamped) against it, and lacham (fought) against it.

Yahawah nathan (give) Lakayash (Lachish) into the yad (hand) of Yasharaal (Israel). He lakad (took) it on the shanay (second) yawam (day), and nakah (struck) it with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword), with all the napash (living being/soul) who were in it, according to all that he ishah (make) done to Labanah (Libnah).

Then Haram (Horam) malak (king) of Gazar (Gezer) ilah (go up / offer) up to izar (help) Lakayash (Lachish); and Yahawashawai (Joshua) nakah (struck) him and his im (people / nation), until he had shaar (left) him none sharayad (remaining).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) ibar (pass over/through) from Lakayash (Lachish), and all Yasharaal (Israel) with him, to Igalawan (Eglon); and they chanah (encamped) against it lacham (fought) against it.

They lakad (took) it on that yawam (day), and nakah (struck) it with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword). He charam (utterly) destroyed all the napash (living being/soul) who were in it that yawam (day), according to all that he ishah (make) done to Lakayash (Lachish).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) ilah (go up / offer) up from Igalawan (Eglon), and all Yasharaal (Israel) with him, to Chabarawan (Hebron); and they lacham (fought) against it.

They lakad (took) it, and nakah (struck) it with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword), with its malak (king) and all its iyar (cities), and all the napash (living being/soul) who were in it. He shaar (left) none sharayad (remaining), according to all that he ishah (make) done to Igalawan (Eglon); but he charam (utterly) destroyed it, and all the napash (living being/soul) who were in it.
Yahawashawai (Joshua) shawab (turn back / repent), and all Yasharaal (Israel) with him, to Dabayar (Debir), and lacham (fought) against it.

He lakad (took) it, with its malak (king) and all its iyar (cities). They nakah (struck) them with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword), and charam (utterly) destroyed all the napash (living being/soul) who were in it. He shaar (left) none sharayad (remaining). As he ishah (make) done to Chabarawan (Hebron), so he ishah (make) to Dabayar (Debir), and to its malak (king); as he ishah (make) done also to Labanah (Libnah), and to its malak (king).

So Yahawashawai (Joshua) nakah (struck) all the aratz (Earth/land), the hill aratz (Earth/land), and the nagab (south), and the lowland, and the slopes, and all their malak (king). He shaar (left) none sharayad (remaining), but he charam (utterly) destroyed all that nashamah (breathing thing), as Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), tzawah (commanded).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) nakah (struck) them Qadashabaranai (from) Kadesh Barnea even to Izah (Gaza), and all the aratz (Earth/land) of Gashan (Goshen), even to Gabaiwan (Gibeon).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) lakad (took) all these malak (king) and their aratz (Earth/land) at achad (one) paim (time), because Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), lacham (fought) for Yasharaal (Israel).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) shawab (turn back / repent), and all Yasharaal (Israel) with him, to the machanah (camp) to Galagal (Gilgal).

It happened, when Yabayan (Jabin) malak (king) of Chatzawar (Hazor) shamai (hearken / hear) of it, that he shalach (send) to Yawabab (Jobab) malak (king) of Madawan (Madon), to the malak (king) of Shamarawan (Shimron), to the malak (king) of Akashap (Achshaph),

And to the malak (king) who were on the tzapawan (north), in the har (mountain) country, in the irabah (arabah) nagab (south) of Kanarawath (Chinneroth), in the lowland, and in the heights of Dawar (Dor) on the yam (sea/waters),

To the Kanainay (Canaanite) on the mazarach (east) and on the yam (sea/waters), and the Amaray (Amorite), and the Chathay (Hittite), and the Parazay (Perizzite), and the Yabawasay (Jebusite) in the har (mountain) country, and the Chaway (Hivite) under Charamawan (Hermon) in the aratz (Earth/land) Matzapah (of) Mizpah.

They yatzaa (go out / come out) out, they and all their machanah (armies) with them, many im (people / nation), even as the chawal (sand) that is on the shapah (seashore) in rab (multitude), with very many sawas (horses) and rakab (chariots).
All these malak (king) yaid (met) together; and they bawaa (come) and chanah (encamped) yaid (together) at the mayam (Waters) of Marawam (Merom), to lacham (fight) with Yasharaal (Israel).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid) panayam (because) of them; for machar (tomorrow) at this ith (time), I will nathan (give) them up all chalal (slain) panayam (before) Yasharaal (Israel). You shall hamstring their sawas (horses) and sharap (burn) their marakabah (chariots) with ash (fire).

So Yahawashawai (Joshua) bawaa (come), and all the im (people / nation) of malachamah (war) with him, against them by the mayam (Waters) of Marawam (Merom) pathaawam (suddenly), and napal (fall / be cast down) on them.

Yahawah nathan (give) them into the yad (hand) of Yasharaal (Israel), and they nakah (struck) them, and radap (chased) them to rab (great) Tzayadawan (Sidon), and to Masharapawathamayam (Misrephoth) Maim, and to the baqaih (valley) of Matzapah (Mizpeh) eastward. They nakah (struck) them until they shaar (left) them none sharayad (remaining).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) ishah (make) to them as Yahawah amar (spoke) him. He hamstrung their sawas (horses) and burnt their marakabah (chariots) with ash (fire).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) shawab (turn back / repent) back at that ith (time), and lakad (took) Chatzawar (Hazor), and nakah (struck) its malak (king) with the charab (sword): for Chatzawar (Hazor) used to be the raash (head) of all those mamalakah (kingdoms).

They nakah (struck) all the napash (living being/soul) who were in it with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword), charam (utterly) destroying them. There was no one yathar (left) who nashamah (breathing thing). He burnt Chatzawar (Hazor) with ash (fire).
