Yahawashawai (Joshua) captured all the iyar (cities) of those malak (king), with their malak (king), and he nakah (struck) them with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword), and charam (utterly) destroyed them; as Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah tzawah (commanded).
But as for the iyar (cities) that imad (stood) on their mounds, Yasharaal (Israel) sharap (burned) none of them, except Chatzawar (Hazor) only. Yahawashawai (Joshua) sharap (burned) that.

The ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) took all the shalal (spoil) of these iyar (cities), with the livestock, as bazaz (spoils) for themselves; but every adam (man) they nakah (struck) with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword), until they had destroyed them. They didn't shaar (leave) any who nashamah (breathing thing).

As Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses) his ibad (servant), so Mashah (Moses) tzawah (commanded) Yahawashawai (Joshua). Yahawashawai (Joshua) ishah (make) so. He sawar (left) nothing sawar (undone) of all that Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses).

So Yahawashawai (Joshua) captured all that aratz (Earth/land), the hill nagab (country), all the nagab (south), all the nagab (land) of Gashan (Goshen), the lowland, the irabah (arabah), the har (mountain) country of Yasharaal (Israel), and the lowland of the same;

From har (mountain) Chalaq (Halak), that ilah (go up / offer) up to Shaiyar (Seir), even to Bailagad (Baal) Gad in the baqaih (valley) of Labanawan (Lebanon) under har (mountain) Charamawan (Hermon). He lakad (took) all their malak (king), nakah (struck) them, and put them to mawath (death).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) ishah (make) malachamah (war) a rab (long) yawam (day) with all those malak (king).

There was not a iyar (city) that made shalam (peace) with the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), except the Chaway (Hivites), the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Gabaiwan (Gibeon). They laqach (take / seized) all in malachamah (battle).

For it was of Yahawah to chazaq (harden) their lab (heart), to come qaraah (against) Yasharaal (Israel) in malachamah (battle), that he might charam (utterly) destroy them, that they thachanah (might) have no favor, but that he might shamad (destroy) them, as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) bawaa (come) at that ith (time), and karath (cut) off the inaqay (anakim) from the har (mountain) country, from Chabarawan (Hebron), from Dabayar (Debir), from Inab (Anab), and from all the har (mountain) country of Yahawadah (Judah), and from all the har (mountain) country of Yasharaal (Israel): Yahawashawai (Joshua) charam (utterly) destroyed them with their iyar (cities).

There were none of the inaqay (anakim) yathar (left) in the aratz (Earth/land) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel). Only in Izah (Gaza), in gath (gath), and Ashadawad (in) Ashdod, did some shaar (remain).

So Yahawashawai (Joshua) laqach (take / seized) the whole aratz (Earth/land), according to all that Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses); and Yahawashawai (Joshua) nathan (give) it for an nachalah (inheritance) to Yasharaal (Israel) according to their machalaqath (divisions) by their shabat (tribes). The aratz (Earth/land) had shaqat (rest) from malachamah (war).

Now these are the malak (king) of the aratz (Earth/land), whom the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) nakah (struck), and yarash (possessed) their aratz (Earth/land) ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) toward the sunrise, from the nachal (stream / river) of the Aranawan (Arnon) to har (mountain) Charamawan (Hermon), and all the irabah (arabah) eastward:

Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of the Amaray (Amorites), who lived in Chashabawan (Heshbon), and mashal (rule/have dominion) from Irawair (Aroer), which is on the shapah (edge) of the nachal (stream / river) of the Aranawan (Arnon), and the thawak (midst) of the nachal (stream / river), and chatzay (half) Galaid (Gilead), even to the nachal (stream / river) Yabaq (Jabbok), the gabawal (border/boundary) of the ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon);

And the irabah (arabah) to the yam (sea/waters) of Kanarawath (Chinneroth), eastward, and to the yam (sea/waters) of the irabah (arabah), even the malach (salt) yam (sea/waters), eastward, the darak (way) to Bayathahayashayamawath (Beth) Jeshimoth; and on the thayaman (south), under the slopes of pasagah (pisgah):
And the gabawal (border/boundary) of Iwag (Og) malak (king) of Bashan (Bashan), of the yathar (remnant) of the Rapaa (Rephaim), who lived Ishatharawath (at) Ashtaroth and at Adaraiy (Edrei),

And mashal (rule/have dominion) in har (mountain) Charamawan (Hermon), and Salakah (in) Salecah, and in all Bashan (Bashan), to the gabawal (border/boundary) of the Gashawaray (Geshurites) and the Maikathay (Maacathites), and chatzay (half) Galaid (Gilead), the gabawal (border/boundary) of Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of Chashabawan (Heshbon).

Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah and the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) nakah (struck) them. Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah nathan (give) it for a yarashah (possession) to the Raawabanay (Reubenites), and the Gaday (Gadites), and the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh).

These are the malak (king) of the aratz (Earth/land) whom Yahawashawai (Joshua) and the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) nakah (struck) ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) westward, from Bailagad (Baal) Gad in the baqaih (valley) of Labanawan (Lebanon) even to har (mountain) Chalaq (Halak), that ilah (go up / offer) up to Shaiyar (Seir). Yahawashawai (Joshua) nathan (give) it to the shabat (tribes) of Yasharaal (Israel) for a yarashah (possession) according to their machalaqath (divisions);

In the har (mountain) country, and in the lowland, and in the irabah (arabah), and in the slopes, and in the madabar (wilderness), and in the nagab (south); the Chathay (Hittite), the Amaray (Amorite), and the Kanainay (Canaanite), the Parazay (Perizzite), the Chaway (Hivite), and the Yabawasay (Jebusite):
The malak (king) of Yarayachaw (Jericho), achad (one); the malak (king) of Iy (Ai), which is tzad (beside) Bayathaal (Bethel), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), achad (one); the malak (king) of Chabarawan (Hebron), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Yaramawath (Jarmuth), achad (one); the malak (king) of Lakayash (Lachish), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Igalawan (Eglon), achad (one); the malak (king) of Gazar (Gezer), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Dabayar (Debir), achad (one); the malak (king) of Gadar (Geder), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Charamah (Hormah), achad (one); the malak (king) of Irad (Arad), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Labanah (Libnah), achad (one); the malak (king) of Idalam (Adullam), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Maqadah (Makkedah), achad (one); the malak (king) of Bayathaal (Bethel), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Thapawach (Tappuah), achad (one); the malak (king) of Chapar (Hepher), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Apaq (Aphek), achad (one); the malak (king) Sharawan (of) Lassharon, achad (one);
The malak (king) of Madawan (Madon), achad (one); the malak (king) of Chatzawar (Hazor), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Shimron Shamarawanamaraawan (Meron), achad (one); the malak (king) of Akashap (Achshaph), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Thainak (Taanach), achad (one); the malak (king) of Magadawan (Megiddo), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Qadash (Kedesh), achad (one); the malak (king) of Yaqanaim (Jokneam) in Karamal (Carmel), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Dawar (Dor) in the height of Dawar (Dor), achad (one); the malak (king) of Goiim in Galagal (Gilgal), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Tharatzah (Tirzah), achad (one): all the malak (king) thirty-one.

Now Yahawashawai (Joshua) was zaqan (old) and well advanced in yawam (day). Yahawah amar (spoke) to him, You are zaqan (old) and advanced in yawam (day), and there shaar (remains) yet very much aratz (Earth/land) to be yarash (possessed).
This is the aratz (Earth/land) that still shaar (remains): all the regions of the Palashathay (Philistines), and all the Gashawaray (Geshurites);

From the Shayachawar (Shihor), which is panayam (before) Matzarayam (Egypt), even to the gabawal (border/boundary) of Iqarawan (Ekron) northward, which is chashab (counted) as Kanainay (Canaanite); the chamash (five) saran (lords) of the Palashathay (Philistines); the izathay (gazites), and the ashadawaday (ashdodites), the Ashkelonites, the Gathay (Gittites), and the iqarawanay (ekronites); also the Avvim,

On the thayaman (south); all the aratz (Earth/land) of the Kanainay (Canaanites), and Mairah (Mearah) that belongs to the Tzayadanay (Sidonians), to Apaq (Aphek), to the gabawal (border/boundary) of the Amaray (Amorites);
And the aratz (Earth/land) of the Gebalites, and all Labanawan (Lebanon), toward the sunrise, from Bailagad (Baal) Gad under har (mountain) Charamawan (Hermon) to the entrance of Chamath (Hamath);

All the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the har (mountain) country from Labanawan (Lebanon) to Masharapawathamayam (Misrephoth) Maim, even all the Tzayadanay (Sidonians); them will I yarash (drive) out from panayam (before) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel): only allocate it to Yasharaal (Israel) for an nachalah (inheritance), as I have tzawah (commanded) you.
Now therefore chalaq (divide) this aratz (Earth/land) for an nachalah (inheritance) to the thashai (nine) shabat (tribes) and the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh).

With him the Raawabanay (Reubenites) and the Gaday (Gadites) laqach (take / seized) their nachalah (inheritance), which Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) them, ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) eastward, even as Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah nathan (give) them:

From Irawair (Aroer), that is on the shapah (edge) of the nachal (stream / river) of the Aranawan (Arnon), and the iyar (city) that is in the thawak (midst) of the nachal (stream / river), and all the mayashawar (plain) of Mayadabaa (Medeba) to Dayabawan (Dibon);
And all the iyar (cities) of Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of the Amaray (Amorites), who malak (king) in Chashabawan (Heshbon), to the gabawal (border/boundary) of the ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon);

And Galaid (Gilead), and the gabawal (border/boundary) of the Gashawaray (Geshurites) and Maikathay (Maacathites), and all har (mountain) Charamawan (Hermon), and all Bashan (Bashan) Salakah (to) Salecah;

All the mamalakawath (kingdom) of Iwag (Og) in Bashan (Bashan), who malak (king) Ishatharawath (in) Ashtaroth and in Adaraiy (Edrei) (the same was shaar (left) of the yathar (remnant) of the Rapaa (Rephaim)); for Mashah (Moses) attacked these, and yarash (drove) them out.

Nevertheless the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) didn't yarash (drive) out the Gashawaray (Geshurites), nor the Maikathay (Maacathites): but Geshur and Maacath yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the qarab (among / near) of Yasharaal (Israel) to this yawam (day).

Only he nathan (give) no nachalah (inheritance) to the shabat (tribe) of Laway (Levi). The ashah (wife/individual woman) of Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), made by ashah (wife/individual woman) are his nachalah (inheritance), as he dabar (word / matter) to him.
Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) to the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family).

Their gabawal (border/boundary) was from Irawair (Aroer), that is on the shapah (edge) of the nachal (stream / river) of the Aranawan (Arnon), and the iyar (city) that is in the thawak (midst) of the nachal (stream / river), and all the mayashawar (plain) by Mayadabaa (Medeba);
Chashabawan (Heshbon), and all its iyar (cities) that are in the mayashawar (plain); Dayabawan (Dibon), Bamawath (Bamoth) Baal, Bayathabailamaiwan (Beth) Baal Meon,
Yahatz (Jahaz), Qadamawath (Kedemoth), Mawapaith (Mephaath),
Qarayathayam (Kiriathaim), Shabam (Sibmah), Zereth Tzarathahashachar (Shahar) in the har (mountain) of the imaq (valley),
Bayathapaiwar (Beth) Peor, the slopes of pasagah (pisgah), Bayathahayashayamawath (Beth) Jeshimoth,

All the iyar (cities) of the mayashawar (plain), and all the mamalakawath (kingdom) of Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of the Amaray (Amorites), who malak (king) in Chashabawan (Heshbon), whom Mashah (Moses) nakah (struck) with the nashayaa (chiefs) of Madayan (Midian), Away (Evi), Raqam (Rekem), Tzawar (Zur), Chawar (Hur), and Rabai (Reba), the nasayak (princes) of Sayachawan (Sihon), who lived in the aratz (Earth/land).

The ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) alse harag (killed) Balaim (Balaam) also the ban (son) of Baiwar (Beor), the qasam (soothsayer), with the charab (sword), al (among) the rest of their chalal (slain).

The gabawal (border/boundary) of the ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben) was the bank of the Yaradan (Jordan). This was the nachalah (inheritance) of the ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family), the iyar (cities) and its chatzar (villages).
Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) to the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Gad (Gad), to the ban (son) of Gad (Gad), according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family).

Their gabawal (border/boundary) was Yaizayar (Jazer), and all the iyar (cities) of Galaid (Gilead), and chatzay (half) the aratz (Earth/land) of the ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon), to Irawair (Aroer) that is panayam (before) Rabah (Rabbah);
And from Chashabawan (Heshbon) to Ramathahamatzapah (Ramath) Mizpeh, and Batanayam (Betonim); and from Machanayam (Mahanaim) to the gabawal (border/boundary) of Dabayar (Debir);

And in the imaq (valley), Bayathaharam (Beth) Haram, Bayathanamarah (Beth) Nimrah, Sakawath (Succoth), and Tzapawan (Zaphon), the yathar (rest) of the mamalakawath (kingdom) of Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of Chashabawan (Heshbon), the Yaradan (Jordan's) bank, to the uttermost part of the yam (sea/waters) of Kanarawath (Chinnereth) ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) eastward.
This is the nachalah (inheritance) of the ban (son) of Gad (Gad) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family), the iyar (cities) and its chatzar (villages).

Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) an chatzay (inheritance) to the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh). It was for the half-tribe of the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family).

Their gabawal (border/boundary) was from Machanayam (Mahanaim), all Bashan (Bashan), all the mamalakawath (kingdom) of Iwag (Og) malak (king) of Bashan (Bashan), and all the chawah (town/named location) of Yaayar (Jair), which are in Bashan (Bashan), shashayam (sixty) iyar (cities).

Chatzay (half) Galaid (Gilead), Ishatharawath (Ashtaroth), and Adaraiy (Edrei), the iyar (cities) of the mamalakawath (kingdom) of Iwag (Og) in Bashan (Bashan), were for the ban (son) of Makayar (Machir) the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh), even for the chatzay (half) of the ban (son) of Makayar (Machir) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family).
These are the nachal (inheritances) which Mashah (Moses) distributed in the irabah (plains) of Mawaab (Moab), ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) at Yarayachaw (Jericho), eastward.

But to the shabat (tribe) of Laway (Levi) Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) no nachalah (inheritance). Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), is their nachalah (inheritance), as he dabar (word / matter) to them.

These are the inheritances which the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) nachal (took) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan), which Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun), and the raash (head) of the ab (father)' houses of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), nachal (distributed) to them,
By the gawaral (lot) of their nachalah (inheritance), as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) by Mashah (Moses), for the thashai (nine) matah (staff / rod / tribe), and for the half-tribe.

For Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) given the nachalah (inheritance) of the shanayam (two) matah (staff / rod / tribe) and the half-tribe ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan); but to the Lawayay (Levites) he nathan (give) no nachalah (inheritance) thawak (midst) them.

For the ban (son) of Yawasap (Joseph) were shanayam (two) matah (staff / rod / tribe), Manashah (Manasseh) and Aparayam (Ephraim): and they nathan (give) no chalaq (portion) to the Lawayay (Levites) in the aratz (Earth/land), except iyar (cities) to yashab (inhabit/dwell) in, with their magarash (suburbs) for their livestock and for their property.
The ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) ishah (make) as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses), and they chalaq (divided) the aratz (Earth/land).

Then the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah) nagash (drew) near to Yahawashawai (Joshua) in Galagal (Gilgal). Kalab (Caleb) the ban (son) of Yapanah (Jephunneh) the Qanazay (Kenizzite) amar (spoke) to him, You yadai (know) the thing that Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses) the ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam awadawath (concerning) me and awadawath (concerning) you Qadashabaranai (in) Kadesh Barnea.

I was arabaiyam (forty) shanah (years) ban (son) when Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah shalach (send) me Qadashabaranai (from) Kadesh Barnea to ragal (spy) out the aratz (Earth/land). I shawab (turn back / repent) him dabar (word / matter) again as it was in my labab (heart).
Nevertheless, my ach (brother/kinsman) who ilah (go up / offer) up with me made the lab (heart) of the im (people / nation) masah (melt); but I malaa (wholly) achar (other) Yahawah my Alahayam.

Mashah (Moses) shabai (swear / take oath) on that yawam (day), amar (spoke), ‘Surely the aratz (Earth/land) where you darak (walked) shall be an nachalah (inheritance) to you and to your ban (son) iwalam (forever), because you malaa (have) wholly achar (other) Yahawah my Alahayam.’

Now, behold, Yahawah has chayah (kept) me alive, as he dabar (word / matter), these forty-five shanah (years), from the az (time) that Yahawah dabar (word / matter) this dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), while Yasharaal (Israel) halak (move) in the madabar (wilderness). Now, behold, I am eighty-five shanah (years) ban (son), today.

As yet I am as chazaq (strong) today as I was in the yawam (day) that Mashah (Moses) shalach (send) me: as my kach (strength / mighty / power) was then, even so is my kach (strength / mighty / power) now for malachamah (war), to yatzaa (go out / come out) out and to bawaa (come) in.

Now therefore nathan (give) me this har (mountain) country, of which Yahawah dabar (word / matter) in that yawam (day); for you shamai (hearken / hear) in that yawam (day) how the inaqay (anakim) were there, and gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and batzar (fortified) iyar (cities). It awalay (perhaps) be that Yahawah will be with me, and I shall yarash (drive) them out, as Yahawah dabar (word / matter).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) barak (blessed) him; and he nathan (give) Chabarawan (Hebron) to Kalab (Caleb) the ban (son) of Yapanah (Jephunneh) for an nachalah (inheritance).

Therefore Chabarawan (Hebron) became the nachalah (inheritance) of Kalab (Caleb) the ban (son) of Yapanah (Jephunneh) the Qanazay (Kenizzite) to this yawam (day); because he malaa (wholly) achar (other) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel).

Now the sham (name) of Chabarawan (Hebron) panayam (before) was Kiriath Qarayathaarabai (Arba), after the greatest adam (man) among the inaqay (anakim). The aratz (Earth/land) had shaqat (rest) from malachamah (war).

The gawaral (lot) for the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) was to the gabawal (border/boundary) of Adam (Edom), even to the madabar (wilderness) of Tzan (Zin) southward, at the uttermost part of the thayaman (south).
Their nagab (south) gabawal (border/boundary) was from the uttermost part of the malach (salt) yam (sea/waters), from the lashawan (tongue/language) that panah (looks) southward;

And it yatzaa (go out / come out) out southward of the ascent of mailahaiqarabayam (akrabbim), and ibar (pass over/through) along to Tzan (Zin), and ilah (go up / offer) up Qadashabaranai (by) the south of Kadesh Barnea, and ibar (pass over/through) along by Chatzarawan (Hezron), ilah (go up / offer) up to Adar (Addar), and sabab (turned) about Qaraqai (to) Karka;

And it ibar (pass over/through) along to Itzamawan (Azmon), yatzaa (go out / come out) out at the nachal (stream / river) of Matzarayam (Egypt); and the gabawal (border/boundary) ended at the yam (sea/waters). This shall be your nagab (south) gabawal (border/boundary).

The qadam (east) gabawal (border/boundary) was the malach (salt) yam (sea/waters), even to the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the Yaradan (Jordan). The gabawal (border/boundary) of the tzapawan (north) paah (quarter) was from the lashawan (tongue/language) of the yam (sea/waters) at the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the Yaradan (Jordan).

The gabawal (border/boundary) ilah (go up / offer) up to Bayathachagalah (Beth) Hoglah, and ibar (pass over/through) along by the tzapawan (north) of Bayathahairabah (Beth) Arabah; and the gabawal (border/boundary) ilah (go up / offer) up to the aban (stone) of Bahan (Bohan) the ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben).

The gabawal (border/boundary) ilah (go up / offer) up to Dabayar (Debir) from the imaq (valley) of Ikawar (Achor), and so northward, panah (looking) toward Galagal (Gilgal), that is over nakach (against) the mailah (ascent) of Adamayam (Adummim), which is on the nagab (south) side of the nachal (stream / river). The gabawal (border/boundary) ibar (pass over/through) along to the mayam (Waters) Iyanashamash (of) En Shemesh, and ended at Iyanaragal (En) Rogel.

The gabawal (border/boundary) ilah (go up / offer) up by the gayaa (valley) of the ban (son) of Hanam (Hinnom) to the kathap (side) of the Yabawasay (Jebusite) southward (the same is Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)); and the gabawal (border/boundary) ilah (go up / offer) up to the raash (head) of the har (mountain) that lies panayam (before) the gayaa (valley) of Hanam (Hinnom) westward, which is at the farthest part of the imaq (valley) of Rapaa (Rephaim) northward.

The gabawal (border/boundary) extended from the raash (head) of the har (mountain) to the maiyan (spring) of the mayam (Waters) of Napathawach (Nephtoah), and yatzaa (go out / come out) out to the iyar (cities) of har (mountain) Iparawan (Ephron); and the gabawal (border/boundary) extended to Bailah (Baalah) (the same is Kiriath Qarayathayairayam (Jearim));

And the gabawal (border/boundary) sabab (turned) about from Bailah (Baalah) westward to har (mountain) Shaiyar (Seir), and ibar (pass over/through) along to the kathap (side) of har (mountain) Yairayam (Jearim) on the tzapawan (north) (the same is Kasalawan (Chesalon)), and yarad (went) down to Bayathashamash (Beth) Shemesh, and ibar (pass over/through) along by Thamanah (Timnah);

And the gabawal (border/boundary) yatzaa (go out / come out) out to the kathap (side) of Iqarawan (Ekron) northward; and the gabawal (border/boundary) extended Shakarawan (to) Shikkeron, and ibar (pass over/through) along to har (mountain) Bailah (Baalah), and yatzaa (go out / come out) out at Yabanaal (Jabneel); and the yatzaa (go out / come out) out of the gabawal (border/boundary) were at the yam (sea/waters).

The yam (sea/waters) gabawal (border/boundary) was to the shore of the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) yam (sea/waters). This is the gabawal (border/boundary) of the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family).

To Kalab (Caleb) the ban (son) of Yapanah (Jephunneh) he nathan (give) a chalaq (portion) thawak (midst) the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah), al (according) to the commandment of Yahawah to Yahawashawai (Joshua), even Kiriath qarayathaarabai (arba), named after the ab (father) of Inaq (Anak) (the same is Chabarawan (Hebron)).
Kalab (Caleb) yarash (drove) out the shalawash (three) ban (son) of Inaq (Anak): Shashay (Sheshai), and Achayaman (Ahiman), and Thalamay (Talmai), the yalayad (children) of Inaq (Anak).
He ilah (go up / offer) up against the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Dabayar (Debir): now the sham (name) of Dabayar (Debir) panayam (before) was Kiriath Qarayathasanah (Sepher).

Kalab (Caleb) amar (spoke), He who nakah (strikes) Kiriath Qarayathasanah (Sepher), and lakad (takes) it, to him will I nathan (give) Ikasah (Achsah) my bath (daughter) as ashah (wife/individual woman).

Ithanayaal (Othniel) the ban (son) of Qanaz (Kenaz), the ach (brother/kinsman) of Kalab (Caleb), lakad (took) it: and he nathan (give) him Ikasah (Achsah) his bath (daughter) as ashah (wife/individual woman).
It happened, when she bawaa (come), that she had him shaal (ask) her ab (father) for a shadah (field). She got off of her donkey, and Kalab (Caleb) amar (spoke), What do you want?

She amar (spoke), "nathan (give) me a barakah (blessing). Because you nathan (give) set me in the aratz (Earth/land) of the nagab (south), nathan (give) me also galah (spring / basin / bowl) of mayam (Waters)." He nathan (give) her the ilay (went up) galah (spring / basin / bowl) and the lower galah (spring / basin / bowl).
This is the nachalah (inheritance) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family).

The farthest iyar (cities) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah) toward the gabawal (border/boundary) of Adam (Edom) in the nagab (south) were Qabatzaal (Kabzeel), Idar (Eder), Yagawar (Jagur),
Qayanah (Kinah), Dayamawanah (Dimonah), Idaidah (Adadah),
Qadash (Kedesh), Chatzawar (Hazor), Yathanan (Ithnan),
Zayap (Ziph), Talam (Telem), Bailawath (Bealoth),
Chatzawar (Hazor) Chatzawarachadathah (Hadattah), Qarayawath (Kerioth) Chatzarawan (Hezron) (the same is Chatzawar (Hazor)),
Amam (Amam), Shamai (Shema), Mawaladah (Moladah),
Chatzaragadah (Hazar) Gaddah, Chashamawan (Heshmon), Bayathapalat (Beth) Pelet,
Chatzarashawail (Hazar) Shual, Baarashabai (Beersheba), Bazayawathayah (Biziothiah),
Bailah (Baalah), Iyayam (Iim), Itzam (Ezem),
Alathawalad (Eltolad), Kasayal (Chesil), Charamah (Hormah),
Tzaqalag (Ziklag), Madamanah (Madmannah), Sanasanah (Sansannah),
Labaawath (Lebaoth), Shalachayam (Shilhim), Iyan (Ain), and Ramawan (Rimmon). All the iyar (cities) are twenty-nine, with their chatzar (villages).
In the lowland, Ashathaal (Eshtaol), Tzaraih (Zorah), Ashanah (Ashnah),
Zanawach (Zanoah), Iyanaganayam (En) Gannim, Thapawach (Tappuah), Iyanayam (Enam),
Yaramawath (Jarmuth), Idalam (Adullam), Shawakah (Socoh), Izaqah (Azekah),
Shairayam (Shaaraim), Idayathayam (Adithaim) and Gadarah (Gederah) (or Gadarathayam (Gederothaim)); fourteen iyar (cities) with their chatzar (villages).
Tzanan (Zenan), Chadashah (Hadashah), Magadalagad (Migdal) Gad,
Dalain (Dilean), Matzapah (Mizpeh), Yaqathaal (Joktheel),
Lakayash (Lachish), Batzaqath (Bozkath), Igalawan (Eglon),
Kabawan (Cabbon), Lachamas (Lahmam), Kathalayash (Chitlish),
Gadarawath (Gederoth), Bayathadagawan (Beth) Dagon, Naimah (Naamah), and Maqadah (Makkedah); sixteen iyar (cities) with their chatzar (villages).
Labanah (Libnah), Ithar (Ether), Ishan (Ashan),
Yapathach (Iphtah), Ashanah (Ashnah), Natzayab (Nezib),
Qaiyalah (Keilah), Akazayab (Achzib), and Maraashah (Mareshah); thashai (nine) iyar (cities) with their chatzar (villages).
Iqarawan (Ekron), with its bath (daughter) and its chatzar (villages);
From Iqarawan (Ekron) even to the yam (sea/waters), all that were by the Ashadawad (side) of Ashdod, with their chatzar (villages).

Ashadawad (Ashdod), its bath (daughter) and its chatzar (villages); Izah (Gaza), its bath (daughter) and its chatzar (villages); to the nachal (stream / river) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and the gabawal (border/boundary) yam (sea/waters) with its coastline.
In the har (mountain) country, Shamayar (Shamir), Yathayar (Jattir), Shawakah (Socoh),
Danah (Dannah), Kiriath Qarayathasanah (Sannah) (which is Dabayar (Debir)),
Inab (Anab), Ashathamai (Eshtemoh), Inayam (Anim),
Gashan (Goshen), Chalawan (Holon), and Galah (Giloh); achad (one) iyar (cities) with their chatzar (villages).
Arab (Arab), Dawamah (Dumah), Ashain (Eshan),
Yanayam (Janim), Bayathathapawach (Beth) Tappuah, Apaqah (Aphekah),
Chamatah (Humtah), Kiriath Qarayathaarabai (Arba) (the same is Chabarawan (Hebron)), and Tzayair (Zior); thashai (nine) iyar (cities) with their chatzar (villages).
Maiwan (maon), Karamal (Carmel), Zayap (Ziph), Yatah (Jutah),
Yazaraial (Jezreel), Yaqadaim (Jokdeam), Zanawach (Zanoah),
Qayan (Kain), Gabaih (Gibeah), and Thamanah (Timnah); ishar (ten) iyar (cities) with their chatzar (villages).
Chalachawal (Halhul), Bayathatzawar (Beth) Zur, Gadar (Gedor),
Mairath (Maarath), Bayathainawath (Beth) Anoth, and Alathaqan (Eltekon); shash (six) iyar (cities) with their chatzar (villages).
Qarayathabail (Kiriath) Baal (the same is Kiriath Qarayathayairayam (Jearim)), and Rabah (Rabbah); shanayam (two) iyar (cities) with their chatzar (villages).
In the madabar (wilderness), Bayathahairabah (Beth) Arabah, Madayan (Middin), Sakakah (Secacah),
Nabashan (Nibshan), the iyarahamalach (city) of Salt, and Iyanagaday (En) Gedi; shash (six) iyar (cities) with their chatzar (villages).

As for the Yabawasay (Jebusites), the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah) couldn't yarash (drive) them out; but the Yabawasay (Jebusites) live with the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah) at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to this yawam (day).

The gawaral (lot) yatzaa (go out / come out) out for the ban (son) of Yawasap (Joseph) from the Yaradan (Jordan) at Yarayachaw (Jericho), at the mayam (Waters) of Yarayachaw (Jericho) on the mazarach (east), even the madabar (wilderness), ilah (go up / offer) up from Yarayachaw (Jericho) through the har (mountain) country to Bayathaal (Bethel).
It yatzaa (go out / come out) out from Bayathaal (Bethel) to Lawaz (Luz), and ibar (pass over/through) along to the gabawal (border/boundary) of the arakay (archites) to Itarawath (Ataroth);

And it yarad (went) down westward to the gabawal (border/boundary) of the Japhletites, to the gabawal (border/boundary) of Bayathachawarawan (Beth) Horon the thachathawan (lower), even to Gazar (Gezer); and ended at the yam (sea/waters).
The ban (son) of Yawasap (Joseph), Manashah (Manasseh) and Aparayam (Ephraim), took their nachal (inheritance).

This was the gabawal (border/boundary) of the ban (son) of Aparayam (Ephraim) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family). The gabawal (border/boundary) of their nachalah (inheritance) eastward was Itarawathaadar (Ataroth) Addar, to Bayathachawarawan (Beth) Horon the ilayawan (upper).

The gabawal (border/boundary) yatzaa (go out / come out) out westward at Makamathath (Michmethath) on the tzapawan (north). The gabawal (border/boundary) sabab (turned) about eastward to Thaanathashalah (Taanath) Shiloh, and ibar (pass over/through) along it on the mazarach (east) of Yanawach (Janoah).
It yarad (went) down from Yanawach (Janoah) to Itarawath (Ataroth), to Nairah (Naarah), pagai (reached) to Yarayachaw (Jericho), and yatzaa (go out / come out) out at the Yaradan (Jordan).

From Thapawach (Tappuah) the gabawal (border/boundary) went along westward to the nachal (stream / river) of Qanah (Kanah); and ended at the yam (sea/waters). This is the nachalah (inheritance) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Aparayam (Ephraim) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family);

Together with the iyar (cities) which were set apart for the ban (son) of Aparayam (Ephraim) in the thawak (midst) of the nachalah (inheritance) of the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh), all the iyar (cities) with their chatzar (villages).

They didn't yarash (drive) out the Kanainay (Canaanites) who lived in Gazar (Gezer); but the Kanainay (Canaanites) yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the qarab (among / near) of Aparayam (Ephraim) to this yawam (day), and have become ibad (servant) to do forced mas (labor).

This was the gawaral (lot) for the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Manashah (Manasseh), for he was the bakawar (firstborn) of Yawasap (Joseph). As for Makayar (Machir) the bakawar (firstborn) of Manashah (Manasseh), the ab (father) of Galaid (Gilead), because he was a ayash (husband/individual man) of malachamah (war), therefore he had Galaid (Gilead) and Bashan (Bashan).

So this was for the yathar (rest) of the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family): for the ban (son) of Abayaizar (Abiezer), for the ban (son) of Chalaq (Helek), for the ban (son) of Asharayaal (Asriel), for the ban (son) of Shakam (Shechem), for the ban (son) of Chapar (Hepher), and for the ban (son) of Shamayadai (Shemida): these were the zakar (remembrance/memory) ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh) the ban (son) of Yawasap (Joseph) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family).

But Tzalapachad (Zelophehad), the ban (son) of Chapar (Hepher), the ban (son) of Galaid (Gilead), the ban (son) of Makayar (Machir), the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh), had no ban (son), but bath (daughter): and these are the sham (name) of his bath (daughter): Machalah (Mahlah), Naih (Noah), Chagalah (Hoglah), Malakah (Milcah), and Tharatzah (Tirzah).

They qarab (come close) near panayam (before) Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), and panayam (before) Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun), and panayam (before) the nashayaa (princes), amar (spoke), "Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses) to nathan (give) us an nachalah (inheritance) thawak (midst) our ach (brother/kinsman)." Therefore pah (according) to the commandment of Yahawah he nathan (give) them an nachalah (inheritance) thawak (midst) the ach (brother/kinsman) of their ab (father).
Ishar (ten) parts napal (fall / be cast down) to Manashah (Manasseh), besides the aratz (Earth/land) of Galaid (Gilead) and Bashan (Bashan), which is ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan);

Because the bath (daughter) of Manashah (Manasseh) nachal (had) an nachalah (inheritance) thawak (midst) his ban (son). The aratz (Earth/land) of Galaid (Gilead) belonged to the yathar (rest) of the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh).

The gabawal (border/boundary) of Manashah (Manasseh) was from Ashar (Asher) to Makamathath (Michmethath), which is panayam (before) Shakam (Shechem). The gabawal (border/boundary) halak (move) along to the right yamayan (right hand), to the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Iyanathapawach (En) Tappuah.

The aratz (Earth/land) of Thapawach (Tappuah) belonged to Manashah (Manasseh); but Thapawach (Tappuah) on the gabawal (border/boundary) of Manashah (Manasseh) belonged to the ban (son) of Aparayam (Ephraim).

The gabawal (border/boundary) yarad (went) down to the nachal (stream / river) of Qanah (Kanah), southward of the nachal (stream / river). These iyar (cities) belonged to Aparayam (Ephraim) thawak (midst) the iyar (cities) of Manashah (Manasseh). The gabawal (border/boundary) of Manashah (Manasseh) was on the tzapawan (north) side of the nachal (stream / river), and ended at the yam (sea/waters).

Southward it was Aparayam (Ephraim's), and northward it was Manashah (Manasseh's), and the yam (sea/waters) was his gabawal (border/boundary). They pagai (reached) to Ashar (Asher) on the tzapawan (north), and to Yashashakar (Issachar) on the mazarach (east).

Manashah (Manasseh) had shalawash (three) heights in Yashashakar (Issachar), in Ashar (Asher) Bayathashaan (Beth) Shean and its bath (daughter), and Yabalaim (Ibleam) and its bath (daughter), and the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Dawar (Dor) and its bath (daughter), and the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Iyanadaar (Endor) and its bath (daughter), and the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Thainak (Taanach) and its bath (daughter), and the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Magadawan (Megiddo) and its bath (daughter).

Yet the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh) couldn't yarash (drive) out the inhabitants of those iyar (cities); but the Kanainay (Canaanites) yaal (would) yashab (inhabit/dwell) in that aratz (Earth/land).

It happened, when the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) had grown chazaq (strong), that they nathan (give) the Kanainay (Canaanites) to forced mas (labor), and didn't yarash (utterly) yarash (drive) them out.

The ban (son) of Yawasap (Joseph) dabar (word / matter) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), amar (spoke), Why nathan (give) you given me just achad (one) gawaral (lot) and achad (one) part for an nachalah (inheritance), since I am a rab (great) im (people / nation), because Yahawah has barak (blessed) me so far?

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to them, If you are a rab (great) im (people / nation), ilah (go up / offer) up to the yair (forest), and clear aratz (Earth/land) for yourself there in the land of the Parazay (Perizzites) and of the Rapaa (Rephaim); since the har (mountain) country of Aparayam (Ephraim) is too awatz (narrow) for you.

The ban (son) of Yawasap (Joseph) amar (spoke), The har (mountain) country is not matzaa (enough) for us. All the Kanainay (Canaanites) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the aratz (Earth/land) of the imaq (valley) have rakab (chariots) of barazal (iron), both those who are in Bayathashaan (Beth) Shean and its bath (daughter), and those who are in the imaq (valley) of Yazaraial (Jezreel).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to the bayath (house) of Yawasap (Joseph), even to Aparayam (Ephraim) and to Manashah (Manasseh), amar (spoke), You are a rab (great) im (people / nation), and rab (have) great kach (strength / mighty / power). You shall not have achad (one) gawaral (lot) only;

But the har (mountain) country shall be yours. Although it is a yair (forest), you shall baraa (created) it down, and it's farthest extent shall be yours; for you shall yarash (drive) out the Kanainay (Canaanites), though they have rakab (chariots) of barazal (iron), and though they are chazaq (strong).

The whole idah (congregation) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) qahal (assembled) themselves together at Shayalah (Shiloh), and shakan (set) up the ahal (tent) of Meeting there. The aratz (Earth/land) was kabash (subdued) panayam (before) them.
Shabai (seven) shabat (tribes) yathar (remained) among the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), which chalaq (had) not yet divided their nachalah (inheritance).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), How long will you neglect to bawaa (come) in to yarash (possess) the aratz (Earth/land), which Yahawah, the Alahayam of your ab (father), nathan (give) given you?

Appoint for yourselves shalawash (three) ayash (husband/individual man) from each shabat (tribe). I will shalach (send) them, and they shall qawam (rise up), halak (move) through the aratz (Earth/land), and kathab (describe) it pah (according) to their nachalah (inheritance); and they shall bawaa (come) to me.

They shall chalaq (divide) it into shabai (seven) chalaq (portions). Yahawadah (Judah) shall live in his gabawal (border/boundary) on the nagab (south), and the bayath (house) of Yawasap (Joseph) shall live in their gabawal (border/boundary) on the tzapawan (north).

You shall survey the aratz (Earth/land) into shabai (seven) chalaq (parts), and bawaa (come) the description here to me; and I will yarah (cast) gawaral (lots) for you here panayam (before) Yahawah our Alahayam.

For the Lawayay (Levites) have no chalaq (portion) qarab (among / near) you; for the kahanah (priesthood) of Yahawah is their nachalah (inheritance). Gad (Gad), Raawaban (Reuben), and the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh) have laqach (take / seized) their nachalah (inheritance) ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) eastward, which Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah nathan (give) them.

The ayash (husband/individual man) qawam (rise up) and yalak (went). Yahawashawai (Joshua) tzawah (commanded) those who halak (move) to survey the aratz (Earth/land), amar (spoke), yalak (go) halak (move) through the aratz (Earth/land), survey it, and shawab (turn back / repent) again to me. I will shalak (cast) gawaral (lots) for you here panayam (before) Yahawah in Shayalah (Shiloh).

The ayash (husband/individual man) yalak (went) and ibar (pass over/through) through the aratz (Earth/land), and surveyed it by iyar (cities) into shabai (seven) chalaq (portions) in a sapar (book / scribed document). They bawaa (come) to Yahawashawai (Joshua) to the machanah (camp) at Shayalah (Shiloh).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) shalak (cast) gawaral (lots) for them in Shayalah (Shiloh) panayam (before) Yahawah. There Yahawashawai (Joshua) chalaq (divided) the aratz (Earth/land) to the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) according to their machalaqath (divisions).

The gawaral (lot) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Banayamayan (Benjamin) ilah (go up / offer) up according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family). The gabawal (border/boundary) of their gawaral (lot) yatzaa (go out / come out) out between the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah) and the ban (son) of Yawasap (Joseph).

Their gabawal (border/boundary) on the tzapawan (north) paah (quarter) was from the Yaradan (Jordan). The gabawal (border/boundary) ilah (go up / offer) up to the kathap (side) of Yarayachaw (Jericho) on the tzapawan (north), and ilah (go up / offer) up through the har (mountain) country westward. It ended at the madabar (wilderness) of Bayathaawan (Beth) Aven.

The gabawal (border/boundary) ibar (pass over/through) along from there to Lawaz (Luz), to the kathap (side) of Lawaz (Luz) (the same is Bayathaal (Bethel)), southward. The gabawal (border/boundary) yarad (went) down to Itarawathaadar (Ataroth) Addar, by the har (mountain) that lies on the nagab (south) of Bayathachawarawan (Beth) Horon the thachathawan (lower).

The gabawal (border/boundary) extended, and sabab (turned) around on the yam (sea/waters) paah (quarter) southward, from the har (mountain) that lies panayam (before) Bayathachawarawan (Beth) Horon southward; and ended Qarayathabail (at) Kiriath Baal (the same is Kiriath Qarayathayairayam (Jearim)), a iyar (city) of the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah). This was the yam (sea/waters) paah (quarter).

The nagab (south) paah (quarter) was from the farthest part of Kiriath Qarayathayairayam (Jearim). The gabawal (border/boundary) yatzaa (go out / come out) out westward, and yatzaa (go out / come out) out to the maiyan (spring) of the mayam (Waters) of Napathawach (Nephtoah).

The gabawal (border/boundary) yarad (went) down to the farthest part of the har (mountain) that lies panayam (before) the gayaa (valley) of the ban (son) of Hanam (Hinnom), which is in the imaq (valley) of Rapaa (Rephaim) northward. It yarad (went) down to the gayaa (valley) of Hanam (Hinnom), to the kathap (side) of the Yabawasay (Jebusite) southward, and yarad (went) down to Iyanaragal (En) Rogel.

It extended northward, yatzaa (go out / come out) out Iyanashamash (at) En Shemesh, and yatzaa (go out / come out) out to Galayalawath (Geliloth), which is over nakach (against) the mailah (ascent) of Adamayam (Adummim). It yarad (went) down to the aban (stone) of Bahan (Bohan) the ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben).
It ibar (pass over/through) along to the kathap (side) over mawal (against) the irabah (arabah) northward, and yarad (went) down to the irabah (arabah).

The gabawal (border/boundary) ibar (pass over/through) along to the kathap (side) of Bayathachagalah (Beth) Hoglah northward; and the gabawal (border/boundary) ended at the tzapawan (north) lashawan (tongue/language) of the malach (salt) yam (sea/waters), at the nagab (south) qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the Yaradan (Jordan). This was the nagab (south) gabawal (border/boundary).

The Yaradan (Jordan) was its gabal (border) on the qadam (east) paah (quarter). This was the nachalah (inheritance) of the ban (son) of Banayamayan (Benjamin), by the gabawalah (borders) around it, according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family).

Now the iyar (cities) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Banayamayan (Benjamin) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) were Yarayachaw (Jericho), Bayathachagalah (Beth) Hoglah, Emek Qatzayatz (Keziz),
Bayathahairabah (Beth) Arabah, Tzamarayam (Zemaraim), Bayathaal (Bethel),
Iwayam (Avvim), Parah (Parah), Iparah (Ophrah),
Kaparahaimawanay (Chephar) Ammoni, Ipanay (Ophni), and Gabai (Geba); shanayam (two) iyar (cities) with their chatzar (villages).
Gabaiwan (Gibeon), Ramah (Ramah), Baarawath (Beeroth),
Matzapah (Mizpeh), Kapayarah (Chephirah), Matzah (Mozah),
Raqam (Rekem), Yarapaal (Irpeel), Tharaalah (Taralah),

Tzalai (Zelah), Alap (Eleph), the Yabawasay (Jebusite) (the same is Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)), Gabaith (Gibeath), and Qarayathayairayam (Kiriath); fourteen iyar (cities) with their chatzar (villages). This is the nachalah (inheritance) of the ban (son) of Banayamayan (Benjamin) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family).

The shanay (second) gawaral (lot) yatzaa (go out / come out) out for Shamaiwan (Simeon), even for the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Shamaiwan (Simeon) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family). Their nachalah (inheritance) was in the thawak (midst) of the nachalah (inheritance) of the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah).
They had for their nachalah (inheritance) Baarashabai (Beersheba) (or shabai (sheba)), Mawaladah (Moladah),
Chatzarashawail (Hazar) Shual, Balah (Balah), Itzam (Ezem),
Alathawalad (Eltolad), Bathawal (Bethul), Charamah (Hormah),
Tzaqalag (Ziklag), Bayathahamarakabawath (Beth) Marcaboth, Chatzarasawasah (Hazar) Susah,
Bayathalabaawath (Beth) Lebaoth, and Sharawachan (Sharuhen); thirteen iyar (cities) with their chatzar (villages);
Iyan (Ain), Ramawan (Rimmon), Ithar (Ether), and Ishan (Ashan); arabai (four) iyar (cities) with their chatzar (villages);

And all the chatzar (villages) that were around these iyar (cities) to Bailathabaar (Baalath) Beer, Ramah (Ramah) of the nagab (south). This is the nachalah (inheritance) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Shamaiwan (Simeon) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family).

Out of the part of the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah) was the nachalah (inheritance) of the ban (son) of Shamaiwan (Simeon); for the chalaq (portion) of the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah) was rab (too) much for them. Therefore the ban (son) of Shamaiwan (Simeon) had nachal (inheritance) in the thawak (midst) of their nachal (inheritance).

The shalayashay (third) gawaral (lot) ilah (go up / offer) up for the ban (son) of Zabawalawan (Zebulun) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family). The gabawal (border/boundary) of their nachalah (inheritance) was to Sharayad (Sarid).

Their gabawal (border/boundary) ilah (go up / offer) up westward, even to Marailah (Maralah), and pagai (reached) to Dabashath (Dabbesheth). It pagai (reached) to the nachal (stream / river) that is panayam (before) Yaqanaim (Jokneam).

It shawab (turn back / repent) from Sharayad (Sarid) eastward toward the sunrise to the gabawal (border/boundary) of Kasalathathabar (Chisloth) Tabor. It yatzaa (go out / come out) out to dabarath (daberath), and ilah (go up / offer) up to Yapayai (Japhia).

From there it ibar (pass over/through) along eastward to Gathahachapar (Gath) Hepher, Ithaqatzayan (to) Ethkazin; and it yatzaa (go out / come out) out at Ramawan (Rimmon) which stretches to Naih (Neah).
The gabawal (border/boundary) sabab (turned) around it on the tzapawan (north) to Chanathan (Hannathon); and it ended at the gayaa (valley) of Iphtah Yapathachaal (El);
Qatath (Kattath), Nahalal (Nahalal), Shamarawan (Shimron), Yadaalah (Idalah), and Bayathalacham (Bethlehem): shanayam (two) iyar (cities) with their chatzar (villages).
This is the nachalah (inheritance) of the ban (son) of Zabawalawan (Zebulun) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family), these iyar (cities) with their chatzar (villages).
The rabayaiy (fourth) gawaral (lot) yatzaa (go out / come out) out for Yashashakar (Issachar), even for the ban (son) of Yashashakar (Issachar) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family).
Their gabawal (border/boundary) was to Yazaraial (Jezreel), Kasalawath (Chesulloth), Shawanam (Shunem),
Chaparayam (Hapharaim), Shayaawan (Shion), Anacharath (Anaharath),
Rabayath (Rabbith), Qashayawan (Kishion), Abatz (Ebez),
Ramath (Remeth), Iyanaganayam (Engannim), Iyanachadah (En) Haddah, and Bayathapatzatz (Beth) Pazzez.

The gabawal (border/boundary) pagai (reached) to Thabawar (Tabor), Shachatzawam (Shahazumah), and Bayathashamash (Beth) Shemesh. Their gabawal (border/boundary) ended at the Yaradan (Jordan): sixteen iyar (cities) with their chatzar (villages).

This is the nachalah (inheritance) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Yashashakar (Issachar) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family), the iyar (cities) with their chatzar (villages).
The chamayashay (fifth) gawaral (lot) yatzaa (go out / come out) out for the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Ashar (Asher) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family).
Their gabawal (border/boundary) was Chalaqath (Helkath), Chalay (Hali), Batan (Beten), Akashap (Achshaph),
Alamalak (Allammelech), Imaid (Amad), Mashaal (Mishal). It pagai (reached) to Karamal (Carmel) westward, and to Shayachawaralabanath (Shihorlibnath).

It shawab (turn back / repent) toward the sunrise to Bayathadagawan (Beth) Dagon, and pagai (reached) to Zabawalawan (Zebulun), and to the gayaa (valley) Yapathachaal (of) Iphtah El northward to Bayathahaimaq (Beth) Emek and Naiyaal (Neiel). It yatzaa (go out / come out) out to Kabawal (Cabul) on the left shamaawal (left hand),
And Ibaran (Ebron), Rachab (Rehob), Chamawan (Hammon), and Qanah (Kanah), even to rab (great) Tzayadawan (Sidon).

The gabawal (border/boundary) shawab (turn back / repent) to Ramah (Ramah), to the fortified iyar (city) of Tzar (Tyre); and the gabawal (border/boundary) shawab (turn back / repent) to Chasah (Hosah). It ended at the yam (sea/waters) by the chabal (region) of Akazayab (Achzib);
Imah (Ummah) also, and Apaq (Aphek), and Rachab (Rehob): twenty-two iyar (cities) with their chatzar (villages).

This is the nachalah (inheritance) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Ashar (Asher) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family), these iyar (cities) with their chatzar (villages).

The shashay (sixth) gawaral (lot) yatzaa (go out / come out) out for the ban (son) of Napathalay (Naphtali), even for the ban (son) of Napathalay (Naphtali) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family).
Their gabawal (border/boundary) was from Chalap (Heleph), from the oak Tzainanayam (in) Zaanannim, Adamay (Adaminekeb), and Yabanaal (Jabneel), Laqawam (to) Lakkum. It ended at the Yaradan (Jordan).

The gabawal (border/boundary) shawab (turn back / repent) westward to Azanawathathabawar (Aznoth) Tabor, and yatzaa (go out / come out) out from there to chaqaq (hukkok). It pagai (reached) to Zabawalawan (Zebulun) on the nagab (south), and pagai (reached) to Ashar (Asher) on the yam (sea/waters), and to Yahawadah (Judah) at the Yaradan (Jordan) toward the sunrise.
The fortified iyar (cities) were Tzadayam (Ziddim), Tzar (Zer), Chamath (Hammath), Raqath (Rakkath), Kanarawath (Chinnereth),
Adamah (Adamah), Ramah (Ramah), Chatzawar (Hazor),
Qadash (Kedesh), Adaraiy (Edrei), Iyanachatzawar (En) Hazor,
Yaraawan (Iron), Magadalaal (Migdal) El, Charam (Horem), Bayathainath (Beth) Anath, and Bayathashamash (Beth) Shemesh; nineteen iyar (cities) with their chatzar (villages).

This is the nachalah (inheritance) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Napathalay (Naphtali) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family), the iyar (cities) with their chatzar (villages).
The shabayaiy (seventh) gawaral (lot) yatzaa (go out / come out) out for the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) Dan (of) Dan according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family).
The gabawal (border/boundary) of their nachalah (inheritance) was Tzaraih (Zorah), Ashathaal (Eshtaol), Iyarashamash (Irshemesh),
Shailabayam (Shaalabbin), Ayalawan (Aijalon), Yathalah (Ithlah),
Ayalawan (Elon), Thamanah (Timnah), Iqarawan (Ekron),
Alathaqaa (Eltekeh), Gabathawan (Gibbethon), Bailath (Baalath),
Yahad (Jehud), Banayabaraq (Bene) Berak, Gatharamawan (Gath) Rimmon,
Me Mayahayaraqawan (Jarkon), and Raqawan (Rakkon), with the gabawal (border/boundary) over mawal (against) Yapaw (Joppa).

The gabawal (border/boundary) of the ban (son) Dan (of) Dan yatzaa (go out / come out) out beyond them; for the ban (son) Dan (of) Dan ilah (go up / offer) up and lacham (fought) against Lasham (Leshem), and lakad (took) it, and nakah (struck) it with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword), and yarash (possessed) it, and lived therein, and qaraa (called) Lasham (Leshem), Dan (Dan), after the sham (name) Dan (of) Dan their ab (father).

This is the nachalah (inheritance) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) Dan (of) Dan according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family), these iyar (cities) with their chatzar (villages).

So they kalah (complete / finish) an end of distributing the aratz (Earth/land) for nachal (inheritance) by its gabawalah (borders). The ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) nathan (give) an nachalah (inheritance) to Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun) in their thawak (midst).

Pah (according) to the commandment of Yahawah, they nathan (give) him the iyar (city) which he shaal (asked), even Thamanathacharas (Timnathserah) in the har (mountain) country of Aparayam (Ephraim); and he banah (built) the iyar (city), and lived there.

These are the nachalah (inheritances), which Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun), and the raash (head) of the ab (father)' houses of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), distributed for nachal (inheritance) by gawaral (lot) in Shayalah (Shiloh) panayam (before) Yahawah, at the pathach (door) of the ahal (tent) of Meeting. So they kalah (complete / finish) an end of chalaq (dividing) the aratz (Earth/land).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), amar (spoke),
Dabar (word / matter) to the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), amar (spoke), ‘Assign the iyar (cities) of maqalat (refuge), of which I dabar (word / matter) to you by Mashah (Moses),

That the manslayer who nakah (kills) any napash (living being/soul) accidentally or unintentionally may nawas (flee) there. They shall be to you for a maqalat (refuge) from the gaal (avenger) of dam (blood).

He shall nawas (flee) to achad (one) of those iyar (cities), and shall imad (stand) at the pathach (entrance) of the shair (gate) of the iyar (city), and dabar (word / matter) his dabar (word / matter) in the azan (ears) of the zaqan (elders) of that iyar (city). They shall asap (take) him into the iyar (city) with them, and nathan (give) him a maqawam (place), that he may live among them.

If the gaal (avenger) of dam (blood) radap (pursue) achar (other) him, then they shall not sagar (deliver) up the manslayer into his yad (hand); because he nakah (struck) his neighbor unintentionally, and didn't shanaa (hate) him thamawal (before).

He shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) in that iyar (city) until he imad (stands) panayam (before) the idah (congregation) for mashapat (judgment), until the mawath (death) of the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest) that shall be in those yawam (day). Then the manslayer shall shawab (turn back / repent), and bawaa (come) to his own iyar (city), and to his own bayath (house), to the iyar (city) he nawas (fled) from.’

They set apart Qadash (Kedesh) in Galayal (Galilee) in the har (mountain) country of Napathalay (Naphtali), Shakam (Shechem) in the har (mountain) country of Aparayam (Ephraim), and Kiriath Qarayathaarabai (Arba) (the same is Chabarawan (Hebron)) in the har (mountain) country of Yahawadah (Judah).

Ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) at Yarayachaw (Jericho) eastward, they nathan (give) Batzar (Bezer) in the madabar (wilderness) in the mayashawar (plain) out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Raawaban (Reuben), Raamawath (Ramoth) in Galaid (Gilead) out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Gad (Gad), and Gawalan (Golan) in Bashan (Bashan) out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Manashah (Manasseh).

These were the mawaidah (appointed) iyar (cities) for all the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), and for the gar (sojourner / stranger / foreigner) who lives thawak (midst) them, that whoever nakah (kills) any napash (living being/soul) unintentionally might nawas (flee) there, and not mawath (death) by the yad (hand) of the gaal (avenger) of dam (blood), until he imad (stands) panayam (before) the idah (congregation).

Then the raash (head) of ab (father)' houses of the Lawayay (Levites) nagash (came) near to Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), and to Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun), and to the raash (head) of ab (father)' houses of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel).

They dabar (word / matter) to them at Shayalah (Shiloh) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan), amar (spoke), Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses) to nathan (give) us iyar (cities) to yashab (inhabit/dwell) in, with their magarash (suburbs) for our livestock.

The ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) nathan (give) to the Lawayay (Levites) out of their nachalah (inheritance), pah (according) to the commandment of Yahawah, these iyar (cities) with their magarash (suburbs).

The gawaral (lot) yatzaa (go out / come out) out for the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Qahathay (Kohathites). The ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron) the kahan (priest), who were of the Lawayay (Levites), had thirteen iyar (cities) by gawaral (lot) out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Yahawadah (Judah), out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the Shamainay (Simeonites), and out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Banayamayan (Benjamin).

The yathar (rest) of the ban (son) of Qahath (Kohath) had ishar (ten) iyar (cities) by gawaral (lot) out of the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Aparayam (Ephraim), out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) Dan (of) Dan, and out of the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh).

The ban (son) of Garashawan (Gershon) had thirteen iyar (cities) by gawaral (lot) out of the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Yashashakar (Issachar), out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Ashar (Asher), out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Napathalay (Naphtali), and out of the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh) in Bashan (Bashan).

The ban (son) of Mararay (Merari) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) had shanayam (two) iyar (cities) out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Raawaban (Reuben), out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Gad (Gad), and out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Zabawalawan (Zebulun).
The ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) nathan (give) these iyar (cities) with their magarash (suburbs) by gawaral (lot) to the Lawayay (Levites), as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) by Mashah (Moses).

They nathan (give) out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah), and out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the ban (son) of Shamaiwan (Simeon), these iyar (cities) which are qaraa (called) by sham (name):

And they were for the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron), of the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Qahathay (Kohathites), who were of the ban (son) of Laway (Levi); for theirs was the raashawan (first) gawaral (lot).

They nathan (give) them Kiriath qarayathaarabai (arba), named after the ab (father) of Inaq (Anak) (the same is Chabarawan (Hebron)), in the har (mountain) country of Yahawadah (Judah), with its magarash (suburbs) around it.
But they nathan (give) the shadah (fields) of the iyar (city) and its chatzar (villages) to Kalab (Caleb) the ban (son) of Yapanah (Jephunneh) for his achazah (possession).

To the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron) the kahan (priest) they nathan (give) Chabarawan (Hebron) with its magarash (suburbs), the iyar (city) of maqalat (refuge) for the manslayer, Labanah (Libnah) with its magarash (suburbs),
Yathayar (Jattir) with its magarash (suburbs), Ashathamai (Eshtemoa) with its magarash (suburbs),
Chalawan (Holon) with its magarash (suburbs), Dabayar (Debir) with its magarash (suburbs),

Iyan (Ain) with its magarash (suburbs), Yatah (Juttah) with its magarash (suburbs), and Bayathashamash (Beth) Shemesh with its magarash (suburbs); thashai (nine) iyar (cities) out of those shanayam (two) shabat (tribes).
Out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Banayamayan (Benjamin), Gabaiwan (Gibeon) with its magarash (suburbs), Gabai (Geba) with its magarash (suburbs),
Inathawath (Anathoth) with its magarash (suburbs), and Ilamawan (Almon) with its magarash (suburbs); arabai (four) iyar (cities).
All the iyar (cities) of the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron), the kahan (priest), were thirteen iyar (cities) with their magarash (suburbs).

The mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the ban (son) of Qahath (Kohath), the Lawayay (Levites), even the yathar (rest) of the ban (son) of Qahath (Kohath), had the iyar (cities) of their gawaral (lot) out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Aparayam (Ephraim).

They nathan (give) them Shakam (Shechem) with its magarash (suburbs) in the har (mountain) country of Aparayam (Ephraim), the iyar (city) of maqalat (refuge) for the manslayer, and Gazar (Gezer) with its magarash (suburbs),
Qabatzayam (Kibzaim) with its magarash (suburbs), and Bayathachawarawan (Beth) Horon with its magarash (suburbs); arabai (four) iyar (cities).
Out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) Dan (of) Dan, Alathaqaa (Elteke) with its magarash (suburbs), Gabathawan (Gibbethon) with its magarash (suburbs),
Ayalawan (Aijalon) with its magarash (suburbs), Gatharamawan (Gath) Rimmon with its magarash (suburbs); arabai (four) iyar (cities).
Out of the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh), Thainak (Taanach) with its magarash (suburbs), and Gatharamawan (Gath) Rimmon with its magarash (suburbs); shanayam (two) iyar (cities).
All the iyar (cities) of the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the yathar (rest) of the ban (son) of Qahath (Kohath) were ishar (ten) with their magarash (suburbs).

They gave to the ban (son) of Garashawan (Gershon), of the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Lawayay (Levites), out of the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh) Gawalan (Golan) in Bashan (Bashan) with its magarash (suburbs), the iyar (city) of maqalat (refuge) for the manslayer, and Be Baishatharah (Eshterah) with its magarash (suburbs); shanayam (two) iyar (cities).
Out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Yashashakar (Issachar), Qashayawan (Kishion) with its magarash (suburbs), dabarath (daberath) with its magarash (suburbs),
Yaramawath (Jarmuth) with its magarash (suburbs), Iyanaganayam (En) Gannim with its magarash (suburbs); arabai (four) iyar (cities).
Out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Ashar (Asher), Mashaal (Mishal) with its magarash (suburbs), Ibadawan (Abdon) with its magarash (suburbs),
Chalaqath (Helkath) with its magarash (suburbs), and Rachab (Rehob) with its magarash (suburbs); arabai (four) iyar (cities).

Out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Napathalay (Naphtali), Qadash (Kedesh) in Galayal (Galilee) with its magarash (suburbs), the iyar (city) of maqalat (refuge) for the manslayer, Chamathadaar (Hammothdor) with its magarash (suburbs), and Qarathan (Kartan) with its magarash (suburbs); shalawash (three) iyar (cities).
All the iyar (cities) of the garashanay (gershonites) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) were thirteen iyar (cities) with their magarash (suburbs).

To the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the ban (son) of Mararay (Merari), the yathar (rest) of the Lawayay (Levites), out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Zabawalawan (Zebulun), Yaqanaim (Jokneam) with its magarash (suburbs), Qarathah (Kartah) with its magarash (suburbs),
Damanah (Dimnah) with its magarash (suburbs), and Nahalal (Nahalal) with its magarash (suburbs); arabai (four) iyar (cities).
Out of the tribe of Raawaban (Reuben), Batzar (Bezer) with its suburbs, Yahatz (Jahaz) with its suburbs,
Qadamawath (Kedemoth) with its suburbs, and Mawapaith (Mephaath) with its suburbs; arabai (four) iyar (cities).

Out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Gad (Gad), Ramathagalaid (Ramoth) in Galaid (Gilead) with its magarash (suburbs), the iyar (city) of maqalat (refuge) for the manslayer, and Machanayam (Mahanaim) with its magarash (suburbs),
Chashabawan (Heshbon) with its magarash (suburbs), Yaizayar (Jazer) with its magarash (suburbs); arabai (four) iyar (cities) in all.

All these were the iyar (cities) of the ban (son) of Mararay (Merari) according to their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family), even the yathar (rest) of the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Lawayay (Levites). Their gawaral (lot) was shanayam (two) iyar (cities).

All the iyar (cities) of the Lawayay (Levites) in the midst of the achazah (possession) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) were arabaiyam (forty) - shamanah (eight) iyar (cities) with their magarash (suburbs).
Each of these iyar (cities) included their magarash (suburbs) around them. It was this way with all these iyar (cities).
So Yahawah nathan (give) to Yasharaal (Israel) all the aratz (Earth/land) which he shabai (swear / take oath) to nathan (give) to their ab (father). They yarash (possessed) it, and lived in it.

Yahawah gave them nawach (rest) all around, according to all that he shabai (swear / take oath) to their ab (father). Not a ayash (husband/individual man) of all their ayab (enemy) imad (stood) panayam (before) them. Yahawah nathan (give) all their ayab (enemy) into their yad (hand).
Nothing napal (fall / be cast down) of any tawab (pleasant/functional) thing which Yahawah had dabar (word / matter) to the bayath (house) of Yasharaal (Israel). All bawaa (come) to pass.
Then Yahawashawai (Joshua) qaraa (called) the Raawabanay (Reubenites), the Gaday (Gadites), and the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh),

And amar (spoke) to them, You have shamar (keep/guard) all that Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah tzawah (commanded) you, and have shamai (hearken / hear) to my qawal (sound / voice) in all that I tzawah (commanded) you.
You have not izab (left) your ach (brother/kinsman) these many yawam (day) to this yawam (day), but have performed the duty of the matzawah (commandment) of Yahawah your Alahayam.

Now Yahawah your Alahayam has given nawach (rest) to your ach (brother/kinsman), as he dabar (word / matter) to them. Therefore now panah (return) and yalak (go) to your ahal (tents), to the aratz (Earth/land) of your achazah (possession), which Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah nathan (give) you ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan).

Only take diligent shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) the matzawah (commandment) and the thawarah (instruction) which Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah tzawah (commanded) you, to ahab (love) Yahawah your Alahayam, to yalak (walk) in all his darak (ways), to shamar (keep/guard) his matzawah (commandments), to hold dabaq (fast) to him, and to ibad (servant) him with all your labab (heart) and with all your napash (living being/soul).
So Yahawashawai (Joshua) barak (blessed) them, and shalach (send) them away; and they yalak (went) to their ahal (tents).

Now to the chatzay (one) half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh) Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) given inheritance in Bashan (Bashan); but to the other chatzay (half) nathan (give) Yahawashawai (Joshua) im (among) their ach (brother/kinsman) ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) westward. Moreover when Yahawashawai (Joshua) shalach (send) them away to their ahal (tents), he barak (blessed) them,

And amar (spoke) to them, amar (spoke), shawab (turn back / repent) with much nakas (wealth) to your ahal (tents), with very much livestock, with kasap (silver), with zahab (gold), with nachashath (brass), with barazal (iron), and with very much clothing. Chalaq (divide) the shalal (spoil) of your ayab (enemy) with your ach (brother/kinsman).

The ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben) and the ban (son) of Gad (Gad) and the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh) shawab (turn back / repent), and departed from the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) out of Shayalah (Shiloh), which is in the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan), to yalak (go) to the aratz (Earth/land) of Galaid (Gilead), to the aratz (Earth/land) of their achazah (possession), which they owned, pah (according) to the commandment of Yahawah by Mashah (Moses).

When they bawaa (come) to the region about the Yaradan (Jordan), that is in the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan), the ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben) and the ban (son) of Gad (Gad) and the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh) banah (built) there an mazabach (altar) by the Yaradan (Jordan), a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) mazabach (altar) to maraah (look) at.

The ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) shamai (hearken / hear) this, Behold, the ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben) and the ban (son) of Gad (Gad) and the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh) have banah (built) an mazabach (altar) in the mawal (forefront) of the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan), in the region about the Yaradan (Jordan), on the ibar (side) that pertains to the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel).

When the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) shamai (hearken / hear) of it, the whole idah (congregation) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) qahal (gathered) themselves together at Shayalah (Shiloh), to ilah (go up / offer) up against them to tzabaa (troop).

The ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) shalach (send) to the ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben), and to the ban (son) of Gad (Gad), and to the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh), into the aratz (Earth/land) of Galaid (Gilead), Payanachas (Phinehas) the ban (son) of Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest),

And with him ishar (ten) nashayaa (princes), one nashayaa (prince) of a ab (father)' bayath (house) for achad (one) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Yasharaal (Israel); and they were everyone of them raash (head) of their ab (father)' bayath (house) among the alap (thousands) of Yasharaal (Israel).

They bawaa (come) to the ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben), and to the ban (son) of Gad (Gad), and to the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh), to the aratz (Earth/land) of Galaid (Gilead), and they dabar (word / matter) with them, amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) the whole idah (congregation) of Yahawah, ‘What mail (top/above) is this that you have mail (top/above) against the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), to shawab (turn back / repent) away this yawam (day) from achar (other) Yahawah, in that you have banah (built) yourselves an mazabach (altar), to marad (rebel) this yawam (day) against Yahawah?

Is the iwan (guilt/iniquity) of Paiwar (Peor) too mait (little) for us, from which we have not tahar (cleansed) ourselves to this yawam (day), although there came a nagap (plague) on the idah (congregation) of Yahawah,

That you must shawab (turn back / repent) away this yawam (day) from achar (other) Yahawah? It will be, since you marad (rebel) today against Yahawah, that machar (tomorrow) he will be qatzap (angry) with the whole idah (congregation) of Yasharaal (Israel).

However, if the aratz (Earth/land) of your achazah (possession) is tamaa (unclean), then ibar (pass over/through) over to the aratz (Earth/land) of the achazah (possession) of Yahawah, in which yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) mashakan (tabernacle) shakan (dwells), and take achaz (possession) thawak (midst) us; but don't marad (rebel) against Yahawah, al (nor) marad (rebel) against us, in banah (building) an mazabach (altar) other than the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah our Alahayam.

Didn't Ikan (Achan) the ban (son) of Zarach (Zerah) mail (top/above) a mail (top/above) in the charam (devoted) thing, and qatzap (wrath) hayah (came to pass) on all the idah (congregation) of Yasharaal (Israel)? That ayash (husband/individual man) didn't gawai (perish) achad (one) in his iwan (guilt/iniquity).’

Then the ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben) and the ban (son) of Gad (Gad) and the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh) inah (answer / respond), and dabar (word / matter) to the raash (head) of the alap (thousands) of Yasharaal (Israel),

The Mighty One, Al, Yahawah, the Mighty One, Al, Yahawah, he yadai (knows); and Yasharaal (Israel) shall yadai (know): if it was in marad (rebellion), or if in mail (top/above) against Yahawah (don't yashai (salvation) us this yawam (day)),

That we have banah (built) us an mazabach (altar) to shawab (turn back / repent) achar (other) from following Yahawah; or if to ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilah (offering) or meal ilah (offering), or if to ishah (make) sacrifices of shalam (peace) zabach (offerings), let Yahawah himself baqash (require) it.

If we have not out of concern ishah (make) this, and for a reason, amar (spoke), ‘In machar (time) to come your ban (son) might amar (spoke) to our ban (son), amar (spoke), "What have you to do with Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel)?

For Yahawah nathan (give) made the Yaradan (Jordan) a gabawal (border/boundary) between us and you, you ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben) and ban (son) of Gad (Gad). You have no chalaq (portion) in Yahawah."’ So your ban (son) might shabath (shabath/rest) our ban (son) shabath (shabath/rest) from yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah.
Therefore we amar (spoke), ‘Let's now ishah (make) to banah (build) ourselves an mazabach (altar), not for burnt ilah (offering), nor for zabach (sacrifice);

But it will be a id (witness) between us and you, and between our dawar (generation / age / period) achar (other) us, that we may perform the ibadah (service) of Yahawah panayam (before) him with our burnt ilah (offerings), with our zabach (sacrifices), and with our shalam (peace) offerings;’ that your ban (son) may not amar (spoke) our ban (son) in machar (time) to come, ‘You have no chalaq (portion) in Yahawah.’

Therefore we amar (spoke), ‘It shall be, when they amar (spoke) us or our dawar (generation / age / period) this in machar (time) to come, that we shall amar (spoke), "raah (see) the thabanayath (pattern) of the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah, which our ab (father) ishah (make), not for burnt ilah (offering), nor for zabach (sacrifice); but it is a id (witness) between us and you."’

Chalayalah (far) be it from us that we should marad (rebel) against Yahawah, and shawab (turn back / repent) away this yawam (day) from achar (other) Yahawah, to banah (build) an mazabach (altar) for burnt ilah (offering), for meal manachah (offering), or for zabach (sacrifice), besides the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah our Alahayam that is panayam (before) his mashakan (tabernacle)!

When Payanachas (Phinehas) the kahan (priest), and the nashayaa (princes) of the idah (congregation), even the raash (head) of the alap (thousands) of Yasharaal (Israel) that were with him, shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) that the ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben) and the ban (son) of Gad (Gad) and the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh) dabar (word / matter), it yatab (pleased) them well.

Payanachas (Phinehas) the ban (son) of Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest) amar (spoke) to the ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben), to the ban (son) of Gad (Gad), and to the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh), Today we yadai (know) that Yahawah is in the thawak (midst) of us, because you have not mail (top/above) this mail (top/above) against Yahawah. Az (now) you have natzal (delivered) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) out of the yad (hand) of Yahawah.

Payanachas (Phinehas) the ban (son) of Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), and the nashayaa (princes), shawab (turn back / repent) from the ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben), and from the ban (son) of Gad (Gad), out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Galaid (Gilead), to the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan), to the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), and shawab (turn back / repent) them dabar (word / matter) again.

The thing yatab (pleased) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel); and the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) barak (blessed) Alahayam, and amar (spoke) no more of ilah (go up / offer) up against them to tzabaa (troop), to shachath (destroy) the aratz (Earth/land) in which the ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben) and the children of Gad (Gad) lived.
The ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben) and the ban (son) of Gad (Gad) qaraa (called) the mazabach (altar) A id (witness) Between Us that Yahawah is Alahayam.

It happened achar (other) many yawam (day), when Yahawah had given nawach (rest) to Yasharaal (Israel) from their ayab (enemy) all around, and Yahawashawai (Joshua) was zaqan (old) and well advanced in yawam (day),

That Yahawashawai (Joshua) qaraa (called) for all Yasharaal (Israel), for their zaqan (elders) and for their raash (head), and for their shapat (judges) and for their shatar (officers), and amar (spoke) to them, I am zaqan (old) and well advanced in yawam (day).
You raah (see) seen all that Yahawah your Alahayam ishah (make) done to all these gaway (nation / people) panayam (because) of you; for it is Yahawah your Alahayam who has lacham (fought) for you.

Raah (see), I napal (fall / be cast down) allotted to you these gaway (nation / people) that shaar (remain), to be an nachalah (inheritance) for your shabat (tribes), from the Yaradan (Jordan), with all the gaway (nation / people) that I have karath (cut) off, even to the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) yam (sea/waters) toward the mabawaa (going) down of the sun.

Yahawah your Alahayam will hadap (thrust) them out from panayam (before) you, and yarash (drive) them from out of your panayam (sight). You shall yarash (possess) their aratz (Earth/land), as Yahawah your Alahayam dabar (word / matter) to you.

Therefore be very courageous to shamar (keep/guard) and to ishah (make) all that is kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction) of Mashah (Moses), that you not sawar (turn) aside from it to the right yamayan (right hand) or to the shamaawal (left hand);

That you not bawaa (come) among these gaway (nation / people), these that shaar (remain) among you; neither zakar (remembrance/memory) mention of the sham (name) of their Alahayam, nor cause to shabai (swear / take oath) by them, neither ibad (servant) them, nor shachah (bow) down yourselves to them;
But hold fast to Yahawah your Alahayam, as you ishah (make) done to this yawam (day).

For Yahawah has driven gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and itzawam (strong) gaway (nation / people) out from panayam (before) you. But as for you, no ayash (husband/individual man) has imad (stood) panayam (before) you to this yawam (day).
Achad (one) ayash (husband/individual man) of you shall radap (chase) a alap (thousand); for it is Yahawah your Alahayam who lacham (fights) for you, as he dabar (word / matter) to you.
Take maad (good) shamar (keep/guard) therefore to yourselves, that you ahab (love) Yahawah your Alahayam.

But if you shawab (turn back / repent) at all shawab (turn back / repent) back, and hold fast to the yathar (remnant) of these gaway (nation / people), even these who shaar (remain) among you, and chathan (make) marriages with them, and bawaa (come) in to them, and they to you;
