He ishah (make) shanayam (two) capitals of yatzaq (molten) nachashath (brass), to nathan (give) on the raash (head) of the imawad (pillar): the qawamah (height) of the achad (one) capital was chamash (five) amah (cubits), and the qawamah (height) of the other capital was chamash (five) amah (cubits).

There were shabak (nets) of shabakah (checker) maishah (work), and gadal (wreaths) of sharasharah (chain) maishah (work), for the capitals which were on the raash (head) of the imawad (pillar); shabai (seven) for the achad (one) capital, and shabai (seven) for the other capital.

So he ishah (make) the imawad (pillar); and there were shanayam (two) tawar (rows) around on the achad (one) shabakah (network), to kasah (cover) the capitals that were on the raash (head) of the pillars: and he ishah (make) so for the other capital.
The capitals that were on the raash (head) of the imawad (pillar) in the awalam (porch) were of shawashan (lily) maishah (work), arabai (four) amah (cubits).

There were capitals mail (top/above) also on the shanayam (two) imawad (pillar), close by the batan (belly) which was beside the shabakah (network): and the ramawan (pomegranates) were two maah (hundred), in tawar (rows) around on the other capital.

He qawam (rise up) up the imawad (pillar) at the awalam (porch) of the hayakal (temple): and he qawam (rise up) up the yamanay (right) imawad (pillar), and qaraa (called) its sham (name) Yakayan (Jachin); and he qawam (rise up) up the shamaalay (left) imawad (pillar), and qaraa (called) its sham (name) Baiz (Boaz).
On the raash (head) of the imawad (pillar) was shawashan (lily) maishah (work): so was the maishah (work) of the imawad (pillar) finished.

He ishah (make) the molten yam (sea/waters) of ishar (ten) amah (cubits) from shapah (brim) to shapah (brim), igal (round) in sabayab (surrounding), and its qawamah (height) was chamash (five) amah (cubits); and a qawah (gather/wait) of shalawashayam (thirty) amah (cubits) encircled it.

Under its shapah (brim) around there were buds which encircled it, for ishar (ten) amah (cubits), encircling the yam (sea/waters): the buds were in shanayam (two) tawar (rows), yatzaqah (cast) when it yatzaqah (was) cast.

It imad (stood) on shanayam (two) oxen, shalawash (three) panah (looking) toward the tzapawan (north), and shalawash (three) panah (looking) toward the yam (sea/waters), and shalawash (three) panah (looking) toward the nagab (south), and shalawash (three) panah (looking) toward the mazarach (east); and the yam (sea/waters) was set on them mail (top/above), and all their hinder achawar (parts) were inward.

It was a tapach (handbreadth) ibay (thick): and its shapah (brim) was maishah (worked) like the shapah (brim) of a kawas (cup), like the parach (flower) of a shawashan (lily): it kawal (all/every/entire) two alap (thousand) bath (daughter).

He ishah (make) the ishar (ten) makawanah (bases) of nachashath (brass); arabai (four) amah (cubits) was the arak (length) of achad (one) makawanah (base), and arabai (four) amah (cubits) its rachab (breadth), and shalawash (three) amah (cubits) its qawamah (height).
The maishah (work) of the makawanah (bases) was like this: they had panels; and there were panels between the shalab (ledges);

And on the panels that were between the shalab (ledges) were aray (lions), oxen, and karawab (cherubim); and on the shalab (ledges) there was a pedestal mail (top/above); and beneath the aray (lions) and oxen were wreaths of hanging maishah (work).

Achad (one) makawanah (base) had arabai (four) bronze awapan (wheels), and axles of nachashath (brass); and the arabai (four) paim (feet) of it had supports: beneath the basin were the supports molten, with wreaths at the ibar (side) of ayash (husband/individual man).

The pah (mouth) of it bayath (house) the capital and mail (top/above) was a amah (cubit): and its pah (mouth) was igal (round) after the maishah (work) of a pedestal, a amah (cubit) and a chatzay (half); and also on its pah (mouth) were engravings, and their panels were rabai (fourth), not igal (round).

The arabai (four) awapan (wheels) were underneath the panels; and the axles of the awapan (wheels) were in the makawanah (base): and the qawamah (height) of a awapan (wheel) was a amah (cubit) and chatzay (half) a amah (cubit).

The maishah (work) of the awapan (wheels) was like the maishah (work) of a marakabah (chariot) awapan (wheel): their axles, and their rims, and their chashar (spokes), and their gab (naves), were all yatzaq (molten).
There were arabai (four) supports at the arabai (four) panah (corners) of achad (one) makawanah (base): its supports were of the makawanah (base) itself.

In the raash (head) of the makawanah (base) was there a igal (round) sabayab (surrounding) chatzay (half) a amah (cubit) qawamah (high); and on the raash (head) of the makawanah (base) its yad (hand) and its panels were of the same.

On the lawach (plates) of its yad (hand), and on its panels, he pathach (engraved) karawab (cherubim), aray (lions), and thamar (palm) trees, according to the space of ayash (husband/individual man), with wreaths all around.
In this way, he ishah (make) the ishar (ten) makawanah (bases): all of them had achad (one) mawatzaq (casting), achad (one) madah (measure), and achad (one) form.

He ishah (make) ishar (ten) basins of nachashath (brass): achad (one) basin kawal (all/every/entire) arabaiyam (forty) bath (daughter); and achad (one) basin was arabai (four) amah (cubits); and on achad (one) achad (one) of the ishar (ten) makawanah (bases) achad (one) basin.

He nathan (give) the makawanah (bases), chamash (five) on the yamayan (right hand) kathap (side) of the bayath (house), and chamash (five) on the shamaawal (left hand) kathap (side) of the bayath (house): and he nathan (give) the yam (sea/waters) on the yamanay (right) kathap (side) of the bayath (house) eastward, mawal (toward) the nagab (south).

Chayaram (Hiram) ishah (make) the basins, and the yai (shovels), and the basins. So Chayaram (Hiram) kalah (complete / finish) an end of ishah (make) all the malaakah (work) that he ishah (make) for malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah:

The shanayam (two) imawad (pillar), and the two galah (spring / basin / bowl) of the capitals that were on the raash (head) of the imawad (pillar); and the shanayam (two) shabakah (networks) to kasah (cover) the shanayam (two) galah (spring / basin / bowl) of the capitals that were on the raash (head) of the imawad (pillar);

And the arabai (four) maah (hundred) ramawan (pomegranates) for the shanayam (two) shabakah (networks); shanayam (two) tawar (rows) of ramawan (pomegranates) for achad (one) shabakah (network), to kasah (cover) the shanayam (two) galah (spring / basin / bowl) of the capitals that were on the imawad (pillar);
And the ishar (ten) makawanah (bases), and the ishar (ten) basins on the makawanah (bases);
And the achad (one) yam (sea/waters), and the shanayam (two) oxen under the yam (sea/waters);

And the sayar (pots), and the yai (shovels), and the basins: even all these kalay (vessels), which Chayaram (Hiram) ishah (make) for malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon), in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, were of burnished nachashath (brass).
The malak (king) yatzaq (cast) them in the kakar (plain) of the Yaradan (Jordan), in the maibah (clay) adamah (ground) between Sakawath (Succoth) and Tzarathan (Zarethan).
Shalamah (Solomon) yanach (left) all the kalay (vessels) unweighed, because they were maad (exceeding) many: the mashaqal (weight) of the nachashath (brass) could not be chaqar (found) out.

Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) all the kalay (vessels) that were in the bayath (house) of Yahawah: the zahab (gold) mazabach (altar), and the shalachan (table) whereupon the show lacham (bread) was, of zahab (gold);

And the lampstands, chamash (five) on the yamayan (right hand) side, and chamash (five) on the shamaawal (left hand), panayam (before) the dabayar (oracle), of sagar (pure) zahab (gold); and the parach (flowers), and the nayar (lamps), and the malaqach (tongs), of zahab (gold);

And the sap (cups), and the mazamarah (snuffers), and the basins, and the kap (spoons), and the machathah (fire) pans, of sagar (pure) zahab (gold); and the path (hinges), both for the dalath (doors) of the inner bayath (house), the most qadash (set apart/make holy) place, and for the dalath (doors) of the bayath (house), of the hayakal (temple), of zahab (gold).

Thus all the malaakah (work) that malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah was shalam (finished). Shalamah (Solomon) bawaa (come) in the things which Dawad (David) his ab (father) had qadash (set apart/make holy), the kasap (silver), and the zahab (gold), and the kalay (vessels), and nathan (give) them in the awatzar (treasuries) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

Then Shalamah (Solomon) qahal (assembled) the zaqan (elders) of Yasharaal (Israel), and all the raash (head) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe), the nashayaa (princes) of the ab (father)' households of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), to malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), to ilah (go up / offer) up the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah out of the iyar (city) of Dawad (David), which is Tzayawan (Zion).

All the ayash (husband/individual man) of Yasharaal (Israel) qahal (assembled) themselves to malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) at the chag (feast/festival), in the yarach (month) ayathanayam (ethanim), which is the shabayaiy (seventh) yarach (month).
All the zaqan (elders) of Yasharaal (Israel) bawaa (come), and the kahan (priest) nashaa (lift) up the arawan (ark).

They ilah (go up / offer) up the arawan (ark) of Yahawah, and the ahal (tent) of Meeting, and all the qadash (set apart/make holy) kalay (vessels) that were in the ahal (tent); even these the kahan (priest) and the Lawayay (Levites) ilah (go up / offer) up.

Malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) and all the idah (congregation) of Yasharaal (Israel), who were yaid (assembled) to him, were with him panayam (before) the arawan (ark), zabach (sacrificing) tzaan (sheep) and cattle, that could not be sapar (book) nor manah (numbered) for rab (multitude).

The kahan (priest) bawaa (come) in the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah to its maqawam (place), into the dabayar (oracle) of the bayath (house), to the most qadash (set apart/make holy) place, even under the kanap (wings) of the karawab (cherubim).

For the karawab (cherubim) parash (spread) forth their kanap (wings) over the maqawam (place) of the arawan (ark), and the karawab (cherubim) sakak (covered) the arawan (ark) and its poles mail (top/above).

The poles were so arak (long) that the raash (head) of the poles were raah (see) from the qadash (set apart/make holy) place panayam (before) the dabayar (oracle); but they were not raah (see) outside: and there they are to this yawam (day).

There was nothing in the arawan (ark) raq (except) the shanayam (two) lawach (tables) of aban (stone) which Mashah (Moses) yanach (put) there at Charab (Horeb), when Yahawah karath (cut) a covenant with the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), when they yatzaa (go out / come out) out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt).
It came to pass, when the kahan (priest) yatzaa (go out / come out) come out of the qadash (set apart/make holy) place, that the inan (cloud) malaa (filled) the bayath (house) of Yahawah,

So that the kahan (priest) yakal (could) not imad (stand) to sharath (minister) by panayam (reason) of the inan (cloud); for the kabawad (glory) of Yahawah malaa (filled) the bayath (house) of Yahawah.
Then Shalamah (Solomon) amar (spoke), Yahawah has amar (spoke) that he would shakan (dwell) in the irapal (thick) darkness.
I have banah (surely) banah (built) you a bayath (house) of zabawal (habitation), a makawan (place) for you to zabawal (dwell) in iwalam (forever).
The malak (king) sabab (turned) his panayam (face) sabab (about), and barak (blessed) all the qahal (assembly) of Yasharaal (Israel): and all the qahal (assembly) of Yasharaal (Israel) imad (stood).

He amar (spoke), barak (blessed) is Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), who dabar (word / matter) with his pah (mouth) to Dawad (David) your ab (father), and has with his yad (hand) malaa (fulfilled) it, amar (spoke),

‘Since the yawam (day) that I brought my im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel) out of Matzarayam (Egypt), I bachar (chose) no iyar (city) out of all the shabat (tribes) of Yasharaal (Israel) to banah (build) a bayath (house), that my sham (name) might be there; but I bachar (chose) Dawad (David) to be over my im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel).’
Now it was in the labab (heart) of Dawad (David) my ab (father) to banah (build) a bayath (house) for the sham (name) of Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel).

But Yahawah amar (spoke) to Dawad (David) my ab (father), ‘Whereas it was in your labab (heart) to banah (build) a bayath (house) for my sham (name), you tawab (pleasant/functional) well that it was in your labab (heart).

Raq (nevertheless), you shall not banah (build) the bayath (house); but your ban (son) who shall yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of your body, he shall banah (build) the bayath (house) for my sham (name).’

Yahawah has qawam (rise up) his dabar (word / matter) that he dabar (word / matter); for I have qawam (rise up) up in the place of Dawad (David) my ab (father), and I yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the kasaa (throne) of Yasharaal (Israel), as Yahawah dabar (word / matter), and have banah (built) the bayath (house) for the sham (name) of Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel).

There I have shawam (place / establish / appoint) a maqawam (place) for the arawan (ark), in which is the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah, which he karath (cut) with our ab (father), when he yatzaa (go out / come out) them out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt).

Shalamah (Solomon) imad (stood) panayam (before) the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah in the nagad (presence) of all the qahal (assembly) of Yasharaal (Israel), and parash (spread) forth his kap (hands) toward shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens));

And he amar (spoke), Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), there is no Alahayam like you, in shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) mail (top/above), or on aratz (Earth/land) beneath; who shamar (keep/guard) barayath (covenant) and loving chasad (grace) with your ibad (servant), who halak (move) panayam (before) you with all their lab (heart);

Who have shamar (keep/guard) with your ibad (servant) Dawad (David) my ab (father) that which you dabar (word / matter) him. Yes, you dabar (word / matter) with your pah (mouth), and malaa (have) fulfilled it with your yad (hand), as it is this yawam (day).

Now therefore, may Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), shamar (keep/guard) with your ibad (servant) Dawad (David) my ab (father) that which you have dabar (word / matter) him, amar (spoke), ‘There shall not karath (cut) you a ayash (husband/individual man) in my panayam (sight) to yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the kasaa (throne) of Yasharaal (Israel), if only your ban (son) shamar (keep/guard) heed to their darak (way), to yalak (walk) panayam (before) me as you have halak (move) panayam (before) me.’

Now therefore, Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), please let your dabar (word / matter) be aman (believe / have faith), which you dabar (word / matter) to your ibad (servant) Dawad (David) my ab (father).

But will Alahayam in very amanam (deed) yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the aratz (Earth/land)? Behold, shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) and the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) of shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) can't kawal (all/every/entire) you; ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) much less this bayath (house) that I have banah (built)!

Yet have panah (respect) for the thapalah (prayer) of your ibad (servant), and for his thachanah (supplication), Yahawah my Alahayam, to shamai (hearken / hear) to the ranah (cry) and to the thapalah (prayer) which your ibad (servant) palal (prays) panayam (before) you this yawam (day);

That your iyan (eye) may be pathach (open) toward this bayath (house) layal (night) and yawam (day), even toward the maqawam (place) of which you have amar (spoke), ‘My sham (name) shall be there;’ to shamai (hearken / hear) to the thapalah (prayer) which your ibad (servant) shall palal (pray) toward this maqawam (place).

Shamai (hearken / hear) to the thachanah (supplication) of your ibad (servant), and of your im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel), when they shall palal (pray) toward this maqawam (place). Yes, shamai (hearken / hear) in shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), your yashab (inhabit/dwell) maqawam (place); and when you shamai (hearken / hear), salach (forgive/pardon/make clean).

If a ayash (husband/individual man) chataa (sins) against his neighbor, and an alah (these) is laid on him to cause him to alah (these), and he bawaa (come) and alah (these) panayam (before) your mazabach (altar) in this bayath (house);

Then shamai (hearken / hear) in shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), and ishah (make), and shapat (judge) your ibad (servant), rashai (condemning) the rashai (wicked), to nathan (give) his darak (way) on his own raash (head), and justifying the tzadayaq (righteous), to nathan (give) him according to his tzadaqah (righteousness).

When your im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel) are nagap (struck) down panayam (before) the ayab (enemy), because they have chataa (sinned) against you; if they shawab (turn back / repent) again to you, and yadah (confess) your sham (name), and palal (pray) and chanan (make) supplication to you in this bayath (house):

Then shamai (hearken / hear) in shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), and salach (forgive/pardon/make clean) the chataah (sin) of your im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel), and shawab (turn back / repent) them again to the adamah (land) which you nathan (give) to their ab (father).

When the sky is itzar (shut) up, and there is no matar (rain), because they have chataa (sinned) against you; if they palal (pray) toward this maqawam (place), and yadah (confess) your sham (name), and shawab (turn back / repent) from their chataah (sin), when you inah (oppress / afflict) them:

Then shamai (hearken / hear) in shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), and salach (forgive/pardon/make clean) the chataah (sin) of your ibad (servant), and of your im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel), when you yarah (teach) them the tawab (pleasant/functional) darak (way) in which they should yalak (walk); and nathan (give) matar (rain) on your aratz (Earth/land), which you nathan (give) given to your im (people / nation) for an nachalah (inheritance).

If there is raib (famine) in the aratz (Earth/land), if there is dabar (word / matter), if there is blight, mildew, arabah (locust) or chasayal (caterpillar); if their ayab (enemy) besieges them in the aratz (Earth/land) of their shair (cities); whatever nagai (plague), whatever machalah (sickness) there is;

Whatever thapalah (prayer) and thachanah (supplication) is made by any adam (man), or by all your im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel), who shall ayash (husband/individual man) yadai (know) the nagai (plague) of his own labab (heart), and parash (spread) forth his kap (hands) toward this bayath (house):

Then shamai (hearken / hear) in shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), your yashab (inhabit/dwell) makawan (place), and salach (forgive/pardon/make clean), and ishah (make), and nathan (give) to every ayash (husband/individual man) according to all his darak (ways), whose labab (heart) you yadai (know); (for you, even you only, yadai (know) the labab (hearts) of all the ban (son) of adam (men);)
That they may yaraa (fear / be afraid) you all the yawam (day) that they chay (life) in the adamah (land) which you nathan (give) to our ab (father).

Moreover concerning the nakaray (foreigner), who is not of your im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel), when he shall bawaa (come) out of a rachawaq (far) aratz (Earth/land) for your sham (name) sake

(For they shall shamai (hearken / hear) of your gadawal (very great/important/mighty) sham (name), and of your chazaq (mighty) yad (hand), and of your natah (outstretched) zarawai (arm)); when he shall bawaa (come) and palal (pray) toward this bayath (house);

Shamai (hearken / hear) in shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), your yashab (inhabit/dwell) makawan (place), and ishah (make) according to all that the nakaray (foreigner) qaraa (called) to you for; that all the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land) may yadai (know) your sham (name), to yaraa (fear / be afraid) you, as do your im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel), and that they may yadai (know) that this bayath (house) which I have banah (built) is qaraa (called) by your sham (name).

If your im (people / nation) yatzaa (go out / come out) out to malachamah (battle) against their ayab (enemy), by whatever way you shall shalach (send) them, and they palal (pray) to Yahawah darak (toward) the iyar (city) which you have bachar (chosen), and toward the bayath (house) which I have banah (built) for your sham (name);
Then shamai (hearken / hear) in shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) their thapalah (prayer) and their thachanah (supplication), and ishah (make) their cause.

If they chataa (sin) against you (for there is no adam (man) who doesn't chataa (sin)), and you are anap (angry) with them, and nathan (give) them to the ayab (enemy), so that they shabah (carry) them away shabah (captive) to the aratz (Earth/land) of the ayab (enemy), rachawaq (far) off or qarawab (near);

Yet if they shall shawab (turn back / repent) in the aratz (Earth/land) where they are shabah (carried) captive, and shawab (turn back / repent) again, and chanan (make) supplication to you in the aratz (Earth/land) of those who shabah (carried) them captive, amar (spoke), ‘We have chataa (sinned), and have iwah (done) perversely; we have dealt wickedly;’

If they shawab (turn back / repent) to you with all their labab (heart) and with all their napash (living being/soul) in the aratz (Earth/land) of their ayab (enemy), who shabah (carried) them captive, and palal (pray) to you darak (toward) their aratz (Earth/land), which you nathan (give) to their ab (father), the iyar (city) which you have bachar (chosen), and the bayath (house) which I have banah (built) for your sham (name):
Then shamai (hearken / hear) their thapalah (prayer) and their thachanah (supplication) in shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), your yashab (inhabit/dwell) makawan (place), and ishah (make) their cause;

And salach (forgive/pardon/make clean) your im (people / nation) who have chataa (sinned) against you, and all their pashai (transgressions) in which they have pashai (transgressed) against you; and nathan (give) them racham (compassion) panayam (before) those who shabah (carried) them captive, that they may racham (have) compassion on them

(For they are your im (people / nation), and your nachalah (inheritance), which you yatzaa (go out / come out) out of Matzarayam (Egypt), from the thawak (midst) of the kawar (furnace) of barazal (iron));

That your iyan (eye) may be pathach (open) to the thachanah (supplication) of your ibad (servant), and to the thachanah (supplication) of your im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel), to shamai (hearken / hear) to them whenever they qaraa (called) to you.

For you badal (separated) them from among all the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land), to be your nachalah (inheritance), as you dabar (word / matter) by Mashah (Moses) your ibad (servant), when you yatzaa (go out / come out) our ab (father) out of Matzarayam (Egypt), Adanay Yahawah.

It was so, that when Shalamah (Solomon) kalah (complete / finish) made an end of palal (praying) all this thapalah (prayer) and thachanah (supplication) to Yahawah, he qawam (rise up) from panayam (before) the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah, from karai (kneeling) on his barak (knees) with his kap (hands) parash (spread) forth toward shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)).
He imad (stood), and barak (blessed) all the qahal (assembly) of Yasharaal (Israel) with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qawal (sound / voice), amar (spoke),

Barak (blessed) be Yahawah, who nathan (give) given manawachah (rest) to his im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel), according to all that he dabar (word / matter). There napal (fall / be cast down) not failed achad (one) dabar (word / matter) of all his tawab (pleasant/functional) dabar (word / matter), which he dabar (word / matter) by Mashah (Moses) his ibad (servant).
May Yahawah our Alahayam be with us, as he was with our ab (father). Let him not izab (leave) us, nor natash (forsake) us;

That he may natah (incline) our labab (hearts) to him, to yalak (walk) in all his darak (ways), and to shamar (keep/guard) his matzawah (commandments), and his chaq (statute), and his mashapat (ordinances), which he tzawah (commanded) our ab (father).

Let these my dabar (word / matter), with which I chanan (have) made supplication panayam (before) Yahawah, be qarawab (near) to Yahawah our Alahayam yawamam (by day) and qarawab (night), that he may ishah (make) the cause of his ibad (servant), and the cause of his im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel), as every yawam (day) shall require;
That all the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land) may yadai (know) that Yahawah, he is Alahayam. There is none else.

Let your labab (heart) therefore be shalam (full / whole / complete) with Yahawah our Alahayam, to yalak (walk) in his chaq (statute), and to shamar (keep/guard) his matzawah (commandments), as at this yawam (day).
The malak (king), and all Yasharaal (Israel) with him, zabach (offered) zabach (sacrifice) panayam (before) Yahawah.

Shalamah (Solomon) zabach (offered) for the zabach (sacrifice) of shalam (peace) offerings, which he zabach (offered) to Yahawah, shanayam (two) and isharayam (twenty) alap (thousand) baqar (morning) of cattle, and one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) alap (thousand) tzaan (sheep). So the malak (king) and all the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) chanak (dedicated) the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

The same yawam (day) the malak (king) made the thawak (midst) of the chatzar (court) qadash (set apart/make holy) that panayam (was) before the bayath (house) of Yahawah; for there he ishah (make) the burnt ishah (make), and the meal ishah (make), and the chalab (fat) of the shalam (peace) offerings, because the bronze mazabach (altar) that panayam (was) before Yahawah was too qatan (small/young/least) to kawal (all/every/entire) the burnt ilah (offering), and the meal manachah (offering), and the chalab (fat) of the shalam (peace) offerings.

So Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) the chag (feast/festival) at that ith (time), and all Yasharaal (Israel) with him, a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qahal (assembly), from the entrance of Chamath (Hamath) to the nachal (stream / river) of Matzarayam (Egypt), panayam (before) Yahawah our Alahayam, shabai (seven) yawam (day) and shabai (seven) yawam (day), even fourteen yawam (day).

On the shamayanay (eighth) yawam (day) he shalach (send) the im (people / nation) shalach (send); and they barak (blessed) the malak (king), and yalak (went) to their ahal (tents) shamach (joyful) and tawab (pleasant/functional) of lab (heart) for all the goodness that Yahawah ishah (make) shown to Dawad (David) his ibad (servant), and to Yasharaal (Israel) his im (people / nation).

It happened, when Shalamah (Solomon) kalah (complete / finish) finished the banah (building) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and the malak (king) bayath (house), and all Shalamah (Solomon's) chashaq (desire) which he was chapatz (pleased) to ishah (make),
That Yahawah raah (see) to Shalamah (Solomon) the shanay (second) time, as he had raah (see) to him at Gabaiwan (Gibeon).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to him, I have shamai (hearken / hear) your thapalah (prayer) and your thachanah (supplication), that you chanan (have) made panayam (before) me. I chanan (have) made this bayath (house) qadash (set apart/make holy), which you have banah (built), to shawam (place / establish / appoint) my sham (name) there iwalam (forever); and my iyan (eye) and my lab (heart) shall be there yawam (day).

As for you, if you will yalak (walk) panayam (before) me, as Dawad (David) your ab (father) halak (move), in tham (integrity) of labab (heart), and in yashar (uprightness), to ishah (make) according to all that I have tzawah (commanded) you, and will shamar (keep/guard) my chaq (statute) and my mashapat (ordinances);

Then I will qawam (rise up) the kasaa (throne) of your mamalakah (kingdom) over Yasharaal (Israel) iwalam (forever), according as I dabar (word / matter) to Dawad (David) your ab (father), amar (spoke), ‘There shall not karath (cut) you a ayash (husband/individual man) on the kasaa (throne) of Yasharaal (Israel).’

But if you shawab (turn back / repent) shawab (turn back / repent) from achar (other) me, you or your ban (son), and not shamar (keep/guard) my matzawah (commandments) and my chaqah (statutes) which I nathan (give) set panayam (before) you, but shall halak (move) and ibad (servant) other Alahayam, and shachah (worship) them;

Then will I karath (cut) off Yasharaal (Israel) out of the adamah (land) which I nathan (give) given them; and this bayath (house), which I have made qadash (set apart/make holy) for my sham (name), will I shalach (send) out of my panayam (sight); and Yasharaal (Israel) shall be a mashal (proverb) and a shanayanah (byword) among all im (people / nation).

Though this bayath (house) is so ilayawan (high), yet shall everyone who passes by it be shamam (astonished), and shall sharaq (hiss); and they shall amar (spoke), ‘Why has Yahawah ishah (make) thus to this aratz (Earth/land), and to this bayath (house)?’

And they shall amar (spoke), ‘Because they forsook Yahawah their Alahayam, who yatzaa (go out / come out) their ab (father) out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and laid chazaq (hold) of other Alahayam, and shachah (worshiped) them, and ibad (servant) them. Therefore Yahawah bawaa (come) brought all this rai (evil) on them.’

It happened at the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of isharayam (twenty) shanah (years), in which Shalamah (Solomon) had banah (built) the shanayam (two) bayath (house), the bayath (house) of Yahawah and the malak (king) bayath (house)

(Now Chayaram (Hiram) the malak (king) of Tzar (Tyre) had nashaa (lift) Shalamah (Solomon) with araz (cedar) itz (trees) and barawash (fir) itz (trees), and with zahab (gold), according to all his chapatz (desire)), that then malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) nathan (give) Chayaram (Hiram) isharayam (twenty) iyar (cities) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Galayal (Galilee).
Chayaram (Hiram) yatzaa (go out / come out) out from Tzar (Tyre) to raah (see) the iyar (cities) which Shalamah (Solomon) nathan (give) given him; and they didn't yashar (please) him.
He amar (spoke), "What iyar (cities) are these which you nathan (give) given me, my ach (brother/kinsman)?" He qaraa (called) them the aratz (Earth/land) of Kabawal (Cabul) to this yawam (day).
Chayaram (Hiram) shalach (send) to the malak (king) one maah (hundred) twenty kakar (talents) of zahab (gold).

This is the dabar (word / matter) of the mas (levy) which malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) ilah (go up / offer), to banah (build) the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and his own bayath (house), and Malawaa (Millo), and the chawamah (wall) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and Chatzawar (Hazor), and Magadawan (Megiddo), and Gazar (Gezer).

Paraih (Pharaoh) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt) had ilah (go up / offer) up, and lakad (taken) Gazar (Gezer), and burnt it with ash (fire), and harag (slain) the Kanainay (Canaanites) who lived in the iyar (city), and nathan (give) it for a portion to his bath (daughter), Shalamah (Solomon's) ashah (wife/individual woman).
Shalamah (Solomon) banah (built) Gazar (Gezer), and Bayathachawarawan (Beth) Horon the thachathawan (lower),
And Bailath (Baalath), and Thamar (Tamar) in the madabar (wilderness), in the aratz (Earth/land),

And all the storage iyar (cities) that Shalamah (Solomon) had, and the iyar (cities) for his rakab (chariots), and the iyar (cities) for his horsemen, and that which Shalamah (Solomon) chashaq (desired) to banah (build) for his pleasure in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and in Labanawan (Lebanon), and in all the aratz (Earth/land) of his mamashalah (dominion).

As for all the im (people / nation) who were yathar (left) of the Amaray (Amorites), the Chathay (Hittites), the Parazay (Perizzites), the Chaway (Hivites), and the Yabawasay (Jebusites), who were not of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel);

Their ban (son) who were yathar (left) achar (other) them in the aratz (Earth/land), whom the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) were not yakal (able) utterly to charam (destroy), of them Shalamah (Solomon) ilah (go up / offer) a mas (levy) of bondservants to this yawam (day).

But of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) Shalamah (Solomon) nathan (give) no ibad (servant); but they were the ban (son) of malachamah (war), and his ibad (servant), and his shar (prince / ruler), and his shalayash (captains), and shar (prince / ruler) of his rakab (chariots) and of his horsemen.

These were the shar (prince / ruler) natzab (officers) who were over Shalamah (Solomon's) malaakah (work), chamash (five) maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty), who radah (rule over / have dominion of / subdue) rule over the im (people / nation) who labored in the malaakah (work).

But Paraih (Pharaoh's) bath (daughter) ilah (go up / offer) up out of the iyar (city) of Dawad (David) to her bayath (house) which Solomon had banah (built) for her: then he banah (built) Malawaa (Millo).

Shalamah (Solomon) ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilah (offerings) and shalam (peace) offerings on the mazabach (altar) which he banah (built) to Yahawah shalawash (three) paim (times) a shanah (year), qatar (burning) incense with them, on the mazabach (altar) that panayam (was) before Yahawah. So he shalam (finished) the bayath (house).

Malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) a anay (navy) of ships in Itzayawanagabar (Ezion) Geber, which is beside Ayalawath (Eloth), on the shapah (shore) of the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters), in the aratz (Earth/land) of Adam (Edom).
Chayaram (Hiram) shalach (send) in the anay (navy) his ibad (servant), sailors who had yadai (knowledge) of the yam (sea/waters), with the ibad (servant) of Shalamah (Solomon).

They bawaa (come) to Awapayar (Ophir), and laqach (take / seized) from there zahab (gold), arabai (four) maah (hundred) and isharayam (twenty) kakar (talents), and bawaa (come) it to malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon).

When the malakah (queen) of Shabaa (Sheba) shamai (hearken / hear) of the shamai (fame) of Shalamah (Solomon) concerning the sham (name) of Yahawah, she bawaa (come) to nasah (prove) him with chayadah (hard) questions.

She bawaa (come) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) with a very kabad (great) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), with gamal (camels) that nashaa (lift) basham (spices), and very much zahab (gold), and yaqar (precious) aban (stone); and when she bawaa (come) come to Shalamah (Solomon), she dabar (word / matter) with him of all that was in her labab (heart).
Shalamah (Solomon) nagad (told) her all her dabar (word / matter): there was not anything ilam (hidden) from the malak (king) which he didn't nagad (tell) her.
When the malakah (queen) of Shabaa (Sheba) raah (see) seen all the chakamah (wisdom) of Shalamah (Solomon), and the bayath (house) that he had banah (built),

And the maakal (food) of his shalachan (table), and the mawashab (sitting) of his ibad (servant), and the maimad (attendance) of his sharath (ministers), and their clothing, and his cup bearers, and his ilah (ascent) by which he ilah (go up / offer) up to the bayath (house) of Yahawah; there was no more rawach (spirit / wind) in her.

She amar (spoke) to the malak (king), It was a amath (truth) dabar (word / matter) that I shamai (hearken / hear) in my own aratz (Earth/land) of your dabar (word / matter), and of your chakamah (wisdom).

However I didn't aman (believe / have faith) the dabar (word / matter), until I bawaa (come), and my iyan (eye) raah (see) seen it. Behold, the chatzay (half) was not nagad (told) me! Your chakamah (wisdom) and tawab (pleasant/functional) yasap (exceed) the shamawaih (fame) which I shamai (hearken / hear).

Ashar (who/that) are your ayash (husband/individual man), ashar (who/that) are these your ibad (servant), who imad (stand) continually panayam (before) you, who shamai (hearken / hear) your chakamah (wisdom).

Barak (blessed) is Yahawah your Alahayam, who chapatz (delighted) in you, to nathan (give) you on the kasaa (throne) of Yasharaal (Israel). Because Yahawah ahabah (loved) Yasharaal (Israel) iwalam (forever), therefore shawam (place / establish / appoint) he you malak (king), to ishah (make) mashapat (justice) and tzadaqah (righteousness).

She nathan (give) the malak (king) one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) kakar (talents) of zahab (gold), and of basham (spices) very rabah (great) store, and yaqar (precious) aban (stone). There bawaa (come) no more such rab (abundance) of basham (spices) as these which the malakah (queen) of Shabaa (Sheba) nathan (give) to malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon).

The anay (navy) also of Chayaram (Hiram), that nashaa (lift) zahab (gold) from Awapayar (Ophir), bawaa (come) in from Awapayar (Ophir) maad (great) rabah (plenty) of alamagayam (almug) itz (trees) and yaqar (precious) aban (stone).

The malak (king) ishah (make) of the alamagayam (almug) itz (trees) masaid (pillars) for the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and for the malak (king) bayath (house), kanawar (harps) also and stringed instruments for the singers: there bawaa (come) no such alamagayam (almug) itz (trees), nor were raah (see), to this yawam (day).

Malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) nathan (give) to the malakah (queen) of Shabaa (Sheba) all her chapatz (desire), whatever she shaal (asked), besides that which Shalamah (Solomon) nathan (give) her of his malak (king) yad (hand). So she panah (turned), and yalak (went) to her own aratz (Earth/land), she and her ibad (servant).

Now the mashaqal (weight) of zahab (gold) that bawaa (come) to Shalamah (Solomon) in achad (one) shanah (year) was shash (six) maah (hundred) shashayam (sixty) - shash (six) kakar (talents) of zahab (gold),
Besides that which the traders brought, and the masachar (traffic) of the rakal (merchants), and of all the malak (king) of the mixed people, and of the pachah (governors) of the aratz (Earth/land).

Malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) two maah (hundred) tzanah (bucklers) of shachat (beaten) zahab (gold); shash (six) maah (hundred) shekels of zahab (gold) ilah (go up / offer) to achad (one) tzanah (buckler).

He made shalawash (three) maah (hundred) magan (shield) of shachat (beaten) zahab (gold); shalawash (three) minas of zahab (gold) ilah (go up / offer) to achad (one) magan (shield): and the malak (king) nathan (give) them in the bayath (house) of the yair (forest) of Labanawan (Lebanon).
Moreover the malak (king) ishah (make) a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kasaa (throne) of shan (ivory), and overlaid it with the finest zahab (gold).

There were shash (six) mailah (ascent/climbing up) to the kasaa (throne), and the raash (head) of the kasaa (throne) was igal (round) achar (other); and there were yad (hand) on either side by the maqawam (place) of the shabath (shabath/rest), and shanayam (two) aray (lions) imad (standing) beside the yad (hand).

Shanayam (two) aray (lions) imad (stood) there on the one side and on the other on the shash (six) mailah (ascent/climbing up): there was nothing kan (for sure) it ishah (make) in any mamalakah (kingdom).

All malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon's) mashaqah (drinking) kalay (vessels) were of zahab (gold), and all the kalay (vessels) of the bayath (house) of the yair (forest) of Labanawan (Lebanon) were of sagar (pure) zahab (gold): none were of kasap (silver); it was maawamah (nothing) chashab (accounted) of in the yawam (day) of Shalamah (Solomon).

For the malak (king) had at yam (sea/waters) a anay (navy) of Tharashayash (Tarshish) with the anay (navy) of Chayaram (Hiram): achad (one) every shalawash (three) shanah (years) bawaa (come) the anay (navy) of Tharashayash (Tarshish), nashaa (lift) zahab (gold), and kasap (silver), shanahabayam (ivory), and qawap (apes), and thakay (peacocks).
So malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) gadal (exceeded) all the malak (king) of the aratz (Earth/land) in riches and in chakamah (wisdom).
All the aratz (Earth/land) baqash (sought) the presence of Shalamah (Solomon), to shamai (hearken / hear) his chakamah (wisdom), which Alahayam nathan (give) put in his lab (heart).

They bawaa (come) every ayash (husband/individual man) his tribute, kalay (vessels) of kasap (silver), and kalay (vessels) of zahab (gold), and clothing, and armor, and basham (spices), sawas (horses), and parad (mules), a dabar (word / matter) shanah (year) by shanah (year).

Shalamah (Solomon) asap (gathered) together rakab (chariots) and horsemen: and he had a alap (thousand) and arabai (four) maah (hundred) rakab (chariots), and shanayam (two) alap (thousand) horsemen, that he nachah (bestowed) in the rakab (chariot) iyar (cities), and with the malak (king) at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

The malak (king) nathan (give) kasap (silver) to be in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) as aban (stone), and araz (cedars) nathan (give) he to be as the shaqamah (sycamore) trees that are in the lowland, for rab (abundance).

The sawas (horses) which Shalamah (Solomon) had were mawatzaa (brought) out of Matzarayam (Egypt); and the malak (king) sachar (merchants) laqach (take / seized) them in droves, each drove at a machayar (price).

A marakabah (chariot) ilah (go up / offer) up and yatzaa (go out / come out) out of Matzarayam (Egypt) for shash (six) maah (hundred) shekels of kasap (silver), and a sawas (horse) for one maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty); and so for all the malak (king) of the Chathay (Hittites), and for the malak (king) of Aram (Syria), they yatzaa (go out / come out) them out by their yad (hand).

Now malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) ahab (love) many foreign ashah (wife/individual woman), together with the bath (daughter) of Paraih (Pharaoh), women of the Mawaabay (Moabites), Imawanay (Ammonites), Adamay (Edomites), Tzayadanay (Sidonians), and Chathay (Hittites);

Of the gaway (nation / people) concerning which Yahawah amar (spoke) to the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), "You shall not bawaa (come) among them, neither shall they bawaa (come) among you; for akan (surely) they will natah (turn) away your labab (heart) achar (other) their Alahayam." Shalamah (Solomon) dabaq (joined) to these in ahabah (love).
He had shabai (seven) maah (hundred) wives, princesses, and shalawash (three) maah (hundred) payalagash (concubines); and his wives natah (turned) away his lab (heart).

For it happened, when Shalamah (Solomon) was zaqanah (old), that his wives natah (turned) away his labab (heart) achar (other) other Alahayam; and his labab (heart) was not shalam (full / whole / complete) with Yahawah his Alahayam, as was the labab (heart) of Dawad (David) his ab (father).

For Shalamah (Solomon) yalak (went) achar (other) Ishatharath (Ashtoreth) the goddess of the Tzayadanay (Sidonians), and achar (other) Malakam (Milcom) the shaqawatz (abomination) of the Imawanay (Ammonites).
Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, and didn't malaa (go) fully achar (other) Yahawah, as did Dawad (David) his ab (father).

Then Shalamah (Solomon) banah (built) a bamah (high) place for Kamawash (Chemosh) the shaqawatz (abomination) of Mawaab (Moab), on the har (mountain) that is panayam (before) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and for Malak (Molech) the shaqawatz (abomination) of the ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon).
So he ishah (make) for all his foreign wives, who burnt qatar (incense) and zabach (sacrificed) to their Alahayam.
Yahawah was anap (angry) with Shalamah (Solomon), because his labab (heart) was natah (turned) away from Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), who had raah (see) to him paim (twice),
And had tzawah (commanded) him dabar (word / matter) this thing, that he should not yalak (go) achar (other) other Alahayam: but he didn't shamar (keep/guard) that which Yahawah tzawah (commanded).

Therefore Yahawah amar (spoke) to Shalamah (Solomon), Because this is done by you, and you have not shamar (keep/guard) my barayath (covenant) and my chaqah (statutes), which I have tzawah (commanded) you, I will qarai (surely) qarai (tear) the mamalakah (kingdom) from you, and will nathan (give) it to your ibad (servant).
Notwithstanding I will not ishah (make) it in your yawam (day), for Dawad (David) your ab (father) sake; but I will qarai (tear) it out of the yad (hand) of your ban (son).

However I will not qarai (tear) away all the mamalakah (kingdom); but I will nathan (give) achad (one) shabat (tribe) to your ban (son), for Dawad (David) my ibad (servant) sake, and for Yarawashalam (Jerusalem's) sake which I have bachar (chosen).
Yahawah qawam (rise up) up an shatan (adversary) to Shalamah (Solomon), Hadad (Hadad) the Adamay (Edomite): he was of the malak (king) zarai (seed) in Adam (Edom).

For it happened, when Dawad (David) was in Adam (Edom), and Yawaab (Joab) the shar (prince / ruler) of the tzabaa (troop) was ilah (go up / offer) up to qabar (bury) the chalal (slain), and had struck every zakar (remembrance/memory) in Adam (Edom)
(For Yawaab (Joab) and all Yasharaal (Israel) yashab (inhabit/dwell) there shash (six) chadash (month), until he had karath (cut) off every zakar (remembrance/memory) in Adam (Edom));

That Adad (Hadad) barach (fled), he and ayash (husband/individual man) Adamay (Edomites) of his ab (father) ibad (servant) with him, to bawaa (come) into Matzarayam (Egypt), Hadad (Hadad) being yet a qatan (small/young/least) nair (child).

They qawam (rise up) out of Madayan (Midian), and bawaa (come) to Paaran (Paran); and they laqach (take / seized) ayash (husband/individual man) with them out of Paaran (Paran), and they bawaa (come) to Matzarayam (Egypt), to Paraih (Pharaoh) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt), who nathan (give) him a bayath (house), and amar (spoke) him lacham (food), and nathan (give) him aratz (Earth/land).

Hadad (Hadad) matzaa (found) maad (great) favor in the iyan (eye) of Paraih (Pharaoh), so that he nathan (give) him as ashah (wife/individual woman) the achawath (sister) of his own ashah (wife/individual woman), the achawath (sister) of Thachapanayas (Tahpenes) the gabayarah (queen).

The achawath (sister) of Thachapanayas (Tahpenes) yalad (birth / begot) him Ganabath (Genubath) his ban (son), whom Thachapanayas (Tahpenes) weaned in Paraih (Pharaoh's) bayath (house); and Ganabath (Genubath) was in Paraih (Pharaoh's) bayath (house) thawak (midst) the ban (son) of Paraih (Pharaoh).

When Hadad (Hadad) shamai (hearken / hear) in Matzarayam (Egypt) that Dawad (David) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and that Yawaab (Joab) the shar (prince / ruler) of the tzabaa (troop) was mawath (death), Hadad (Hadad) amar (spoke) to Paraih (Pharaoh), shalach (send) me depart, that I may yalak (go) to my own aratz (Earth/land).

Then Paraih (Pharaoh) amar (spoke) to him, "But what chasar (have) you lacked with me, that behold, you baqash (seek) to yalak (go) to your own aratz (Earth/land)?" He amar (spoke), Nothing, however only shalach (send) me depart.

Alahayam qawam (rise up) up an shatan (adversary) to him, Razawan (Rezon) the ban (son) of Alayadai (Eliada), who had barach (fled) from his Adawan Hadadaizar (Hadadezer) malak (king) of Tzawabaa (Zobah).

He qabatz (gathered) ayash (husband/individual man) to him, and became shar (prince / ruler) over a gadawad (troop), when Dawad (David) harag (killed) them of Zobah: and they yalak (went) to Damashaq (Damascus), and lived therein, and malak (king) in Damashaq (Damascus).

He was an shatan (adversary) to Yasharaal (Israel) all the yawam (day) of Shalamah (Solomon), besides the rai (mischief) of Hadad (Hadad): and he qawatz (abhorred) Yasharaal (Israel), and malak (king) over Aram (Syria).

Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat), an Aparathay (Ephraimite) Tzaradah (of) Zeredah, a ibad (servant) of Shalamah (Solomon), whose am (mother) sham (name) was Tzarawaih (Zeruah), a alamanah (widow), he also rawam (will lift up) up his yad (hand) against the malak (king).

This was the dabar (word / matter) why he rawam (will lift up) up his yad (hand) against the malak (king): Shalamah (Solomon) banah (built) Malawaa (Millo), and sagar (repaired) the breach of the iyar (city) of Dawad (David) his ab (father).

The ayash (husband/individual man) Yarabaim (Jeroboam) was a ayash (husband/individual man) man of valor; and Shalamah (Solomon) raah (see) the nair (young) man that he was ishah (make), and he put him in paqad (visit) of all the sabal (labor) of the bayath (house) of Yawasap (Joseph).

It happened at that ith (time), when Yarabaim (Jeroboam) yatzaa (go out / come out) out of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), that the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) Achayah (Ahijah) the Shayalawanay (Shilonite) matzaa (found) him in the darak (way); now Ahijah had kasah (clad) himself with a chadash (new) shalamah (Shalamah/(Solomon) - Patriarch); and they shanayam (two) were alone in the shadah (field).
Achayah (Ahijah) thapash (laid) hold of the chadash (new) shalamah (Shalamah/(Solomon) - Patriarch) that was on him, and qarai (tore) it in shanayam (two) qarai (pieces).

He amar (spoke) to Yarabaim (Jeroboam), laqach (take / seized) ishar (ten) qarai (pieces); for thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), ‘Behold, I will qarai (tear) the mamalakah (kingdom) out of the yad (hand) of Shalamah (Solomon), and will nathan (give) ishar (ten) shabat (tribes) to you

(But he shall have achad (one) shabat (tribe), for my ibad (servant) Dawad (David's) sake and for Yarawashalam (Jerusalem's) sake, the iyar (city) which I have bachar (chosen) out of all the shabat (tribes) of Yasharaal (Israel));

Because that they have forsaken me, and have shachah (worshiped) Ishatharath (Ashtoreth) the goddess of the Tzayadanay (Sidonians), Kamawash (Chemosh) the Alahayam of Mawaab (Moab), and Malakam (Milcom) the Alahayam of the ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon). They have not halak (move) in my darak (ways), to ishah (make) that which is yashar (right) in my iyan (eye), and to keep my chaqah (statutes) and my mashapat (ordinances), as Dawad (David) his ab (father) did.

‘However I will not laqach (take / seized) the whole mamalakah (kingdom) out of his yad (hand); but I will shayath (put / appoint / make) him nashayaa (prince) all the yawam (day) of his chay (life), for Dawad (David) my ibad (servant) sake whom I bachar (chose), who shamar (keep/guard) my matzawah (commandments) and my chaqah (statutes);
But I will laqach (take / seized) the malawakah (kingdom) out of his ban (son) yad (hand), and will nathan (give) it to you, even ishar (ten) shabat (tribes).

To his ban (son) will I nathan (give) achad (one) shabat (tribe), that Dawad (David) my ibad (servant) may have a nayar (lamp) yawam (day) panayam (before) me in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), the iyar (city) which I have bachar (chosen) me to shawam (place / establish / appoint) my sham (name) there.
I will laqach (take / seized) you, and you shall malak (king) according to all that your napash (living being/soul) awah (desires), and shall be malak (king) over Yasharaal (Israel).

It shall be, if you will shamai (hearken / hear) to all that I tzawah (command) you, and will halak (move) in my darak (ways), and ishah (make) that which is yashar (right) in my iyan (eye), to shamar (keep/guard) my chaqah (statutes) and my matzawah (commandments), as Dawad (David) my ibad (servant) ishah (make); that I will be with you, and will banah (build) you a aman (believe / have faith) bayath (house), as I banah (built) for Dawad (David), and will nathan (give) Yasharaal (Israel) to you.
I will for this inah (oppress / afflict) the zarai (seed) of Dawad (David), but not yawam (day).’

Shalamah (Solomon) baqash (sought) therefore to mawath (death) Yarabaim (Jeroboam); but Yarabaim (Jeroboam) qawam (rise up), and barach (fled) into Matzarayam (Egypt), to Shayashaq (Shishak) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and was in Matzarayam (Egypt) until the mawath (death) of Shalamah (Solomon).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Shalamah (Solomon), and all that he ishah (make), and his chakamah (wisdom), aren't they kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabar (word / matter) of Shalamah (Solomon)?
The yawam (day) that Shalamah (Solomon) malak (king) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) over all Yasharaal (Israel) was arabaiyam (forty) shanah (years).
Shalamah (Solomon) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and was qabar (bury) in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David) his ab (father): and Rachabaim (Rehoboam) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.
Rachabaim (Rehoboam) yalak (went) to Shakam (Shechem): for all Yasharaal (Israel) bawaa (come) come to Shakam (Shechem) to make him malak (king).

It happened, when Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat) shamai (hearken / hear) of it (for he was yet in Matzarayam (Egypt), where he had barach (fled) from the panayam (presence) of malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon), and Yarabaim (Jeroboam) lived in Matzarayam (Egypt),

And they shalach (send) and qaraa (called) him), that Yarabaim (Jeroboam) and all the qahal (assembly) of Yasharaal (Israel) bawaa (come), and dabar (word / matter) to Rachabaim (Rehoboam), amar (spoke),

Your ab (father) qashah (rough / hard) our il (over) qashah (rough / hard): now therefore make you the qashah (rough / hard) ibadah (service) of your ab (father), and his kabad (heavy) il (over) which he nathan (give) on us, lighter, and we will ibad (servant) you.
He amar (spoke) to them, "Depart for shalawash (three) yawam (day), then shawab (turn back / repent) back to me." The im (people / nation) departed.

Malak (king) Rachabaim (Rehoboam) took yaitz (counsel) with the zaqan (old) men, who had imad (stood) panayam (before) Shalamah (Solomon) his ab (father) while he yet chay (life), amar (spoke), What yaitz (counsel) do you give me to shawab (turn back / repent) dabar (word / matter) to this im (people / nation)?

They dabar (word / matter) to him, amar (spoke), If you will be a ibad (servant) to this im (people / nation) this yawam (day), and will ibad (servant) them, and inah (answer / respond) them, and dabar (word / matter) tawab (pleasant/functional) dabar (word / matter) to them, then they will be your ibad (servant) yawam (day).

But he forsook the itzah (counsel) of the zaqan (old) men which they had yaitz (given) him, and took yaitz (counsel) with the yalad (birth / begot) men who had gadal (grown) up with him, who imad (stood) panayam (before) him.

He amar (spoke) to them, What yaitz (counsel) do you give, that we may return dabar (word / matter) to this im (people / nation), who have dabar (word / matter) to me, amar (spoke), ‘qalal (make) the il (over) that your ab (father) nathan (give) on us lighter?’

The yalad (birth / begot) men who had gadal (grown) up with him dabar (word / matter) to him, amar (spoke), Thus you shall amar (spoke) this im (people / nation) who amar (spoke) to you, amar (spoke), ‘Your ab (father) kabad (made) our il (over) kabad (heavy), but qalal (make) it lighter to us;’ you shall dabar (word / matter) to them, ‘My qatan (small/young/least) finger is ibah (thicker) than my ab (father) waist.

Now whereas my ab (father) imas (burdened) you with a kabad (heavy) il (over), I will yasap (add) to your il (over): my ab (father) yasar (chastised) you with shawat (whips), but I will yasar (chastise) you with iqarab (scorpions).’

So Yarabaim (Jeroboam) and all the im (people / nation) bawaa (come) to Rachabaim (Rehoboam) the shalayashay (third) yawam (day), as the malak (king) asked, amar (spoke), shawab (turn back / repent) to me again the shalayashay (third) yawam (day).
The malak (king) inah (answer / respond) the im (people / nation) qashah (rough / hard), and forsook the itzah (counsel) of the zaqan (old) men which they had yaitz (given) him,

And dabar (word / matter) to them according to the itzah (counsel) of the yalad (birth / begot) men, amar (spoke), My ab (father) kabad (made) your il (over) kabad (heavy), but I will yasap (add) to your il (over). My ab (father) yasar (chastised) you with shawat (whips), but I will yasar (chastise) you with iqarab (scorpions).

So the malak (king) didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to the im (people / nation); for it was a thing brought about of Yahawah, that he might qawam (rise up) his dabar (word / matter), which Yahawah dabar (word / matter) by Achayah (Ahijah) the Shayalawanay (Shilonite) to Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat).

When all Yasharaal (Israel) raah (see) that the malak (king) didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to them, the im (people / nation) dabar (word / matter) the malak (king), amar (spoke), "What chalaq (portion) have we in Dawad (David)? Neither do we have an nachalah (inheritance) in the ban (son) of Yashay (Jesse). To your ahal (tents), Yasharaal (Israel)! Now raah (see) to your own bayath (house), Dawad (David)." So Yasharaal (Israel) departed to their ahal (tents).
But as for the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) who lived in the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), Rachabaim (Rehoboam) malak (king) over them.

Then malak (king) Rachabaim (Rehoboam) shalach (send) Adaram (Adoram), who was over the men subject to forced mas (labor); and all Yasharaal (Israel) ragam (stoned) him to mawath (death) with aban (stone). Malak (king) Rachabaim (Rehoboam) amatz (made) speed to ilah (go up / offer) him up to his marakabah (chariot), to nawas (flee) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
So Yasharaal (Israel) pashai (rebelled) against the bayath (house) of Dawad (David) to this yawam (day).

It happened, when all Yasharaal (Israel) shamai (hearken / hear) that Yarabaim (Jeroboam) was shawab (turn back / repent), that they shalach (send) and qaraa (called) him to the idah (congregation), and made him malak (king) over all Yasharaal (Israel): there was none who achar (other) the bayath (house) of Dawad (David), but the shabat (tribe) of Yahawadah (Judah) only.

When Rachabaim (Rehoboam) bawaa (come) come to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), he qahal (assembled) all the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah), and the shabat (tribe) of Banayamayan (Benjamin), a maah (hundred) and shamanayam (eighty) alap (thousand) bachar (chosen) men, who were ishah (make), to lacham (fight) against the bayath (house) of Yasharaal (Israel), to shawab (turn back / repent) the malawakah (kingdom) again to Rachabaim (Rehoboam) the ban (son) of Shalamah (Solomon).
But the dabar (word / matter) of Alahayam came to Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) the ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam, amar (spoke),

"Amar (spoke) to Rachabaim (Rehoboam) the ban (son) of Shalamah (Solomon), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and to all the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Banayamayan (Benjamin), and to the yathar (rest) of the im (people / nation), amar (spoke),

‘Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, "You shall not ilah (go up / offer) up, nor lacham (fight) against your ach (brother/kinsman), the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel). Everyone shawab (turn back / repent) to his bayath (house); for this thing is of me."’" So they shamai (hearken / hear) to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, and shawab (turn back / repent) and went their yalak (way), according to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah.

Then Yarabaim (Jeroboam) banah (built) Shakam (Shechem) in the har (mountain) country of Aparayam (Ephraim), and lived in it; and he yatzaa (go out / come out) out from there, and banah (built) Panawaal (Penuel).
Yarabaim (Jeroboam) amar (spoke) in his lab (heart), Now the mamalakah (kingdom) will shawab (turn back / repent) to the bayath (house) of Dawad (David).

If this im (people / nation) ilah (go up / offer) up to ishah (make) zabach (sacrifices) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), then the lab (heart) of this im (people / nation) will shawab (turn back / repent) again to their Adawan, even to Rachabaim (Rehoboam) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah); and they will harag (kill) me, and shawab (turn back / repent) to Rachabaim (Rehoboam) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah).

Whereupon the malak (king) took yaitz (counsel), and ishah (make) shanayam (two) calves of zahab (gold); and he amar (spoke) to them, It is rab (too) much for you to ilah (go up / offer) up to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). Look and see your Alahayam, Yasharaal (Israel), which ilah (go up / offer) you up out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt)!
He shawam (place / establish / appoint) the achad (one) in Bayathaal (Bethel), and the other nathan (give) he Dan (in) Dan.
This thing became a chataah (sin); for the im (people / nation) yalak (went) to worship panayam (before) the achad (one), Dan (even) to Dan.
He ishah (make) bayath (house) of bamah (high) places, and ishah (make) kahan (priest) from among all the im (people / nation), who were not of the ban (son) of Laway (Levi).

Yarabaim (Jeroboam) ordained a chag (feast/festival) in the shamayanay (eighth) chadash (month), on the fifteenth yawam (day) of the chadash (month), like the chag (feast/festival) that is in Yahawadah (Judah), and he ilah (go up / offer) up to the mazabach (altar); he ishah (make) so in Bayathaal (Bethel), zabach (sacrificing) to the calves that he ishah (make) made: and he imad (placed) in Bayathaal (Bethel) the kahan (priest) of the bamah (high) places that he ishah (make) made.

He ilah (go up / offer) up to the mazabach (altar) which he ishah (make) made in Bayathaal (Bethel) on the fifteenth yawam (day) in the shamayanay (eighth) chadash (month), even in the chadash (month) which he had badaa (devised) of his own heart: and he ordained a chag (feast/festival) for the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), and ilah (go up / offer) up to the mazabach (altar), to qatar (burn) incense.

Behold, there bawaa (come) a ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam out of Yahawadah (Judah) by the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah to Bayathaal (Beth) El: and Yarabaim (Jeroboam) was imad (standing) by the mazabach (altar) to qatar (burn) incense.

He qaraa (called) against the mazabach (altar) by the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, and amar (spoke), mazabach (altar), mazabach (altar), thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: ‘Behold, a ban (son) shall be yalad (birth / begot) to the bayath (house) of Dawad (David), Yaashayah (Josiah) by sham (name). On you he shall zabach (sacrifice) the kahan (priest) of the bamah (high) places who qatar (burn) incense on you, and they will sharap (burn) adam (men's) itzam (bones) on you.’

He nathan (give) a mawapath (sign) the same yawam (day), amar (spoke), This is the mawapath (sign) which Yahawah has dabar (word / matter): Behold, the mazabach (altar) will be split apart, and the ashes that are on it will be shapak (poured) out.

It happened, when the malak (king) shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of the ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam, which he qaraa (called) against the mazabach (altar) in Bayathaal (Bethel), that Yarabaim (Jeroboam) shalach (send) out his yad (hand) from the mazabach (altar), amar (spoke), "Seize him!" His yad (hand), which he shalach (send) out against him, yabash (dry land) up, so that he yakal (could) not shawab (turn back / repent) it back again to himself.

The mazabach (altar) also was split apart, and the ashes shapak (poured) out from the mazabach (altar), according to the mawapath (sign) which the ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam nathan (give) given by the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah.

The malak (king) inah (answer / respond) the ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam, "Now entreat the favor of Yahawah your Alahayam, and chalah (afflict) for me, that my yad (hand) may be shawab (turn back / repent) me again." The ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam entreated Yahawah, and the malak (king) yad (hand) was shawab (turn back / repent) him again, and became as it was raashawan (before).
The malak (king) dabar (word / matter) to the ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam, bawaa (come) bayath (house) with me, and said (refresh) yourself, and I will nathan (give) you a reward.

The ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam amar (spoke) to the malak (king), Even if you nathan (give) me chatzay (half) of your bayath (house), I would not bawaa (come) in with you, neither would I akal (eat) lacham (bread) nor shathah (drinks) mayam (Waters) in this maqawam (place);

For so was it tzawah (commanded) me by the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, amar (spoke), ‘You shall akal (eat) no lacham (bread), nor shathah (drinks) mayam (Waters), neither shawab (turn back / repent) by the darak (way) that you halak (move).’
So he yalak (went) achar (other) darak (way), and didn't shawab (turn back / repent) by the darak (way) that he bawaa (come) to Bayathaal (Bethel).

Now there lived an zaqan (old) nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) in Bayathaal (Bethel); and one of his ban (son) bawaa (come) and sapar (book) him all the maishah (works) that the ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam ishah (make) done that yawam (day) in Bayathaal (Bethel). They also dabar (word / matter) their malak (king) the dabar (word / matter) which he had sapar (book) to the ab (father).

Their ab (father) dabar (word / matter) to them, "Which darak (way) did he halak (move)?" Now his ban (son) raah (see) seen which darak (way) the ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam halak (move), who bawaa (come) from Yahawadah (Judah).
He amar (spoke) to his ban (son), "chabash (saddle) the donkey for me." So they chabash (saddled) the donkey for him; and he rakab (rode) on it.

He yalak (went) achar (other) the ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam, and matzaa (found) him sitting under an alah (these). He amar (spoke) to him, "Are you the ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam who bawaa (come) from Yahawadah (Judah)?" He amar (spoke), I am.
Then he amar (spoke) to him, yalak (come) bayath (house) with me, and akal (eat) lacham (bread).

He amar (spoke), I may not shawab (turn back / repent) with you, nor bawaa (come) in with you; neither will I akal (eat) lacham (bread) nor shathah (drinks) mayam (Waters) with you in this maqawam (place).

For it was dabar (word / matter) to me by the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, ‘You shall akal (eat) no lacham (bread) nor shathah (drinks) mayam (Waters) there, nor shawab (turn back / repent) again to yalak (go) by the darak (way) that you halak (move).’

He amar (spoke) to him, "I also am a nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) as you are; and an malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) dabar (word / matter) to me by the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, amar (spoke), ‘shawab (turn back / repent) him back with you into your bayath (house), that he may akal (eat) lacham (bread) and shathah (drinks) mayam (Waters).’" He lied to him.
So he shawab (turn back / repent) back with him, and akal (eat) lacham (bread) in his bayath (house), and shathah (drinks) mayam (Waters).
It happened, as they yashab (inhabit/dwell) at the shalachan (table), that the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) who shawab (turn back / repent) him back;

And he qaraa (called) to the ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam who bawaa (come) from Yahawadah (Judah), amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, ‘yain (because) you have been marah (disobedient) to the pah (mouth) of Yahawah, and have not shamar (keep/guard) the matzawah (commandment) which Yahawah your Alahayam tzawah (commanded) you,

But shawab (turn back / repent) back, and have akal (eat) lacham (bread) and shathah (drinks) mayam (Waters) in the maqawam (place) of which he dabar (word / matter) to you, "akal (eat) no lacham (bread), and shathah (drinks) no mayam (Waters);" your nabalah (body) shall not bawaa (come) to the tomb of your ab (father).’

It happened, achar (other) he had akal (eat) lacham (bread), and achar (other) he had shathah (drinks), that he chabash (saddled) the donkey for the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) whom he had shawab (turn back / repent) back.

When he had yalak (gone), a aray (lion) matzaa (met) him by the darak (way), and mawath (death) him. His nabalah (body) was shalak (cast) in the darak (way), and the donkey imad (stood) by it. The aray (lion) also imad (stood) by the nabalah (body).

Behold, ayash (husband/individual man) ibar (pass over/through) by, and raah (see) the nabalah (body) shalak (cast) in the darak (way), and the aray (lion) imad (standing) by the nabalah (body); and they bawaa (come) and dabar (word / matter) it in the iyar (city) where the zaqan (old) nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) lived.

When the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) who shawab (turn back / repent) him back from the darak (way) shamai (hearken / hear) of it, he amar (spoke), It is the ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam who was marah (disobedient) to the pah (mouth) of Yahawah. Therefore Yahawah nathan (give) delivered him to the aray (lion), which has mauled him and mawath (death) him, according to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, which he dabar (word / matter) to him.
He dabar (word / matter) to his ban (son), amar (spoke), "chabash (saddle) the donkey for me." They chabash (saddled) it.

He yalak (went) and matzaa (found) his nabalah (body) shalak (cast) in the darak (way), and the donkey and the aray (lion) imad (standing) by the nabalah (body). The aray (lion) had not akal (eat) the nabalah (body), nor mauled the donkey.

The nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) nashaa (lift) up the nabalah (body) of the ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam, and yanach (laid) it on the donkey, and shawab (turn back / repent) it back. He bawaa (come) to the iyar (city) of the zaqan (old) nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) to sapad (mourn), and to qabar (bury) him.
He yanach (laid) his nabalah (body) in his own qabar (grave / tomb / sepulcher); and they sapad (mourned) over him, saying, haway (Alas/Woe!), my ach (brother/kinsman)!

It happened, achar (other) he had qabar (bury) him, that he amar (spoke) to his ban (son), amar (spoke), When I am mawath (death), then qabar (bury) me in the tomb in which the ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam is qabar (bury). Yanach (lay) my itzam (bones) beside his itzam (bones).

For the dabar (word / matter) which he qaraa (called) by the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah against the mazabach (altar) in Bayathaal (Bethel), and against all the bayath (house) of the bamah (high) places which are in the iyar (cities) of Shamarawan (Samaria), will surely happen.

Achar (other) this thing Yarabaim (Jeroboam) didn't shawab (turn back / repent) from his rai (evil) darak (way), but again ishah (make) kahan (priest) of the bamah (high) places from among all the im (people / nation). Whoever wanted to, he malaa (consecrated) him, that there might be kahan (priest) of the bamah (high) places.
This thing became chataah (sin) to the bayath (house) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam), even to kachad (cut) it off, and to shamad (destroy) it from off the surface of the adamah (earth).
At that ith (time) Abayah (Abijah) the ban (son) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) chalah (afflict) sick.

Yarabaim (Jeroboam) amar (spoke) to his ashah (wife/individual woman), Please qawam (rise up) up and shanah (disguise) yourself, that you won't be recognized as the ashah (wife/individual woman) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam). Halak (move) to Shayalah (Shiloh). Behold, there is Achayah (Ahijah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), who dabar (word / matter) concerning me that I should be malak (king) over this im (people / nation).
Laqach (take / seized) with you ishar (ten) loaves, and cakes, and a jar of dabash (honey), and bawaa (come) to him. He will nagad (tell) you what will become of the nair (child).

Yarabaim (Jeroboam's) ashah (wife/individual woman) ishah (make) so, and qawam (rise up), and yalak (went) to Shayalah (Shiloh), and bawaa (come) to the bayath (house) of Achayah (Ahijah). Now Achayah (Ahijah) yakal (could) not raah (see); for his iyan (eye) were qawam (rise up) by reason of his shayab (age).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Achayah (Ahijah), Behold, the ashah (wife/individual woman) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) bawaa (come) to darash (inquire) of you dabar (word / matter) her ban (son); for he is chalah (afflict). Zah (this/that/these) and thus you shall dabar (word / matter) her; for it will be, when she bawaa (come) in, that she will pretend to be nakar (another) woman.

It was so, when Achayah (Ahijah) shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of her ragal (feet / foot), as she bawaa (come) in at the pathach (door), that he amar (spoke), bawaa (come) in, you ashah (wife/individual woman) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam)! Why do you pretend to be nakar (another)? For I am shalach (send) to you with qashah (rough / hard) news.

Yalak (go), amar (spoke) Yarabaim (Jeroboam), ‘Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): “yain (because) I rawam (will lift up) you from thawak (midst) the im (people / nation), and nathan (give) you nagayad (prince) over my im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel),

And qarai (tore) the mamalakah (kingdom) away from the bayath (house) of Dawad (David), and nathan (give) it you; and yet you have not been as my ibad (servant) Dawad (David), who shamar (keep/guard) my matzawah (commandments), and who halak (move) me with all his labab (heart), to ishah (make) that only which was yashar (right) in my iyan (eye),

But ishah (make) done raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil) above all who were panayam (before) you, and have yalak (gone) and ishah (make) you other Alahayam, and masakah (molten) images, to provoke me to kais (anger), and have shalak (cast) me achar (other) your gaw (back):

Therefore, behold, I will bawaa (come) rai (evil) on the bayath (house) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam), and will karath (cut) off from Yarabaim (Jeroboam) everyone who urinates on a qayar (wall), he who is itzar (shut) up and he who is izab (left) at large in Yasharaal (Israel), and will utterly sweep bair (away) the bayath (house) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam), as a man sweeps bair (away) galal (dung), until it is thamam (all) gone.

He who mawath (death) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) in the iyar (city) shall the kalab (dogs) akal (eat); and he who mawath (death) in the shadah (field) shall the iwap (flying) of the sky akal (eat): for Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) it.”’
Qawam (rise up) therefore, and yalak (go) to your bayath (house). When your ragal (feet / foot) bawaa (come) into the iyar (city), the yalad (birth / begot) shall mawath (death).

All Yasharaal (Israel) shall sapad (mourn) for him, and qabar (bury) him; for he only of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) shall bawaa (come) to the qabar (grave / tomb / sepulcher), because in him there is matzaa (found) some tawab (pleasant/functional) thing toward Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), in the bayath (house) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam).
Moreover Yahawah will qawam (rise up) him up a malak (king) over Yasharaal (Israel), who shall karath (cut) off the bayath (house) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam). This is yawam (day)! What? Even now.

For Yahawah will nakah (strike) Yasharaal (Israel), as a qanah (reed) is nawad (shaken) in the mayam (Waters); and he will nathash (root) up Yasharaal (Israel) out of this tawab (pleasant/functional) adamah (land) which he nathan (give) to their ab (father), and will zarah (scatter) them ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), because they ishah (make) made their Asharah (Asherim), provoking Yahawah to kais (anger).
He will nathan (give) Yasharaal (Israel) up galal (because) of the chataah (sin) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam), which he has chataa (sinned), and with which he has made Yasharaal (Israel) to chataa (sin).

Yarabaim (Jeroboam's) ashah (wife/individual woman) qawam (rise up), and departed, and bawaa (come) to Tharatzah (Tirzah). As she bawaa (come) to the sap (threshold) of the bayath (house), the nair (child) mawath (death).

All Yasharaal (Israel) qabar (bury) him, and sapad (mourned) for him, according to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, which he dabar (word / matter) by his ibad (servant) Achayah (Ahijah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy).

The yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam), how he lacham (warred), and how he malak (king), behold, they are kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabar (word / matter) of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel).

The yawam (day) which Yarabaim (Jeroboam) malak (king) were shanayam (two) and isharayam (twenty) shanah (years): and he shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and Nadab (Nadab) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Rachabaim (Rehoboam) the ban (son) of Shalamah (Solomon) malak (king) in Yahawadah (Judah). Rachabaim (Rehoboam) was arabaiyam (forty) - achad (one) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king), and he malak (king) seventeen shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), the iyar (city) which Yahawah had bachar (chosen) out of all the shabat (tribes) of Yasharaal (Israel), to shawam (place / establish / appoint) his sham (name) there: and his am (mother) sham (name) was Naimah (Naamah) the imawanayath (ammonitess).

Yahawadah (Judah) ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, and they qanaa (jealous) him to jealousy with their chataah (sin) which they chataa (committed), above all that their ab (father) ishah (make) done.
For they also banah (built) them bamah (high) places, and matzabah (pillars), and Asharah (Asherim), on every gabah (high) gabaih (hill), and under every rainan (green) itz (tree);

And there were also qadash (set apart/make holy) in the aratz (Earth/land): they ishah (make) according to all the thawaibah (abominations) of the gaway (nation / people) which Yahawah yarash (drove) out panayam (before) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel).

It happened in the chamayashay (fifth) shanah (year) of malak (king) Rachabaim (Rehoboam), that Shayashaq (Shishak) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt) ilah (go up / offer) up against Yarawashalam (Jerusalem);

And he laqach (take / seized) away the awatzar (treasures) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and the awatzar (treasures) of the malak (king) bayath (house); he even laqach (take / seized) away all: and he laqach (take / seized) away all the magan (shield) of zahab (gold) which Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) made.

Malak (king) Rachabaim (Rehoboam) ishah (make) in their place magan (shield) of nachashath (brass), and paqad (visit) them to the yad (hand) of the shar (prince / ruler) of the rawatz (guard), who shamar (keep/guard) the pathach (door) of the malak (king) bayath (house).

It was so, that as often as the malak (king) bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah, the rawatz (guard) nashaa (lift) them, and shawab (turn back / repent) them back into the rawatz (guard) room.

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Rachabaim (Rehoboam), and all that he ishah (make), aren't they kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabar (word / matter) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah)?
