The rawatz (guard) imad (stood), every ayash (husband/individual man) with his kalay (weapons) in his yad (hand), from the yamanay (right) kathap (side) of the bayath (house) to the shamaalay (left) kathap (side) of the bayath (house), along by the mazabach (altar) and the bayath (house), around the malak (king).

Then he yatzaa (go out / come out) out the malak (king) ban (son), and nathan (give) the nazar (crown / consecrate) on him, and gave him the idawath (testimony); and they made him malak (king), and mashach (anointed) him; and they nakah (clapped) their kap (hands), and amar (spoke), Long chayah (live) the malak (king)!

When Ithalayah (Athaliah) shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of the rawatz (guard) and of the im (people / nation), she bawaa (come) to the im (people / nation) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah:

And she raah (see), and behold, the malak (king) imad (stood) by the imawad (pillar), as the tradition was, and the shar (prince / ruler) and the chatzatzarah (trumpets) by the malak (king); and all the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land) shamach (rejoiced), and thaqai (blow / sound alarm) chatzatzarah (trumpets). Then Ithalayah (Athaliah) qarai (tore) her clothes, and qaraa (called), qashar (treason)! Qashar (treason)!

Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the kahan (priest) tzawah (commanded) the shar (prince / ruler) of maah (hundred) who were set over the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), and amar (spoke) to them, "yatzaa (go out / come out) her out between the ranks. Mawath (death) him who bawaa (come) her with the charab (sword)." For the kahan (priest) amar (spoke), Don't let her be mawath (death) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

So they shawam (place / establish / appoint) yad (hand) for her; and she bawaa (come) by the darak (way) of the sawas (horses)' mabawaa (entry) to the malak (king) bayath (house). She was mawath (death) there.

Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) between Yahawah and the malak (king) and the im (people / nation), that they should be yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) im (people / nation); between the malak (king) also and the im (people / nation).

All the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land) bawaa (come) to the bayath (house) of Bail (Baal), and nathatz (broke) it down; his mazabach (altars) and his tzalam (likeness) shabar (broke) they in pieces yatab (thoroughly), and harag (killed) Mathan (Mattan) the kahan (priest) of Bail (Baal) panayam (before) the mazabach (altars). The kahan (priest) shawam (place / establish / appoint) kahan (priest) over the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

He laqach (take / seized) the karay (captains) over maah (hundred), and the Carites, and the rawatz (guard), and all the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land); and they yarad (brought) down the malak (king) from the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and bawaa (come) by the darak (way) of the shair (gate) of the rawatz (guard) to the malak (king) bayath (house). He yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the kasaa (throne) of the malak (king).

So all the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land) shamach (rejoiced), and the iyar (city) was shaqat (quiet). Ithalayah (Athaliah) they had mawath (death) with the charab (sword) at the malak (king) bayath (house).
Yahawaash (Jehoash) was shabai (seven) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king).
In the shabai (seven) shanah (year) of Jehu began Yahawaash (Jehoash) to malak (king); and he malak (king) forty shanah (years) in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Zibiah of Beersheba.
Yahawaash (Jehoash) did that which was right in the eyes of Yahawah all his arabaiyam (forty) in which Jehoiada the priest instructed him.
However the high places were not ishah (make) away; the people still ishah (make) and burnt incense in the high places.

Jehoash said to the priests, All the money of the holy things that is sawar (brought) into the bamah (house) of Yahawah, in current money, the money of the persons for whom each bamah (man) is rated, and all the money that it comes into any bamah (man's) heart to sawar (bring) into the bamah (house) of Yahawah,

Let the kahan (priest) bawaa (come) it to them, every ayash (husband/individual man) from his acquaintance; and they shall repair the breaches of the bayath (house), wherever any breach shall be found.
But it was so, that in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash the kahan (priest) had not chazaq (repaired) the breaches of the bayath (house).

Then malak (king) Yahawaash (Jehoash) called for Jehoiada the kahan (priest), and for the other kahan (priest), and said to them, Why don't you chazaq (repair) the breaches of the bayath (house)? Now therefore chazaq (take) no more money from your treasurers, but deliver it for the breaches of the bayath (house).
The kahan (priest) consented that they should laqach (take / seized) no more kasap (money) from the people, ayan (neither) chazaq (repair) the breaches of the bayath (house).

But Jehoiada the kahan (priest) laqach (take / seized) a chest, and bored a hole in its lid, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into the bayath (house) of Yahawah: and the kahan (priest) who kept the threshold put therein all the kasap (money) that was laqach (take / seized) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

It was so, when they atzal (saw) that there was much kasap (money) in the arawan (chest), that the king's scribe and the ayash (husband/individual man) kahan (priest) nathan (give) up, and they nathan (give) up in bags and nathan (give) the kasap (money) that was found in the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

They gave the kasap (money) that was weighed out into the matzaa (hands) of those who hayah (came to pass) the ilah (go up / offer), who hayah (came to pass) the oversight of the bayath (house) of Yahawah: and they paid it out to the carpenters and the builders, who ilah (go up / offer) on the bayath (house) of Yahawah,

And to the charash (masons) and the stone cutters, and for buying itz (timber) and cut stone to banah (repair) the breaches of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and for all that was yatzaa (go out / come out) out for the bayath (house) to banah (repair) it.

But there were not gadar (made) for the bayath (house) of Yahawah cups of silver, snuffers, basins, trumpets, any vessels of gold, or vessels of silver, of the money that was yatzaa (go out / come out) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah;
For they bawaa (come) that to those who did the ishah (make), and repaired therewith the bayath (house) of Yahawah.
Moreover they didn't demand an accounting from the ishah (make) into whose hand they nathan (give) the money to nathan (give) to those who did the malaakah (work); for they dealt faithfully.
The kasap (money) for the trespass offerings, and the kasap (money) for the ishah (make) offerings, was not nathan (give) into the house of Yahawah: it was the priests'.
Then Hazael king of Syria bawaa (come) up, and fought against Gath, and bawaa (come) it; and Hazael bawaa (come) his face to bawaa (come) up to Jerusalem.

Jehoash malak (king) of Gath (Judah) ilah (go up / offer) all the gath (holy) things that Jehoshaphat and Jehoram and Ahaziah, his fathers, malak (king) of Gath (Judah), had dedicated, and his own gath (holy) things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the gath (house) of Yahawah, and of the malak (king) gath (house), and sent it to Chazaal (Hazael) malak (king) of Aram (Syria): and he ilah (go up / offer) away from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah)?
His servants arose, and made a conspiracy, and struck Yawaash (Joash) at the house of Millo, on the way that ishah (make) down to Silla.

For Jozacar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his ibad (servant), nakah (struck) him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Amaziah his son reigned in his place.

In the shalawash (three) and isharayam (twenty) shanah (year) of Yawaash (Joash) the ban (son) of Achazayah (Ahaziah), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) the ban (son) of Yahawaa (Jehu) began to malak (king) over Yasharaal (Israel) in Shamarawan (Samaria) for seventeen shanah (years).

He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, and yalak (followed) the chataah (sin) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat), with which he made Yasharaal (Israel) to chataa (sin); he didn't sawar (depart) from it.

The ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah was charah (hot with anger) against Yasharaal (Israel), and he nathan (give) them into the yad (hand) of Chazaal (Hazael) malak (king) of Aram (Syria), and into the yad (hand) of Banahadad (Benhadad) the ban (son) of Chazaal (Hazael), yawam (day).

Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) begged Yahawah, and Yahawah shamai (hearken / hear) to him; for he raah (see) the lachatz (oppression) of Yasharaal (Israel), how that the malak (king) of Aram (Syria) lachatz (oppressed) them.

(Yahawah nathan (give) Yasharaal (Israel) a savior, so that they yatzaa (go out / come out) out from under the yad (hand) of the Aram (Syrians); and the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) lived in their ahal (tents) as shalashawam (before).

Nevertheless they didn't sawar (depart) from the chataah (sin) of the bayath (house) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam), with which he made Yasharaal (Israel) to chataa (sin), but halak (move) therein: and there imad (remained) the Asharah (Asherah) also in Shamarawan (Samaria).)

For he didn't shaar (leave) to Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) of the im (people / nation) any more than chamashayam (fifty) horsemen, and ishar (ten) rakab (chariots), and ishar (ten) alap (thousand) footmen; for the malak (king) of Aram (Syria) abad (destroy/perish) them, and shawam (place / establish / appoint) them like the ipar (dust) in dawash (threshing).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz), and all that he ishah (make), and his gabawarah (might), aren't they kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabar (word / matter) of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel)?
Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) shakab (slept) with his ab (father); and they qabar (bury) him in Shamarawan (Samaria): and Yawaash (Joash) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

In the shalawashayam (thirty) - shabai (seven) shanah (year) of Yawaash (Joash) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), Yahawaash (Jehoash) the ban (son) of Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) began to malak (king) over Yasharaal (Israel) in Shamarawan (Samaria) for sixteen shanah (years).

He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah; he didn't sawar (depart) from all the chataah (sin) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat), with which he made Yasharaal (Israel) to chataa (sin); but he halak (move) therein.

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Yawaash (Joash), and all that he ishah (make), and his gabawarah (might) with which he lacham (fought) against Amatzayah (Amaziah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), aren't they kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabar (word / matter) of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel)?

Yawaash (Joash) shakab (slept) with his ab (father); and Yarabaim (Jeroboam) yashab (inhabit/dwell) on his kasaa (throne): and Yawaash (Joash) was qabar (bury) in Shamarawan (Samaria) with the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel).

Now Alayashai (Elisha) was chalah (afflict) sick of his chalay (sickness) of which he mawath (death): and Yawaash (Joash) the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) yarad (came) down to him, and bakah (wept) over him, and amar (spoke), My ab (father), my ab (father), the rakab (chariots) of Yasharaal (Israel) and its horsemen!
Alayashai (Elisha) amar (spoke) to him, "laqach (take / seized) qashath (bow) and chatz (arrows);" and he laqach (take / seized) to him qashath (bow) and chatz (arrows).

He amar (spoke) to the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel), "rakab (put) your yad (hand) on the qashath (bow);" and he rakab (put) his yad (hand) on it. Alayashai (Elisha) shawam (place / establish / appoint) his yad (hand) on the malak (king) yad (hand).

He amar (spoke), "pathach (open) the chalawan (window) eastward;" and he pathach (opened) it. Then Alayashai (Elisha) amar (spoke), "yarah (shoot)!" And he yarah (shot). He amar (spoke), yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) chatz (arrow) of thashawaih (deliverance), even the chatz (arrow) of thashawaih (deliverance) over Aram (Syria); for you shall nakah (strike) the Aram (Syrians) in Apaq (Aphek), until you kalah (complete / finish) consumed them.

He amar (spoke), "laqach (take / seized) the chatzay (arrows);" and he laqach (take / seized) them. He amar (spoke) to the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel), "nakah (strike) the aratz (Earth/land);" and he nakah (struck) shalawash (three) times, and stopped.

The ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam was qatzap (angry) with him, and amar (spoke), You should have nakah (struck) chamash (five) or shash (six) paim (times). Then you would have nakah (struck) Aram (Syria) until you kalah (complete / finish) consumed it, whereas now you shall nakah (strike) Aram (Syria) just shalawash (three) times.
Alayashai (Elisha) mawath (death), and they qabar (bury) him. Now the gadawad (bands) Mawaab (of) the Moabites bawaa (come) the aratz (Earth/land) at the bawaa (come) in of the shanah (year).

It happened, as they were qabar (bury) a ayash (husband/individual man), that raah (see), they spied a gadawad (band); and they shalak (cast) the ayash (husband/individual man) into the tomb of Alayashai (Elisha): and as soon as the ayash (husband/individual man) nagai (touched) the itzam (bones) of Alayashai (Elisha), he chayah (revived), and qawam (rise up) up on his ragal (feet / foot).
Chazaal (Hazael) malak (king) of Aram (Syria) lachatz (oppressed) Yasharaal (Israel) all the yawam (day) of Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz).

But Yahawah was gracious to them, and racham (had) compassion on them, and had panah (respect) to them, main (because) of his barayath (covenant) with Abaraham (Abraham), Yatzachaq (Isaac), and Yaiqab (Jacob), and would not shachath (destroy) them, neither shalak (cast) he them from his panayam (presence) as yet.
Chazaal (Hazael) malak (king) of Aram (Syria) mawath (death); and Banahadad (Benhadad) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Yahawaash (Jehoash) the ban (son) of Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) laqach (take / seized) again out of the yad (hand) of Banahadad (Benhadad) the ban (son) of Chazaal (Hazael) the iyar (cities) which he had laqach (take / seized) out of the yad (hand) of Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) his ab (father) by malachamah (war). Yawaash (Joash) nakah (struck) him shalawash (three) paim (times), and shawab (turn back / repent) the iyar (cities) of Yasharaal (Israel).

In the shanayam (two) shanah (year) of Yawaash (Joash) ban (son) of Yawaachaz (Joahaz) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) began Amatzayah (Amaziah) the ban (son) of Yawaash (Joash) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) to malak (king).

He was twenty-five shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) twenty-nine shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Yahawaidayan (Jehoaddin) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

He ishah (make) that which was yashar (right) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, yet not like Dawad (David) his ab (father): he ishah (make) according to all that Yawaash (Joash) his ab (father) ishah (make) done.
However the bamah (high) places were not sawar (taken) away: the im (people / nation) still zabach (sacrificed) and burnt qatar (incense) in the bamah (high) places.
It happened, as soon as the mamalakah (kingdom) was chazaq (established) in his yad (hand), that he nakah (killed) his ibad (servant) who had nakah (slain) the malak (king) his ab (father):

But the ban (son) of the nakah (murderers) he didn't put to mawath (death); according to that which is kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction) of Mashah (Moses), as Yahawah tzawah (commanded), amar (spoke), The ab (father) shall not be put to mawath (death) for the ban (son), nor the ban (son) be put to mawath (death) for the ab (father); but every ayash (husband/individual man) shall mawath (death) for his own chataa (sin).

He nakah (killed) of Adam (Edom) in the gayaa (valley) of malach (salt) ishar (ten) alap (thousand), and thapash (took) salai (sela) by malachamah (war), and qaraa (called) its sham (name) Yaqathaal (Joktheel), to this yawam (day).

Then Amatzayah (Amaziah) shalach (send) malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) to Yahawaash (Jehoash), the ban (son) of Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) ban (son) of Yahawaa (Jehu), malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel), amar (spoke), yalak (come), raah (see) us look one another in the panayam (face).

Yahawaash (Jehoash) the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) shalach (send) to Amatzayah (Amaziah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), amar (spoke), The chawach (thistle) that was in Labanawan (Lebanon) shalach (send) to the araz (cedar) that was in Labanawan (Lebanon), amar (spoke), ‘nathan (give) your bath (daughter) to my ban (son) as ashah (wife/individual woman). Then a shadah (wild) animal that was in Labanawan (Lebanon) ibar (pass over/through) by, and ramas (trampled) down the chawach (thistle).

You have nakah (indeed) nakah (struck) Adam (Edom), and your lab (heart) has nashaa (lift) you up. Enjoy the glory of it, and stay at bayath (house); for why should you garah (meddle) to your rai (harm), that you should napal (fall / be cast down), even you, and Yahawadah (Judah) with you?’

But Amatzayah (Amaziah) would not shamai (hearken / hear). So Yahawaash (Jehoash) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) ilah (go up / offer) up; and he and Amatzayah (Amaziah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) raah (see) one another in the panayam (face) at Bayathashamash (Beth) Shemesh, which belongs to Yahawadah (Judah).
Yahawadah (Judah) was defeated by Yasharaal (Israel); and they nawas (fled) every ayash (husband/individual man) to his ahal (tent).

Yahawaash (Jehoash) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) thapash (took) Amatzayah (Amaziah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), the ban (son) of Yahawaash (Jehoash) the ban (son) of Achazayah (Ahaziah), at Bayathashamash (Beth) Shemesh, and bawaa (come) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and paratz (broke) down the chawamah (wall) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) from the shair (gate) of Aparayam (Ephraim) to the panah (corner) shair (gate), arabai (four) maah (hundred) amah (cubits).

He laqach (take / seized) all the zahab (gold) and kasap (silver), and all the kalay (vessels) that were matzaa (found) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and in the awatzar (treasures) of the malak (king) bayath (house), the hostages also, and shawab (turn back / repent) to Shamarawan (Samaria).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawaash (Jehoash) which he ishah (make), and his gabawarah (might), and how he lacham (fought) with Amatzayah (Amaziah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), aren't they kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabar (word / matter) of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel)?

Yahawaash (Jehoash) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and was qabar (bury) in Shamarawan (Samaria) with the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel); and Yarabaim (Jeroboam) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Amatzayah (Amaziah) the ban (son) of Yawaash (Joash) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) chayah (lived) achar (other) the mawath (death) of Yahawaash (Jehoash) ban (son) of Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) chamash (fifteen) shanah (years).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Amatzayah (Amaziah), aren't they kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabar (word / matter) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah)?

They made a qashar (conspiracy) against him in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and he nawas (fled) to Lakayash (Lachish): but they shalach (send) achar (other) him to Lakayash (Lachish), and mawath (death) him there.
They nashaa (lift) him on sawas (horses); and he was qabar (bury) at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) with his ab (father) in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David).

All the im (people / nation) of Yahawadah (Judah) laqach (take / seized) Izarayah (Azariah), who was sixteen shanah (years) ban (son), and made him malak (king) in the place of his ab (father) Amatzayah (Amaziah).
He banah (built) Ayalawath (Elath), and shawab (turn back / repent) it to Yahawadah (Judah), achar (other) that the malak (king) shakab (slept) with his ab (father).

In the fifteenth shanah (year) of Amatzayah (Amaziah) the ban (son) of Yawaash (Joash) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Yawaash (Joash) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) began to malak (king) in Shamarawan (Samaria) for arabaiyam (forty) - achad (one) shanah (years).

He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah: he didn't sawar (depart) from all the chataah (sin) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat), with which he made Yasharaal (Israel) to chataa (sin).

He shawab (turn back / repent) the gabawal (border/boundary) of Yasharaal (Israel) from the entrance of Chamath (Hamath) to the yam (sea/waters) of the irabah (arabah), according to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), which he dabar (word / matter) by his ibad (servant) Yawanah (Jonah) the ban (son) of Amathay (Amittai), the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), who was of Gathahachapar (Gath) Hepher.

For Yahawah raah (see) the inay (affliction) of Yasharaal (Israel), that it was very marah (bitter); for there was apas (none) itzar (shut) up nor izab (left) at large, neither was there any helper for Yasharaal (Israel).

Yahawah didn't dabar (word / matter) that he would machah (blot) out the sham (name) of Yasharaal (Israel) from under the sky; but he yashai (salvation) them by the yad (hand) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Yawaash (Joash).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam), and all that he ishah (make), and his gabawarah (might), how he lacham (warred), and how he shawab (turn back / repent) Damashaq (Damascus), and Chamath (Hamath), which had belonged to Yahawadah (Judah), for Yasharaal (Israel), aren't they kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabar (word / matter) of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel)?
Yarabaim (Jeroboam) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), even with the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel); and Zakarayah (Zechariah) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

In the twenty - seventh shanah (year) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) began Izarayah (Azariah) ban (son) of Amatzayah (Amaziah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) to malak (king).

Sixteen shanah (years) ban (son) was he when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) chamashayam (fifty) - shanayam (two) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Yakalayah (Jecoliah) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
He ishah (make) that which was yashar (right) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, according to all that his ab (father) Amatzayah (Amaziah) ishah (make) done.
However the bamah (high) places were not sawar (taken) away: the im (people / nation) still zabach (sacrificed) and burnt qatar (incense) in the bamah (high) places.

Yahawah nagai (struck) the malak (king), so that he was a tzarai (leper) to the yawam (day) of his mawath (death), and lived in a separate bayath (house). Yawatham (Jotham) the malak (king) ban (son) was over the bayath (house), shapat (judging) the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Izarayah (Azariah), and all that he ishah (make), aren't they kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabar (word / matter) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah)?

Izarayah (Azariah) shakab (slept) with his ab (father); and they qabar (bury) him with his ab (father) in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David): and Yawatham (Jotham) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

In the shalawashayam (thirty) - shamanah (eighth) shanah (year) of Izarayah (Azariah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), Zakarayah (Zechariah) the ban (son) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) malak (king) over Yasharaal (Israel) in Shamarawan (Samaria) shash (six) chadash (month).

He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, as his ab (father) ishah (make) done: he didn't sawar (depart) from the chataah (sin) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat), with which he made Yasharaal (Israel) to chataa (sin).

Shalawam (Shallum) the ban (son) Yabash (of) Jabesh qashar (conspired) against him, and nakah (struck) him qabal (before) the im (people / nation), and mawath (death) him, and malak (king) in his place.

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Zakarayah (Zechariah), behold, they are kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabar (word / matter) of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel).

This was the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah which he dabar (word / matter) to Yahawaa (Jehu), amar (spoke), "Your ban (son) to the rabayaiy (fourth) generation shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the kasaa (throne) of Yasharaal (Israel)." So it came to pass.

Shalawam (Shallum) the ban (son) Yabash (of) Jabesh began to malak (king) in the shalawashayam (thirty) - thashai (nine) shanah (year) of Izayah (Uzziah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah); and he malak (king) for a yarach (month) in Shamarawan (Samaria).

Manacham (Menahem) the ban (son) of Gaday (Gadi) ilah (go up / offer) up from Tharatzah (Tirzah), and bawaa (come) to Shamarawan (Samaria), and nakah (struck) Shalawam (Shallum) the ban (son) Yabash (of) Jabesh in Shamarawan (Samaria), and mawath (death) him, and malak (king) in his place.

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Shalawam (Shallum), and his qashar (conspiracy) which he made, behold, they are kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabar (word / matter) of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel).

Then Manacham (Menahem) nakah (struck) Thapasach (Tiphsah), and all who were therein, and its gabawal (border/boundary), from Tharatzah (Tirzah): because they didn't pathach (open) to him, therefore he nakah (struck) it; and all the harah (women) therein who were with child he baqai (ripped) up.

In the shalawashayam (thirty) thashai (nine) shanah (year) of Izarayah (Azariah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), Manacham (Menahem) the ban (son) of Gaday (Gadi) began to malak (king) over Yasharaal (Israel) for ishar (ten) shanah (years) in Shamarawan (Samaria).

He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah: he didn't sawar (depart) all his yawam (day) from the chataah (sin) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat), with which he made Yasharaal (Israel) to chataa (sin).

There bawaa (come) against the aratz (Earth/land) Pawal (Pul) the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria); and Manacham (Menahem) nathan (give) Pawal (Pul) one alap (thousand) kakar (talents) of kasap (silver), that his yad (hand) might be with him to chazaq (confirm) the mamalakah (kingdom) in his yad (hand).

Manacham (Menahem) yatzaa (go out / come out) the kasap (money) of Yasharaal (Israel), even of all the gabawar (mighty) men of wealth, of achad (one) ayash (husband/individual man) chamashayam (fifty) shaqal (shekels) of kasap (silver), to nathan (give) to the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria). So the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) shawab (turn back / repent) back, and didn't imad (stay) there in the aratz (Earth/land).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Manacham (Menahem), and all that he ishah (make), aren't they kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabar (word / matter) of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel)?
Manacham (Menahem) shakab (slept) with his ab (father); and Paqachayah (Pekahiah) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

In the fiftieth shanah (year) of Izarayah (Azariah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) Paqachayah (Pekahiah) the ban (son) of Manacham (Menahem) began to malak (king) over Yasharaal (Israel) in Shamarawan (Samaria) for two shanah (years).

He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah: he didn't sawar (depart) from the chataah (sin) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat), with which he made Yasharaal (Israel) to chataa (sin).

Paqach (Pekah) the ban (son) of Ramalayahaw (Remaliah), his shalayash (captain), qashar (conspired) against him, and nakah (struck) him in Shamarawan (Samaria), in the aramawan (castle) of the malak (king) bayath (house), with Aragab (Argob) and Arayah (Arieh); and with him were chamashayam (fifty) ayash (husband/individual man) of the Gileadites: and he mawath (death) him, and malak (king) in his place.

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Paqachayah (Pekahiah), and all that he ishah (make), behold, they are kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabar (word / matter) of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel).

In the chamashayam (fifty)- shanayam (two) shanah (year) of Izarayah (Azariah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) Paqach (Pekah) the ban (son) of Ramalayahaw (Remaliah) began to malak (king) over Yasharaal (Israel) in Shamarawan (Samaria) for isharayam (twenty) shanah (years).

He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah: he didn't sawar (depart) from the chataah (sin) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat), with which he made Yasharaal (Israel) to chataa (sin).

In the yawam (day) of Paqach (Pekah) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) bawaa (come) Thagalathapalaasar (Tiglath) Pileser malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), and laqach (take / seized) Iyawan (Ijon), and Abalabayathamaikah (Abel) Beth Maacah, and Yanawach (Janoah), and Qadash (Kedesh), and Chatzawar (Hazor), and Galaid (Gilead), and Galayal (Galilee), all the aratz (Earth/land) of Napathalay (Naphtali); and he galah (carried) them captive to Ashawar (Assyria).

Hawashai (Hoshea) the ban (son) of Alah (Elah) made a qashar (conspiracy) against Paqach (Pekah) the ban (son) of Ramalayahaw (Remaliah), and nakah (struck) him, and mawath (death) him, and malak (king) in his place, in the isharayam (twenty) shanah (year) of Yawatham (Jotham) the ban (son) of Izayah (Uzziah).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Paqach (Pekah), and all that he ishah (make), behold, they are kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabar (word / matter) of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel).

In the shanayam (two) shanah (year) of Paqach (Pekah) the ban (son) of Ramalayahaw (Remaliah) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) began Yawatham (Jotham) the ban (son) of Izayah (Uzziah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) to malak (king).

He was isharayam (twenty) - chamash (five) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) sixteen shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Yarawashaa (Jerusha) the bath (daughter) of Tzadawaq (Zadok).
He ishah (make) that which was yashar (right) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah; he ishah (make) according to all that his ab (father) Izayah (Uzziah) ishah (make) done.

However the bamah (high) places were not sawar (taken) away: the im (people / nation) still zabach (sacrificed) and qatar (burned) incense in the bamah (high) places. He banah (built) the ilayawan (upper) shair (gate) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Yawatham (Jotham), and all that he ishah (make), aren't they kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabar (word / matter) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah)?
In those yawam (day) Yahawah chalal (began) to shalach (send) against Yahawadah (Judah) Ratzayan (Rezin) the malak (king) of Aram (Syria), and Paqach (Pekah) the ban (son) of Ramalayahaw (Remaliah).

Yawatham (Jotham) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and was qabar (bury) with his ab (father) in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David) his ab (father): and Achaz (Ahaz) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.
In the seventeenth shanah (year) of Paqach (Pekah) the ban (son) of Ramalayahaw (Remaliah) Achaz (Ahaz) the ban (son) of Yawatham (Jotham) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) began to malak (king).

Isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) was Achaz (Ahaz) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) sixteen shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and he didn't do that which was yashar (right) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah his Alahayam, like Dawad (David) his ab (father).

But he yalak (walked) in the darak (way) of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel), yes, and made his ban (son) to ibar (pass over/through) through the ash (fire), according to the thawaibah (abominations) of the gaway (nation / people), whom Yahawah yarash (cast) out from panayam (before) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel).
He zabach (sacrificed) and burnt qatar (incense) in the bamah (high) places, and on the gabaih (hills), and under every rainan (green) itz (tree).

Then Ratzayan (Rezin) malak (king) of Aram (Syria) and Paqach (Pekah) ban (son) of Ramalayahaw (Remaliah) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) ilah (go up / offer) up to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to malachamah (war): and they tzawar (besieged) Achaz (Ahaz), but yakal (could) not lacham (overcome) him.

At that ith (time) Ratzayan (Rezin) malak (king) of Aram (Syria) shawab (turn back / repent) Ayalawath (Elath) to Aram (Syria), and nashal (drove) the Yahawaday (Jews) from Ayalawath (Elath); and the Arawamay (Syrians) bawaa (come) to Ayalawath (Elath), and lived there, to this yawam (day).

So Achaz (Ahaz) shalach (send) malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) to Thagalathapalaasar (Tiglath) Pileser malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), amar (spoke), I am your ibad (servant) and your ban (son). Ilah (go up / offer) up, and yashai (salvation) me out of the kap (hand) of the malak (king) of Aram (Syria), and out of the kap (hand) of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel), who qawam (rise up) up against me.

Achaz (Ahaz) laqach (take / seized) the kasap (silver) and zahab (gold) that was matzaa (found) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and in the awatzar (treasures) of the malak (king) bayath (house), and shalach (send) it for a shachad (present) to the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria).

The malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) shamai (hearken / hear) to him; and the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) ilah (go up / offer) up against Damashaq (Damascus), and thapash (took) it, and galah (carried) its people captive to Qayar (Kir), and mawath (death) Ratzayan (Rezin).

Malak (king) Achaz (Ahaz) yalak (went) to Damashaq (Damascus) to qaraah (meet) Thagalathapalaasar (Tiglath) Pileser malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), and raah (see) the mazabach (altar) that was at Damashaq (Damascus); and malak (king) Achaz (Ahaz) shalach (send) to Awarayah (Urijah) the kahan (priest) the damawath (fashion) of the mazabach (altar), and its thabanayath (pattern), according to all its workmanship.

Awarayah (Urijah) the kahan (priest) banah (built) an mazabach (altar): according to all that malak (king) Achaz (Ahaz) had shalach (send) from Damashaq (Damascus), so Awarayah (Urijah) the kahan (priest) ishah (make) it for the bawaa (come) of malak (king) Achaz (Ahaz) from Damashaq (Damascus).

When the malak (king) bawaa (come) come from Damashaq (Damascus), the malak (king) raah (see) the mazabach (altar): and the malak (king) qarab (come close) near to the mazabach (altar), and ilah (go up / offer) on it.

He burnt his burnt ilah (offering) and his meal manachah (offering), and nasak (poured) his drink nasak (offering), and zaraq (sprinkled) the dam (blood) of his shalam (peace) offerings, on the mazabach (altar).

The bronze mazabach (altar), which panayam (was) before Yahawah, he qarab (come close) from the panayam (forefront) of the bayath (house), from between his mazabach (altar) and the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and nathan (give) it on the tzapawan (north) yarak (side) of his mazabach (altar).

Malak (king) Achaz (Ahaz) tzawah (commanded) Awarayah (Urijah) the kahan (priest), amar (spoke), On the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) mazabach (altar) qatar (burn) the baqar (morning) burnt ilah (offering), and the irab (evening) meal manachah (offering), and the malak (king) burnt ilah (offering), and his meal manachah (offering), with the burnt ilah (offering) of all the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land), and their meal manachah (offering), and their drink nasak (offerings); and zaraq (sprinkle) on it all the dam (blood) of the burnt ilah (offering), and all the dam (blood) of the zabach (sacrifice); but the bronze mazabach (altar) shall be for me to baqar (morning) by.
Awarayah (Urijah) the kahan (priest) ishah (make) so, according to all that malak (king) Achaz (Ahaz) tzawah (commanded).

Malak (king) Achaz (Ahaz) qatzatz (cut) off the panels of the makawanah (bases), and sawar (removed) the basin from off them, and yarad (took) down the yam (sea/waters) from off the bronze oxen that were under it, and nathan (give) it on a maratzapath (pavement) of aban (stone).

The covered way for the shabath (shabath/rest) that they had banah (built) in the bayath (house), and the malak (king) mabawaa (entry) outside, sabab (turned) he to the bayath (house) of Yahawah, panayam (because) of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Achaz (Ahaz) which he ishah (make), aren't they kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabar (word / matter) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah)?
Achaz (Ahaz) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and was qabar (bury) with his ab (father) in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David): and Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

In the shanayam (two) shanah (year) of Achaz (Ahaz) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), Hawashai (Hoshea) the ban (son) of Alah (Elah) began to malak (king) in Shamarawan (Samaria) over Yasharaal (Israel) for thashai (nine) shanah (years).
He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, yet not as the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) who were panayam (before) him.
Against him ilah (go up / offer) up Shalamanaasar (Shalmaneser) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria); and Hawashai (Hoshea) became his ibad (servant), and shawab (turn back / repent) him tribute.

The malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) matzaa (found) qashar (conspiracy) in Hawashai (Hoshea); for he had shalach (send) malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) Sawaa (to) So malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and ilah (go up / offer) no tribute to the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), as he had done shanah (year) by shanah (year): therefore the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) itzar (shut) him up, and asar (bound) him in bayath (house).

Then the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) ilah (go up / offer) up throughout all the aratz (Earth/land), and ilah (go up / offer) up to Shamarawan (Samaria), and tzawar (besieged) it shalawash (three) shanah (years).

In the thashayaiy (ninth) shanah (year) of Hawashai (Hoshea) the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) lakad (took) Shamarawan (Samaria), and galah (carried) Yasharaal (Israel) away to Ashawar (Assyria), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) them in Chalach (Halah), and on the Chabawar (Habor), the nahar (river) of Gawazan (Gozan), and in the iyar (cities) of the Maday (Medes).

It was so, because the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) had chataa (sinned) against Yahawah their Alahayam, who ilah (go up / offer) them up out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) from under the yad (hand) of Paraih (Pharaoh) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and had yaraa (fear / be afraid) other Alahayam,

And yalak (walked) in the chaqah (statutes) of the gaway (nation / people), whom Yahawah yarash (cast) out from panayam (before) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), and of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel), which they ishah (make).

The ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) chapaa (did) secretly things that were not right against Yahawah their Alahayam: and they banah (built) them bamah (high) places in all their iyar (cities), from the magadal (tower) of the watchmen to the fortified iyar (city);
And they natzab (set) them up matzabah (pillars) and Asharah (Asherim) on every gabah (high) gabaih (hill), and under every rainan (green) itz (tree);

And there they burnt qatar (incense) in all the bamah (high) places, as did the gaway (nation / people) whom Yahawah galah (carried) away panayam (before) them; and they ishah (make) rai (wicked) things to provoke Yahawah to kais (anger);
And they ibad (servant) galawal (idols), of which Yahawah had amar (spoke) to them, You shall not ishah (make) this thing.

Yet Yahawah iwad (admonish/bear witness against) to Yasharaal (Israel), and to Yahawadah (Judah), by every nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), and every chazah (seer), amar (spoke), shawab (turn back / repent) from your rai (evil) darak (ways), and shamar (keep/guard) my matzawah (commandments) and my chaqah (statutes), according to all the thawarah (instruction) which I tzawah (commanded) your ab (father), and which I shalach (send) to you by my ibad (servant) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy).
Notwithstanding, they would not shamai (hearken / hear), but hardened their irap (neck), like the irap (neck) of their ab (father), who didn't aman (believe / have faith) in Yahawah their Alahayam.

They maas (rejected) his chaq (statute), and his barayath (covenant) that he karath (cut) with their ab (father), and his idawath (testimonies) which he iwad (admonish/bear witness against) to them; and they yalak (followed) habal (vanity), and habal (became) vain, and achar (other) the gaway (nation / people) that were around them, concerning whom Yahawah had tzawah (commanded) them that they should not ishah (make) like them.

They forsook all the matzawah (commandments) of Yahawah their Alahayam, and ishah (make) them masakah (molten) images, even shanayam (two) calves, and ishah (make) an Asharah (Asherah), and shachah (worshiped) all the tzabaa (troop) of the sky, and ibad (servant) Bail (Baal).

They caused their ban (son) and their bath (daughter) to ibar (pass over/through) through the ash (fire), and used qasam (divination) and nachash (enchantments), and makar (sold) themselves to ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, to provoke him to kais (anger).
Therefore Yahawah was very anap (angry) with Yasharaal (Israel), and sawar (removed) them out of his panayam (sight): there was none shaar (left) but the shabat (tribe) of Yahawadah (Judah) only.
Also Yahawadah (Judah) didn't shamar (keep/guard) the matzawah (commandments) of Yahawah their Alahayam, but yalak (walked) in the chaqah (statutes) of Yasharaal (Israel) which they ishah (make).

Yahawah maas (rejected) all the zarai (seed) of Yasharaal (Israel), and inah (oppress / afflict) them, and nathan (give) them into the yad (hand) of shasah (spoilers), until he had shalak (cast) them out of his panayam (sight).

For he qarai (tore) Yasharaal (Israel) from the bayath (house) of Dawad (David); and they made Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat) malak (king): and Yarabaim (Jeroboam) nadah (drove) Yasharaal (Israel) from achar (other) Yahawah, and made them chataa (sin) a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) chataah (sin).
The ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) yalak (walked) in all the chataah (sin) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) which he ishah (make); they didn't sawar (depart) from them;

Until Yahawah sawar (removed) Yasharaal (Israel) out of his panayam (sight), as he dabar (word / matter) by all his ibad (servant) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy). So Yasharaal (Israel) was galah (carried) away out of their own adamah (land) to Ashawar (Assyria) to this yawam (day).

The malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) bawaa (come) men from Babal (Babylon), and Kawath (from) Cuthah, and Iwah (from) Avva, and from Chamath (Hamath) and Saparawayam (Sepharvaim), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) them in the iyar (cities) of Shamarawan (Samaria) instead of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel); and they yarash (possessed) Shamarawan (Samaria), and lived in the iyar (cities) of it.

So it was, at the thachalah (beginning) of their yashab (inhabit/dwell) there, that they didn't yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah: therefore Yahawah shalach (send) aray (lions) among them, which harag (killed) some of them.

Therefore they amar (spoke) to the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), amar (spoke), The gaway (nation / people) which you have galah (carried) away, and yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the iyar (cities) of Shamarawan (Samaria), don't yadai (know) the mashapat (law) of the Alahayam of the aratz (Earth/land). Therefore he has shalach (send) aray (lions) among them, and behold, they mawath (death) them, because they don't yadai (know) the mashapat (law) of the Alahayam of the aratz (Earth/land).

Then the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) tzawah (commanded), amar (spoke), yalak (carry) there achad (one) of the kahan (priest) whom you galah (brought) from there; and yalak (let) them go and yashab (inhabit/dwell) there, and let him yarah (teach) them the mashapat (law) of the Alahayam of the aratz (Earth/land).

So achad (one) of the kahan (priest) whom they had galah (carried) away from Shamarawan (Samaria) bawaa (come) and lived in Bayathaal (Bethel), and yarah (taught) them how they should yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah.

However every gaway (nation / people) ishah (make) Alahayam of their own, and yanach (put) them in the bayath (house) of the bamah (high) places which the Shamaranay (Samaritans) ishah (make) made, every gaway (nation / people) in their iyar (cities) in which they lived.

The ayash (husband/individual man) of Babal (Babylon) ishah (make) Sakawathabanawath (Succoth) Benoth, and the ayash (husband/individual man) of Kawath (Cuth) ishah (make) Naragal (Nergal), and the ayash (husband/individual man) of Chamath (Hamath) ishah (make) Ashayamaa (Ashima),

And the Avvites ishah (make) Nabachaz (Nibhaz) and Tharathaq (Tartak); and the saparaway (sepharvites) burnt their ban (son) in the ash (fire) to Adaramalak (Adrammelech) and Inamalak (Anammelech), the Alahayam of Saparawayam (Sepharvaim).

So they yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah, and ishah (make) to them from among themselves kahan (priest) of the bamah (high) places, who ishah (make) for them in the bayath (house) of the bamah (high) places.
They yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah, and ibad (servant) their own Alahayam, after the mashapat (ways) of the gaway (nation / people) from among whom they had been galah (carried) away.

To this yawam (day) they ishah (make) what they did raashawan (before): they don't yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah, neither ishah (make) they follow their chaqah (statutes), or their mashapat (ordinances), or the thawarah (instruction) or the matzawah (commandment) which Yahawah tzawah (commanded) the ban (son) of Yaiqab (Jacob), whom he shawam (place / establish / appoint) Yasharaal (Israel);

With whom Yahawah had karath (cut) a barayath (covenant), and tzawah (commanded) them, amar (spoke), You shall not yaraa (fear / be afraid) other Alahayam, nor shachah (bow) yourselves to them, nor ibad (servant) them, nor zabach (sacrifice) to them;

But you shall yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah, who ilah (go up / offer) you up out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) with gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kach (strength / mighty / power) and with an natah (outstretched) zarawai (arm), and you shall shachah (bow) yourselves to him, and you shall zabach (sacrifice) to him.

The chaq (statute) and the mashapat (ordinances), and the thawarah (instruction) and the matzawah (commandment), which he kathab (wrote) for you, you shall shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) forevermore. You shall not yaraa (fear / be afraid) other Alahayam.
You shall not shakach (forget) the barayath (covenant) that I have karath (cut) with you; neither shall you yaraa (fear / be afraid) other Alahayam.
But you shall yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah your Alahayam; and he will natzal (deliver) you out of the yad (hand) of all your ayab (enemy).
However they did not shamai (hearken / hear), but they ishah (make) what they did raashawan (before).

So these gaway (nation / people) yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah, and ibad (servant) their engraved pasayal (images). Their ban (son) likewise, and their ban (son) ban (son), as their ab (father) ishah (make), so they ishah (make) to this yawam (day).

Now it happened in the shalawash (three) shanah (year) of Hawashai (Hoshea) ban (son) of Alah (Elah) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel), that Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) the ban (son) of Achaz (Ahaz) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) began to malak (king).

He was isharayam (twenty) - chamash (five) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) isharayam (twenty) - thashai (nine) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Abay (Abi) the bath (daughter) of Zakarayah (Zechariah).
He ishah (make) that which was yashar (right) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, according to all that Dawad (David) his ab (father) ishah (make) done.

He sawar (removed) the bamah (high) places, and shabar (broke) the matzabah (pillars), and karath (cut) down the Asharah (Asherah): and he kathath (broke) in pieces the bronze nachash (serpent) that Mashah (Moses) ishah (make) made; for in those yawam (day) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) qatar (burned) incense to it; and he qaraa (called) it Nachashathan (Nehushtan).

He batach (trusted) in Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel); so that achar (other) him was none like him among all the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), nor among them that were panayam (before) him.
For he dabaq (joined) with Yahawah; he didn't sawar (depart) from achar (other) him, but shamar (keep/guard) his matzawah (commandments), which Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses).
Yahawah was with him; wherever he yatzaa (go out / come out) forth he shakal (prospered): and he marad (rebelled) against the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), and didn't ibad (servant) him.
He nakah (struck) the Palashathay (Philistines) to Izah (Gaza) and its gabawal (border/boundary), from the magadal (tower) of the watchmen to the fortified iyar (city).

It happened in the rabayaiy (fourth) shanah (year) of malak (king) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), which was the shabayaiy (seventh) shanah (year) of Hawashai (Hoshea) ban (son) of Alah (Elah) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel), that Shalamanaasar (Shalmaneser) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) ilah (go up / offer) up against Shamarawan (Samaria), and tzawar (besieged) it.

At the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of shalawash (three) shanah (years) they lakad (took) it: in the shash (six) shanah (year) of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), which was the thashai (nine) shanah (year) of Hawashai (Hoshea) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel), Shamarawan (Samaria) was lakad (taken).

The malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) carried Yasharaal (Israel) away to Ashawar (Assyria), and nachah (put) them in Chalach (Halah), and on the Chabawar (Habor), the nahar (river) of Gawazan (Gozan), and in the iyar (cities) of the Maday (Medes),

Because they didn't shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah their Alahayam, but ibar (pass over/through) his barayath (covenant), even all that Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah tzawah (commanded), and would not shamai (hearken / hear) it, nor ishah (make) it.

Now in the fourteenth shanah (year) of malak (king) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), Sanacharayab (Sennacherib) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) ilah (go up / offer) up against all the batzar (fortified) iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and thapash (took) them.

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) shalach (send) to the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) to Lakayash (Lachish), amar (spoke), "I have chataa (offended); shawab (turn back / repent) from me. That which you nathan (give) on me, I will nashaa (lift)." The malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) shawam (place / establish / appoint) to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) shalawash (three) maah (hundred) kakar (talents) of kasap (silver) and shalawashayam (thirty) kakar (talents) of zahab (gold).
Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) nathan (give) him all the kasap (silver) that was matzaa (found) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and in the awatzar (treasures) of the malak (king) bayath (house).

At that ith (time), Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) qatzatz (cut) off the gold from the dalath (doors) of the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah, and from the amanah (pillars) which Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) had overlaid, and nathan (give) it to the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria).

The malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) shalach (send) tharathan (tartan) and rabasarayas (rabsaris) and Rabashaqah (Rabshakeh) from Lakayash (Lachish) to malak (king) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) with a kabad (great) chayal (army) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). They ilah (go up / offer) up and bawaa (come) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). When they had ilah (go up / offer) up, they bawaa (come) and imad (stood) by the thailah (conduit) of the ilayawan (upper) barakah (pool), which is in the masalah (highway) of the kabas (fuller's) shadah (field).

When they had qaraa (called) to the malak (king), there yatzaa (go out / come out) out to them Alayaqayam (Eliakim) the ban (son) Chalaqayah (of) Hilkiah, who was over the bayath (house), and Shabanaa (Shebnah) the sapar (book), and Yawaach (Joah) the ban (son) of Asap (Asaph) the zakar (remembrance/memory).

Rabashaqah (Rabshakeh) amar (spoke) to them, amar (spoke) now to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), ‘Thus amar (spoke) the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) malak (king), the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), “What batachawan (confidence) is this in which you batach (trust)?

You amar (spoke) (but they are but vain dabar (word / matter)), ‘There is itzah (counsel) and gabawarah (strength) for malachamah (war).’ Now on whom do you batach (trust), that you have marad (rebelled) against me?

Now, behold, you batach (trust) in the mashainah (staff) of this ratzatz (bruised) qanah (reed), even in Matzarayam (Egypt). If a ayash (husband/individual man) samak (leans) on it, it will bawaa (come) into his kap (hand), and naqab (pierce) it. So is Paraih (Pharaoh) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt) to all who batach (trust) on him.

But if you amar (spoke) me, ‘We batach (trust) in Yahawah our Alahayam;’ isn't that he whose bamah (high) places and whose mazabach (altars) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) has sawar (taken) away, and has amar (spoke) to Yahawadah (Judah) and to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), ‘You shall shachah (worship) panayam (before) this mazabach (altar) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)?’

Now therefore, please irab (evening) pledges to my adawan (master / lord) the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), and I will nathan (give) you two alap (thousand) sawas (horses), if you are yakal (able) on your part to nathan (give) riders on them.

How then can you shawab (turn back / repent) away the panayam (face) of achad (one) pachah (captain) of the qatan (small/young/least) of my adawan (master / lord) ibad (servant), and batach (put) your trust on Matzarayam (Egypt) for rakab (chariots) and for horsemen?

Have I now ilah (go up / offer) up balaiday (without) Yahawah against this maqawam (place) to shachath (destroy) it? Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, ‘ilah (go up / offer) up against this aratz (Earth/land), and shachath (destroy) it.’”’

Then Alayaqayam (Eliakim) the ban (son) Chalaqayah (of) Hilkiah, and Shabanaa (Shebnah), and Yawaach (Joah), amar (spoke) to Rabashaqah (Rabshakeh), Please dabar (word / matter) to your ibad (servant) in the Aramayath (Syrian) language; for we shamai (hearken / hear) it. Don't dabar (word / matter) with us in the Yahawadayath (Jews)' language, in the azan (hearing) of the im (people / nation) who are on the chawamah (wall).

But Rabashaqah (Rabshakeh) amar (spoke) to them, Has my adawan (master / lord) shalach (send) me to your adawan (master / lord), and to you, to dabar (word / matter) these dabar (word / matter)? Hasn't he sent me to the ayash (husband/individual man) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the chawamah (wall), to akal (eat) their own charayayawanayam (dung), and to shathah (drinks) their own water with you?

Then Rabashaqah (Rabshakeh) imad (stood), and qaraa (called) with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qawal (sound / voice) in the Yahawadayath (Jews)' language, and dabar (word / matter), amar (spoke), shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) malak (king), the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria).
Thus amar (spoke) the malak (king), ‘Don't let Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) nashaa (lift) you; for he will not be yakal (able) to natzal (deliver) you out of his yad (hand).

Neither let Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) batach (make) you trust in Yahawah, amar (spoke), Yahawah will natzal (surely) natzal (deliver) us, and this iyar (city) shall not be nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria).

Don't shamai (hearken / hear) to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah).’ For thus amar (spoke) the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), ‘ishah (make) your barakah (peace) with me, and yatzaa (go out / come out) out to me; and everyone of you akal (eat) of his gapan (vine), and everyone of his thaan (fig) tree, and everyone shathah (drinks) the mayam (Waters) of his own bawar (cistern);

Until I bawaa (come) and laqach (take / seized) you away to a aratz (Earth/land) like your own aratz (Earth/land), a aratz (Earth/land) of grain and new thayarawash (wine), a aratz (Earth/land) of lacham (bread) and karam (vineyards), a aratz (Earth/land) of zayath (olive) trees and of dabash (honey), that you may chayah (live), and not mawath (death). Don't shamai (hearken / hear) to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), when he sawath (persuades) you, amar (spoke), Yahawah will natzal (deliver) us.
Has any of the Alahayam of the gaway (nation / people) ever natzal (delivered) his aratz (Earth/land) out of the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria)?

Where are the Alahayam of Chamath (Hamath), and of Arapad (Arpad)? Where are the Alahayam of Saparawayam (Sepharvaim), of Hanai (Hena), and Iwah (Ivvah)? Have they natzal (delivered) Shamarawan (Samaria) out of my yad (hand)?

Who are they among all the Alahayam of the aratz (Earth/land), that have natzal (delivered) their aratz (Earth/land) out of my yad (hand), that Yahawah should natzal (deliver) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) out of my yad (hand)?’

But the im (people / nation) held their charash (peace), and inah (answer / respond) him not a dabar (word / matter); for the malak (king) matzawah (commandment) was, Don't inah (answer / respond) him.

Then Alayaqayam (Eliakim) the ban (son) Chalaqayah (of) Hilkiah, who was over the bayath (house), bawaa (come) with Shabanaa (Shebna) the sapar (book), and Yawaach (Joah) the ban (son) of Asap (Asaph) the zakar (remembrance/memory), to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) with their clothes qarai (torn), and nagad (told) him the dabar (word / matter) of Rabashaqah (Rabshakeh).

It happened, when malak (king) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) shamai (hearken / hear) it, that he qarai (tore) his clothes, and kasah (covered) himself with sackcloth, and bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

He shalach (send) Alayaqayam (Eliakim), who was over the bayath (house), and Shabanaa (Shebna) the sapar (book), and the zaqan (elders) of the kahan (priest), kasah (covered) with sackcloth, to Yashaiyah (Isaiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) the ban (son) of Amawatz (Amoz).

They amar (spoke) to him, Thus amar (spoke) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), ‘This yawam (day) is a yawam (day) of tzarah (trouble), of thawakachah (rebuke), and of rejection; for the ban (son) bawaa (come) come to the point of mashabar (birth), and there is no kach (strength / mighty / power) to deliver them.

It awalay (perhaps) be Yahawah your Alahayam will shamai (hearken / hear) all the dabar (word / matter) of Rabashaqah (Rabshakeh), whom the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) his adawan (master / lord) has shalach (send) to charap (defy) the chay (life) Alahayam, and will yakach (rebuke) the dabar (word / matter) which Yahawah your Alahayam has shamai (hearken / hear). Therefore nashaa (lift) up your thapalah (prayer) for the shaarayath (remnant) that is matzaa (left).’
So the ibad (servant) of malak (king) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) bawaa (come) to Yashaiyah (Isaiah).

Yashaiyah (Isaiah) amar (spoke) to them, Thus you shall amar (spoke) your adawan (master / lord), ‘Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, "Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid) of the dabar (word / matter) that you have shamai (hearken / hear), with which the nair (servants) of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) have gadap (blasphemed) me.

Behold, I will nathan (give) a rawach (spirit / wind) in him, and he will shamai (hearken / hear) shamawaih (news), and will shawab (turn back / repent) to his own aratz (Earth/land). I will napal (fall / be cast down) him to fall by the charab (sword) in his own aratz (Earth/land)."’

So Rabashaqah (Rabshakeh) shawab (turn back / repent), and matzaa (found) the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) lacham (warring) against Labanah (Libnah); for he had shamai (hearken / hear) that he had departed from Lakayash (Lachish).

When he shamai (hearken / hear) it amar (spoke) of Tharahaqah (Tirhakah) malak (king) of Kawash (Ethiopia), Behold, he yatzaa (go out / come out) come out to lacham (fight) against you, he shalach (send) malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) again to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), amar (spoke),

‘Thus you shall amar (spoke) to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), amar (spoke), “Don't let your Alahayam in whom you batach (trust) nashaa (lift) you, amar (spoke), Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) will not be nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria).
Behold, you have shamai (hearken / hear) what the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) ishah (make) done to all aratz (Earth/land), by charam (destroying) them utterly. Will you be natzal (delivered)?

Have the Alahayam of the gaway (nation / people) natzal (delivered) them, which my ab (father) have shachath (destroyed), Gawazan (Gozan), and Charan (Haran), and Ratzap (Rezeph), and the ban (son) of Idan (Eden) that were in Thalaashar (Telassar)?
Where is the malak (king) of Chamath (Hamath), and the malak (king) of Arapad (Arpad), and the malak (king) of the iyar (city) of Saparawayam (Sepharvaim), of Hanai (Hena), and Iwah (Ivvah)?”’

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) laqach (take / seized) the sapar (book / scribed document) from the yad (hand) of the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah), and qaraa (called) it. Then Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) ilah (go up / offer) up to the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and parash (spread) it panayam (before) Yahawah.

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) palal (prayed) panayam (before) Yahawah, and amar (spoke), Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), who yashab (inhabit/dwell) above the karawab (cherubim), you are the Alahayam, even you alone, of all the mamalakah (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land). You ishah (make) made shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) and aratz (Earth/land).

Natah (incline) your azan (ear), Yahawah, and shamai (hearken / hear). Paqach (open) your iyan (eye), Yahawah, and raah (see). Shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Sanacharayab (Sennacherib), with which he has shalach (send) to charap (defy) the chay (life) Alahayam.
Truly, Yahawah, the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) have charab (laid) waste the gaway (nation / people) and their aratz (Earth/land),

And nathan (give) cast their Alahayam into the ash (fire); for they were no Alahayam, but the maishah (work) of adam (men's) yad (hand), itz (wood) and aban (stone). Therefore they abad (destroy/perish) destroyed them.

Now therefore, Yahawah our Alahayam, yashai (salvation) us, I beg you, out of his yad (hand), that all the mamalakah (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land) may yadai (know) that you, Yahawah, are Alahayam alone.

Then Yashaiyah (Isaiah) the ban (son) of Amawatz (Amoz) shalach (send) to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), ‘Whereas you have palal (prayed) to me against Sanacharayab (Sennacherib) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), I have shamai (hearken / hear) you.

This is the dabar (word / matter) that Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) concerning him: The bathawalah (virgin) bath (daughter) of Tzayawan (Zion) has bazah (despised) you and ridiculed you. The bath (daughter) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) has nawai (shaken) her raash (head) at you.

Whom have you charap (defied) and gadap (blasphemed)? Against whom have you rawam (will lift up) your qawal (sound / voice) and nashaa (lift) up your iyan (eye) on marawam (high)? Against the qadawash (holy) One of Yasharaal (Israel).

By your malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) you have charap (defied) the Adanay, and have amar (spoke), ‘With the rakab (multitude) of my rakab (chariots), I have ilah (go up / offer) up to the marawam (height) of the har (mountain), to the innermost yarakah (parts) of Labanawan (Lebanon); and I will karath (cut) down its qawamah (tall) araz (cedars), and its mabachar (choice) barawash (fir) trees; and I will bawaa (come) into his farthest malawan (lodging) place, the yair (forest) of his Karamal (fruitful) field.
I have qawar (dug) and shathah (drinks) zawar (strange) mayam (Waters), and with the kap (sole) of my paim (feet) will I charab (dry) up all the yaar (rivers) Matzawar (of) Egypt.’

Haven't you shamai (hearken / hear) how I ishah (make) done it rachawaq (long) ago, and yatzar (formed) it of qadam (ancient) yawam (day)? Now bawaa (come) I brought it to pass, that it should be yours to lay shaah (waste) batzar (fortified) iyar (cities) into ruinous gal (heaps).

Therefore their yashab (inhabit/dwell) were of qatzar (small) yad (hand). They were chathath (dismayed) and bawash (confounded). They were like the ishab (grass) of the shadah (field), and like the yaraq (green) dashaa (herb), like the chatzayar (grass) on the housetops, and like grain shadapah (blasted) panayam (before) it has qamah (grown) up.
But I yadai (know) your sitting down, and your yatzaa (go out / come out) out, and your bawaa (come) in, and your ragaz (raging) against me.

Because of your ragaz (raging) against me, and because your arrogance has ilah (go up / offer) up into my azan (ears), therefore will I shawam (place / establish / appoint) my chach (hook) in your ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), and my mathag (bridle) in your shapah (lips), and I will shawab (turn back / repent) you back by the darak (way) by which you bawaa (come).

‘This shall be the awath (sign / mark / miracle) to you: You shall akal (eat) this shanah (year) that which sapayach (grows) of itself, and in the shanay (second) shanah (year) that which springs of the same; and in the shalayashay (third) shanah (year) zarai (sow), and qatzar (reap), and natai (plant) karam (vineyards), and akal (eat) its paray (fruit).
The shaar (remnant) that has palayatah (escaped) of the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah) shall again take sharash (root) matah (downward), and ishah (make) paray (fruit) upward.

For out of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) a shaarayath (remnant) will yatzaa (go out / come out) out, and out of har (mountain) Tzayawan (Zion) those who shall palayatah (escape). The qanaah (zeal) of Yahawah will ishah (make) this.’

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah concerning the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), ‘He shall not bawaa (come) to this iyar (city), nor yarah (shoot) an chatz (arrow) there, neither shall he qadam (come) before it with magan (shield), nor shapak (cast) up a mound against it.
By the darak (way) that he bawaa (come), by the same shall he shawab (turn back / repent), and he shall not bawaa (come) to this iyar (city),’ naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.
‘For I will ganan (defend) this iyar (city) to yashai (salvation) it, for my own sake, and for my ibad (servant) Dawad (David's) sake.’

It happened that layal (night), that the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah yatzaa (go out / come out) out, and nakah (struck) one maah (hundred) shamanayam (eighty) - chamash (five) alap (thousand) in the machanah (camp) of the Ashawar (Assyrians). When men arose shakam (early) in the shakam (morning), behold, these were all mawath (death) pagar (bodies).
So Sanacharayab (Sennacherib) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) departed, and yalak (went) and shawab (turn back / repent), and lived at Nayanawah (Nineveh).

It happened, as he was shachah (worshipping) in the bayath (house) of Nasarak (Nisroch) his Alahayam, that Adaramalak (Adrammelech) and Sharaatzar (Sharezer) nakah (struck) him with the charab (sword); and they malat (escaped) into the aratz (Earth/land) of Ararat (Ararat). Asarachadawan (Esar) Haddon his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

In those yawam (day) was Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) chalah (afflict) to mawath (death). Yashaiyah (Isaiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) the ban (son) of Amawatz (Amoz) bawaa (come) to him, and amar (spoke) to him, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, ‘Set your bayath (house) in tzawah (order); for you shall mawath (death), and not chayah (live).’
Then he sabab (turned) his panayam (face) to the qayar (wall), and palal (prayed) to Yahawah, amar (spoke),

"Zakar (remembrance/memory) now, Yahawah, I beg you, how I have halak (move) panayam (before) you in amath (truth) and with a shalam (full / whole / complete) labab (heart), and ishah (make) done that which is tawab (pleasant/functional) in your iyan (eye)." Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) bakah (wept) bitterly.
It happened, before Yashaiyah (Isaiah) yatzaa (go out / come out) gone out into the thayakawan (middle) part of the city, that the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to him, amar (spoke),

Shawab (turn back / repent) back, and amar (spoke) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) the nagayad (prince) of my im (people / nation), ‘Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Dawad (David) your ab (father), "I have shamai (hearken / hear) your thapalah (prayer). I raah (see) seen your damaih (tears). Behold, I will rapaa (heal) you. On the shalayashay (third) yawam (day), you shall ilah (go up / offer) up to the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

I will yasap (add) to your yawam (day) chamash (fifteen) shanah (years). I will natzal (deliver) you and this iyar (city) out of the kap (hand) of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria). I will ganan (defend) this iyar (city) for my own sake, and for my ibad (servant) Dawad (David's) sake."’

Yashaiyah (Isaiah) amar (spoke), "laqach (take / seized) a dabalah (fig cake) of thaan (figs)." They laqach (take / seized) and shawam (place / establish / appoint) it on the shachayan (boil), and he chayah (recovered).

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) amar (spoke) to Yashaiyah (Isaiah), What shall be the awath (sign / mark / miracle) that Yahawah will rapaa (heal) me, and that I shall ilah (go up / offer) up to the bayath (house) of Yahawah the shalayashay (third) yawam (day)?

Yashaiyah (Isaiah) amar (spoke), This shall be the awath (sign / mark / miracle) to you from Yahawah, that Yahawah will ishah (make) the thing that he has dabar (word / matter): shall the tzal (shadow) halak (move) forward ishar (ten) mailah (ascent/climbing up), or shawab (turn back / repent) back ishar (ten) mailah (ascent/climbing up)?

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) amar (spoke), It is a qalal (light) thing for the tzal (shadow) to natah (go) forward ishar (ten) mailah (ascent/climbing up). Nay, but let the tzal (shadow) shawab (turn back / repent) backward ishar (ten) mailah (ascent/climbing up).

Yashaiyah (Isaiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) qaraa (called) to Yahawah; and he shawab (turn back / repent) the tzal (shadow) ishar (ten) mailah (ascent/climbing up) backward, by which it had yarad (gone) down on the dial of Achaz (Ahaz).

At that ith (time) Berodach Balaadan (Baladan) the ban (son) of Balaadan (Baladan), malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), shalach (send) sapar (book / scribed document) and a manachah (present) to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah); for he had shamai (hearken / hear) that Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) had been chalah (afflict).

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) shamai (hearken / hear) to them, and showed them all the bayath (house) of his nakath (precious) things, the kasap (silver), and the zahab (gold), and the basham (spices), and the tawab (pleasant/functional) shaman (oil), and the bayath (house) of his armor, and all that was matzaa (found) in his awatzar (treasures): there was nothing in his bayath (house), nor in all his mamashal (authority), that Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) didn't show them.

Then Yashaiyah (Isaiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) bawaa (come) to malak (king) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), and amar (spoke) to him, "What did these ayash (husband/individual man) amar (spoke)? From ayan (where) did they bawaa (come) to you?" Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) amar (spoke), They bawaa (come) come from a rachawaq (far) aratz (Earth/land), even from Babal (Babylon).

He amar (spoke), "What raah (see) they seen in your bayath (house)?" Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) amar (spoke), They raah (see) seen all that is in my bayath (house). There is nothing among my awatzar (treasures) that I raah (see) not shown them.
Yashaiyah (Isaiah) amar (spoke) to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah.

‘Behold, the yawam (day) bawaa (come), that all that is in your bayath (house), and that which your ab (father) have laid up in atzar (store) to this yawam (day), shall be nashaa (lift) to Babal (Babylon). Nothing shall be yathar (left),’ amar (spoke) Yahawah.

‘Of your ban (son) who shall yatzaa (go out / come out) from you, whom you shall yalad (birth / begot), shall they laqach (take / seized) away; and they shall be sarayas (eunuchs) in the hayakal (palace) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon).’

Then Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) amar (spoke) to Yashaiyah (Isaiah), "The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah which you have dabar (word / matter) is tawab (pleasant/functional)." He amar (spoke) moreover, Isn't it so, if shalawam (peace / safety) and amath (truth) shall be in my yawam (day)?

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), and all his gabawarah (might), and how he ishah (make) the barakah (pool), and the thailah (conduit), and bawaa (come) mayam (Waters) into the iyar (city), aren't they kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabar (word / matter) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah)?
Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) shakab (slept) with his ab (father); and Manashah (Manasseh) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Manashah (Manasseh) was shanayam (two) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) chamashayam (fifty) - chamash (five) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Chapatzayabah (Hephzibah).

He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, after the thawaibah (abominations) of the gaway (nation / people) whom Yahawah yarash (cast) out panayam (before) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel).

For he banah (built) again the bamah (high) places which Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) his ab (father) abad (destroy/perish) destroyed; and he qawam (rise up) up mazabach (altars) for Bail (Baal), and ishah (make) an Asharah (Asherah), as ishah (make) Achaab (Ahab) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel), and shachah (worshiped) all the tzabaa (troop) of the sky, and ibad (servant) them.
He banah (built) mazabach (altars) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, of which Yahawah amar (spoke), I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) my sham (name) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
He banah (built) mazabach (altars) for all the tzabaa (troop) of the sky in the shanayam (two) chatzar (courts) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

He made his ban (son) to ibar (pass over/through) through the ash (fire), and practiced sorcery, and used nachash (enchantments), and dealt with those who had familiar awab (spirits), and with yadainay (wizards): he ishah (make) much rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, to provoke him to kais (anger).

He shawam (place / establish / appoint) the engraved pasal (idol/graven image) Asharah (of) Asherah, that he ishah (make) made, in the bayath (house) of which Yahawah amar (spoke) to Dawad (David) and to Shalamah (Solomon) his ban (son), In this bayath (house), and in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), which I have bachar (chosen) out of all the shabat (tribes) of Yasharaal (Israel), will I shawam (place / establish / appoint) my sham (name) iwalam (forever);

Neither will I cause the ragal (feet / foot) of Yasharaal (Israel) to wander any more out of the adamah (land) which I nathan (give) their ab (father), if only they will shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) according to all that I have tzawah (commanded) them, and according to all the thawarah (instruction) that my ibad (servant) Mashah (Moses) tzawah (commanded) them.

But they didn't shamai (hearken / hear): and Manashah (Manasseh) thaih (seduced) them to ishah (make) that which is rai (evil) more than the gaway (nation / people) did whom Yahawah destroyed panayam (before) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) by his ibad (servant) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), amar (spoke),

Because Manashah (Manasseh) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) ishah (make) done these thawaibah (abominations), and has raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil) wickedly above all that the Amaray (Amorites) ishah (make), who were panayam (before) him, and has made Yahawadah (Judah) also to chataa (sin) with his galawal (idols);

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), ‘Behold, I bawaa (come) such rai (evil) on Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) and Yahawadah (Judah), that whoever shamai (hearken / hear) of it, shanayam (two) his azan (ears) shall tzalal (tingle).

I will natah (stretch) over Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) the qaw (line) of Shamarawan (Samaria), and the mashaqalath (plummet) of the bayath (house) of Achaab (Ahab); and I will machah (wipe) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) as a man machah (wipes) a tzalachath (dish), machah (wiping) it and hapak (turning) it panayam (upside) down.

I will natash (cast) off the shaarayath (remnant) of my nachalah (inheritance), and nathan (give) them into the yad (hand) of their ayab (enemy). They will become a baz (prey) and a mashasah (spoil) to all their ayab (enemy);

Because they ishah (make) done that which is rai (evil) in my iyan (eye), and have provoked me to kais (anger), since the yawam (day) their ab (father) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of Matzarayam (Egypt), even to this yawam (day).’
