Moreover Manashah (Manasseh) shapak (shed) naqay (innocent) dam (blood) very much, until he malaa (had) filled Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) from one pah (end) to another; besides his chataah (sin) with which he made Yahawadah (Judah) to chataa (sin), in ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah.

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Manashah (Manasseh), and all that he ishah (make), and his chataah (sin) that he chataa (sinned), aren't they kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabar (word / matter) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah)?

Manashah (Manasseh) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and was qabar (bury) in the gan (garden) of his own bayath (house), in the gan (garden) of Izaa (Uzza): and Amawan (Amon) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Amawan (Amon) was isharayam (twenty) - shanayam (two) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) shanayam (two) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Mashalamath (Meshullemeth) the bath (daughter) of Charawatz (Haruz) of Yatabah (Jotbah).
He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, as Manashah (Manasseh) his ab (father) ishah (make).
He yalak (walked) in all the darak (way) that his ab (father) halak (move) in, and ibad (servant) the galawal (idols) that his ab (father) ibad (servant), and shachah (worshiped) them:
And he forsook Yahawah, the Alahayam of his ab (father), and didn't halak (move) in the darak (way) of Yahawah.
The ibad (servant) of Amawan (Amon) qashar (conspired) against him, and put the malak (king) to mawath (death) in his own bayath (house).

But the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land) nakah (killed) all those who had qashar (conspired) against malak (king) Amawan (Amon); and the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land) made Yaashayah (Josiah) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Amawan (Amon) which he ishah (make), aren't they kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabar (word / matter) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah)?
He was qabar (bury) in his tomb in the gan (garden) of Izaa (Uzza): and Yaashayah (Josiah) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Yaashayah (Josiah) was shamanah (eight) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) shalawashayam (thirty) - achad (one) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Yadayadah (Jedidah) the bath (daughter) of Idayah (Adaiah) Batzaqath (of) Bozkath.

He ishah (make) that which was yashar (right) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, and yalak (walked) in all the darak (way) of Dawad (David) his ab (father), and didn't sawar (turn) aside to the right yamayan (right hand) or to the shamaawal (left hand).

It happened in the eighteenth shanah (year) of malak (king) Yaashayah (Josiah), that the malak (king) shalach (send) Shapan (Shaphan), the ban (son) of Atzalayahaw (Azaliah) the ban (son) of Mashalam (Meshullam), the sapar (book), to the bayath (house) of Yahawah, amar (spoke),

Ilah (go up / offer) up Chalaqayah (to) Hilkiah the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest), that he may thamam (sum) the kasap (money) which is bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah, which the keepers of the sap (threshold) have asap (gathered) of the im (people / nation).

Nathan (give) them deliver it into the yad (hand) of the workmen who paqad (visit) the oversight of the bayath (house) of Yahawah; and nathan (give) them give it to the workmen who are in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, to chazaq (repair) the breaches of the bayath (house),
To the charash (carpenters), and to the banah (builders), and to the gadar (masons), and for qanah (buying) itz (timber) and cut aban (stone) to chazaq (repair) the bayath (house).
However there was no chashab (accounting) made with them of the kasap (money) that was nathan (give) into their yad (hand); for they dealt faithfully.

Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest) amar (spoke) Shapan (to) Shaphan the sapar (book), "I matzaa (have) found the sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah." Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) nathan (give) the sapar (book / scribed document) Shapan (to) Shaphan, and he qaraa (called) it.

Shapan (Shaphan) the sapar (book) bawaa (come) to the malak (king), and shawab (turn back / repent) the malak (king) dabar (word / matter) again, and amar (spoke), Your ibad (servant) have emptied out the kasap (money) that was matzaa (found) in the bayath (house), and nathan (give) delivered it into the yad (hand) of the workmen who paqad (visit) the oversight of the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

Shapan (Shaphan) the sapar (book) nagad (told) the malak (king), amar (spoke), "Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) the kahan (priest) nathan (give) delivered a sapar (book / scribed document) Shapan (to) me." Shaphan qaraa (called) it panayam (before) the malak (king).
It happened, when the malak (king) had shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of the sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction), that he qarai (tore) his clothes.

The malak (king) tzawah (commanded) Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) the kahan (priest), and Achayaqam (Ahikam) the ban (son) Shapan (of) Shaphan, and Ikabawar (Achbor) the ban (son) Mayakayah (of) Micaiah, and Shapan (Shaphan) the sapar (book), and Ishayah (Asaiah) the malak (king) ibad (servant), amar (spoke),

Yalak (go) darash (inquire) of Yahawah for me, and for the im (people / nation), and for all Yahawadah (Judah), concerning the dabar (word / matter) of this sapar (book / scribed document) that is matzaa (found); for gadawal (very great/important/mighty) is the chamah (wrath) of Yahawah that is yatzath (kindled) against us, because our ab (father) have not shamai (hearken / hear) to the dabar (word / matter) of this sapar (book / scribed document), to ishah (make) according to all that which is kathab (written) concerning us.

So Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) the kahan (priest), and Achayaqam (Ahikam), and Ikabawar (Achbor), and Shapan (Shaphan), and Ishayah (Asaiah), yalak (went) to Chaladah (Huldah) the nabayaah (prophetess), the ashah (wife/individual woman) of Shalawam (Shallum) the ban (son) of Thaqawah (Tikvah), the ban (son) of Charachas (Harhas), keeper of the bagad (wardrobe) (now she lived in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) in the mashanah (second) quarter); and they dabar (word / matter) with her.
She amar (spoke) to them, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): ‘amar (spoke) the ayash (husband/individual man) who shalach (send) you to me,

“Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, ‘Behold, I will bawaa (come) rai (evil) on this maqawam (place), and on its yashab (inhabit/dwell), even all the dabar (word / matter) of the sapar (book / scribed document) which the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) has qaraa (called).

Because they have forsaken me, and have qatar (burned) incense to other Alahayam, that they might provoke me to kais (anger) with all the maishah (work) of their yad (hand), therefore my chamah (wrath) shall be yatzath (kindled) against this maqawam (place), and it shall not be kabah (quenched).’

But to the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), who shalach (send) you to darash (inquire) of Yahawah, thus you shall amar (spoke) him, ”Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): ‘Concerning the dabar (word / matter) which you have shamai (hearken / hear),

Because your labab (heart) was rakak (tender), and you kanai (humbled) yourself panayam (before) Yahawah, when you shamai (hearken / hear) what I dabar (word / matter) against this maqawam (place), and against its yashab (inhabit/dwell), that they should become a shamah (desolation) and a qalalah (curse), and have qarai (torn) your clothes, and bakah (wept) panayam (before) me; I also have shamai (hearken / hear) you,’ naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

‘Therefore, behold, I will asap (gather) you to your ab (father), and you shall be asap (gathered) to your qabar (grave / tomb / sepulcher) in shalawam (peace / safety), neither shall your iyan (eye) raah (see) all the rai (evil) which I will bawaa (come) on this maqawam (place).’"'" They shawab (turn back / repent) shawab (turn back / repent) this dabar (word / matter) to the malak (king).
The malak (king) shalach (send), and they asap (gathered) to him all the zaqan (elders) of Yahawadah (Judah) and of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

The malak (king) ilah (go up / offer) up to the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and all the ayash (husband/individual man) of Yahawadah (Judah) and all the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) with him, and the kahan (priest), and the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), and all the im (people / nation), both qatan (small/young/least) and gadawal (very great/important/mighty): and he qaraa (called) in their azan (ears) all the dabar (word / matter) of the sapar (book / scribed document) of the barayath (covenant) which was matzaa (found) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

The malak (king) imad (stood) by the imawad (pillar), and karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) panayam (before) Yahawah, to yalak (walk) achar (other) Yahawah, and to shamar (keep/guard) his matzawah (commandments), and his idawath (testimonies), and his chaqah (statutes), with all his lab (heart), and all his napash (living being/soul), to qawam (rise up) the dabar (word / matter) of this barayath (covenant) that were kathab (written) in this sapar (book / scribed document): and all the im (people / nation) imad (stood) to the barayath (covenant).

The malak (king) tzawah (commanded) Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest), and the kahan (priest) of the mashanah (second) order, and the keepers of the sap (threshold), to yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah all the kalay (vessels) that were ishah (make) for Bail (Baal), and Asharah (for) the Asherah, and for all the tzabaa (troop) of the sky, and he sharap (burned) them outside of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) in the shadamah (fields) of the Qadarawan (Kidron), and nashaa (lift) their ashes to Bayathaal (Bethel).

He shabath (shabath/rest) down the idolatrous kamar (priests), whom the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) nathan (give) ordained to qatar (burn) incense in the bamah (high) places in the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and in the places around Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); those also who qatar (burned) incense to Bail (Baal), to the shamash (sun), and to the yarach (moon), and to the mazalah (planets), and to all the tzabaa (troop) of the sky.

He yatzaa (go out / come out) out the Asharah (Asherah) from the bayath (house) of Yahawah, outside of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), to the nachal (stream / river) Qadarawan (Kidron), and sharap (burned) it at the nachal (stream / river) Qadarawan (Kidron), and daqaq (beat) it to ipar (dust), and shalak (cast) its ipar (dust) on the qabar (grave / tomb / sepulcher) of the ban (son) im (people / nation).

He nathatz (broke) down the bayath (house) of the qadash (set apart/make holy), that were in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, where the ashah (wife/individual woman) wove bayath (house) Asharah (for) the Asherah.

He bawaa (come) all the kahan (priest) out of the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and tamaa (defiled) the bamah (high) places where the kahan (priest) had qatar (burned) incense, from Gabai (Geba) Baarashabai (to) Beersheba; and he nathatz (broke) down the bamah (high) places of the shair (gates) that were at the pathach (entrance) of the shair (gate) of Yahawashawai (Joshua) the shar (prince / ruler) of the iyar (city), which were on a ayash (husband/individual man) left shamaawal (left hand) at the shair (gate) of the iyar (city).

Nevertheless the kahan (priest) of the bamah (high) places didn't ilah (go up / offer) up to the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), but they akal (eat) unleavened matzah (bread) thawak (midst) their ach (brother/kinsman).

He tamaa (defiled) Thapath (Topheth), which is in the gayaa (valley) of the ban (son) of Hanam (Hinnom), that no ayash (husband/individual man) might make his ban (son) or his bath (daughter) to ibar (pass over/through) through the ash (fire) to Malak (Molech).

He shabath (shabath/rest) away the sawas (horses) that the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) nathan (give) given to the shamash (sun), at the entrance of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, by the room Nathanamalak (of) Nathan Melech the sarayas (officer), who was in the court; and he sharap (burned) the marakabah (chariots) of the shamash (sun) with ash (fire).

The malak (king) nathatz (broke) down the mazabach (altars) that were on the gag (roof) of the upper room of Achaz (Ahaz), which the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) ishah (make) made, and the mazabach (altars) which Manashah (Manasseh) ishah (make) made in the shanayam (two) chatzar (courts) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and nathatz (beat) them down from there, and shalak (cast) their ipar (dust) into the nachal (stream / river) Qadarawan (Kidron).

The the malak (king) tamaa (defiled) the bamah (high) places that were panayam (before) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), which were on the right yamayan (right hand) of the har (mountain) of mashachayath (corruption), which Shalamah (Solomon) the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) had banah (built) for Ishatharath (Ashtoreth) the shaqawatz (abomination) of the Tzayadanay (Sidonians), and for Kamawash (Chemosh) the shaqawatz (abomination) of Mawaab (Moab), and for Malakam (Milcom) the thawaibah (abomination) of the ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon).
He shabar (broke) in pieces the matzabah (pillars), and karath (cut) down the Asharah (Asherim), and malaa (filled) their maqawam (place) with the itzam (bones) of adam (men).

Moreover the mazabach (altar) that was at Bayathaal (Bethel), and the bamah (high) place which Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat), who made Yasharaal (Israel) to chataa (sin), ishah (make) made, even that mazabach (altar) and the bamah (high) place he nathatz (broke) down; and he sharap (burned) the bamah (high) place and daqaq (beat) it to ipar (dust), and sharap (burned) the Asharah (Asherah).

As Yaashayah (Josiah) panah (turned) himself, he raah (see) the tombs that were there in the har (mountain); and he shalach (send), and laqach (take / seized) the itzam (bones) out of the tombs, and sharap (burned) them on the mazabach (altar), and tamaa (defiled) it, according to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah which the ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam qaraa (called), who qaraa (called) these things.

Then he amar (spoke), "What monument is that which I raah (see)?" The ayash (husband/individual man) of the iyar (city) amar (spoke) him, It is the tomb of the ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam, who bawaa (come) from Yahawadah (Judah), and qaraa (called) these things that you ishah (make) done against the mazabach (altar) of Bayathaal (Bethel).

He amar (spoke), "yanach (let) him be! Let no ayash (husband/individual man) nawai (move) his itzam (bones)." So they let his itzam (bones) malat (alone), with the itzam (bones) of the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) who bawaa (come) out of Shamarawan (Samaria).

All the bayath (house) also of the bamah (high) places that were in the iyar (cities) of Shamarawan (Samaria), which the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) ishah (make) made to provoke Yahawah to anger, Yaashayah (Josiah) sawar (took) away, and ishah (make) to them according to all the maishah (acts) that he ishah (make) done in Bayathaal (Bethel).

He zabach (killed) all the kahan (priest) of the bamah (high) places that were there, on the mazabach (altars), and sharap (burned) adam (men's) itzam (bones) on them; and he shawab (turn back / repent) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

The malak (king) tzawah (commanded) all the im (people / nation), amar (spoke), ishah (make) the pasach (passover) to Yahawah your Alahayam, as it is kathab (written) in this sapar (book / scribed document) of the barayath (covenant).

Ishah (make) there was not kept such a pasach (passover) from the yawam (day) of the shapat (judges) who shapat (judged) Yasharaal (Israel), nor in all the yawam (day) of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel), nor of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah);
But in the eighteenth shanah (year) of malak (king) Yaashayah (Josiah) was this pasach (passover) ishah (make) to Yahawah in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Moreover Yaashayah (Josiah) removed those who had familiar awab (spirits), and the yadainay (wizards), and the tharapayam (teraphim), and the tharapayam (idols), and all the galawal (abominations) that were raah (see) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah) and in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), that he might qawam (rise up) the dabar (word / matter) of the thawarah (instruction) which were kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) that Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) the kahan (priest) matzaa (found) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

Like him was there no malak (king) panayam (before) him, who shawab (turn back / repent) to Yahawah with all his labab (heart), and with all his napash (living being/soul), and with all his maad (might), according to all the thawarah (instruction) of Mashah (Moses); neither achar (other) him qawam (rise up) there any like him.

Notwithstanding, Yahawah didn't shawab (turn back / repent) from the charawan (fierceness) of his gadawal (very great/important/mighty) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), with which his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) was charah (hot with anger) against Yahawadah (Judah), because of all the kais (provocation) with which Manashah (Manasseh) kais (had) provoked him.

Yahawah amar (spoke), I will sawar (remove) Yahawadah (Judah) also out of my panayam (sight), as I have sawar (removed) Yasharaal (Israel), and I will maas (cast) off this iyar (city) which I have bachar (chosen), even Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and the bayath (house) of which I amar (spoke), ‘My sham (name) shall be there.’

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Yaashayah (Josiah), and all that he ishah (make), aren't they kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabar (word / matter) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah)?

In his yawam (day) Paraihanakah (Pharaoh) Necoh malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt) ilah (go up / offer) up against the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) to the nahar (river) Parath (Euphrates): and malak (king) Yaashayah (Josiah) yalak (went) qaraah (against) him; and Pharaoh Necoh mawath (death) him at Magadawan (Megiddo), when he raah (see) seen him.

His ibad (servant) rakab (carried) him in a chariot mawath (death) from Magadawan (Megiddo), and bawaa (come) him to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and qabar (bury) him in his own tomb. The im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land) laqach (take / seized) Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah), and mashach (anointed) him, and made him malak (king) in his ab (father) place.

Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) was isharayam (twenty) - shalawash (three) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) shalawash (three) chadash (month) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Chamawatal (Hamutal) the bath (daughter) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah) of Labanah (Libnah).
He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, according to all that his ab (father) ishah (make) done.

Paraihanakah (Pharaoh) Necoh asar (put) him in bonds at Rabalah (Riblah) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Chamath (Hamath), that he might not malak (king) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and nathan (give) the aratz (Earth/land) to a inash (tribute) of one maah (hundred) kakar (talents) of kasap (silver), and a kakar (talent) of zahab (gold).

Paraihanakah (Pharaoh) Necoh made Alayaqayam (Eliakim) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah) malak (king) in the place of Yaashayah (Josiah) his ab (father), and sabab (changed) his sham (name) to Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim): but he laqach (take / seized) Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) laqach (take / seized); and he bawaa (come) to Matzarayam (Egypt), and mawath (death) there.

Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) nathan (give) the kasap (silver) and the zahab (gold) to Paraih (Pharaoh); but he irak (taxed) the aratz (Earth/land) to nathan (give) the kasap (money) pah (according) to the commandment of Paraih (Pharaoh): he nagash (exacted) the kasap (silver) and the zahab (gold) of the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land), of everyone according to his irak (taxation), to nathan (give) it to Paraihanakah (Pharaoh) Necoh.

Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) was isharayam (twenty) - chamash (five) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) achad (one) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Zabayadah (Zebidah) the bath (daughter) of Padayah (Pedaiah) of Rawamah (Rumah).
He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, according to all that his ab (father) ishah (make) done.

In his yawam (day) Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) ilah (go up / offer) up, and Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) became his ibad (servant) shalawash (three) shanah (years): then he shawab (turn back / repent) and marad (rebelled) against him.

Yahawah shalach (send) against him gadawad (bands) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans), and gadawad (bands) of the Aram (Syrians), and gadawad (bands) Mawaab (of) the Moabites, and gadawad (bands) of the ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon), and shalach (send) them against Yahawadah (Judah) to abad (destroy/perish) it, according to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, which he dabar (word / matter) by his ibad (servant) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy).

Surely at the commandment of Yahawah came this on Yahawadah (Judah), to sawar (remove) them out of his panayam (sight), for the chataah (sin) of Manashah (Manasseh), according to all that he ishah (make),

And also for the naqay (innocent) dam (blood) that he shapak (shed); for he malaa (filled) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) with naqay (innocent) dam (blood): and Yahawah would not salach (forgive/pardon/make clean).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim), and all that he ishah (make), aren't they kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabar (word / matter) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah)?
So Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) shakab (slept) with his ab (father); and Yahawayakayan (Jehoiachin) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

The malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt) didn't yatzaa (go out / come out) again out of his aratz (Earth/land) any more; for the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) had laqach (take / seized), from the brook of Matzarayam (Egypt) to the nachal (stream / river) Parath (Euphrates), all that pertained to the malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt).

Yahawayakayan (Jehoiachin) was eighteen shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) shalawash (three) chadash (month): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Nachashathaa (Nehushta) the bath (daughter) of Alanathan (Elnathan) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, according to all that his ab (father) ishah (make) done.
At that ith (time) the ibad (servant) of Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) ilah (go up / offer) up to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and the iyar (city) was bawaa (come).
Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) bawaa (come) to the iyar (city), while his ibad (servant) were tzawar (besieging) it;

And Yahawayakayan (Jehoiachin) the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) yatzaa (go out / come out) out to the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), he, and his am (mother), and his ibad (servant), and his shar (prince / ruler), and his sarayas (officers): and the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) laqach (take / seized) him in the shamanah (eighth) shanah (year) of his malak (king).

He yatzaa (go out / come out) out there all the awatzar (treasures) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and the awatzar (treasures) of the malak (king) bayath (house), and qatzatz (cut) in pieces all the kalay (vessels) of zahab (gold), which Shalamah (Solomon) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) ishah (make) made in the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah, as Yahawah had dabar (word / matter).

He galah (carried) away all Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and all the shar (prince / ruler), and all the gabawar (mighty) men of valor, even ishar (ten) alap (thousand) galah (captives), and all the craftsmen and the masagar (smiths); none shaar (remained), except the poorest sort of the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land).

He galah (carried) away Yahawayakayan (Jehoiachin) to Babal (Babylon); and the malak (king) am (mother), and the malak (king) wives, and his sarayas (officers), and the chief men of the aratz (Earth/land), yalak (carried) he into gawalah (captivity) from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to Babal (Babylon).

All the ayash (husband/individual man) of chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), even shabai (seven) alap (thousand), and the craftsmen and the masagar (smiths) one alap (thousand), all of them gabawar (strong) and ishah (make) for malachamah (war), even them the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) bawaa (come) gawalah (captive) to Babal (Babylon).
The malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) made Mathanayah (Mattaniah), Jehoiachin's dawad (father's) brother, malak (king) is his place, and sabab (changed) his sham (name) to Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah).

Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) was isharayam (twenty) - achad (one) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) achad (one) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Chamawatal (Hamutal) the bath (daughter) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah) of Labanah (Libnah).
He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, according to all that Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) ishah (make) done.

For through the ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah, it happened in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) and Yahawadah (Judah), until he had shalak (cast) them out from his panayam (presence). Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) marad (rebelled) against the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon).

It happened in the thashayaiy (ninth) shanah (year) of his malak (king), in the ishayaray (tenth) chadash (month), in the ishawar (tenth) day of the chadash (month), that Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) bawaa (come), he and all his chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), against Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and chanah (encamped) against it; and they banah (built) dayaq (forts) against it around it.
So the iyar (city) was bawaa (come) to the ishathay (eleven) shanah (year) of malak (king) Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah).
On the thashai (nine) day of the fourth chadash (month) the raib (famine) was severe in the iyar (city), so that there was no lacham (bread) for the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land).

Then a baqai (breach) was made in the iyar (city), and all the ayash (husband/individual man) of malachamah (war) fled by layal (night) by the darak (way) of the shair (gate) between the two chawamah (walls), which was by the malak (king) gan (garden) (now the Kashaday (Chaldeans) were against the iyar (city) around it); and the king yalak (went) by the darak (way) of the irabah (arabah).

But the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans) radap (pursued) achar (other) the malak (king), and overtook him in the irabah (plains) of Yarayachaw (Jericho); and all his chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) was pawatz (scattered) from him.
Then they thapash (took) the malak (king), and ilah (go up / offer) him up to the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) to Rabalah (Riblah); and they dabar (word / matter) mashapat (judgment) on him.

They shachat (killed) the ban (son) of Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) before his iyan (eye), and iwar (put) out the iyan (eye) of Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah), and asar (bound) him in nachashath (fetters), and bawaa (come) him to Babal (Babylon).

Now in the chamayashay (fifth) chadash (month), on the shabai (seven) day of the chadash (month), which was the nineteenth shanah (year) of malak (king) Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar), malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), bawaa (come) Nabawazaraadan (Nebuzaradan) the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard), a ibad (servant) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

He burnt the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and the malak (king) bayath (house); and all the bayath (house) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), even every gadawal (very great/important/mighty) bayath (house), burnt he with ash (fire).

All the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans), who were with the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard), nathatz (broke) down the chawamah (walls) around Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Nabawazaraadan (Nebuzaradan) the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) galah (carried) away captive the yathar (residue) of the im (people / nation) who were shaar (left) in the iyar (city), and those who napal (fall / be cast down) away, who fell to the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and the yathar (residue) of the hamawan (multitude).
But the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) shaar (left) some of the poorest of the aratz (Earth/land) to karam (work) the vineyards and fields.

The Kashaday (Chaldeans) broke up the imawad (pillar) of nachashath (brass) that were in the bayath (house) of Yahawah and the makawanah (bases) and the bronze yam (sea/waters) that were in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and nashaa (lift) the nachashath (brass) shabar (pieces) to Babal (Babylon).

They laqach (take / seized) away the sayar (pots), the yai (shovels), the mazamarah (snuffers), the kap (spoons), and all the kalay (vessels) of nachashath (brass) with which they sharath (ministered).

The rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) laqach (take / seized) away the machathah (fire) pans, the basins, that which was of zahab (gold), in zahab (gold), and that which was of kasap (silver), in kasap (silver).

The shanayam (two) imawad (pillar), the achad (one) yam (sea/waters), and the makawanah (bases), which Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) made for the bayath (house) of Yahawah, the nachashath (brass) of all these kalay (vessels) was laa (NOT) mashaqal (weight).

The qawamah (height) of the achad (one) imawad (pillar) was eighteen amah (cubits), and a capital of nachashath (brass) was on it; and the qawamah (height) of the capital was shalawash (three) amah (cubits), with shabakah (network) and ramawan (pomegranates) on the capital around it, all of nachashath (brass): and like to these had the shanay (second) imawad (pillar) with shabakah (network).

The rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) laqach (take / seized) Sharayah (Seraiah) the raash (head) kahan (priest), and Tzapanayah (Zephaniah) the mashanah (second) kahan (priest), and the shalawash (three) keepers of the sap (threshold):

And out of the iyar (city) he laqach (take / seized) an sarayas (officer) who paqayad (was) set over the achad (one) of malachamah (war); and chamash (five) achad (one) of those who raah (see) the malak (king) raah (see), who were matzaa (found) in the iyar (city); and the sapar (book), the shar (prince / ruler) of the tzabaa (troop), who tzabaa (troop) the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land); and shashayam (sixty) ayash (husband/individual man) of the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land), who were matzaa (found) in the iyar (city).
Nabawazaraadan (Nebuzaradan) the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) laqach (take / seized) them, and yalak (brought) them to the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) to Rabalah (Riblah).

The malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) nakah (struck) them, and put them to mawath (death) at Rabalah (Riblah) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Chamath (Hamath). So Yahawadah (Judah) was galah (carried) away captive out of his adamah (land).

As for the im (people / nation) who were shaar (left) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah), whom Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) had shaar (left), even over them he made Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam), the ban (son) Shapan (of) Shaphan, governor.

Now when all the shar (prince / ruler) of the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), they and their chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), shamai (hearken / hear) that the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) had made Gadalayah (Gedaliah) governor, they bawaa (come) to Gadalayah (Gedaliah) Matzapah (to) Mizpah, even Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah), and Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah), and Sharayah (Seraiah) the ban (son) of Thanachamath (Tanhumeth) the Natapathay (Netophathite), and Yaazanayah (Jaazaniah) the ban (son) of the Maikathay (Maacathite), they and their chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor).

Gadalayah (Gedaliah) shabai (swear / take oath) to them and to their ayash (husband/individual man), and amar (spoke) to them, Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid) because of the ibad (servant) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans). Yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the aratz (Earth/land), and ibad (servant) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and it shall be yatab (well) with you.

But it happened in the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month), that Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah), the ban (son) of Alayashamai (Elishama), of the malawakah (royal) zarai (seed) bawaa (come), and ishar (ten) ban (son) with him, and nakah (struck) Gadalayah (Gedaliah), so that he mawath (death), and the Yahawaday (Jews) and the Kashaday (Chaldeans) that were Matzapah (with) him at Mizpah.

All the im (people / nation), both qatan (small/young/least) and gadawal (very great/important/mighty), and the shar (prince / ruler) of the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), qawam (rise up), and bawaa (come) to Matzarayam (Egypt); for they were yaraa (fear / be afraid) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans).

It happened in the shalawashayam (thirty) shabai (seven) shanah (year) of the galawath (captivity) of Yahawayakayan (Jehoiachin) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), in the shanayam (two) chadash (month), on the shabai (seven) and isharayam (twenty) day of the chadash (month), that awayalamaradak (evilmerodach) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), in the shanah (year) that he began to malak (king), nashaa (lift) up the raash (head) of Yahawayakayan (Jehoiachin) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) out of bayath (house);
And he dabar (word / matter) tawab (pleasant/functional) to him, and nathan (give) his kasaa (throne) above the kasaa (throne) of the malak (king) who were with him in Babal (Babylon),
And shanaa (hate) his kalaa (prison) bagad (garments). Jehoiachin akal (eat) lacham (bread) panayam (before) him continually all the yawam (day) of his chay (life):

And for his arachah (allowance), there was a thamayad (continual) arachah (allowance) nathan (give) him of the malak (king), every yawam (day) a dabar (word / matter), all the yawam (day) of his chay (life).
Adam (Adam), Shath (Seth), Anawash (Enosh),
Qayanan (Kenan), Mahalalaal (Mahalalel), Yarad (Jared),
Chanawak (Enoch), Mathawashalach (Methuselah), Lamak (Lamech),
Nach (Noah), Sham (Shem), Cham (Ham), and Yapath (Japheth).
The ban (son) of Yapath (Japheth): Gamar (Gomer), and Magawag (Magog), and Maday (Madai), and Yawan (Javan), and Thawabal (Tubal), and Mashak (Meshech), and Thayaras (Tiras).
The ban (son) of Gamar (Gomer): Ashakanaz (Ashkenaz), and Rayapath (Diphath), and Thawagaramah (Togarmah).
The ban (son) of Yawan (Javan): Alayashah (Elishah), and Tharashayash (Tarshish), Kathay (Kittim), and Dadanayam (Rodanim).
The ban (son) of Cham (Ham): Kawash (Cush), and Matzarayam (Mizraim), Pawat (Put), and Kanain (Canaan).

The ban (son) of Kawash (Cush): Sabaa (Seba), and Chawayalah (Havilah), and Sabathaa (Sabta), and Raimah (Raama), and Sabathakaa (Sabteca). The ban (son) of Raimah (Raamah): Shabaa (Sheba), and Dadan (Dedan).
Kawash (Cush) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Namarawad (Nimrod); he chalal (began) to be a gabawar (mighty) one in the aratz (Earth/land).
Matzarayam (Mizraim) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Lawaday (Ludim), and inamayam (anamim), and lahabayam (lehabim), and Naphtuhim,
And patharasay (pathrusim), and kasalachayam (casluhim) (where the Palashathay (Philistines) yatzaa (go out / come out) from), and Kapatharay (Caphtorim).
Kanain (Canaan) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Tzayadawan (Sidon) his bakawar (firstborn), and Chath (Heth),
And the Yabawasay (Jebusite), and the Amaray (Amorite), and the Garagashay (Girgashite),
And the Chaway (Hivite), and the iraqay (arkite), and the sayanay (sinite),
And the arawaday (arvadite), and the tzamaray (zemarite), and the chamathay (hamathite).

The ban (son) of Sham (Shem): Iyalam (Elam), and Ashawar (Asshur), and Arapakashad (Arpachshad), and Lawad (Lud), and Aram (Aram), and Iwatz (Uz), and Chawal (Hul), and Gathar (Gether), and Mashak (Meshech).
Arapakashad (Arpachshad) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Shalach (Shelah), and Shalach (Shelah) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Ibar (Eber).

To Ibar (Eber) were yalad (birth / begot) shanayam (two) ban (son): the sham (name) of the achad (one) was Palag (Peleg); for in his yawam (day) the aratz (Earth/land) was palag (divided); and his ach (brother/kinsman) sham (name) was Yaqatan (Joktan).
Yaqatan (Joktan) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Alamawadad (Almodad), and Shalap (Sheleph), and Chatzaramawath (Hazarmaveth), and Yarach (Jerah),
And Hadawaram (Hadoram), and Awazal (Uzal), and Daqalah (Diklah),
And Iyabal (Ebal), and Abayamaal (Abimael), and Shabaa (Sheba),
And Awapayar (Ophir), and Chawayalah (Havilah), and Yawabab (Jobab). All these were the ban (son) of Yaqatan (Joktan).
Sham (Shem), Arapakashad (Arpachshad), Shalach (Shelah),
Ibar (Eber), Palag (Peleg), Raiw (Reu),
Sharawag (Serug), Nachawar (Nahor), Tharach (Terah),
Abaram (Abram) (the same is Abaraham (Abraham)).
The ban (son) of Abaraham (Abraham): Yatzachaq (Isaac), and Yashamaial (Ishmael).
These are their thawaladah (generation): the bakawar (firstborn) of Yashamaial (Ishmael), Nabayawath (Nebaioth); then Qadar (Kedar), and Adabaal (Adbeel), and Mabasham (Mibsam),
Mashamai (Mishma), and Dawamah (Dumah), Mashaa (Massa), Chadad (Hadad), and Thayamaa (Tema),
Yatawar (Jetur), Napayash (Naphish), and Qadamah (Kedemah). These are the ban (son) of Yashamaial (Ishmael).

The ban (son) of Qatawarah (Keturah), Abaraham (Abraham's) payalagash (concubine): she yalad (birth / begot) Zamaran (Zimran), and Yaqashan (Jokshan), and Madan (Medan), and Madayan (Midian), and Yashabaq (Ishbak), and Shawach (Shuah). The ban (son) of Yaqashan (Jokshan): Shabaa (Sheba), and Dadan (Dedan).
The ban (son) of Madayan (Midian): Iyapah (Ephah), and Ipar (Epher), and Chanawak (Hanoch), and Abayadai (Abida), and Aladaih (Eldaah). All these were the ban (son) of Qatawarah (Keturah).
Abaraham (Abraham) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Yatzachaq (Isaac). The ban (son) of Yatzachaq (Isaac): Ishaw (Esau), and Yasharaal (Israel).
The ban (son) of Ishaw (Esau): Alayapaz (Eliphaz), Raiwaal (Reuel), and Yaiwash (Jeush), and Yailam (Jalam), and Qarach (Korah).
The ban (son) of Alayapaz (Eliphaz): Thayaman (Teman), and Awamar (Omar), Tzapaw (Zephi), and Gaitham (Gatam), Qanaz (Kenaz), and Thamanai (Timna), and Imalaq (Amalek).
The ban (son) of Raiwaal (Reuel): Nachath (Nahath), Zarach (Zerah), Shamah (Shammah), and Mazah (Mizzah).
The ban (son) of Shaiyar (Seir): Lawatan (Lotan), and Shawabal (Shobal), and Tzabaiwan (Zibeon), and Inah (Anah), and Dayashawan (Dishon), and Atzar (Ezer), and Dayashan (Dishan).
The ban (son) of Lawatan (Lotan): Charay (Hori), and Hawamam (Homam); and Thamanai (Timna) was Lawatan (Lotan's) achawath (sister).
The ban (son) of Shawabal (Shobal): Ilawan (Alian), and Manachath (Manahath), and Iyabal (Ebal), Shapaw (Shephi), and Awanam (Onam). The ban (son) of Tzabaiwan (Zibeon): Ayah (Aiah), and Inah (Anah).
The ban (son) of Inah (Anah): Dayashawan (Dishon). The ban (son) of Dayashawan (Dishon): Chamaran (Hamran), and Ashaban (Eshban), and Yatharan (Ithran), and Karan (Cheran).
The ban (son) of Atzar (Ezer): Balahan (Bilhan), and Zaiwan (Zaavan), Yaiqan (Jaakan). The ban (son) of Dishan: Iwatz (Uz), and Aran (Aran).

Now these are the malak (king) who malak (king) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Adam (Edom), panayam (before) there malak (king) any malak (king) over the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel): Balai (Bela) the ban (son) of Baiwar (Beor); and the sham (name) of his iyar (city) was Danahabah (Dinhabah).
Balai (Bela) mawath (death), and Yawabab (Jobab) the ban (son) of Zarach (Zerah) of Batzarah (Bozrah) malak (king) in his place.
Yawabab (Jobab) mawath (death), and Chawasham (Husham) of the aratz (Earth/land) of the thayamanay (temanites) malak (king) in his place.

Chawasham (Husham) mawath (death), and Hadad (Hadad) the ban (son) of Badad (Bedad), who nakah (struck) Madayan (Midian) in the shadah (field) of Mawaab (Moab), malak (king) in his place; and the sham (name) of his iyar (city) was Iwayath (Avith).
Hadad (Hadad) mawath (death), and Shamalah (Samlah) of Masharaqah (Masrekah) malak (king) in his place.
Shamalah (Samlah) mawath (death), and Shaawal (Shaul) of Rachabawath (Rehoboth) by the nahar (river) malak (king) in his place.
Shaawal (Shaul) mawath (death), and Bailachanan (Baal) Hanan the ban (son) of Ikabawar (Achbor) malak (king) in his place.

Bailachanan (Baal) Hanan mawath (death), and Hadad (Hadad) malak (king) in his place; and the sham (name) of his iyar (city) was Paiw (Pai): and his ashah (wife/individual woman) sham (name) was Mahayatabaal (Mehetabel), the bath (daughter) of Matarad (Matred), the bath (daughter) of Mayazahab (Mezahab).
Hadad (Hadad) mawath (death). The chiefs of Adam (Edom) were: chief Thamanai (Timna), chief Ilawah (Aliah), chief Yathath (Jetheth),
Chief Ahalayabamah (Oholibamah), chief Alah (Elah), chief Payanan (Pinon),
Chief Qanaz (Kenaz), chief Thayaman (Teman), chief Mabatzar (Mibzar),
Chief Magadayaal (Magdiel), chief Iyaram (Iram). These are the chiefs of Adam (Edom).
These are the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel): Raawaban (Reuben), Shamaiwan (Simeon), Laway (Levi), and Yahawadah (Judah), Yashashakar (Issachar), and Zabawalawan (Zebulun),
Dan (Dan), Yawasap (Joseph), and Banayamayan (Benjamin), Napathalay (Naphtali), Gad (Gad), and Ashar (Asher).

The ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah): Ir (Er), and Awanan (Onan), and Shalah (Shelah); which shalawash (three) were yalad (birth / begot) to him of Shawaia (Shua's) bath (daughter) the Canaanitess. Ir (Er), Yahawadah (Judah's) bakawar (firstborn), was rai (wicked) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah; and he mawath (death) him.
Thamar (Tamar) his kalah (complete / finish) yalad (birth / begot) him Paratz (Perez) and Zarach (Zerah). All the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah) were chamash (five).
The ban (son) of Paratz (Perez): Chatzarawan (Hezron), and Chamawal (Hamul).
The ban (son) of Zarach (Zerah): Zamaray (Zimri), and Ayathan (Ethan), and Hayaman (Heman), and Kalakal (Calcol), and Darai (Dara); chamash (five) of them in all.
The ban (son) of Karamay (Carmi): Ikar (Achar), the troubler of Yasharaal (Israel), who mail (top/above) a trespass in the charam (devoted) thing.
The ban (son) of Ayathan (Ethan): Izarayah (Azariah).
The ban (son) also of Chatzarawan (Hezron), who were yalad (birth / begot) to him: Yarachamaal (Jerahmeel), and Ram (Ram), and Kalawabay (Chelubai).

Ram (Ram) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Imayanadab (Amminadab), and Imayanadab (Amminadab) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Nachashawan (Nahshon), nashayaa (prince) of the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah);
And Nachashawan (Nahshon) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Shalamaa (Salma), and Shalamaa (Salma) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Baiz (Boaz),
And Baiz (Boaz) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Iwabad (Obed), and Iwabad (Obed) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Yashay (Jesse);
And Yashay (Jesse) became the yalad (birth / begot) of his bakawar (firstborn) Alayaab (Eliab), and Abayanadab (Abinadab) the shanay (second), and Shamaia (Shimea) the shalayashay (third),
Nathanaal (Nethanel) the rabayaiy (fourth), Raday (Raddai) the chamayashay (fifth),
Atzam (Ozem) the shashay (sixth), Dawad (David) the shabayaiy (seventh);

And their achawath (sisters) were Tzarawayah (Zeruiah) and Abayagayal (Abigail). The ban (son) of Tzarawayah (Zeruiah): Abayashay (Abishai), and Yawaab (Joab), and Ishahaal (Asahel), shalawash (three).
Abayagayal (Abigail) yalad (birth / begot) Imashaa (Amasa); and the ab (father) of Imashaa (Amasa) was Yathar (Jether) the Yashamaialay (Ishmaelite).

Kalab (Caleb) the ban (son) of Chatzarawan (Hezron) became the yalad (birth / begot) of children of Izawabah (Azubah) his ashah (wife/individual woman), and of Yarayaiwath (Jerioth); and these were her ban (son): Yashar (Jesher), and Shawabab (Shobab), and Aradawan (Ardon).
Izawabah (Azubah) mawath (death), and Kalab (Caleb) laqach (take / seized) to him aparath (ephrath), who yalad (birth / begot) him Chawar (Hur).
Chawar (Hur) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Awaray (Uri), and Awaray (Uri) became the yalad (birth / begot) Batzalaal (of) Bezalel.

Afterward Chatzarawan (Hezron) bawaa (come) in to the bath (daughter) of Makayar (Machir) the ab (father) of Galaid (Gilead), whom he laqach (take / seized) as wife when he was shashayam (sixty) shanah (years) ban (son); and she yalad (birth / begot) him Shagawab (Segub).
Shagawab (Segub) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Yaayar (Jair), who had twenty - three iyar (cities) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Galaid (Gilead).

Gashawar (Geshur) and Aram (Aram) laqach (take / seized) the chawah (town/named location) of Yaayar (Jair) from them, with Qanath (Kenath), and its villages, even shashayam (sixty) iyar (cities). All these were the ban (son) of Makayar (Machir) the ab (father) of Galaid (Gilead).

Achar (other) that Chatzarawan (Hezron) was mawath (death) in Kalabaaparathah (Caleb) Ephrathah, then Abayah (Abijah) Chatzarawan (Hezron's) ashah (wife/individual woman) yalad (birth / begot) him Ashachawar (Ashhur) the ab (father) of Thaqawai (Tekoa).

The ban (son) of Yarachamaal (Jerahmeel) the bakawar (firstborn) of Chatzarawan (Hezron) were Ram (Ram) the bakawar (firstborn), and Bawanah (Bunah), and Aran (Oren), and Atzam (Ozem), Achayah (Ahijah).
Yarachamaal (Jerahmeel) had achar (other) ashah (wife/individual woman), whose sham (name) was Itarah (Atarah); she was the am (mother) of Awanam (Onam).
The ban (son) of Ram (Ram) the bakawar (firstborn) of Yarachamaal (Jerahmeel) were Maitz (Maaz), and Yamayan (Jamin), and Iqar (Eker).
The ban (son) of Awanam (Onam) were Shamay (Shammai), and Yadai (Jada). The ban (son) of Shamay (Shammai): Nadab (Nadab), and Abayashawar (Abishur).
The sham (name) of the ashah (wife/individual woman) of Abayashawar (Abishur) was Abayahayal (Abihail); and she yalad (birth / begot) him Achaban (Ahban), and Mawalayad (Molid).
The ban (son) of Nadab (Nadab): Salad (Seled), and Apayam (Appaim); but Salad (Seled) mawath (death) without ban (son).
The ban (son) of Apayam (Appaim): Yashaiy (Ishi). The ban (son) of Yashaiy (Ishi): Shashan (Sheshan). The ban (son) of Shashan (Sheshan): Achalay (Ahlai).
The ban (son) of Yadai (Jada) the ach (brother/kinsman) of Shamay (Shammai): Yathar (Jether), and Yawanathan (Jonathan); and Yathar (Jether) mawath (death) without ban (son).
The ban (son) of Yawanathan (Jonathan): Palath (Peleth), and Zazaa (Zaza). These were the ban (son) of Yarachamaal (Jerahmeel).
Now Shashan (Sheshan) had no ban (son), but bath (daughter). Shashan (Sheshan) had a ibad (servant), an Matzaray (Egyptian), whose sham (name) was Yarachai (Jarha).
Shashan (Sheshan) nathan (give) his bath (daughter) to Yarachai (Jarha) his ibad (servant) as ashah (wife/individual woman); and she yalad (birth / begot) him Ithay (Attai).
Ithay (Attai) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Nathan (Nathan), and Nathan (Nathan) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Zabad (Zabad),
And Zabad (Zabad) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Apalal (Ephlal), and Apalal (Ephlal) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Iwabad (Obed),
And Iwabad (Obed) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Yahawaa (Jehu), and Yahawaa (Jehu) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Izarayah (Azariah),
And Izarayah (Azariah) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Chalatz (Helez), and Chalatz (Helez) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Alaishah (Eleasah),
And Alaishah (Eleasah) became the yalad (birth / begot) Sasamay (of) Sismai, and Sasamay (Sismai) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Shalawam (Shallum),
And Shalawam (Shallum) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Yaqamayah (Jekamiah), and Yaqamayah (Jekamiah) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Alayashamai (Elishama).

The ban (son) of Kalab (Caleb) the ach (brother/kinsman) of Yarachamaal (Jerahmeel) were Mayashai (Mesha) his bakawar (firstborn), who was the ab (father) of Zayap (Ziph); and the ban (son) of Maraashah (Mareshah) the ab (father) of Chabarawan (Hebron).
The ban (son) of Chabarawan (Hebron): Qarach (Korah), and Thapawach (Tappuah), and Raqam (Rekem), and Shamai (Shema).
Shamai (Shema) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Racham (Raham), the yalad (birth / begot) of Yaraqaim (Jorkeam); and Raqam (Rekem) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Shamay (Shammai).
The ban (son) of Shamay (Shammai) was maiwan (maon); and maiwan (maon) was the ab (father) of Bayathatzawar (Beth) Zur.

Iyapah (Ephah), Kalab (Caleb's) payalagash (concubine), yalad (birth / begot) Charan (Haran), and Mawatzaa (Moza), and Gazaz (Gazez); and Charan (Haran) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Gazaz (Gazez).
The ban (son) Yahaday (of) Jahdai: Ragam (Regem), and Yawatham (Jothan), and Gayashan (Geshan), and Palat (Pelet), and Iyapah (Ephah), and Shaip (Shaaph).
Maikah (Maacah), Kalab (Caleb's) payalagash (concubine), yalad (birth / begot) Shabar (Sheber) and Tharachanah (Tirhanah).

She yalad (birth / begot) also Shaip (Shaaph) the ab (father) of Madamanah (Madmannah), Shawaa (Sheva) the ab (father) Makabanaa (of) Machbena, and the ab (father) Gabaia (of) Gibea; and the bath (daughter) of Kalab (Caleb) was Ikasah (Achsah).
These were the ban (son) of Kalab (Caleb), the ban (son) of Chawar (Hur), the bakawar (firstborn) of Ephrathah: Shawabal (Shobal) the ab (father) of Kiriath Qarayathayairayam (Jearim),
Shalamaa (Salma) the ab (father) of Bayathalacham (Bethlehem), Charap (Hareph) the ab (father) of Bayathagadar (Beth) Gader.
Shawabal (Shobal) the ab (father) of Kiriath Qarayathayairayam (Jearim) had ban (son): Raah (Haroeh), chatzayahamanachawath (half) of the Menuhoth.

The mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of Kiriath Qarayathayairayam (Jearim): The yatharay (ithrites), and the Puthites, and the shamathay (shumathites), and the masharaiy (mishraites); of them yatzaa (go out / come out) the Tzaraiy (Zorathites) and the Ashathaalay (Eshtaolites).

The ban (son) of Shalamaa (Salma): Bayathalacham (Bethlehem), and the Natapathay (Netophathites), Atroth Beth itarawathabayathayawaab (joab), and chatzayahamanachathay (half) of the Manahathites, the tzaraiy (zorites).

The mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of sapar (book) who lived at Yaibatz (Jabez): the tharaithay (tirathites), the shamaithay (shimeathites), the Sucathites. These are the Qayanay (Kenites) who bawaa (come) of Hammath, the ab (father) of the bayath (house) of Rakab (Rechab).

Now these were the ban (son) of Dawad (David), who were yalad (birth / begot) to him in Chabarawan (Hebron): the bakawar (firstborn), Amanawan (Amnon), of Achayanaim (Ahinoam) the yazaraialayath (jezreelitess); the shanay (second), Danayaal (Daniel), Abayagayal (of) Abigail the karamalayath (carmelitess);

The shalayashay (third), Abayashalawam (Absalom) the ban (son) Maikah (of) Maacah the bath (daughter) of Thalamay (Talmai) malak (king) of Gashawar (Geshur); the rabayaiy (fourth), Adanayah (Adonijah) the ban (son) of Chagayath (Haggith);
The chamayashay (fifth), Shapatayah (Shephatiah) of Abayatal (Abital); the shashay (sixth), Yatharaim (Ithream) by Igalah (Eglah) his ashah (wife/individual woman):

Shash (six) were yalad (birth / begot) to him in Chabarawan (Hebron); and there he malak (king) shabai (seven) shanah (years) and shash (six) chadash (month). In Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) he malak (king) shalawashayam (thirty) - shalawash (three) shanah (years);

And these were yalad (birth / begot) to him in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): Shamaia (Shimea), and Shawabab (Shobab), and Nathan (Nathan), and Shalamah (Solomon), arabai (four), of Bathashawai (Bathshua) the bath (daughter) of Imayaal (Ammiel);
And Yabachar (Ibhar), and Alayashamai (Elishama), and Alayapalat (Eliphelet),
And Nagah (Nogah), and Napag (Nepheg), and Yapayai (Japhia),
And Alayashamai (Elishama), and Alayadai (Eliada), and Alayapalat (Eliphelet), thashai (nine).
All these were the ban (son) of Dawad (David), besides the ban (son) of the payalagash (concubines); and Thamar (Tamar) was their achawath (sister).
Shalamah (Solomon's) ban (son) was Rachabaim (Rehoboam), Abayah (Abijah) his ban (son), Asaa (Asa) his ban (son), Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) his ban (son),
Yawaram (Joram) his ban (son), Achazayah (Ahaziah) his ban (son), Yawaash (Joash) his ban (son),
Amatzayah (Amaziah) his ban (son), Izarayah (Azariah) his ban (son), Yawatham (Jotham) his ban (son),
Achaz (Ahaz) his ban (son), Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) his ban (son), Manashah (Manasseh) his ban (son),
Amawan (Amon) his ban (son), Yaashayah (Josiah) his ban (son).

The ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah): the bakawar (firstborn) Yawachanan (Johanan), the shanay (second) Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim), the shalayashay (third) Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah), the rabayaiy (fourth) Shalawam (Shallum).
The ban (son) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim): Yakanayah (Jeconiah) his ban (son), Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) his ban (son).
The ban (son) of Yakanayah (Jeconiah), the Asayar (captive): Shaalathayaal (Shealtiel) his ban (son),
And Malakayaram (Malchiram), and Padayah (Pedaiah), and Shanaatzar (Shenazzar), Yaqamayah (Jekamiah), Hawashamai (Hoshama), and Nadabayah (Nedabiah).

The ban (son) of Padayah (Pedaiah): Zarababal (Zerubbabel), and Shamaiy (Shimei). The ban (son) of Zarababal (Zerubbabel): Mashalam (Meshullam), and Chananayah (Hananiah); and Shalamayath (Shelomith) was their achawath (sister);
And Chashabah (Hashubah), and Ahal (Ohel), and Barakayah (Berechiah), and Chasadayah (Hasadiah), Yawashabachasad (Jushab) Hesed, chamash (five).

The ban (son) of Chananayah (Hananiah): Palatayah (Pelatiah), and Yashaiyah (Jeshaiah); the ban (son) of Rapayah (Rephaiah), the ban (son) of Aranan (Arnan), the ban (son) of Ibadayah (Obadiah), the ban (son) of Shakanayah (Shecaniah).

The ban (son) of Shakanayah (Shecaniah): Shamaiyah (Shemaiah). The ban (son) of Shamaiyah (Shemaiah): Chatawash (Hattush), and Yagaal (Igal), and Barayach (Bariah), and Nairayah (Neariah), and Shapat (Shaphat), shash (six).
The ban (son) of Nairayah (Neariah): Alayahawaiyanay (Elioenai), and Chazaqayah (Hizkiah), and Izarayaqam (Azrikam), shalawash (three).

The ban (son) Alayahawaiyanay (of) Elioenai: Hawadayawahaw (Hodaviah), and Alayashayab (Eliashib), and Palayah (Pelaiah), and Iqawab (Akkub), and Yawachanan (Johanan), and Dalayah (Delaiah), and Inanay (Anani), shabai (seven).
The ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah): Paratz (Perez), Chatzarawan (Hezron), and Karamay (Carmi), and Chawar (Hur), and Shawabal (Shobal).

Raayah (Reaiah) the ban (son) of Shawabal (Shobal) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Yachath (Jahath); and Yachath (Jahath) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Achawamay (Ahumai) and Lahad (Lahad). These are the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Tzaraiy (Zorathites).

These were the sons of the ab (father) of Iyatam (Etam): Yazaraial (Jezreel), and Yashamaa (Ishma), and Yadabash (Idbash); and the sham (name) of their achawath (sister) was Tzalalapawanay (Hazzelelponi);

And Panawaal (Penuel) the ab (father) of Gadar (Gedor), and Izar (Ezer) the ab (father) of Chawashah (Hushah). These are the ban (son) of Chawar (Hur), the bakawar (firstborn) of Ephrathah, the ab (father) of Bayathalacham (Bethlehem).
Ashachawar (Ashhur) the ab (father) of Thaqawai (Tekoa) had shanayam (two) wives, Chalaah (Helah) and Nairah (Naarah).
Nairah (Naarah) yalad (birth / begot) him Achazam (Ahuzzam), and Chapar (Hepher), and Thayamanay (Temeni), and Achashatharay (Haahashtari). These were the ban (son) of Nairah (Naarah).
The ban (son) of Chalaah (Helah) were Tzarath (Zereth), Izhar, and Athanan (Ethnan).
Qawatz (Hakkoz) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Inawab (Anub), and Tzababah (Zobebah), and the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of Acharachal (Aharhel) the ban (son) of Haram (Harum).
Yaibatz (Jabez) was more honorable than his ach (brother/kinsman): and his am (mother) sham (name) him Yaibatz (Jabez), amar (spoke), Because I yalad (birth / begot) him with itzab (sorrow).

Yaibatz (Jabez) qaraa (called) on the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), amar (spoke), "Oh that you would barak (bless) me barak (indeed), and rabah (enlarge) my gabawal (border/boundary), and that your yad (hand) might be with me, and that you would ishah (make) me from rai (evil), that it not be to my sorrow!" Alahayam bawaa (come) him that which he shaal (requested).
Kalawab (Chelub) the ach (brother/kinsman) Shawachah (of) Shuhah became the yalad (birth / begot) of Machayar (Mehir), who was the ab (father) of Ashathawan (Eshton).

Ashathawan (Eshton) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Bayatharapaa (Beth) Rapha, and Pasach (Paseah), and Thachanah (Tehinnah) the ab (father) Iyaranachash (of) Ir Nahash. These are the ayash (husband/individual man) of Recah.
The ban (son) of Qanaz (Kenaz): Ithanayaal (Othniel), and Sharayah (Seraiah). The ban (son) of Ithanayaal (Othniel): Chathath (Hathath).

Maiwanathay (Meonothai) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Iparah (Ophrah): and Sharayah (Seraiah) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Yawaab (Joab) the ab (father) of Ge Charashayam (Harashim); for they were craftsmen.
The ban (son) of Kalab (Caleb) the ban (son) of Yapanah (Jephunneh): Iyaraw (Iru), Alah (Elah), and Naim (Naam); and the ban (son) of Alah (Elah); and Qanaz (Kenaz).
The ban (son) Yahalalaal (of) Jehallelel: Zayap (Ziph), and Zayapah (Ziphah), Thayarayaa (Tiria), and Asharaal (Asarel).

The ban (son) of Izarah (Ezrah): Yathar (Jether), and Marad (Mered), and Ipar (Epher), and Yalawan (Jalon); and she bore Marayam (Miriam), and Shamay (Shammai), and Yashabach (Ishbah) the ab (father) of Ashathamai (Eshtemoa).

His ashah (wife/individual woman) the Jewess yalad (birth / begot) Yarad (Jered) the ab (father) of Gadar (Gedor), and Chabar (Heber) the ab (father) of Shawakah (Soco), and Yaqawathayaal (Jekuthiel) the ab (father) of Zanawach (Zanoah). These are the ban (son) of Bathayah (Bithiah) the bath (daughter) of Paraih (Pharaoh), whom Marad (Mered) laqach (take / seized).

The ban (son) of the ashah (wife/individual woman) of Hawadayah (Hodiah), the achawath (sister) of Nacham (Naham), were the ab (father) of Qaiyalah (Keilah) the garamay (garmite), and Ashathamai (Eshtemoa) the Maikathay (Maacathite).

The ban (son) of Shayamawan (Shimon): Amanawan (Amnon), and Ranah (Rinnah), Banachanan (Ben) Hanan, and Thawalawan (Tilon). The ban (son) of Yashaiy (Ishi): Zawachath (Zoheth), and Ben Zawachath (Zoheth).

The ban (son) of Shalah (Shelah) the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah): Ir (Er) the ab (father) of Lakah (Lecah), and Laidah (Laadah) the ab (father) of Maraashah (Mareshah), and the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the bayath (house) of those who ibadah (worked) bawatz (fine) linen, of the bayath (house) of Ashabai (Ashbea);

And Yawaqayam (Jokim), and the ayash (husband/individual man) Kazabaa (of) Cozeba, and Yawaash (Joash), and Sharap (Saraph), who bail (had) dominion in Mawaab (Moab), and Yashabayalacham (Jashubilehem). The records are ithayaq (ancient).
These were the yatzar (potters), and the yashab (inhabit/dwell) Nataiyam (of) Netaim and Gederah: there they lived with the malak (king) for his malaakah (work).
The ban (son) of Shamaiwan (Simeon): Namawaal (Nemuel), and Yamayan (Jamin), Yarayab (Jarib), Zarach (Zerah), Shaawal (Shaul);
Shalawam (Shallum) his ban (son), Mabasham (Mibsam) his ban (son), Mashamai (Mishma) his ban (son).
The ban (son) of Mashamai (Mishma): Chamawaal (Hammuel) his ban (son), Zakawar (Zaccur) his ban (son), Shamaiy (Shimei) his ban (son).

Shamaiy (Shimei) had sixteen ban (son) and shash (six) bath (daughter); but his ach (brother/kinsman) didn't rab (have) many ban (son), neither did all their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) rabah (multiply) like the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah).
They lived Baarashabai (at) Beersheba, and Mawaladah (Moladah), and Chatzarashawail (Hazarshual),
And at Balahah (Bilhah), and at Itzam (Ezem), and at Thawalad (Tolad),
And at Bathawaal (Bethuel), and at Charamah (Hormah), and at Tzaqalag (Ziklag),

And Bayathahamarakabawath (at) Beth Marcaboth, and Chatzarasawasayam (Hazar) Susim, and Bayathabaraay (at) Beth Biri, and at Shairayam (Shaaraim). These were their iyar (cities) to the malak (king) of Dawad (David).
Their chatzar (villages) were Iyatam (Etam), and Iyan (Ain), Ramawan (Rimmon), and Thakan (Tochen), and Ishan (Ashan), chamash (five) iyar (cities);
And all their chatzar (villages) that were around the same iyar (cities), to Bail (Baal). These were their habitations, and they have their yachash (genealogy).
Mashawabab (Meshobab), and Yamalak (Jamlech), and Yawashah (Joshah) the ban (son) of Amatzayah (Amaziah),
And Yawaal (Joel), and Yahawaa (Jehu) the ban (son) Yawashabayah (of) Joshibiah, the ban (son) of Sharayah (Seraiah), the ban (son) of Ishayaal (Asiel),
And Alayahawaiyanay (Elioenai), and Yaiqabah (Jaakobah), and Yashawachayah (Jeshohaiah), and Ishayah (Asaiah), and Idayaal (Adiel), and Yashayamaal (Jesimiel), and Banayah (Benaiah),
And Zayazaa (Ziza) the ban (son) of Shapaiy (Shiphi), the ban (son) of alawan (allon), the ban (son) of Yadayah (Jedaiah), the ban (son) of Shamaray (Shimri), the ban (son) of Shamaiyah (Shemaiah)—
These bawaa (come) by sham (name) were nashayaa (princes) in their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family): and their ab (father)' bayath (house) paratz (increased) greatly.
They yalak (went) to the mabawaa (entrance) of Gadar (Gedor), even to the mazarach (east) side of the gayaa (valley), to baqash (seek) maraih (pasture) for their tzaan (flocks).

They matzaa (found) shaman (fat) maraih (pasture) and tawab (pleasant/functional), and the aratz (Earth/land) was rachab (wide), and shaqat (quiet), and shalaw (peaceable); for those who lived there panayam (before) were of Cham (Ham).

These kathab (written) by sham (name) bawaa (come) in the yawam (day) of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and nakah (struck) their ahal (tents), and the Meunim who were matzaa (found) there, and charam (destroyed) them utterly to this yawam (day), and lived in their maraih (place); because there was pasture there for their tzaan (flocks).

Some of them, even of the ban (son) of Shamaiwan (Simeon), chamash (five) maah (hundred) ban (son), halak (move) to har (mountain) Shaiyar (Seir), having for their raash (head) Palatayah (Pelatiah), and Nairayah (Neariah), and Rapayah (Rephaiah), and Izayaal (Uzziel), the ban (son) of Yashaiy (Ishi).
They nakah (struck) the shaarayath (remnant) Imalaq (of) the Amalekites who palayatah (escaped), and have lived there to this yawam (day).

The ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben) the bakawar (firstborn) of Yasharaal (Israel) (for he was the bakawar (firstborn); but, because he chalal (defiled) his ab (father) yatzawai (couch), his bakawarah (birthright) was nathan (give) to the ban (son) of Yawasap (Joseph) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel); and the yachash (genealogy) is not to be reckoned after the bakawarah (birthright).
For Yahawadah (Judah) gabar (prevailed) above his ach (brother/kinsman), and of him came the nagayad (prince); but the bakawarah (birthright) was Yawasap (Joseph's):)
The ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben) the bakawar (firstborn) of Yasharaal (Israel): Chanawak (Hanoch), and Palawaa (Pallu), Chatzarawan (Hezron), and Karamay (Carmi).
The ban (son) of Yawaal (Joel): Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) his ban (son), Gawag (Gog) his ban (son), Shamaiy (Shimei) his ban (son),
Mayakah (Micah) his ban (son), Raayah (Reaiah) his ban (son), Bail (Baal) his ban (son),
Baarah (Beerah) his ban (son), whom Thagalathapalaasar (Tilgath) Pilneser malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) galah (carried) away captive: he was nashayaa (prince) of the Raawabanay (Reubenites).

His ach (brother/kinsman) by their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family), when the yachash (genealogy) of their thawaladah (generation) was yachash (reckoned): the raash (head), Yaiyaal (Jeiel), and Zakarayah (Zechariah),
And Balai (Bela) the ban (son) of Izaz (Azaz), the ban (son) of Shamai (Shema), the ban (son) of Yawaal (Joel), who lived in Irawair (Aroer), even to Nabaw (Nebo) and Bailamaiwan (Baal) Meon:

And eastward he lived even to the entrance of the madabar (wilderness) from the nahar (river) Parath (Euphrates), because their livestock were rabah (multiplied) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Galaid (Gilead).

In the yawam (day) of Shaawal (Saul), they ishah (make) malachamah (war) with the Hagaray (Hagrites), who napal (fall / be cast down) by their yad (hand); and they lived in their ahal (tents) throughout all the land mazarach (east) of Galaid (Gilead).
The ban (son) of Gad (Gad) lived over against them, in the aratz (Earth/land) of Bashan (Bashan) Salakah (to) Salecah:
Yawaal (Joel) the raash (head), and Shapam (Shapham) the mashanah (second), and Yainay (Janai), and Shapat (Shaphat) in Bashan (Bashan).

Their ach (brother/kinsman) of their ab (father)' bayath (house): Mayakaal (Michael), and Mashalam (Meshullam), and shabai (sheba), and Yawaray (Jorai), and Yaikan (Jacan), and Zayai (Zia), and Ibar (Eber), shabai (seven).

These were the ban (son) of Abayahayal (Abihail), the ban (son) of Chawaray (Huri), the ban (son) of Yarawach (Jaroah), the ban (son) of Galaid (Gilead), the ban (son) of Mayakaal (Michael), the ban (son) of Yashayashay (Jeshishai), the ban (son) of Yachadaw (Jahdo), the ban (son) of Bawaz (Buz);
Achay (Ahi) the ban (son) of Ibadayaal (Abdiel), the ban (son) of Gawanay (Guni), raash (head) of their ab (father)' bayath (house).
They lived in Galaid (Gilead) in Bashan (Bashan), and in its bath (daughter), and in all the magarash (suburbs) of Sharawan (Sharon), as far as their thawatzaah (borders).

All these were yachash (reckoned) by genealogies in the yawam (day) of Yawatham (Jotham) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and in the yawam (day) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel).

The ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben), and the Gaday (Gadites), and the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh), of valiant ban (son), chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) nashaa (lift) to bear magan (shield) and charab (sword), and to shoot with qashath (bow), and skillful in malachamah (war), were arabaiyam (forty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand) shabai (seven) maah (hundred) and shashayam (sixty), that were yatzaa (go out / come out) to go forth to tzabaa (troop).
They ishah (make) malachamah (war) with the Hagaray (Hagrites), with Yatawar (Jetur), and Napayash (Naphish), and Nawadab (Nodab).

They were izar (helped) against them, and the Hagaray (Hagrites) were nathan (give) into their yad (hand), and all who were with them; for they zaiq (cried) to Alahayam in the malachamah (battle), and he was entreated of them, because they batach (put) their trust in him.

They shabah (took) away their livestock; of their gamal (camels) chamashayam (fifty) alap (thousand), and of tzaan (sheep) two maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) alap (thousand), and of donkeys two alap (thousand), and of adam (men) one maah (hundred) alap (thousand).
For there napal (fall / be cast down) many chalal (slain), because the malachamah (war) was of Alahayam. They lived in their place until the gawalah (captivity).

The ban (son) of the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh) lived in the aratz (Earth/land): they rabah (increased) from Bashan (Bashan) to Bailacharamawan (Baal) Hermon and Shanayar (Senir) and har (mountain) Bailacharamawan (Hermon).

These were the raash (head) of their ab (father)' bayath (house): even Ipar (Epher), and Yashaiy (Ishi), and Alayaal (Eliel), and Izarayaal (Azriel), and Yaramayah (Jeremiah), and Hawadawayah (Hodaviah), and Yachadayaal (Jahdiel), gabawar (mighty) raash (head) of valor, sham (name) raash (head), raash (head) of their ab (father)' bayath (house).

They mail (top/above) against the Alahayam of their ab (father), and zanah (played) the prostitute achar (other) the Alahayam of the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land), whom Alahayam destroyed panayam (before) them.

The Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel) iwar (rouse / awaken) up the rawach (spirit / wind) of Pawal (Pul) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), and the rawach (spirit / wind) of Thagalathapalaasar (Tilgath) Pilneser malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), and he galah (carried) them away, even the Raawabanay (Reubenites), and the Gaday (Gadites), and the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh), and bawaa (come) them to Chalach (Halah), and Chabawar (Habor), and Haraa (Hara), and to the nahar (river) of Gawazan (Gozan), to this yawam (day).
The ban (son) of Laway (Levi): Gershon, Qahath (Kohath), and Mararay (Merari).
The ban (son) of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
The ban (son) of Imaram (Amram): Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The ban (son) of Aaron: Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Eleazar became the ab (father) of Phinehas, Phinehas became the ab (father) of Abishua,
And Abishua became the father of Labanay (Bukki), and Labanay (Bukki) became the father of Uzzi,
And Uzzi became the father of Yaatharay (Zerahiah), and Yaatharay (Zerahiah) became the father of Meraioth,
Meraioth became the father of Qahath (Amariah), and Qahath (Amariah) became the father of Ahitub,
And Ahitub became the father of Abayasap (Zadok), and Abayasap (Zadok) became the father of Ahimaaz,
And Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah, and Azariah became the father of Johanan,
And Johanan became the father of Azariah, (he it is who executed the priest's office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem),
And Azariah became the father of Amariah, and Amariah became the father of Ahitub,
And Ahitub became the father of Zadok, and Zadok became the father of Shallum,
And Shallum became the father of Hilkiah, and Washanay (Hilkiah) became the father of Azariah,
And Azariah became the father of Seraiah, and Seraiah became the father of Jehozadak;
Jehozadak went into captivity, when Yahawah carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
The ban (son) of Kohath were Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
The ban (son) of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Ban (Levites) according to their fathers' households.
Of Gershom: Libni his ban (son), Jahath his ban (son), Zimmah his ban (son),
Joah his ban (son), Iddo his ban (son), Zerah his ban (son), Jeatherai his ban (son).
The ban (son) of Kohath: Amminadab his ban (son), Qarach (Korah) his ban (son), Asayar (Assir) his ban (son),
Elkanah his ban (son), and Ebiasaph his ban (son), and Assir his ban (son),
Tahath his ban (son), Uriel his ban (son), Uzziah his ban (son), and Shaul his ban (son).
The ban (son) of Elkanah: Amasai, and Ahimoth.
As for Athanay (Elkanah), the ban (son) of Athanay (Elkanah): Zophai his ban (son), and Nahath his ban (son),
Eliab his ban (son), Jeroham his ban (son), Elkanah his ban (son).
The ban (son) of Samuel: the ban (son) Joel, and the second Abijah.
The ban (son) of Mararay (Merari): Mahli, Libni his ban (son), Shimei his ban (son), Uzzah his ban (son),
Shimea his ban (son), Haggiah his ban (son), Asaiah his ban (son).
These are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of Yahawah, after that the ark had rest.
They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, until Solomon had built the house of Yahawah in Jerusalem: and they waited on their office according to their order.
These are those who waited, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
The ban (son) of Elkanah, the ban (son) of Jeroham, the ban (son) of Eliel, the ban (son) of Toah,
The ban (son) of Zuph, the ban (son) of Elkanah, the ban (son) of Mahath, the ban (son) of Amasai,
The ban (son) of Elkanah, the ban (son) of Joel, the ban (son) of Azariah, the ban (son) of Zephaniah,
The ban (son) of Tahath, the ban (son) of Assir, the ban (son) of Ebiasaph, the ban (son) of Korah,
The ban (son) of Izhar, the ban (son) of Kohath, the ban (son) of Levi, the ban (son) of Israel.
His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the ban (son) of Berechiah, the ban (son) of Shimea,
The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
The ban (son) of Ethni, the ban (son) of Zerah, the ban (son) of Adaiah,
The ban (son) of Ethan, the ban (son) of Zimmah, the ban (son) of Shimei,
The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
The ban (son) of Amzi, the ban (son) of Bani, the ban (son) of Shemer,
The ban (son) of Mahli, the ban (son) of Mushi, the ban (son) of Merari, the ban (son) of Levi.
Their brothers the Ban (Levites) were ban (son) for all the service of the tabernacle of the house of Alahayam.

But Aaron and his ban (son) nathan (give) on the altar of burnt nathan (give), and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Yasharaal (Israel), according to all that Moses the ban (son) of Alahayam had commanded.
These are the ban (son) of Aaron: Eleazar his ban (son), Phinehas his ban (son), Abishua his ban (son),
Bukki his ban (son), Uzzi his ban (son), Zerahiah his ban (son),
Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),
To them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and its magarash (suburbs) around it;
But the fields of the city, and its villages, they gave to Caleb the ban (son) of Jephunneh.
To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron; Libnah also with its magarash (suburbs), and Jattir, and Eshtemoa with its magarash (suburbs),
And Hilen with its magarash (suburbs), Debir with its magarash (suburbs),
And Ashan with its magarash (suburbs), and Beth Shemesh with its magarash (suburbs);

And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its magarash (suburbs), and Allemeth with its magarash (suburbs), and Anathoth with its magarash (suburbs). All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the matah (staff / rod / tribe), out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.

To the ban (son) of Gershom, according to their families, out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Issachar, and out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Asher, and out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Naphtali, and out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Raawaban (Reuben), and out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Gad, and out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Zebulun, twelve cities.
The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their magarash (suburbs).

They gave by lot out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the children of Judah, and out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the children of Simeon, and out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.
Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.

They nathan (give) to them the iyar (cities) of maqalat (refuge), Shakam (Shechem) in the har (mountain) country of Aparayam (Ephraim) with its magarash (suburbs); Gazar (Gezer) also with its magarash (suburbs),
And Yaqamaim (Jokmeam) with its magarash (suburbs), and Bayathachawarawan (Beth) Horon with its magarash (suburbs),
And Ayalawan (Aijalon) with its magarash (suburbs), and Gatharamawan (Gath) Rimmon with its magarash (suburbs);

And out of the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh), Inar (Aner) with its magarash (suburbs), and Balaim (Bileam) with its magarash (suburbs), for the yathar (rest) of the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the ban (son) of Qahath (Kohath).

To the ban (son) of Garasham (Gershom) were given, out of the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh), Gawalan (Golan) in Bashan (Bashan) with its magarash (suburbs), and Ishatharawath (Ashtaroth) with its magarash (suburbs);
And out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Yashashakar (Issachar), Qadash (Kedesh) with its magarash (suburbs), dabarath (daberath) with its magarash (suburbs),
And Raamawath (Ramoth) with its magarash (suburbs), and Inam (Anem) with its magarash (suburbs);
And out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Ashar (Asher), Mashal (Mashal) with its magarash (suburbs), and Ibadawan (Abdon) with its magarash (suburbs),
And chaqaq (hukok) with its magarash (suburbs), and Rachab (Rehob) with its magarash (suburbs);

And out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Napathalay (Naphtali), Qadash (Kedesh) in Galayal (Galilee) with its magarash (suburbs), and Chamawan (Hammon) with its magarash (suburbs), and Qarayathayam (Kiriathaim) with its magarash (suburbs).

To the yathar (rest) of the Levites, the ban (son) of Mararay (Merari), were given, out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Zabawalawan (Zebulun), Ramawan (Rimmono) with its magarash (suburbs), Thabawar (Tabor) with its magarash (suburbs);

And ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) at Yarayachaw (Jericho), on the east ibar (side) of the Yaradan (Jordan), were given them, out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Raawaban (Reuben), Batzar (Bezer) in the madabar (wilderness) with its magarash (suburbs), and Yahatz (Jahzah) with its magarash (suburbs),
And Qadamawath (Kedemoth) with its magarash (suburbs), and Mawapaith (Mephaath) with its magarash (suburbs);
And out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Gad (Gad), Raamawath (Ramoth) in Galaid (Gilead) with its magarash (suburbs), and Machanayam (Mahanaim) with its magarash (suburbs),
And Chashabawan (Heshbon) with its magarash (suburbs), and Yaizayar (Jazer) with its magarash (suburbs).
Of the ban (son) of Yashashakar (Issachar): Thawalai (Tola), and Pawaah (Puah), Yashawab (Jashub), and Shamarawan (Shimron), arabai (four).
