Shatan (satan) imad (stood) up against Yasharaal (Israel), and sawath (moved) Dawad (David) to manah (number) Yasharaal (Israel).

Dawad (David) amar (spoke) to Yawaab (Joab) and to the shar (prince / ruler) of the im (people / nation), yalak (go), sapar (book) Yasharaal (Israel) Baarashabai (from) Beersheba Dan (even) to Dan; and bawaa (come) me word, that I may yadai (know) the sum of them.

Yawaab (Joab) amar (spoke), May Yahawah make his im (people / nation) a maah (hundred) paim (times) as many as they are. But, my Adawan the malak (king), aren't they all my adawan (master / lord) ibad (servant)? Why does my Adawan baqash (require) this thing? Why will he be a cause of ashamah (guilt) to Yasharaal (Israel)?

Nevertheless the malak (king) dabar (word / matter) chazaq (prevailed) against Yawaab (Joab). Therefore Yawaab (Joab) departed, and halak (move) throughout all Yasharaal (Israel), and bawaa (come) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Yawaab (Joab) nathan (give) up the sum of the mapaqad (numbering) of the im (people / nation) to Dawad (David). All those of Yasharaal (Israel) were alap (one) million one maah (hundred) alap (thousand) ayash (husband/individual man) who shalap (drew) charab (sword): and in Yahawadah (Judah) were arabai (four) maah (hundred) shabaiyam (seventy) alap (thousand) ayash (husband/individual man) who shalap (drew) charab (sword).
But he didn't paqad (visit) Laway (Levi) and Banayamayan (Benjamin) thawak (midst) them; for the malak (king) dabar (word / matter) was thaib (abominable) to Yawaab (Joab).
Alahayam was displeased with this thing; therefore he nakah (struck) Yasharaal (Israel).

Dawad (David) amar (spoke) to Alahayam, I have chataa (sinned) maad (greatly), in that I ishah (make) done this thing. But now, ibar (pass over/through) away, I beg you, the iwan (guilt/iniquity) of your ibad (servant); for I have done very foolishly.
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Gad (Gad), Dawad (David's) chazah (seer), amar (spoke),

Yalak (go) and dabar (word / matter) to Dawad (David), amar (spoke), ‘Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, "I natah (offer) you shalawash (three) things. Bachar (choose) achad (one) of them, that I may ishah (make) it to you."’
So Gad (Gad) bawaa (come) to Dawad (David), and amar (spoke) to him, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, ‘qabal (take) your choice:

Either shalawash (three) shanah (years) of raib (famine); or shalawash (three) chadash (month) to be sapah (consumed) panayam (before) your tzar (oppressor / distressor), while the charab (sword) of your ayab (enemy) nashag (overtakes) you; or else shalawash (three) yawam (day) the charab (sword) of Yahawah, even dabar (word / matter) in the aratz (Earth/land), and the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah shachath (destroying) throughout all the gabawal (border/boundary) of Yasharaal (Israel). Now therefore raah (see) dabar (word / matter) answer I shall shawab (turn back / repent) to him who shalach (send) me.’

Dawad (David) amar (spoke) to Gad (Gad), I am in tzar (oppressor / distressor). Napal (fall / be cast down) me fall, I pray, into the yad (hand) of Yahawah; for his racham (mercies) are very rab (great). Napal (fall / be cast down) me not fall into the yad (hand) of adam (man).
So Yahawah nathan (give) a dabar (word / matter) on Yasharaal (Israel); and shabaiyam (seventy) alap (thousand) ayash (husband/individual man) of Yasharaal (Israel) napal (fall / be cast down).

Alahayam shalach (send) an malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to shachath (destroy) it. As he was about to shachath (destroy), Yahawah raah (see), and he relented of the disaster, and amar (spoke) to the shachath (destroying) malaak (angel / messenger of Yah), "It is rab (enough); now rapah (stay) your yad (hand)." The malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah was imad (standing) by the garan (threshing) floor of Aranan (Ornan) the Yabawasay (Jebusite).

Dawad (David) nashaa (lift) up his iyan (eye), and raah (see) the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah imad (standing) between aratz (Earth/land) and the sky, having a shalap (drawn) charab (sword) in his yad (hand) natah (stretched) out over Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). Then Dawad (David) and the zaqan (elders), kasah (clothed) in sackcloth, napal (fall / be cast down) on their panayam (faces).

Dawad (David) amar (spoke) to Alahayam, Isn't it I who commanded the im (people / nation) to be manah (numbered)? It is even I who have chataa (sinned) and raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil) very wickedly; but these tzaan (sheep), what ishah (make) they done? Please let your yad (hand), O Yahawah my Alahayam, be against me, and against my ab (father) bayath (house); but not against your im (people / nation), that they should be magapah (plagued).

Then the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah commanded Gad (Gad) to amar (spoke) Dawad (David) that Dawad (David) should ilah (go up / offer) up, and qawam (rise up) an mazabach (altar) to Yahawah in the garan (threshing) floor of Aranan (Ornan) the Yabawasay (Jebusite).
Dawad (David) ilah (go up / offer) up at the dabar (word / matter) of Gad (Gad), which he dabar (word / matter) in the sham (name) of Yahawah.

Aranan (Ornan) shawab (turn back / repent) back, and raah (see) the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah); and his arabai (four) ban (son) who were with him chabaa (hid) themselves. Now Aranan (Ornan) was dawash (threshing) chatah (wheat).

As Dawad (David) bawaa (come) to Aranan (Ornan), Aranan (Ornan) nabat (looked) and nabat (saw) Dawad (David), and yatzaa (go out / come out) out of the garan (threshing) floor, and shachah (bowed) himself to Dawad (David) with his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) to the aratz (Earth/land).

Then Dawad (David) amar (spoke) to Aranan (Ornan), nathan (give) me the maqawam (place) of this garan (threshing) floor, that I may banah (build) thereon an mazabach (altar) to Yahawah. You shall sell it to me for the malaa (full) kasap (price), that the magapah (plague) may be itzar (stopped) from afflicting the im (people / nation).

Aranan (Ornan) amar (spoke) to Dawad (David), laqach (take / seized) it for yourself, and let my Adawan the malak (king) ishah (make) that which is tawab (pleasant/functional) in his iyan (eye). Raah (see), I nathan (give) the oxen for burnt ilah (offerings), and the mawarag (threshing) instruments for itz (wood), and the chatah (wheat) for the meal manachah (offering). I nathan (give) it all.

Malak (king) Dawad (David) amar (spoke) to Aranan (Ornan), No; but I will most certainly qanah (buy) it for the malaa (full) kasap (price). For I will not nashaa (lift) that which is yours for Yahawah, nor ilah (go up / offer) a burnt ilah (offering) chanam (without) cost.
So Dawad (David) nathan (give) to Aranan (Ornan) shash (six) maah (hundred) shaqal (shekels) of zahab (gold) by mashaqal (weight) for the maqawam (place).

Dawad (David) banah (built) an mazabach (altar) to Yahawah there, and ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilah (offerings) and peace ilah (offerings), and qaraa (called) on Yahawah; and he inah (answer / respond) him from the sky by ash (fire) on the mazabach (altar) of burnt ilah (offering).
Yahawah commanded the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah); and he shawab (turn back / repent) up his charab (sword) again into its nadan (sheath).

At that ith (time), when Dawad (David) raah (see) that Yahawah had inah (answer / respond) him in the garan (threshing) floor of Aranan (Ornan) the Yabawasay (Jebusite), then he zabach (sacrificed) there.

For the mashakan (tabernacle) of Yahawah, which Mashah (Moses) ishah (make) in the madabar (wilderness), and the mazabach (altar) of burnt ilah (offering), were at that ith (time) in the bamah (high) place at Gabaiwan (Gibeon).

But Dawad (David) couldn't yalak (go) panayam (before) it to darash (inquire) of Alahayam; for he was baith (afraid) panayam (because) of the charab (sword) of the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah.
Then Dawad (David) amar (spoke), This is the bayath (house) of Yahawah Alahayam, and this is the mazabach (altar) of burnt ilah (offering) for Yasharaal (Israel).

Dawad (David) amar (spoke) orders to kanas (gather) together the foreigners who were in the aratz (Earth/land) of Yasharaal (Israel); and he imad (set) chatzab (masons) to chatzab (cut) worked aban (stone) to banah (build) the bayath (house) of Alahayam.

Dawad (David) kawan (prepared) barazal (iron) in rab (abundance) for the masamar (nails) for the dalath (doors) of the shair (gates), and for the machabarah (couplings); and nachashath (brass) in rab (abundance) without mashaqal (weight);
And araz (cedar) itz (trees) without rab (number): for the Tzayadanay (Sidonians) and they of tzaray (tyre) bawaa (come) araz (cedar) itz (trees) in abundance to Dawad (David).

Dawad (David) amar (spoke), "Shalamah (Solomon) my ban (son) is nair (young) and rak (tender), and the bayath (house) that is to be banah (built) for Yahawah must be mail (top/above) magnificent, of sham (name) and of glory throughout all aratz (Earth/land). I will therefore kawan (make) preparation for it." So Dawad (David) kawan (prepared) rab (abundantly) panayam (before) his mawath (death).
Then he qaraa (called) for Shalamah (Solomon) his ban (son), and tzawah (commanded) him to banah (build) a bayath (house) for Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel).
Dawad (David) amar (spoke) to Shalamah (Solomon) his ban (son), As for me, it was in my labab (heart) to banah (build) a bayath (house) to the sham (name) of Yahawah my Alahayam.

But the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to me, amar (spoke), ‘You have shapak (shed) dam (blood) rab (abundantly), and ishah (make) made gadawal (very great/important/mighty) malachamah (wars). You shall not banah (build) a bayath (house) to my sham (name), because you have shapak (shed) much dam (blood) on the aratz (Earth/land) in my panayam (sight).

Behold, a ban (son) shall be yalad (birth / begot) to you, who shall be a ayash (husband/individual man) of manawachah (rest). I will give him nawach (rest) from all his ayab (enemy) all around; for his sham (name) shall be Shalamah (Solomon), and I will nathan (give) shalawam (peace / safety) and shaqat (quietness) to Yasharaal (Israel) in his yawam (day).

He shall banah (build) a bayath (house) for my sham (name); and he shall be my ban (son), and I will be his ab (father); and I will kawan (establish) the kasaa (throne) of his malakawath (kingdom) over Yasharaal (Israel) for iwalam (forever).’
Now, my ban (son), may Yahawah be with you and tzalach (prosper) you, and banah (build) the bayath (house) of Yahawah your Alahayam, as he has dabar (word / matter) concerning you.

May Yahawah nathan (give) you shakal (discretion) and bayanah (understanding), and tzawah (put) you in charge of Yasharaal (Israel); that so you may shamar (keep/guard) the thawarah (instruction) of Yahawah your Alahayam.

Then you will tzalach (prosper), if you shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) the chaq (statute) and the mashapat (ordinances) which Yahawah tzawah (gave) Mashah (Moses) concerning Yasharaal (Israel). Be chazaq (strong), and amatz (courageous). Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid), neither be chathath (dismayed).

Now, behold, in my inay (affliction) I have kawan (prepared) for the bayath (house) of Yahawah one maah (hundred) alap (thousand) kakar (talents) of zahab (gold), alap (one) million kakar (talents) of kasap (silver), and nachashath (brass) and barazal (iron) without mashaqal (weight); for it is in rab (abundance). I have also kawan (prepared) itz (timber) and aban (stone); and you may yasap (add) to them.
There are also workmen with you in rab (abundance), cutters and charash (workers) of aban (stone) and itz (timber), and all kinds of chakam (men) who are skillful in every kind of malaakah (work):
Of the zahab (gold), the kasap (silver), and the nachashath (brass), and the barazal (iron), there is no masapar (number). Qawam (rise up) and be ishah (make), and may Yahawah be with you.
Dawad (David) also tzawah (commanded) all the shar (prince / ruler) of Yasharaal (Israel) to izar (help) Shalamah (Solomon) his ban (son), saying,

Isn't Yahawah your Alahayam with you? Hasn't he given you nawach (rest) on sabayab (surrounding) side? For he nathan (give) delivered the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the aratz (Earth/land) into my yad (hand); and the aratz (Earth/land) is kabash (subdued) panayam (before) Yahawah, and panayam (before) his im (people / nation).

Now nathan (give) your labab (heart) and your napash (living being/soul) to darash (seek) after Yahawah your Alahayam. Qawam (rise up) therefore, and banah (build) the maqadash (sanctuary) of Yahawah Alahayam, to bawaa (come) the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah, and the qadash (set apart/make holy) kalay (vessels) of Alahayam, into the bayath (house) that is to be banah (built) to the sham (name) of Yahawah.
Now Dawad (David) was zaqan (old) and shabai (full) of yawam (day); and he made Shalamah (Solomon) his ban (son) malak (king) over Yasharaal (Israel).
He asap (gathered) together all the shar (prince / ruler) of Yasharaal (Israel), with the kahan (priest) and the Lawayay (Levites).

The Lawayay (Levites) were sapar (book) from shalawashayam (thirty) years old and upward: and their masapar (number) by their galagalath (polls), gabar (man) by gabar (man), was shalawashayam (thirty) - shamanah (eight) alap (thousand).

David said, Of these, isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand) were to natzach (oversee) the malaakah (work) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah; shash (six) alap (thousand) were shatar (officers) and shapat (judges);
Arabai (four) alap (thousand) were shawair (doorkeepers); and arabai (four) alap (thousand) halal (praise) Yahawah with the kalay (instruments) which I ishah (make), for giving halal (praise).
Dawad (David) chalaq (divided) them into machalaqath (divisions) according to the ban (son) of Laway (Levi): Gershon, Qahath (Kohath), and Mararay (Merari).
Of the garashanay (gershonites): Laidan (Ladan) and Shamaiy (Shimei).
The ban (son) Laidan (of) Ladan: Yachayaal (Jehiel) the raash (head), and Zatham (Zetham), and Yawaal (Joel), shalawash (three).
The ban (son) of Shamaiy (Shimei): Shalamawath (Shelomoth), and Chazayaal (Haziel), and Haran (Haran), shalawash (three). These were the raash (head) of the ab (father)' Laidan (households) of Ladan.
The ban (son) of Shamaiy (Shimei): Yachath (Jahath), Zayanaa (Zina), and Yaiwash (Jeush), and Barayaih (Beriah). These arabai (four) were the ban (son) of Shamaiy (Shimei).

Yachath (Jahath) was the raash (head), and Zayazah (Zizah) the shanay (second): but Yaiwash (Jeush) and Barayaih (Beriah) didn't rabah (have) many ban (son); therefore they became a ab (father)' bayath (house) in achad (one) paqadah (reckoning).
The ban (son) of Qahath (Kohath): Imaram (Amram), Yatzahar (Izhar), Chabarawan (Hebron), and Izayaal (Uzziel), arabai (four).

The ban (son) of Imaram (Amram): Aharawan (Aaron) and Mashah (Moses); and Aharawan (Aaron) was badal (separated), that he should qadash (set apart/make holy) the most qadash (set apart/make holy) things, he and his ban (son), iwalam (forever), to qatar (burn) incense panayam (before) Yahawah, to sharath (minister) to him, and to barak (bless) in his sham (name), iwalam (forever).
But as for Mashah (Moses) the ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam, his ban (son) were qaraa (called) among the shabat (tribe) of Laway (Levi).
The ban (son) of Mashah (Moses): Garasham (Gershom) and Alayaizar (Eliezer).
The ban (son) of Garasham (Gershom): Shabawaal (Shebuel) the raash (head).
The ban (son) of Alayaizar (Eliezer) were: Rachabayah (Rehabiah) the raash (head); and Alayaizar (Eliezer) had no other ban (son); but the ban (son) of Rachabayah (Rehabiah) were very many.
The ban (son) of Yatzahar (Izhar): Shalamayath (Shelomith) the raash (head).

The ban (son) of Chabarawan (Hebron): Yarayah (Jeriah) the raash (head), Amarayah (Amariah) the shanay (second), Yachazayaal (Jahaziel) the shalayashay (third), and Yaqamaim (Jekameam) the rabayaiy (fourth).
The ban (son) of Izayaal (Uzziel): Mayakah (Micah) the raash (head), and Yashayah (Isshiah) the shanay (second).
The ban (son) of Mararay (Merari): Machalay (Mahli) and Mawashay (Mushi). The ban (son) of Machalay (Mahli): Alaizar (Eleazar) and Qayash (Kish).
Alaizar (Eleazar) mawath (death), and had no ban (son), but bath (daughter) only: and their ach (brother/kinsman) the ban (son) of Qayash (Kish) nashaa (lift) them as wives.
The ban (son) of Mawashay (Mushi): Machalay (Mahli), and Idar (Eder), and Yarayamawath (Jeremoth), shalawash (three).

These were the ban (son) of Laway (Levi) after their ab (father)' bayath (house), even the raash (head) of the ab (father)' houses of those who were paqad (visit) individually, in the masapar (number) of sham (name) by their galagalath (polls), who ishah (make) the malaakah (work) for the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, from isharayam (twenty) years ban (son) and upward.
For Dawad (David) amar (spoke), Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), has given nawach (rest) to his im (people / nation); and he shakan (dwells) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) iwalam (forever).
Also the Lawayay (Levites) will no longer nashaa (lift) to carry the mashakan (tabernacle) and all its kalay (vessels) for its ibadah (service).
For by the acharawan (last) dabar (word / matter) of Dawad (David) the lawayay (sons) of Levi were masapar (numbered), from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward.

For their maimad (office) was to yad (hand) on the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron) for the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, in the chatzar (courts), and in the rooms, and in the purifying of all qadash (set apart/make holy) things, even the maishah (work) of the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam;

For the show lacham (bread) also, and for the fine salath (flour) for a meal manachah (offering), whether of unleavened raqayaq (wafers), or of that which is baked in the machabath (pan), or of that which is soaked, and for all kinds of mashawarah (measure) and madah (size);
And to imad (stand) every baqar (morning) to yadah (thank) and halal (praise) Yahawah, and likewise in the irab (evening);

And to ilah (go up / offer) all burnt ilah (offerings) to Yahawah, on the shabath (shabath/rest), on the new chadash (month), and on the mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) feasts, in masapar (number) according to the mashapat (ordinance) concerning them, continually panayam (before) Yahawah;

And that they should shamar (keep/guard) the duty of the ahal (tent) of Meeting, and the duty of the qadash (set apart/make holy) place, and the duty of the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron) their ach (brother/kinsman), for the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah.
These were the machalaqath (divisions) of the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron). The ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron): Nadab (Nadab) and Abayahawaa (Abihu), Alaizar (Eleazar) and Ayathamar (Ithamar).

But Nadab (Nadab) and Abayahawaa (Abihu) mawath (death) panayam (before) their ab (father), and had no ban (son): therefore Alaizar (Eleazar) and Ayathamar (Ithamar) executed the kahan (priest) office.

Dawad (David) with Tzadawaq (Zadok) of the ban (son) of Alaizar (Eleazar), and Achayamalak (Ahimelech) of the ban (son) of Ayathamar (Ithamar), chalaq (divided) them according to their paqadah (ordering) in their ibadah (service).

There were more raash (head) gabar (men) matzaa (found) of the ban (son) of Alaizar (Eleazar) than of the ban (son) of Ayathamar (Ithamar); and they were chalaq (divided) like this: of the ban (son) of Alaizar (Eleazar) there were sixteen, raash (head) of ab (father)' bayath (house); and of the ban (son) of Ayathamar (Ithamar), according to their ab (father)' bayath (house), shamanah (eight).

Thus were they chalaq (divided) impartially by drawing gawaral (lots); for there were shar (prince / ruler) of the qadash (set apart/make holy), and shar (prince / ruler) of Alahayam, both of the ban (son) of Alaizar (Eleazar), and of the ban (son) of Ayathamar (Ithamar).

Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) the ban (son) Nathanaal (of) Nethanel the sapar (book), who was of the Lawayay (Levites), kathab (wrote) them in the panayam (presence) of the malak (king), and the shar (prince / ruler), and Tzadawaq (Zadok) the kahan (priest), and Achayamalak (Ahimelech) the ban (son) of Abayathar (Abiathar), and the raash (head) of the ab (father)' households of the kahan (priest) and of the Lawayay (Levites); achad (one) ab (father)' bayath (house) being achaz (taken) for Alaizar (Eleazar), and one achaz (taken) for Ayathamar (Ithamar).
Now the raashawan (first) gawaral (lot) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth to Yahawayarayab (Jehoiarib), the shanay (second) to Yadaiyah (Jedaiah),
The shalayashay (third) to Charam (Harim), the rabayaiy (fourth) to Shairayam (Seorim),
The chamayashay (fifth) to Malakayah (Malchijah), the shashay (sixth) to Mayaman (Mijamin),
The shabayaiy (seventh) to Qawatz (Hakkoz), the shamayanay (eighth) to Abayah (Abijah),
The thashayaiy (ninth) to Yashawai (Jeshua), the ishayaray (tenth) to Shakanayah (Shecaniah),
The ishathay (eleven) to Alayashayab (Eliashib), the shanayam (two) to Yaqayam (Jakim),
The thirteenth to Chapah (Huppah), the fourteenth to Yashabaab (Jeshebeab),
The fifteenth to Balagah (Bilgah), the sixteenth to Amar (Immer),
The seventeenth to Chazayar (Hezir), the eighteenth Patzatz (to) Happizzez,
The nineteenth Pathachayah (to) Pethahiah, the isharayam (twenty) Yachazaqaal (to) Jehezkel,
The isharayam (twenty) - achad (one) to Yakayan (Jachin), the isharayam (twenty) - shanayam (two) to Gamawal (Gamul),
The isharayam (twenty) - shalawash (three) to Dalayah (Delaiah), the isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) to Maizayah (Maaziah).

This was their paqadah (ordering) in their ibadah (service), to bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah according to the mashapat (ordinance) given to them by Aharawan (Aaron) their ab (father), as Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), had tzawah (commanded) him.
Of the yathar (rest) of the ban (son) of Laway (Levi): of the ban (son) of Imaram (Amram), Shabawaal (Shubael); of the ban (son) of Shabawaal (Shubael), Yachadayahaw (Jehdeiah).
Of Rachabayah (Rehabiah): of the ban (son) of Rachabayah (Rehabiah), Yashayah (Isshiah) the raash (head).
Of the yatzaharay (izharites), Shalamawath (Shelomoth); of the ban (son) of Shalamawath (Shelomoth), Yachath (Jahath).
The ban (son) of Hebron: Yarayah (Jeriah), Amarayah (Amariah) the shanay (second), Yachazayaal (Jahaziel) the shalayashay (third), Yaqamaim (Jekameam) the rabayaiy (fourth).
The ban (son) of Izayaal (Uzziel), Mayakah (Micah); of the ban (son) of Mayakah (Micah), Shamawar (Shamir).
The ach (brother/kinsman) of Mayakah (Micah), Yashayah (Isshiah); of the ban (son) of Yashayah (Isshiah), Zakarayah (Zechariah).
The ban (son) of Mararay (Merari): Machalay (Mahli) and Mawashay (Mushi); the ban (son) of Yaizayahaw (Jaaziah): Beno.
The ban (son) of Mararay (Merari): of Yaizayahaw (Jaaziah), Beno, and Shaham (Shoham), and Zakawar (Zaccur), and Ibaray (Ibri).
Of Machalay (Mahli): Alaizar (Eleazar), who had no ban (son).
Of Qayash (Kish); the ban (son) of Qayash (Kish): Yarachamaal (Jerahmeel).
The ban (son) of Mawashay (Mushi): Machalay (Mahli), and Idar (Eder), and Yarayamawath (Jerimoth). These were the ban (son) of the Lawayay (Levites) after their ab (father)' bayath (house).

These likewise napal (fall / be cast down) gawaral (lots) even as their ach (brother/kinsman) the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron) in the panayam (presence) of Dawad (David) the malak (king), and Tzadawaq (Zadok), and Achayamalak (Ahimelech), and the raash (head) of the ab (father)' households of the kahan (priest) and of the Lawayay (Levites); the ab (father)' households of the raash (head) even as those of his younger ach (brother/kinsman).

Moreover, Dawad (David) and the shar (prince / ruler) of the tzabaa (troop) set apart for the ibadah (service) certain of the ban (son) of Asap (Asaph), and of Hayaman (Heman), and of Yadawathawan (Jeduthun), who should nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) with kanawar (harps), with stringed instruments, and with matzalath (cymbals): and the masapar (number) of those who did the work according to their ibadah (service) was:

Of the ban (son) of Asap (Asaph): Zakawar (Zaccur), and Yawasap (Joseph), and Nathanayah (Nethaniah), and Asharaalah (Asharelah), the ban (son) of Asap (Asaph), under the yad (hand) of Asap (Asaph), who nabaa (prophesied) after the yad (hand) of the malak (king).

Of Yadawathawan (Jeduthun); the ban (son) of Yadawathawan (Jeduthun): Gadalayah (Gedaliah), and Tzaray (Zeri), and Yashaiyah (Jeshaiah), Chashabayah (Hashabiah), and Mathathayah (Mattithiah), shash (six), under the yad (hand) of their ab (father) Yadawathawan (Jeduthun) with the kanawar (harp), who nabaa (prophesied) in giving yadah (thanks) and halal (praise) Yahawah.

Of Hayaman (Heman); the ban (son) of Hayaman (Heman): Baqayah (Bukkiah), Mathanayah (Mattaniah), Izayaal (Uzziel), Shabawaal (Shebuel), and Yarayamawath (Jerimoth), Chananayah (Hananiah), Chananay (Hanani), Alayaathah (Eliathah), Gadalathay (Giddalti), and Rawamamathayaizar (Romamti-Ezer), Yashabaqashah (Joshbekashah), Malawathay (Mallothi), Hawathayar (Hothir), Machazayaawath (Mahazioth).

All these were the ban (son) of Hayaman (Heman) the malak (king) chazah (seer) in the dabar (word / matter) of Alahayam, to rawam (will lift up) up the qaran (horn). Alahayam nathan (give) to Hayaman (Heman) fourteen ban (son) and shalawash (three) bath (daughter).

All these were under the yad (hand) of their ab (father) for shayar (song) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, with matzalath (cymbals), stringed instruments, and kanawar (harps), for the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam; Asap (Asaph), Yadawathawan (Jeduthun), and Hayaman (Heman) being under the yad (hand) of the malak (king).

The masapar (number) of them, with their ach (brother/kinsman) who were lamad (teach/instruct) in shayar (song) to Yahawah, even all who were skillful, was two maah (hundred) shamanayam (eighty) - shamanah (eight).

They napal (fall / be cast down) gawaral (lots) for their mashamarath (duty / watch), all alike, as well the qatan (small/young/least) as the gadawal (very great/important/mighty), the teacher as the thalamayad (scholar).

Now the raashawan (first) gawaral (lot) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth for Asap (Asaph) to Yawasap (Joseph): the shanay (second) to Gadalayah (Gedaliah); he and his ach (brother/kinsman) and ban (son) were shanayam (two):
The shalayashay (third) to Zakawar (Zaccur), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
The rabayaiy (fourth) Yatzaray (to) Izri, his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
The chamayashay (fifth) to Nathanayah (Nethaniah), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
The shashay (sixth) to Baqayah (Bukkiah), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
The shabayaiy (seventh) to Yasharaalah (Jesharelah), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
The shamayanay (eighth) to Yashaiyah (Jeshaiah), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
The thashayaiy (ninth) to Mathanayah (Mattaniah), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
The ishayaray (tenth) to Shamaiy (Shimei), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
The ishathay (eleven) Izaraal (to) Azarel, his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
The shanayam (two) to Chashabayah (Hashabiah), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
For the thirteenth, Shabawaal (Shubael), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
For the fourteenth, Mathathayah (Mattithiah), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
For the fifteenth Yarayamawath (to) Jeremoth, his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
For the sixteenth to Chananayah (Hananiah), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
For the seventeenth to Yashabaqashah (Joshbekashah), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
For the eighteenth to Chananay (Hanani), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
For the nineteenth to Malawathay (Mallothi), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
For the isharayam (twenty) to Alayaathah (Eliathah), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
For the achad (one) and isharayam (twenty) to Hawathayar (Hothir), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
For the shanayam (two) and isharayam (twenty) to Gadalathay (Giddalti), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
For the shalawash (three) and isharayam (twenty) to Machazayaawath (Mahazioth), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
For the arabai (four) and isharayam (twenty) to Rawamamathayaizar (Romamti-Ezer), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two).
For the machalaqath (divisions) of the shawair (doorkeepers): of the qarachay (korahites), Mashalamayah (Meshelemiah) the ban (son) of Qawaraa (Kore), of the ban (son) of Asap (Asaph).

Mashalamayah (Meshelemiah) had ban (son): Zakarayah (Zechariah) the bakawar (firstborn), Yadayaial (Jediael) the shanay (second), Zabadayah (Zebadiah) the shalayashay (third), Yathanayaal (Jathniel) the rabayaiy (fourth),
Iyalam (Elam) the chamayashay (fifth), Yahawachanan (Jehohanan) the shashay (sixth), Alayahawaiyanay (Eliehoenai) the shabayaiy (seventh).

Ibadaadawam (Obed-Edom) had ban (son): Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) the bakawar (firstborn), Yahawazabad (Jehozabad) the shanay (second), Yawaach (Joah) the shalayashay (third), and Shakar (Sacar) the rabayaiy (fourth), and Nathanaal (Nethanel) the chamayashay (fifth),
Imayaal (Ammiel) the shashay (sixth), Yashashakar (Issachar) the shabayaiy (seventh), Pailathay (Peullethai) the shamayanay (eighth); for Alahayam barak (blessed) him.
Also to Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) his ban (son) were ban (son) yalad (birth / begot), who mamashal (authority) over the bayath (house) of their ab (father); for they were gabawar (mighty) men of valor.

The ban (son) of Shamaiyah (Shemaiah): Ithanay (Othni), and Rapaal (Rephael), and Iwabad (Obed), Alazabad (Elzabad), whose ach (brother/kinsman) were chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) ban (son), Alayahaw (Elihu), and Samakayahaw (Semachiah).

All these were of the ban (son) of Ibadaadawam (Obed-Edom): they and their ban (son) and their ach (brother/kinsman), chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) ayash (husband/individual man) in kach (strength / mighty / power) for the ibadah (service); shashayam (sixty) - shanayam (two) of Ibadaadawam (Obed-Edom).
Mashalamayah (Meshelemiah) had ban (son) and ach (brother/kinsman), chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) ban (son), eighteen.

Also Chasah (Hosah), of the ban (son) of Mararay (Merari), had ban (son): Shamaray (Shimri) the raash (head), (for though he was not the bakawar (firstborn), yet his ab (father) shawam (place / establish / appoint) him raash (head)),

Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) the shanay (second), Tabalayahaw (Tebaliah) the shalayashay (third), Zakarayah (Zechariah) the rabayaiy (fourth): all the ban (son) and ach (brother/kinsman) of Chasah (Hosah) were thirteen.

Of these were the machalaqath (divisions) of the shawair (doorkeepers), even of the raash (head) gabar (men), having mashamarath (duty / watch) like their ach (brother/kinsman), to sharath (minister) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

They napal (fall / be cast down) gawaral (lots), the qatan (small/young/least) as well as the gadawal (very great/important/mighty), according to their ab (father)' bayath (house), for every shair (gate).

The gawaral (lot) eastward napal (fall / be cast down) to Shalamayah (Shelemiah). Then for Zakarayah (Zechariah) his ban (son), a shakal (wise) yaitz (counselor), they napal (fall / be cast down) gawaral (lots); and his gawaral (lot) yatzaa (go out / come out) out northward.
To Ibadaadawam (Obed-Edom) southward; and to his ban (son) the storehouse.

To Shapayam (Shuppim) and Chasah (Hosah) westward, by the shair (gate) Shalakath (of) Shallecheth, at the masalah (causeway) that ilah (go up / offer) up, mashamar (watch) imah (against) mashamar (watch).
Eastward were shash (six) Lawayay (Levites), northward arabai (four) a yawam (day), southward arabai (four) a yawam (day), and for the storehouse shanayam (two) and shanayam (two).
For parabar (parbar) westward, arabai (four) at the masalah (causeway), and shanayam (two) at parabar (parbar).
These were the machalaqath (divisions) of the shawair (doorkeepers); of the ban (son) of the qarachay (korahites), and of the ban (son) of Mararay (Merari).
Of the Lawayay (Levites), Achayah (Ahijah) was over the awatzar (treasures) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam, and over the awatzar (treasures) of the qadash (set apart/make holy) things.

The ban (son) Laidan (of) Ladan, the ban (son) of the garashanay (gershonites) Laidan (belonging) to Ladan, the raash (head) of the ab (father)' Laidan (households) belonging to Ladan the garashanay (gershonite): Yachayaalay (Jehieli).
The ban (son) of Yachayaalay (Jehieli): Zatham (Zetham), and Yawaal (Joel) his ach (brother/kinsman), over the awatzar (treasures) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah.
Of the imaramay (amramites), of the yatzaharay (izharites), of the chabarawanay (hebronites), of the izayaalay (uzzielites):
And Shabawaal (Shebuel) the ban (son) of Garasham (Gershom), the ban (son) of Mashah (Moses), was nagayad (ruler) over the awatzar (treasures).

His ach (brother/kinsman): of Alayaizar (Eliezer), Rachabayah (Rehabiah) his ban (son), and Yashaiyah (Jeshaiah) his ban (son), and Yawaram (Joram) his ban (son), and Zakaray (Zichri) his ban (son), and Shalamawath (Shelomoth) his ban (son).

This Shalamawath (Shelomoth) and his ach (brother/kinsman) were over all the awatzar (treasures) of the qadash (set apart/make holy) things, which Dawad (David) the malak (king), and the raash (head) of the ab (father)' households, the shar (prince / ruler) over alap (thousands) and maah (hundred), and the shar (prince / ruler) of the tzabaa (troop), had qadash (set apart/make holy).
They qadash (set apart/make holy) some of the shalal (spoil) won in malachamah (battles) to chazaq (repair) the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

All that Shamawaal (Samuel) the seer, and Shaawal (Saul) the ban (son) of Qayash (Kish), and Abanar (Abner) the ban (son) of Nar (Ner), and Yawaab (Joab) the ban (son) of Tzarawayah (Zeruiah), had qadash (set apart/make holy), whoever had qadash (set apart/make holy) anything, it was under the yad (hand) Shalamayath (of) Shelomoth, and of his ach (brother/kinsman).
Of the yatzaharay (izharites), Kananayah (Chenaniah) and his ban (son) were for the chayatzawan (outward) malaakah (business) over Yasharaal (Israel), for shatar (officers) and shapat (judges).

Of the chabarawanay (hebronites), Chashabayah (Hashabiah) and his ach (brother/kinsman), ban (son) of valor, one alap (thousand) shabai (seven) maah (hundred), had the paqadah (oversight) of Yasharaal (Israel) ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) westward, for all the malaakah (business) of Yahawah, and for the ibadah (service) of the malak (king).

Of the chabarawanay (hebronites) was Yarayah (Jerijah) the raash (head), even of the chabarawanay (hebronites), according to their thawaladah (generation) by ab (father)' households. In the fortieth shanah (year) of the malakawath (reign) of Dawad (David) they were darash (sought) for, and there were matzaa (found) among them gabawar (mighty) men of valor at Yaizayar (Jazer) of Galaid (Gilead).

His ach (brother/kinsman), ban (son) of valor, were two alap (thousand) shabai (seven) maah (hundred), raash (head) of ab (father)' households, whom malak (king) Dawad (David) paqad (visit) overseers over the Raawabanay (Reubenites), and the Gaday (Gadites), and the chatzay (half) - shabat (tribe) of the Manashay (Manassites), for every dabar (word / matter) pertaining to Alahayam, and for the dabar (word / matter) of the malak (king).

Now the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) after their masapar (number), the raash (head) of ab (father)' households and the shar (prince / ruler) of alap (thousands) and of maah (hundred), and their shatar (officers) who sharath (served) the malak (king), in any dabar (word / matter) of the machalaqath (divisions) which bawaa (come) in and yatzaa (go out / come out) out chadash (month) by chadash (month) throughout all the chadash (month) of the year—of achad (one) machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).

Over the raashawan (first) machalaqath (division) for the raashawan (first) chadash (month) was Yashabaim (Jashobeam) the ban (son) of Zabadayaal (Zabdiel): and in his machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).
He was of the ban (son) of Paratz (Perez), the raash (head) of all the shar (prince / ruler) of the tzabaa (troop) for the raashawan (first) chadash (month).

Over the machalaqath (division) of the shanay (second) chadash (month) was Dawaday (Dodai) the Achawachay (Ahohite), and his machalaqath (division); and Maqalawath (Mikloth) the nagayad (ruler): and in his machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).

The shalayashay (third) shar (prince / ruler) of the tzabaa (troop) for the shalayashay (third) chadash (month) was Banayah (Benaiah), the ban (son) of Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the kahan (priest), raash (head): and in his machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).

This is that Banayah (Benaiah), who was the gabawar (mighty) man of the shalawashayam (thirty), and over the shalawashayam (thirty): and of his machalaqath (division) was Imayazabad (Ammizabad) his ban (son).

The rabayaiy (fourth) captain for the rabayaiy (fourth) chadash (month) was Ishahaal (Asahel) the ach (brother/kinsman) of Yawaab (Joab), and Zabadayah (Zebadiah) his ban (son) achar (other) him: and in his machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).

The chamayashay (fifth) shar (prince / ruler) for this chamayashay (fifth) chadash (month) was Shamahawath (Shamhuth) the yazarach (izrahite): and in his machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).

The shashay (sixth) captain for the shashay (sixth) chadash (month) was Iyaraa (Ira) the ban (son) of Iqash (Ikkesh) the Thaqawaiy (Tekoite): and in his machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).

The shabayaiy (seventh) captain for the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month) was Chalatz (Helez) the palawanay (pelonite), of the ban (son) of Aparayam (Ephraim): and in his machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).

The shamayanay (eighth) captain for the shamayanay (eighth) chadash (month) was Sabakay (Sibbecai) the chashathay (hushathite), of the Zerahites: and in his machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).

The thashayaiy (ninth) captain for the thashayaiy (ninth) chadash (month) was Abayaizar (Abiezer) the Inathathay (Anathothite), of the Banayamayanay (Benjamites): and in his machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).

The ishayaray (tenth) captain for the ishayaray (tenth) chadash (month) was Maharay (Maharai) the Natapathay (Netophathite), of the Zerahites: and in his machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).

The ishathay (eleven) captain for the ishathay (eleven) chadash (month) was Banayah (Benaiah) the paraithawanay (pirathonite), of the ban (son) of Aparayam (Ephraim): and in his machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).

The shanayam (two) captain for the shanayam (two) chadash (month) was Chaladay (Heldai) the Natapathay (Netophathite), of Ithanayaal (Othniel): and in his machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).

Furthermore over the shabat (tribes) of Yasharaal (Israel): of the Raawabanay (Reubenites) was Alayaizar (Eliezer) the ban (son) of Zakaray (Zichri) the ruler: of the Shamainay (Simeonites), Shapatayah (Shephatiah) the ban (son) Maikah (of) Maacah:
Of Levi, Chashabayah (Hashabiah) the ban (son) of Qamawaal (Kemuel): of Aharawan (Aaron), Tzadawaq (Zadok):
Of Yahawadah (Judah), Alayahaw (Elihu), one of the ach (brother/kinsman) of Dawad (David): of Yashashakar (Issachar), Imaray (Omri) the ban (son) of Mayakaal (Michael):
Of Zabawalawan (Zebulun), Yashamaiyah (Ishmaiah) the ban (son) of Ibadayah (Obadiah): of Napathalay (Naphtali), Yarayamawath (Jeremoth) the ban (son) of Izarayaal (Azriel):

Of the ban (son) of Aparayam (Ephraim), Hawashai (Hoshea) the ban (son) of Izazayahaw (Azaziah): of the chatzay (half) - shabat (tribe) of Manashah (Manasseh), Yawaal (Joel) the ban (son) of Padayah (Pedaiah):

Of the chatzay (half) - tribe of Manashah (Manasseh) in Galaid (Gilead), Yadaw (Iddo) the ban (son) of Zakarayah (Zechariah): of Banayamayan (Benjamin), Yaishayaal (Jaasiel) the ban (son) of Abanar (Abner):
Dan (of) Dan, Izaraal (Azarel) the ban (son) of Yaracham (Jeroham). These were the shar (prince / ruler) of the shabat (tribes) of Yasharaal (Israel).

But Dawad (David) didn't nashaa (lift) the masapar (number) of them from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and under, because Yahawah had amar (spoke) he would rabah (increase) Yasharaal (Israel) like the kawakab (star) of the sky.

Yawaab (Joab) the ban (son) of Tzarawayah (Zeruiah) chalal (began) to manah (number), but didn't kalah (complete / finish); and there came qatzap (wrath) for zaath (this) on Yasharaal (Israel); neither was the masapar (number) ilah (go up / offer) into the masapar (account) in the dabar (word / matter) of malak (king) Dawad (David).

Over the malak (king) awatzar (treasures) was Izamawath (Azmaveth) the ban (son) of Idayaal (Adiel): and over the awatzar (treasures) in the shadah (fields), in the iyar (cities), and in the kapar (villages), and in the magadal (towers), was Yahawanathan (Jonathan) the ban (son) of Izayah (Uzziah):
Over those who ishah (make) the malaakah (work) of the shadah (field) for ibadah (tillage) of the adamah (ground) was Izaray (Ezri) the ban (son) of Kalawab (Chelub):
And over the karam (vineyards) was Shamaiy (Shimei) the ramathay (ramathite): and over the increase of the karam (vineyards) for the winecellars was Zabaday (Zabdi) the shapamay (shiphmite):

And over the zayath (olive) trees and the shaqamah (sycamore) trees that were in the lowland was Bailachanan (Baal) Hanan the gadaray (gederite): and over the awatzar (cellars) of shaman (oil) was Yawaish (Joash):

And over the baqar (morning) that raih (fed) in Sharawan (Sharon) was Shataray (Shitrai) the sharawanay (sharonite): and over the baqar (morning) that were in the imaq (valleys) was Shapat (Shaphat) the ban (son) of Idalay (Adlai):

And over the gamal (camels) was Awabayal (Obil) the Yashamaialay (Ishmaelite): and over the donkeys was Yachadayahaw (Jehdeiah) the maranathay (meronothite): and over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite.
All these were the shar (prince / ruler) of the rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions) which was malak (king) Dawad (David's).

Also Yahawanathan (Jonathan), Dawad (David's) dawad (uncle), was a yaitz (counselor), a ayash (husband/individual man) of bayan (between), and a sapar (book): and Yachayaal (Jehiel) the ban (son) of Chakamawanay (Hachmoni) was with the malak (king) ban (son):
Achayathapal (Ahithophel) was the malak (king) yaitz (counselor): and Chawashay (Hushai) the arakay (archite) was the malak (king) rai (neigbor/another person):

And achar (other) Achayathapal (Ahithophel) was Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the ban (son) of Banayah (Benaiah), and Abayathar (Abiathar): and the shar (prince / ruler) of the malak (king) tzabaa (troop) was Yawaab (Joab).

Dawad (David) qahal (assembled) all the shar (prince / ruler) of Yasharaal (Israel), the shar (prince / ruler) of the shabat (tribes), and the shar (prince / ruler) of the machalaqath (companies) who sharath (served) the malak (king) by machalaqath (division), and the shar (prince / ruler) of alap (thousands), and the shar (prince / ruler) of maah (hundred), and the rulers over all the rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions) and maqanah (possessions) of the malak (king) and of his ban (son), with the sarayas (officers), and the gabawar (mighty) men, even all the gabawar (mighty) men of valor, to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Then Dawad (David) the malak (king) qawam (rise up) up on his ragal (feet / foot), and amar (spoke), shamai (hearken / hear) me, my ach (brother/kinsman), and my im (people / nation)! As for me, it was in my labab (heart) to banah (build) a bayath (house) of manawachah (rest) for the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah, and for the hadam (footstool) of our Alahayam; and I had kawan (prepared) for the banah (building).

But Alahayam amar (spoke) to me, ‘You shall not banah (build) a bayath (house) for my sham (name), because you are a ayash (husband/individual man) of malachamah (war), and have shapak (shed) dam (blood).’

However Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), bachar (chose) me out of all the bayath (house) of my ab (father) to be malak (king) over Yasharaal (Israel) iwalam (forever). For he has bachar (chosen) Yahawadah (Judah) to be nagayad (prince); and in the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah), the bayath (house) of my ab (father); and among the ban (son) of my ab (father) he ratzah (took) pleasure in me to make me malak (king) over all Yasharaal (Israel).

Of all my ban (son) (for Yahawah nathan (give) given me many ban (son)), he has bachar (chosen) Shalamah (Solomon) my ban (son) to yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the kasaa (throne) of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) malakawath (kingdom) over Yasharaal (Israel).

He amar (spoke) to me, ‘Shalamah (Solomon), your ban (son), shall banah (build) my bayath (house) and my chatzar (courts); for I have bachar (chosen) him to be my ban (son), and I will be his ab (father).
I will kawan (establish) his malakawath (kingdom) iwalam (forever), if he chazaq (continues) to ishah (make) my matzawah (commandments) and my mashapat (ordinances), as at this yawam (day).’

Now therefore, in the iyan (eye) of all Yasharaal (Israel), the qahal (assembly) of Yahawah, and in the azan (audience) of our Alahayam, shamar (keep/guard) and darash (seek) out all the matzawah (commandments) of Yahawah your Alahayam; that you may yarash (possess) this tawab (pleasant/functional) aratz (Earth/land), and leave it for an nachal (inheritance) to your ban (son) achar (other) you iwalam (forever).

You, Shalamah (Solomon) my ban (son), yadai (know) the Alahayam of your ab (father), and ibad (servant) him with a shalam (full / whole / complete) lab (heart) and with a chapatz (willing) napash (living being/soul); for Yahawah searches all labab (hearts), and bayan (between) all the yatzar (imaginations) of the machashabah (thoughts). If you darash (seek) him, he will be matzaa (found) by you; but if you izab (forsake) him, he will zanach (cast) you off id (forever).
Raah (see) heed now; for Yahawah has bachar (chosen) you to banah (build) a bayath (house) for the maqadash (sanctuary). Be chazaq (strong), and ishah (make) it.

Then Dawad (David) nathan (give) to Shalamah (Solomon) his ban (son) the thabanayath (pattern) of the awalam (porch) of the bayath (house), and of its houses, and of its ganazak (treasuries), and of the upper rooms of it, and of the inner rooms of it, and of the bayath (house) of the kaparath (mercy) seat;

And the thabanayath (pattern) of all that he had by the rawach (spirit / wind), for the chatzar (courts) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and for all the surrounding rooms, for the awatzar (treasuries) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam, and for the awatzar (treasuries) of the qadash (set apart/make holy) things;

Also for the machalaqath (divisions) of the kahan (priest) and the Lawayay (Levites), and for all the malaakah (work) of the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and for all the kalay (vessels) of ibadah (service) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah;

Of zahab (gold) by mashaqal (weight) for the zahab (gold), for all kalay (vessels) of every kind of ibadah (service); for all the kalay (vessels) of kasap (silver) by mashaqal (weight), for all kalay (vessels) of every kind of ibadah (service);

By mashaqal (weight) also for the lampstands of zahab (gold), and for its nayar (lamps), of zahab (gold), by mashaqal (weight) for every lampstand and for its nayar (lamps); and for the lampstands of kasap (silver), by mashaqal (weight) for every lampstand and for its nayar (lamps), according to the use of every lampstand;
And the zahab (gold) by mashaqal (weight) for the shalachan (tables) of show mairakath (bread), for every shalachan (table); and kasap (silver) for the shalachan (tables) of kasap (silver);

And the forks, and the basins, and the cups, of tahawar (pure) zahab (gold); and for the zahab (gold) bowls by mashaqal (weight) for every bowl; and for the kasap (silver) bowls by mashaqal (weight) for every bowl;

And for the mazabach (altar) of qatarath (incense) zaqaq (refined) zahab (gold) by mashaqal (weight); and zahab (gold) for the thabanayath (pattern) of the marakabah (chariot), the karawab (cherubim), that parash (spread) out, and sakak (covered) the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah.
"All this," said David, I shakal (have) been made to understand in kathab (writing) from the yad (hand) of Yahawah, even all the malaakah (works) of this thabanayath (pattern).

Dawad (David) amar (spoke) to Shalamah (Solomon) his ban (son), Be chazaq (strong) and amatz (courageous), and ishah (make) it. Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid), nor be chathath (dismayed); for Yahawah Alahayam, even my Alahayam, is with you. He will not rapah (fail) you, nor izab (forsake) you, until all the malaakah (work) for the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah is kalah (complete / finish).

Behold, there are the machalaqath (divisions) of the kahan (priest) and the Lawayay (Levites), for all the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam. There shall be with you in all kinds of malaakah (work) every nadayab (willing) chakamah (man) who has skill, for any kind of ibadah (service). Also the shar (prince / ruler) and all the im (people / nation) will be entirely at your command.

Dawad (David) the malak (king) amar (spoke) to all the qahal (assembly), Shalamah (Solomon) my ban (son), whom achad (one) Alahayam has bachar (chosen), is yet nair (young) and rak (tender), and the malaakah (work) is gadawal (very great/important/mighty); for the bayarah (palace) is not for adam (man), but for Yahawah Alahayam.

Now I have kawan (prepared) with all my kach (strength / mighty / power) for the bayath (house) of my Alahayam the zahab (gold) for the things of zahab (gold), and the kasap (silver) for the things of kasap (silver), and the nachashath (brass) for the things of nachashath (brass), the barazal (iron) for the things of barazal (iron), and itz (wood) for the things of itz (wood); shaham (Onyx) aban (stone), and aban (stone) to be malaa (set), aban (stone) for inlaid raqamah (work), and of various colors, and all kinds of yaqar (precious) aban (stone), and marble aban (stone) in rab (abundance).

In addition, because I ratzah (have) set my affection on the bayath (house) of my Alahayam, since I yash (have) a treasure of my own of zahab (gold) and kasap (silver), I nathan (give) it to the bayath (house) of my Alahayam, over and mail (top/above) all that I have kawan (prepared) for the qadash (set apart/make holy) bayath (house),

Even shalawash (three) alap (thousand) kakar (talents) of zahab (gold), of the zahab (gold) of Awapayar (Ophir), and shabai (seven) alap (thousand) kakar (talents) of zaqaq (refined) kasap (silver), with which to tawach (overlay) the qayar (walls) of the bayath (house);

Of zahab (gold) for the things of zahab (gold), and of kasap (silver) for the things of kasap (silver), and for all kinds of malaakah (work) to be made by the yad (hand) of artisans. Who then nadab (offers) willingly to malaa (consecrate) yad (hand) this yawam (day) to Yahawah?

Then the shar (prince / ruler) of the ab (father)' households, and the shar (prince / ruler) of the shabat (tribes) of Yasharaal (Israel), and the shar (prince / ruler) of alap (thousands) and of maah (hundred), with the shar (prince / ruler) over the malak (king) malaakah (work), nadab (offered) willingly;

And they nathan (give) for the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam of zahab (gold) chamash (five) alap (thousand) kakar (talents) and ishar (ten) alap (thousand) darics, and of kasap (silver) ishar (ten) alap (thousand) kakar (talents), and of nachashath (brass) eighteen alap (thousand) kakar (talents), and of barazal (iron) a maah (hundred) alap (thousand) kakar (talents).

They with whom precious aban (stone) were matzaa (found) nathan (give) them to the awatzar (treasure) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, under the yad (hand) of Yachayaal (Jehiel) the garashanay (gershonite).

Then the im (people / nation) shamach (rejoiced), because they nadab (offered) willingly, because with a shalam (full / whole / complete) lab (heart) they nadab (offered) willingly to Yahawah: and Dawad (David) the malak (king) also shamach (rejoiced) with gadawal (very great/important/mighty) shamachah (joy).

Therefore Dawad (David) barak (blessed) Yahawah iyan (eye) all the qahal (assembly); and Dawad (David) amar (spoke), You are barak (blessed), Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel) our ab (father), iwalam (forever) and iwalam (forever).

Yours, Yahawah, is the gadawalah (greatness), the gabawarah (power), the glory, the natzach (victory), and the hawad (majesty)! For all that is in the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) and in the aratz (Earth/land) is yours. Yours is the mamalakah (kingdom), Yahawah, and you are mathanashaa (exalted) as raash (head) above all.

Both riches and honor come from you, and you mashal (rule/have dominion) over all; and in your yad (hand) is kach (strength / mighty / power) and gabawarah (might); and it is in your yad (hand) to gadal (make) great, and to give chazaq (strength) to all.
Now therefore, our Alahayam, we yadah (thank) you, and halal (praise) your thapaarah (glorious) sham (name).

But who am I, and what is my im (people / nation), that we should be kach (strength / mighty / power) to nadab (offer) so willingly as this? For all things come from you, and of your yad (hand) nathan (give) we given you.

For we are gar (sojourner / stranger / foreigner) panayam (before) you, and thawashab (foreigners), as all our ab (father) were. Our yawam (day) on the aratz (Earth/land) are as a tzal (shadow), and there is no remaining.

Yahawah our Alahayam, all this hamawan (store) that we have kawan (prepared) to banah (build) you a bayath (house) for your qadash (set apart/make holy) sham (name) comes from your yad (hand), and is all your own.

I yadai (know) also, my Alahayam, that you bachan (try) the labab (heart), and ratzah (have) pleasure in yashar (uprightness). As for me, in the uprightness of my labab (heart) I have nadab (willingly) offered all these things. Now raah (see) I seen with shamachah (joy) your im (people / nation), that are matzaa (present) here, nadab (offer) willingly to you.

Yahawah, the Alahayam of Abaraham (Abraham), of Yatzachaq (Isaac), and of Yasharaal (Israel), our ab (father), shamar (keep/guard) this iwalam (forever) in the yatzar (imagination) of the machashabah (thoughts) of the labab (heart) of your im (people / nation), and kawan (prepare) their labab (heart) for you;

And nathan (give) to Shalamah (Solomon) my ban (son) a shalam (full / whole / complete) labab (heart), to shamar (keep/guard) your matzawah (commandments), your idawath (testimonies), and your idawath (statutes), and to ishah (make) all these things, and to banah (build) the bayarah (palace), for which I have kawan (made) provision.

Dawad (David) amar (spoke) to all the qahal (assembly), "Now barak (bless) Yahawah your Alahayam!" All the qahal (assembly) barak (blessed) Yahawah, the Alahayam of their ab (father), and bowed down their qadad (heads) and prostrated themselves before Yahawah and the malak (king).

They zabach (sacrificed) zabach (sacrifices) to Yahawah, and ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilah (offerings) to Yahawah, on the next macharath (day) after that macharath (day), even one alap (thousand) par (bulls), one alap (thousand) ayal (rams), and one alap (thousand) kabash (lambs), with their drink nasak (offerings), and zabach (sacrifices) in rab (abundance) for all Yasharaal (Israel),

And akal (eat) and shathah (drinks) panayam (before) Yahawah on that yawam (day) with gadawal (very great/important/mighty) shamachah (gladness). They made Shalamah (Solomon) the ban (son) of Dawad (David) malak (king) the shanay (second) time, and mashach (anointed) him to Yahawah to be nagayad (prince), and Tzadawaq (Zadok) to be kahan (priest).

Then Shalamah (Solomon) yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the kasaa (throne) of Yahawah as malak (king) instead of Dawad (David) his ab (father), and tzalach (prospered); and all Yasharaal (Israel) shamai (hearken / hear) him.
All the shar (prince / ruler), the gabawar (mighty) men, and also all of the ban (son) of malak (king) Dawad (David) submitted yad (hand) to Shalamah (Solomon) the malak (king).

Yahawah gadal (magnified) Shalamah (Solomon) mail (top/above) in the iyan (eye) of all Yasharaal (Israel), and nathan (give) on him such malakawath (royal) hawad (majesty) as had not been on any malak (king) panayam (before) him in Yasharaal (Israel).
Now Dawad (David) the ban (son) of Yashay (Jesse) malak (king) over all Yasharaal (Israel).

The yawam (day) that he malak (king) over Yasharaal (Israel) was arabaiyam (forty) shanah (years); he malak (king) shabai (seven) shanah (years) in Chabarawan (Hebron), and he malak (king) shalawashayam (thirty) - shalawash (three) years in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

He mawath (death) in a tawab (pleasant/functional) shayabah (old age / white hair (due to age)) age, shabai (full) of yawam (day), riches, and honor: and Shalamah (Solomon) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Now the dabar (word / matter) of Dawad (David) the malak (king), raashawan (first) and acharawan (last), behold, they are kathab (written) in the history of Shamawaal (Samuel) the seer, and in the history of Nathan (Nathan) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), and in the history of Gad (Gad) the chazah (seer),

With all his malakawath (reign) and his gabawarah (might), and the ith (times) that ibar (pass over/through) over him, and over Yasharaal (Israel), and over all the mamalakah (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land).
Shalamah (Solomon) the ban (son) of Dawad (David) was chazaq (strengthened) in his malakawath (kingdom), and Yahawah his Alahayam was with him, and gadal (magnified) him mail (top/above).

Shalamah (Solomon) amar (spoke) to all Yasharaal (Israel), to the shar (prince / ruler) of alap (thousands) and of maah (hundred), and to the shapat (judges), and to raash (head) prince in all Yasharaal (Israel), the raash (head) of the ab (father)' households.

So Shalamah (Solomon), and all the qahal (assembly) with him, yalak (went) to the bamah (high) place that was at Gabaiwan (Gibeon); for there was the ahal (tent) of Meeting of Alahayam, which Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah ishah (make) made in the madabar (wilderness).

But Dawad (David) had brought the arawan (ark) of Alahayam up from Kiriath Qarayathayairayam (Jearim) to the place that Dawad (David) had kawan (prepared) for it; for he had natah (pitched) a ahal (tent) for it at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Moreover the bronze mazabach (altar), that Batzalaal (Bezalel) the ban (son) of Awaray (Uri), the ban (son) of Chawar (Hur), ishah (make) made, was there panayam (before) the mashakan (tabernacle) of Yahawah: and Shalamah (Solomon) and the qahal (assembly) were darash (seeking) counsel there.

Shalamah (Solomon) ilah (go up / offer) up there to the bronze mazabach (altar) panayam (before) Yahawah, which was at the ahal (tent) of Meeting, and ilah (go up / offer) one alap (thousand) burnt ilah (offerings) on it.
In that layal (night) Alahayam appeared to Shalamah (Solomon), and amar (spoke) to him, shaal (ask) what I shall nathan (give) you.

Shalamah (Solomon) amar (spoke) to Alahayam, You ishah (make) shown gadawal (very great/important/mighty) loving chasad (grace) to Dawad (David) my ab (father), and have made me malak (king) in his place.

Now, Yahawah Alahayam, let your dabar (word / matter) to Dawad (David) my ab (father) be aman (believe / have faith); for you have made me malak (king) over a im (people / nation) like the ipar (dust) of the aratz (Earth/land) in rab (multitude).

Now nathan (give) me chakamah (wisdom) and madai (knowledge), that I may yatzaa (go out / come out) out and bawaa (come) in panayam (before) this im (people / nation); for who can shapat (judge) this your im (people / nation), that is so gadawal (very great/important/mighty)?

Alahayam amar (spoke) to Shalamah (Solomon), Because this was in your labab (heart), and you have not shaal (asked) riches, wealth, or honor, nor the napash (living being/soul) of those who shanaa (hate) you, neither yet have shaal (asked) rab (long) yawam (day); but have shaal (asked) chakamah (wisdom) and madai (knowledge) for yourself, that you may shapat (judge) my im (people / nation), over whom I have made you malak (king):

Chakamah (wisdom) and madai (knowledge) is nathan (give) to you. I will nathan (give) you riches, wealth, and honor, such as none of the malak (king) have had who have been panayam (before) you; neither shall there any achar (other) you have the like.

So Shalamah (Solomon) bawaa (come) from the bamah (high) place that was at Gabaiwan (Gibeon), from panayam (before) the ahal (tent) of Meeting, to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and he malak (king) over Yasharaal (Israel).

Shalamah (Solomon) asap (gathered) rakab (chariots) and horsemen: and he had one alap (thousand) arabai (four) maah (hundred) rakab (chariots), and shanayam (two) alap (thousand) horsemen, that he yanach (placed) in the rakab (chariot) iyar (cities), and with the malak (king) at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

The malak (king) nathan (give) kasap (silver) and zahab (gold) to be in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) as aban (stone), and araz (cedars) nathan (give) he to be as the shaqamah (sycamore) trees that are in the lowland, for rab (abundance).

The sawas (horses) which Shalamah (Solomon) had were mawatzaa (brought) out of Matzarayam (Egypt) and from maqawah (gathering/collection); the malak (king) sachar (merchants) purchased them from maqawah (gathering/collection).

They ilah (go up / offer) up and yatzaa (go out / come out) out of Matzarayam (Egypt) a marakabah (chariot) for shash (six) maah (hundred) pieces of kasap (silver), and a sawas (horse) for one maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty): and so for all the malak (king) of the Chathay (Hittites), and the malak (king) of Aram (Syria), they yatzaa (go out / come out) them out by their yad (hand).
Now Shalamah (Solomon) purposed to build a house for the name of Yahawah, and a house for his kingdom.

Shalamah (Solomon) counted out seventy thousand ishah (make) to ishah (make) burdens, and eighty thousand men who were stone cutters in the mountains, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.
Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As you dealt with Yahawah (David) my father, and sent him cedars to banah (build) him a bayath (house) in which to dwell, so deal with me.

Behold, I am about to banah (build) a bayath (house) for the name of Yahawah my Alahayam, to dedicate it to him, and to burn before him incense of sweet spices, and for the continual show bread, and for the burnt offerings morning and kay (surely), on the Sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the banah (set) feasts of Yahawah our Alahayam. This is an ordinance forever to Israel.
The bayath (house) which I banah (build) is bayath (house); for our Alahayam is bayath (house) above all Alahayam.
But who is able to build him a house, since heaven and the heaven of heavens can't contain him? Who am I then, that I should build him a house, except just to burn incense im (before) him?

Now therefore shalach (send) me a yadai (man) skillful to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and who yadai (knows) how to engrave engravings, to be with the skillful yadai (men) who are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father provided.
Send me also cedar itz (trees), fir trees, and algum trees, out of Lebanon; for I know that your servants know how to cut itz (timber) in Lebanon: and behold, my servants shall be with your servants,
Even to prepare me itz (timber) in abundance; for the house which I am about to build shall be great and wonderful.

Behold, I will nathan (give) to your servants, the cutters who cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.
Then Chawaram (Huram) the malak (king) of Tyre amar (spoke) in writing, which he nathan (give) to Solomon, Because Yahawah loves his ban (son), he nathan (give) made you malak (king) over them.

Chawaram (Huram) continued, Blessed be Yahawah, the Alahayam of Israel, that yadai (made) heaven and earth, who yadai (has) given to David the king a chakam (wise) son, endowed with discretion and chakam (understanding), that should build a house for Yahawah, and a house for his kingdom.
Now I have nathan (give) a skillful ayash (husband/individual man), endowed with yadai (understanding), of Huram my ab (father),

The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan; and his father was a man of Tyre, skillful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson, also to engrave any kind of engraving, and to devise any device; that there may be a place appointed to him with your skillful men, and with the skillful men of my Adawan David your father.
Now therefore the wheat and the barley, the oil and the wine, which my Adawan has spoken of, bawaa (come) him send to his servants:
And we will cut wood out of Shalamah (Lebanon), as much as you shall need; and we will bring it to you in floats by sea to Joppa; and you shall carry it up to Jerusalem.

Solomon numbered all the foreigners who were in the land of Israel, after the numbering with which David his father had numbered them; and they were found one maah (hundred) fifty - shalawash (three) alap (thousand) shash (six) maah (hundred).

He ishah (make) shabaiyam (seventy) alap (thousand) of them to sabal (bear) burdens, and shamanayam (eighty) alap (thousand) who were chatzab (stone) cutters in the har (mountain), and shalawash (three) alap (thousand) shash (six) maah (hundred) natzach (overseers) to set the im (people / nation) at ibad (servant).

Then Shalamah (Solomon) chalal (began) to banah (build) the bayath (house) of Yahawah at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) on har (mountain) Mawarayah (Moriah), where Yahawah raah (see) to Dawad (David) his ab (father), which he prepared in the maqawam (place) that Dawad (David) had appointed, in the garan (threshing) floor of Aranan (Ornan) the Yabawasay (Jebusite).
He chalal (began) to banah (build) in the shanay (second) day of the shanay (second) chadash (month), in the arabai (four) shanah (year) of his malakawath (reign).

Now these are the foundations which Shalamah (Solomon) yasad (laid) for the banah (building) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam. The arak (length) by amah (cubits) after the raashawan (first) madah (measure) was shashayam (sixty) amah (cubits), and the rachab (breadth) isharayam (twenty) amah (cubits).

The awalam (porch) that panayam (was) in front, its arak (length), according to the rachab (breadth) of the bayath (house), was isharayam (twenty) amah (cubits), and the gabah (height) one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty); and he overlaid it panayamah (within) with tahawar (pure) zahab (gold).

The greater bayath (house) he made a chapah (ceiling) with barawash (fir) itz (wood), which he overlaid with tawab (pleasant/functional) zahab (gold), and ornamented it with thamar (palm) trees and sharasharah (chains).
He garnished the bayath (house) with yaqar (precious) aban (stone) for thapaarah (beauty): and the zahab (gold) was zahab (gold) of Parawayam (Parvaim).

He overlaid also the bayath (house), the qawarah (beams), the sap (thresholds), and its qayar (walls), and its dalath (doors), with zahab (gold); and pathach (engraved) karawab (cherubim) on the qayar (walls).

He ishah (make) the most qadash (set apart/make holy) bayath (house): its arak (length), according to the rachab (breadth) of the bayath (house), was isharayam (twenty) amah (cubits), and its rachab (breadth) isharayam (twenty) amah (cubits); and he overlaid it with tawab (pleasant/functional) zahab (gold), amounting to shash (six) maah (hundred) kakar (talents).
The mashaqal (weight) of the masamar (nails) was chamashayam (fifty) shaqal (shekels) of zahab (gold). He overlaid the upper rooms with zahab (gold).
In the most qadash (set apart/make holy) bayath (house) he ishah (make) shanayam (two) karawab (cherubim) of tzaitzai (image) maishah (work); and they overlaid them with zahab (gold).

The kanap (wings) of the karawab (cherubim) were isharayam (twenty) amah (cubits) arak (length): the kanap (wing) of the achad (one) was chamash (five) amah (cubits), nagai (reaching) to the qayar (wall) of the bayath (house); and the other kanap (wing) was chamash (five) amah (cubits), nagai (reaching) to the kanap (wing) of the other karawab (cherub).

The kanap (wing) of the other karawab (cherub) was chamash (five) amah (cubits), nagai (reaching) to the qayar (wall) of the bayath (house); and the other kanap (wing) was chamash (five) amah (cubits), dabaq (joining) to the kanap (wing) of the other karawab (cherub).

The kanap (wings) of these karawab (cherubim) parash (spread) themselves forth isharayam (twenty) amah (cubits): and they imad (stood) on their ragal (feet / foot), and their panayam (faces) were toward the bayath (house).
He ishah (make) the parakath (veil) of thakalath (blue), and aragaman (purple), and karamayal (crimson), and bawatz (fine) linen, and ornamented it with karawab (cherubim).

Also he ishah (make) panayam (before) the bayath (house) shanayam (two) imawad (pillar) of shalawashayam (thirty) - chamash (five) amah (cubits) high, and the capital that was on the raash (head) of each of them was chamash (five) amah (cubits).

He ishah (make) sharasharah (chains) in the dabayar (oracle), and nathan (give) them on the raash (head) of the imawad (pillar); and he ishah (make) one maah (hundred) ramawan (pomegranates), and nathan (give) them on the sharasharah (chains).

He qawam (rise up) up the imawad (pillar) panayam (before) the hayakal (temple), achad (one) on the right yamayan (right hand), and the other on the shamaawal (left hand); and qaraa (called) the sham (name) of that on the panayam (right) hand Yakayan (Jachin), and the sham (name) of that on the shamaalay (left) Baiz (Boaz).

Then he ishah (make) an mazabach (altar) of nachashath (brass), isharayam (twenty) amah (cubits) its arak (length), and isharayam (twenty) amah (cubits) its rachab (breadth), and ishar (ten) amah (cubits) its qawamah (height).

Also he ishah (make) the yatzaq (molten) yam (sea/waters) of ishar (ten) amah (cubits) from shapah (brim) to shapah (brim), igal (round) in sabayab (surrounding); and its qawamah (height) was chamash (five) amah (cubits); and a qaw (line) of shalawashayam (thirty) amah (cubits) encircled it.

Under it was the damawath (likeness) of oxen, which encircled it, for ishar (ten) amah (cubits), encircling the yam (sea/waters). The oxen were in shanayam (two) tawar (rows), yatzaq (cast) when it was yatzaq (cast).

It imad (stood) on shanayam (two) oxen, shalawash (three) panah (looking) toward the tzapawan (north), and shalawash (three) panah (looking) toward the yam (sea/waters), and shalawash (three) panah (looking) toward the nagab (south), and shalawash (three) panah (looking) toward the mazarach (east): and the yam (sea/waters) was set on them mail (top/above), and all their hinder achawar (parts) were inward.

It was a tapach (handbreadth) ibay (thick); and its shapah (brim) was maishah (worked) like the shapah (brim) of a kawas (cup), like the parach (flower) of a shawashan (lily): it received and kawal (all/every/entire) shalawash (three) alap (thousand) bath (daughter).

He ishah (make) also ishar (ten) basins, and nathan (give) chamash (five) on the right yamayan (right hand), and chamash (five) on the shamaawal (left hand), to rachatz (wash) in them; such things as belonged to the burnt maishah (offering) they dawach (washed) in them; but the yam (sea/waters) was for the kahan (priest) to rachatz (wash) in.

He ishah (make) the ishar (ten) lampstands of zahab (gold) according to the mashapat (ordinance) concerning them; and he nathan (give) them in the hayakal (temple), chamash (five) on the right yamayan (right hand), and chamash (five) on the shamaawal (left hand).

He ishah (make) also ishar (ten) shalachan (tables), and yanach (placed) them in the hayakal (temple), chamash (five) on the yamayan (right hand) side, and chamash (five) on the shamaawal (left hand). He ishah (make) one maah (hundred) basins of zahab (gold).

Furthermore he ishah (make) the chatzar (court) of the kahan (priest), and the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) izarah (court), and dalath (doors) for the izarah (court), and overlaid their dalath (doors) with nachashath (brass).
He nathan (give) the yam (sea/waters) on the yamanay (right) kathap (side) of the qadam (house) eastward, mawal (toward) the nagab (south).

Chawaram (Huram) ishah (make) the sayar (pots), and the yai (shovels), and the basins. So Chawaram (Huram) kalah (complete / finish) an end of doing the malaakah (work) that he ishah (make) for malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) in the bayath (house) of Alahayam:

The shanayam (two) imawad (pillar), and the galah (spring / basin / bowl), and the shanayam (two) capitals which were on the raash (head) of the imawad (pillar), and the shanayam (two) networks to kasah (cover) the shanayam (two) galah (spring / basin / bowl) of the capitals that were on the raash (head) of the imawad (pillar),

And the arabai (four) maah (hundred) ramawan (pomegranates) for the shanayam (two) shabakah (networks); shanayam (two) tawar (rows) of ramawan (pomegranates) for achad (one) shabakah (network), to kasah (cover) the shanayam (two) galah (spring / basin / bowl) of the capitals that were on the imawad (pillar).
He ishah (make) also the makawanah (bases), and the basins ishah (make) he on the makawanah (bases);
Achad (one) yam (sea/waters), and the shanayam (two) oxen under it.

Chawaram (Huram) his ab (father) also ishah (make) the sayar (pots), the yai (shovels), the forks, and all its kalay (vessels) for malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) for the bayath (house) of Yahawah of maraq (bright) nachashath (brass).
The malak (king) yatzaq (cast) them in the kakar (plain) of the Yaradan (Jordan), in the ib (clay) adamah (ground) between Sakawath (Succoth) and Tzaradah (Zeredah).
Thus Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) all these kalay (vessels) in maad (great) rab (abundance): for the mashaqal (weight) of the nachashath (brass) could not be chaqar (found) out.

Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) all the kalay (vessels) that were in the bayath (house) of Alahayam, the zahab (gold) mazabach (altar) also, and the shalachan (tables) with the show lacham (bread) on them;
And the lampstands with their nayar (lamps), to bair (burn) according to the mashapat (ordinance) panayam (before) the dabayar (oracle), of sagar (pure) zahab (gold);
And the parach (flowers), and the nayar (lamps), and the malaqach (tongs), of zahab (gold), and that makalah (perfect) zahab (gold);

And the mazamarah (snuffers), and the basins, and the kap (spoons), and the machathah (fire) pans, of sagar (pure) zahab (gold): and as for the entry of the bayath (house), the inner dalath (doors) of it for the most qadash (set apart/make holy) place, and the dalath (doors) of the main hall of the hayakal (temple) were of zahab (gold).

Thus all the malaakah (work) that Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) for the bayath (house) of Yahawah was shalam (finished). Shalamah (Solomon) bawaa (come) in the things that Dawad (David) his ab (father) had qadash (set apart/make holy), even the kasap (silver), and the zahab (gold), and all the kalay (vessels), and nathan (give) them in the awatzar (treasuries) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam.

Then Shalamah (Solomon) qahal (assembled) the zaqan (elders) of Yasharaal (Israel), and all the raash (head) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe), the nashayaa (princes) of the ab (father)' households of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), to ilah (go up / offer) up the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah out of the iyar (city) of Dawad (David), which is Tzayawan (Zion).
And all the ayash (husband/individual man) of Yasharaal (Israel) qahal (assembled) themselves to the malak (king) at the chag (feast/festival), which was in the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month).
All the zaqan (elders) of Yasharaal (Israel) bawaa (come): and the Lawayay (Levites) nashaa (lift) up the arawan (ark);

And they ilah (go up / offer) up the arawan (ark), and the ahal (tent) of Meeting, and all the qadash (set apart/make holy) kalay (vessels) that were in the ahal (tent); these the kahan (priest) the Lawayay (Levites) ilah (go up / offer) up.

Malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) and all the idah (congregation) of Yasharaal (Israel), that were yaid (assembled) to him, were panayam (before) the arawan (ark), zabach (sacrificing) tzaan (sheep) and cattle, that could not be sapar (book) nor manah (numbered) for rab (multitude).

The kahan (priest) bawaa (come) in the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah to its maqawam (place), into the dabayar (oracle) of the bayath (house), to the most qadash (set apart/make holy) place, even under the kanap (wings) of the karawab (cherubim).

For the karawab (cherubim) parash (spread) forth their kanap (wings) over the maqawam (place) of the arawan (ark), and the karawab (cherubim) kasah (covered) the arawan (ark) and its poles mail (top/above).

The poles were so arak (long) that the raash (head) of the poles were raah (see) from the arawan (ark) panayam (before) the dabayar (oracle); but they were not raah (see) outside: and there it is to this yawam (day).

There was nothing in the arawan (ark) except the shanayam (two) lawach (tables) which Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) at Charab (Horeb), when Yahawah karath (cut) a covenant with the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), when they yatzaa (go out / come out) out of Matzarayam (Egypt).
