It happened, when the kahan (priest) yatzaa (go out / come out) come out of the qadash (set apart/make holy) place, (for all the kahan (priest) who were matzaa (present) had qadash (set apart/make holy) themselves, and didn't shamar (keep/guard) their machalaqath (divisions);

Also the Lawayay (Levites) who were the singers, all of them, even Asap (Asaph), Hayaman (Heman), Yadawathawan (Jeduthun), and their ban (son) and their ach (brother/kinsman), labash (arrayed) in bawatz (fine) linen, with matzalath (cymbals) and stringed instruments and kanawar (harps), imad (stood) at the mazarach (east) end of the mazabach (altar), and with them one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) kahan (priest) chatzar (sounding) with chatzatzarah (trumpets);)

It happened, when the chatzar (trumpeters) and singers were as achad (one), to make achad (one) qawal (sound / voice) to be shamai (hearken / hear) in halal (praise) and yadah (thanking) Yahawah; and when they rawam (will lift up) up their qawal (sound / voice) with the chatzatzarah (trumpets) and matzalath (cymbals) and kalay (instruments) of music, and halal (praise) Yahawah, saying, "For he is tawab (pleasant/functional); for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever)!" That then the bayath (house) was malaa (filled) with a inan (cloud), even the bayath (house) of Yahawah,

So that the kahan (priest) yakal (could) not imad (stand) to sharath (minister) by panayam (reason) of the inan (cloud): for the kabawad (glory) of Yahawah malaa (filled) the bayath (house) of Alahayam.
Then Shalamah (Solomon) amar (spoke), Yahawah has amar (spoke) that he would shakan (dwell) in the irapal (thick) darkness.
But I have banah (built) you a bayath (house) of zabawal (habitation), and a makawan (place) for you to yashab (inhabit/dwell) in iwalam (forever).
The malak (king) sabab (turned) his panayam (face), and barak (blessed) all the qahal (assembly) of Yasharaal (Israel): and all the qahal (assembly) of Yasharaal (Israel) imad (stood).

He amar (spoke), barak (blessed) be Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), who dabar (word / matter) with his pah (mouth) to Dawad (David) my ab (father), and has with his yad (hand) malaa (fulfilled) it, amar (spoke),

‘Since the yawam (day) that I yatzaa (go out / come out) forth my im (people / nation) out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), I bachar (chose) no iyar (city) out of all the shabat (tribes) of Yasharaal (Israel) to banah (build) a bayath (house) in, that my sham (name) might be there; neither bachar (chose) I any ayash (husband/individual man) to be nagayad (prince) over my im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel):
But I have bachar (chosen) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), that my sham (name) might be there; and have bachar (chosen) Dawad (David) to be over my im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel).’
Now it was in the labab (heart) of Dawad (David) my ab (father) to banah (build) a bayath (house) for the sham (name) of Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel).

But Yahawah amar (spoke) to Dawad (David) my ab (father), ‘Whereas it was in your labab (heart) to banah (build) a bayath (house) for my sham (name), you tawab (pleasant/functional) well that it was in your labab (heart):

Raq (nevertheless) you shall not banah (build) the bayath (house); but your ban (son) who shall yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of your body, he shall banah (build) the bayath (house) for my sham (name).’

Yahawah has qawam (rise up) his dabar (word / matter) that he dabar (word / matter); for I have qawam (rise up) up in the place of Dawad (David) my ab (father), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the kasaa (throne) of Yasharaal (Israel), as Yahawah dabar (word / matter), and have banah (built) the bayath (house) for the sham (name) of Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel).
There I have shawam (place / establish / appoint) the arawan (ark), in which is the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah, which he karath (cut) with the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel).
He imad (stood) panayam (before) the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah in the presence of all the qahal (assembly) of Yasharaal (Israel), and parash (spread) forth his kap (hands)

(For Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) made a bronze kayawar (scaffold), chamash (five) amah (cubits) arak (length), and chamash (five) amah (cubits) rachab (broad), and shalawash (three) amah (cubits) qawamah (high), and nathan (give) set it in the thawak (midst) of the izarah (court); and on it he imad (stood), and kneeled down on his barak (knees) before all the qahal (assembly) of Yasharaal (Israel), and parash (spread) forth his kap (hands) toward shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens));)

And he amar (spoke), Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), there is no Alahayam like you, in shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), or on aratz (Earth/land); you who shamar (keep/guard) barayath (covenant) and loving chasad (grace) with your ibad (servant), who halak (move) panayam (before) you with all their lab (heart);

Who have shamar (keep/guard) with your ibad (servant) Dawad (David) my ab (father) that which you dabar (word / matter) him: yes, you dabar (word / matter) with your pah (mouth), and malaa (have) fulfilled it with your yad (hand), as it is this yawam (day).

Now therefore, Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), shamar (keep/guard) with your ibad (servant) Dawad (David) my ab (father) that which you have dabar (word / matter) him, amar (spoke), ‘There shall not karath (cut) you a ayash (husband/individual man) in my panayam (sight) to yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the kasaa (throne) of Yasharaal (Israel), if only your ban (son) shamar (keep/guard) heed to their darak (way), to yalak (walk) in my thawarah (instruction) as you have yalak (walked) panayam (before) me.’
Now therefore, Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), let your dabar (word / matter) be aman (believe / have faith), which you dabar (word / matter) to your ibad (servant) Dawad (David).

But will Alahayam indeed yashab (inhabit/dwell) with adam (men) on the aratz (Earth/land)? Behold, shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) and the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) of shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) can't kawal (all/every/entire) you; how much less this bayath (house) which I have banah (built)!

Yet have panah (respect) for the thapalah (prayer) of your ibad (servant), and to his thachanah (supplication), Yahawah my Alahayam, to shamai (hearken / hear) to the ranah (cry) and to the thapalah (prayer) which your ibad (servant) palal (prays) panayam (before) you;

That your iyan (eye) may be pathach (open) toward this bayath (house) yawamam (by day) and layal (night), even toward the maqawam (place) where you have amar (spoke) that you would shawam (place / establish / appoint) your sham (name); to shamai (hearken / hear) to the thapalah (prayer) which your ibad (servant) shall palal (pray) toward this maqawam (place).

Shamai (hearken / hear) to the petitions of your ibad (servant), and of your im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel), when they shall palal (pray) toward this maqawam (place): yes, shamai (hearken / hear) from your yashab (inhabit/dwell) maqawam (place), even from shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)); and when you shamai (hearken / hear), salach (forgive/pardon/make clean).

If a ayash (husband/individual man) chataa (sin) against his neighbor, and an alah (these) is nashaa (lift) on him to cause him to alah (these), and he bawaa (come) and alah (these) panayam (before) your mazabach (altar) in this bayath (house);

Then shamai (hearken / hear) from shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), and ishah (make), and shapat (judge) your ibad (servant), shawab (turn back / repent) retribution to the rashai (wicked), to nathan (give) his darak (way) on his own raash (head); and justifying the tzadayaq (righteous), to nathan (give) him according to his tzadaqah (righteousness).

If your im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel) be nagap (struck) down panayam (before) the ayab (enemy), because they have chataa (sinned) against you, and shall shawab (turn back / repent) again and yadah (confess) your sham (name), and palal (pray) and chanan (make) supplication panayam (before) you in this bayath (house);

Then shamai (hearken / hear) from shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), and salach (forgive/pardon/make clean) the chataah (sin) of your im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel), and shawab (turn back / repent) them again to the adamah (land) which you nathan (give) to them and to their ab (father).

When the sky is itzar (shut) up, and there is no matar (rain), because they have chataa (sinned) against you; if they palal (pray) toward this maqawam (place), and yadah (confess) your sham (name), and shawab (turn back / repent) from their chataah (sin), when you inah (oppress / afflict) them:

Then shamai (hearken / hear) in shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), and salach (forgive/pardon/make clean) the chataah (sin) of your ibad (servant), and of your im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel), when you yarah (teach) them the tawab (pleasant/functional) darak (way) in which they should yalak (walk); and nathan (give) matar (rain) on your aratz (Earth/land), which you nathan (give) given to your im (people / nation) for an nachalah (inheritance).

If there is raib (famine) in the aratz (Earth/land), if there is dabar (word / matter), if there is blight or mildew, arabah (locust) or chasayal (caterpillar); if their ayab (enemy) besiege them in the aratz (Earth/land) of their shair (cities); whatever nagai (plague) or whatever machalah (sickness) there is;

Whatever thapalah (prayer) and thachanah (supplication) be made by any adam (man), or by all your im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel), who shall yadai (know) every ayash (husband/individual man) his own nagai (plague) and his own makaab (sorrow), and shall parash (spread) forth his kap (hands) toward this bayath (house):

Then shamai (hearken / hear) from shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), your yashab (inhabit/dwell) makawan (place) and salach (forgive/pardon/make clean), and nathan (give) to every ayash (husband/individual man) according to all his darak (ways), whose labab (heart) you yadai (know); (for you, even you only, yadai (know) the labab (hearts) of the ban (son) of adam (men);)
That they may yaraa (fear / be afraid) you, to yalak (walk) in your darak (ways), so yawam (day) as they chay (life) in the adamah (land) which you nathan (give) to our ab (father).

Moreover concerning the nakaray (foreigner), who is not of your im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel), when he shall bawaa (come) from a rachawaq (far) aratz (Earth/land) for your gadawal (very great/important/mighty) sham (name) sake, and your chazaq (mighty) yad (hand), and your natah (outstretched) zarawai (arm); when they shall bawaa (come) and palal (pray) toward this bayath (house):

Then shamai (hearken / hear) from shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), even from your yashab (inhabit/dwell) makawan (place), and ishah (make) according to all that the nakaray (foreigner) qaraa (called) to you for; that all the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land) may yadai (know) your sham (name), and yaraa (fear / be afraid) you, as does your im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel), and that they may yadai (know) that this bayath (house) which I have banah (built) is qaraa (called) by your sham (name).

If your im (people / nation) yatzaa (go out / come out) out to malachamah (battle) against their ayab (enemy), by whatever darak (way) you shall shalach (send) them, and they palal (pray) to you darak (toward) this iyar (city) which you have bachar (chosen), and the bayath (house) which I have banah (built) for your sham (name);
Then shamai (hearken / hear) from shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) their thapalah (prayer) and their thachanah (supplication), and ishah (make) their cause.

If they chataa (sin) against you (for there is no adam (man) who doesn't chataa (sin)), and you are anap (angry) with them, and nathan (give) them to the ayab (enemy), so that they shabah (carry) them away shabah (captive) to a aratz (Earth/land) rachawaq (far) off or qarawab (near);

Yet if they shall shawab (turn back / repent) themselves in the aratz (Earth/land) where they are shabah (carried) captive, and shawab (turn back / repent) again, and chanan (make) supplication to you in the aratz (Earth/land) of their shabayah (captivity), amar (spoke), ‘We have chataa (sinned), we have rashai (done) perversely, and have dealt wickedly;’

If they shawab (turn back / repent) to you with all their lab (heart) and with all their napash (living being/soul) in the aratz (Earth/land) of their shabayah (captivity), where they have shabah (carried) them captive, and palal (pray) darak (toward) their aratz (Earth/land), which you nathan (give) to their ab (father), and the iyar (city) which you have bachar (chosen), and toward the bayath (house) which I have banah (built) for your sham (name):

Then shamai (hearken / hear) from shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), even from your yashab (inhabit/dwell) makawan (place), their thapalah (prayer) and their petitions, and ishah (make) their cause, and salach (forgive/pardon/make clean) your im (people / nation) who have chataa (sinned) against you.
Now, my Alahayam, let, I beg you, your iyan (eye) be pathach (open), and let your azan (ears) be qashab (attentive), to the thapalah (prayer) that is made in this maqawam (place).

Now therefore qawam (rise up), Yahawah Alahayam, into your nawach (resting) place, you, and the arawan (ark) of your iz (strength / might / refuge): let your kahan (priest), Yahawah Alahayam, be labash (clothed) with thashawaih (deliverance), and let your chasayad (saints) shamach (rejoice) in goodness.

Yahawah Alahayam, don't shawab (turn back / repent) away the panayam (face) of your mashayach (anointed one). Zakar (remembrance/memory) your chasad (grace) kindnesses to Dawad (David) your ibad (servant).

Now when Shalamah (Solomon) kalah (complete / finish) made an end of palal (praying), the ash (fire) yarad (came) down from shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), and akal (eat) the burnt ilah (offering) and the zabach (sacrifices); and the kabawad (glory) of Yahawah malaa (filled) the bayath (house).
The kahan (priest) yakal (could) not bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah, because the kabawad (glory) of Yahawah malaa (filled) yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) bayath (house).

All the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) raah (see) on, when the ash (fire) yarad (came) down, and the kabawad (glory) of Yahawah was on the bayath (house); and they karai (bowed) themselves with their ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) to the aratz (Earth/land) on the ratzapah (pavement), and shachah (worshiped), and gave yadah (thanks) to Yahawah, saying, For he is tawab (pleasant/functional); for his loving chasad (grace) endures for iwalam (forever).
Then the malak (king) and all the im (people / nation) zabach (offered) zabach (sacrifice) panayam (before) Yahawah.

Malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) zabach (offered) a zabach (sacrifice) of isharayam (twenty) - shanayam (two) alap (thousand) baqar (morning) of cattle, and a maah (hundred) and isharayam (twenty) alap (thousand) tzaan (sheep). So the malak (king) and all the im (people / nation) chanak (dedicated) the bayath (house) of Alahayam.

The kahan (priest) imad (stood), according to their positions; the Lawayay (Levites) also with kalay (instruments) of music of Yahawah, which Dawad (David) the malak (king) ishah (make) made to give yadah (thanks) to Yahawah, when Dawad (David) yadah (praised) by their yad (hand), saying "For his loving chasad (grace) endures for iwalam (forever)." The kahan (priest) chatzar (sounded) trumpets before them; and all Yasharaal (Israel) imad (stood).

Moreover Shalamah (Solomon) made the thawak (midst) of the chatzar (court) qadash (set apart/make holy) that panayam (was) before the bayath (house) of Yahawah; for there he ishah (make) the burnt ilah (offerings), and the chalab (fat) of the shalam (peace) offerings, because the bronze mazabach (altar) which Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) made was not yakal (able) to kawal (all/every/entire) the burnt ilah (offering), and the meal manachah (offering), and the chalab (fat).

So Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) the chag (feast/festival) at that ith (time) shabai (seven) yawam (day), and all Yasharaal (Israel) with him, a very gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qahal (assembly), from the entrance of Chamath (Hamath) to the nachal (stream / river) of Matzarayam (Egypt).

On the shamayanay (eighth) yawam (day) they ishah (make) a solemn itzarah (assembly): for they ishah (make) the chanakah (dedication) of the mazabach (altar) shabai (seven) yawam (day), and the chag (feast/festival) shabai (seven) yawam (day).

On the shalawash (three) and isharayam (twenty) yawam (day) of the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month) he shalach (send) the im (people / nation) shalach (send) to their ahal (tents), tawab (pleasant/functional) and shamach (glad) of lab (heart) for the goodness that Yahawah ishah (make) shown to Dawad (David), and to Shalamah (Solomon), and to Yasharaal (Israel) his im (people / nation).

Thus Shalamah (Solomon) kalah (complete / finish) the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and the malak (king) bayath (house): and he successfully completed all that bawaa (come) into Shalamah (Solomon's) lab (heart) to ishah (make) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and in his own bayath (house).

Yahawah raah (see) to Shalamah (Solomon) by layal (night), and amar (spoke) to him, I have shamai (hearken / hear) your thapalah (prayer), and have bachar (chosen) this maqawam (place) to myself for a bayath (house) of zabach (sacrifice).

If I itzar (shut) up the sky so that there is no matar (rain), or if I tzawah (command) the chagab (locust) to akal (eat) the aratz (Earth/land), or if I shalach (send) dabar (word / matter) among my im (people / nation);

If my im (people / nation), who are qaraa (called) by my sham (name), shall kanai (humble) themselves, and palal (pray), and baqash (seek) my panayam (face), and shawab (turn back / repent) from their rai (wicked) darak (ways); then will I shamai (hearken / hear) from shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), and will salach (forgive/pardon/make clean) their chataah (sin), and will rapaa (heal) their aratz (Earth/land).
Now my iyan (eye) shall be pathach (open), and my azan (ears) qashab (attentive), to the thapalah (prayer) that is made in this maqawam (place).

For now have I bachar (chosen) and made this bayath (house) qadash (set apart/make holy), that my sham (name) may be there iwalam (forever); and my iyan (eye) and my lab (heart) shall be there yawam (day).

As for you, if you will yalak (walk) panayam (before) me as Dawad (David) your ab (father) yalak (walked), and ishah (make) according to all that I have tzawah (commanded) you, and will shamar (keep/guard) my chaq (statute) and my mashapat (ordinances);

Then I will qawam (rise up) the kasaa (throne) of your malakawath (kingdom), according as I karath (cut) with Dawad (David) your ab (father), amar (spoke), ‘There shall not karath (cut) you a ayash (husband/individual man) to be mashal (rule/have dominion) in Yasharaal (Israel).’

But if you shawab (turn back / repent) away, and izab (forsake) my chaqah (statutes) and my matzawah (commandments) which I nathan (give) set panayam (before) you, and shall halak (move) and ibad (servant) other Alahayam, and shachah (worship) them;

Then I will nathash (pluck) them up by the roots out of my adamah (land) which I nathan (give) given them; and this bayath (house), which I have made qadash (set apart/make holy) for my sham (name), I will shalak (cast) out of my panayam (sight), and I will nathan (give) it a mashal (proverb) and a shanayanah (byword) among all im (people / nation).

This bayath (house), which is so ilayawan (high), everyone who passes by it shall be shamam (astonished), and shall amar (spoke), ‘Why has Yahawah ishah (make) thus to this aratz (Earth/land), and to this bayath (house)?’

They shall amar (spoke), ‘Because they abandoned Yahawah, the Alahayam of their ab (father), who yatzaa (go out / come out) them forth out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and chazaq (took) other Alahayam, shachah (worshiped) them, and ibad (servant) them. Therefore he bawaa (come) brought all this rai (evil) on them.’
It happened at the qatz (end) of isharayam (twenty) shanah (years), in which Shalamah (Solomon) had banah (built) the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and his own bayath (house),

That the iyar (cities) which Chawaram (Huram) nathan (give) given to Shalamah (Solomon), Shalamah (Solomon) banah (built) them, and caused the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) to yashab (inhabit/dwell) there.
Shalamah (Solomon) yalak (went) to Chamathatzawabah (Hamath) Zobah, and chazaq (prevailed) against it.
He banah (built) Thadamar (Tadmor) in the madabar (wilderness), and all the storage iyar (cities), which he banah (built) in Chamath (Hamath).

Also he banah (built) Bayathachawarawan (Beth) Horon the ilayawan (upper), and Bayathachawarawan (Beth) Horon the thachathawan (lower), fortified iyar (cities), with chawamah (walls), dalath (gates), and barayach (bars);

And Bailath (Baalath), and all the storage iyar (cities) that Shalamah (Solomon) had, and all the iyar (cities) for his rakab (chariots), and the iyar (cities) for his horsemen, and all that Shalamah (Solomon) chashaq (desired) to banah (build) for his pleasure in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and in Labanawan (Lebanon), and in all the aratz (Earth/land) of his mamashal (authority).

As for all the im (people / nation) who were yathar (left) of the Chathay (Hittites), and the Amaray (Amorites), and the Parazay (Perizzites), and the Chaway (Hivites), and the Yabawasay (Jebusites), who were not of Yasharaal (Israel);

Of their ban (son) who were yathar (left) achar (other) them in the aratz (Earth/land), whom the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) didn't kalah (complete / finish), of them Shalamah (Solomon) conscripted forced mas (labor) to this yawam (day).

But of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), Shalamah (Solomon) nathan (give) no ibad (servant) for his malaakah (work); but they were ban (son) of malachamah (war), and shar (prince / ruler) of his shalayash (captains), and shar (prince / ruler) of his rakab (chariots) and of his horsemen.

These were the shar (prince / ruler) natzayab (officers) of malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon), even two - maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty), who radah (rule over / have dominion of / subdue) over the im (people / nation).

Shalamah (Solomon) ilah (go up / offer) up the bath (daughter) of Paraih (Pharaoh) out of the iyar (city) of Dawad (David) to the bayath (house) that he had banah (built) for her; for he amar (spoke), My ashah (wife/individual woman) shall not yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the bayath (house) of Dawad (David) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel), because the places where the arawan (ark) of Yahawah bawaa (come) come are qadash (set apart/make holy).
Then Shalamah (Solomon) ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilah (offerings) to Yahawah on the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah, which he had banah (built) panayam (before) the awalam (porch),

Even as the dabar (word / matter) of every yawam (day) required, ilah (go up / offer) according to the matzawah (commandment) of Mashah (Moses), on the shabath (shabath/rest), and on the new chadash (month), and on the mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) feasts, shalawash (three) paim (times) in the shanah (year), in the chag (feast/festival) of unleavened matzah (bread), and in the chag (feast/festival) of shabawai (weeks), and in the chag (feast/festival) of sakah (tents).

He imad (appointed), according to the mashapat (ordinance) of Dawad (David) his ab (father), the machalaqath (divisions) of the kahan (priest) to their ibadah (service), and the Lawayay (Levites) to their mashamarath (duty / watch), to halal (praise), and to sharath (minister) before the kahan (priest), as the dabar (word / matter) of every yawam (day) yawam (day); the shawair (doorkeepers) also by their machalaqath (divisions) at every shair (gate): for so had Dawad (David) the ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam commanded.
They didn't sawar (depart) from the matzawah (commandment) of the malak (king) to the kahan (priest) and Lawayay (Levites) dabar (word / matter) any matter, or concerning the awatzar (treasures).

Now all the malaakah (work) of Shalamah (Solomon) was kawan (prepared) to the yawam (day) of the mawasad (foundation) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and until it was kalah (complete / finish). So the bayath (house) of Yahawah was completed.
Then halak (move) Shalamah (Solomon) to Itzayawanagabar (Ezion) Geber, and to Ayalawath (Eloth), on the shapah (seashore) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Adam (Edom).

Chawaram (Huram) shalach (send) him anayah (ships) and ibad (servant) who had yadai (knowledge) of the yam (sea/waters) by the yad (hand) of his ibad (servant); and they bawaa (come) with the ibad (servant) of Shalamah (Solomon) to Awapayar (Ophir), and laqach (take / seized) from there arabai (four) maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) kakar (talents) of zahab (gold), and bawaa (come) them to malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon).

When the malakah (queen) of Shabaa (Sheba) shamai (hearken / hear) of the shamai (fame) of Shalamah (Solomon), she bawaa (come) to nasah (prove) Shalamah (Solomon) with chayadah (hard) questions at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), with a very kabad (great) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), and gamal (camels) that nashaa (lift) basham (spices), and zahab (gold) in rab (abundance), and yaqar (precious) aban (stone): and when she bawaa (come) come to Shalamah (Solomon), she dabar (word / matter) with him of all that was in her labab (heart).
Shalamah (Solomon) nagad (told) her all her dabar (word / matter); and there was not anything ilam (hidden) from Shalamah (Solomon) which he didn't nagad (tell) her.
When the malakah (queen) of Shabaa (Sheba) raah (see) seen the chakamah (wisdom) of Shalamah (Solomon), and the bayath (house) that he had banah (built),

And the maakal (food) of his shalachan (table), and the mawashab (sitting) of his ibad (servant), and the maimad (attendance) of his sharath (ministers), and their clothing, his cup bearers also, and their clothing, and his ilayah (ascent) by which he ilah (go up / offer) up to the bayath (house) of Yahawah; there was no more rawach (spirit / wind) in her.

She amar (spoke) to the malak (king), It was a amath (truth) dabar (word / matter) that I shamai (hearken / hear) in my own aratz (Earth/land) of your dabar (word / matter), and of your chakamah (wisdom).

However I didn't aman (believe / have faith) their dabar (word / matter), until I bawaa (come), and my iyan (eye) raah (see) seen it; and behold, the chatzay (half) of the marabayath (greatness) of your chakamah (wisdom) was not nagad (told) me: you yasap (exceed) the shamawaih (fame) that I shamai (hearken / hear).

Ashar (who/that) are your ayash (husband/individual man), and ashar (who/that) are these your ibad (servant), who imad (stand) continually panayam (before) you, and shamai (hearken / hear) your chakamah (wisdom).

Barak (blessed) be Yahawah your Alahayam, who chapatz (delighted) in you, to nathan (give) you on his kasaa (throne), to be malak (king) for Yahawah your Alahayam: because your Alahayam ahabah (loved) Yasharaal (Israel), to imad (establish) them iwalam (forever), therefore nathan (give) he you malak (king) over them, to ishah (make) mashapat (justice) and tzadaqah (righteousness).

She nathan (give) the malak (king) one maah (hundred) and isharayam (twenty) kakar (talents) of zahab (gold), and basham (spices) in maad (great) rab (abundance), and yaqar (precious) aban (stone): neither was there any such basham (spice) as the malakah (queen) of Shabaa (Sheba) nathan (give) to malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon).

The ibad (servant) also of Chayaram (Huram), and the ibad (servant) of Shalamah (Solomon), who bawaa (come) zahab (gold) from Awapayar (Ophir), bawaa (come) alagawamayam (algum) itz (trees) and yaqar (precious) aban (stone).

The malak (king) ishah (make) of the alagawamayam (algum) itz (trees) masalah (terraces) for the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and for the malak (king) bayath (house), and kanawar (harps) and stringed instruments for the singers: and there were none ham (like) these raah (see) panayam (before) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah).

Malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) nathan (give) to the malakah (queen) of Shabaa (Sheba) all her chapatz (desire), whatever she shaal (asked), besides that which she bawaa (come) brought to the malak (king). So she hapak (turned), and yalak (went) to her own aratz (Earth/land), she and her ibad (servant).

Now the mashaqal (weight) of zahab (gold) that bawaa (come) to Shalamah (Solomon) in achad (one) shanah (year) was shash (six) maah (hundred) and shashayam (sixty) - shash (six) kakar (talents) of zahab (gold),

Besides that which the traders and sachar (merchants) bawaa (come): and all the malak (king) of Irab (Arabia) and the pachah (governors) of the aratz (Earth/land) bawaa (come) zahab (gold) and kasap (silver) to Shalamah (Solomon).

Malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) two maah (hundred) tzanah (bucklers) of shachat (beaten) zahab (gold); shash (six) maah (hundred) shekels of shachat (beaten) zahab (gold) ilah (go up / offer) to achad (one) tzanah (buckler).

He made shalawash (three) maah (hundred) magan (shield) of shachat (beaten) zahab (gold); shalawash (three) maah (hundred) shekels of zahab (gold) ilah (go up / offer) to achad (one) magan (shield): and the malak (king) nathan (give) them in the bayath (house) of the yair (forest) of Labanawan (Lebanon).
Moreover the malak (king) ishah (make) a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kasaa (throne) of shan (ivory), and overlaid it with tahawar (pure) zahab (gold).

And there were shash (six) mailah (ascent/climbing up) to the kasaa (throne), with a kabash (footstool) of zahab (gold), which were achaz (fastened) to the kasaa (throne), and yad (hand) on either side by the maqawam (place) of the yashab (inhabit/dwell), and shanayam (two) aray (lions) imad (standing) beside the yad (hand).
Shanayam (two) aray (lions) imad (stood) there on the one side and on the other on the shash (six) mailah (ascent/climbing up): there was nothing like it ishah (make) in any mamalakah (kingdom).

All malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon's) mashaqah (drinking) kalay (vessels) were of zahab (gold), and all the kalay (vessels) of the bayath (house) of the yair (forest) of Labanawan (Lebanon) were of sagar (pure) zahab (gold): kasap (silver) was maawamah (nothing) chashab (accounted) of in the yawam (day) of Shalamah (Solomon).

For the malak (king) had anayah (ships) that halak (move) to Tharashayash (Tarshish) with the ibad (servant) of Chawaram (Huram); achad (one) every shalawash (three) shanah (years) bawaa (come) the anayah (ships) of Tharashayash (Tarshish), nashaa (lift) zahab (gold), and kasap (silver), shanahabayam (ivory), and qawap (apes), and thakay (peacocks).
So malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) gadal (exceeded) all the malak (king) of the aratz (Earth/land) in riches and chakamah (wisdom).

All the malak (king) of the aratz (Earth/land) baqash (sought) the panayam (presence) of Shalamah (Solomon), to shamai (hearken / hear) his chakamah (wisdom), which Alahayam nathan (give) put in his lab (heart).

They bawaa (come) every ayash (husband/individual man) his tribute, kalay (vessels) of kasap (silver), and kalay (vessels) of zahab (gold), and clothing, armor, and basham (spices), sawas (horses), and parad (mules), a dabar (word / matter) shanah (year) by shanah (year).

Shalamah (Solomon) had arabai (four) alap (thousand) arawah (stalls) for sawas (horses) and marakabah (chariots), and shanayam (two) alap (thousand) horsemen, that he stationed in the rakab (chariot) iyar (cities), and with the malak (king) at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

He mashal (rule/have dominion) over all the malak (king) from the nahar (river) even to the aratz (Earth/land) of the Palashathay (Philistines), and to the gabawal (border/boundary) of Matzarayam (Egypt).

The malak (king) nathan (give) kasap (silver) to be in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) as aban (stone), and he nathan (give) araz (cedars) to be as the shaqamah (sycamore) trees that are in the lowland, for rab (abundance).
They yatzaa (go out / come out) sawas (horses) for Shalamah (Solomon) out of Matzarayam (Egypt), and out of all aratz (Earth/land).

Now the shaar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Shalamah (Solomon), raashawan (first) and acharawan (last), aren't they kathab (written) in the history of Nathan (Nathan) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), and in the nabawaah (prophecy) of Achayah (Ahijah) the Shayalawanay (Shilonite), and in the chazawath (visions) of Yaiday (Iddo) the chazah (seer) concerning Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat)?
Shalamah (Solomon) malak (king) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) over all Yasharaal (Israel) arabaiyam (forty) shanah (years).
Shalamah (Solomon) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and he was qabar (bury) in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David) his ab (father): and Rachabaim (Rehoboam) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.
Rachabaim (Rehoboam) yalak (went) to Shakam (Shechem); for all Yasharaal (Israel) bawaa (come) come to Shakam (Shechem) to make him malak (king).

It happened, when Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat) shamai (hearken / hear) of it, (for he was in Matzarayam (Egypt), where he had barach (fled) from the panayam (presence) of malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon)), that Yarabaim (Jeroboam) shawab (turn back / repent) out of Matzarayam (Egypt).
They shalach (send) and qaraa (called) him; and Yarabaim (Jeroboam) and all Yasharaal (Israel) bawaa (come), and they dabar (word / matter) to Rachabaim (Rehoboam), amar (spoke),

Your ab (father) made our il (over) qashah (rough / hard): now therefore make you the qashah (rough / hard) ibadah (service) of your ab (father), and his kabad (heavy) il (over) which he nathan (give) on us, lighter, and we will ibad (servant) you.
He amar (spoke) to them, "shawab (turn back / repent) again to me after shalawash (three) yawam (day)." The im (people / nation) departed.

Malak (king) Rachabaim (Rehoboam) took yaitz (counsel) with the zaqan (old) men, who had imad (stood) panayam (before) Shalamah (Solomon) his ab (father) while he yet chay (life), amar (spoke), ayak (what) yaitz (counsel) do you give me to shawab (turn back / repent) dabar (word / matter) to this im (people / nation)?

They dabar (word / matter) to him, amar (spoke), If you are kind to this im (people / nation), and ratzah (please) them, and dabar (word / matter) tawab (pleasant/functional) dabar (word / matter) to them, then they will be your ibad (servant) yawam (day).

But he forsook the itzah (counsel) of the zaqan (old) men which they had yaitz (given) him, and took yaitz (counsel) with the yalad (birth / begot) men who had gadal (grown) up with him, who imad (stood) panayam (before) him.

He amar (spoke) to them, What yaitz (counsel) do you give, that we may shawab (turn back / repent) dabar (word / matter) to this im (people / nation), who have dabar (word / matter) to me, amar (spoke), ‘Make the il (over) that your ab (father) nathan (give) on us lighter?’

The yalad (birth / begot) men who had gadal (grown) up with him dabar (word / matter) to him, amar (spoke), Thus you shall amar (spoke) the im (people / nation) who dabar (word / matter) to you, amar (spoke), ‘Your ab (father) kabad (made) our il (over) kabad (heavy), but qalal (make) it lighter on us;’ thus you shall amar (spoke) to them, ‘My qatan (small/young/least) finger is ibah (thicker) than my ab (father) waist.

Ithah (now / present moment) whereas my ab (father) imas (burdened) you with a kabad (heavy) il (over), I will yasap (add) to your il (over). My ab (father) yasar (chastised) you with shawat (whips), but I will chastise you with iqarab (scorpions).’

So Yarabaim (Jeroboam) and all the im (people / nation) bawaa (come) to Rachabaim (Rehoboam) the shalayashay (third) yawam (day), as the malak (king) asked, amar (spoke), shawab (turn back / repent) to me again the shalayashay (third) yawam (day).
The malak (king) inah (answer / respond) them qashah (rough / hard); and malak (king) Rachabaim (Rehoboam) forsook the itzah (counsel) of the zaqan (old) men,

And dabar (word / matter) to them after the itzah (counsel) of the yalad (birth / begot) men, amar (spoke), My ab (father) made your il (over) kabad (heavy), but I will yasap (add) to it. My ab (father) yasar (chastised) you with shawat (whips), but I will chastise you with iqarab (scorpions).

So the malak (king) didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to the im (people / nation); for it was brought about of Alahayam, that Yahawah might qawam (rise up) his dabar (word / matter), which he dabar (word / matter) by Achayah (Ahijah) the Shayalawanay (Shilonite) to Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat).

When all Yasharaal (Israel) raah (see) that the malak (king) didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to them, the im (people / nation) shawab (turn back / repent) the malak (king), amar (spoke), "What chalaq (portion) have we in Dawad (David)? Neither have we nachalah (inheritance) in the ban (son) of Yashay (Jesse)! Every ayash (husband/individual man) to your ahal (tents), Yasharaal (Israel)! Now raah (see) to your own bayath (house), Dawad (David)." So all Yasharaal (Israel) departed to their ahal (tents).
But as for the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) who lived in the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), Rachabaim (Rehoboam) malak (king) over them.

Then malak (king) Rachabaim (Rehoboam) shalach (send) Hadawaram (Hadoram), who was over the men subject to forced mas (labor); and the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) ragam (stoned) him to mawath (death) with aban (stone). Malak (king) Rachabaim (Rehoboam) amatz (made) speed to ilah (go up / offer) himself up to his marakabah (chariot), to nawas (flee) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
So Yasharaal (Israel) pashai (rebelled) against the bayath (house) of Dawad (David) to this yawam (day).

When Rachabaim (Rehoboam) bawaa (come) come to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), he qahal (assembled) the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Banayamayan (Benjamin), one maah (hundred) shamanayam (eighty) alap (thousand) bachar (chosen) ishah (make), who were warriors, to lacham (fight) against Yasharaal (Israel), to shawab (turn back / repent) the mamalakah (kingdom) again to Rachabaim (Rehoboam).
But the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) the ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam, amar (spoke),

"Amar (spoke) to Rachabaim (Rehoboam) the ban (son) of Shalamah (Solomon), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and to all Yasharaal (Israel) in Yahawadah (Judah) and Banayamayan (Benjamin), amar (spoke),

‘Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, "You shall not ilah (go up / offer) up, nor lacham (fight) against your ach (brother/kinsman)! Shawab (turn back / repent) every ayash (husband/individual man) to his bayath (house); for this thing is of me."’" So they shamai (hearken / hear) to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, and shawab (turn back / repent) from yalak (going) against Yarabaim (Jeroboam).
Rachabaim (Rehoboam) lived in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and banah (built) iyar (cities) for defense in Yahawadah (Judah).
He banah (built) Bayathalacham (Bethlehem), and Iyatam (Etam), and Thaqawai (Tekoa),
Bayathatzawar (Beth) Zur, and Shawakah (Soco), and Idalam (Adullam),
And gath (gath), and Maraashah (Mareshah), and Zayap (Ziph),
And Adawarayam (Adoraim), and Lakayash (Lachish), and Izaqah (Azekah),
And Tzaraih (Zorah), and Ayalawan (Aijalon), and Chabarawan (Hebron), which are in Yahawadah (Judah) and in Banayamayan (Benjamin), fortified iyar (cities).
He chazaq (fortified) the strongholds, and nathan (give) nagayad (captains) in them, and awatzar (stores) of maakal (food), and shaman (oil) and yayan (wine).
He put tzanah (shields) and ramach (spears) in every iyar (city), and rabah (made) them exceeding chazaq (strong). Yahawadah (Judah) and Banayamayan (Benjamin) belonged to him.
The kahan (priest) and the Lawayay (Levites) who were in all Yasharaal (Israel) yatzab (resorted) to him out of all their gabawal (border/boundary).

For the Lawayay (Levites) izab (left) their magarash (suburbs) and their achazah (possession), and yalak (came) to Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): for Yarabaim (Jeroboam) and his ban (son) zanach (cast) them off, that they should not execute the kahan (priest) office to Yahawah;
And he imad (appointed) him kahan (priest) for the bamah (high) places, and for the male shaiyar (goats), and for the calves which he ishah (make) made.

Achar (other) them, out of all the shabat (tribes) of Yasharaal (Israel), such as nathan (give) their labab (hearts) to baqash (seek) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), bawaa (come) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to zabach (sacrifice) to Yahawah, the Alahayam of their ab (father).

So they chazaq (strengthened) the malakawath (kingdom) of Yahawadah (Judah), and made Rachabaim (Rehoboam) the ban (son) of Shalamah (Solomon) amatz (strong), shalawash (three) shanah (years); for they halak (move) shalawash (three) shanah (years) in the darak (way) of Dawad (David) and Shalamah (Solomon).

Rachabaim (Rehoboam) laqach (take / seized) him a ashah (wife/individual woman), Machalath (Mahalath) the bath (daughter) of Yarayamawath (Jerimoth) the ban (son) of Dawad (David), and of Abayahayal (Abihail) the bath (daughter) of Alayaab (Eliab) the ban (son) of Yashay (Jesse);
And she yalad (birth / begot) him ban (son): Yaiwash (Jeush), and Shamarayah (Shemariah), and Zaham (Zaham).

Achar (other) her he laqach (take / seized) Maikah (Maacah) the bath (daughter) of Abayashalawam (Absalom); and she yalad (birth / begot) him Abayah (Abijah), and Ithay (Attai), and Zayazaa (Ziza), and Shalamayath (Shelomith).

Rachabaim (Rehoboam) ahab (love) Maikah (Maacah) the bath (daughter) of Abayashalawam (Absalom) above all his wives and his payalagash (concubines): (for he nashaa (lift) eighteen wives, and shashayam (sixty) payalagash (concubines), and became the yalad (birth / begot) of isharayam (twenty) - shamanah (eight) ban (son) and shashayam (sixty) bath (daughter).)

Rachabaim (Rehoboam) imad (appointed) Abayah (Abijah) the ban (son) Maikah (of) Maacah to be raash (head), the nagayad (prince) among his ach (brother/kinsman); for he intended to make him malak (king).

He dealt wisely, and paratz (dispersed) of all his ban (son) throughout all the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Banayamayan (Benjamin), to every fortified iyar (city): and he nathan (give) them food in rab (abundance). He sought for them many wives.

It happened, when the malakawath (kingdom) of Rachabaim (Rehoboam) was kawan (established), and he was chazaqah (strong), that he forsook the thawarah (instruction) of Yahawah, and all Yasharaal (Israel) with him.

It happened in the chamayashay (fifth) shanah (year) of malak (king) Rachabaim (Rehoboam), that Shayashaq (Shishak) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt) ilah (go up / offer) up against Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), because they had mail (top/above) against Yahawah,

With twelve maah (hundred) rakab (chariots), and shashayam (sixty) alap (thousand) horsemen. The im (people / nation) were without masapar (number) who bawaa (come) with him out of Matzarayam (Egypt): the Lawabay (Lubim), the sakay (sukkiim), and the Kawashay (Ethiopians).
He lakad (took) the fortified iyar (cities) which pertained to Yahawadah (Judah), and bawaa (come) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Now Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) bawaa (come) to Rachabaim (Rehoboam), and to the shar (prince / ruler) of Yahawadah (Judah), who were asap (gathered) together to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) panayam (because) of Shayashaq (Shishak), and amar (spoke) to them, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, ‘You have forsaken me, therefore have I also izab (left) you in the yad (hand) of Shayashaq (Shishak).’
Then the shar (prince / ruler) of Yasharaal (Israel) and the malak (king) kanai (humbled) themselves; and they amar (spoke), Yahawah is tzadayaq (righteous).

When Yahawah raah (see) that they kanai (humbled) themselves, the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Shamaiyah (Shemaiah), amar (spoke), They have kanai (humbled) themselves. I will not shachath (destroy) them; but I will nathan (give) them some palayatah (deliverance), and my chamah (wrath) shall not be nathak (poured) out on Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) by the yad (hand) of Shayashaq (Shishak).
Nevertheless they shall be his ibad (servant), that they may yadai (know) my ibadah (service), and the ibadah (service) of the mamalakah (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land).

So Shayashaq (Shishak) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt) ilah (go up / offer) up against Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and laqach (take / seized) away the awatzar (treasures) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and the awatzar (treasures) of the malak (king) bayath (house). He laqach (take / seized) it all laqach (take / seized). He also took away the magan (shield) of zahab (gold) which Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) made.

Malak (king) Rachabaim (Rehoboam) ishah (make) in their place magan (shield) of nachashath (brass), and paqad (visit) them to the yad (hand) of the shar (prince / ruler) of the rawatz (guard), who shamar (keep/guard) the pathach (door) of the malak (king) bayath (house).

It was so, that as often as the malak (king) bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah, the rawatz (guard) bawaa (come) and nashaa (lift) them, and shawab (turn back / repent) them back into the rawatz (guard) room.

When he kanai (humbled) himself, the ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah shawab (turn back / repent) from him, so as not to shachath (destroy) him kalah (complete / finish): and moreover in Yahawadah (Judah) there were tawab (pleasant/functional) things found.

So malak (king) Rachabaim (Rehoboam) chazaq (strengthened) himself in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and malak (king): for Rachabaim (Rehoboam) was arabaiyam (forty) - achad (one) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king), and he malak (king) seventeen shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), the iyar (city) which Yahawah had bachar (chosen) out of all the shabat (tribes) of Yasharaal (Israel), to shawam (place / establish / appoint) his sham (name) there: and his am (mother) sham (name) was Naimah (Naamah) the imawanayath (ammonitess).
He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil), because he didn't kawan (set) his lab (heart) to darash (seek) Yahawah.

Now the dabar (word / matter) of Rachabaim (Rehoboam), raashawan (first) and acharawan (last), aren't they kathab (written) in the histories of Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) and of Idaw (Iddo) the chazah (seer), yachash (after) the way of genealogies? There were malachamah (wars) between Rachabaim (Rehoboam) and Yarabaim (Jeroboam) yawam (day).
Rachabaim (Rehoboam) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and was qabar (bury) in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David): and Abayah (Abijah) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.
In the eighteenth shanah (year) of malak (king) Yarabaim (Jeroboam) began Abayah (Abijah) to malak (king) over Yahawadah (Judah).

He malak (king) shalawash (three) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Mayakayahaw (Micaiah) the bath (daughter) of Awarayaal (Uriel) of Gabaih (Gibeah). There was malachamah (war) between Abayah (Abijah) and Yarabaim (Jeroboam).

Abayah (Abijah) joined malachamah (battle) with an chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of gabawar (valiant) men of malachamah (war), even arabai (four) maah (hundred) alap (thousand) bachar (chosen) gabawar (men): and Yarabaim (Jeroboam) set the malachamah (battle) in irak (array) against him with shamanah (eight) maah (hundred) alap (thousand) bachar (chosen) ayash (husband/individual man), who were ayash (husband/individual man) men of valor.

Abayah (Abijah) qawam (rise up) up on har (mountain) Tzamarayam (Zemaraim), which is in the har (mountain) country of Aparayam (Ephraim), and amar (spoke), shamai (hearken / hear) me, Yarabaim (Jeroboam) and all Yasharaal (Israel):

Ought you not to yadai (know) that Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), nathan (give) the mamalakah (kingdom) over Yasharaal (Israel) to Dawad (David) iwalam (forever), even to him and to his ban (son) by a barayath (covenant) of malach (salt)?
Yet Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat), the ibad (servant) of Shalamah (Solomon) the ban (son) of Dawad (David), qawam (rise up) up, and marad (rebelled) against his Adawan.

There were qabatz (gathered) to him worthless ayash (husband/individual man), base ayash (husband/individual man), who amatz (strengthened) themselves against Rachabaim (Rehoboam) the ban (son) of Shalamah (Solomon), when Rachabaim (Rehoboam) was nair (young) and rak (tenderhearted), and could not chazaq (withstand) them.

Now you amar (spoke) to chazaq (withstand) the panayam (kingdom) of Yahawah in the yad (hand) of the ban (son) of Dawad (David); and you are a rab (great) hamawan (multitude), and there are with you the zahab (gold) calves which Yarabaim (Jeroboam) ishah (make) you for Alahayam.

Haven't you nadach (driven) out the kahan (priest) of Yahawah, the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron), and the Lawayay (Levites), and ishah (make) kahan (priest) for yourselves after the ways of the im (people / nation) of other aratz (Earth/land)? So that whoever bawaa (come) to malaa (consecrate) himself with a ban (son) par (bull) and shabai (seven) ayal (rams), the same may be a kahan (priest) of those who are no Alahayam.

But as for us, Yahawah is our Alahayam, and we have not forsaken him; and we have kahan (priest) sharath (ministering) to Yahawah, the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron), and the Lawayay (Levites) in their malaakah (work):

And they qatar (burn) to Yahawah every baqar (morning) and every irab (evening) burnt ilah (offerings) and sam (sweet) qatarath (incense). They also set the show lacham (bread) in order on the tahawar (pure) shalachan (table); and the lampstand of zahab (gold) with its nayar (lamps), to bair (burn) every irab (evening): for we shamar (keep/guard) the instruction of Yahawah our Alahayam; but you have forsaken him.

Behold, Alahayam is with us at our raash (head), and his kahan (priest) with the chatzatzarah (trumpets) of rawai (alarm) to rawai (sound) an alarm against you. Ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), don't lacham (fight) against Yahawah, the Alahayam of your ab (father); for you shall not tzalach (prosper).
But Yarabaim (Jeroboam) caused an maarab (ambush) to bawaa (come) sabab (about) achar (other) them: so they were panayam (before) Yahawadah (Judah), and the maarab (ambush) was achar (other) them.

When Yahawadah (Judah) panah (looked) back, behold, the malachamah (battle) panayam (was) before and achawar (behind) them; and they tzaiq (cried) to Yahawah, and the kahan (priest) chatzar (sounded) with the chatzatzarah (trumpets).

Then the ayash (husband/individual man) of Yahawadah (Judah) gave a rawai (shout): and as the ayash (husband/individual man) of Yahawadah (Judah) rawai (shouted), it happened, that Alahayam nagap (struck) Yarabaim (Jeroboam) and all Yasharaal (Israel) panayam (before) Abayah (Abijah) and Yahawadah (Judah).
The ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) nawas (fled) panayam (before) Yahawadah (Judah); and Alahayam nathan (give) them into their yad (hand).

Abayah (Abijah) and his im (people / nation) nakah (killed) them with a rab (great) makah (slaughter): so there napal (fall / be cast down) down chalal (slain) of Yasharaal (Israel) chamash (five) maah (hundred) alap (thousand) bachar (chosen) ayash (husband/individual man).

Thus the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) were kanai (brought) under at that ith (time), and the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah) amatz (prevailed), because they shain (relied) on Yahawah, the Alahayam of their ab (father).

Abayah (Abijah) radap (pursued) achar (other) Yarabaim (Jeroboam), and lakad (took) iyar (cities) from him, Bayathaal (Bethel) with its bath (daughter), and Yashanah (Jeshanah) with its bath (daughter), and Iparawan (Ephron) with its bath (daughter).
Yarabaim (Jeroboam) didn't itzar (recover) kach (strength / mighty / power) again in the yawam (day) of Abayah (Abijah). Yahawah nagap (struck) him, and he mawath (death).

But Abayah (Abijah) grew chazaq (mighty), and nashaa (lift) to himself fourteen wives, and became the yalad (birth / begot) of isharayam (twenty) - shanayam (two) ban (son), and sixteen bath (daughter).

The yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Abayah (Abijah), and his darak (ways), and his dabar (word / matter), are kathab (written) in the commentary of the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) Idaw (Iddo).
So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of Yahawah (David); and Asaa (Asa) his son reigned in his place. In his days the land was quiet ten years.
Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of Yahawah his Alahayam:
For he ishah (make) away the foreign altars, and the high places, and broke down the pillars, and cut down the Asherim,
And commanded Yahawadah (Judah) to seek Yahawah, the Alahayam of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment.
Also he shaqat (took) away out of all the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah) the high places and the sun images: and the kingdom was shaqat (quiet) im (before) him.
He banah (built) fortified iyar (cities) in Yahawadah (Judah); for the aratz (Earth/land) was nawach (quiet), and he had no war in those years, because Yahawah had given him nawach (rest).

For he said to Yahawadah (Judah), "Let us build these cities, and make walls around them, with towers, gates, and bars. The land is yet before us, because we have sought Yahawah our Alahayam; we have sought him, and he has given us rest on kal (every) side." So they built and prospered.

Asa had an chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) that yatzaa (go out / come out) bucklers and spears, out of Judah shalawash (three) maah (hundred) alap (thousand); and out of Benjamin, that yatzaa (go out / come out) shields and yatzaa (go out / come out) bows, two maah (hundred) eighty alap (thousand): all these were mighty men of valor.
There yatzaa (go out / come out) out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an army of a million troops, and three hundred chariots; and he yatzaa (go out / come out) to Maraashah (Mareshah).
Then Asaa (Asa) ayan (went) out to meet him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.

Asaa (Asa) cried to Yahawah his Alahayam, and said, Yahawah, there is none besides you to help, between the mighty and him who has no strength. Help us, Yahawah our Alahayam; for we rely on you, and in your name are we come against this multitude. Yahawah, you are our Alahayam. Don't let man prevail against you.
So Yahawah struck the Kawashay (Ethiopians) panayam (before) Asaa (Asa), and panayam (before) Judah; and the Kawashay (Ethiopians) fled.

Asa and the people who were with him pursued them to Garar (Gerar): and there hayah (came to pass) of the Ethiopians so many that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before Yahawah, and before his army; and they carried away very much booty.
They nakah (struck) all the cities around Gerar; for the fear of Yahawah came on them: and they despoiled all the cities; for there was much spoil in them.
They nakah (struck) also the ahal (tents) of livestock, and shabah (carried) away tzaan (sheep) in rab (abundance), and gamal (camels), and shawab (turn back / repent) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
The rawach (spirit / wind) of Alahayam came on Izarayah (Azariah) the ban (son) of Iwadad (Oded):

And he yatzaa (go out / come out) out to panayam (meet) Asaa (Asa), and amar (spoke) to him, shamai (hearken / hear) me, Asaa (Asa), and all Yahawadah (Judah) and Banayamayan (Benjamin)! Yahawah is with you, while you are with him; and if you darash (seek) him, he will be matzaa (found) by you; but if you izab (forsake) him, he will izab (forsake) you.
Now for a rab (long) yawam (day) Yasharaal (Israel) was laa (NOT) the amath (truth) Alahayam, and without a yarah (teaching) kahan (priest), and without thawarah (instruction).
But when in their tzar (oppressor / distressor) they shawab (turn back / repent) to Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), and baqash (sought) him, he was matzaa (found) by them.

In those ith (times) there was no shalawam (peace / safety) to him who yatzaa (go out / come out) out, nor to him who bawaa (come) in; but rab (great) mahawamah (troubles) were on all the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the aratz (Earth/land).
They were kathath (broken) in pieces, gaway (nation / people) against gaway (nation / people), and iyar (city) against iyar (city); for Alahayam hamam (troubled) them with all tzarah (adversity).
But you be chazaq (strong), and don't let your yad (hand) be rapah (slack); for your pailah (work) yash (shall) be shakar (rewarded).

When Asaa (Asa) shamai (hearken / hear) these dabar (word / matter), and the nabawaah (prophecy) of Iwadad (Oded) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), he chazaq (took) courage, and ibar (pass over/through) away the shaqawatz (abominations) out of all the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Banayamayan (Benjamin), and out of the iyar (cities) which he had lakad (taken) from the har (mountain) country of Aparayam (Ephraim); and he chadash (renewed) the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah, that panayam (was) before the awalam (porch) of Yahawah.

He qabatz (gathered) all Yahawadah (Judah) and Banayamayan (Benjamin), and those who lived with them out of Aparayam (Ephraim) and Manashah (Manasseh), and out of Shamaiwan (Simeon): for they napal (fall / be cast down) to him out of Yasharaal (Israel) in rab (abundance), when they raah (see) that Yahawah his Alahayam was with him.
So they qabatz (gathered) themselves together at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) in the shalayashay (third) chadash (month), in the fifteenth shanah (year) of the malakawath (reign) of Asaa (Asa).

They zabach (sacrificed) to Yahawah in that yawam (day), of the shalal (spoil) which they bawaa (come) brought, shabai (seven) maah (hundred) baqar (morning) of cattle and shabai (seven) alap (thousand) tzaan (sheep).
They bawaa (come) into the barayath (covenant) to darash (seek) Yahawah, the Alahayam of their ab (father), with all their labab (heart) and with all their napash (living being/soul);

And that whoever would not darash (seek) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), should be put to mawath (death), man (from) qatan (small/young/least) or gadawal (very great/important/mighty), whether ayash (husband/individual man) or ashah (wife/individual woman).

They shabai (swear / take oath) to Yahawah with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qawal (sound / voice), and with tharawaih (shouting), and with chatzatzarah (trumpets), and with shawapar (Shawapar(Shofar) - Ram's horn (instrument)).

All Yahawadah (Judah) shamach (rejoiced) at the shabawaih (oath); for they had shabai (swear / take oath) with all their labab (heart), and baqash (sought) him with their whole ratzawan (desire); and he was matzaa (found) of them: and Yahawah gave them nawach (rest) all around.

Maikah (Also) Maacah, the am (mother) of Asaa (Asa) the malak (king), he sawar (removed) from being gabayarah (queen), because she ishah (make) made an abominable mapalatzath (image) Asharah (for) an Asherah; and Asaa (Asa) karath (cut) down her mapalatzath (image), and daqaq (made) dust of it, and burnt it at the nachal (stream / river) Qadarawan (Kidron).
But the bamah (high) places were not sawar (taken) away out of Yasharaal (Israel): nevertheless the labab (heart) of Asaa (Asa) was shalam (full / whole / complete) all his yawam (day).

He bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of Alahayam the things that his ab (father) had qadash (set apart/make holy), and that he himself had qadash (set apart/make holy), kasap (silver), and zahab (gold), and kalay (vessels).
There was no more malachamah (war) to the chamash (five) and shalawashayam (thirty) shanah (year) of the malakawath (reign) of Asaa (Asa).

In the shash (six) and shalawashayam (thirty) shanah (year) of the malakawath (reign) of Asaa (Asa), Baishaa (Baasha) malakawath (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) ilah (go up / offer) up against Yahawadah (Judah), and banah (built) Ramah (Ramah), that he might not allow anyone to yatzaa (go out / come out) out or bawaa (come) in to Asaa (Asa) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah).

Then Asaa (Asa) yatzaa (go out / come out) out kasap (silver) and zahab (gold) out of the awatzar (treasures) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah and of the malak (king) bayath (house), and shalach (send) Banahadad (to) Ben Hadad malak (king) of Aram (Syria), who lived at Damashaq (Damascus), amar (spoke),

Let there be a treaty between me and you, as there was between my ab (father) and your ab (father). Behold, I have shalach (send) you kasap (silver) and zahab (gold). Yalak (go), parar (break) your treaty with Baishaa (Baasha) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel), that he may depart from me.

Banahadad (Ben) Hadad shamai (hearken / hear) to malak (king) Asaa (Asa), and shalach (send) the shar (prince / ruler) of his chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) against the iyar (cities) of Yasharaal (Israel); and they nakah (struck) Iyawan (Ijon), and Dan (Dan), and Abalamayam (Abel) Maim, and all the storage iyar (cities) of Napathalay (Naphtali).
It happened, when Baishaa (Baasha) shamai (hearken / hear) of it, that he chadal (left) off banah (building) Ramah (Ramah), and let his malaakah (work) shabath (shabath/rest).

Then Asaa (Asa) the malak (king) laqach (take / seized) all Yahawadah (Judah); and they nashaa (lift) away the aban (stone) of Ramah (Ramah), and its itz (timber), with which Baishaa (Baasha) had banah (built); and he built therewith Gabai (Geba) and Matzapah (Mizpah).

At that ith (time) Chananay (Hanani) the seer bawaa (come) to Asaa (Asa) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and amar (spoke) to him, Because you have shain (relied) on the malak (king) of Aram (Syria), and have not shain (relied) on Yahawah your Alahayam, therefore is the chayal (army) of the malak (king) of Aram (Syria) malat (escaped) out of your yad (hand).

Weren't the Kawashay (Ethiopians) and the Lawabay (Lubim) a rab (huge) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), with rakab (chariots) and horsemen maad (exceeding) many? Yet, because you shain (relied) on Yahawah, he nathan (give) them into your yad (hand).

For the iyan (eye) of Yahawah shawat (run) back and forth throughout the whole aratz (Earth/land), to show himself chazaq (strong) in the behalf of them whose labab (heart) is shalam (full / whole / complete) toward him. Herein you have sakal (done) foolishly; for from ithah (now / present moment) you yash (shall) have malachamah (wars).

Then Asaa (Asa) was kais (angry) with the seer, and nathan (give) him in the mahapakath (prison); for he was in a zaip (rage) with him because of this thing. Asaa (Asa) ratzatz (oppressed) some of the im (people / nation) at the same ith (time).

Behold, the dabar (word / matter) of Asaa (Asa), raashawan (first) and acharawan (last), behold, they are kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Yasharaal (Israel).

In the shalawashayam (thirty) - thashai (nine) shanah (year) of his malakawath (reign) Asaa (Asa) was chalaa (diseased) in his ragal (feet / foot); his chalay (disease) was mail (top/above) great: yet in his chalay (disease) he didn't darash (seek) Yahawah, but to the rapaa (physicians).
Asaa (Asa) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and mawath (death) in the achad (one) and fortieth shanah (year) of his malak (king).

They qabar (bury) him in his own tombs, which he had karah (dug) out for himself in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David), and shakab (laid) him in the mashakab (bed) which was malaa (filled) with basham (sweet) odors and various zan (kinds) of raqach (spices) prepared by the perfumers' maishah (art): and they sharap (made) a very gadawal (very great/important/mighty) sharapah (burning) for him.
Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place, and chazaq (strengthened) himself against Yasharaal (Israel).

He nathan (give) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) in all the batzar (fortified) iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and nathan (give) natzayab (garrisons) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah), and in the iyar (cities) of Aparayam (Ephraim), which Asaa (Asa) his ab (father) had lakad (taken).
Yahawah was with Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat), because he halak (move) in the raashawan (first) darak (ways) of his ab (father) Dawad (David), and didn't darash (seek) the Bail (Baals),
But darash (sought) to the Alahayam of his ab (father), and halak (move) in his matzawah (commandments), and not after the maishah (doings) of Yasharaal (Israel).

Therefore Yahawah kawan (established) the mamalakah (kingdom) in his yad (hand); and all Yahawadah (Judah) nathan (give) to Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) tribute; and he had riches and honor in rab (abundance).
His lab (heart) was gabah (lifted) up in the darak (ways) of Yahawah: and furthermore he sawar (took) away the bamah (high) places and the Asharah (Asherim) out of Yahawadah (Judah).

Also in the shalawash (three) shanah (year) of his malak (king) he shalach (send) his shar (prince / ruler), even Banachayal (Ben) Hail, and Ibadayah (Obadiah), and Zakarayah (Zechariah), and Nathanaal (Nethanel), and Mayakayahaw (Micaiah), to lamad (teach/instruct) in the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah);

And with them the Lawayay (Levites), even Shamaiyah (Shemaiah), and Nathanayah (Nethaniah), and Zabadayah (Zebadiah), and Ishahaal (Asahel), and Shamayaramawath (Shemiramoth), and Yahawanathan (Jehonathan), and Adanayah (Adonijah), and Tawabayah (Tobijah), and Tawabaadanayahaw (Tobadonijah), the Lawayay (Levites); and with them Alayashamai (Elishama) and Yahawaram (Jehoram), the kahan (priest).

They lamad (teach/instruct) in Yahawadah (Judah), having the sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction) of Yahawah with them; and they sabab (went) about throughout all the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and lamad (teach/instruct) among the im (people / nation).

The pachad (fear / dread) of Yahawah fell on all the mamalakah (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land) that were around Yahawadah (Judah), so that they made no lacham (war) against Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat).

Some of the Palashathay (Philistines) bawaa (come) Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) manachah (presents), and kasap (silver) for tribute; the Irabay (Arabians) also bawaa (come) him tzaan (flocks), shabai (seven) alap (thousand) and shabai (seven) maah (hundred) ayal (rams), and shabai (seven) alap (thousand) and shabai (seven) maah (hundred) male thayash (goats).
Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) halak (move) gadal (great) mail (top/above); and he banah (built) in Yahawadah (Judah) bayaranayath (castles) and iyar (cities) of masakanah (store).
He rab (had) many malaakah (works) in the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah); and rab (men) of malachamah (war), mighty rab (men) of valor, in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

This was the numbering of them according to their ab (father)' bayath (house): Of Yahawadah (Judah), the shar (prince / ruler) of alap (thousands): Idanah (Adnah) the shar (prince / ruler), and with him gabawar (mighty) men of valor shalawash (three) maah (hundred) alap (thousand);
And next to him Yahawachanan (Jehohanan) the shar (prince / ruler), and with him two maah (hundred) shamanayam (eighty) alap (thousand);
And next to him Imasayah (Amasiah) the ban (son) of Zakaray (Zichri), who nadab (willingly) offered himself to Yahawah; and with him two maah (hundred) alap (thousand) gabawar (mighty) men of valor.
Of Banayamayan (Benjamin): Alayadai (Eliada) a gabawar (mighty) man of valor, and with him two maah (hundred) alap (thousand) nashaq (armed) with qashath (bow) and magan (shield);
And next to him Yahawazabad (Jehozabad) and with him one maah (hundred) shamanayam (eighty) alap (thousand) chalatz (ready) prepared for tzabaa (troop).
These were those who sharath (waited) on the malak (king), besides those whom the malak (king) nathan (give) in the fortified iyar (cities) throughout all Yahawadah (Judah).
Now Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) had riches and honor in rab (abundance); and he chathan (joined) affinity with Achaab (Ahab).

Qatz (after) certain shanah (years) he yarad (went) down to Achaab (Ahab) to Shamarawan (Samaria). Achaab (Ahab) zabach (killed) tzaan (sheep) and cattle for him in rab (abundance), and for the im (people / nation) who were with him, and sawath (moved) him to ilah (go up / offer) up with him to Ramathagalaid (Ramoth) Gilead.

Achaab (Ahab) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) amar (spoke) to Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), "Will you yalak (go) with me to Ramathagalaid (Ramoth) Gilead?" He amar (spoke) him, I am as you are, and my im (people / nation) as your im (people / nation). We will be with you in the malachamah (war).
Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) amar (spoke) to the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel), Please darash (inquire) yawam (day) for the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah.

Then the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) gathered the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) qabatz (together), arabai (four) maah (hundred) ayash (husband/individual man), and amar (spoke) to them, "Shall we yalak (go) to Ramathagalaid (Ramoth) Gilead to malachamah (battle), or shall I chadal (forbear)?" They amar (spoke), ilah (go up / offer) up; for Alahayam will nathan (give) it into the yad (hand) of the malak (king).
But Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) amar (spoke), Isn't there here a nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) of Yahawah besides, that we may darash (inquire) of him?

The malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) amar (spoke) to Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat), "There is yet achad (one) ayash (husband/individual man) by whom we may darash (inquire) of Yahawah; but I shanaa (hate) him, for he never nabaa (prophesies) tawab (pleasant/functional) concerning me, but yawam (day) rai (evil). He is Mayakayahaw (Micaiah) the ban (son) of Yamalaa (Imla)." Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) amar (spoke), Don't let the malak (king) amar (spoke) so.
Then the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) qaraa (called) an sarayas (officer), and amar (spoke), Get Mayakah (Micaiah) the ban (son) of Yamalaa (Imla) mahar (quickly).

Now the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) and Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) yashab (inhabit/dwell) ayash (husband/individual man) on his kasaa (throne), labash (arrayed) in their bagad (robes), and they were sitting in an open garan (place) at the entrance of the shair (gate) of Shamarawan (Samaria); and all the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) were nabaa (prophesying) panayam (before) them.

Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the ban (son) of Kanainah (Chenaanah) ishah (make) him qaran (horn) of barazal (iron), and amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, ‘With these you shall nagach (push) the Aram (Syrians), until they are kalah (complete / finish).’

All the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) nabaa (prophesied) so, amar (spoke), ilah (go up / offer) up to Ramathagalaid (Ramoth) Gilead, and tzalach (prosper); for Yahawah will nathan (give) it into the yad (hand) of the malak (king).

The malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) who halak (move) to qaraa (called) Mayakayahaw (Micaiah) dabar (word / matter) to him, amar (spoke), Behold, the dabar (word / matter) of the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) declare tawab (pleasant/functional) to the malak (king) with achad (one) achad (one). Let your dabar (word / matter) therefore, please be like achad (one) of theirs, and dabar (word / matter) tawab (pleasant/functional).
Mayakayahaw (Micaiah) amar (spoke), As Yahawah chay (life), what my Alahayam amar (spoke), that will I dabar (word / matter).

When he bawaa (come) come to the malak (king), the malak (king) amar (spoke) to him, "Mayakah (Micaiah), shall we yalak (go) to Ramathagalaid (Ramoth) Gilead to malachamah (battle), or shall I chadal (forbear)?" He amar (spoke), ilah (go up / offer) up, and tzalach (prosper). They shall be nathan (give) into your yad (hand).
The malak (king) amar (spoke) to him, How many paim (times) shall I shabai (swear / take oath) you that you dabar (word / matter) to me nothing but the amath (truth) in the sham (name) of Yahawah?

He amar (spoke), I raah (see) all Yasharaal (Israel) pawatz (scattered) on the har (mountain), as tzaan (sheep) that have no raih (shepherd). Yahawah amar (spoke), ‘These have no adawan (master / lord). Let them shawab (turn back / repent) every ayash (husband/individual man) to his bayath (house) in shalawam (peace / safety).’

The malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) amar (spoke) to Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat), Didn't I amar (spoke) you that he would not nabaa (prophesy) tawab (pleasant/functional) concerning me, but rai (evil)?

Micaiah amar (spoke), Therefore shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah: I raah (see) Yahawah sitting on his kasaa (throne), and all the tzabaa (troop) of shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) imad (standing) on his right yamayan (right hand) and on his shamaawal (left hand).

Yahawah amar (spoke), ‘Who shall pathah (entice) Achaab (Ahab) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel), that he may ilah (go up / offer) up and napal (fall / be cast down) at Ramathagalaid (Ramoth) Gilead?’ One amar (spoke) amar (spoke) in kakah (this) way, and another amar (spoke) in that kakah (way).
A rawach (spirit / wind) yatzaa (go out / come out) out, imad (stood) panayam (before) Yahawah, and amar (spoke), ‘I will pathah (entice) him.’ Yahawah amar (spoke) to him, ‘How?’

He amar (spoke), ‘I will yatzaa (go out / come out) forth, and will be a shaqar (lying) rawach (spirit / wind) in the pah (mouth) of all his nabayaa (prophet/prophecy).’ He amar (spoke), ‘You will pathah (entice) him, and will yakal (prevail) also. Yatzaa (go out / come out) forth, and ishah (make) so.’

Now therefore, behold, Yahawah nathan (give) put a shaqar (lying) rawach (spirit / wind) in the pah (mouth) of these your nabayaa (prophet/prophecy); and Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) rai (evil) concerning you.

Then Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the ban (son) of Kanainah (Chenaanah) nagash (came) near, and nakah (struck) Mayakayahaw (Micaiah) on the lachay (cheek), and amar (spoke), Which darak (way) did the rawach (spirit / wind) of Yahawah ibar (pass over/through) from me to dabar (word / matter) to you?
Mayakayahaw (Micaiah) amar (spoke), raah (see), you shall see on that yawam (day), when you shall bawaa (come) into an chadar (inner) room to chabaa (hide) yourself.

The malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) amar (spoke), laqach (take / seized) Mayakayahaw (Micaiah), and shawab (turn back / repent) him back to Amawan (Amon) the shar (prince / ruler) of the iyar (city), and to Yawaash (Joash) the malak (king) ban (son);

And amar (spoke), ‘Thus amar (spoke) the malak (king), "shawam (place / establish / appoint) this fellow in the bayath (house), and akal (eat) him with lacham (bread) of lachatz (affliction) and with mayam (Waters) of lachatz (affliction), until I shawab (turn back / repent) in shalawam (peace / safety)."’

Mayakayahaw (Micaiah) amar (spoke), "If you shawab (turn back / repent) at all in shalawam (peace / safety), Yahawah has not dabar (word / matter) by me." He amar (spoke), shamai (hearken / hear), you im (people / nation), all of you!
So the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) and Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) ilah (go up / offer) up to Ramathagalaid (Ramoth) Gilead.

The malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) amar (spoke) to Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat), "I will disguise myself, and bawaa (come) into the malachamah (battle); but you labash (put) on your bagad (robes)." So the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) disguised himself; and they bawaa (come) into the malachamah (battle).

Now the malak (king) of Aram (Syria) had tzawah (commanded) the shar (prince / ruler) of his rakab (chariots), amar (spoke), lacham (fight) neither with qatan (small/young/least) nor gadawal (very great/important/mighty), except only with the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel).

It happened, when the shar (prince / ruler) of the rakab (chariots) raah (see) Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat), that they amar (spoke), "It is the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel)!" Therefore they sabab (turned) around to lacham (fight) against him. But Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) zaiq (cried) out, and Yahawah izar (helped) him; and Alahayam sawath (moved) them to depart from him.

It happened, when the shar (prince / ruler) of the rakab (chariots) raah (see) that it was not the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel), that they shawab (turn back / repent) back from achar (other) him.

A certain man mashak (drew) his qashath (bow) at random, and nakah (struck) the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) between the dabaq (joints) of the armor. Therefore he amar (spoke) to the driver of the rakab (chariot), hapak (turn) your yad (hand), and yatzaa (go out / come out) me out of the machanah (army); for I am severely chalah (afflict).

The malachamah (battle) ilah (go up / offer) that yawam (day). However the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) propped himself up in his marakabah (chariot) nakach (against) the Aram (Syrians) until the irab (evening); and about the ith (time) of the bawaa (come) down of the shamash (sun), he mawath (death).
Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) shawab (turn back / repent) to his bayath (house) in shalawam (peace / safety) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Yahawaa (Jehu) the ban (son) of Chananay (Hanani) the chazah (seer) yatzaa (go out / come out) out to panayam (meet) him, and amar (spoke) to malak (king) Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat), Should you izar (help) the rashai (wicked), and ahab (love) those who shanaa (hate) Yahawah? Because of this, qatzap (wrath) is on you from panayam (before) Yahawah.

Abal (nevertheless) there are tawab (pleasant/functional) things matzaa (found) in you, in that you have bair (put) away the Asharah (Asheroth) out of the aratz (Earth/land), and have kawan (set) your labab (heart) to darash (seek) Alahayam.

Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) lived at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and he yatzaa (go out / come out) out again among the im (people / nation) Baarashabai (from) Beersheba to the har (mountain) country of Aparayam (Ephraim), and shawab (turn back / repent) them back to Yahawah, the Alahayam of their ab (father).
He imad (set) shapat (judges) in the aratz (Earth/land) throughout all the batzar (fortified) iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), iyar (city) by iyar (city),
And amar (spoke) to the shapat (judges), raah (see) what you ishah (make): for you don't shapat (judge) for adam (man), but for Yahawah; and he is with you in the dabar (word / matter).

Now therefore let the pachad (fear / dread) of Yahawah be on you. Shamar (keep/guard) heed and ishah (make) it: for there is no iwal (iniquity) with Yahawah our Alahayam, nor mashaa (respect) of panayam (persons), nor maqach (taking) of shachad (bribes).
