Moreover in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) imad (appointed) Lawayay (Levites) and kahan (priest), and of the raash (head) of the ab (father)' households of Yasharaal (Israel), for the mashapat (judgment) of Yahawah, and for rayab (controversies). They shawab (turn back / repent) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
He tzawah (commanded) them, amar (spoke), Thus you shall ishah (make) in the yaraah (fear) of Yahawah, faithfully, and with a shalam (full / whole / complete) labab (heart).

Whenever any controversy shall bawaa (come) to you from your ach (brother/kinsman) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in their iyar (cities), between dam (blood) and dam (blood), between thawarah (instruction) and matzawah (commandment), chaq (statute) and mashapat (ordinances), you shall zahar (warn) them, that they not be asham (guilty) towards Yahawah, and so qatzap (wrath) come on you and on your ach (brother/kinsman). Ishah (make) kah (this), and you shall not be asham (guilty).

Behold, Amarayah (Amariah) the raash (head) kahan (priest) is over you in all dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah; and Zabadayah (Zebadiah) the ban (son) of Yashamaial (Ishmael), the nagayad (ruler) of the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah), in all the malak (king) dabar (word / matter): also the Lawayay (Levites) shall be shatar (officers) panayam (before) you. Ishah (make) courageously, and may Yahawah be with the tawab (pleasant/functional).

It happened achar (other) this, that the ban (son) of Mawaab (Moab), and the ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon), and with them some of the Imawanay (Ammonites), bawaa (come) against Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) to malachamah (battle).

Then some bawaa (come) who nagad (told) Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat), amar (spoke), "A rab (great) hamawan (multitude) is bawaa (come) ibar (against) you from beyond the yam (sea/waters) from Aram (Syria). Behold, they are in Hazazon Chatzatzawanathamar (Tamar)" (that is, Iyanagaday (En) Gedi).
Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) was alarmed, and nathan (give) panayam (himself) to darash (seek) to Yahawah. He qaraa (called) a tzawam (fast) il (over) all Yahawadah (Judah).
Yahawadah (Judah) qabatz (gathered) themselves together, to baqash (seek) help from Yahawah. They bawaa (come) out of all the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah) to baqash (seek) Yahawah.

Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) imad (stood) in the qahal (assembly) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, panayam (before) the chadash (new) chatzar (court);

And he amar (spoke), Yahawah, the Alahayam of our ab (father), aren't you Alahayam in shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens))? Aren't you mashal (rule/have dominion) over all the mamalakah (kingdoms) of the gaway (nation / people)? Kach (strength / mighty / power) and gabawarah (might) are in your yad (hand), so that no one is yatzab (able) to withstand you.

Didn't you, our Alahayam, yarash (drive) out the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of this aratz (Earth/land) panayam (before) your im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel), and nathan (give) it to the zarai (seed) of Abaraham (Abraham) your ahab (love) iwalam (forever)?
They lived in it, and have banah (built) you a maqadash (sanctuary) in it for your sham (name), amar (spoke),

‘If rai (evil) bawaa (come) on us—the charab (sword), shapawat (judgment), dabar (word / matter), or famine—we will imad (stand) before this bayath (house), and panayam (before) you, (for your sham (name) is in this bayath (house)), and zaiq (cry) to you in our tzarah (affliction), and you will shamai (hearken / hear) and yashai (salvation).’

Now, behold, the ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon) and Mawaab (Moab) and har (mountain) Shaiyar (Seir), whom you nathan (give) not let Yasharaal (Israel) bawaa (come), when they bawaa (come) out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), but they sawar (turned) aside from them, and didn't shamad (destroy) them;
Behold, how they gamal (reward) us, to bawaa (come) to garash (cast) us out of your yarashah (possession), which you have yarash (given) us to inherit.

Our Alahayam, will you not shapat (judge) them? For we have no kach (strength / mighty / power) panayam (against) this rab (great) hamawan (company) that bawaa (come) against us; neither yadai (know) we what to ishah (make), but our iyan (eye) are on you.
All Yahawadah (Judah) imad (stood) panayam (before) Yahawah, with their little tap (ones), their wives, and their ban (son).

Then the rawach (spirit / wind) of Yahawah came on Yachazayaal (Jahaziel) the ban (son) of Zakarayah (Zechariah), the ban (son) of Banayah (Benaiah), the ban (son) of Yaiyaal (Jeiel), the ban (son) of Mathanayah (Mattaniah), the Lawayay (Levite), of the ban (son) of Asap (Asaph), in the thawak (midst) of the qahal (assembly);

And he amar (spoke), Listen, all Yahawadah (Judah), and you yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and you malak (king) Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat). Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah to you, ‘Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid), neither be chathath (dismayed) by panayam (reason) of this rab (great) hamawan (multitude); for the malachamah (battle) is not yours, but alahayam (Alahayam).

Machar (tomorrow) yarad (go) down against them. Behold, they are ilah (go up / offer) up by the ascent of Tzayatz (Ziz). You shall matzaa (find) them at the sawap (end) of the nachal (stream / river), panayam (before) the madabar (wilderness) of Yarawaal (Jeruel).

You will not need to lacham (fight) zaath (this) battle. Yatzab (set) yourselves, imad (stand) still, and raah (see) the yashawaih (salvation) of Yahawah with you, O Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid), nor be chathath (dismayed). Yatzaa (go out / come out) out panayam (against) them machar (tomorrow), for Yahawah is with you.’

Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) qadad (bowed) his head with his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) to the aratz (Earth/land); and all Yahawadah (Judah) and the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) napal (fall / be cast down) down panayam (before) Yahawah, shachah (worshipping) Yahawah.

The Lawayay (Levites), of the ban (son) of the Qahathay (Kohathites) and of the ban (son) of the qarachay (korahites), qawam (rise up) up to halal (praise) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), with an mail (top/above) gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qawal (sound / voice).

They shakam (rose) early in the baqar (morning), and yatzaa (go out / come out) forth into the madabar (wilderness) of Thaqawai (Tekoa): and as they yatzaa (go out / come out) forth, Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) imad (stood) and amar (spoke), shamai (hearken / hear) to me, Yahawadah (Judah), and you yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)! Aman (believe / have faith) in Yahawah your Alahayam, so you shall be aman (believe / have faith)! Aman (believe / have faith) his nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), so you shall tzalach (prosper).

When he had taken yaitz (counsel) with the im (people / nation), he imad (appointed) those who should shayar (sing) to Yahawah, and give halal (praise) in qadash (set apart/make holy) array, as they yatzaa (go out / come out) out panayam (before) the army, and amar (spoke), Give yadah (thanks) to Yahawah; for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever).

When they chalal (began) to ranah (sing) and to thahalah (praise), Yahawah nathan (give) ambushers against the ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon), Mawaab (Moab), and har (mountain) Shaiyar (Seir), who bawaa (come) come against Yahawadah (Judah); and they were nagap (struck).

For the ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon) and Mawaab (Moab) imad (stood) up against the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of har (mountain) Shaiyar (Seir), charam (utterly) to kill and shamad (destroy) them: and when they kalah (complete / finish) made an end of the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Shaiyar (Seir), everyone izar (helped) to mashachayath (destroy) rai (neigbor/another person).

When Yahawadah (Judah) bawaa (come) to the place overlooking the madabar (wilderness), they panah (looked) at the hamawan (multitude); and behold, they were pagar (dead) bodies napal (fall / be cast down) to the aratz (Earth/land), and there were none who palayatah (escaped).

When Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) and his im (people / nation) bawaa (come) to bazaz (take) their shalal (spoil), they matzaa (found) among them in rab (abundance) both riches and pagar (dead) bodies, and chamad (precious) kalay (jewels), which they natzal (stripped) off for themselves, more than they could mashaa (carry) away: and they were shalawash (three) yawam (day) in bazaz (taking) the shalal (spoil), it was so much.

On the rabayaiy (fourth) yawam (day) they qahal (assembled) themselves in the imaq (valley) Barakah (of) Beracah; for there they barak (blessed) Yahawah: therefore the sham (name) of that maqawam (place) was qaraa (called) The imaq (valley) Barakah (of) Beracah to this yawam (day).

Then they shawab (turn back / repent), every ayash (husband/individual man) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) in their raash (head), to shawab (turn back / repent) again to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) with shamachah (joy); for Yahawah shamach (had) made them to rejoice over their ayab (enemy).
They bawaa (come) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) with stringed instruments and kanawar (harps) and chatzatzarah (trumpets) to the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

The pachad (fear / dread) of Alahayam was on all the mamalakah (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land), when they shamai (hearken / hear) that Yahawah lacham (fought) against the ayab (enemy) of Yasharaal (Israel).
So the malakawath (realm) of Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) was shaqat (quiet); for his Alahayam gave him nawach (rest) all around.

Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) malak (king) over Yahawadah (Judah): he was shalawashayam (thirty) - chamash (five) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) isharayam (twenty) - chamash (five) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Izawabah (Azubah) the bath (daughter) of Shalachay (Shilhi).
He yalak (walked) in the darak (way) of Asaa (Asa) his ab (father), and didn't sawar (turn) aside from it, ishah (make) that which was yashar (right) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah.
However the bamah (high) places were not sawar (taken) away; neither as yet had the im (people / nation) kawan (set) their labab (hearts) to the Alahayam of their ab (father).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat), raashawan (first) and acharawan (last), behold, they are kathab (written) in the history of Yahawaa (Jehu) the ban (son) of Chananay (Hanani), which is inserted in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel).

Achar (other) this Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) chabar (joined) himself with Achazayah (Ahaziah) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel). The same ishah (make) very wickedly:
And he chabar (joined) himself with him to ishah (make) anayah (ships) to yalak (go) to Tharashayash (Tarshish); and they ishah (make) the anayah (ships) in Itzayawanagabar (Ezion) Geber.

Then Alayaizar (Eliezer) the ban (son) Dawadawahaw (of) Dodavahu of Maraashah (Mareshah) nabaa (prophesied) against Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat), amar (spoke), "Because you chabar (have) joined yourself with Achazayah (Ahaziah), Yahawah has destroyed your maishah (works)." The anayah (ships) were paratz (broken), so that they were not itzar (able) to yalak (go) to Tharashayash (Tarshish).

Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and was qabar (bury) with his ab (father) in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David): and Yahawaram (Jehoram) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

He had ach (brother/kinsman), the ban (son) of Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat): Izarayah (Azariah), and Yachayaal (Jehiel), and Zakarayah (Zechariah), and Izarayah (Azariah), and Mayakaal (Michael), and Shapatayah (Shephatiah); all these were the ban (son) of Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel).

Their ab (father) nathan (give) them rab (great) mathanah (gifts), of kasap (silver), and of zahab (gold), and of magadanah (precious) things, with fortified iyar (cities) in Yahawadah (Judah): but the mamalakah (kingdom) nathan (give) he to Yahawaram (Jehoram), because he was the bakawar (firstborn).

Now when Yahawaram (Jehoram) was qawam (rise up) up over the mamalakah (kingdom) of his ab (father), and had chazaq (strengthened) himself, he harag (killed) all his ach (brother/kinsman) with the charab (sword), and various also of the shar (prince / ruler) of Yasharaal (Israel).

Yahawaram (Jehoram) was shalawashayam (thirty) - shanayam (two) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) shamanah (eight) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

He yalak (walked) in the darak (way) of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel), as ishah (make) the bayath (house) of Achaab (Ahab); for he had the bath (daughter) of Achaab (Ahab) as ashah (wife/individual woman): and he ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah.

However Yahawah would not shachath (destroy) the bayath (house) of Dawad (David), because of the barayath (covenant) that he had karath (cut) with Dawad (David), and as he amar (spoke) to nathan (give) a nayar (lamp) to him and to his ban (son) yawam (day).
In his yawam (day) Adam (Edom) pashai (revolted) from under the yad (hand) of Yahawadah (Judah), and malak (king) a malak (king) over themselves.

Then Yahawaram (Jehoram) ibar (pass over/through) over with his shar (prince / ruler), and all his rakab (chariots) with him: and he qawam (rise up) up by layal (night), and nakah (struck) the Adam (Edomites) who surrounded him, along with the shar (prince / ruler) of the rakab (chariots).

So Adam (Edom) pashai (revolted) from under the yad (hand) of Yahawadah (Judah) to this yawam (day): then Labanah (Libnah) pashai (revolted) at the same ith (time) from under his yad (hand), because he had forsaken Yahawah, the Alahayam of his ab (father).

Moreover he ishah (make) bamah (high) places in the har (mountain) of Yahawadah (Judah), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) the inhabitants of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to zanah (play) the prostitute, and led Yahawadah (Judah) astray.

A letter bawaa (come) to him from Alayah (Elijah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Dawad (David) your ab (father), ‘Because you have not halak (move) in the darak (ways) of Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) your ab (father), nor in the darak (ways) of Asaa (Asa) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah),

But have yalak (walked) in the darak (way) of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel), and have made Yahawadah (Judah) and the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to zanah (play) the prostitute, like the bayath (house) of Achaab (Ahab) did, and also have harag (slain) your ach (brother/kinsman) of your ab (father) bayath (house), who were tawab (pleasant/functional) than yourself:

Behold, Yahawah will nagap (strike) with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) magapah (plague) your im (people / nation), and your ban (son), and your wives, and all your rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions);

And you shall rab (have) great chalay (sickness) by machalah (disease) of your maih (bowels), until your maih (bowels) yatzaa (go out / come out) out by reason of the chalay (sickness), yawam (day) by yawam (day).’
Yahawah iwar (rouse / awaken) up against Yahawaram (Jehoram) the rawach (spirit / wind) of the Palashathay (Philistines), and of the Irabay (Arabians) who are il (over) the Kawashay (Ethiopians):

And they ilah (go up / offer) up against Yahawadah (Judah), and baqai (broke) into it, and shabah (carried) away all the rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions) that was matzaa (found) in the malak (king) bayath (house), and his ban (son) also, and his wives; so that there was never a ban (son) shaar (left) him, except Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz), the youngest of his ban (son).
Achar (other) all this Yahawah nagap (struck) him in his maih (bowels) with an ayan (incurable) chalay (disease).

It happened, in process of yawam (day), at the qatz (end) of shanayam (two) yawam (day), that his maih (bowels) yatzaa (go out / come out) out by reason of his chalay (sickness), and he mawath (death) of severe thachalawaa (diseases). His im (people / nation) ishah (make) no sharapah (burning) for him, like the sharapah (burning) of his ab (father).

Shalawashayam (thirty) - shanayam (two) years ban (son) was he when he began to malak (king), and he malak (king) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) shamanah (eight) shanah (years): and he departed without being chamadah (desired); and they qabar (bury) him in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David), but not in the tombs of the malak (king).

The inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his place; for the band of men who came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.

Arabaiyam (forty) - shanayam (two) shanah (years) ban (son) was Achazayah (Ahaziah) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) achad (one) shanah (year) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Ithalayah (Athaliah) the bath (daughter) of Imaray (Omri).
He also halak (move) in the darak (ways) of the bayath (house) of Achaab (Ahab); for his am (mother) was his yaitz (counselor) to rashai (do) wickedly.

He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, as did the bayath (house) of Achaab (Ahab); for they were his yaitz (counselors) achar (other) the mawath (death) of his ab (father), to his mashachayath (destruction).

He halak (move) also after their itzah (counsel), and yalak (went) with Yahawaram (Jehoram) the ban (son) of Achaab (Ahab) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) to malachamah (war) against Chazaal (Hazael) malak (king) of Aram (Syria) at Ramathagalaid (Ramoth) Gilead: and the Ramay (Syrians) wounded Yawaram (Joram).

He shawab (turn back / repent) to be rapaa (healed) in Yazaraial (Jezreel) of the makah (wounds) which they had nakah (given) him at Ramah (Ramah), when he lacham (fought) against Chazaal (Hazael) malak (king) of Aram (Syria). Izarayah (Azariah) the ban (son) of Yahawaram (Jehoram) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) yarad (went) down to raah (see) Yahawaram (Jehoram) the ban (son) of Achaab (Ahab) in Yazaraial (Jezreel), because he was chalah (afflict).

Now the thabawasah (destruction) of Achazayah (Ahaziah) was of Alahayam, in that he bawaa (come) to Yawaram (Joram): for when he bawaa (come) come, he yatzaa (go out / come out) out with Yahawaram (Jehoram) against Yahawaa (Jehu) the ban (son) of Namashay (Nimshi), whom Yahawah had mashach (anointed) to karath (cut) off the bayath (house) of Achaab (Ahab).

It happened, when Yahawaa (Jehu) was executing shapat (judgment) on the bayath (house) of Achaab (Ahab), that he matzaa (found) the shar (prince / ruler) of Yahawadah (Judah), and the ban (son) of the ach (brother/kinsman) of Achazayah (Ahaziah), sharath (ministering) to Achazayah (Ahaziah), and harag (killed) them.

He baqash (sought) Achazayah (Ahaziah), and they lakad (caught) him (now he was chabaa (hiding) in Shamarawan (Samaria)), and they bawaa (come) him to Yahawaa (Jehu), and mawath (death) him; and they qabar (bury) him, for they amar (spoke), "He is the ban (son) of Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat), who darash (sought) Yahawah with all his labab (heart)." The bayath (house) of Achazayah (Ahaziah) had no kach (strength / mighty / power) to hold the mamalakah (kingdom).

Now when Ithalayah (Athaliah) the am (mother) of Achazayah (Ahaziah) raah (see) that her ban (son) was mawath (death), she qawam (rise up) and dabar (word / matter) all the mamalakah (royal) zarai (seed) of the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah).

But Yahawashabaith (Jehoshabeath), the bath (daughter) of the malak (king), laqach (take / seized) Yawaash (Joash) the ban (son) of Achazayah (Ahaziah), and ganab (stole) him away from thawak (midst) the malak (king) ban (son) who were mawath (death), and nathan (give) him and his yanaq (nurse) in the bedroom. So Yahawashabaith (Jehoshabeath), the bath (daughter) of malak (king) Yahawaram (Jehoram), the ashah (wife/individual woman) of Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the kahan (priest) (for she was the achawath (sister) of Achazayah (Ahaziah)), sathar (hid) him from Ithalayah (Athaliah), so that she didn't mawath (death) him.
He was with them chabaa (hidden) in the bayath (house) of Alahayam shash (six) shanah (years): and Ithalayah (Athaliah) malak (king) over the aratz (Earth/land).

In the shabayaiy (seventh) shanah (year) Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) chazaq (strengthened) himself, and laqach (take / seized) the shar (prince / ruler) of maah (hundred), Izarayah (Azariah) the ban (son) of Yaracham (Jeroham), and Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Yahawachanan (Jehohanan), and Izarayah (Azariah) the ban (son) of Iwabad (Obed), and Maishayah (Maaseiah) the ban (son) of Idayah (Adaiah), and Alayashapat (Elishaphat) the ban (son) of Zakaray (Zichri), into barayath (covenant) with him.

They sabab (went) about in Yahawadah (Judah), and qabatz (gathered) the Lawayay (Levites) out of all the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and the raash (head) of ab (father)' households of Yasharaal (Israel), and they bawaa (come) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

All the qahal (assembly) karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) with the malak (king) in the bayath (house) of Alahayam. He amar (spoke) to them, Behold, the malak (king) ban (son) shall malak (king), as Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) concerning the ban (son) of Dawad (David).

This is the thing that you shall ishah (make). A shalayashay (third) part of you, who bawaa (come) in on the shabath (shabath/rest), of the kahan (priest) and of the Lawayay (Levites), shall be shawair (porters) of the sap (thresholds).

A shalayashay (third) part shall be at the malak (king) bayath (house); and a shalayashay (third) part at the shair (gate) of the yasawad (foundation). All the im (people / nation) shall be in the chatzar (courts) of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) bayath (house).

But bawaa (come) no one come into the bayath (house) of Yahawah, except the kahan (priest), and those who sharath (minister) of the Lawayay (Levites). They shall bawaa (come) in, for they are qadash (set apart/make holy), but all the im (people / nation) shall follow yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) instructions.

The Lawayay (Levites) shall surround the malak (king), every ayash (husband/individual man) with his kalay (weapons) in his yad (hand). Whoever bawaa (come) into the bayath (house), let him be mawath (death). Be with the malak (king) when he bawaa (come) in, and when he yatzaa (go out / come out) out.

So the Lawayay (Levites) and all Yahawadah (Judah) ishah (make) according to all that Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the kahan (priest) tzawah (commanded): and they laqach (take / seized) every ayash (husband/individual man) his ayash (husband/individual man), those who were to bawaa (come) in on the shabath (shabath/rest); with those who were to yatzaa (go out / come out) out on the shabath (shabath/rest); for Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the kahan (priest) didn't dismiss the shift.

Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the kahan (priest) nathan (give) to the shar (prince / ruler) of maah (hundred) the chanayath (spears), and magan (shield), and shalat (shields), that had been malak (king) Dawad (David's), which were in the bayath (house) of Alahayam.

He imad (set) all the im (people / nation), every ayash (husband/individual man) with his shalach (weapon) in his yad (hand), from the yamanay (right) kathap (side) of the bayath (house) to the shamaalay (left) kathap (side) of the bayath (house), along by the mazabach (altar) and the bayath (house), around the malak (king).

Then they yatzaa (go out / come out) out the malak (king) ban (son), and nathan (give) the nazar (crown / consecrate) on him, and gave him the idawath (testimony), and made him malak (king): and Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) and his ban (son) mashach (anointed) him; and they amar (spoke), Long chayah (live) the malak (king)!

When Ithalayah (Athaliah) shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of the im (people / nation) running and halal (praise) the malak (king), she bawaa (come) to the im (people / nation) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah:

And she raah (see), and, behold, the malak (king) imad (stood) by his imawad (pillar) at the mabawaa (entrance), and the shar (prince / ruler) and the chatzatzarah (trumpets) by the malak (king); and all the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land) shamach (rejoiced), and thaqai (blow / sound alarm) chatzatzarah (trumpets); the singers also played shayar (song) kalay (instruments), and led the singing of halal (praise). Then Ithalayah (Athaliah) qarai (tore) her clothes, and amar (spoke), qashar (treason)! Qashar (treason)!

Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the kahan (priest) yatzaa (go out / come out) out the shar (prince / ruler) of maah (hundred) who were paqad (visit) over the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), and amar (spoke) to them, "yatzaa (go out / come out) her out between the ranks; and whoever bawaa (come) her, let him be mawath (death) with the charab (sword)." For the kahan (priest) amar (spoke), Don't mawath (death) her in the yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) bayath (house).

So they shawam (place / establish / appoint) yad (hand) for her. She bawaa (come) to the mabawaa (entrance) of the sawas (horse) shair (gate) to the malak (king) bayath (house); and they mawath (death) her there.

Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) between himself, and all the im (people / nation), and the malak (king), that they should be yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) im (people / nation).

All the im (people / nation) bawaa (come) to the bayath (house) of Bail (Baal), and nathatz (broke) it down, and shabar (broke) his mazabach (altars) and his tzalam (likeness) in shabar (pieces), and harag (killed) Mathan (Mattan) the kahan (priest) of Bail (Baal) panayam (before) the mazabach (altars).

Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) shawam (place / establish / appoint) the paqadah (officers) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah under the yad (hand) of the kahan (priest) the Lawayay (Levites), whom Dawad (David) chalaq (had) distributed in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, to ilah (go up / offer) the burnt ilah (offerings) of Yahawah, as it is kathab (written) in the thawarah (instruction) of Mashah (Moses), with shamachah (rejoicing) and with shayar (song), according to the yad (hand) of Dawad (David).
He imad (set) the shawair (porters) at the shair (gates) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, that no one who was tamaa (unclean) in anything should bawaa (come) in.

He laqach (take / seized) the shar (prince / ruler) of maah (hundred), and the adayar (nobles), and the mashal (rule/have dominion) of the im (people / nation), and all the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land), and yarad (brought) down the malak (king) from the bayath (house) of Yahawah: and they bawaa (come) thawak (midst) the ilayawan (upper) shair (gate) to the malak (king) bayath (house), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) the malak (king) on the kasaa (throne) of the mamalakah (kingdom).
So all the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land) shamach (rejoiced), and the iyar (city) was shaqat (quiet). Ithalayah (Athaliah) they had mawath (death) with the charab (sword).

Yawaash (Joash) was shabai (seven) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) arabaiyam (forty) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Tzabayah (Zibiah), Baarashabai (of) Beersheba.
Yawaash (Joash) ishah (make) that which was yashar (right) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah all the yawam (day) of Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the kahan (priest).
Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) nashaa (lift) for him shanayam (two) wives; and he became the yalad (birth / begot) of ban (son) and bath (daughter).
It happened achar (other) this, that Yawaash (Joash) intended to chadash (restore) the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

He qabatz (gathered) together the kahan (priest) and the Lawayay (Levites), and amar (spoke) to them, "yatzaa (go out / come out) out to the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and qabatz (gather) kasap (money) to chazaq (repair) the bayath (house) of your Alahayam from all Israel from shanah (year) to shanah (year). See that you expedite this dabar (word / matter)." However the Lawayay (Levites) didn't do it right away.

The malak (king) qaraa (called) for Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the raash (head), and amar (spoke) to him, Why haven't you darash (required) of the Lawayay (Levites) to bawaa (come) in the tax of Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah, and of the qahal (assembly) of Yasharaal (Israel), out of Yahawadah (Judah) and out of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), for the ahal (tent) of the idawath (testimony)?

For the ban (son) of Ithalayah (Athaliah), that marashaith (wicked) woman, had paratz (broken) up the bayath (house) of Alahayam; and they also gave all the qadash (set apart/make holy) things of the bayath (house) of Yahawah to the Bail (Baals).
So the malak (king) commanded, and they ishah (make) a arawan (chest), and nathan (give) it outside at the shair (gate) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

They nathan (give) a qawal (sound / voice) through Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), to bawaa (come) in for Yahawah the tax that Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Alahayam laid on Yasharaal (Israel) in the madabar (wilderness).
All the shar (prince / ruler) and all the im (people / nation) shamach (rejoiced), and bawaa (come) in, and shalak (cast) into the arawan (chest), until they kalah (complete / finish) made an end.

It was so, that whenever the arawan (chest) was bawaa (come) to the malak (king) paqadah (officers) by the yad (hand) of the Lawayay (Levites), and when they raah (see) that there was much kasap (money), the malak (king) sapar (book) and the raash (head) kahan (priest) officer bawaa (come) and irah (emptied) the arawan (chest), and nashaa (lift) it, and nashaa (lift) it to its maqawam (place) again. Thus they ishah (make) yawam (day) by yawam (day), and asap (gathered) kasap (money) in rab (abundance).

The malak (king) and Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) nathan (give) it to such as ishah (make) the malaakah (work) of the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah; and they shakar (hired) chatzab (masons) and charash (carpenters) to chadash (restore) the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and also such as worked barazal (iron) and nachashath (brass) to chazaq (repair) the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

So the workmen ishah (make), and the malaakah (work) of repairing went forward in their yad (hand), and they imad (set) up the bayath (house) of Alahayam in its mathakanath (state), and amatz (strengthened) it.

When they kalah (complete / finish) made an end, they bawaa (come) the shaar (rest) of the kasap (money) panayam (before) the malak (king) and Yahawayadai (Jehoiada), of which were ishah (make) kalay (vessels) for the bayath (house) of Yahawah, even kalay (vessels) with which to sharath (minister) and to ilah (go up / offer), and kap (spoons), and kalay (vessels) of zahab (gold) and kasap (silver). They ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilah (offerings) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah continually all the yawam (day) of Yahawayadai (Jehoiada).

But Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) grew zaqan (old) and was shabai (full) of yawam (day), and he mawath (death); one maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) shanah (years) ban (son) was he when he mawath (death).

They qabar (bury) him in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David) among the malak (king), because he ishah (make) done tawab (pleasant/functional) in Yasharaal (Israel), and toward Alahayam and his bayath (house).

Now achar (other) the mawath (death) of Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) bawaa (come) the shar (prince / ruler) of Yahawadah (Judah), and shachah (made) obeisance to the malak (king). Then the malak (king) shamai (hearken / hear) to them.

They forsook the bayath (house) of Yahawah, the Alahayam of their ab (father), and ibad (servant) the Asharah (Asherim) and the itzab (idols): and qatzap (wrath) came on Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) for this their guiltiness.

Yet he shalach (send) nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) to them, to shawab (turn back / repent) them again to Yahawah; and they iwad (admonish/bear witness against) against them: but they would not azan (give) ear.

The rawach (spirit / wind) of Alahayam labash (came) on Zakarayah (Zechariah) the ban (son) of Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the kahan (priest); and he imad (stood) above the im (people / nation), and amar (spoke) to them, Thus amar (spoke) Alahayam, ‘Why ibar (pass over/through) you disobey the matzawah (commandments) of Yahawah, so that you can't tzalach (prosper)? Because you have forsaken Yahawah, he has also forsaken you.’
They qashar (conspired) against him, and ragam (stoned) him with aban (stone) at the matzawah (commandment) of the malak (king) in the chatzar (court) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

Thus Yawaash (Joash) the malak (king) didn't zakar (remembrance/memory) the chasad (grace) which Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) his ab (father) ishah (make) done to him, but harag (killed) his ban (son). When he mawath (death), he amar (spoke), May Yahawah raah (see) at it, and repay it.

It happened at the thaqawapah (end) of the shanah (year), that the chayal (army) of the Aram (Syrians) ilah (go up / offer) up bawaa (come) him: and they came to Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and shachath (destroyed) all the shar (prince / ruler) of the im (people / nation) from among the im (people / nation), and shalach (send) all their shalal (spoil) to the malak (king) of Damashaq (Damascus).

For the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of the Aram (Syrians) bawaa (come) with a matzair (small) company of ayash (husband/individual man); and Yahawah nathan (give) a very rab (great) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) into their yad (hand), because they had forsaken Yahawah, the Alahayam of their ab (father). So they ishah (make) shapat (judgment) on Yawaash (Joash).

When they were departed for him (for they izab (left) him very sick), his own ibad (servant) qashar (conspired) against him for the dam (blood) of the ban (son) of Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the kahan (priest), and harag (killed) him on his matah (bed), and he mawath (death); and they qabar (bury) him in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David), but they didn't qabar (bury) him in the tombs of the malak (king).

These are those who qashar (conspired) against him: Zabad (Zabad) the ban (son) Shamaith (of) Shimeath the imawanayath (ammonitess), and Yahawazabad (Jehozabad) the ban (son) of Shamarayath (Shimrith) the Moabitess.

Now concerning his ban (son), and the greatness of the mashaa (burdens) laid on him, and the rebuilding of the bayath (house) of Alahayam, behold, they are kathab (written) in the commentary of the sapar (book / scribed document) of the malak (king). Amatzayah (Amaziah) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Amatzayah (Amaziah) was isharayam (twenty) - chamash (five) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) isharayam (twenty) - thashai (nine) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Yahawaidayan (Jehoaddan), of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
He ishah (make) that which was yashar (right) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, but not with a shalam (full / whole / complete) labab (heart).
Now it happened, when the mamalakah (kingdom) was chazaq (established) to him, that he harag (killed) his ibad (servant) who had harag (killed) the malak (king) his ab (father).

But he didn't put their ban (son) to mawath (death), but did according to that which is kathab (written) in the thawarah (instruction) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of Mashah (Moses), as Yahawah tzawah (commanded), amar (spoke), The ab (father) shall not mawath (death) for the ban (son), neither shall the ban (son) mawath (death) for the ab (father); but every ayash (husband/individual man) shall mawath (death) for his own chataa (sin).

Moreover Amatzayah (Amaziah) qabatz (gathered) Yahawadah (Judah) qabatz (together), and ordered them according to their ab (father)' bayath (house), under shar (prince / ruler) of alap (thousands) and shar (prince / ruler) of maah (hundred), even all Yahawadah (Judah) and Banayamayan (Benjamin): and he paqad (visit) them from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, and matzaa (found) them shalawash (three) maah (hundred) alap (thousand) bachar (chosen) men, yatzaa (go out / come out) to go forth to tzabaa (troop), who could achaz (handle) ramach (spear) and tzanah (shield).

He shakar (hired) also one maah (hundred) alap (thousand) gabawar (mighty) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of valor out of Yasharaal (Israel) for one maah (hundred) kakar (talents) of kasap (silver).

A ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam bawaa (come) to him, amar (spoke), O malak (king), don't let the tzabaa (troop) of Yasharaal (Israel) bawaa (come) with you; for Yahawah is not with Yasharaal (Israel), with all the ban (son) of Aparayam (Ephraim).

But if you will bawaa (come), ishah (make) action, be chazaq (strong) for the malachamah (battle). Alahayam will overthrow you panayam (before) the ayab (enemy); for Alahayam yash (has) kach (strength / mighty / power) to izar (help), and to overthrow.

Amatzayah (Amaziah) amar (spoke) to the ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam, "But what shall we ishah (make) for the maah (hundred) kakar (talents) which I nathan (give) given to the gadawad (army) of Yasharaal (Israel)?" The ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam amar (spoke), Yahawah is able to nathan (give) you much more than this.

Then Amatzayah (Amaziah) badal (separated) them, the gadawad (army) that bawaa (come) come to him out of Aparayam (Ephraim), to bawaa (come) maqawam (place) again: therefore their ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) was maad (greatly) charah (hot with anger) against Yahawadah (Judah), and they shawab (turn back / repent) maqawam (place) in charay (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting).

Amatzayah (Amaziah) chazaq (took) courage, and nahag (led) forth his im (people / nation), and yalak (went) to the gayaa (valley) of malach (salt), and nakah (struck) ishar (ten) alap (thousand) of the ban (son) of Shaiyar (Seir).

The ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah) shabah (carry) away ishar (ten) alap (thousand) chay (life), and bawaa (come) them to the raash (head) of the salai (rock), and shalak (threw) them down from the raash (head) of the salai (rock), so that they all were baqai (broken) in pieces.

But the ban (son) of the gadawad (army) whom Amatzayah (Amaziah) shawab (turn back / repent) back, that they should not yalak (go) with him to malachamah (battle), pashat (fell) on the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), from Shamarawan (Samaria) even to Bayathachawarawan (Beth) Horon, and nakah (struck) of them shalawash (three) alap (thousand), and bazaz (took) much bazah (spoil).

Now it happened, achar (other) that Amatzayah (Amaziah) bawaa (come) come from the nakah (slaughter) of the Adamay (Edomites), that he bawaa (come) the Alahayam of the ban (son) of Shaiyar (Seir), and imad (set) them up to be his Alahayam, and shachah (bowed) down panayam (himself) before them, and qatar (burned) incense to them.

Therefore the ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah was charah (hot with anger) against Amatzayah (Amaziah), and he shalach (send) to him a nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), who amar (spoke) to him, Why have you darash (sought) after the Alahayam of the im (people / nation), which have not natzal (delivered) their own im (people / nation) out of your yad (hand)?

It happened, as he dabar (word / matter) with him, that the king amar (spoke) to him, "nathan (give) we made you one of the malak (king) yaitz (counselors)? Stop! Why should you be nakah (struck) down?" Then the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) stopped, and amar (spoke), I yadai (know) that Alahayam has yaitz (determined) to shachath (destroy) you, because you ishah (make) done this, and have not shamai (hearken / hear) to my itzah (counsel).

Then Amatzayah (Amaziah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) yaitz (consulted) his advisers, and shalach (send) to Yawaash (Joash), the ban (son) of Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) the ban (son) of Yahawaa (Jehu), malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel), amar (spoke), ban (son), raah (see) us look one another in the panayam (face).

Yawaash (Joash) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) shalach (send) to Amatzayah (Amaziah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), amar (spoke), The chawach (thistle) that was in Labanawan (Lebanon) shalach (send) to the araz (cedar) that was in Labanawan (Lebanon), amar (spoke), ‘nathan (give) your bath (daughter) to my ban (son) as his ashah (wife/individual woman); then a shadah (wild) animal that was in Labanawan (Lebanon) ibar (pass over/through) by, and ramas (trampled) down the chawach (thistle).

You amar (spoke) to yourself that you have nakah (struck) Adam (Edom); and your lab (heart) nashaa (lift) you up to kabad (boast). Now stay at bayath (house). Why should you garah (meddle) with rai (trouble), that you should napal (fall / be cast down), even you, and Yahawadah (Judah) with you?’

But Amatzayah (Amaziah) would not shamai (hearken / hear); for it was of Alahayam, that he might nathan (give) them into the yad (hand) of their enemies, because they had darash (sought) after the Alahayam of Adam (Edom).

So Yawaash (Joash) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) ilah (go up / offer) up; and he and Amatzayah (Amaziah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) raah (see) one another in the panayam (face) at Bayathashamash (Beth) Shemesh, which belongs to Yahawadah (Judah).
Yahawadah (Judah) was defeated by Yasharaal (Israel); and they nawas (fled) every ayash (husband/individual man) to his ahal (tent).

Yawaash (Joash) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) thapash (took) Amatzayah (Amaziah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), the ban (son) of Yawaash (Joash) the ban (son) of Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz), at Bayathashamash (Beth) Shemesh, and bawaa (come) him to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and paratz (broke) down the chawamah (wall) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) from the shair (gate) of Aparayam (Ephraim) to the panah (corner) shair (gate), arabai (four) maah (hundred) amah (cubits).

He took all the zahab (gold) and kasap (silver), and all the kalay (vessels) that were matzaa (found) in the bayath (house) of Alahayam with Ibadaadawam (Obed-Edom), and the awatzar (treasures) of the malak (king) bayath (house), the hostages also, and shawab (turn back / repent) to Shamarawan (Samaria).

Amatzayah (Amaziah) the ban (son) of Yawaash (Joash) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) chayah (lived) achar (other) the mawath (death) of Yawaash (Joash) ban (son) of Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) chamash (fifteen) shanah (years).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Amatzayah (Amaziah), raashawan (first) and acharawan (last), behold, aren't they kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Yasharaal (Israel)?

Now from the ith (time) that Amatzayah (Amaziah) sawar (turned) away from achar (other) Yahawah, they made a qashar (conspiracy) against him in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). He nawas (fled) to Lakayash (Lachish); but they shalach (send) achar (other) him to Lakayash (Lachish), and mawath (death) him there.
They nashaa (lift) him on sawas (horses), and qabar (bury) him with his ab (father) in the iyar (city) of Yahawadah (Judah).

All the im (people / nation) of Yahawadah (Judah) laqach (take / seized) Izayah (Uzziah), who was sixteen shanah (years) ban (son), and made him malak (king) in the place of his ab (father) Amatzayah (Amaziah).
He banah (built) Ayalawath (Eloth), and shawab (turn back / repent) it to Yahawadah (Judah), achar (other) that the malak (king) shakab (slept) with his ab (father).

Sixteen shanah (years) ban (son) was Izayah (Uzziah) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) chamashayam (fifty) - shanayam (two) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Yakalayah (Jechiliah), of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
He ishah (make) that which was yashar (right) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, according to all that his ab (father) Amatzayah (Amaziah) ishah (make) done.

He set himself to darash (seek) Alahayam in the yawam (day) of Zakarayah (Zechariah), who had bayan (between) in the raah (see) of Alahayam: and as long as he darash (sought) Yahawah, Alahayam made him to tzalach (prosper).

He yatzaa (go out / come out) forth and lacham (warred) against the Palashathay (Philistines), and paratz (broke) down the chawamah (wall) of gath (gath), and the chawamah (wall) of Yabanah (Jabneh), and the chawamah (wall) Ashadawad (of) Ashdod; and he banah (built) iyar (cities) Ashadawad (in) the country of Ashdod, and among the Palashathay (Philistines).
Alahayam izar (helped) him against the Palashathay (Philistines), and against the Irabay (Arabians) who lived in Gawarabail (Gur) Baal, and the maiwanay (meunim).
The Imawanay (Ammonites) nathan (give) tribute to Izayah (Uzziah): and his sham (name) yalak (spread) abroad even to the entrance of Matzarayam (Egypt); for he grew mail (top/above) chazaq (strong).

Moreover Izayah (Uzziah) banah (built) magadal (towers) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) at the panah (corner) shair (gate), and at the gayaa (valley) shair (gate), and at the maqatzawai (turning) of the wall, and chazaq (fortified) them.

He banah (built) magadal (towers) in the madabar (wilderness), and chatzab (dug) out many bawar (cisterns), for he rab (had) much livestock; in the lowland also, and in the mayashawar (plain): and he had farmers and vineyard keepers in the har (mountain) and in the Karamal (fruitful) fields; for he ahab (love) farming.

Moreover Izayah (Uzziah) had an chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of malachamah (fighting) ishah (make), who yatzaa (go out / come out) out to tzabaa (troop) by gadawad (bands), according to the masapar (number) of their paqadah (reckoning) made by Yaiyaal (Jeiel) the sapar (book) and Maishayah (Maaseiah) the shatar (officer), under the yad (hand) of Chananayah (Hananiah), one of the malak (king) shar (prince / ruler).
The whole masapar (number) of the raash (head) of ab (father)' households, even the gabawar (mighty) men of valor, was two alap (thousand) and shash (six) maah (hundred).

Under their yad (hand) was an chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), shalawash (three) maah (hundred) alap (thousand) and shabai (seven) alap (thousand) and chamash (five) maah (hundred), who ishah (make) malachamah (war) with chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) kach (strength / mighty / power), to izar (help) the malak (king) against the ayab (enemy).

Izayah (Uzziah) kawan (prepared) for them, even for all the tzabaa (troop), magan (shield), and ramach (spears), and kawabai (helmets), and sharayawan (coats) of mail, and qashath (bows), and aban (stone) for qalai (slinging).

He ishah (make) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) chashabawan (engines), machashabah (invented) by skillful chashab (men), to be on the magadal (towers) and on the battlements, with which to yarah (shoot) chatzay (arrows) and gadawal (very great/important/mighty) aban (stone). His sham (name) yatzaa (go out / come out) rachawaq (far) abroad; for he was marvelously izar (helped), kay (surely) he was chazaq (strong).

But when he was chazaqah (strong), his lab (heart) was gabah (lifted) up, so that he did corruptly, and he mail (top/above) against Yahawah his Alahayam; for he bawaa (come) into the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah to qatar (burn) incense on the mazabach (altar) of qatar (incense).

Izarayah (Azariah) the kahan (priest) bawaa (come) in achar (other) him, and with him shamanayam (eighty) kahan (priest) of Yahawah, who were chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) ban (son):

And they resisted Izayah (Uzziah) the malak (king), and amar (spoke) to him, It isn't for you, Izayah (Uzziah), to qatar (burn) incense to Yahawah, but for the kahan (priest) the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron), who are qadash (set apart/make holy) to qatar (burn) incense. Yatzaa (go out / come out) out of the maqadash (sanctuary); for you have mail (top/above); neither shall it be for your honor from Yahawah Alahayam.

Then Izayah (Uzziah) was angry; and he had a maqatarath (censer) in his yad (hand) to qatar (burn) incense; and while he was angry with the kahan (priest), the tzaraith (leprosy) broke forth in his matzach (forehead) panayam (before) the kahan (priest) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, beside the mazabach (altar) of qatarath (incense).

Izarayah (Azariah) the raash (head) kahan (priest), and all the kahan (priest), panah (looked) on him, and behold, he was tzarai (leprous) in his matzach (forehead), and they bahal (thrust) him out quickly from there; yes, himself hurried also to yatzaa (go out / come out) out, because Yahawah had nagai (struck) him.

Izayah (Uzziah) the malak (king) was a tzarai (leper) to the yawam (day) of his mawath (death), and lived in a separate bayath (house), being a tzarai (leper); for he was gazar (cut) off from the bayath (house) of Yahawah: and Yawatham (Jotham) his ban (son) was over the malak (king) bayath (house), shapat (judging) the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Izayah (Uzziah), raashawan (first) and acharawan (last), Yashaiyah (Isaiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), the ban (son) of Amawatz (Amoz), kathab (wrote).

So Izayah (Uzziah) shakab (slept) with his ab (father); and they qabar (bury) him with his ab (father) in the shadah (field) of qabawarah (burial) which belonged to the malak (king); for they amar (spoke), "He is a tzarai (leper)." Yawatham (Jotham) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Yawatham (Jotham) was isharayam (twenty) - chamash (five) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) sixteen shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Yarawashaa (Jerushah) the bath (daughter) of Tzadawaq (Zadok).

He ishah (make) that which was yashar (right) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, according to all that his ab (father) Izayah (Uzziah) ishah (make) done: however he didn't enter into the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah. The im (people / nation) still did corruptly.
He banah (built) the ilayawan (upper) shair (gate) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and on the chawamah (wall) of Ipal (Ophel) he banah (built) much.
Moreover he banah (built) iyar (cities) in the har (mountain) country of Yahawadah (Judah), and in the Charash (forests) he banah (built) bayaranayath (castles) and towers.

He lacham (fought) also with the malak (king) of the children of imawan (ammon), and chazaq (prevailed) against them. The ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon) nathan (give) him the same shanah (year) one maah (hundred) kakar (talents) of kasap (silver), and ishar (ten) alap (thousand) kar (measures) of chatah (wheat), and ishar (ten) alap (thousand) of shairah (barley). The ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon) shawab (turn back / repent) that much to him in the shanay (second) shanah (year) also, and in the shalayashay (third).
So Yawatham (Jotham) became chazaq (mighty), because he kawan (ordered) his darak (ways) panayam (before) Yahawah his Alahayam.

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Yawatham (Jotham), and all his malachamah (wars), and his darak (ways), behold, they are kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) and Yahawadah (Judah).
He was chamash (five) and isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king), and malak (king) sixteen shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
Yawatham (Jotham) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and they qabar (bury) him in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David): and Achaz (Ahaz) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Achaz (Ahaz) was isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) sixteen shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and he didn't do that which was yashar (right) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, like Dawad (David) his ab (father);
But he yalak (walked) in the darak (ways) of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel), and ishah (make) also masakah (molten) images for the Bail (Baals).

Moreover he burnt qatar (incense) in the gayaa (valley) of the ban (son) of Hanam (Hinnom), and burnt his ban (son) in the ash (fire), according to the thawaibah (abominations) of the gaway (nation / people) whom Yahawah yarash (cast) out panayam (before) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel).
He zabach (sacrificed) and burnt qatar (incense) in the bamah (high) places, and on the gabaih (hills), and under every rainan (green) itz (tree).

Therefore Yahawah his Alahayam nathan (give) him into the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Aram (Syria); and they nakah (struck) him, and shabah (carried) away of his a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) multitude of shabayah (captives), and bawaa (come) them to Damashaq (Damascus). He was also nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel), who nakah (struck) him with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) makah (slaughter).

For Paqach (Pekah) the ban (son) of Ramalayahaw (Remaliah) harag (killed) in Yahawadah (Judah) one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) alap (thousand) in achad (one) yawam (day), all of them chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) ban (son); because they had forsaken Yahawah, the Alahayam of their ab (father).

Zakaray (Zichri), a gabawar (mighty) man of Aparayam (Ephraim), harag (killed) Maishayah (Maaseiah) the malak (king) ban (son), and Izarayaqam (Azrikam) the nagayad (ruler) of the bayath (house), and Alaqanah (Elkanah) who was mashanah (next) to the malak (king).

The ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) shabah (carried) away captive of their ach (brother/kinsman) two maah (hundred) alap (thousand), ashah (wife/individual woman), ban (son), and bath (daughter), and bazaz (took) also away much shalal (spoil) from them, and bawaa (come) the shalal (spoil) to Shamarawan (Samaria).

But a nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) of Yahawah was there, whose sham (name) was Iwadad (Oded): and he yatzaa (go out / come out) out to panayam (meet) the tzabaa (troop) that bawaa (come) to Shamarawan (Samaria), and amar (spoke) to them, Behold, because Yahawah, the Alahayam of your ab (father), was angry with Yahawadah (Judah), he nathan (give) delivered them into your yad (hand), and you have harag (slain) them in a zaip (rage) which has nagai (reached) up to shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)).

Now you purpose to kabash (keep) under the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) for ibad (servant) and bondmaids for yourselves. Aren't there even with you trespasses of your own against Yahawah your Alahayam?

Now shamai (hearken / hear) me therefore, and shawab (turn back / repent) back the shabayah (captives), that you have shabah (taken) captive from your ach (brother/kinsman); for the charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah is on you.

Then some of the raash (head) of the ban (son) of Aparayam (Ephraim), Izarayah (Azariah) the ban (son) of Yahawachanan (Johanan), Barakayah (Berechiah) the ban (son) of Mashalamawath (Meshillemoth), and Yachazaqayah (Jehizkiah) the ban (son) of Shalawam (Shallum), and Imashaa (Amasa) the ban (son) of Chadalay (Hadlai), qawam (rise up) up bawaa (come) those who came from the tzabaa (troop),

And amar (spoke) to them, You shall not bawaa (come) in the shabayah (captives) here: for you purpose that which will bring on us a ashamah (trespass) against Yahawah, to yasap (add) to our chataah (sin) and to our ashamah (trespass); for our ashamah (trespass) is rab (great), and there is fierce ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) against Yasharaal (Israel).
So the chalatz (armed) men izab (left) the shabayah (captives) and the bazah (spoil) panayam (before) the shar (prince / ruler) and all the qahal (assembly).

The ayash (husband/individual man) who have been mentioned by sham (name) qawam (rise up) up, and chazaq (took) the shabayah (captives), and with the shalal (spoil) labash (clothed) all who were mairam (naked) among them, dressed them, gave them sandals, and gave them something to akal (eat) and to shaqah (drink), sawak (anointed) them, nahal (carried) all the kashal (stumble / stagger) of them on donkeys, and bawaa (come) them to Yarayachaw (Jericho), the iyar (city) of thamar (palm) trees, to their ach (brother/kinsman). Then they shawab (turn back / repent) to Shamarawan (Samaria).
At that ith (time) malak (king) Achaz (Ahaz) shalach (send) to the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) to izar (help) him.
For again the Adamay (Edomites) bawaa (come) come and nakah (struck) Yahawadah (Judah), and shabah (carried) away shabay (captives).

The Palashathay (Philistines) also had pashat (invaded) the iyar (cities) of the lowland, and of the nagab (south) of Yahawadah (Judah), and had lakad (taken) Bayathashamash (Beth) Shemesh, and Ayalawan (Aijalon), and Gadarawath (Gederoth), and Shawakah (Soco) with its bath (daughter), and Thamanah (Timnah) with its bath (daughter), Gamazaw (Gimzo) also and its bath (daughter): and they lived there.

For Yahawah kanai (brought) Yahawadah (Judah) low because of Achaz (Ahaz) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel); for he had dealt wantonly in Yahawadah (Judah), and mail (top/above) severely against Yahawah.
Thagalathapalaasar (Tilgath) Pilneser malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) bawaa (come) to him, and tzawar (distressed) him, but didn't chazaq (strengthen) him.

For Achaz (Ahaz) chalaq (took) away a portion out of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and out of the bayath (house) of the malak (king) and of the shar (prince / ruler), and nathan (give) it to the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria): but it didn't izarah (help) him.
In the ith (time) of his tzarar (distress), he mail (top/above) yet more against Yahawah, this same malak (king) Achaz (Ahaz).

For he zabach (sacrificed) to the Alahayam of Damashaq (Damascus), which nakah (struck) him; and he amar (spoke), "Because the Alahayam of the malak (king) of Aram (Syria) izar (helped) them, so I will zabach (sacrifice) to them, that they may izar (help) me." But they were the kashal (stumble / stagger) of him, and of all Yasharaal (Israel).

Achaz (Ahaz) asap (gathered) together the kalay (vessels) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam, and qatzatz (cut) in pieces the kalay (vessels) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam, and sagar (shut) up the dalath (doors) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah; and he ishah (make) him mazabach (altars) in every panah (corner) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
In every iyar (city) of Yahawadah (Judah) he ishah (make) bamah (high) places to qatar (burn) incense to other Alahayam, and provoked to kais (anger) Yahawah, the Alahayam of his ab (father).

Now the yathar (rest) of his dabar (word / matter), and all his darak (ways), raashawan (first) and acharawan (last), behold, they are kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Yasharaal (Israel).

Achaz (Ahaz) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and they qabar (bury) him in the iyar (city), even in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); for they didn't bawaa (come) him into the tombs of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel): and Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) began to malak (king) when he was isharayam (twenty) - chamash (five) shanah (years) ban (son); and he malak (king) isharayam (twenty) - thashai (nine) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Abayah (Abijah), the bath (daughter) of Zakarayah (Zechariah).
He ishah (make) that which was yashar (right) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, according to all that Dawad (David) his ab (father) ishah (make) done.

He in the raashawan (first) shanah (year) of his malak (king), in the raashawan (first) chadash (month), pathach (opened) the dalath (doors) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and chazaq (repaired) them.
He bawaa (come) in the kahan (priest) and the Lawayay (Levites), and asap (gathered) them together into the rachab (broad) place on the mazarach (east),

And amar (spoke) to them, shamai (hearken / hear) to me, you Lawayay (Levites)! Now qadash (set apart/make holy) yourselves, and qadash (set apart/make holy) the bayath (house) of Yahawah, the Alahayam of your ab (father), and yatzaa (go out / come out) out the nadah (filthiness) out of the qadash (set apart/make holy) place.

For our ab (father) have mail (top/above), and ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah our Alahayam, and have forsaken him, and have sabab (turned) away their panayam (faces) from the mashakan (habitation) of Yahawah, and nathan (give) their irap (neck).

Also they have sagar (shut) up the dalath (doors) of the awalam (porch), and put out the nayar (lamps), and have not qatar (burned) qatarath (incense) nor ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilah (offerings) in the qadash (set apart/make holy) place to the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel).

Therefore the qatzap (wrath) of Yahawah was on Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and he nathan (give) delivered them to be tossed back and forth, to be an shamah (astonishment), and a sharaqah (hissing), as you raah (see) with your iyan (eye).
For, behold, our ab (father) napal (fall / be cast down) fallen by the charab (sword), and our ban (son) and our bath (daughter) and our wives are in shabay (captivity) for this.

Now it is in my labab (heart) to karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) with Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), that his charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) may shawab (turn back / repent) away from us.

My ban (son), don't be shalah (negligent) now; for Yahawah has bachar (chosen) you to imad (stand) panayam (before) him, to sharath (minister) to him, and that you should be his sharath (ministers), and qatar (burn) incense.

Then the Lawayay (Levites) qawam (rise up), Machath (Mahath), the ban (son) of Imashay (Amasai), and Yawaal (Joel) the ban (son) of Izarayah (Azariah), of the ban (son) of the Qahathay (Kohathites); and of the ban (son) of Mararay (Merari), Qayash (Kish) the ban (son) of Ibaday (Abdi), and Izarayah (Azariah) the ban (son) Yahalalaal (of) Jehallelel; and of the garashanay (gershonites), Yawaach (Joah) the ban (son) of Zamah (Zimmah), and Idan (Eden) the ban (son) of Yawaach (Joah);
And of the ban (son) of Alayatzapan (Elizaphan), Shamaray (Shimri) and Yaiyaal (Jeuel); and of the ban (son) of Asap (Asaph), Zakarayah (Zechariah) and Mathanayah (Mattaniah);
And of the ban (son) of Hayaman (Heman), Yachayaal (Jehuel) and Shamaiy (Shimei); and of the ban (son) of Yadawathawan (Jeduthun), Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) and Izayaal (Uzziel).

They asap (gathered) their ach (brother/kinsman), and qadash (set apart/make holy) themselves, and bawaa (come) in, according to the matzawah (commandment) of the malak (king) by the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, to tahar (cleanse) the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

The kahan (priest) bawaa (come) in to the inner panayamah (part) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, to tahar (cleanse) it, and yatzaa (go out / come out) out all the tamaah (uncleanness) that they matzaa (found) in the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah into the chatzar (court) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah. The Lawayay (Levites) qabal (took) it, to yatzaa (go out / come out) it out chawatz (abroad) to the nachal (stream / river) Qadarawan (Kidron).

Now they chalal (began) on the achad (one) day of the raashawan (first) chadash (month) to qadash (set apart/make holy), and on the shamanah (eighth) yawam (day) of the chadash (month) bawaa (come) they to the awalam (porch) of Yahawah; and they qadash (set apart/make holy) the bayath (house) of Yahawah in shamanah (eight) yawam (day): and on the sixteenth day of the raashawan (first) chadash (month) they kalah (complete / finish) an end.

Then they bawaa (come) in to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) the malak (king) within the palace, and amar (spoke), We have tahar (cleansed) all the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and the mazabach (altar) of burnt ilah (offering), with all its kalay (vessels), and the shalachan (table) of show mairakath (bread), with all its kalay (vessels).

Moreover all the kalay (vessels), which malak (king) Achaz (Ahaz) in his malakawath (reign) threw zanach (away) when he mail (top/above), have we kawan (prepared) and qadash (set apart/make holy); and behold, they are panayam (before) the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah.
Then Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) the malak (king) arose shakam (early), and asap (gathered) the shar (prince / ruler) of the iyar (city), and ilah (go up / offer) up to the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

They bawaa (come) shabai (seven) par (bulls), and shabai (seven) ayal (rams), and shabai (seven) kabash (lambs), and shabai (seven) male iz (goats), for a chataah (sin) offering for the mamalakah (kingdom) and for the maqadash (sanctuary) and for Yahawadah (Judah). He commanded the kahan (priest) the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron) to ilah (go up / offer) them on the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah.

So they shachat (killed) the baqar (morning), and the kahan (priest) qabal (received) the dam (blood), and zaraq (sprinkled) it on the mazabach (altar): and they shachat (killed) the ayal (rams), and zaraq (sprinkled) the dam (blood) on the mazabach (altar): they shachat (killed) also the kabash (lambs), and zaraq (sprinkled) the dam (blood) on the mazabach (altar).
They nagash (brought) near the male shaiyar (goats) for the chataah (sin) offering panayam (before) the malak (king) and the qahal (assembly); and they samak (laid) their yad (hand) on them:

And the kahan (priest) shachat (killed) them, and they made a chataa (sin) offering with their dam (blood) on the mazabach (altar), to make kapar (atonement) for all Yasharaal (Israel); for the malak (king) commanded that the burnt ilah (offering) and the sin ilah (offering) should be made for all Yasharaal (Israel).

He imad (set) the Lawayay (Levites) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah with matzalath (cymbals), with stringed instruments, and with kanawar (harps), according to the matzawah (commandment) of Dawad (David), and of Gad (Gad) the malak (king) chazah (seer), and Nathan (Nathan) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy); for the matzawah (commandment) was of Yahawah by his nabayaa (prophet/prophecy).
The Lawayay (Levites) imad (stood) with the kalay (instruments) of Dawad (David), and the kahan (priest) with the chatzatzarah (trumpets).

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) commanded to ilah (go up / offer) the burnt ilah (go up / offer) on the mazabach (altar). When the burnt ilah (offering) chalal (began), the shayar (song) of Yahawah chalal (began) also, and the chatzatzarah (trumpets), together with the kalay (instruments) of Dawad (David) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel).

All the qahal (assembly) shachah (worshiped), and the singers shayar (sang), and the chatzatzarah (trumpeters) chatzar (sounded); all this continued until the burnt ilah (offering) was kalah (complete / finish).
When they kalah (complete / finish) made an end of ilah (go up / offer), the malak (king) and all who were matzaa (present) with him karai (bowed) themselves and shachah (worshiped).

Moreover Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) the malak (king) and the shar (prince / ruler) commanded the Lawayay (Levites) to sing halal (praise) to Yahawah with the dabar (word / matter) of Dawad (David), and of Asap (Asaph) the chazah (seer). They sang halal (praise) with shamachah (gladness), and they bowed their qadad (heads) and shachah (worshiped).

Then Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) inah (answer / respond), "Now you malaa (have) consecrated yourselves to Yahawah; nagash (come) near and bawaa (come) zabach (sacrifices) and thank thawadah (offerings) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah." The qahal (assembly) bawaa (come) in zabach (sacrifices) and thank thawadah (offerings); and as many as were of a nadayab (willing) lab (heart) brought burnt ilah (offerings).

The masapar (number) of the burnt ilah (offerings) which the qahal (assembly) bawaa (come) was shabaiyam (seventy) baqar (morning), one maah (hundred) ayal (rams), and two maah (hundred) kabash (lambs): all these were for a burnt ilah (offering) to Yahawah.
The qadash (set apart/make holy) things were shash (six) maah (hundred) baqar (morning) of cattle and shalawash (three) alap (thousand) tzaan (sheep).

But the kahan (priest) were too mait (few), so that they yakal (could) not pashat (flay) all the burnt ilah (offerings): therefore their ach (brother/kinsman) the Lawayay (Levites) chazaq (helped) them, until the malaakah (work) was kalah (complete / finish), and until the kahan (priest) had qadash (set apart/make holy) themselves; for the Lawayay (Levites) were more yashar (upright) in labab (heart) to qadash (set apart/make holy) themselves than the kahan (priest).

Also the burnt ilah (offerings) were in rab (abundance), with the chalab (fat) of the shalam (peace) offerings, and with the drink nasak (offerings) for every burnt ilah (offering). So the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah was kawan (set) in order.

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) shamach (rejoiced), and all the im (people / nation), because of that which Alahayam had kawan (prepared) for the im (people / nation): for the thing was done pathaawam (suddenly).

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) shalach (send) to all Yasharaal (Israel) and Yahawadah (Judah), and kathab (wrote) agarath (letters) also to Aparayam (Ephraim) and Manashah (Manasseh), that they should bawaa (come) to the bayath (house) of Yahawah at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), to ishah (make) the pasach (passover) to Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel).

For the malak (king) had taken yaitz (counsel), and his shar (prince / ruler), and all the qahal (assembly) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), to ishah (make) the pasach (passover) in the shanay (second) chadash (month).

For they yakal (could) not ishah (make) it at that ith (time), because the kahan (priest) had not qadash (set apart/make holy) themselves in sufficient number, neither had the im (people / nation) asap (gathered) themselves together to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
The thing was yashar (right) in the eyes of the malak (king) and of all the qahal (assembly).

So they imad (established) a dabar (word / matter) to ibar (pass over/through) proclamation throughout all Yasharaal (Israel), Baarashabai (from) Beersheba Dan (even) to Dan, that they should bawaa (come) to ishah (make) the pasach (passover) to Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): for they ishah (make) not kept it in rab (great) numbers in such sort as it is kathab (written).

So the couriers yalak (went) with the agarath (letters) from the malak (king) and his shar (prince / ruler) throughout all Yasharaal (Israel) and Yahawadah (Judah), and according to the matzawah (commandment) of the malak (king), amar (spoke), You ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), shawab (turn back / repent) again to Yahawah, the Alahayam of Abaraham (Abraham), Yatzachaq (Isaac), and Yasharaal (Israel), that he may shawab (turn back / repent) to the shaar (remnant) that have palayatah (escaped) of you out of the kap (hand) of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria).

Don't be like your ab (father), and like your ach (brother/kinsman), who mail (top/above) against Yahawah, the Alahayam of their ab (father), so that he nathan (give) them up to shamah (desolation), as you raah (see).

Now don't be stiff-necked, as your ab (father) were; but nathan (give) yad (hand) to Yahawah, and bawaa (come) into his maqadash (sanctuary), which he has qadash (set apart/make holy) iwalam (forever), and ibad (servant) Yahawah your Alahayam, that his charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) may shawab (turn back / repent) away from you.

For if you shawab (turn back / repent) again to Yahawah, your ach (brother/kinsman) and your ban (son) shall find racham (compassion) panayam (before) those who shabah (led) them captive, and shall shawab (turn back / repent) again into this aratz (Earth/land): for Yahawah your Alahayam is chanawan (gracious) and rachawam (merciful), and will not sawar (turn) away his panayam (face) from you, if you shawab (turn back / repent) to him.

So the couriers ibar (pass over/through) from iyar (city) to iyar (city) through the aratz (Earth/land) of Aparayam (Ephraim) and Manashah (Manasseh), even to Zabawalawan (Zebulun): but they ridiculed them, and laig (mocked) them.
Nevertheless ayash (husband/individual man) men of Ashar (Asher) and Manashah (Manasseh) and of Zabawalawan (Zebulun) kanai (humbled) themselves, and bawaa (come) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Also on Yahawadah (Judah) came the yad (hand) of Alahayam to nathan (give) them achad (one) lab (heart), to ishah (make) the matzawah (commandment) of the malak (king) and of the shar (prince / ruler) by the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah.

Many im (people / nation) asap (assembled) at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to ishah (make) the chag (feast/festival) of unleavened matzah (bread) in the shanay (second) chadash (month), a very rab (great) qahal (assembly).

They qawam (rise up) and sawar (took) away the mazabach (altars) that were in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and all the altars for qatar (incense) sawar (took) they away, and shalak (cast) them into the nachal (stream / river) Qadarawan (Kidron).

Then they shachat (killed) the pasach (passover) on the fourteenth day of the shanay (second) chadash (month): and the kahan (priest) and the Lawayay (Levites) were kalam (ashamed), and qadash (set apart/make holy) themselves, and bawaa (come) burnt ilah (offerings) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

They imad (stood) in their imad (place) after their mashapat (order), according to the thawarah (instruction) of Mashah (Moses) the ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam: the kahan (priest) zaraq (sprinkled) the dam (blood) which they received of the yad (hand) of the Lawayay (Levites).

For there were many in the qahal (assembly) who had not qadash (set apart/make holy) themselves: therefore the Lawayay (Levites) were in charge of shachayatah (killing) the pasach (passovers) for everyone who was not tahawar (clean), to qadash (set apart/make holy) them to Yahawah.

For a marabayath (multitude) of the im (people / nation), even many of Aparayam (Ephraim) and Manashah (Manasseh), Yashashakar (Issachar) and Zabawalawan (Zebulun), had not tahar (cleansed) themselves, yet they akal (eat) the pasach (passover) otherwise than it is kathab (written). For Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) had palal (prayed) for them, amar (spoke), May the tawab (pleasant/functional) Yahawah kapar (pardon) everyone

Who kawan (sets) his labab (heart) to darash (seek) Alahayam, Yahawah, the Alahayam of his ab (father), even if they aren't clean according to the taharah (purification) of the qadash (set apart/make holy).
Yahawah shamai (hearken / hear) to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), and rapaa (healed) the im (people / nation).

The ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) who were matzaa (present) at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) ishah (make) the chag (feast/festival) of unleavened matzah (bread) shabai (seven) yawam (day) with gadawal (very great/important/mighty) shamachah (gladness); and the Lawayay (Levites) and the kahan (priest) halal (praise) Yahawah yawam (day) by yawam (day), singing with iz (strength / might / refuge) kalay (instruments) to Yahawah.

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) dabar (word / matter) lab (heart) to all the Lawayay (Levites) who had tawab (pleasant/functional) shakal (understanding) in the service of Yahawah. So they akal (eat) throughout the mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) for the shabai (seven) yawam (day), zabach (offering) sacrifices of shalam (peace) zabach (offerings), and making yadah (confession) to Yahawah, the Alahayam of their ab (father).
The whole qahal (assembly) took yaitz (counsel) to ishah (make) other shabai (seven) yawam (day); and they ishah (make) another shabai (seven) yawam (day) with shamachah (gladness).

For Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) rawam (will lift up) to the qahal (assembly) for offerings one alap (thousand) par (bulls) and shabai (seven) alap (thousand) tzaan (sheep); and the shar (prince / ruler) rawam (will lift up) to the qahal (assembly) a alap (thousand) par (bulls) and ishar (ten) alap (thousand) tzaan (sheep): and a rab (great) number of kahan (priest) qadash (set apart/make holy) themselves.

All the qahal (assembly) of Yahawadah (Judah), with the kahan (priest) and the Lawayay (Levites), and all the qahal (assembly) who bawaa (come) out of Yasharaal (Israel), and the foreigners who bawaa (come) out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Yasharaal (Israel), and who lived in Yahawadah (Judah), shamach (rejoiced).

So there was gadawal (very great/important/mighty) shamachah (joy) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); for yawam (day) the time of Shalamah (Solomon) the ban (son) of Dawad (David) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) there was not the like in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Then the kahan (priest) the Lawayay (Levites) qawam (rise up) and barak (blessed) the im (people / nation): and their qawal (sound / voice) was shamai (hearken / hear), and their thapalah (prayer) bawaa (come) up to his qadash (set apart/make holy) maiwan (habitation), even to shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)).

Now when all this was kalah (complete / finish), all Yasharaal (Israel) who were matzaa (present) yatzaa (go out / come out) out to the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and shabar (broke) in shabar (pieces) the matzabah (pillars), and gadai (cut) down the Asharah (Asherim), and nathatz (broke) down the bamah (high) places and the mazabach (altars) out of all Yahawadah (Judah) and Banayamayan (Benjamin), in Aparayam (Ephraim) also and Manashah (Manasseh), until they kalah (complete / finish) destroyed them all. Then all the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) shawab (turn back / repent), every ayash (husband/individual man) to his achazah (possession), into their own iyar (cities).

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) imad (appointed) the machalaqath (divisions) of the kahan (priest) and the Lawayay (Levites) after their machalaqath (divisions), every ayash (husband/individual man) pah (according) to his ibadah (service), both the kahan (priest) and the Lawayay (Levites), for burnt ilah (offerings) and for peace ilah (offerings), to sharath (minister), and to give yadah (thanks), and to halal (praise) in the shair (gates) of the machanah (camp) of Yahawah.

He appointed also the malak (king) manath (portion) of his rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions) for the burnt ilah (offerings), for the baqar (morning) and irab (evening) burnt ilah (offerings), and the burnt ilah (offerings) for the shabath (shabath/rest), and for the new chadash (month), and for the mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) feasts, as it is kathab (written) in the thawarah (instruction) of Yahawah.
