Moreover he commanded the im (people / nation) who lived in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to nathan (give) the manath (portion) of the kahan (priest) and the Lawayay (Levites), that they might give themselves to the thawarah (instruction) of Yahawah.

As soon as the commandment paratz (came) abroad, the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) bawaa (come) in rabah (abundance) the raashayath (beginning) fruits of grain, new thayarawash (wine), and yatzahar (fresh oil), and dabash (honey), and of all the thabawaah (increase) of the shadah (field); and the maishar (tithe) of all things bawaa (come) they in rab (abundantly).

The ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) and Yahawadah (Judah), who lived in the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), they also bawaa (come) in the maishar (tithe) of cattle and tzaan (sheep), and the maishar (tithe) of qadash (set apart/make holy) things which were qadash (set apart/make holy) to Yahawah their Alahayam, and nathan (give) them by iram (heaps).
In the shalayashay (third) chadash (month) they chalal (began) to yasad (lay) the foundation of the iram (heaps), and kalah (complete / finish) them in the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month).
When Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) and the shar (prince / ruler) bawaa (come) and raah (see) the iram (heaps), they barak (blessed) Yahawah, and his im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel).
Then Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) darash (questioned) the kahan (priest) and the Lawayay (Levites) concerning the iram (heaps).

Izarayah (Azariah) the raash (head) kahan (priest), of the bayath (house) of Tzadawaq (Zadok), amar (spoke) him and amar (spoke), Since people chalal (began) to bawaa (come) the tharawamah (offerings) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah, we have akal (eat) and shabai (had) enough, and have yathar (left) rab (plenty): for Yahawah has barak (blessed) his im (people / nation); and that which is yathar (left) is this great hamawan (store).
Then Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) commanded them to kawan (prepare) rooms in the bayath (house) of Yahawah; and they kawan (prepared) them.

They bawaa (come) in the tharawamah (offerings) and the maishar (tithes) and the qadash (set apart/make holy) things faithfully: and over them Kawananayahaw (Conaniah) the Lawayay (Levite) was nagayad (ruler), and Shamaiy (Shimei) his ach (brother/kinsman) was mashanah (second).

Yachayaal (Jehiel), and Izazayahaw (Azaziah), and Nachath (Nahath), and Ishahaal (Asahel), and Yarayamawath (Jerimoth), and Yawazabad (Jozabad), and Alayaal (Eliel), and Yasamakayahaw (Ismachiah), and Machath (Mahath), and Banayah (Benaiah), were paqayad (overseers) under the yad (hand) of Kawananayahaw (Conaniah) and Shamaiy (Shimei) his ach (brother/kinsman), by the appointment of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) the malak (king), and Izarayah (Azariah) the nagayad (ruler) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam.

Qawaraa (Kore) the ban (son) of Yamanah (Imnah) the Lawayay (Levite), the shawair (porter) at the mazarach (east) gate, was over the freewill nadabah (voluntary / freewill offering) of Alahayam, to nathan (give) the tharawamah (offerings) of Yahawah, and the most qadash (set apart/make holy) things.

Under him were Idan (Eden), and Manayamayan (Miniamin), and Yashawai (Jeshua), and Shamaiyah (Shemaiah), Amarayah (Amariah), and Shakanayah (Shecaniah), in the iyar (cities) of the kahan (priest), in their amawanah (office) of trust, to nathan (give) to their ach (brother/kinsman) by machalaqath (divisions), as well to the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) as to the qatan (small/young/least):

Besides those who were yachash (reckoned) by genealogy of zakar (remembrance/memory), from shalawash (three) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, even everyone who bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah, as the duty of every yawam (day) required, for their ibadah (service) in their mashamarath (duty / watch) according to their machalaqath (divisions);

And those who were yachash (reckoned) by genealogy of the kahan (priest) by their ab (father)' bayath (house), and the Lawayay (Levites) from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, in their mashamarath (duty / watch) by their machalaqath (divisions);

And those who were yachash (reckoned) by genealogy of all their little tap (ones), their wives, and their ban (son), and their bath (daughter), through all the qahal (congregation): for in their amawanah (office) of trust they qadash (set apart/make holy) themselves in qadash (set apart/make holy).

Also for the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron) the kahan (priest), who were in the shadah (fields) of the magarash (suburbs) of their iyar (cities), in every iyar (city), there were ban (son) who were mentioned by sham (name), to nathan (give) manah (portions) to all the zakar (remembrance/memory) among the kahan (priest), and to all who were yachash (reckoned) by genealogy among the Lawayay (Levites).

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) ishah (make) so throughout all Yahawadah (Judah); and he ishah (make) that which was tawab (pleasant/functional) and yashar (right) and amath (truth) panayam (before) Yahawah his Alahayam.

In every maishah (work) that he chalal (began) in the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam, and in the thawarah (instruction), and in the matzawah (commandments), to darash (seek) his Alahayam, he ishah (make) it with all his labab (heart), and tzalach (prospered).

Achar (other) these things, and this amath (truth), Sanacharayab (Sennacherib) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) bawaa (come), and bawaa (come) into Yahawadah (Judah), and chanah (encamped) against the batzar (fortified) iyar (cities), and amar (spoke) to baqai (win) them for himself.
When Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) raah (see) that Sanacharayab (Sennacherib) bawaa (come) come, and that he panayam (was) purposed to malachamah (fight) against Yarawashalam (Jerusalem),

He took yaitz (counsel) with his shar (prince / ruler) and his gabawar (mighty) men to satham (stop) the mayam (Waters) of the springs which were outside of the iyar (city); and they izar (helped) him.

So many im (people / nation) qabatz (gathered) qabatz (together), and they satham (stopped) all the maiyan (springs), and the nachal (stream / river) that shatap (flowed) thawak (midst) the midst of the aratz (Earth/land), amar (spoke), Why should the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) bawaa (come), and matzaa (find) much mayam (Waters)?

He chazaq (took) courage, and banah (built) up all the chawamah (wall) that was paratz (broken) down, and ilah (go up / offer) it up to the magadal (towers), and the other chawamah (wall) outside, and chazaq (strengthened) Malawaa (Millo) in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David), and ishah (make) shalach (weapons) and magan (shield) in rab (abundance).

He nathan (give) shar (prince / ruler) of malachamah (war) over the im (people / nation), and qabatz (gathered) them together to him in the rachab (broad) place at the shair (gate) of the iyar (city), and dabar (word / matter) labab (comfortably) to them, amar (spoke),

"Be chazaq (strong) and amatz (courageous), don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid) nor chathath (dismayed) for the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), nor for all the hamawan (multitude) who is with him; for there is a greater with us than with him.

With him is an zarawai (arm) of bashar (flesh); but with us is Yahawah our Alahayam to izar (help) us, and to lacham (fight) our malachamah (battles)." The im (people / nation) samak (rested) themselves on the dabar (word / matter) of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah).

Achar (other) this, Sanacharayab (Sennacherib) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) shalach (send) his ibad (servant) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), (now he was before Lakayash (Lachish), and all his mamashalah (power) with him), to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and to all Yahawadah (Judah) who were at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), amar (spoke),
Thus amar (spoke) Sanacharayab (Sennacherib) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), In whom do you batach (trust), that you yashab (inhabit/dwell) under matzawar (siege) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)?

Doesn't Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) sawath (persuade) you, to nathan (give) you over to mawath (death) by raib (famine) and by tzamaa (thirst), amar (spoke), ‘Yahawah our Alahayam will natzal (deliver) us out of the kap (hand) of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria)?’

Hasn't the same Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) sawar (taken) away his bamah (high) places and his mazabach (altars), and commanded Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), amar (spoke), ‘You shall shachah (worship) panayam (before) achad (one) mazabach (altar), and on it you shall qatar (burn) incense?’

Don't you yadai (know) what I and my ab (father) ishah (make) done to all the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land)? Were the Alahayam of the gaway (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land) in any yakal (way) yakal (able) to natzal (deliver) their aratz (Earth/land) out of my yad (hand)?

Who was there among all the Alahayam of those gaway (nation / people) which my ab (father) charam (utterly) destroyed, that yakal (could) natzal (deliver) his im (people / nation) out of my yad (hand), that your Alahayam should be yakal (able) to natzal (deliver) you out of my yad (hand)?

Now therefore don't let Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) nashaa (lift) you, nor sawath (persuade) you in this way, neither aman (believe / have faith) him; for no Alawah of any gaway (nation / people) or mamalakah (kingdom) was yakal (able) to natzal (deliver) his im (people / nation) out of my yad (hand), and out of the yad (hand) of my ab (father). How much less will your Alahayam natzal (deliver) you out of my yad (hand)?
His ibad (servant) dabar (word / matter) yet more against Yahawah Alahayam, and against his ibad (servant) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah).

He also kathab (wrote) sapar (book / scribed document) insulting Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), and to amar (spoke) amar (spoke) him, saying, As the Alahayam of the gaway (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land), which have not natzal (delivered) their im (people / nation) out of my yad (hand), so shall the Alahayam of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) not natzal (deliver) his im (people / nation) out of my yad (hand).

They qaraa (called) with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qawal (sound / voice) in the Yahawadayath (Jews)' language to the im (people / nation) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) who were on the chawamah (wall), to frighten them, and to bahal (trouble) them; that they might lakad (take) the iyar (city).

They dabar (word / matter) of the Alahayam of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), as of the Alahayam of the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land), which are the maishah (work) of adam (men's) yad (hand).

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) the malak (king), and Yashaiyah (Isaiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) the ban (son) of Amawatz (Amoz), palal (prayed) because of this, and zaiq (cried) to shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)).

Yahawah shalach (send) an malaak (angel / messenger of Yah), who kachad (cut) off all the gabawar (mighty) men of valor, and the nagayad (leaders) and shar (prince / ruler), in the machanah (camp) of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria). So he shawab (turn back / repent) with bashath (shame) of panayam (face) to his own aratz (Earth/land). When he bawaa (come) come into the bayath (house) of his Alahayam, yatzayaa (those) who came forth from his own maih (bowels) killed him there with the charab (sword).

Thus Yahawah yashai (salvation) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) and the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) from the yad (hand) of Sanacharayab (Sennacherib) the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), and from the yad (hand) of all others, and nahal (guided) them on sabayab (surrounding) side.

Many bawaa (come) manachah (gifts) to Yahawah to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and magadanah (precious) things to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah); so that he was nashaa (lift) in the iyan (eye) of all gaway (nation / people) from achar (other).
In those yawam (day) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) was chalah (afflict) even to mawath (death): and he palal (prayed) to Yahawah; and he amar (spoke) to him, and nathan (give) him a mawapath (sign).

But Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) didn't shawab (turn back / repent) again according to the gamawal (benefit) done to him; for his lab (heart) was gabah (lifted) up: therefore there was qatzap (wrath) on him, and on Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Notwithstanding Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) kanai (humbled) himself for the gabah (pride) of his lab (heart), both he and the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), so that the qatzap (wrath) of Yahawah didn't bawaa (come) on them in the yawam (day) of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah).

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) had maad (exceeding) much riches and honor: and he ishah (make) him awatzar (treasuries) for kasap (silver), and for zahab (gold), and for yaqar (precious) aban (stone), and for basham (spices), and for magan (shield), and for all kinds of chamadah (goodly) kalay (vessels);
Masakanah (storehouses) also for the thabawaah (increase) of grain and new thayarawash (wine) and yatzahar (fresh oil); and arawah (stalls) for all kinds of animals, and idar (flocks) in folds.

Moreover he ishah (make) him iyar (cities), and maqanah (possessions) of tzaan (flocks) and baqar (morning) in rab (abundance); for Alahayam nathan (give) given him very much rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions).

This same Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) also satham (stopped) the ilayawan (upper) mawatzaa (spring) of the waters of Gayachawan (Gihon), and brought them yashar (straight) down on the mairab (west) side of the iyar (city) of Dawad (David). Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) tzalach (prospered) in all his maishah (works).

However concerning the lawatz (ambassadors) of the shar (prince / ruler) of Babal (Babylon), who shalach (send) to him to darash (inquire) of the mawapath (wonder) that was done in the aratz (Earth/land), Alahayam izab (left) him, to nasah (try) him, that he might yadai (know) all that was in his labab (heart).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), and his chasad (grace) deeds, behold, they are kathab (written) in the chazawan (vision) of Yashaiyah (Isaiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) the ban (son) of Amawatz (Amoz), in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Yasharaal (Israel).

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and they qabar (bury) him in the mailah (ascent) of the tombs of the ban (son) of Dawad (David): and all Yahawadah (Judah) and the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) ishah (make) him honor at his mawath (death). Manashah (Manasseh) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.
Manashah (Manasseh) was shanayam (two) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) chamashayam (fifty) - chamash (five) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, after the thawaibah (abominations) of the gaway (nation / people) whom Yahawah yarash (cast) out panayam (before) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel).

For he banah (built) again the bamah (high) places which Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) his ab (father) had nathatz (broken) down; and he qawam (rise up) up mazabach (altars) for the Bail (Baals), and ishah (make) Asharah (Asheroth), and shachah (worshiped) all the tzabaa (troop) of the sky, and ibad (servant) them.
He banah (built) mazabach (altars) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, of which Yahawah amar (spoke), My sham (name) shall be in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) iwalam (forever).
He banah (built) mazabach (altars) for all the tzabaa (troop) of the sky in the shanayam (two) chatzar (courts) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

He also ibar (pass over/through) his ban (son) to ibar (pass over/through) through the ash (fire) in the gayaa (valley) of the ban (son) of Hanam (Hinnom); and he practiced sorcery, and used nachash (enchantments), and practiced sorcery, and dealt with those who had familiar awab (spirits), and with yadainay (wizards): he ishah (make) much rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, to provoke him to kais (anger).

He shawam (place / establish / appoint) the engraved pasal (idol/graven image) of the samal (idol), which he ishah (make) made, in the bayath (house) of Alahayam, of which Alahayam amar (spoke) to Dawad (David) and to Shalamah (Solomon) his ban (son), In this bayath (house), and in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), which I have bachar (chosen) out of all the shabat (tribes) of Yasharaal (Israel), will I shawam (place / establish / appoint) my sham (name) iyalawam (forever):

Neither will I any more sawar (remove) the ragal (feet / foot) of Yasharaal (Israel) from off the adamah (land) which I have imad (appointed) for your ab (father), if only they will shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) all that I have tzawah (commanded) them, even all the thawarah (instruction) and the chaq (statute) and the mashapat (ordinances) given by Mashah (Moses).

Manashah (Manasseh) thaih (seduced) Yahawadah (Judah) and the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), so that they ishah (make) more thaih (evil) than the gaway (nation / people) whom Yahawah destroyed panayam (before) the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) did.
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Manashah (Manasseh), and to his im (people / nation); but they qashab (gave) no heed.

Therefore Yahawah bawaa (come) on them the shar (prince / ruler) of the army of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), who lakad (took) Manashah (Manasseh) in chains, and asar (bound) him with nachashath (fetters), and yalak (carried) him to Babal (Babylon).
When he was in tzarar (distress), he begged Yahawah his Alahayam, and kanai (humbled) himself maad (greatly) panayam (before) the Alahayam of his ab (father).

He palal (prayed) to him; and he was entreated by him, and shamai (hearken / hear) his thachanah (supplication), and shawab (turn back / repent) him again to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) into his malakawath (kingdom). Then Manashah (Manasseh) yadai (knew) that Yahawah was Alahayam.

Now achar (other) this he banah (built) an outer chawamah (wall) to the iyar (city) of Dawad (David), on the mairab (west) side of Gayachawan (Gihon), in the nachal (stream / river), even to the entrance at the dag (fish) shair (gate); and he encircled Ipal (Ophel) with it, and gabah (raised) it up to a very maad (great) height: and he shawam (place / establish / appoint) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) shar (prince / ruler) in all the batzar (fortified) iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah).

He sawar (took) away the foreign Alahayam, and the samal (idol) out of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and all the mazabach (altars) that he had banah (built) in the har (mountain) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and shalak (cast) them out of the iyar (city).

He built up the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah, and zabach (offered) thereon sacrifices of shalam (peace) zabach (offerings) and of thanksgiving, and commanded Yahawadah (Judah) to ibad (servant) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel).
Abal (nevertheless) the im (people / nation) zabach (sacrificed) still in the bamah (high) places, but only to Yahawah their Alahayam.

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Manashah (Manasseh), and his thapalah (prayer) to his Alahayam, and the dabar (word / matter) of the chazah (seers) who dabar (word / matter) to him in the sham (name) of Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), behold, they are written among the dabar (word / matter) of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel).

His thapalah (prayer) also, and how Alahayam was entreated of him, and all his chataah (sin) and his mail (top/above), and the maqawam (place) in which he banah (built) bamah (high) places, and imad (set) up the Asharah (Asherim) and the engraved pasayal (images), panayam (before) he kanai (humbled) himself: behold, they are kathab (written) in the history of Hozai.
So Manashah (Manasseh) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and they qabar (bury) him in his own bayath (house): and Amawan (Amon) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.
Amawan (Amon) was isharayam (twenty) - shanayam (two) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) shanayam (two) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, as ishah (make) Manashah (Manasseh) his ab (father); and Amawan (Amon) zabach (sacrificed) to all the engraved pasayal (images) which Manashah (Manasseh) his ab (father) ishah (make) made, and ibad (servant) them.
He didn't humble panayam (himself) before Yahawah, as Manashah (Manasseh) his ab (father) had kanai (humbled) himself; but this same Amawan (Amon) ashamah (trespassed) more and more.
His ibad (servant) qashar (conspired) against him, and put him to mawath (death) in his own bayath (house).

But the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land) nakah (killed) all those who had qashar (conspired) against malak (king) Amawan (Amon); and the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land) malak (king) Yaashayah (Josiah) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.
Yaashayah (Josiah) was shamanah (eight) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) shalawashayam (thirty) - achad (one) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

He ishah (make) that which was yashar (right) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, and yalak (walked) in the darak (ways) of Dawad (David) his ab (father), and didn't sawar (turn) aside to the right yamayan (right hand) or to the shamaawal (left hand).

For in the shamanah (eighth) shanah (year) of his malak (king), while he was yet nair (young), he chalal (began) to darash (seek) after the Alahayam of Dawad (David) his ab (father); and in the shanayam (two) shanah (year) he chalal (began) to tahar (purge) Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) from the bamah (high) places, and the Asharah (Asherim), and the engraved pasayal (images), and the masakah (molten) images.

They nathatz (broke) down the mazabach (altars) of the Bail (Baals) in his panayam (presence); and the incense chaman (altars) that were on mail (top/above) above them he gadai (cut) down; and the Asharah (Asherim), and the engraved pasayal (images), and the molten pasayal (images), he shabar (broke) in pieces, and daqaq (made) dust of them, and zaraq (strewed) it on the qabar (grave / tomb / sepulcher) of those who had zabach (sacrificed) to them.
He burnt the itzam (bones) of the kahan (priest) on their mazabach (altars), and tahar (purged) Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
He did this in the iyar (cities) of Manashah (Manasseh) and Aparayam (Ephraim) and Shamaiwan (Simeon), even to Napathalay (Naphtali), around in their ruins.

He nathatz (broke) down the mazabach (altars), and kathath (beat) the Asharah (Asherim) and the engraved pasayal (images) into daqaq (powder), and gadai (cut) down all the incense chaman (altars) throughout all the aratz (Earth/land) of Yasharaal (Israel), and shawab (turn back / repent) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Now in the eighteenth shanah (year) of his malak (king), when he had tahar (purged) the aratz (Earth/land) and the bayath (house), he shalach (send) Shapan (Shaphan) the ban (son) of Atzalayahaw (Azaliah), and Maishayah (Maaseiah) the shar (prince / ruler) of the iyar (city), and Yawaach (Joah) the ban (son) of Yawaachaz (Joahaz) the zakar (remembrance/memory), to chazaq (repair) the bayath (house) of Yahawah his Alahayam.

They bawaa (come) Chalaqayah (to) Hilkiah the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest), and nathan (give) the kasap (money) that was bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of Alahayam, which the Lawayay (Levites), the keepers of the sap (threshold), had asap (gathered) of the yad (hand) of Manashah (Manasseh) and Aparayam (Ephraim), and of all the shaarayath (remnant) of Yasharaal (Israel), and of all Yahawadah (Judah) and Banayamayan (Benjamin), and of the inhabitants of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

They nathan (give) it into the yad (hand) of the workmen who paqad (visit) the oversight of the bayath (house) of Yahawah; and the workmen who labored in the bayath (house) of Yahawah nathan (give) it to chazaq (mend) and badaq (repair) the bayath (house);

Even to the charash (carpenters) and to the banah (builders) nathan (give) they it, to qanah (buy) cut aban (stone), and itz (timber) for machabarah (couplings), and to make qarah (beams) for the bayath (house) which the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) had shachath (destroyed).

The ayash (husband/individual man) ishah (make) the malaakah (work) faithfully: and their natzach (overseers) were Yachath (Jahath) and Ibadayah (Obadiah), the Lawayay (Levites), of the ban (son) of Mararay (Merari); and Zakarayah (Zechariah) and Mashalam (Meshullam), of the sons of the Qahathay (Kohathites), to paqad (visit) it forward; and others of the Lawayay (Levites), all who were skillful with kalay (instruments) of music.

Also they were over the sabal (bearers) of burdens, and natzach (set) forward all who ishah (make) the malaakah (work) in every kind of ibadah (service): and of the Lawayay (Levites) there were sapar (book), and shatar (officers), and shawair (porters).

When they yatzaa (go out / come out) out the kasap (money) that was bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah, Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) the kahan (priest) matzaa (found) the sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction) of Yahawah given by Mashah (Moses).

Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) inah (answer / respond) Shapan (Shaphan) the sapar (book), "I matzaa (have) found the sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah." Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) nathan (give) the sapar (book / scribed document) Shapan (to) Shaphan.

Shapan (Shaphan) bawaa (come) the sapar (book / scribed document) to the malak (king), and moreover shawab (turn back / repent) shawab (turn back / repent) dabar (word / matter) to the malak (king), amar (spoke), All that was nathan (give) to your ibad (servant), they are ishah (make).

They have emptied out the kasap (money) that was matzaa (found) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and nathan (give) delivered it into the yad (hand) of the paqad (visit), and into the yad (hand) of the workmen.

Shapan (Shaphan) the sapar (book) nagad (told) the malak (king), amar (spoke), "Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) the kahan (priest) nathan (give) delivered me a sapar (book / scribed document)." Shapan (Shaphan) qaraa (called) therein panayam (before) the malak (king).
It happened, when the malak (king) had shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of the thawarah (instruction), that he qarai (tore) his clothes.

The malak (king) tzawah (commanded) Chalaqayah (Hilkiah), and Achayaqam (Ahikam) the ban (son) Shapan (of) Shaphan, and Ibadawan (Abdon) the ban (son) of Mayakah (Micah), and Shapan (Shaphan) the sapar (book), and Ishayah (Asaiah) the malak (king) ibad (servant), amar (spoke),

Yalak (go) darash (inquire) of Yahawah for me, and for those who are shaar (left) in Yasharaal (Israel) and in Yahawadah (Judah), concerning the dabar (word / matter) of the sapar (book / scribed document) that is matzaa (found); for gadawal (very great/important/mighty) is the chamah (wrath) of Yahawah that is nathak (poured) out on us, because our ab (father) have not shamar (keep/guard) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, to ishah (make) according to all that is kathab (written) in this sapar (book / scribed document).

So Chalaqayah (Hilkiah), and they whom the malak (king) had commanded, yalak (went) to Chaladah (Huldah) the nabayaah (prophetess), the ashah (wife/individual woman) of Shalawam (Shallum) the ban (son) of Tokhath, the ban (son) of Chasarah (Hasrah), keeper of the bagad (wardrobe); (now she lived in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) in the mashanah (second) quarter;) and they dabar (word / matter) to her to that effect.
She amar (spoke) to them, “Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): ‘amar (spoke) the ayash (husband/individual man) who shalach (send) you to me,

"Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, ‘Behold, I will bawaa (come) rai (evil) on this maqawam (place), and on its yashab (inhabit/dwell), even all the alah (these) that are kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) which they have qaraa (called) panayam (before) the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah).

Because they have forsaken me, and have qatar (burned) incense to other Alahayam, that they might provoke me to kais (anger) with all the maishah (works) of their yad (hand); therefore is my chamah (wrath) nathak (poured) out on this maqawam (place), and it shall not be kabah (quenched).’"’

But to the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), who shalach (send) you to darash (inquire) of Yahawah, thus you shall amar (spoke) him, ‘Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): "As touching the dabar (word / matter) which you have shamai (hearken / hear),

Because your labab (heart) was rakak (tender), and you kanai (humbled) yourself panayam (before) Alahayam, when you shamai (hearken / hear) his dabar (word / matter) against this maqawam (place), and against its yashab (inhabit/dwell), and have kanai (humbled) yourself panayam (before) me, and have qarai (torn) your clothes, and bakah (wept) panayam (before) me; I also have shamai (hearken / hear) you," naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

"Behold, I will asap (gather) you to your ab (father), and you shall be asap (gathered) to your qabar (grave / tomb / sepulcher) in shalawam (peace / safety), neither shall your iyan (eye) raah (see) all the rai (evil) that I will bawaa (come) on this maqawam (place), and on its yashab (inhabit/dwell)."’” They shawab (turn back / repent) shawab (turn back / repent) dabar (word / matter) to the malak (king).
Then the malak (king) shalach (send) and asap (gathered) together all the zaqan (elders) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

The malak (king) ilah (go up / offer) up to the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and all the ayash (husband/individual man) of Yahawadah (Judah) and the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and the kahan (priest), and the Lawayay (Levites), and all the im (people / nation), both gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and qatan (small/young/least): and he qaraa (called) in their azan (ears) all the dabar (word / matter) of the sapar (book / scribed document) of the barayath (covenant) that was matzaa (found) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

The malak (king) imad (stood) in his imad (place), and karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) panayam (before) Yahawah, to yalak (walk) achar (other) Yahawah, and to shamar (keep/guard) his matzawah (commandments), and his idawath (testimonies), and his chaq (statute), with all his labab (heart), and with all his napash (living being/soul), to ishah (make) the dabar (word / matter) of the barayath (covenant) that were kathab (written) in this sapar (book / scribed document).

He caused all who were matzaa (found) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) and Banayamayan (Benjamin) to imad (stand). The yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) ishah (make) according to the barayath (covenant) of Alahayam, the Alahayam of their ab (father).

Yaashayah (Josiah) sawar (took) away all the thawaibah (abominations) out of all the aratz (Earth/land) that pertained to the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel), and made all who were matzaa (found) in Yasharaal (Israel) to ibad (servant), even to ibad (servant) Yahawah their Alahayam. All his yawam (day) they didn't sawar (depart) from achar (other) Yahawah, the Alahayam of their ab (father).

Yaashayah (Josiah) ishah (make) a pasach (passover) to Yahawah in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and they shachat (killed) the pasach (passover) on the fourteenth day of the raashawan (first) chadash (month).
He imad (set) the kahan (priest) in their mashamarath (duty / watch), and chazaq (encouraged) them to the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

He amar (spoke) to the Lawayay (Levites) who bayan (between) all Yasharaal (Israel), who were qadawash (holy) to Yahawah, nathan (give) the qadash (set apart/make holy) arawan (ark) in the bayath (house) which Shalamah (Solomon) the ban (son) of Dawad (David) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) banah (built). There shall no more be a mashaa (burden) on your kathap (shoulders). Now ibad (servant) Yahawah your Alahayam, and his im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel).

Kawan (prepare) yourselves after your ab (father)' bayath (house) by your machalaqath (divisions), according to the kathab (writing) of Dawad (David) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel), and according to the makathab (writing) of Shalamah (Solomon) his ban (son).

Imad (stand) in the qadash (set apart/make holy) place according to the palagah (divisions) of the ab (father)' bayath (house) of your ach (brother/kinsman) the children of the ban (son), and let there be for each a portion of a ab (father)' house of the Lawayay (Levites).

Shachat (kill) the pasach (passover), and qadash (set apart/make holy) yourselves, and kawan (prepare) for your ach (brother/kinsman), to ishah (make) according to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah by Mashah (Moses).

Yaashayah (Josiah) rawam (will lift up) to the children of the ban (son), of the tzaan (flock), kabash (lambs) and ban (son) goats, all of them for the pasach (passover) offerings, to all who were matzaa (present), to the masapar (number) of shalawashayam (thirty) alap (thousand), and shalawash (three) alap (thousand) baqar (morning): these were of the malak (king) rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions).

His shar (prince / ruler) rawam (will lift up) for a freewill nadabah (voluntary / freewill offering) to the im (people / nation), to the kahan (priest), and to the Lawayay (Levites). Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) and Zakarayah (Zechariah) and Yachayaal (Jehiel), the nagayad (rulers) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam, nathan (give) to the kahan (priest) for the pasach (passover) offerings two alap (thousand) and shash (six) maah (hundred) small livestock, and shalawash (three) maah (hundred) baqar (morning) of cattle.

Kawananayahaw (Conaniah) also, and Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) and Nathanaal (Nethanel), his ach (brother/kinsman), and Chashabayah (Hashabiah) and Yaiyaal (Jeiel) and Yawazabad (Jozabad), the shar (prince / ruler) of the Lawayay (Levites), rawam (will lift up) to the Lawayay (Levites) for the pasach (passover) offerings chamash (five) alap (thousand) small livestock, and chamash (five) maah (hundred) baqar (morning) of cattle.

So the ibadah (service) was kawan (prepared), and the kahan (priest) imad (stood) in their imad (place), and the Lawayay (Levites) by their machalaqath (divisions), according to the malak (king) matzawah (commandment).
They shachat (killed) the pasach (passover), and the kahan (priest) zaraq (sprinkled) the blood which they received of their yad (hand), and the Lawayay (Levites) pashat (flayed) them.

They sawar (removed) the burnt ilah (offerings), that they might nathan (give) them according to the mapalagah (divisions) of the ab (father)' houses of the children of the ban (son), to qarab (come close) to Yahawah, as it is kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of Mashah (Moses). So they did with the cattle.

They bashal (roasted) the pasach (passover) with ash (fire) according to the mashapat (ordinance): and the qadash (set apart/make holy) offerings bashal (boiled) they in sayar (pots), and in dawad (caldrons), and in tzalachah (pans), and carried them quickly to all the children of the ban (son).

Afterward they kawan (prepared) for themselves, and for the kahan (priest), because the kahan (priest) the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron) were busy with ilah (go up / offer) the burnt ilah (go up / offer) and the chalab (fat) until layal (night): therefore the Lawayay (Levites) kawan (prepared) for themselves, and for the kahan (priest) the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron).

The singers the ban (son) of Asap (Asaph) were in their maimad (place), according to the matzawah (commandment) of Dawad (David), and Asap (Asaph), and Hayaman (Heman), and Yadawathawan (Jeduthun) the malak (king) chazah (seer); and the shawair (porters) were at every shair (gate): they didn't need to sawar (depart) from their ibadah (service); for their ach (brother/kinsman) the Lawayay (Levites) kawan (prepared) for them.

So all the ibadah (service) of Yahawah was kawan (prepared) the same yawam (day), to ishah (make) the pasach (passover), and to ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilah (offerings) on the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah, according to the matzawah (commandment) of malak (king) Yaashayah (Josiah).

The ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) who were matzaa (present) ishah (make) the pasach (passover) at that ith (time), and the chag (feast/festival) of unleavened matzah (bread) shabai (seven) yawam (day).

There was no pasach (passover) kamaw (like) that ishah (make) in Yasharaal (Israel) from the yawam (day) of Shamawaal (Samuel) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy); neither ishah (make) any of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) ishah (make) such a pasach (passover) as Yaashayah (Josiah) ishah (make), and the kahan (priest), and the Lawayay (Levites), and all Yahawadah (Judah) and Yasharaal (Israel) who were matzaa (present), and the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
In the eighteenth shanah (year) of the malakawath (reign) of Yaashayah (Josiah) was this pasach (passover) ishah (make).

Achar (other) all this, when Yaashayah (Josiah) had kawan (prepared) the bayath (house), Nakaw (Neco) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt) ilah (go up / offer) up to lacham (fight) against Karakamayash (Carchemish) by the Parath (Euphrates): and Yaashayah (Josiah) yatzaa (go out / come out) out qaraah (against) him.

But he shalach (send) malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) to him, amar (spoke), What have I to do with you, you malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah)? I come not against you this yawam (day), but against the bayath (house) with which I have malachamah (war). Alahayam has commanded me to bahal (make) haste. Beware that it is Alahayam who is with me, that he not shachath (destroy) you.

Nevertheless Yaashayah (Josiah) would not sabab (turn) his panayam (face) from him, but disguised himself, that he might lacham (fight) with him, and didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to the dabar (word / matter) Nakaw (of) Neco from the pah (mouth) of Alahayam, and bawaa (come) to lacham (fight) in the baqaih (valley) of Magadawan (Megiddo).

The yarah (archers) yarah (shot) at malak (king) Yaashayah (Josiah); and the malak (king) amar (spoke) to his ibad (servant), ibar (pass over/through) me away, because I am seriously chalah (afflict)!

So his ibad (servant) ibar (pass over/through) him out of the marakabah (chariot), and rakab (put) him in the mashanah (second) rakab (chariot) that he had, and yalak (brought) him to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and he mawath (death), and was qabar (bury) in the tombs of his ab (father). All Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) abal (mourned) for Yaashayah (Josiah).

Yaramayah (Jeremiah) qawan (lamented) for Yaashayah (Josiah): and all the shayar (singing) men and shayar (singing) women amar (spoke) of Yaashayah (Josiah) in their qayanah (lamentations) to this yawam (day); and they nathan (give) them an chaq (statute) in Yasharaal (Israel): and behold, they are kathab (written) in the qayanah (lamentations).
Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Yaashayah (Josiah), and his chasad (grace) deeds, according to that which is kathab (written) in the thawarah (instruction) of Yahawah,

And his dabar (word / matter), raashawan (first) and acharawan (last), behold, they are kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) and Yahawadah (Judah).

Then the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land) laqach (take / seized) Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah), and made him malak (king) in his ab (father) place in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Yawaachaz (Joahaz) was isharayam (twenty) - shalawash (three) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) shalawash (three) chadash (month) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

The malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt) deposed him at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and fined the aratz (Earth/land) one maah (hundred) kakar (talents) of kasap (silver) and a kakar (talent) of zahab (gold).

The malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt) made Alayaqayam (Eliakim) his ach (brother/kinsman) malak (king) over Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and sabab (changed) his sham (name) to Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim). Nakaw (Neco) laqach (take / seized) Yawaachaz (Joahaz) his ach (brother/kinsman), and laqach (take / seized) him to Matzarayam (Egypt).

Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) was isharayam (twenty) - chamash (five) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) achad (one) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and he ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah his Alahayam.
Against him ilah (go up / offer) up Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and asar (bound) him in nachashath (fetters), to yalak (carry) him to Babal (Babylon).
Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) also bawaa (come) of the kalay (vessels) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah to Babal (Babylon), and nathan (give) them in his hayakal (temple) at Babal (Babylon).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim), and his thawaibah (abominations) which he ishah (make), and that which was matzaa (found) in him, behold, they are kathab (written) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) and Yahawadah (Judah): and Yahawayakayan (Jehoiachin) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Yahawayakayan (Jehoiachin) was shamanah (eight) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) shalawash (three) chadash (month) and ishar (ten) yawam (day) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and he ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah.

At the thashawabah (return) of the shanah (year) malak (king) Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) shalach (send), and bawaa (come) him to Babal (Babylon), with the chamadah (goodly) kalay (vessels) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and made Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) his ach (brother/kinsman) malak (king) over Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) was isharayam (twenty) - achad (one) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) achad (one) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem):

And he ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah his Alahayam; he didn't kanai (humble) panayam (himself) before Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) speaking from the pah (mouth) of Yahawah.

He also marad (rebelled) against malak (king) Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar), who had made him shabai (swear / take oath) by Alahayam: but he stiffened his irap (neck), and amatz (hardened) his labab (heart) against shawab (turn back / repent) to Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel).

Moreover all the shar (prince / ruler) of the kahan (priest), and the im (people / nation), mail (top/above) very greatly after all the thawaibah (abominations) of the gaway (nation / people); and they tamaa (polluted) the bayath (house) of Yahawah which he had made qadash (set apart/make holy) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Yahawah, the Alahayam of their ab (father), shalach (send) to them by his malaak (angel / messenger of Yah), shakam (rising) up early and shalach (send), because he chamal (had) compassion on his im (people / nation), and on his maiwan (dwelling) place:

But they laib (mocked) the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Alahayam, and bazah (despised) his dabar (word / matter), and scoffed at his nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), until the chamah (wrath) of Yahawah arose against his im (people / nation), until there was no marapaa (remedy).

Therefore he ilah (go up / offer) on them the malak (king) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans), who harag (killed) their bachawar (young) men with the charab (sword) in the bayath (house) of their maqadash (sanctuary), and chamal (had) no compassion on bachawar (young) man or bathawalah (virgin), old zaqan (man) or gray-headed: he nathan (give) them all into his yad (hand).

All the kalay (vessels) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam, gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and qatan (small/young/least), and the awatzar (treasures) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and the awatzar (treasures) of the malak (king), and of his shar (prince / ruler), all these he bawaa (come) to Babal (Babylon).

They burnt the bayath (house) of Alahayam, and nathatz (broke) down the chawamah (wall) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and burnt all its aramawan (palaces) with ash (fire), and shachath (destroyed) all the machamad (goodly) kalay (vessels) of it.

He carried those who shaarayath (had) escaped from the charab (sword) away to Babal (Babylon); and they were ibad (servant) to him and his ban (son) until the malak (king) of the malakawath (kingdom) of Paras (Persia):

To fulfill the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah by the pah (mouth) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah), until the aratz (Earth/land) ratzah (had) enjoyed its shabath (shabath/rest). As long as it shamam (lay) desolate it shabath (shabath/rest) Sabbath, to fulfill shabaiyam (seventy) shanah (years).

Now in the achad (one) shanah (year) of Kawarash (Cyrus) malak (king) of Paras (Persia), that the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah by the pah (mouth) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah) might be kalah (complete / finish), Yahawah iwar (rouse / awaken) up the rawach (spirit / wind) of Kawarash (Cyrus) malak (king) of Paras (Persia), so that he ibar (pass over/through) a proclamation throughout all his malakawath (kingdom), and put it also in makathab (writing), amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) Kawarash (Cyrus) malak (king) of Paras (Persia), ‘Yahawah, the Alahayam of shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), nathan (give) given all the mamalakah (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land) to me; and he paqad (visit) commanded me to banah (build) him a bayath (house) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), which is in Yahawadah (Judah). Whoever there is among you of all his im (people / nation), Yahawah his Alahayam be with him, and let him ilah (go up / offer) up.’

Now in the achad (one) shanah (year) of Kawarash (Cyrus) malak (king) of Paras (Persia), that the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah by the pah (mouth) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah) might be kalah (complete / finish), Yahawah iwar (rouse / awaken) up the rawach (spirit / wind) of Kawarash (Cyrus) malak (king) of Paras (Persia), so that he ibar (pass over/through) a proclamation throughout all his malakawath (kingdom), and put it also in makathab (writing), amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) Kawarash (Cyrus) malak (king) of Paras (Persia), ‘Yahawah, the Alahayam of shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), nathan (give) given me all the mamalakah (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land); and he paqad (visit) commanded me to banah (build) him a bayath (house) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), which is in Yahawadah (Judah).

Whoever there is among you of all his im (people / nation), may his Alahayam be with him, and let him ilah (go up / offer) up to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), which is in Yahawadah (Judah), and banah (build) the bayath (house) of Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel) (he is Alahayam), which is in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Whoever is shaar (left), in any maqawam (place) where he lives, let the ayash (husband/individual man) of his maqawam (place) nashaa (lift) him with kasap (silver), with zahab (gold), with rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions), and with animals, besides the freewill nadabah (voluntary / freewill offering) for the bayath (house) of Alahayam which is in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).’

Then the raash (head) of ab (father)' households of Yahawadah (Judah) and Banayamayan (Benjamin), and the kahan (priest), and the Lawayay (Levites), even all whose rawach (spirit / wind) Alahayam had iwar (rouse / awaken) to ilah (go up / offer) up ilah (go up / offer) up to banah (build) the bayath (house) of Yahawah which is in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

All those who were around them chazaq (strengthened) their yad (hand) with kalay (vessels) of kasap (silver), with zahab (gold), with rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions), and with animals, and with magadanah (precious) things, besides all that was nadab (willingly) offered.

Also Kawarash (Cyrus) the malak (king) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth the kalay (vessels) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, which Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) yatzaa (go out / come out) brought out of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and nathan (give) put in the bayath (house) of his Alahayam;

Even those, Kawarash (Cyrus) malak (king) of Paras (Persia) yatzaa (go out / come out) out by the yad (hand) of Matharadath (Mithredath) the gazabar (treasurer), and sapar (book) them to Shashabatzar (Sheshbazzar), the nashayaa (prince) of Yahawadah (Judah).
This is the masapar (number) of them: shalawashayam (thirty) platters of zahab (gold), one alap (thousand) platters of kasap (silver), isharayam (twenty) - thashai (nine) knives,
Shalawashayam (thirty) bowls of zahab (gold), kasap (silver) bowls of a mashanah (second) sort arabai (four) maah (hundred) and ishar (ten), and other kalay (vessels) one alap (thousand).

All the kalay (vessels) of zahab (gold) and of kasap (silver) were chamash (five) alap (thousand) and arabai (four) maah (hundred). Shashabatzar (Sheshbazzar) ilah (go up / offer) all these up, when the gawalah (captives) were ilah (go up / offer) up from Babal (Babylon) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Now these are the ban (son) of the madayanah (province), who ilah (go up / offer) up out of the shabay (captivity) of those who had been carried away, whom Nabawakadanatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) had galah (carried) away to Babal (Babylon), and who shawab (turn back / repent) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) and Yahawadah (Judah), everyone to his iyar (city);

Who bawaa (come) with Zarababal (Zerubbabel), Yashawai (Jeshua), Nachamayah (Nehemiah), Sharayah (Seraiah), Railayah (Reelaiah), Maradakay (Mordecai), Balashan (Bilshan), Masapar (Mispar), Bagaway (Bigvai), Rachawam (Rehum), Bainah (Baanah). The masapar (number) of the ayash (husband/individual man) of the im (people / nation) of Yasharaal (Israel):
The ban (son) of Paraish (Parosh), two alap (thousand) one maah (hundred) shabaiyam (seventy) - shanayam (two).
The ban (son) of Shapatayah (Shephatiah), shalawash (three) maah (hundred) shabaiyam (seventy) - shanayam (two).
The ban (son) of Arach (Arah), shabai (seven) maah (hundred) shabaiyam (seventy) - chamash (five).
The ban (son) of Pachathamawaab (Pahathmoab), of the ban (son) of Yashawai (Jeshua) and Yawaab (Joab), two alap (thousand) shamanah (eight) maah (hundred) shanayam (two).
The ban (son) of Iyalam (Elam), one alap (thousand) two maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) - arabai (four).
The ban (son) of Zathawaa (Zattu), thashai (nine) maah (hundred) arabaiyam (forty) - chamash (five).
The ban (son) of Zakay (Zaccai), shabai (seven) maah (hundred) shashayam (sixty).
The ban (son) of Banay (Bani), shash (six) maah (hundred) arabaiyam (forty) - shanayam (two).
The ban (son) of Babay (Bebai), shash (six) maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shalawash (three). Three.
The ban (son) of Izagad (Azgad), one alap (thousand) shanayam (two) maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shanayam (two).
The ban (son) of Adanayaqam (Adonikam), shash (six) maah (hundred) shashayam (sixty) - shash (six).
The ban (son) of Bagaway (Bigvai), two alap (thousand) chamashayam (fifty) - shash (six).
The ban (son) of Idayan (Adin), arabai (four) maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) - arabai (four).
The ban (son) of Atar (Ater), of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), thashaiyam (ninety) - shamanah (eight).
The ban (son) of Batzay (Bezai), shalawash (three) maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shalawash (three).
The ban (son) of Yawarah (Jorah), one maah (hundred) shanayam (two).
The ban (son) of Chasham (Hashum), two maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shalawash (three).
The ban (son) of Gabar (Gibbar), thashaiyam (ninety) - chamash (five).
The ban (son) of Bayathalacham (Bethlehem), one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shalawash (three).
The ayash (husband/individual man) of Natapah (Netophah), chamashayam (fifty) - shash (six).
The ayash (husband/individual man) of Inathawath (Anathoth), one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shamanah (eight).
The ban (son) of Izamawath (Azmaveth), arabaiyam (forty) - shanayam (two).
The ban (son) of Kiriath Qarayathayairayam (Arim), Kapayarah (Chephirah), and Baarawath (Beeroth), shabai (seven) maah (hundred) arabaiyam (forty) - shalawash (three).
The ban (son) of Ramah (Ramah) and Gabai (Geba), shash (six) maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - achad (one).
The ayash (husband/individual man) of Makamas (Michmas), one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shanayam (two).
The ayash (husband/individual man) of Bayathaal (Bethel) and Iy (Ai), two maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shalawash (three).
The ban (son) of Nabaw (Nebo), chamashayam (fifty) - shanayam (two).
The ban (son) of Magabayash (Magbish), one maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) - shash (six).
The ban (son) of the other Iyalam (Elam), one alap (thousand) two maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) - arabai (four).
The ban (son) of Charam (Harim), shalawash (three) maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty).
The ban (son) of Lad (Lod), Chadayad (Hadid), and Awanaw (Ono), shabai (seven) maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - chamash (five).
The ban (son) of Yarayachaw (Jericho), shalawash (three) maah (hundred) arabaiyam (forty) - chamash (five).
The ban (son) of Sanaah (Senaah), shalawash (three) alap (thousand) shash (six) maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty).
The kahan (priest): the ban (son) of Yadaiyah (Jedaiah), of the bayath (house) of Yashawai (Jeshua), thashai (nine) maah (hundred) shabaiyam (seventy) - shalawash (three).
The ban (son) of Amar (Immer), one alap (thousand) chamashayam (fifty) - shanayam (two).
The ban (son) Pashachawar (of) Pashhur, one alap (thousand) two maah (hundred) arabaiyam (forty) - shabai (seven).
The ban (son) of Charam (Harim), one alap (thousand) seventeen.
The Lawayay (Levites): the ban (son) of Yashawai (Jeshua) and Qadamayaal (Kadmiel), of the ban (son) of Hawadawayah (Hodaviah), shabaiyam (seventy) - arabai (four).
The singers: the ban (son) of Asap (Asaph), one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shamanah (eight).

The ban (son) of the shawair (porters): the ban (son) of Shalawam (Shallum), the ban (son) of Atar (Ater), the ban (son) of Talamawan (Talmon), the ban (son) of Iqawab (Akkub), the ban (son) of Chatayataa (Hatita), the ban (son) of Shabay (Shobai), in all one maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) - thashai (nine).
The nathayan (nethinim): the ban (son) of Tzayachaa (Ziha), the ban (son) of Chashawapaa (Hasupha), the ban (son) Tabaiwath (of) Tabbaoth,
The ban (son) of Qayaras (Keros), the ban (son) of Sayaia (Siaha), the ban (son) of Padawan (Padon),
The ban (son) of Labanaa (Lebanah), the ban (son) of Chagabaa (Hagabah), the ban (son) of Iqawab (Akkub),
The ban (son) of Chagab (Hagab), the ban (son) Shamalay (of) Shamlai, the ban (son) Chanan (of) Hanan,
The ban (son) of Gadal (Giddel), the ban (son) of Gachar (Gahar), the ban (son) of Raayah (Reaiah),
The ban (son) of Ratzayan (Rezin), the ban (son) of Naqawadaa (Nekoda), the ban (son) of Gazam (Gazzam),
The ban (son) of Izaa (Uzza), the ban (son) of Pasach (Paseah), the ban (son) of Basay (Besai),
The ban (son) of Asanah (Asnah), the ban (son) of maiwanay (meunim), the ban (son) of Nephisim,
The ban (son) of Baqabawaq (Bakbuk), the ban (son) of Chaqawapaa (Hakupha), the ban (son) of Charachawar (Harhur),
The ban (son) of Batzalawath (Bazluth), the ban (son) of Machayadaa (Mehida), the ban (son) of Charashaa (Harsha),
The ban (son) of Baraqawas (Barkos), the ban (son) of Sayasaraa (Sisera), the ban (son) Thamach (of) Temah,
The ban (son) of Natzayach (Neziah), the ban (son) of Chatayapaa (Hatipha).
The ban (son) of Shalamah (Solomon's) ibad (servant): the ban (son) of Sawatay (Sotai), the ban (son) Saparath (of) Hassophereth, the ban (son) of Parawadaa (Peruda),
The ban (son) of Yailaa (Jaalah), the ban (son) of Daraqawan (Darkon), the ban (son) of Gadal (Giddel),
The ban (son) of Shapatayah (Shephatiah), the ban (son) of Chatayal (Hattil), the ban (son) of Pakarathatzabayayam (Pochereth) Hazzebaim, the ban (son) of Amay (Ami).
All the nathayan (nethinim), and the ban (son) of Shalamah (Solomon's) ibad (servant), were shalawash (three) maah (hundred) thashaiyam (ninety) - shanayam (two).

These were those who ilah (go up / offer) up from Thalamalach (Tel) Melah, Thalacharashaa (Tel) Harsha, karawab (cherub), Adan (Addan), and Amar (Immer); but they yakal (could) not show their ab (father)' bayath (house), and their zarai (seed), whether they were of Yasharaal (Israel):
The ban (son) of Dalayah (Delaiah), the ban (son) of Tawabayah (Tobiah), the ban (son) of Naqawadaa (Nekoda), shash (six) maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) - shanayam (two).

Of the ban (son) of the kahan (priest): the ban (son) of Chabayah (Habaiah), the ban (son) of Qawatz (Hakkoz), the ban (son) of Barazalay (Barzillai), who laqach (take / seized) a ashah (wife/individual woman) of the bath (daughter) of Barazalay (Barzillai) the Galaiday (Gileadite), and was qaraa (called) after their sham (name).

These baqash (sought) their place among those who were kathab (registered) by yachash (genealogy), but they were not matzaa (found): therefore were they deemed gaal (polluted) and put from the kahanah (priesthood).

The governor amar (spoke) to them, that they should not akal (eat) of the most qadash (set apart/make holy) things, until there imad (stood) up a kahan (priest) with awarayam (urim) and with thamayam (complete / whole).
The whole qahal (assembly) achad (one) was arabai (four) - two alap (thousand) shalawash (three) maah (hundred) shashayam (sixty),

Besides their male ibad (servant) and their female ibad (servant), of whom there were shabai (seven) alap (thousand) shalawash (three) maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) - shabai (seven): and they had two maah (hundred) shayar (singing) men and shayar (singing) women.
Their sawas (horses) were shabai (seven) maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) - shash (six); their parad (mules), two maah (hundred) arabaiyam (forty) - chamash (five);
Their gamal (camels), arabai (four) maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) - chamash (five); their donkeys, shash (six) alap (thousand) shabai (seven) maah (hundred) and isharayam (twenty).

Some of the raash (head) of ab (father)' households, when they bawaa (come) to the bayath (house) of Yahawah which is in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), nadab (offered) willingly for the bayath (house) of Alahayam to imad (set) it up in its makawan (place):

They nathan (give) after their kach (strength / mighty / power) into the awatzar (treasury) of the malaakah (work) shash (six) - one alap (thousand) darics of zahab (gold), and chamash (five) alap (thousand) minas of kasap (silver), and one maah (hundred) kahan (priest)' kathanath (garments).

So the kahan (priest), and the Lawayay (Levites), and some of the im (people / nation), and the singers, and the shawair (porters), and the nathayan (nethinim), lived in their iyar (cities), and all Yasharaal (Israel) in their iyar (cities).

When the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month) had nagai (come), and the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) were in the iyar (cities), the im (people / nation) asap (gathered) themselves together as achad (one) ayash (husband/individual man) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Then qawam (rise up) up Yashawai (Jeshua) the ban (son) of Yawatzadaq (Jozadak), and his ach (brother/kinsman) the kahan (priest), and Zarababal (Zerubbabel) the ban (son) of Shaalathayaal (Shealtiel), and his ach (brother/kinsman), and banah (built) the mazabach (altar) of the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), to ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilah (offerings) thereon, as it is kathab (written) in the thawarah (instruction) of Mashah (Moses) the ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam.

They kawan (set) the mazabach (altar) on its makawanah (base); for ayamah (fear) was on them because of the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land): and they ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilah (offerings) thereon to Yahawah, even burnt ilah (offerings) baqar (morning) and irab (evening).

They ishah (make) the chag (feast/festival) of sakah (tents), as it is kathab (written), and offered the yawam (day) burnt ilah (offerings) by masapar (number), according to the mashapat (ordinance), as the dabar (word / matter) of every yawam (day) yawam (day);

And afterward the thamayad (continual) burnt ilah (offering), and the offerings of the new chadash (month), and of all the mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) feasts of Yahawah that were qadash (set apart/make holy), and of everyone who nadab (willingly) offered a freewill nadab (offering) to Yahawah.

From the achad (one) yawam (day) of the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month) chalal (began) they to ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilah (offerings) to Yahawah: but the yasad (foundation) of the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah was not yet yasad (laid).

They nathan (give) kasap (money) also to the chatzab (masons), and to the charash (carpenters); and maakal (food), and mashathah (drink), and shaman (oil), to them of tzayadanay (sidon), and to them of tzaray (tyre), to bawaa (come) araz (cedar) itz (trees) from Labanawan (Lebanon) to the yam (sea/waters), to Yapaw (Joppa), according to the rashayawan (grant) that they had of Kawarash (Cyrus) malak (king) of Paras (Persia).

Now in the shanay (second) shanah (year) of their bawaa (come) to the bayath (house) of Alahayam at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), in the shanay (second) chadash (month), chalal (began) Zarababal (Zerubbabel) the ban (son) of Shaalathayaal (Shealtiel), and Yashawai (Jeshua) the ban (son) of Yawatzadaq (Jozadak), and the shaar (rest) of their ach (brother/kinsman) the kahan (priest) and the Lawayay (Levites), and all those who were bawaa (come) out of the shabay (captivity) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and imad (appointed) the Lawayay (Levites), from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, to have the oversight of the malaakah (work) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

Then imad (stood) Yashawai (Jeshua) with his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), Qadamayaal (Kadmiel) and his ban (son), the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah), achad (one), to have the oversight of the workmen in the bayath (house) of Alahayam: the ban (son) of Chanadad (Henadad), with their ban (son) and their ach (brother/kinsman) the Lawayay (Levites).

When the banah (builders) yasad (laid) the foundation of the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah, they imad (set) the kahan (priest) in their labash (clothing) with chatzatzarah (trumpets), and the Lawayay (Levites) the ban (son) of Asap (Asaph) with matzalath (cymbals), to halal (praise) Yahawah, after the yad (hand) of Dawad (David) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel).

They inah (answer / respond) one to another in halal (praise) and giving yadah (thanks) to Yahawah, "For he is tawab (pleasant/functional), for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever) toward Yasharaal (Israel)." All the im (people / nation) rawai (shouted) with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) tharawaih (shout), when they halal (praise) Yahawah, because the yasad (foundation) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah was yasad (laid).

But many of the kahan (priest) and Lawayay (Levites) and raash (head) of ab (father)' households, the zaqan (old) men who raah (see) seen the raashawan (first) bayath (house), when the yasad (foundation) of this bayath (house) was yasad (laid) before their iyan (eye), bakah (wept) with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qawal (sound / voice); and many tharawaih (shouted) aloud for shamachah (joy):

So that the im (people / nation) nakar (could) not discern the qawal (sound / voice) of the tharawaih (shout) of shamachah (joy) from the qawal (sound / voice) of the bakay (weeping) of the im (people / nation); for the im (people / nation) rawai (shouted) with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) tharawaih (shout), and the qawal (sound / voice) was shamai (hearken / hear) rachawaq (afar) off.

Now when the tzar (oppressor / distressor) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Banayamayan (Benjamin) shamai (hearken / hear) that the ban (son) of the gawalah (captivity) were banah (building) a hayakal (temple) to Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel);

Then they nagash (drew) near to Zarababal (Zerubbabel), and to the raash (head) of ab (father)' households, and amar (spoke) to them, Let us banah (build) with you; for we darash (seek) your Alahayam, as you do; and we zabach (sacrifice) to him since the yawam (day) of Asarachadawan (Esar) Haddon malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), who ilah (go up / offer) us up here.

But Zarababal (Zerubbabel), and Yashawai (Jeshua), and the shaar (rest) of the raash (head) of ab (father)' households of Yasharaal (Israel), amar (spoke) to them, You have nothing to do with us in banah (building) a bayath (house) to our Alahayam; but we ourselves yachad (together) will banah (build) to Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), as malak (king) Kawarash (Cyrus) the malak (king) of Paras (Persia) has tzawah (commanded) us.
Then the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land) rapah (weakened) the yad (hand) of the im (people / nation) of Yahawadah (Judah), and balah (troubled) them in banah (building),

And shakar (hired) yaitz (counselors) against them, to parar (frustrate) their itzah (purpose), all the yawam (day) of Kawarash (Cyrus) malak (king) of Paras (Persia), even until the malakawath (reign) of Darayawash (Darius) malak (king) of Paras (Persia).

In the malakawath (reign) of Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus), in the thachalah (beginning) of his malakawath (reign), kathab (wrote) they an shatanah (accusation) against the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

In the yawam (day) Arathachashashathaa (of) Artaxerxes kathab (wrote) Bashalam (Bishlam), Matharadath (Mithredath), Tabaal (Tabeel), and the shaar (rest) of his kanath (companions), Arathachashashathaa (to) Artaxerxes malak (king) of Paras (Persia); and the kathab (writing) of the letter was kathab (written) in Aramayath (Syrian), and set forth in the Aramayath (Syrian) language.

Rachawam (Rehum) the bail (chancellor) and Shamashay (Shimshai) the sapar (book) kathab (wrote) a agaraa (letter) il (over) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) Arathachashashathaa (to) Artaxerxes the malak (king) in kanamaa (this) sort:

Then Rachawam (Rehum) the bail (chancellor), and Shamashay (Shimshai) the sapar (book), and the shaar (rest) of their kanath (companions), the dayanay (dinaites), and the Apharsathchites, the tarapalay (tarpelites), the aparasay (apharsites), the arakaway (archevites), the Babalay (Babylonians), the Shushanchites, the Dehaites, the Ilamay (Elamites),

And the shaar (rest) of the amah (nations) whom the rab (great) and yaqayar (noble) Asanapar (Osnappar) galah (brought) over, and yathab (set) in the qarayaa (city) of Shamarayan (Samaria), and in the shaar (rest) of the country Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), and so forth, wrote.

Dan (this) is the parashagan (copy) of the agaraa (letter) that they shalach (sent) to Arathachashashathaa (Artaxerxes) the malak (king): Your ibad (servant) the anash (men) Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), and so forth.

Be it yadai (known) to the malak (king), that the Yahawadaay (Jews) who salaq (came) up from you have athah (come) to us to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); they are banaa (building) the marad (rebellious) and the baawash (bad) qarayaa (city), and have kalal (finished) the shawar (walls), and repaired the ash (fire).

Be it yadai (known) kain (now) to the malak (king) that if dak (this) qarayaa (city) is banaa (built), and the shawar (walls) kalal (finished), they will not nathan (give) balaw (tribute), halak (move), or madah (toll), and in the end it will be nazaq (hurtful) to the malak (king).

Kain (now) qabal (because) we eat the salt of the hayakal (palace), and it is not appropriate for us to chazaa (see) the malak (king) irawah (dishonor), il (over) have we shalach (sent) and informed the malak (king);

That baqar (morning) may be made in the sapar (book) of the dakarawan (records) of your ab (father): so you shall shakach (find) in the sapar (book) of the dakarawan (records), and yadai (know) that dak (this) qarayaa (city) is a marad (rebellious) qarayaa (city), and nazaq (hurtful) to malak (king) and madayanah (provinces), and that they have ibad (servant) ashathadawar (sedition) within the same of ilam (old) yawam (day); for which cause was dak (this) qarayaa (city) laid waste.

We inform the malak (king) that, if dak (this) qarayaa (city) be banaa (built), and the shawar (walls) kalal (finished), by dan (this) qabal (means) you shall ayathay (have) no chalaq (portion) Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river).

Then the malak (king) shalach (sent) an pathagam (answer) to Rachawam (Rehum) the bail (chancellor), and to Shamashay (Shimshai) the sapar (book), and to the shaar (rest) of their kanath (companions) who yathab (dwell) in Shamarayan (Samaria), and in the shaar (rest) of the country Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river): shalam (peace), and so forth.
The nashathawan (letter) which you shalach (sent) to us has been plainly qaraa (called) qadam (before) me.

I decreed, and baqar (morning) has been made, and it is shakach (found) that dak (this) qarayaa (city) of ilam (old) yawam (day) has nashaa (lift) insurrection il (over) malak (king), and that marad (rebellion) and ashathadawar (sedition) have been ibad (servant) therein.

There hawaa (which/who/that is) been thaqayap (mighty) malak (king) also over Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), who have shalayat (ruled) over kal (every) the country Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river); and balaw (tribute), halak (move), and madah (toll), was yahab (paid) to them.

Shawam (place / establish / appoint) a taim (decree) kain (now) to batal (cause) these gabar (men) to batal (cease), and that dak (this) qarayaa (city) not be banaa (built), id (until) a decree shall be shawam (place / establish / appoint) by me.
Hawaa (which/who/that is) heed that you not be slack herein: mah (why) should chabal (damage) shagaa (grow) to the nazaq (hurt) of the malak (king)?

Then when the parashagan (copy) of malak (king) Arathachashashathaa (Artaxerxes)' nashathawan (letter) was qaraa (called) qadam (before) Rachawam (Rehum), and Shamashay (Shimshai) the sapar (book), and their kanath (companions), they went in bahayalaw (haste) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to the Yahawadaay (Jews), and made them to batal (cease) by adarai (force) and chayal (power).

Then batal (ceased) the ibayadah (work) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam which is at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and it hawaa (which/who/that is) id (until) the tharayan (second) shanah (year) of the malakaw (reign) of Darayawash (Darius) malak (king) of Paras (Persia).

Now the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), Chagay (Haggai) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), and Zakarayah (Zechariah) the bar (son) of Idaw (Iddo), nabaa (prophesied) to the Yahawadaay (Jews) who were in Yahawad (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); in the sham (name) of the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel) they prophesied to them.

Then qawam (rise up) up Zarababal (Zerubbabel) the bar (son) of Shaalathayaal (Shealtiel), and Yashawai (Jeshua) the bar (son) of Yawatzadaq (Jozadak), and sharaa (began) to banaa (build) the bayath (house) of Alahayam which is at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and with them were the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) of Alahayam, said (helping) them.

At the same zaman (time) athah (came) to them Tattenai, the pachah (governor) Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), and Shatharabawazanay (Shetharbozenai), and their kanath (companions), and amar (spoke) kan (for sure) to them, Who shawam (place / establish / appoint) you a decree to banaa (build) dan (this) bayath (house), and to kalal (finish) dan (this) asharanaa (wall)?
Then we amar (spoke) them in kanamaa (this) way, man (from) the sham (name) of the gabar (men) were who were banaa (making) dan (this) banayan (building).

But the iyan (eye) of their Alahayam was on the shayab (elders) of the Yahawadaay (Jews), and they did not batal (make) them batal (cease), id (until) the taim (matter) should hawak (come) to Darayawash (Darius), and then thawab (answer) should be returned by nashathawan (letter) il (over) it.

The parashagan (copy) of the agaraa (letter) that Tattenai, the pachah (governor) Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), and Shatharabawazanay (Shetharbozenai), and his kanath (companions) the aparasakay (apharsachites), who were Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), shalach (sent) to Darayawash (Darius) the malak (king);
They shalach (sent) a pathagam (letter) to him, in which was kathab (written) dan (thus): To Darayawash (Darius) the malak (king), kal (every) shalam (peace).

Be it known to the malak (king), that we azal (went) into the madayanah (province) of Yahawad (Judah), to the bayath (house) of the rab (great) Alahayam, which is banaa (built) with galal (great) aban (stone), and ai (timber) is shawam (place / establish / appoint) in the kathal (walls); and dak (this) ibayadah (work) ibad (servant) on with diligence and tzalach (prospers) in their yad (hand).

Then we shaal (asked) alak (those) shayab (elders), and amar (spoke) to them kanamaa (thus), Who shawam (place / establish / appoint) you a decree to banaa (build) dan (this) bayath (house), and to kalal (finish) dan (this) asharanaa (wall)?
We shaal (asked) them their sham (name) also, to inform you that we might kathab (write) the sham (name) of the gabar (men) who were at their raash (head).

Kanamaa (thus) they thawab (returned) us pathagam (answer), amar (spoke), We are the ibad (servant) of the Alahayam of shamayan (heaven) and arai (earth), and are banaa (building) the bayath (house) that was banaa (built) these many shanah (years) qadamah (ago), which a rab (great) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) banaa (built) and kalal (finished).

But man (from) that our ab (father) had ragaz (provoked) the Alahayam of shamayan (heaven) to ragaz (wrath), he yahab (gave) them into the yad (hand) of Nabawakadanatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), the Kasaday (Chaldean), who sathar (destroyed) dan (this) bayath (house), and galah (carried) the im (people) galah (away) into Babal (Babylon).

But in the chad (first) shanah (year) of Kawarash (Cyrus) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), Kawarash (Cyrus) the malak (king) shawam (place / establish / appoint) a taim (decree) to banaa (build) dan (this) bayath (house) of Alahayam.

The dahab (gold) and kasap (silver) maan (vessels) also of the bayath (house) of Alahayam, which Nabawakadanatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) napaq (took) out of the hayakal (temple) that was in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and yabal (brought) into the hayakal (temple) of Babal (Babylon), hamaw (those) Kawarash (Cyrus) the malak (king) took out of the hayakal (temple) of Babal (Babylon), and they were yahab (delivered) to one whose sham (name) was Shashabatzar (Sheshbazzar), whom he had shawam (place / establish / appoint) pachah (governor);

And he amar (spoke) to him, ‘nashaa (lift) these maan (vessels), azal (go), put them in the hayakal (temple) that is in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and let the bayath (house) of Alahayam be banaa (built) in its athar (place).’

Then the same Shashabatzar (Sheshbazzar) athah (came), and yahab (laid) the ash (fire) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam which is in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and man (from) that adayan (time) even id (until) kain (now) has it been in banaa (building), and yet it is not completed.

Kain (now) therefore, if it seem tab (good) to the malak (king), let a baqar (morning) be made in the malak (king) ganaz (treasure) bayath (house), which is there at Babal (Babylon), han (whether) it be so, that a taim (decree) was shawam (place / establish / appoint) of Kawarash (Cyrus) the malak (king) to banaa (build) dak (this) bayath (house) of Alahayam at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and let the malak (king) shalach (send) his raiwath (pleasure) to us il (over) dan (this) matter.

Then Darayawash (Darius) the malak (king) shawam (place / establish / appoint) a taim (decree), and baqar (morning) was made in the bayath (house) of the archives, tham (where) the ganaz (treasures) were nachath (laid) up in Babal (Babylon).

There was shakach (found) at Achamathaa (Achmetha), in the bayaraa (palace) that is in the madayanah (province) Maday (of) Media, a scroll, and therein was kan (for sure) kathab (written) for a dakarawan (record):

In the chad (first) shanah (year) of Kawarash (Cyrus) the malak (king), Kawarash (Cyrus) the malak (king) shawam (place / establish / appoint) a taim (decree): Concerning the bayath (house) of Alahayam at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), let the bayath (house) be banaa (built), the athar (place) where they dabach (offer) dabach (sacrifices), and let its ash (fire) be sabal (strongly) laid; its rawam (will lift up) shathayan (sixty) amah (cubits), and its pathay (breadth) shathayan (sixty) amah (cubits);
With thalath (three) courses of galal (great) aban (stone), and a course of chadath (new) ai (timber): and let the napaqaa (expenses) be yahab (given) out of the malak (king) bayath (house).

Also let the dahab (gold) and kasap (silver) maan (vessels) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam, which Nabawakadanatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) napaq (took) forth out of the hayakal (temple) which is at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and yabal (brought) to Babal (Babylon), be thawab (restored), and hawak (brought) again to the hayakal (temple) which is at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), everyone to its athar (place); and you shall put them in the bayath (house) of Alahayam.

Kain (now) therefore, Tattenai, pachah (governor) Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), Shatharabawazanay (Shetharbozenai), and your kanath (companions) the aparasakay (apharsachites), who are Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), you must stay rachayaq (far) from there.

Leave the ibayadah (work) of dak (this) bayath (house) of Alahayam shabaq (alone); let the pachah (governor) of the Yahawadaay (Jews) and the shayab (elders) of the Yahawadaay (Jews) banaa (build) dak (this) bayath (house) of Alahayam in its athar (place).

Moreover I shawam (place / establish / appoint) a taim (decree) maa (what) you shall ibad (servant) to these shayab (elders) of the Yahawadaay (Jews) for the banaa (building) of dak (this) bayath (house) of Alahayam: that of the malak (king) nakas (goods), even of the madah (tribute) Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), napaqaa (expenses) be yahab (given) with all diligence to these gabar (men), that they be not batal (hindered).
