He ishah (make) his malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) rawach (spirit / wind); his sharath (servants) lahat (flames) of ash (fire).
He yasad (laid) the makawan (foundations) of the aratz (Earth/land), that it should not be mawat (moved) iwalam (forever).
You kasah (covered) it with the thahawam (depths) as with a cloak. The mayam (Waters) imad (stood) above the har (mountain).
At your gairah (rebuke) they nawas (fled). At the qawal (sound / voice) of your raim (thunder) they hurried away.
The har (mountain) ilah (go up / offer), the baqaih (valleys) yarad (sank) down, to the maqawam (place) which you had assigned to them.
You have shawam (place / establish / appoint) a boundary that they may not ibar (pass over/through) over; that they don't shawab (turn back / repent) again to kasah (cover) the aratz (Earth/land).
He shalach (send) forth maiyan (springs) into the nachal (stream / river). They halak (move) among the har (mountain).
They shaqah (give) drink to every animal of the shadah (field). The paraa (wild) donkeys shabar (quench) their tzamaa (thirst).
The iwap (flying) of the sky nest by them. They nathan (give) bayan (between) the branches.
He shaqah (waters) the har (mountain) from his rooms. The aratz (Earth/land) is shabai (filled) with the paray (fruit) of your maishah (works).
He causes the chatzayar (grass) to tzamach (grow) for the livestock, and plants for adam (man) to cultivate, that he may yatzaa (go out / come out) forth lacham (food) out of the aratz (Earth/land):

Yayan (wine) that shamach (makes) glad the labab (heart) of anawash (man), shaman (oil) to make his panayam (face) to tzahal (shine), and lacham (bread) that said (strengthens) anawash (man's) labab (heart).
Yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) itz (trees) are well watered, the araz (cedars) of Labanawan (Lebanon), which he has natai (planted);
Where the tzapawar (birds) qanan (make) their nests. The chasayadah (stork) makes its bayath (house) in the barawash (fir) trees.
The gabah (high) har (mountain) are for the yail (wild) goats. The salai (rocks) are a machasah (refuge) Shapan (for) the rock badgers.
He ishah (make) the yarach (moon) for mawaid (Feast/Holy Day). The shamash (sun) yadai (knows) when to set.
You shayath (put / appoint / make) chashak (darkness), and it is layal (night), in which all the animals of the yair (forest) prowl.
The young kapayar (lions) shaag (roar) after their tarap (prey), and baqash (seek) their akal (food) from Al.
The shamash (sun) zarach (rises), and they steal asap (away), and rabatz (lay) down in their maiwanah (dens).
Adam (man) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth to his pail (work), to his ibadah (labor) until the irab (evening).
Yahawah, how many are your maishah (works)! In chakamah (wisdom) ishah (make) you made them all. The aratz (Earth/land) is malaa (full) of your riches.
There is the yam (sea/waters), gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and rachab (wide), in which are innumerable living things, both qatan (small/young/least) and large animals.
There the anayah (ships) halak (move), and lawayathan (leviathan), whom you yatzar (formed) to shachaq (play) there.
These all shabar (wait) for you, that you may nathan (give) them their akal (food) in due ith (season).
You nathan (give) to them; they laqat (gather). You pathach (open) your yad (hand); they are shabai (satisfied) with tawab (pleasant/functional).
You sathar (hide) your panayam (face): they are bahal (troubled); you asap (take) away their rawach (spirit / wind): they gawai (die), and shawab (turn back / repent) to the ipar (dust).
You shalach (send) forth your rawach (spirit / wind): they are baraa (created). You chadash (renew) the panayam (face) of the adamah (ground).
Let the kabawad (glory) of Yahawah endure iwalam (forever). Let Yahawah shamach (rejoice) in his maishah (works).
He nabat (looks) at the aratz (Earth/land), and it raid (trembles). He touches the har (mountain), and they ishan (smoke).
I will shayar (sing) to Yahawah as long as I chay (life). I will zamar (sing) praise to my Alahayam iwad (more/again) I have any being.
Let your shayach (meditation) be irab (evening) to him. I will shamach (rejoice) in Yahawah.
Let chataa (sinners) be thamam (consumed) out of the aratz (Earth/land). Let the rashai (wicked) be no more. Barak (bless) Yahawah, my napash (living being/soul). Halal (praise) Yah!
Give yadah (thanks) to Yahawah! Qaraa (called) on his sham (name)! Make his ilayalah (doings) yadai (known) among the im (people / nation).
Shayar (sing) to him, sing zamar (praises) to him! Tell of all his marvelous palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous).
Glory in his qadash (set apart/make holy) sham (name). Let the lab (heart) of those who baqash (seek) Yahawah shamach (rejoice).
Darash (seek) Yahawah and his iz (strength / might / refuge). Baqash (seek) his panayam (face) thamayad (forever) more.
Zakar (remembrance/memory) his marvelous palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) that he ishah (make) done; his mawapath (wonders), and the mashapat (judgments) of his pah (mouth),
You zarai (seed) of Abaraham (Abraham), his ibad (servant), you ban (son) of Yaiqab (Jacob), his bachayar (chosen) ones.
He is Yahawah, our Alahayam. His mashapat (judgments) are in all the aratz (Earth/land).
He has zakar (remembrance/memory) his barayath (covenant) iwalam (forever), the dabar (word / matter) which he tzawah (commanded) to a alap (thousand) dawar (generation / age / period),
The karath (cut) which he made with Abaraham (Abraham), his shabawaih (oath) to Yashachaq (Isaac),
And imad (confirmed) the same to Yaiqab (Jacob) for a chaq (statute); to Yasharaal (Israel) for an iwalam (forever) barayath (covenant),
Amar (spoke), To you I will nathan (give) the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan), the chabal (lot) of your nachalah (inheritance);
When they were but a math (few) men in masapar (number), yes, very mait (few), and foreigners in it.
They halak (move) about from gaway (nation / people) to nation, from one mamalakah (kingdom) to achar (other) im (people / nation).
He allowed no adam (one) to ishaq (do) them wrong. Yes, he yakach (reproved) malak (king) for their sakes,
Don't nagai (touch) my mashayach (anointed one) ones! Do my nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) no raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil)!
He qaraa (called) for a raib (famine) on the aratz (Earth/land). He shabar (destroyed) the lacham (food) supplies.
He shalach (send) a ayash (husband/individual man) panayam (before) them. Yawasap (Joseph) was makar (sold) for a ibad (servant).
They bruised his ragal (feet / foot) with shackles. His neck was locked in barazal (irons),
Until the ith (time) that his dabar (word / matter) happened, and yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) amarah (sayings) proved him true.
The malak (king) shalach (send) and freed him; even the mashal (rule/have dominion) of im (people / nation), and pathach (let) him go free.
He shawam (place / establish / appoint) him Adawan of his bayath (house), and mashal (rule/have dominion) of all of his qanayan (possessions);
To discipline his shar (prince / ruler) at his napash (living being/soul), and to teach his zaqan (elders) chakam (wisdom).
Yasharaal (Israel) also bawaa (come) into Matzarayam (Egypt). Yaiqab (Jacob) lived in the aratz (Earth/land) of Cham (Ham).
He parah (increased) his im (people / nation) maad (greatly), and itzam (made) them stronger than their tzar (oppressor / distressor).
He hapak (turned) their lab (heart) to shanaa (hate) his im (people / nation), to nakal (conspire) against his ibad (servant).
He shalach (send) Mashah (Moses), his ibad (servant), and Aharawan (Aaron), whom he had bachar (chosen).
They performed awath (sign / mark / miracle) among them, and mawapath (wonders) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Cham (Ham).
He shalach (send) chashak (darkness), and made it chashak (darkness). They didn't marah (rebel) against his dabar (word / matter).
He hapak (turned) their mayam (Waters) into dam (blood), and mawath (death) their dagah (fish).
Their aratz (Earth/land) swarmed with tzaparadai (frogs), even in the rooms of their malak (king).
He amar (spoke), and irab (evening) of flies bawaa (come), and kan (for sure) in all their gabawal (border/boundary).
He nathan (give) them barad (hail) for gasham (rain), with lightning in their aratz (Earth/land).
He nakah (struck) their gapan (vines) and also their thaan (fig) trees, and shattered the itz (trees) of their country.
He amar (spoke), and the arabah (locusts) bawaa (come), and the grasshoppers, without masapar (number),
Akal (eat) up every plant in their aratz (Earth/land); and akal (eat) up the paray (fruit) of their aratz (Earth/land).
He nakah (struck) also all the bakawar (firstborn) in their aratz (Earth/land), the raashayath (beginning) fruits of all their manhood.
He yatzaa (go out / come out) them forth with kasap (silver) and zahab (gold). There was not one kashal (stumble / stagger) person among his shabat (tribes).
Matzarayam (Egypt) was shamach (glad) when they departed, for the pachad (fear / dread) of them napal (fall / be cast down) fallen on them.
He parash (spread) a inan (cloud) for a masak (covering), ash (fire) to give awar (light) in the layal (night).
They shaal (asked), and he bawaa (come) shalaw (quails), and shabai (satisfied) them with the lacham (bread) of the sky.
He pathach (opened) the tzawar (rock), and mayam (Waters) zawab (flow) out. They halak (move) as a nahar (river) in the tzayah (dry) places.
For he zakar (remembrance/memory) his qadash (set apart/make holy) dabar (word / matter), and Abaraham (Abraham), his ibad (servant).
He yatzaa (go out / come out) forth his im (people / nation) with shashawan (joy), his bachayar (chosen) with ranah (singing).
He nathan (give) them the aratz (Earth/land) of the gaway (nation / people). They took the imal (labor) of the laam (peoples) in yarash (possession),
That they might shamar (keep/guard) his chaq (statute), and shamar (keep/guard) his thawarah (instruction). Halal (praise) Yah!
Halal (praise) Yahawah! Give yadah (thanks) to Yahawah, for he is tawab (pleasant/functional), for his loving tawab (pleasant/functional) endures iwalam (forever).
Who can malal (utter) the gabawarah (mighty) acts of Yahawah, or fully shamai (hearken / hear) all his thahalah (praise)?
Ashar (who/that) are those who shamar (keep/guard) mashapat (justice). Blessed is one who ishah (make) what is tzadaqah (righteousness) at all ith (times).
Zakar (remembrance/memory) me, Yahawah, with the favor that you show to your im (people / nation). Paqad (visit) me with your yashawaih (salvation),

That I may raah (see) the tawab (pleasant/functional) of your bachayar (chosen), that I may shamach (rejoice) in the shamachah (gladness) of your gaway (nation / people), that I may glory with your nachalah (inheritance).
We have chataa (sinned) with our ab (father). We have committed iwah (iniquity). We have rashai (done) wickedly.

Our ab (father) didn't shakal (understand) your palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) in Matzarayam (Egypt). They didn't zakar (remembrance/memory) the rab (multitude) of your chasad (grace) kindnesses, but were rebellious at the yam (sea/waters), even at the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters).
Nevertheless he yashai (salvation) them for his sham (name) sake, that he might make his gabawarah (mighty) power yadai (known).
He gair (rebuked) the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters) also, and it was charab (dried) up; so he yalak (led) them through the thahawam (depths), as through a madabar (desert).
He yashai (salvation) them from the yad (hand) of him who shanaa (hate) them, and gaal (redeemed) them from the yad (hand) of the ayab (enemy).
The mayam (Waters) kasah (covered) their tzar (oppressor / distressor). There was not achad (one) of them yathar (left).
Then they aman (believe / have faith) his dabar (word / matter). They shayar (sang) his thahalah (praise).
They mahar (soon) shakach (forgot) his maishah (works). They didn't chakah (wait) for his itzah (counsel),
But gave in to craving in the madabar (desert), and tested Al in the wasteland.
He nathan (give) them their shaalah (request), but shalach (send) razawan (leanness) into their napash (living being/soul).
They qanaa (jealous) Mashah (Moses) also in the machanah (camp), and Aharawan (Aaron), yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) qadawash (saint).
The aratz (Earth/land) pathach (opened) and balai (swallowed) up Dathan (Dathan), and kasah (covered) the idah (company) of Abayaram (Abiram).
A ash (fire) was bair (kindled) in their idah (company). The lahabah (flame) lahat (burned) up the rashai (wicked).
They ishah (make) a igal (calf) in Charab (Horeb), and shachah (worshiped) a masakah (molten) image.
Thus they mawar (exchanged) their kabawad (glory) for an thabanayath (image) of a shawar (bull) that akal (eat) ishab (grass).
They shakach (forgot) Al, their Savior, who ishah (make) done gadawal (very great/important/mighty) things in Matzarayam (Egypt),
Wondrous palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Cham (Ham), and awesome things by the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters).

Therefore he amar (spoke) that he would shamad (destroy) them, had Mashah (Moses), his bachayar (chosen), not imad (stood) panayam (before) him in the paratz (breach), to shawab (turn back / repent) away his chamah (wrath), so that he wouldn't shachath (destroy) them.
Yes, they maas (despised) the chamadah (pleasant) aratz (Earth/land). They didn't aman (believe / have faith) his dabar (word / matter),
But ragan (murmured) in their ahal (tents), and didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) qawal (sound / voice).
Therefore he nashaa (lift) to them that he would napal (fall / be cast down) them in the madabar (wilderness),
That he would napal (fall / be cast down) their zarai (seed) among the gaway (nation / people), and zarah (scatter) them in the aratz (Earth/land).
They tzamad (joined) themselves also to Bailapaiwar (Baal) Peor, and akal (eat) the zabach (sacrifices) of the mawath (death).
Thus they provoked him to kais (anger) with their deeds. The magapah (plague) paratz (broke) in on them.
Then Payanachas (Phinehas) imad (stood) up, and executed palal (judgment), so the magapah (plague) was itzar (stopped).
That was credited to him for tzadaqah (righteousness), for all dawar (generation / age / period) to come.
They qatzap (angered) him also at the mayam (Waters) of marayabah (meribah), so that Mashah (Moses) was troubled for their sakes;
Because they were rebellious against his rawach (spirit / wind), he bataa (spoke) rashly with his shapah (lips).
They didn't shamad (destroy) the im (people / nation), as Yahawah commanded them,
But mixed themselves with the gaway (nation / people), and lamad (teach/instruct) their maishah (works).
They ibad (servant) their itzab (idols), which became a mawaqash (snare) to them.
Yes, they zabach (sacrificed) their ban (son) and their bath (daughter) to demons.

They shapak (shed) naqay (innocent) dam (blood), even the dam (blood) of their ban (son) and of their bath (daughter), whom they zabach (sacrificed) to the itzab (idols) of Kanain (Canaan). The aratz (Earth/land) was chanap (polluted) with dam (blood).
Thus were they tamaa (defiled) with their maishah (works), and prostituted themselves in their maishah (deeds).
Therefore Yahawah charah (hot with anger) with ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) against his im (people / nation). He thaib (abhorred) his nachalah (inheritance).
He nathan (give) them into the yad (hand) of the gaway (nation / people). Those who shanaa (hate) them mashal (rule/have dominion) over them.
Their ayab (enemy) also lachatz (oppressed) them. They were kanai (brought) into subjection under their yad (hand).
Many paim (times) he natzal (delivered) them, but they were rebellious in their itzah (counsel), and were makak (brought) low in their iwan (guilt/iniquity).
Nevertheless he raah (see) their tzar (oppressor / distressor), when he shamai (hearken / hear) their ranah (cry).
He zakar (remembrance/memory) for them his barayath (covenant), and nacham (turn away / repent) according to the rab (multitude) of his chasad (grace) kindnesses.
He nathan (give) them also to be racham (pitied) by all those who shabah (carried) them captive.

Yashai (salvation) us, Yahawah, our Alahayam, qabatz (gather) us from among the gaway (nation / people), to give yadah (thanks) to your qadash (set apart/make holy) sham (name), to shabach (triumph) in your thahalah (praise)!

Barak (blessed) BOOK be V Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), from iwalam (forever) even to iwalam (forever)! Let all the im (people / nation) amar (spoke), "aman (believe / have faith)." Halal (praise) Yah!
Give yadah (thanks) to Yahawah, for he is tawab (pleasant/functional), for his loving tawab (pleasant/functional) endures iwalam (forever).
Let the gaal (redeemed) by Yahawah amar (spoke) so, whom he has gaal (redeemed) from the yad (hand) of the tzar (oppressor / distressor),
And qabatz (gathered) out of the aratz (Earth/land), from the mazarach (east) and from the mairab (west), from the tzapawan (north) and from the yam (sea/waters).
They thaih (wandered) in the madabar (wilderness) in a yashayamawan (desert) darak (way). They matzaa (found) no iyar (city) to live in.
Raib (hungry) and thirsty, their napash (living being/soul) itap (fainted) in them.
Then they tzaiq (cried) to Yahawah in their tzar (oppressor / distressor), and he natzal (delivered) them out of their distresses,
He darak (led) them also by a yashar (straight) darak (way), that they might yalak (go) to a iyar (city) to live in.
Let them yadah (praise) Yahawah for his loving chasad (grace), for his wonderful palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) to the ban (son) of adam (men)!
For he shabai (satisfies) the shaqaq (longing) napash (living being/soul). He malaa (fills) the raib (hungry) napash (living being/soul) with tawab (pleasant/functional).
Some yashab (inhabit/dwell) in chashak (darkness) and in the shadow of tzalamawath (death), being asayar (bound) in inay (affliction) and barazal (iron),
Because they marah (rebelled) against the amar (spoke) of Al, and condemned the itzah (counsel) of the Most ilayawan (high).
Therefore he kanai (brought) down their lab (heart) with imal (labor). They kashal (stumble / stagger) down, and there was none to izar (help).
Then they zaiq (cried) to Yahawah in their tzar (oppressor / distressor), and he yashai (salvation) them out of their distresses.
He yatzaa (go out / come out) them out of chashak (darkness) and the shadow of tzalamawath (death), and nathaq (broke) their mawasar (bonds) in sunder.
Let them yadah (praise) Yahawah for his loving chasad (grace), for his wonderful palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) to the ban (son) of adam (men)!
For he has shabar (broken) the dalath (gates) of nachashath (brass), and gadai (cut) through barayach (bars) of barazal (iron).
Awayal (fools) are inah (oppress / afflict) darak (because) of their disobedience, and because of their iwan (guilt/iniquity).
Their napash (living being/soul) thaib (abhors) all kinds of akal (food). They nagai (draw) near to the shair (gates) of mawath (death).
Then they zaiq (cry) to Yahawah in their tzar (oppressor / distressor), he yashai (salvation) them out of their distresses.
He shalach (send) his dabar (word / matter), and rapaa (heals) them, and malat (delivers) them from their shachayath (graves).
Let them yadah (praise) Yahawah for his loving chasad (grace), for his wonderful palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) to the ban (son) of adam (men)!
Let them offer the zabach (sacrifices) of thanksgiving, and sapar (book) his maishah (works) with ranah (singing).
Those who yarad (go) down to the yam (sea/waters) in anayah (ships), who ishah (make) malaakah (business) in rab (great) mayam (Waters);
These raah (see) yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) maishah (works), and his palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) in the matzawalah (deep).
For he commands, and imad (raises) the sair (stormy) rawach (spirit / wind), which rawam (will lift up) up its gal (waves).
They ilah (go up / offer) up to the sky; they yarad (go) down again to the thahawam (depths). Their napash (living being/soul) mawag (melts) away because of rai (trouble).
They chagag (reel) back and forth, and nawai (stagger) like a drunken shakawar (man), and are at their chakamah (wits)' balai (end).
Then they tzaiq (cry) to Yahawah in their tzar (oppressor / distressor), and he yatzaa (go out / come out) them out of their matzawaqah (distress).
He qawam (rise up) the sair (storm) a damamah (calm), so that its gal (waves) are still.
Then they are shamach (glad) because it is shathaq (calm), so he nachah (brings) them to their chapatz (desired) machawaz (haven).
Let them yadah (praise) Yahawah for his loving chasad (grace), for his wonderful palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) for the ban (son) of adam (men)!
Let them rawam (will lift up) him also in the qahal (assembly) of the im (people / nation), and halal (praise) him in the mawashab (seat) of the zaqan (elders).
He shawam (place / establish / appoint) nahar (rivers) into a madabar (desert), mayam (Waters) springs into a thirsty tzamaawan (ground),
And a paray (fruitful) aratz (Earth/land) into a malachah (salt) waste, for the rai (wickedness) of those who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in it.
He shawam (place / establish / appoint) a madabar (desert) into a agam (pool) of mayam (Waters), and a tzayah (dry) aratz (Earth/land) into mayam (Waters) springs.
There he makes the raib (hungry) live, that they may kawan (prepare) a iyar (city) to live in,
Zarai (sow) shadah (fields), natai (plant) karam (vineyards), and reap the paray (fruits) of thabawaah (increase).
He blesses them also, so that they are rabah (multiplied) maad (greatly). He doesn't allow their livestock to mait (decrease).
Again, they are mait (diminished) and shachach (bowed) down through itzar (oppression), rai (trouble), and yagawan (sorrow).
He shapak (pours) bawaz (contempt) on nadayab (princes), and thaih (causes) them to wander in a trackless thahaw (formless).
Yet he lifts the abayawan (needy) out of their inay (affliction), and increases their mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) like a tzaan (flock).
The yashar (upright) will raah (see) it, and be shamach (glad). All the iwal (wicked) will qapatz (shut) their pah (mouths).
Whoever is chakam (wise) will pay attention to these things. They will bayan (between) the chasad (grace) kindnesses of Yahawah.
My lab (heart) is steadfast, Alahayam. I will shayar (sing) and I will make music with my kabawad (soul).
Iwar (rouse / awaken) up, harp and lyre! I will iwar (rouse / awaken) up the dawn.
I will give yadah (thanks) to you, Yahawah, among the im (people / nation). I will sing zamar (praises) to you among the laam (peoples).
For your loving chasad (grace) is gadawal (very great/important/mighty) above the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)). Your amath (truth) reaches to the shachaq (skies).
Be rawam (will lift up), Alahayam, above the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens))! Let your kabawad (glory) be over all the aratz (Earth/land).
That your yadayad (beloved) may be chalatz (delivered), yashai (salvation) with your right yamayan (right hand), and inah (answer / respond) us.
Alahayam has dabar (word / matter) from his qadash (set apart/make holy): In ilaz (triumph), I will chalaq (divide) Shakam (Shechem), and madad (measure) out the imaq (valley) of Sakawath (Succoth).
Galaid (Gilead) is mine. Manashah (Manasseh) is mine. Aparayam (Ephraim) also is my helmet. Yahawadah (Judah) is my scepter.
Mawaab (Moab) is my rachatz (wash) pot. I will toss my sandal on Adam (Edom). I will rawai (shout) over Palashath (Philistia).
Who will yabal (bring) me into the fortified iyar (city)? Who has nachah (led) me to Adam (Edom)?
Haven't you rejected us, Alahayam? You don't yatzaa (go out / come out) forth, Alahayam, with our tzabaa (troop).
Yahab (give) us izarah (help) against the tzar (oppressor / distressor), for the thashawaih (deliverance) of adam (man) is shawaa (vanity).
Through Alahayam, we will ishah (make) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor). For it is he who will bawas (tread) down our tzar (oppressor / distressor).
Alahayam of my thahalah (praise), don't remain charash (silent),

For they pathach (have) opened the pah (mouth) of the rashai (wicked) and the pah (mouth) of maramah (deceit) against me. They have dabar (word / matter) to me with a shaqar (lying) lashawan (tongue/language).
They have also surrounded me with dabar (word / matter) of hatred, and lacham (fought) against me chanam (without) a cause.
In return for my ahabah (love), they are my shatan (adversaries); but I am in thapalah (prayer).
They have shawam (place / establish / appoint) me rai (evil) for tawab (pleasant/functional), and hatred for my ahabah (love).
Paqad (visit) a rashai (wicked) man over him. Let an shatan (adversary) imad (stand) at his right yamayan (right hand).
When he is shapat (judged), yatzaa (go out / come out) him come forth rashai (guilty). Let his thapalah (prayer) be turned into chataah (sin).
Let his yawam (day) be mait (few). Let achar (other) laqach (take / seized) his paqadah (office).
Let his ban (son) be yathawam (fatherless), and his ashah (wife/individual woman) a alamanah (widow).
Let his ban (son) be nawai (wandering) beggars. Let them be darash (sought) from their ruins.
Let the nashah (creditor) seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his yagayai (labor).
Let there be no one to mashak (extend) chasad (grace) to him, neither let there be anyone to chanan (have) pity on his yathawam (fatherless) children.
Let his acharayath (posterity) be karath (cut) off. In the dawar (generation / age / period) achar (other) let their sham (name) be machah (blotted) out.
Let the iwan (guilt/iniquity) of his ab (father) be zakar (remembrance/memory) by Yahawah. Don't let the chataah (sin) of his am (mother) be machah (blotted) out.
Let them be before Yahawah continually, that he may karath (cut) off their zakar (remembrance/memory) from the aratz (Earth/land);

Because he didn't zakar (remembrance/memory) to show chasad (grace), but radap (persecuted) the inay (poor) and abayawan (needy) ayash (husband/individual man), the kaah (broken) in labab (heart), to mawath (death) them.
Yes, he ahab (love) qalalah (cursing), and it bawaa (come) to him. He didn't chapatz (delight) in barakah (blessing), and it was rachaq (far) from him.
He labash (clothed) himself also with qalalah (cursing) as with his mad (garment). It bawaa (come) into his qarab (among / near) parts like mayam (Waters), like shaman (oil) into his itzam (bones).
Let it be to him as the bagad (clothing) with which he itah (covers) himself, for the belt that is thamayad (always) around him.
This is the pailah (reward) of my shatan (adversaries) from Yahawah, of those who dabar (word / matter) rai (evil) against my napash (living being/soul).
But ishah (make) with me, Yahawah the Adanay, for your sham (name) sake, because your loving chasad (grace) is tawab (pleasant/functional), natzal (deliver) me;
For I am inay (poor) and abayawan (needy). My lab (heart) is wounded qarab (among / near) me.
I fade halak (move) like an evening tzal (shadow). I am nair (shaken) off like a arabah (locust).
My barak (knees) are kashal (stumble / stagger) through tzawam (fasting). My bashar (flesh) is thin and lacks shaman (fat).
I have also become a charapah (reproach) to them. When they raah (see) me, they nawai (shake) their raash (head).
Izar (help) me, Yahawah, my Alahayam. Yashai (salvation) me according to your loving chasad (grace);
That they may yadai (know) that this is your yad (hand); that you, Yahawah, ishah (make) done it.
They may qalal (curse), but you barak (bless). When they qawam (rise up), they will be bawash (shamed), but your ibad (servant) shall shamach (rejoice).
Let my shatan (adversaries) be labash (clothed) with dishonor. Let them itah (cover) themselves with their own bashath (shame) as with a maiyal (robe).
I will give maad (great) yadah (thanks) to Yahawah with my pah (mouth). Yes, I will halal (praise) him thawak (midst) the rab (multitude).
For he will imad (stand) at the right yamayan (right hand) of the abayawan (needy), to yashai (salvation) him from those who shapat (judge) his napash (living being/soul).

Yahawah naam (declares (prophetically)) to my Adawan, yashab (inhabit/dwell) at my right yamayan (right hand), until I shayath (put / appoint / make) your ayab (enemy) your hadam (footstool) for your feet.

Yahawah will shalach (send) forth the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of your iz (strength / might / refuge) out of Tzayawan (Zion). Radah (rule over / have dominion of / subdue) in the qarab (among / near) of your ayab (enemy).

Your im (people / nation) offer themselves nadabah (voluntary / freewill offering) in the yawam (day) of your chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), in qadash (set apart/make holy) array. Out of the racham (womb) of the mashachar (earnest / diligent search), you have the tal (dew) of your yaladawath (youth).
Yahawah has shabai (swear / take oath), and will not change his mind: You are a kahan (priest) iwalam (forever) in the dabarah (order) of Malakayatzadaq (Melchizedek).
The Adanay is at your right yamayan (right hand). He will machatz (crush / shatter) malak (king) in the yawam (day) of his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting).
He will dayan (judge) among the gaway (nation / people). He will heap up dead gawayah (corpse). He will machatz (crush / shatter) the raash (head) of the whole aratz (Earth/land).
He will shathah (drinks) of the nachal (stream / river) in the darak (way); therefore he will rawam (will lift up) up his raash (head).
Halal (praise) Yah! I will give yadah (thanks) to Yahawah with my whole labab (heart), in the council of the yashar (upright), and in the idah (congregation).
Yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) maishah (works) are gadawal (very great/important/mighty), pondered by all those who chapatz (delight) in them.
His pail (work) is honor and hadar (glory / majesty / splendor). His tzadaqah (righteousness) imad (endures) id (forever).
He ishah (make) caused his wonderful palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) to be remembered. Yahawah is chanawan (gracious) and rachawam (merciful).
He nathan (give) given food to those who yaraa (fear) him. He iwalam (forever) zakar (remembrance/memory) his barayath (covenant).
He has shown his im (people / nation) the kach (strength / mighty / power) of his maishah (works), in nathan (give) them the nachalah (heritage) of the gaway (nation / people).
The maishah (works) of his yad (hand) are amath (truth) and mashapat (justice). All his paqawad (precepts) are aman (believe / have faith).
They are samak (established) id (forever) and id (ever). They are ishah (make) in amath (truth) and uprightness.
He has shalach (send) padawath (redemption) to his im (people / nation). He has ordained his barayath (covenant) iwalam (forever). His sham (name) is qadawash (holy) and awesome!

The yaraah (fear) of Yahawah is the raashayath (beginning) of chakamah (wisdom). All those who ishah (make) his work have a tawab (pleasant/functional) shakal (understanding). His thahalah (praise) imad (endures) id (forever)!
Halal (praise) Yah! Ashar (who/that) is the ayash (husband/individual man) who yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah, who chapatz (delights) maad (greatly) in his matzawah (commandments).
His zarai (seed) will be gabawar (mighty) in the aratz (Earth/land). The dawar (generation / age / period) of the yashar (upright) will be barak (blessed).
Hawan (wealth) and riches are in his bayath (house). His tzadaqah (righteousness) imad (endures) id (forever).
Awar (light) dawns in the chashak (darkness) for the yashar (upright), chanawan (gracious), rachawam (merciful), and tzadayaq (righteous).
It is tawab (pleasant/functional) with the ayash (husband/individual man) who chanan (deals) graciously and lawah (lends). He will maintain his dabar (word / matter) in mashapat (judgment).
For he will iwalam (forever) be mawat (shaken). The tzadayaq (righteous) will be remembered iwalam (forever).
He will not be yaraa (fear / be afraid) of rai (evil) shamawaih (news). His lab (heart) is steadfast, batach (trusting) in Yahawah.
His lab (heart) is samak (established). He will not be yaraa (fear / be afraid) in the end when he raah (see) his tzar (oppressor / distressor).
He has pazar (dispersed), he nathan (give) given to the abayawan (poor). His tzadaqah (righteousness) imad (endures) id (forever). His qaran (horn) will be rawam (will lift up) with honor.

The rashai (wicked) will raah (see) it, and be kais (grieved). He shall charaq (gnash) with his shan (teeth), and masas (melt) away. The thaawah (desire) of the rashai (wicked) will abad (destroy/perish).
Halal (praise) Yah! Halal (praise), you ibad (servant) of Yahawah, halal (praise) the sham (name) of Yahawah.
Barak (blessed) be the sham (name) of Yahawah, from ithah (now / present moment) time forth and forevermore.
From the mazarach (rising) of the shamash (sun) to the mabawaa (going) down of the same, yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) sham (name) is to be halal (praise).
Yahawah is rawam (will lift up) above all gaway (nation / people), his kabawad (glory) above the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)).
Who is like Yahawah, our Alahayam, who has his yashab (inhabit/dwell) on gabah (high),
Who stoops down to raah (see) in shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) and in the aratz (Earth/land)?
He qawam (rise up) up the dal (poor) out of the ipar (dust). Rawam (will lift up) up the abayawan (needy) from the ash heap;
That he may yashab (inhabit/dwell) him with nadayab (princes), even with the nadayab (princes) of his im (people / nation).
He yashab (inhabit/dwell) the iqar (barren) woman in her bayath (house), as a shamach (joyful) am (mother) of ban (son). Halal (praise) Yah!
When Yasharaal (Israel) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of Matzarayam (Egypt), the bayath (house) of Yaiqab (Jacob) from a im (people / nation) of foreign laiz (language);
Yahawadah (Judah) became his qadash (set apart/make holy), Yasharaal (Israel) his mamashalah (dominion).
The yam (sea/waters) raah (see) it, and nawas (fled). The Yaradan (Jordan) was sabab (driven) achawar (back).
The har (mountain) raqad (skipped) like ayal (rams), the gabaih (little) hills like ban (son).
What was it, you yam (sea/waters), that you nawas (fled)? You Yaradan (Jordan), that you sabab (turned) achawar (back)?
You har (mountain), that you raqad (skipped) like ayal (rams); you gabaih (little) hills, like ban (son)?
Chawal (tremble), you aratz (Earth/land), at the panayam (presence) of the Adawan, at the panayam (presence) of the Alawah of Yaiqab (Jacob),
Who hapak (turned) the tzawar (rock) into a agam (pool) of mayam (Waters), the chalamayash (flint) into a maiyan (spring) of mayam (Waters).
Not to us, Yahawah, not to us, but to your sham (name) nathan (give) kabawad (glory), for your loving chasad (grace), and for your amath (truth) sake.
Why should the gaway (nation / people) amar (spoke), Where is their Alahayam, now?
But our Alahayam is in the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)). He ishah (make) whatever he pleases.
Their itzab (idols) are kasap (silver) and zahab (gold), the maishah (work) of adam (men's) yad (hand).
They have pah (mouths), but they don't dabar (word / matter). They have iyan (eye), but they don't raah (see).
They have azan (ears), but they don't shamai (hearken / hear). They have ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), but they don't rawach (spirit / wind).
They have yad (hand), but they don't mawash (feel). They have ragal (feet / foot), but they don't halak (move), neither do they hagah (speak) through their garawan (throat).
Those who ishah (make) them will be like them; yes, everyone who batach (trusts) in them.
Yasharaal (Israel), batach (trust) in Yahawah! He is their izar (help) and their magan (shield).
Bayath (house) of Aharawan (Aaron), batach (trust) in Yahawah! He is their izar (help) and their magan (shield).
You who yaraa (fear) Yahawah, batach (trust) in Yahawah! He is their izar (help) and their magan (shield).
Yahawah zakar (remembrance/memory) us. He will barak (bless) us. He will barak (bless) the bayath (house) of Yasharaal (Israel). He will barak (bless) the bayath (house) of Aharawan (Aaron).
He will barak (bless) those who yaraa (fear) Yahawah, both qatan (small/young/least) and gadawal (very great/important/mighty).
May Yahawah yasap (increase) you more and more, you and your ban (son).
Barak (blessed) are you by Yahawah, who ishah (make) shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) and aratz (Earth/land).
The shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) are the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) of Yahawah; but the aratz (Earth/land) nathan (give) he given to the ban (son) of adam (men).
The mawath (death) don't halal (praise) Yah, neither any who yarad (go) down into dawamah (silence);
But we will barak (bless) Yah, from this time forth and forevermore. Halal (praise) Yah!
I ahab (love) Yahawah, because he shamai (hearken / hear) to my qawal (sound / voice), and my cries for thachanawan (mercy).
Because he has natah (turned) his azan (ear) to me, therefore I will qaraa (called) on him as yawam (day) as I live.
The chabal (cords) of mawath (death) surrounded me, the matzar (pains) of shaawal (Shaawal/afterlife) matzaa (got) a hold of me. I matzaa (found) tzarah (trouble) and yagawan (sorrow).
Then I qaraa (called) on the sham (name) of Yahawah: Yahawah, I beg you, malat (deliver) my napash (living being/soul).
Yahawah is chanawan (gracious) and tzadayaq (righteous). Yes, our Alahayam is merciful.
Yahawah shamar (keep/guard) the pathay (simple). I was dalal (brought) low, and he yashai (salvation) me.
Shawab (turn back / repent) to your manawachah (rest), my napash (living being/soul), for Yahawah has dealt gamal (bountifully) with you.
For you have chalatz (delivered) my napash (living being/soul) from mawath (death), my iyan (eye) from damaih (tears), and my ragal (feet / foot) from dachay (falling).
I will halak (move) panayam (before) Yahawah in the aratz (Earth/land) of the chay (life).
I aman (believe / have faith), therefore I dabar (word / matter), I was maad (greatly) inah (oppress / afflict).
I amar (spoke) in my chapaz (haste), All adam (men) are kazab (liars).
What will I shawab (turn back / repent) to Yahawah for all his thagamawal (benefits) toward me?
I will nashaa (lift) the kawas (cup) of yashawaih (salvation), and qaraa (called) on the sham (name) of Yahawah.
I will shalam (pay) my nadar (vow) to Yahawah, yes, in the presence of all his im (people / nation).
Yaqar (precious) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah is the mawath (death) of his chasayad (saints).
Yahawah, truly I am your ibad (servant). I am your ibad (servant), the ban (son) of your handmaid. You pathach (have) freed me from my chains.
I will zabach (offer) to you the zabach (sacrifice) of thanksgiving, and will qaraa (called) on the sham (name) of Yahawah.
I will shalam (pay) my nadar (vow) to Yahawah, yes, in the presence of all his im (people / nation),
In the chatzar (courts) of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) bayath (house), in the thawak (midst) of you, Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). Halal (praise) Yah!
Halal (praise) Yahawah, all you gaway (nation / people)! Extol him, all you gaway (nation / people)!
For his loving chasad (grace) is gabar (great) toward us. Yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) amath (truth) endures iwalam (forever). Halal (praise) Yah!
Give yadah (thanks) to Yahawah, for he is tawab (pleasant/functional), for his loving tawab (pleasant/functional) endures iwalam (forever).

Let the bayath (house) of Aharawan (Aaron) now amar (spoke) that his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever).
Now let those who yaraa (fear) Yahawah amar (spoke) that his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever).
Out of my matzar (distress), I qaraa (called) on Yah. Yah inah (answer / respond) me with freedom.
Yahawah is on my side. I will not be yaraa (fear / be afraid). What can adam (man) ishah (make) to me?
Yahawah is on my side among those who izar (help) me. Therefore I will raah (see) in triumph at those who shanaa (hate) me.
It is tawab (pleasant/functional) to take chasah (refuge) in Yahawah, than to batach (put) confidence in adam (man).
It is tawab (pleasant/functional) to take chasah (refuge) in Yahawah, than to batach (put) confidence in nadayab (princes).
All the gaway (nation / people) surrounded me, but in the sham (name) of Yahawah, I mawal (cut) them off.
They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In the sham (name) of Yahawah I indeed mawal (cut) them off.
They surrounded me like dabawarah (bees). They are daik (quenched) like the ash (fire) qawatz (thorns). In the sham (name) of Yahawah I mawal (cut) them off.
You pushed me back hard, to napal (fall / be cast down) me fall, but Yahawah izar (helped) me.
Yah is my iz (strength / might / refuge) and zamarath (song). He has become my yashawaih (salvation).

The qawal (sound / voice) of ranah (rejoicing) and yashawaih (salvation) is in the ahal (tents) of the tzadayaq (righteous). The right yamayan (right hand) of Yahawah ishah (make) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor).
The right yamayan (right hand) of Yahawah is ramam (exalted)! The right yamayan (right hand) of Yahawah ishah (make) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor)!
I will not mawath (death), but chayah (live), and sapar (book) yah (Yah (contracted form of Yahawah)) maishah (works).
Yah has yasar (punished) me severely, but he nathan (give) not given me over to mawath (death).
Pathach (open) to me the shair (gates) of tzadaq (righteous / just / fair). I will bawaa (come) into them. I will give yadah (thanks) to Yah.
This is the shair (gate) of Yahawah; the tzadayaq (righteous) will bawaa (come) into it.
I will give yadah (thanks) to you, for you have inah (answer / respond) me, and have become my yashawaih (salvation).
The aban (stone) which the banah (builders) maas (rejected) has become the raash (head) of the panah (corner).
This is yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous). It is marvelous in our iyan (eye).
This is the yawam (day) that Yahawah ishah (make) made. We will gayal (rejoice) and be shamach (glad) in it!
Yashai (salvation) us now, we beg you, Yahawah! Yahawah, we beg you, tzalach (send) prosperity now.
Barak (blessed) is he who bawaa (come) in the sham (name) of Yahawah! We have barak (blessed) you out of the bayath (house) of Yahawah.
Yahawah is Al, and he has given us awar (light). Asar (bind) the chag (feast/festival) with ibath (cords), even to the qaran (horn) of the mazabach (altar).
You are my Al, and I will give yadah (thanks) to you. You are my Alahayam, I will rawam (will lift up) you.
Oh give yadah (thanks) to Yahawah, for he is tawab (pleasant/functional), for his loving tawab (pleasant/functional) endures iwalam (forever).
Ashar (who/that) are those whose darak (ways) are blameless, who halak (move) according to yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) thawarah (instruction).
Ashar (who/that) are those who natzar (keep) his idah (statutes), who darash (seek) him with their whole lab (heart).
Yes, they pail (do) nothing wrong. They halak (move) in his darak (ways).
You have tzawah (commanded) your paqawad (precepts), that we should fully obey them.
Oh that my darak (ways) were steadfast to obey your chaq (statute)!
Then I wouldn't be disappointed, when I nabat (consider) all of your matzawah (commandments).
I will give yadah (thanks) to you with yashar (uprightness) of labab (heart), when I lamad (teach/instruct) your tzadaq (righteous / just / fair) mashapat (judgments).
I will shamar (keep/guard) your chaq (statute). Don't maad (utterly) izab (forsake) me.
How can a nair (young) man keep his arach (way) zakah (pure)? By living according to your dabar (word / matter).
With my whole lab (heart), I have darash (sought) you. Don't shagah (let) me wander from your matzawah (commandments).
I have tzapan (hidden) your amarah (sayings) in my lab (heart), that I might not chataa (sin) against you.
Barak (blessed) are you, Yahawah. Lamad (teach/instruct) me your chaq (statute).
With my shapah (lips), I have sapar (book) all the mashapat (ordinances) of your pah (mouth).
I have shawash (rejoiced) in the darak (way) of your idawath (testimonies), as much as in all riches.
I will shayach (meditate) on your paqawad (precepts), and nabat (consider) your arach (ways).
I will shaii (delight) myself in your chaqah (statutes). I will not shakach (forget) your dabar (word / matter).
Gamal (do) good to your ibad (servant). I will chayah (live) and I will obey your dabar (word / matter).
Galah (open) my iyan (eye), that I may nabat (see) palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) things out of your thawarah (instruction).
I am a gar (sojourner / stranger / foreigner) on the aratz (Earth/land). Don't sathar (hide) your matzawah (commandments) from me.
My napash (living being/soul) is consumed with thaabah (longing) for your mashapat (ordinances) at all ith (times).
You have gair (rebuked) the zad (proud) who are arar (cursed), who shagah (wander) from your matzawah (commandments).
Take charapah (reproach) and bawaz (contempt) away from me, for I have natzar (kept) your idah (statutes).
Though shar (prince / ruler) yashab (inhabit/dwell) and slander me, your ibad (servant) will shayach (meditate) on your chaq (statute).
Indeed your idah (statutes) are my shaishai (delight), and my counselors.
My napash (living being/soul) is laid low in the ipar (dust). Chayah (revive) me according to your dabar (word / matter)!
I sapar (book) my darak (ways), and you inah (answer / respond) me. Lamad (teach/instruct) me your chaq (statute).
Let me bayan (between) the teaching of your paqawad (precepts)! Then I will shayach (meditate) on your wondrous palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous).
My napash (living being/soul) is weary with thawagah (sorrow): qawam (rise up) me according to your dabar (word / matter).
Keep me from the darak (way) of shaqar (deceit). Grant me your thawarah (instruction) graciously!
I have bachar (chosen) the darak (way) of amawanah (truth). I have set your mashapat (ordinances) before me.
I cling to your idawath (statutes), Yahawah. Don't let me be disappointed.
I rawatz (run) in the darak (path) of your matzawah (commandments), for you have set my lab (heart) free.
Yarah (teach) me, Yahawah, the darak (way) of your chaq (statute). I will natzar (keep) them to the iqab (award / effect after the cause).
Give me bayan (between), and I will natzar (keep) your thawarah (instruction). Yes, I will obey it with my whole lab (heart).
Direct me in the nathayab (path) of your matzawah (commandments), for I chapatz (delight) in them.
Natah (turn) my lab (heart) toward your idawath (statutes), not toward selfish batzai (gain).
Turn my iyan (eye) ibar (pass over/through) from raah (see) at worthless things. Chayah (revive) me in your darak (ways).
Fulfill your promise to your ibad (servant), that you may be yaraah (feared).
Ibar (pass over/through) away my disgrace that I dread, for your mashapat (ordinances) are tawab (pleasant/functional).
Behold, I thaab (long) for your paqawad (precepts)! Chayah (revive) me in your tzadaqah (righteousness).
Let your loving chasad (grace) also bawaa (come) to me, Yahawah, your thashawaih (deliverance), according to your amarah (sayings).
So I will have an inah (answer / respond) for him who reproaches me, for I batach (trust) in your dabar (word / matter).
Don't snatch the dabar (word / matter) of amath (truth) out of my pah (mouth), for I put my yachal (hope) in your mashapat (ordinances).
So I will obey your thawarah (instruction) continually, iwalam (forever) and id (ever).
I will halak (move) in rachab (liberty), for I have darash (sought) your paqawad (precepts).
I will also dabar (word / matter) of your idah (statutes) before malak (king), and will not be disappointed.
I will shaii (delight) myself in your matzawah (commandments), because I ahab (love) them.
I reach out my kap (hands) for your matzawah (commandments), which I ahab (love). I will shayach (meditate) on your chaq (statute).
Zakar (remembrance/memory) your dabar (word / matter) to your ibad (servant), because you gave me yachal (hope).
This is my nachamah (comfort) in my inay (affliction), for your amarah (sayings) has chayah (revived) me.
The arrogant lawatz (mock) me excessively, but I don't swerve from your thawarah (instruction).
I zakar (remembrance/memory) your mashapat (ordinances) of iwalam (forever), Yahawah, and have nacham (turn away / repent) myself.
Indignation achaz (has) taken hold on me, because of the rashai (wicked) who izab (forsake) your thawarah (instruction).
Your chaq (statute) have been my zamayar (songs), in the bayath (house) magawar (where) I live.
I have zakar (remembrance/memory) your sham (name), Yahawah, in the layal (night), and I obey your thawarah (instruction).
This is my way, that I natzar (keep) your paqawad (precepts).
Yahawah is my chalaq (portion). I amar (spoke) to obey your dabar (word / matter).
I sought your favor with my whole lab (heart). Be chanan (merciful) to me according to your amarah (sayings).
I chashab (considered) my darak (ways), and shawab (turn back / repent) my steps to your idah (statutes).
I will hurry, and not mahah (delay), to obey your matzawah (commandments).
The chabal (ropes) of the rashai (wicked) bind me, but I won't shakach (forget) your thawarah (instruction).
At chatzawath (midnight) I will qawam (rise up) to give yadah (thanks) to you, because of your tzadaq (righteous / just / fair) mashapat (ordinances).
I am a friend of all those who yaraa (fear / be afraid) you, of those who shamar (keep/guard) your paqawad (precepts).
The aratz (Earth/land) is malaa (full) of your loving chasad (grace), Yahawah. Lamad (teach/instruct) me your chaq (statute).
Ishah (make) tawab (pleasant/functional) to your ibad (servant), according to your dabar (word / matter), Yahawah.
Lamad (teach/instruct) me tawab (pleasant/functional) taim (judgment) and daith (knowledge), for I aman (believe / have faith) in your matzawah (commandments).
Before I was inah (oppress / afflict), I shagag (went) astray; but now I shamar (keep/guard) your amarah (sayings).
You are tawab (pleasant/functional), and do tawab (pleasant/functional). Lamad (teach/instruct) me your chaq (statute).
The zad (proud) have smeared a shaqar (lie) upon me. With my whole lab (heart), I will natzar (keep) your paqawad (precepts).
Their lab (heart) is as callous as the tapash (fat), but I shaii (delight) in your thawarah (instruction).
It is tawab (pleasant/functional) for me that I have been inah (oppress / afflict), that I may lamad (teach/instruct) your chaq (statute).
The thawarah (instruction) of your pah (mouth) is tawab (pleasant/functional) to me than alap (thousands) of pieces of zahab (gold) and kasap (silver).
Your yad (hand) ishah (make) made me and formed me. Give me bayan (between), that I may lamad (teach/instruct) your matzawah (commandments).
Those who yaraa (fear) you will raah (see) me and be shamach (glad), because I yachal (have) put my hope in your dabar (word / matter).
Yahawah, I yadai (know) that your mashapat (judgments) are tzadaq (righteous / just / fair), that in amawanah (faithfulness) you have inah (oppress / afflict) me.
Please let your loving chasad (grace) be for my nacham (turn away / repent), according to your amarah (sayings) to your ibad (servant).
Let your tender racham (mercies) bawaa (come) to me, that I may chayah (live); for your thawarah (instruction) is my shaishai (delight).
Let the zad (proud) be disappointed, for they have overthrown me shaqar (wrongfully). I will shayach (meditate) on your paqawad (precepts).
Let those who yaraa (fear) you shawab (turn back / repent) to me. They yadai (will) know your idah (statutes).
Let my lab (heart) be blameless toward your chaq (statute), that I may not be disappointed.
My napash (living being/soul) kalah (complete / finish) for your thashawaih (deliverance). I yachal (hope) in your dabar (word / matter).
My iyan (eye) kalah (complete / finish) for your amarah (sayings). I amar (spoke), When will you nacham (turn away / repent) me?
For I have become like a wineskin in the qayatawar (smoke). I don't shakach (forget) your chaq (statute).
How many are the yawam (day) of your ibad (servant)? When will you ishah (make) mashapat (judgment) on those who radap (persecute) me?
The zad (proud) have karah (dug) shayachah (pits) for me, contrary to your thawarah (instruction).
All of your matzawah (commandments) are amawanah (faithful). They radap (persecute) me shaqar (wrongfully). Izar (help) me!
They had mait (almost) wiped me from the aratz (Earth/land), but I didn't izab (forsake) your paqawad (precepts).
Preserve my chayah (life) according to your loving chasad (grace), so I will obey the idawath (statutes) of your pah (mouth).
Yahawah, your dabar (word / matter) is natzab (settled) in shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) iwalam (forever).
Your amawanah (faithfulness) is to all dawar (generation / age / period). You have kawan (established) the aratz (Earth/land), and it imad (remains).
Your mashapat (laws) imad (remain) to this yawam (day), for all things ibad (servant) you.
Lawalaa (unless) your thawarah (instruction) had been my shaishai (delight), I would abad (destroy/perish) perished in my inay (affliction).
I will iwalam (forever) shakach (forget) your paqawad (precepts), for with them, you have chayah (revived) me.
I am yours. Yashai (salvation) me, for I have darash (sought) your paqawad (precepts).
The rashai (wicked) have qawah (gather/wait) for me, to abad (destroy/perish) me. I will bayan (between) your idah (statutes).
I raah (see) seen a limit to all thakalah (perfection), but your commands are boundless.
How I love your thawarah (instruction)! It is my shayachah (meditation) all yawam (day).
Your matzawah (commandments) chakam (make) me wiser than my ayab (enemy), for your commandments are iwalam (forever) with me.
I have more shakal (understanding) than all my teachers, for your idawath (testimonies) are my shayachah (meditation).
I bayan (between) more than the zaqan (aged), because I have natzar (kept) your paqawad (precepts).
I have kalaa (kept) my ragal (feet / foot) from every rai (evil) arach (way), that I might shamar (keep/guard) your dabar (word / matter).
I have not sawar (turned) aside from your mashapat (ordinances), for you have yarah (taught) me.
How malatz (sweet) are your promises to my chak (taste), more than dabash (honey) to my pah (mouth)!
Through your paqawad (precepts), I get bayan (between); therefore I shanaa (hate) every shaqar (false) arach (way).
Your dabar (word / matter) is a nayar (lamp) to my ragal (feet / foot), and a awar (light) for my nathayab (path).
I have shabai (swear / take oath), and have qawam (rise up) it, that I will obey your tzadaq (righteous / just / fair) mashapat (ordinances).
I am inah (oppress / afflict) very much. Chayah (revive) me, Yahawah, according to your dabar (word / matter).
Ratzah (accept), I beg you, the willing nadabah (voluntary / freewill offering) of my pah (mouth). Yahawah, lamad (teach/instruct) me your mashapat (ordinances).
My napash (living being/soul) is continually in my kap (hand), yet I won't shakach (forget) your thawarah (instruction).
The rashai (wicked) nathan (give) laid a pach (snare) for me, yet I haven't thaih (gone) astray from your paqawad (precepts).
I have taken your idawath (testimonies) as a nachal (heritage) iwalam (forever), for they are the shashawan (joy) of my lab (heart).
I have set my lab (heart) to ishah (make) your chaq (statute) iwalam (forever), even to the iqab (award / effect after the cause).
I shanaa (hate) double-minded men, but I ahab (love) your thawarah (instruction).
You are my sathar (secret / hidden) place and my magan (shield). I yachal (hope) in your dabar (word / matter).
Sawar (depart) from me, you evildoers, that I may natzar (keep) the matzawah (commandments) of my Alahayam.
Samak (uphold) me according to your amarah (sayings), that I may chayah (live). Let me not be bawash (ashamed) of my shabar (hope).
Said (hold) me up, and I will be yashai (salvation), and will shaih (have) respect for your chaq (statute) continually.
You reject all those who stray from your chaq (statute), for their tharamah (deceit) is in shaqar (vain).
You shabath (shabath/rest) away all the rashai (wicked) of the aratz (Earth/land) like sayag (dross). Therefore I ahab (love) your idah (testimonies).
My bashar (flesh) samar (trembles) for pachad (fear / dread) of you. I am yaraa (fear / be afraid) of your mashapat (judgments).
I ishah (make) done what is mashapat (just) and tzadaq (righteous / just / fair). Don't yanach (leave) me to my oppressors.
Ensure your ibad (servant) well-being. Don't let the zad (proud) ishaq (oppress) me.
My iyan (eye) kalah (complete / finish) looking for your yashawaih (salvation), for your tzadaq (righteous / just / fair) amarah (sayings).
Ishah (make) with your ibad (servant) according to your loving chasad (grace). Lamad (teach/instruct) me your chaq (statute).
I am your ibad (servant). Give me bayan (between), that I may yadai (know) your idah (testimonies).
It is ith (time) to act, Yahawah, for they parar (break) your thawarah (instruction).
Therefore I ahab (love) your matzawah (commandments) more than zahab (gold), yes, more than pure paz (gold).
Therefore I consider all of your paqawad (precepts) to be yashar (right). I shanaa (hate) every shaqar (false) arach (way).
Your idawath (testimonies) are wonderful, therefore my napash (living being/soul) natzar (keeps) them.
The pathach (entrance) of your dabar (word / matter) gives awar (light). It gives bayan (between) to the pathay (simple).
I pair (opened) my pah (mouth) wide and shaap (panted), for I yaab (longed) for your matzawah (commandments).
Panah (turn) to me, and have chanan (mercy) on me, as you always do to those who ahab (love) your sham (name).
Kawan (establish) my paim (footsteps) in your amarah (sayings). Don't let any awan (iniquity) shalat (have) dominion over me.

Make your panayam (face) awar (light) on your ibad (servant). Lamad (teach/instruct) me your chaq (statute).
Palag (streams) of tears yarad (run) down my iyan (eye), because they don't shamar (keep/guard) your thawarah (instruction).
You are tzadayaq (righteous), Yahawah. Your mashapat (judgments) are yashar (upright).
You have tzawah (commanded) your idah (statutes) in tzadaq (righteous / just / fair). They are fully trustworthy.
My qanaah (zeal) wears me out, because my tzar (oppressor / distressor) ignore your dabar (word / matter).
Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your ibad (servant) ahab (love) them.
I am tzaiyar (small) and bazah (despised). I don't shakach (forget) your paqawad (precepts).
Your tzadaqah (righteousness) is an iwalam (forever) tzadaq (righteous / just / fair). Your thawarah (instruction) is amath (truth).
Tzar (oppressor / distressor) and matzawaq (anguish) matzaa (have) taken hold of me. Your matzawah (commandments) are my shaishai (delight).
Your idawath (testimonies) are tzadaq (righteous / just / fair) iwalam (forever). Give me bayan (between), that I may chayah (live).
I have qaraa (called) with my whole lab (heart). Inah (answer / respond) me, Yahawah! I will natzar (keep) your chaq (statute).
I have qaraa (called) to you. Yashai (salvation) me! I will obey your idah (statutes).
I rise qadam (before) dawn and shawai (cry) for help. I put my yachal (hope) in your dabar (word / matter).
My iyan (eye) stay open through the ashamarah (night) watches, that I might shayach (meditate) on your amarah (sayings).
Shamai (hearken / hear) my qawal (sound / voice) according to your loving chasad (grace). Chayah (revive) me, Yahawah, according to your mashapat (ordinances).
They qarab (come close) near who radap (follow) after zamah (wickedness). They are rachaq (far) from your thawarah (instruction).
You are qarawab (near), Yahawah. All your matzawah (commandments) are amath (truth).
Of qadam (old) I yadai (have) known from your idah (testimonies), that you have founded them iwalam (forever).
Raah (see) my inay (affliction), and chalatz (deliver) me, for I don't shakach (forget) your thawarah (instruction).
Rayab (plead) my rayab (cause), and gaal (redeem) me! Chayah (revive) me according to your promise.
Yashawaih (salvation) is rachawaq (far) from the rashai (wicked), for they don't darash (seek) your chaq (statute).
Rab (great) are your tender racham (mercies), Yahawah. Chayah (revive) me according to your mashapat (ordinances).
Many are my persecutors and my tzar (oppressor / distressor). I haven't swerved from your idawath (testimonies).
I raah (see) at the faithless with qawat (loathing), because they don't shamar (keep/guard) your amarah (sayings).
Raah (see) how I ahab (love) your paqawad (precepts). Chayah (revive) me, Yahawah, according to your loving chasad (grace).
All of your dabar (word / matter) are amath (truth). Every one of your tzadaq (righteous / just / fair) mashapat (ordinances) endures iwalam (forever).
Shar (prince / ruler) have radap (persecuted) me chanam (without) a cause, but my lab (heart) pachad (fear / dread) in awe of your dabar (word / matter).
I shawash (rejoice) at your amarah (sayings), as one who matzaa (finds) rab (great) shalal (spoil).
I shanaa (hate) and thaib (abhor) falsehood. I ahab (love) your thawarah (instruction).
Shabai (seven) times a yawam (day), I halal (praise) you, because of your tzadaq (righteous / just / fair) mashapat (ordinances).
Those who ahab (love) your thawarah (instruction) rab (have) great shalawam (peace / safety). Makashawal (nothing) causes them to stumble.
I have shabar (hoped) for your yashawaih (salvation), Yahawah. I ishah (make) done your matzawah (commandments).
My napash (living being/soul) has shamar (keep/guard) your idah (testimonies). I ahab (love) them maad (exceedingly).
I have obeyed your paqawad (precepts) and your idah (testimonies), for all my darak (ways) are before you.
Let my ranah (cry) qarab (come close) panayam (before) you, Yahawah. Give me bayan (between) according to your dabar (word / matter).
Let my thachanah (supplication) bawaa (come) panayam (before) you. Natzal (deliver) me according to your amarah (sayings).
Let my shapah (lips) nabai (utter) thahalah (praise), for you lamad (teach/instruct) me your chaq (statute).
Let my lashawan (tongue/language) inah (answer / respond) of your amarah (sayings), for all your matzawah (commandments) are tzadaq (righteous / just / fair).
Let your yad (hand) be ready to izar (help) me, for I have bachar (chosen) your paqawad (precepts).
I have thaab (longed) for your yashawaih (salvation), Yahawah. Your thawarah (instruction) is my shaishai (delight).
Let my napash (living being/soul) chayah (live), that I may halal (praise) you. Let your mashapat (ordinances) izar (help) me.
I have thaih (gone) astray like a abad (destroy/perish) shah (sheep). Baqash (seek) your ibad (servant), for I don't shakach (forget) your matzawah (commandments).
In my tzarah (distress), I qaraa (called) to Yahawah. He inah (answer / respond) me.
Natzal (deliver) my napash (living being/soul), Yahawah, from shaqar (lying) shapah (lips), from a deceitful lashawan (tongue/language).
What will be nathan (give) to you, and what will be yasap (done) more to you, you deceitful lashawan (tongue/language)?
Shanan (sharp) chatz (arrows) of the gabawar (mighty), with gachal (coals) of ratham (juniper).
Awayah (woe) is me, that I live in Mashak (Meshech), that I shakan (dwell) among the ahal (tents) of Qadar (Kedar)!
My napash (living being/soul) shakan (has) had her dwelling rab (too) long with him who shanaa (hate) shalawam (peace / safety).
I am for shalawam (peace / safety), but when I dabar (word / matter), they are for malachamah (war).
I will nashaa (lift) up my iyan (eye) to the har (mountain). Ayan (where) does my izar (help) bawaa (come) from?
My izar (help) comes from Yahawah, who ishah (make) shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) and aratz (Earth/land).
He will not allow your ragal (feet / foot) to be mawat (moved). He who shamar (keep/guard) you will not nawam (slumber).
Behold, he who shamar (keep/guard) Yasharaal (Israel) will neither nawam (slumber) nor sleep.
Yahawah is your keeper. Yahawah is your tzal (shade) on your yamayan (right hand) yad (hand).
The shamash (sun) will not harm you by yawamam (by day), nor the yarach (moon) by layal (night).
Yahawah will shamar (keep/guard) you from all rai (evil). He will shamar (keep/guard) your napash (living being/soul).
Yahawah will shamar (keep/guard) your yatzaa (go out / come out) out and your bawaa (come) in, from this time forth, and forevermore.
I was shamach (glad) when they amar (spoke) to me, yalak (let's) go to yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) bayath (house)!
Our ragal (feet / foot) are imad (standing) within your shair (gates), Yarawashalam (Jerusalem);
Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), that is banah (built) as a iyar (city) that is chabar (compact) yachad (together);

Where the shabat (tribes) ilah (go up / offer) up, even yah (Yah (contracted form of Yahawah)) shabat (tribes), according to an idawath (ordinance) for Yasharaal (Israel), to give yadah (thanks) to the sham (name) of Yahawah.
For there are yashab (inhabit/dwell) kasaa (thrones) for mashapat (judgment), the kasaa (thrones) of Dawad (David's) bayath (house).
Shaal (pray) for the shalawam (peace / safety) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). Those who ahab (love) you will shalah (prosper).
Shalawam (peace / safety) be within your chayal (walls), and shalawah (prosperity) within your aramawan (palaces).
For my ach (brother/kinsman)' and rai (neigbor/another person)' sakes, I will now dabar (word / matter), shalawam (peace / safety) be within you.
For the sake of the bayath (house) of Yahawah our Alahayam, I will baqash (seek) your tawab (pleasant/functional).
To you I do nashaa (lift) up my iyan (eye), you who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)).

Behold, as the iyan (eye) of ibad (servant) look to the yad (hand) of their adawan (master / lord), as the iyan (eye) of a shapachah (maid) to the yad (hand) of her gabarath (mistress); so our iyan (eye) look to Yahawah, our Alahayam, until he has chanan (mercy) on us.
Have chanan (mercy) on us, Yahawah, have chanan (mercy) on us, for we rab (have) endured much bawaz (contempt).
Our napash (living being/soul) is rab (exceedingly) shabai (filled) with the scoffing of those who are at shaanan (ease), with the bawaz (contempt) of the gaayawan (proud).
If it had not been Yahawah who was on our side, let Yasharaal (Israel) now amar (spoke),
If it had not been Yahawah who was on our side, when adam (men) qawam (rise up) up against us;
Then they would have balai (swallowed) us up chay (life), when their ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) was charah (hot with anger) against us;
Then the mayam (Waters) would have shatap (overwhelmed) us, the nachal (stream / river) would ibar (pass over/through) gone over our napash (living being/soul);
Then the zayadawan (proud) mayam (Waters) would ibar (pass over/through) gone over our napash (living being/soul).
Barak (blessed) be Yahawah, who nathan (give) not given us as a tarap (prey) to their shan (teeth).
Our napash (living being/soul) has malat (escaped) like a tzapawar (bird) out of the yaqash (fowler's) pach (snare). The pach (snare) is shabar (broken), and we have malat (escaped).
Our izar (help) is in the sham (name) of Yahawah, who ishah (make) shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) and aratz (Earth/land).
Those who batach (trust) in Yahawah are as har (mountain) Tzayawan (Zion), which can't be mawat (moved), but yashab (inhabit/dwell) iwalam (forever).
As the har (mountain) surround Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), so Yahawah surrounds his im (people / nation) from this time forth and forevermore.
For the scepter of rashai (wickedness) won't nawach (remain) over the allotment of the tzadayaq (righteous); so that the tzadayaq (righteous) won't use their yad (hand) to do iwal (evil).
Do tawab (pleasant/functional), Yahawah, to those who are tawab (pleasant/functional), to those who are yashar (upright) in their labah (hearts).

But as for those who natah (turn) aside to their crooked iqalaqal (ways), Yahawah will yalak (lead) them away with the pail (workers) of awan (iniquity). Shalawam (peace / safety) be on Yasharaal (Israel).
When Yahawah shawab (turn back / repent) back those who shawab (turn back / repent) to Tzayawan (Zion), we were like those who dream.

Then our pah (mouth) was malaa (filled) with shachawaq (laughter/joking matter), and our lashawan (tongue/language) with ranah (singing). Then they amar (spoke) among the gaway (nation / people), Yahawah ishah (make) done gadal (great) things for them.
Yahawah ishah (make) done gadal (great) things for us, and we are shamach (glad).
Shabawath (restore) our fortunes again, Yahawah, like the apayaq (streams) in the Negev.
Those who zarai (sow) in damaih (tears) will qatzar (reap) in ranah (joy).
He who yalak (goes) out bakah (weeping), nashaa (lift) zarai (seed) for sowing, will bawaa (come) bawaa (come) again with ranah (joy), nashaa (lift) his sheaves.

Unless Yahawah banah (builds) the bayath (house), they imal (labor) in shawaa (vanity) who banah (build) it. Unless Yahawah watches over the iyar (city), the shamar (keep/guard) guards it in shawaa (vanity).
It is shawaa (vanity) for you to qawam (rise up) up shakam (early), to stay up achar (other), akal (eat) the lacham (bread) of toil; for he nathan (give) shanah (sleep) to his loved yadayad (ones).
Behold, ban (son) are a nachalah (heritage) of Yahawah. The paray (fruit) of the batan (womb) is his shakar (reward).
As chatz (arrows) in the yad (hand) of a gabawar (mighty) man, so are the ban (son) of naiwar (youth).
Ashar (who/that) is the gabar (man) who has his ashapah (quiver) malaa (full) of them. They won't be disappointed when they dabar (word / matter) with their ayab (enemy) in the shair (gate).
Ashar (who/that) is everyone who yaraa (fears) Yahawah, who halak (move) in his darak (ways).
For you will akal (eat) the yagayai (labor) of your kap (hands). You will be ashar (who/that), and it will be tawab (pleasant/functional) with you.

Your ashah (wife/individual woman) will be as a parah (fruitful) gapan (vine), in the innermost yarakah (parts) of your bayath (house); your ban (son) like zayath (olive) shathal (plants), around your shalachan (table).
Behold, thus is the gabar (man) barak (blessed) who yaraa (fears) Yahawah.
May Yahawah barak (bless) you out of Tzayawan (Zion), and may you raah (see) the tawab (pleasant/functional) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) all the yawam (day) of your chay (life).
Yes, may you raah (see) your ban (son) ban (son). Shalawam (peace / safety) be upon Yasharaal (Israel).
Many rab (times) they have tzarar (afflicted) me from my naiwar (youth) up. Let Yasharaal (Israel) now amar (spoke),
Many rab (times) they have tzarar (afflicted) me from my naiwar (youth) up, yet they yakal (have) not prevailed against me.
The plowers charash (plowed) on my gab (back). They made their mainah (furrows) arak (long).
Yahawah is tzadayaq (righteous). He has qatzatz (cut) apart the ibath (cords) of the rashai (wicked).
Let them be disappointed and sawag (turned) backward, all those who shanaa (hate) Tzayawan (Zion).
Let them be as the chatzayar (grass) on the housetops, which yabash (dry land) before it shalap (grows) up;
With which the qatzar (reaper) doesn't malaa (fill) his kap (hand), nor he who imar (binds) sheaves, his chatzan (bosom).
Neither ibar (pass over/through) those who go by amar (spoke), The barakah (blessing) of Yahawah be on you. We barak (bless) you in the sham (name) of Yahawah.
Out of the maimaq (depths) I have qaraa (called) to you, Yahawah.
Adanay, shamai (hearken / hear) my qawal (sound / voice). Let your azan (ears) be qashab (attentive) to the qawal (sound / voice) of my petitions.
If you, Yah, shamar (keep/guard) a record of iwan (guilt/iniquity), Adanay, who could imad (stand)?
But there is salayachah (forgiveness) with you, therefore you are yaraa (fear / be afraid).
I qawah (gather/wait) for Yahawah. My napash (living being/soul) qawah (gather/wait). I yachal (hope) in his dabar (word / matter).
My napash (living being/soul) longs for the Adanay more than watchmen long for the baqar (morning); more than watchmen for the baqar (morning).
Yasharaal (Israel), yachal (hope) in Yahawah, for with Yahawah there is loving chasad (grace). With him is abundant padawath (redemption).
He will padah (redeem) Yasharaal (Israel) from all their iwan (guilt/iniquity).

Yahawah, my lab (heart) isn't gabah (haughty), nor my iyan (eye) rawam (will lift up); nor do I concern myself with gadawal (very great/important/mighty) matters, or things palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) wonderful for me.
Surely I have stilled and damam (quieted) my napash (living being/soul), like a weaned child with his am (mother), like a weaned child is my napash (living being/soul) within me.
Yasharaal (Israel), yachal (hope) in Yahawah, from this time forth and forevermore.
Yahawah, zakar (remembrance/memory) Dawad (David) and all his affliction,
How he shabai (swear / take oath) to Yahawah, and nadar (make vow) to the abayar (mighty) One of Yaiqab (Jacob):
Bawaa (come) I will not come into the structure of my bayath (house), nor ilah (go up / offer) up into my irash (bed);
I will not nathan (give) sleep to my iyan (eye), or thanawamah (slumber) to my ipaip (eyelids);
Until I matzaa (find) out a maqawam (place) for Yahawah, a mashakan (dwelling) for the abayar (mighty) One of Yaiqab (Jacob).
Behold, we shamai (hearken / hear) of it in Ephrathah. We matzaa (found) it in the shadah (field) of Jaar:
We will bawaa (come) into his mashakan (dwelling) place. We will shachah (worship) at his hadam (footstool).
Qawam (rise up), Yahawah, into your manawachah (resting) place; you, and the arawan (ark) of your iz (strength / might / refuge).
Let your kahan (priest) be labash (clothed) with tzadaq (righteous / just / fair). Let your chasayad (saints) ranan (shout) for joy!
For your ibad (servant) Dawad (David's) sake, don't shawab (turn back / repent) away the panayam (face) of your mashayach (anointed one) one.

Yahawah has shabai (swear / take oath) to Dawad (David) in amath (truth). He will not shawab (turn back / repent) from it: I will shayath (put / appoint / make) the paray (fruit) of your batan (body) on your kasaa (throne).

If your ban (son) will shamar (keep/guard) my barayath (covenant), my idah (testimony) that I will lamad (teach/instruct) them, their ban (son) also will yashab (inhabit/dwell) on your kasaa (throne) forevermore.
For Yahawah has bachar (chosen) Tzayawan (Zion). He has awah (desired) it for his habitation.
This is my manawachah (resting) place id (forever). Here I will live, for I have awah (desired) it.
I will barak (abundantly) barak (bless) her provision. I will shabai (satisfy) her abayawan (poor) with lacham (bread).
Her kahan (priest) I will also labash (clothe) with yashai (salvation). Her chasayad (saints) will ranan (shout) aloud for joy.
There I will tzamach (make) the qaran (horn) of Dawad (David) to tzamach (bud). I have irak (ordained) a nayar (lamp) for my mashayach (anointed one).
I will labash (clothe) his ayab (enemy) with bashath (shame), but on himself, his nazar (crown / consecrate) will be resplendent.
See how tawab (pleasant/functional) and how naiyam (pleasant) it is for ach (brother/kinsman) to live yachad (together) in unity!

It is like the tawab (pleasant/functional) shaman (oil) on the raash (head), that yarad (ran) down on the zaqan (beard), even Aharawan (Aaron's) zaqan (beard); that yarad (came) down on the pah (edge) of his robes;
Like the tal (dew) of Charamawan (Hermon), that yarad (comes) down on the harar (hills) of Tzayawan (Zion): for there Yahawah tzawah (gives) the barakah (blessing), even chay (life) forevermore.
Look! Barak (praise) Yahawah, all you ibad (servant) of Yahawah, who imad (stand) by layal (night) in yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) bayath (house)!
Nashaa (lift) up your yad (hand) in the qadash (set apart/make holy). Barak (praise) Yahawah!
May Yahawah barak (bless) you from Tzayawan (Zion); even he who ishah (make) shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) and aratz (Earth/land).
Halal (praise) Yah! Halal (praise) the sham (name) of Yahawah! Halal (praise) him, you ibad (servant) of Yahawah,
You who imad (stand) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, in the chatzar (courts) of our alahayam (Alahayam) bayath (house).
Halal (praise) Yah, for Yahawah is tawab (pleasant/functional). Sing zamar (praises) to his sham (name), for that is naiyam (pleasant).
For Yah has bachar (chosen) Yaiqab (Jacob) for himself; Yasharaal (Israel) for his own sagalah (possession).
For I yadai (know) that Yahawah is gadawal (very great/important/mighty), that our Adawan is above all Alahayam.
Whatever Yahawah chapatz (pleased), that he ishah (make) done, in shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) and in aratz (Earth/land), in the yam (sea/waters) and in all thahawam (depths);

Who causes the nashayaa (clouds) to ilah (go up / offer) from the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the aratz (Earth/land); who ishah (make) baraq (lightnings) with the matar (rain); who yatzaa (go out / come out) forth the rawach (spirit / wind) out of his awatzar (treasuries);
Who nakah (struck) the bakawar (firstborn) of Matzarayam (Egypt), both of adam (man) and animal;
Who shalach (send) awath (sign / mark / miracle) and mawapath (wonders) into the thawak (midst) of you, Matzarayam (Egypt), on Paraih (Pharaoh), and on all his ibad (servant);
Who nakah (struck) many gaway (nation / people), and nakah (killed) rab (mighty) malak (king),
Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of the Amaray (Amorites), Iwag (Og) malak (king) of Bashan (Bashan), and all the mamalakah (kingdoms) of Kanain (Canaan),
And nathan (give) their aratz (Earth/land) for a nachalah (heritage), a nachalah (heritage) to Yasharaal (Israel), his im (people / nation).
Your sham (name), Yahawah, endures iwalam (forever); your renown, Yahawah, throughout all dawar (generation / age / period).
For Yahawah will dayan (judge) his im (people / nation), and have compassion on his ibad (servant).
The itzab (idols) of the gaway (nation / people) are kasap (silver) and zahab (gold), the maishah (work) of adam (men's) yad (hand).
They have pah (mouths), but they can't dabar (word / matter). They have iyan (eye), but they can't raah (see).
They have azan (ears), but they can't azan (hear); neither is there any rawach (spirit / wind) in their pah (mouths).
Those who ishah (make) them will be like them; yes, everyone who batach (trusts) in them.
Bayath (house) of Yasharaal (Israel), barak (praise) Yahawah! Bayath (house) of Aharawan (Aaron), barak (praise) Yahawah!
Bayath (house) of Laway (Levi), barak (praise) Yahawah! You who yaraa (fear) Yahawah, barak (praise) Yahawah!
Barak (blessed) be Yahawah from Tzayawan (Zion), Who shakan (dwells) at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). Halal (praise) Yah!
Give yadah (thanks) to Yahawah, for he is tawab (pleasant/functional); for his loving tawab (pleasant/functional) endures iwalam (forever).
Give yadah (thanks) to the Alahayam of Alahayam; for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever).
