Haway (Alas/Woe!) To those who mashak (draw) iwan (guilt/iniquity) with chabal (cords) of falsehood, and chataah (sin) as with igalah (cart) ibath (rope);

Who amar (spoke), Let him mahar (make) speed, let him chawash (hasten) his maishah (work), that we may raah (see) it; and let the itzah (counsel) of the qadawash (holy) One of Yasharaal (Israel) qarab (come close) near and bawaa (come), that we may yadai (know) it!

Haway (Alas/Woe!) To those who amar (spoke) rai (evil) tawab (pleasant/functional), and tawab (pleasant/functional) rai (evil); who shawam (place / establish / appoint) chashak (darkness) for awar (light), and awar (light) for chashak (darkness); who shawam (place / establish / appoint) mar (bitter) for mathawaq (sweet), and mathawaq (sweet) for mar (bitter)!
Haway (Alas/Woe!) To those who are chakam (wise) in their own iyan (eye), and bayan (between) in their own panayam (sight)!
Haway (Alas/Woe!) To those who are gabawar (mighty) to shathah (drinks) yayan (wine), and champions at mixing shakar (strong) drink;
Who acquit the rashai (guilty) for a shachad (bribe), but deny tzadaqah (righteousness) for the innocent!

Therefore as the tongue of ash (fire) akal (eat) the qash (stubble), and as the dry grass sinks down in the lashawan (tongue/language), so their sharash (root) shall be as maq (rottenness), and their parach (blossom) shall ilah (go up / offer) up as abaq (dust); because they have maas (rejected) the thawarah (instruction) of Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), and naatz (despised) the amarah (sayings) of the qadawash (holy) One of Yasharaal (Israel).

Therefore yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) charah (hot with anger) against his im (people / nation), and he has natah (stretched) out his yad (hand) against them, and has nakah (struck) them. The har (mountain) ragaz (tremble), and their nabalah (dead) bodies are as refuse in the qarab (among / near) of the chawatz (streets). For all this, his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) is not shawab (turn back / repent) away, but his yad (hand) is still natah (stretched) out.

He will nashaa (lift) up a nas (banner) to the gaway (nation / people) from rachawaq (far), and he will whistle for them from the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the aratz (Earth/land). Behold, they will bawaa (come) maharah (speedily) and qal (swiftly).

None shall be iyap (weary) nor kashal (stumble / stagger) among them; none shall nawam (slumber) nor sleep; neither shall the belt of their waist be untied, nor the sharawak (latchet) of their nail (shoes) be nathaq (broken):

Whose chatz (arrows) are shanan (sharp), and all their qashath (bows) bent. Their sawas (horses)' parasah (hoofs) will be chashab (like) tzar (oppressor / distressor), and their galagal (wheels) like a sawapah (whirlwind).

Their shaagah (roaring) will be like a labayaa (lioness). They will shaag (roar) like young kapayar (lions). Yes, they shall naham (roar), and seize their tarap (prey) and palat (carry) it off, and there will be no one to natzal (deliver).

They will naham (roar) against them in that yawam (day) like the nahamah (roaring) of the yam (sea/waters). If one nabat (looks) to the aratz (Earth/land) behold, chashak (darkness) and tzar (oppressor / distressor). The awar (light) is chashak (darkness) in its clouds.

In the shanah (year) that malak (king) Izayah (Uzziah) mawath (death), I raah (see) the Adanay sitting on a kasaa (throne), rawam (will lift up) and nashaa (lift) up; and his shawal (train) malaa (filled) the hayakal (temple).

Mail (top/above) him imad (stood) the seraphim. Achad (one) one had shash (six) kanap (wings). With shanayam (two) he kasah (covered) his panayam (face). With shanayam (two) he kasah (covered) his ragal (feet / foot). With shanayam (two) he iwap (flying).
One qaraa (called) to another, and amar (spoke), qadawash (holy), qadawash (holy), qadawash (holy), is Yahawah of tzabaa (troop)! The whole aratz (Earth/land) is malaa (full) of his kabawad (glory)!
The foundations of the sap (thresholds) nawai (shook) at the qawal (sound / voice) of him who qaraa (called), and the bayath (house) was malaa (filled) with ishan (smoke).

Then I amar (spoke), away (woe) is me! For I am damah (undone), because I am a ayash (husband/individual man) of tamaa (unclean) shapah (lips), and I yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the thawak (midst) of a im (people / nation) of tamaa (unclean) shapah (lips): for my iyan (eye) raah (see) seen the malak (king), Yahawah of tzabaa (troop)!
Then achad (one) of the seraphim iwap (flying) to me, having a ratzapah (live) coal in his yad (hand), which he had laqach (take / seized) with the malaqach (tongs) from off the mazabach (altar).

He nagai (touched) my pah (mouth) with it, and amar (spoke), Behold, this has nagai (touched) your shapah (lips); and your iwan (guilt/iniquity) is sawar (taken) away, and your chataah (sin) kapar (forgiven).
I shamai (hearken / hear) the adanay (master) qawal (sound / voice), amar (spoke), "Whom shall I shalach (send), and who will yalak (go) for us?" Then I amar (spoke), Here I am. Shalach (send) me!

He amar (spoke), yalak (go), and amar (spoke) this im (people / nation), ‘You shamai (hearken / hear) shamai (hearken / hear), but don't bayan (between); and you raah (see) raah (see), but don't yadai (perceive).’

Make the lab (heart) of this im (people / nation) shaman (fat). Make their azan (ears) kabad (heavy), and shaii (shut) their iyan (eye); lest they raah (see) with their iyan (eye), and shamai (hearken / hear) with their azan (ears), and bayan (between) with their labab (heart), and shawab (turn back / repent) again, and be rapaa (healed).

Then I amar (spoke), "Adanay, how long?" He amar (spoke), Until iyar (cities) are shaah (waste) without yashab (inhabit/dwell), and bayath (house) without adam (man), and the adamah (land) becomes utterly shaah (waste),
And Yahawah has rachaq (removed) adam (men) rachaq (far) away, and the forsaken places are many in the qarab (among / near) of the aratz (Earth/land).

If there is a ishayaray (tenth) left in it, that also will in shawab (turn back / repent) be consumed: as a terebinth, and as an alawan (oak), whose stock remains when they are felled; so the qadash (set apart/make holy) zarai (seed) is its stock.

It happened in the yawam (day) of Achaz (Ahaz) the ban (son) of Yawatham (Jotham), the ban (son) of Izayah (Uzziah), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), that Ratzayan (Rezin) the malak (king) of Aram (Syria), and Paqach (Pekah) the ban (son) of Ramalayahaw (Remaliah), malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel), ilah (go up / offer) up to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to malachamah (war) against it, but yakal (could) not lacham (prevail) against it.

It was nagad (told) the bayath (house) of Dawad (David), amar (spoke), "Aram (Syria) is allied with Aparayam (Ephraim)." His labab (heart) trembled, and the labab (heart) of his im (people / nation), as the itz (trees) of the yair (forest) tremble with the rawach (spirit / wind).

Then Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yashaiyah (Isaiah), yatzaa (go out / come out) out now to qaraah (meet) Achaz (Ahaz), you, and Shaarayashawab (Shearjashub) your ban (son), at the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the thailah (conduit) of the ilayawan (upper) barakah (pool), on the masalah (highway) of the kabas (fuller's) shadah (field).

Amar (spoke) him, ‘Be careful, and keep calm. Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid), neither let your heart be rakak (faint) because of these shanayam (two) zanab (tails) of ishan (smoking) torches, for the charay (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Ratzayan (Rezin) and Aram (Syria), and of the ban (son) of Ramalayahaw (Remaliah).
Because Aram (Syria), Aparayam (Ephraim), and the ban (son) of Ramalayahaw (Remaliah), have plotted rai (evil) amar (spoke) you, saying,

Let's ilah (go up / offer) up against Yahawadah (Judah), and tear it apart, and let's baqai (divide) it among ourselves, and malak (king) up a malak (king) in its thawak (midst), even the ban (son) of Tabaal (Tabeel).
Kah (this) is what the Adanay Yahawah amar (spoke): It shall not qawam (rise up), neither shall it happen.

For the raash (head) of Aram (Syria) is Damashaq (Damascus), and the raash (head) of Damashaq (Damascus) is Ratzayan (Rezin); and within shashayam (sixty) - chamash (five) shanah (years) Aparayam (Ephraim) shall be broken in pieces, so that it shall not be a im (people / nation);

And the raash (head) of Aparayam (Ephraim) is Shamarawan (Samaria), and the raash (head) of Shamarawan (Samaria) is Ramalayahaw (Remaliah's) ban (son). If you will not aman (believe / have faith), aman (believe / have faith) you shall not be established.’
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) again to Achaz (Ahaz), amar (spoke),
Shaal (ask) a awath (sign / mark / miracle) of Yahawah your Alahayam; shaal (ask) it either in the imaq (depth), or in the gabah (height) mail (top/above).
But Achaz (Ahaz) amar (spoke), I will not shaal (ask), neither will I nasah (tempt) Yahawah.

He amar (spoke), shamai (hearken / hear) now, bayath (house) of Dawad (David). Is it not enough for you to try the patience of ayash (husband/individual man), that you will try the patience of my Alahayam also?

Therefore the Adanay himself will nathan (give) you a awath (sign / mark / miracle). Behold, the ilamah (virgin) will harah (conceive), and yalad (birth / begot) a ban (son), and shall qaraa (called) his sham (name) Imanawaal (Immanuel).
He shall akal (eat) chamaah (butter) and dabash (honey) when he yadai (knows) to maas (refuse) the rai (evil), and bachar (choose) the tawab (pleasant/functional).

For before the nair (child) yadai (knows) to maas (refuse) the rai (evil), and bachar (choose) the tawab (pleasant/functional), the adamah (land) whose shanayam (two) malak (king) you qawatz (abhor) shall be forsaken.

Yahawah will bawaa (come) on you, on your im (people / nation), and on your ab (father) bayath (house), yawam (day) that bawaa (come) not come, from the yawam (day) that Aparayam (Ephraim) sawar (departed) from Yahawadah (Judah); even the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria).

It will happen in that yawam (day) that Yahawah will whistle for the zabawab (fly) that is in the uttermost part of the yaar (rivers) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and for the dabawarah (bee) that is in the aratz (Earth/land) of Ashawar (Assyria).
They shall bawaa (come), and shall all nawach (rest) in the bathah (desolate) nachal (stream / river), in the clefts of the salai (rocks), on all naitzawatz (thorn) hedges, and on all pastures.

In that yawam (day) the Adanay will galach (shave) with a thair (razor) that is shakayarah (hired) in the parts ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), even with the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), the raash (head) and the shair (hair) of the ragal (feet / foot); and it shall also sapah (consume) the zaqan (beard).
It shall happen in that yawam (day) that a ayash (husband/individual man) shall chayah (keep) alive a young igalah (cow), and shanayam (two) tzaan (sheep);

And it shall happen, that because of the rab (abundance) of chalab (milk) which they shall give he shall akal (eat) chamaah (butter): for everyone will akal (eat) chamaah (butter) and dabash (honey) that is yathar (left) in the midst of the aratz (Earth/land).

It will happen in that yawam (day) that every maqawam (place) where there were a alap (thousand) gapan (vines) at a alap (thousand) kasap (silver) shekels, shall be for shamayar (briers) and shayath (thorns).
People will bawaa (come) there with chatzay (arrows) and with qashath (bow), because all the aratz (Earth/land) will be shamayar (briers) and shayath (thorns).

All the har (mountain) that were cultivated with the hoe, you shall not bawaa (come) there for yaraah (fear) of shamayar (briers) and shayath (thorns); but it shall be for the mashalawach (sending) forth of oxen, and for the maramas (treading) of shah (sheep).
Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, laqach (take / seized) a large tablet, and kathab (write) on it with a anawash (man's) charat (pen), ‘For Maharashalalachashabaz (Maher) Shalal Hash Baz;’

And I will iwad (admonish/bear witness against) for myself aman (believe / have faith) witnesses to iwad (admonish/bear witness against): Awarayah (Uriah) the kahan (priest), and Zakarayah (Zechariah) the ban (son) of Yabarakayahaw (Jeberechiah).

I qarab (come close) to the nabayaah (prophetess), and she harah (conceived), and yalad (birth / begot) a ban (son). Then Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, qaraa (called) his sham (name) ‘Maharashalalachashabaz (Maher) Shalal Hash Baz.’

For before the nair (child) yadai (knows) how to qaraa (called), ‘My ab (father),’ and, ‘My am (mother),’ the riches of Damashaq (Damascus) and the shalal (spoil) of Shamarawan (Samaria) will be nashaa (lift) away by the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to me yet again, amar (spoke),

Yain (because) this im (people / nation) have maas (refused) the mayam (Waters) of shalach (shiloah) that halak (move) at (softly), and mashawash (rejoice) in Ratzayan (Rezin) and Ramalayahaw (Remaliah's) ban (son);

Now therefore, behold, the Adanay ilah (go up / offer) upon them the itzawam (mighty) flood mayam (Waters) of the nahar (river): the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) and all his kabawad (glory). It will ilah (go up / offer) up over all its apayaq (channels), and halak (move) over all its gadah (banks).

It will sweep onward into Yahawadah (Judah). It will shatap (overflow) and ibar (pass over/through) through; it will nagai (reach) even to the tzawaar (neck); and the matah (stretching) out of its kanap (wings) will malaa (fill) the rachab (breadth) of your aratz (Earth/land), Imanawaal (Immanuel).

Make an uproar, you im (people / nation), and be broken in pieces! Listen, kal (every) you from marachaq (far) aratz (Earth/land): dress for battle, and be shattered! Dress for battle, and be shattered!
Iwatz (take) itzah (counsel) iwatz (together), and it will be parar (brought) to nothing; dabar (word / matter) the dabar (word / matter), and it will not qawam (rise up): for Al is with us.
For Yahawah amar (spoke) thus to me with a chazaqah (strong) yad (hand), and yasar (instructed) me not to yalak (walk) in the darak (way) of this im (people / nation), amar (spoke),

Don't amar (spoke), ‘A qashar (conspiracy)!’ Concerning all about which this im (people / nation) amar (spoke), ‘A qashar (conspiracy)!’ Neither yaraa (fear / be afraid) their threats, nor be terrorized.
Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must mawaraa (fear). He is the one you must iratz (dread).
He will be a maqadash (sanctuary), but for shanayam (two) bayath (house) of Yasharaal (Israel), he will be a trap and a mawaqash (snare) for the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
Many will kashal (stumble / stagger) over it, napal (fall / be cast down), be shabar (broken), be yaqash (snared), and be captured.
Wrap up the thaiwadah (testimony). Chatham (seal) the thawarah (instruction) among my lamawad (disciples).
I will chakah (wait) for Yahawah, who sathar (hides) his panayam (face) from the bayath (house) of Yaiqab (Jacob), and I will qawah (gather/wait) for him.

Behold, I and the yalad (birth / begot) whom Yahawah nathan (give) given me are for awath (sign / mark / miracle) and for mawapath (wonders) in Yasharaal (Israel) from Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), who shakan (dwells) in har (mountain) Tzayawan (Zion).

When they amar (spoke) you, "Consult with those who have familiar awab (spirits) and with the yadainay (wizards), who chirp and who hagah (mutter):" shouldn't a im (people / nation) consult with their Alahayam? Should they consult the mawath (death) on behalf of the chay (life)?
Turn to the thawarah (instruction) and to the thaiwadah (testimony)! If they don't amar (spoke) according to this dabar (word / matter), surely there is no shachar (morning) for them.

They will ibar (pass over/through) through it, very distressed and raib (hungry); and it will happen that when they are raib (hungry), they will worry, and qalal (curse) by their malak (king) and by their Alahayam. They will panah (turn) their mail (top/above) upward,
And nabat (look) to the aratz (Earth/land), and see tzarah (distress), chashakah (darkness), and the gloom of tzawaq (anguish). They will be nadach (driven) into thick apalah (darkness).

But there shall be no more gloom for her who was in anguish. In the former time, he brought into contempt the aratz (Earth/land) of Zebulun and the aratz (Earth/land) of Naphtali; but in the latter time he raah (see) made it glorious, by the aratz (Earth/land) of the sea, il (over) the Jordan, Galilee of the im (people / nation).
The gaway (nation / people) who walked in darkness rabah (have) seen a rabah (great) light. Those who lived in the land of the shadow of death, on them the light has shined.
You have multiplied the nation. You have increased their joy. They rejoice before you according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the spoil.
For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as in the hayah (came to pass) of Midian.
For all the armor of the armed yalad (birth / begot) in the noisy battle, and the garments rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for the fire.

For to us a child is ishah (make). To us a son is given; and the masharah (government) will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful, Counselor, Mighty Al, Everlasting Father, Prince of shalawam (peace / safety).

Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on the throne of David, and on his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from that time on, even forever. The zeal of Yahawah of Armies will perform this.
The Adanay sent a word into Jacob, and it falls on Israel.
All the people will know, including Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria, who say in pride and in arrogance of heart,
The bricks il (over) fallen, but we will build with cut stone. The sycamore fig trees have been cut down, but we will put cedars in their place.
Therefore Yahawah will shawab (turn back / repent) up on high against him the adversaries of Rezin, and will stir up his enemies,
The Syrians in front, and the Philistines behind; and they will devour Israel with open mouth. For all this, his anger is not shawab (turn back / repent) away, but his hand is stretched out still.
Yet the people have not turned to him who struck them, neither have they sought Yahawah of Armies.
Therefore Yahawah will cut off from Israel raash (head) and zanab (tail), palm branch and reed, in one day.
The elder and the honorable zah (this/that/these) is the head, and the prophet who teaches lies is the tail.
For those who lead this people lead them astray; and those who are led by them are dabar (word / matter).

Therefore the Adanay will not rejoice over their young men, neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and widows; for everyone is profane and an evildoer, and every mouth speaks folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
For wickedness burns like a ash (fire). It devours the briers and thorns; yes, it kindles in the thickets of the forest, and they roll upward in a column of smoke.
Through the wrath of Yahawah of Armies, the land is burnt up; and the ayash (husband/individual man) are the fuel for the fire. No ayash (husband/individual man) spares his brother.
One will devour on the right yad (hand), and be hungry; and he will eat on the left yad (hand), and they will not be satisfied. Everyone will eat the flesh of his own arm:

Manashah (Manasseh), Aparayam (Ephraim); and Aparayam (Ephraim), Manashah (Manasseh); and they yachad (together) shall be against Yahawadah (Judah). For all this his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) is not shawab (turn back / repent) away, but his yad (hand) is natah (stretched) out still.
Haway (Alas/Woe!) To those who chaqaq (decree) awan (unrighteous) chaqaq (decrees), and to the writers who kathab (write) oppressive decrees;

To deprive the dal (needy) from dayan (judge), and to gazal (rob) the inay (poor) among my im (people / nation) of their mashapat (rights), that alamanah (widows) may be their shalal (spoil), and that they may make the yathawam (fatherless) their bazaz (prey)!

What will you ishah (make) in the yawam (day) of paqadah (visitation), and in the shawaa (vanity) which will bawaa (come) from afar? To whom will you nawas (flee) for izarah (help)? Where will you izab (leave) your wealth?

They will only karai (bow) down under the asayar (prisoners), and will napal (fall / be cast down) under the harag (slain). For all this his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) is not shawab (turn back / repent) away, but his yad (hand) is natah (stretched) out still.
Alas Ashawar (Assyrian), the shabat (rod) of my ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), the matah (staff / rod / tribe) in whose yad (hand) is my zaim (indignation)!

I will shalach (send) him against a profane gaway (nation / people), and against the im (people / nation) who ibarah (anger) me will I give him a tzawah (command) to take the shalal (spoil) and to bazaz (take) the baz (prey), and to shawam (place / establish / appoint) them down like the chamar (mire) of the chawatz (streets).

However he doesn't damah (mean) so, neither does his labab (heart) chashab (think) so; but it is in his labab (heart) to shamad (destroy), and to karath (cut) off not a mait (few) gaway (nation / people).
For he amar (spoke), Aren't yachad (all) of my shar (prince / ruler) malak (king)?
Isn't Kalanah (Calno) like Karakamayash (Carchemish)? Isn't Chamath (Hamath) like Arapad (Arpad)? Isn't Shamarawan (Samaria) like Damashaq (Damascus)?
As my yad (hand) matzaa (has) found the mamalakah (kingdoms) of the alayal (idols), whose engraved pasayal (images) exceeded those of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) and of Shamarawan (Samaria);
Shall I not, as I ishah (make) done to Shamarawan (Samaria) and her alayal (idols), so ishah (make) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) and her itzab (idols)?

Therefore it will happen that, when the Adanay has batzai (performed) his whole maishah (work) on har (mountain) Tzayawan (Zion) and on Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), I will paqad (visit) the paray (fruit) of the willful proud labab (heart) of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), and the insolence of his haughty iyan (eye).

For he has amar (spoke), By the kach (strength / mighty / power) of my yad (hand) I ishah (make) done it, and by my chakamah (wisdom); for I have chakamah (understanding): and I have sawar (removed) the boundaries of the im (people / nation), and have shasah (robbed) their treasures. Like a abayar (valiant) man I have yarad (brought) down their yashab (inhabit/dwell).

My yad (hand) matzaa (has) found the riches of the im (people / nation) like a qan (nest), and like one asap (gathers) bayatzah (eggs) that are abandoned, have I asap (gathered) all the aratz (Earth/land). There was no one who nadad (moved) their kanap (wing), or that patzah (opened) their pah (mouth), or chirped.

Should an axe brag against him who chops with it? Should a mashawar (saw) exalt itself above him who saws with it? As if a shabat (rod) should nawap (lift) those who rawam (will lift up) it up, or as if a matah (staff / rod / tribe) should rawam (will lift up) up someone who is not itz (wood).

Therefore the Adawan, Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), will shalach (send) among his mashaman (fat) ones razawan (leanness); and under his kabawad (glory) a yaqawad (burning) will be yaqad (kindled) like the burning of ash (fire).

The awar (light) of Yasharaal (Israel) will be for a ash (fire), and his qadawash (holy) One for a lahabah (flame); and it will bair (burn) and akal (eat) his shayath (thorns) and his shamayar (briers) in achad (one) yawam (day).

He will kalah (complete / finish) the kabawad (glory) of his yair (forest), and of his karamal (fruitful) field, both napash (living being/soul) and bashar (flesh). It will be as when a standard bearer masas (faints).
The shaar (remnant) of the itz (trees) of his yair (forest) shall be masapar (few), so that a nair (child) could kathab (write) their number.

It will come to pass in that yawam (day) that the shaar (remnant) of Yasharaal (Israel), and those who have palayatah (escaped) from the bayath (house) of Yaiqab (Jacob) will no more again shain (lean) on him who nakah (struck) them, but shall shain (lean) on Yahawah, the qadawash (holy) One of Yasharaal (Israel), in amath (truth).
A shaar (remnant) will shawab (turn back / repent), even the shaar (remnant) of Yaiqab (Jacob), to the gabawar (mighty) Al.

For though your im (people / nation), Yasharaal (Israel), are like the chawal (sand) of the yam (sea/waters), only a shaar (remnant) of them will shawab (turn back / repent). A destruction is charatz (determined), shatap (overflowing) with tzadaqah (righteousness).
For the Adanay, Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), will ishah (make) a kalah (complete / finish) end, and that charatz (determined), in the qarab (among / near) of all the aratz (Earth/land).

Therefore the Adanay, Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), amar (spoke) My im (people / nation) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in Tzayawan (Zion), don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid) of the Ashawar (Assyrian), though he nakah (strike) you with the shabat (rod), and nashaa (lift) up his matah (staff / rod / tribe) against you, as Matzarayam (Egypt) did.

For yet a very mait (little) while, and the zaim (indignation) against you will be kalah (complete / finish), and my ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) will be directed to his thabalayath (destruction).

Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) will iwar (rouse / awaken) up a shawat (scourge) against him, as in the makah (slaughter) of Madayan (Midian) at the tzawar (rock) of Irab (Oreb). His matah (staff / rod / tribe) will be over the yam (sea/waters), and he will nashaa (lift) it up like he did against Matzarayam (Egypt).

It will happen in that yawam (day), that his sabal (burden) will sawar (depart) from off your shakam (shoulder), and his il (over) from off your tzawaar (neck), and the il (over) shall be chabal (destroyed) panayam (because) of the anointing shaman (oil).
He bawaa (come) come Iy (to) Aiath. He ibar (pass over/through) passed through Magarawan (Migron). At Makamas (Michmash) he stores his baggage.

They ibar (pass over/through) gone over the maibar (pass). They have taken up their malawan (lodging) at Gabai (Geba). Ramah (Ramah) charad (trembles). Gabaih (Gibeah) of Shaawal (Saul) has nawas (fled).
Qawal (sound / voice) tzahal (aloud) with your qawal (sound / voice), bath (daughter) of Galayam (Gallim)! Listen, Laishah! You inay (poor) Inathawath (Anathoth)!
Madamanah (Madmenah) is a fugitive. The yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Gabayam (Gebim) iwaz (flee) for safety.
This very yawam (day) he will halt at Nab (Nob). He nawap (shakes) his yad (hand) at the har (mountain) of the bath (daughter) of Zion, the gabaih (hill) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
Behold, the Adawan, Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), will lop the paarah (boughs) with mairatzah (terror). The qawamah (tall) will be gadai (cut) down, and the gabah (lofty) will be brought low.
He will naqap (cut) down the sabak (thickets) of the yair (forest) with barazal (iron), and Labanawan (Lebanon) will napal (fall / be cast down) by the adayar (mighty) One.
A shoot will yatzaa (go out / come out) out of the gazai (stock) of Yashay (Jesse), and a natzar (branch) out of his sharash (roots) will parah (bear) fruit.

The rawach (spirit / wind) of Yahawah will nawach (rest) on him: the rawach (spirit / wind) of chakamah (wisdom) and chakamah (understanding), the rawach (spirit / wind) of itzah (counsel) and gabawarah (might), the rawach (spirit / wind) of daith (knowledge) and of the yaraah (fear) of Yahawah.
His delight will be in the yaraah (fear) of Yahawah. He will not shapat (judge) by the maraah (sight) of his maraah (eyes), neither decide by the mashamai (hearing) of his azan (ears);

But with tzadaq (righteous / just / fair) he will shapat (judge) the dal (poor), and decide with mayashawar (equity) for the inaw (humble) of the aratz (Earth/land). He will nakah (strike) the aratz (Earth/land) with the shabat (rod) of his pah (mouth); and with the rawach (spirit / wind) of his shapah (lips) he will mawath (death) the rashai (wicked).
Tzadaq (righteous / just / fair) will be the belt of his waist, and amawanah (faithfulness) the belt of his waist.

The zaab (wolf) will live with the kabash (lamb), and the namar (leopard) will rabatz (lie) down with the young goat; The igal (calf), the young kapayar (lion), and the fattened igal (calf) yachad (together); and a qatan (small/young/least) nair (child) will nahag (lead) them.
The parah (cow) and the dab (bear) will graze. Their yalad (birth / begot) ones will rabatz (lie) down yachad (together). The aray (lion) will akal (eat) thaban (straw) like the baqar (morning).
The yanaq (nursing) child will shaii (play) near a cobra's chawar (hole), and the weaned child will hadah (put) his yad (hand) on the viper's maawarah (den).

They will not raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil) nor shachath (destroy) in all my qadash (set apart/make holy) har (mountain); for the aratz (Earth/land) will be malaa (full) of the daih (knowledge) of Yahawah, as the mayam (Waters) kasah (cover) the yam (sea/waters).

It will happen in that yawam (day) that the gaway (nation / people) will darash (seek) the sharash (root) of Yashay (Jesse), who imad (stands) as a nas (banner) of the im (people / nation); and his manawachah (resting) place will be kabawad (glorious).

It will happen in that yawam (day) that the Adanay will set his yad (hand) again the shanay (second) time to qanah (recover) the shaar (remnant) that is shaar (left) of his im (people / nation) from Ashawar (Assyria), from Matzarayam (Egypt), from Patharawas (Pathros), from Kawash (Cush), from Iyalam (Elam), from Shanair (Shinar), from Chamath (Hamath), and from the ay (islands) of the yam (sea/waters).

He will nashaa (lift) up a nas (banner) for the gaway (nation / people), and will asap (assemble) the dachah (outcasts) of Yasharaal (Israel), and qabatz (gather) together the napatz (dispersed) of Yahawadah (Judah) from the arabai (four) kanap (corners) of the aratz (Earth/land).

The qanaah (envy) also of Aparayam (Ephraim) will sawar (depart), and those who persecute Yahawadah (Judah) will be karath (cut) off. Aparayam (Ephraim) won't qanaa (jealous) Yahawadah (Judah), and Yahawadah (Judah) won't persecute Aparayam (Ephraim).

They will iwap (flying) down on the kathap (shoulders) of the Palashathay (Philistines) on the yam (sea/waters). Yachad (together) they will plunder the ban (son) of the qadam (east). They will extend their yad (hand) over Adam (Edom) and Mawaab (Moab), and the ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon) will mashamaith (obey) them.

Yahawah will utterly charam (destroy) the lashawan (tongue/language) of the Matzarayam (Egyptian) yam (sea/waters); and with his scorching rawach (spirit / wind) he will nawap (wave) his yad (hand) over the nahar (river), and will split it into shabai (seven) nachal (stream / river), and cause men to march over in sandals.

There will be a masalah (highway) for the shaar (remnant) that is shaar (left) of his im (people / nation) from Ashawar (Assyria), like there was for Yasharaal (Israel) in the yawam (day) that he ilah (go up / offer) up out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt).

In that yawam (day) you will amar (spoke), I will give yadah (thanks) to you, Yahawah; for though you were anap (angry) with me, your ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) has shawab (turn back / repent) away and you nacham (turn away / repent) me.

Behold, Al is my yashawaih (salvation). I will batach (trust), and will not be pachad (fear / dread); for Yah, Yahawah, is my iz (strength / might / refuge) and zamarath (song); and he has become my yashawaih (salvation).
Therefore with shashawan (joy) you will shaab (draw) mayam (Waters) out of the maiyan (wells) of yashawaih (salvation).

In that yawam (day) you will amar (spoke), Give yadah (thanks) to Yahawah! Qaraa (called) on his sham (name). Yadai (declare) his ilayalah (doings) among the im (people / nation). Proclaim that his sham (name) is shagab (exalted)!
Zamar (sing) to Yahawah, for he ishah (make) done gaawath (excellent) things! Yadai (let) this be known in all the aratz (Earth/land)!

Tzahal (cry) aloud and ranan (shout), you yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Tzayawan (Zion); for the qadawash (holy) One of Yasharaal (Israel) is gadawal (very great/important/mighty) in the qarab (among / near) of you!
The mashaa (burden) of Babal (Babylon), which Yashaiyah (Isaiah) the ban (son) of Amawatz (Amoz) chazah (saw):

Nashaa (lift) up a nas (banner) on the bare har (mountain)! Rawam (will lift up) up your qawal (sound / voice) to them! Nawap (wave) your yad (hand), that they may bawaa (come) into the pathach (gates) of the nadayab (nobles).

I have tzawah (commanded) my qadash (set apart/make holy) ones; yes, I have qaraa (called) my gabawar (mighty) men for my ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), even my gaawah (proudly) exulting ilayaz (ones).

The qawal (sound / voice) of a hamawan (multitude) is in the har (mountain), as of a rab (great) im (people / nation); the qawal (sound / voice) of an uproar of the mamalakah (kingdoms) of the gaway (nation / people) asap (gathered) together! Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) is mustering the tzabaa (troop) for the malachamah (battle).

They bawaa (come) from a marachaq (far) aratz (Earth/land), from the uttermost part of shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), even Yahawah, and the kalay (weapons) of his zaim (indignation), to chabal (destroy) the whole aratz (Earth/land).
Wail; for the yawam (day) of Yahawah is at qarawab (hand)! It will bawaa (come) as shad (destruction) from the Shaday.
Therefore all yad (hand) will be rapah (feeble), and everyone's labab (heart) will melt.

They will be bahal (dismayed). Tzayar (pangs) and chabal (sorrows) will seize them. They will be in chawal (pain) like a yalad (birth / begot) in labor. They will look in amazement ayash (husband/individual man) at rai (neigbor/another person). Their panayam (faces) will be panayam (faces) of flame.

Behold, the yawam (day) of Yahawah bawaa (come), akazaray (cruel), with ibarah (wrath) and charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting); to shawam (place / establish / appoint) the aratz (Earth/land) a shamah (desolation), and to shamad (destroy) its chataa (sinners) out of it.

For the kawakab (star) of the sky and its kasayal (constellations) will not halal (praise) their awar (light). The shamash (sun) will be chashak (darkness) in its yatzaa (go out / come out) forth, and the yarach (moon) will not cause its awar (light) to nagah (shine).

I will paqad (visit) the thabal (world) for their rai (evil), and the rashai (wicked) for their iwan (guilt/iniquity). I will cause the arrogance of the zad (proud) to shabath (shabath/rest), and will shapal (humble) the gaawah (haughtiness) of the irayatz (terrible).
I will make anawash (people) more rare than paz (fine) gold, even a adam (person) than the katham (pure) gold of Awapayar (Ophir).

Therefore I will make the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) ragaz (tremble), and the aratz (Earth/land) will be raish (shaken) out of its maqawam (place) in the ibarah (wrath) of Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), and in the yawam (day) of his charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting).

It will happen that like a hunted gazelle, and like tzaan (sheep) that no ayash (husband/individual man) qabatz (gathers), they will each panah (turn) to their own im (people / nation), and will ayash (husband/individual man) nawas (flee) to their own aratz (Earth/land).
Everyone who is matzaa (found) will be thrust daqar (through). Everyone who is captured will napal (fall / be cast down) by the charab (sword).
Their iwalal (infants) also will be ratash (dashed) in pieces before their iyan (eye). Their bayath (house) will be ransacked, and their wives raped.
Behold, I will iwar (rouse / awaken) up the Maday (Medes) against them, who will not value kasap (silver), and as for zahab (gold), they chapatz (will) not delight in it.

Their qashath (bows) will ratash (dash) the nair (young) men in pieces; and they shall racham (have) no pity on the paray (fruit) of the batan (womb). Their iyan (eye) will not chawas (spare) ban (son).

Babal (Babylon), the glory of mamalakah (kingdoms), the thapaarah (beauty) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans)' gaawan (pride), will be like when Alahayam mahapakah (overthrew) Sadam (Sodom) and Imarah (Gomorrah).

It will never be yashab (inhabit/dwell), neither will it be lived in from dawar (generation / age / period) to dawar (generation / age / period). The Irabay (Arabian) will not pitch a ahal (tent) there, neither will raih (shepherds) rabatz (make) their flocks lie down there.

But tzayay (wild) animals of the desert will rabatz (lie) there, and their bayath (house) will be malaa (full) of jackals. Ostriches will shakan (dwell) there, and wild shaiyar (goats) will frolic there.

Wolves will inah (answer / respond) in their castles, and jackals in the inag (pleasant) hayakal (palaces). Her ith (time) is qarawab (near) to bawaa (come), and her yawam (day) will not be prolonged.

For Yahawah will racham (have) compassion on Yaiqab (Jacob), and will yet bachar (choose) Yasharaal (Israel), and yanach (set) them in their own adamah (land). The foreigner will lawah (join) himself with them, and they will unite with the bayath (house) of Yaiqab (Jacob).

The im (people / nation) will laqach (take / seized) them, and bawaa (come) them to their maqawam (place). The bayath (house) of Yasharaal (Israel) will nachal (possess) them in yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) adamah (land) for ibad (servant) and for handmaids. They will shabah (take) as captives those whose shabah (captives) they were; and they shall radah (rule over / have dominion of / subdue) over their nagash (oppressors).

It will happen in the yawam (day) that Yahawah will give you nawach (rest) from your itzab (sorrow), from your trouble, and from the qashah (rough / hard) ibadah (service) in which you were made to ibad (servant),

That you will nashaa (lift) up this mashal (parable) against the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and amar (spoke), How the nagash (oppressor) has shabath (shabath/rest)! The madahabah (golden) city has shabath (shabath/rest)!
Yahawah has shabar (broken) the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the rashai (wicked), the scepter of the mashal (rule/have dominion),

Who nakah (struck) the im (people / nation) in ibarah (wrath) with a balathay (continual) makah (stroke), who radah (rule over / have dominion of / subdue) the gaway (nation / people) in ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), with a persecution that balay (none) restrained.
The whole aratz (Earth/land) is at nawach (rest), and is shaqat (quiet). They patzach (break) out song.
Yes, the barawash (fir) trees shamach (rejoice) with you, with the araz (cedars) of Labanawan (Lebanon), saying, Since you are humbled, no lumberjack has ilah (go up / offer) up against us.

Shaawal (Shaawal/afterlife) from beneath has ragaz (moved) for you to qaraah (meet) you at your bawaa (come). It iwar (rouse / awaken) up the rapaa (dead) for you, even all the ithawad (rulers) of the aratz (Earth/land). It has qawam (rise up) up from their kasaa (thrones) all the malak (king) of the gaway (nation / people).
They all will inah (answer / respond) and ask you, Have you also become as chalah (afflict) as we are? Have you mashal (speak in proverb/parable) like us?

Your gaawan (pomp) is yarad (brought) down to shaawal (Shaawal/afterlife), with the sound of your stringed instruments. Maggots are yatzai (spread) out under you, and ramah (worms) makasah (cover) you.

How you napal (fall / be cast down) fallen from shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), morning hayalal (star), ban (son) of the dawn! How you are gadai (cut) down to the aratz (Earth/land), who laid the gaway (nation / people) low!

You amar (spoke) in your labab (heart), I will ilah (go up / offer) into shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens))! I will rawam (will lift up) my kasaa (throne) mail (top/above) the kawakab (star) of Al! I will yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the har (mountain) of mawaid (Feast/Holy Day), in the far tzapawan (north)!
I will ilah (go up / offer) above the bamah (heights) of the ib (clouds)! I will make myself damah (like) the Most ilayawan (high)!
Yet you shall be yarad (brought) down to shaawal (Shaawal/afterlife), to the depths of the bawar (pit).

Those who raah (see) you will stare at you. They will ponder you, saying, Is this the ayash (husband/individual man) who made the aratz (Earth/land) to ragaz (tremble), who raish (shook) mamalakah (kingdoms);
Who shawam (place / establish / appoint) the thabal (world) like a madabar (wilderness), and overthrew its iyar (cities); who didn't release his asayar (prisoners) to their bayath (house)?
All the malak (king) of the gaway (nation / people), sleep in kabawad (glory), everyone in his own bayath (house).

But you are shalak (cast) away from your tomb like an thaib (abominable) natzar (branch), labawash (clothed) with the harag (slain), who are tain (thrust) through with the charab (sword), who yarad (go) down to the aban (stone) of the bawar (pit); like a pagar (dead) body bawas (trodden) under foot.

You will not yachad (join) them in qabawarah (burial), because you have shachath (destroyed) your aratz (Earth/land). You have harag (killed) your im (people / nation). The zarai (seed) of evildoers will not be qaraa (called) iwalam (forever).

Kawan (prepare) for matabach (slaughter) of his ban (son) because of the iwan (guilt/iniquity) of their ab (father), that they not qawam (rise up) up and yarash (possess) the aratz (Earth/land), and malaa (fill) the surface of the thabal (world) with cities.

"I will qawam (rise up) up against them," naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), "and karath (cut) off from Babal (Babylon) sham (name) and shaar (remnant), and nayan (son) and nakad (son's) son," naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

"I will also shawam (place / establish / appoint) it a mawarash (possession) for the porcupine, and agam (pools) of mayam (Waters). I will tawaa (sweep) it with the broom of destruction," naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).
Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) has shabai (swear / take oath), amar (spoke), Surely, as I have damah (thought), so shall it happen; and as I have yaitz (purposed), so shall it qawam (rise up):

That I will shabar (break) the Ashawar (Assyrian) in my aratz (Earth/land), and bawas (tread) him under foot on my har (mountain). Then his il (over) will sawar (leave) them, and his sabal (burden) sawar (leave) their shakam (shoulders).
This is the plan that is yaitz (determined) for the whole aratz (Earth/land). This is the yad (hand) that is natah (stretched) out over all the gaway (nation / people).
For Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) has planned, and who can stop it? His yad (hand) is natah (stretched) out, and who can shawab (turn back / repent) it back?
This mashaa (burden) was in the shanah (year) that malak (king) Achaz (Ahaz) mawath (death).

Don't shamach (rejoice), O Palashath (Philistia), all of you, because the shabat (rod) that nakah (struck) you is shabar (broken); for out of the nachash (serpent's) sharash (root) an tzapai (adder) will emerge, and his paray (fruit) will be a sharap (fiery) iwap (flying) serpent.

The bakawar (firstborn) of the dal (poor) will raih (eat), and the abayawan (needy) will rabatz (lie) down in safety; and I will mawath (death) your sharash (root) with raib (famine), and your shaarayath (remnant) will be harag (killed).

Yalal (howl), shair (gate)! Zaiq (cry), iyar (city)! You are mawag (melted) away, Palashath (Philistia), all of you; for ishan (smoke) bawaa (come) out of the tzapawan (north), and there is no straggler in his ranks.

What will they inah (answer / respond) the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of the gaway (nation / people)? That Yahawah has founded Tzayawan (Zion), and in her the inay (afflicted) of his im (people / nation) will take chasah (refuge).

The mashaa (burden) of Mawaab (Moab): for in a layal (night), Ir (Ar) of Mawaab (Moab) is laid shadad (waste), and damah (brought) to nothing; for in a layal (night) Qayar (Kir) of Mawaab (Moab) is laid shadad (waste), and damah (brought) to nothing.

They have ilah (go up / offer) up to Bayith, and to Dayabawan (Dibon), to the bamah (high) places, to bakay (weep). Mawaab (Moab) wails over Nabaw (Nebo) and over Mayadabaa (Medeba). Qarachah (baldness) is on all of their raash (head). Every zaqan (beard) is ilah (go up / offer) off.
In their chawatz (streets), they clothe themselves in sackcloth. In their rachab (streets) and on their housetops, everyone wails, bakay (weeping) yarad (abundantly).

Chashabawan (Heshbon) zaiq (cries) out with Alailaa (Elealeh). Their qawal (sound / voice) is shamai (hearken / hear) even to Yahatz (Jahaz). Therefore the chalatz (armed) men of Mawaab (Moab) rawai (cry) aloud. Their napash (living being/soul) tremble within them.

My lab (heart) zaiq (cries) out for Mawaab (Moab)! Her nobles flee to Tzair (Zoar), to Eglath Shelishiyah; for they go up by the ascent of Lawachayath (Luhith) with bakay (weeping); for in the darak (way) of Charanayam (Horonaim), they ilah (go up / offer) up a zaiq (cry) of shabar (destruction).

For the mayam (Waters) of Namarayam (Nimrim) will be mashamah (desolate); for the dashaa (grass) has yabash (dry land) away, the tender dashaa (grass) kalah (complete / finish), there is no yaraq (green) thing.
Therefore they will carry away the yatharah (abundance) they ishah (make) gotten, and that which they have stored up, over the nachal (stream / river) of the irab (evening).
For the zaiq (cry) has naqap (gone) around the gabawal (border/boundary) of Mawaab (Moab); its wailing to Agalayam (Eglaim), and its wailing to Baaraalayam (Beer) Elim.

For the mayam (Waters) of Dayamawan (Dimon) are malaa (full) of dam (blood); for I will shayath (put / appoint / make) yet more on Dayamawan (Dimon), a aray (lion) on those of Mawaab (Moab) who palayatah (escape), and on the shaarayath (remnant) of the adamah (land).

Shalach (send) the kar (lambs) for the mashal (rule/have dominion) of the aratz (Earth/land) from salai (selah) to the madabar (wilderness), to the har (mountain) of the bath (daughter) of Tzayawan (Zion).
For it will be that as nadad (wandering) iwap (flying), as a scattered qan (nest), so will the bath (daughter) of Mawaab (Moab) be at the maibar (fords) of the Aranawan (Arnon).

Give itzah (counsel)! Ishah (make) palayalah (justice)! Shayath (put / appoint / make) your tzal (shade) like the layal (night) in the thawak (midst) of the noonday! Sathar (hide) the nadach (outcasts)! Don't betray the fugitive!

Let my nadach (outcasts) gawar (dwell) with you! As for Mawaab (Moab), be a sathar (secret / hidden) place for him from the panayam (face) of the shadad (destroyer). For the mawatz (extortioner) is apas (brought) to nothing. Shad (destruction) kalah (complete / finish). The ramas (oppressors) are thamam (consumed) out of the aratz (Earth/land).

A kasaa (throne) will be kawan (established) in loving chasad (grace). One will yashab (inhabit/dwell) on it in amath (truth), in the ahal (tent) of Dawad (David), shapat (judging), darash (seeking) mashapat (justice), and swift to do tzadaq (righteous / just / fair).
We have shamai (hearken / hear) of the gaawan (pride) of Mawaab (Moab), that he is very gaa (proud); even of his arrogance, his gaawan (pride), and his ibarah (wrath). His boastings are nothing.
Therefore Mawaab (Moab) will wail for Mawaab (Moab). Everyone will wail. You will hagah (mourn) for the raisin cakes of Qayaracharash (Kir) Hareseth, utterly nakaa (stricken).

For the shadamah (fields) of Chashabawan (Heshbon) amal (languish) with the gapan (vine) of Shabam (Sibmah). The bail (lords) of the gaway (nation / people) have halam (broken) down its choice branches, which nagai (reached) even to Yaizayar (Jazer), which thaih (wandered) into the madabar (wilderness). Its shoots were natash (spread) abroad. They ibar (pass over/through) over the yam (sea/waters).

Therefore I will bakah (weep) with the bakay (weeping) of Yaizayar (Jazer) for the gapan (vine) of Shabam (Sibmah). I will rawah (water) you with my damaih (tears), Chashabawan (Heshbon), and Alailaa (Elealeh): for on your qayatz (summer) fruits and on your qatzayar (harvest) the battle hayadad (shout) napal (fall / be cast down) fallen.

Shamachah (gladness) is asap (taken) away, and gayal (joy) out of the karamal (fruitful) field; and in the karam (vineyards) there will be no ranan (singing), neither rawai (joyful) noise. Nobody will darak (tread) out yayan (wine) in the presses. I have made the hayadad (shouting) stop.
Therefore my maih (heart) hamah (they) like a kanawar (harp) for Mawaab (Moab), and my qarab (among / near) parts for Qayaracharash (Kir) Heres.

It will happen that when Mawaab (Moab) raah (see) himself, when he laah (wearies) himself on the bamah (high) place, and bawaa (come) to his maqadash (sanctuary) to palal (pray), that he will not yakal (prevail).
This is the dabar (word / matter) that Yahawah dabar (word / matter) concerning Mawaab (Moab) in az (time) past.

But now Yahawah has dabar (word / matter), amar (spoke), Within shalawash (three) shanah (years), as a worker bound by contract would count them, the kabawad (glory) of Mawaab (Moab) shall be brought into contempt, with all his rab (great) hamawan (multitude); and the shaar (remnant) will be very small and feeble.
The mashaa (burden) of Damashaq (Damascus): "Behold, Damashaq (Damascus) is sawar (taken) away from being a iyar (city), and it will be a mapalah (ruinous) maiy (heap).
The iyar (cities) of Irawair (Aroer) are forsaken. They will be for idar (flocks), which shall rabatz (lie) down, and none shall make them charad (afraid).

The mabatzar (fortress) shall shabath (shabath/rest) from Aparayam (Ephraim), and the mamalakah (kingdom) from Damashaq (Damascus), and the shaar (remnant) of Aram (Syria). They will be as the kabawad (glory) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel)," naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).
“It will happen in that yawam (day) that the kabawad (glory) of Yaiqab (Jacob) will be dalal (made) thin, and the fatness of his bashar (flesh) will become razah (lean).

It will be like when the harvester asap (gathers) the wheat, and his zarawai (arm) qatzar (reaps) the grain. Yes, it will be like when one laqat (gleans) grain in the imaq (valley) of Rapaa (Rephaim).

Yet gleanings will be shaar (left) there, like the naqap (shaking) of an zayath (olive) tree, shanayam (two) or shalawash (three) olives in the raash (head) of the uppermost amayar (bough), arabai (four) or chamash (five) in the outermost branches of a parah (fruitful) tree,” naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel).
In that yawam (day), adam (people) will shaih (look) to their Maker, and their iyan (eye) will raah (see) respect for the qadawash (holy) One of Yasharaal (Israel).

They will not shaih (look) to the mazabach (altars), the maishah (work) of their yad (hand); neither shall they raah (see) that which their atzabai (fingers) ishah (make) made, Asharah (either) the Asherim, or the incense chaman (altars).

In that yawam (day), their maiwaz (stronghold / fortress / protection) iyar (cities) will be like the forsaken Charash (places) in the woods and on the panayam (mountain) top, which were forsaken from before the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel); and it will be a shamamah (desolation).

For you have shakach (forgotten) the Alahayam of your yashai (salvation), and have not zakar (remembrance/memory) the tzawar (rock) of your maiwaz (stronghold / fortress / protection). Therefore you natai (plant) naiman (pleasant) natai (plants), and zarai (set) out foreign seedlings.

In the yawam (day) of your natai (planting), you hedge it in. In the baqar (morning), you make your zarai (seed) parach (blossom), but the qatzayar (harvest) flees away in the yawam (day) of chalah (afflict) and of anash (desperate) kaab (sorrow).

Haway (Alas/Woe!), the uproar of many im (people / nation), who hamah (they) like the hamah (they) of the yam (sea/waters); and the shaawan (rushing) of laam (nations), that shaah (rush) like the rushing of kabayar (mighty) mayam (Waters)!

The laam (nations) will shaah (rush) like the shaawan (rushing) of many mayam (Waters): but he will gair (rebuke) them, and they will nawas (flee) marachaq (far) off, and will be radap (chased) like the matz (chaff) of the har (mountain) panayam (before) the rawach (spirit / wind), and like the whirling dust panayam (before) the sawapah (storm).
At ith (evening), behold, balahah (terror)! Before the baqar (morning), they are no more. This is the chalaq (portion) of those who plunder us, and the gawaral (lot) of those who bazaz (rob) us.
Haway (Alas/Woe!), the aratz (Earth/land) of the rustling of kanap (wings), which is ibar (beyond) the nahar (rivers) of Kawash (Ethiopia);

That shalach (send) tzayar (ambassadors) by the yam (sea/waters), even in kalay (vessels) of papyrus on the mayam (Waters), saying, yalak (go), you qal (swift) malaak (angel / messenger of Yah), to a gaway (nation / people) tall and smooth, to a im (people / nation) awesome from their beginning onward, a gaway (nation / people) that measures out and treads down, whose aratz (Earth/land) the nahar (rivers) divide!

All you yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the thabal (world), and you shakan (dwellers) on the aratz (Earth/land), when a nas (banner) is nashaa (lift) up on the har (mountain), raah (see)! When the shawapar (Shawapar(Shofar) - Ram's horn (instrument)) is thaqai (blow / sound alarm), shamai (hearken / hear)!

For Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, I will be still, and I will nabat (see) in my makawan (dwelling) place, like tzach (clear) cham (heat) in sunshine, like a ib (cloud) of tal (dew) in the cham (heat) of qatzayar (harvest).

For panayam (before) the qatzayar (harvest), when the parach (blossom) is over, and the natzah (flower) becomes a gamal (ripening) basar (grape), he will karath (cut) off the zalazal (sprigs) with mazamarah (pruning) hooks, and he will thazaz (cut) down and sawar (take) away the spreading branches.

They will be izab (left) yachad (together) for the iyat (ravenous) birds of the har (mountain), and for the animals of the aratz (Earth/land). The iyat (ravenous) birds will qawatz (summer) on them, and all the animals of the aratz (Earth/land) will winter on them.

In that ith (time), a shay (present) will be yabal (brought) to Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) from a im (people / nation) tall and smooth, even from a im (people / nation) awesome from their beginning onward, a gaway (nation / people) that measures out and treads down, whose aratz (Earth/land) the nahar (rivers) divide, to the maqawam (place) of the sham (name) of Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), har (mountain) Tzayawan (Zion).

The mashaa (burden) of Matzarayam (Egypt): “Behold, Yahawah rakab (rides) on a qal (swift) ib (cloud), and bawaa (come) to Matzarayam (Egypt). The alayal (idols) of Matzarayam (Egypt) will tremble at his panayam (presence); and the labab (heart) of Matzarayam (Egypt) will masas (melt) in its qarab (among / near).

I will stir up the Matzarayam (Egyptians) against the Matzarayam (Egyptians), and they will lacham (fight) everyone against his ach (brother/kinsman), and everyone against his neighbor; iyar (city) against iyar (city), and mamalakah (kingdom) against mamalakah (kingdom).

The rawach (spirit / wind) of Matzarayam (Egypt) will baqaq (fail) in its qarab (among / near). I will balai (destroy) its itzah (counsel). They will darash (seek) the alayal (idols), the at (charmers), those who have familiar awab (spirits), and the yadainay (wizards).

I will sakar (give) over the Matzarayam (Egyptians) into the yad (hand) of a qashah (rough / hard) Adawan. A iz (fierce) malak (king) will mashal (rule/have dominion) over them,” naam (declares (prophetically)) the Adawan, Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).
The mayam (Waters) will nashath (fail) from the yam (sea/waters), and the nahar (river) will be charab (wasted) and become yabash (dry land).
The nahar (rivers) will become foul. The yaar (streams) Matzawar (of) Egypt will be diminished and charab (dried) up. The qanah (reeds) and sawap (flags) will qamal (wither) away.
The meadows by the Nile, by the brink of the Nile, and all the mazarai (sown) fields of the Nile, will become yabash (dry land), be nadap (driven) away, and be no more.
The fishermen will anah (lament), and all those who fish in the Nile will abal (mourn), and those who parash (spread) makamarath (nets) on the mayam (Waters) will amal (languish).
Moreover those who ibad (servant) in combed pashathah (flax), and those who weave white cloth, will be bawash (confounded).
The pillars will be dakaa (broken) in pieces. All those who ishah (make) for hire will be grieved in napash (living being/soul).

The shar (prince / ruler) of Tzain (Zoan) are utterly awayal (foolish). The itzah (counsel) of the wisest counselors of Paraih (Pharaoh) has become stupid. How do you amar (spoke) to Paraih (Pharaoh), I am the ban (son) of the chakam (wise), the ban (son) of qadam (ancient) malak (king)?
Ay (where) then are your chakam (wise) men? Let them nagad (tell) you now; and yadai (let) them know what Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) has yaitz (purposed) concerning Matzarayam (Egypt).

The shar (prince / ruler) of Tzain (Zoan) have yaal (become) fools. The shar (prince / ruler) Nap (of) Memphis are nashaa (lift). They have caused Matzarayam (Egypt) to thaih (go) astray, who are the cornerstone of her shabat (tribes).

Yahawah has mixed a rawach (spirit / wind) of perverseness in the qarab (among / near) of her; and they have caused Matzarayam (Egypt) to thaih (go) astray in all of its maishah (works), like a shakawar (drunken) man thaih (staggers) in his qaa (vomit).
Neither shall there be any maishah (work) for Matzarayam (Egypt), which raash (head) or zanab (tail), palm kapah (branch) or agamawan (rush), may ishah (make).

In that yawam (day) the Matzarayam (Egyptians) will be like ashah (wife/individual woman). They will charad (tremble) and pachad (fear / dread) panayam (because) of the thanawapah (shaking) of the yad (hand) of Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), which he nawap (shakes) over them.

The adamah (land) of Yahawadah (Judah) will become a chagaa (terror) to Matzarayam (Egypt). Everyone to whom zakar (remembrance/memory) is pachad (fear / dread) of it will be afraid, panayam (because) of the plans of Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), which he yaitz (determines) against it.

In that yawam (day), there will be chamash (five) iyar (cities) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) that dabar (word / matter) the shapah (language) of Kanain (Canaan), and shabai (swear / take oath) to Yahawah of tzabaa (troop). Achad (one) will be amar (spoke) The iyar (city) of haras (destruction).

In that yawam (day), there will be an mazabach (altar) to Yahawah in the thawak (midst) of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and a matzabah (pillar) to Yahawah at its gabawal (border/boundary).

It will be for a awath (sign / mark / miracle) and for a id (witness) to Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt); for they will tzaiq (cry) to Yahawah panayam (because) of lachatz (oppressors), and he will shalach (send) them a savior and a defender, and he will natzal (deliver) them.

Yahawah yadai (will) be known to Matzarayam (Egypt), and the Matzarayam (Egyptians) yadai (will) know Yahawah in that yawam (day). Yes, they will ibad (servant) with zabach (sacrifice) and manachah (offering), and will nadar (vow) a nadar (make vow) to Yahawah, and will shalam (perform) it.
Yahawah will nagap (strike) Matzarayam (Egypt), nagap (striking) and rapaa (healing). They will shawab (turn back / repent) to Yahawah, and he will be entreated by them, and will rapaa (heal) them.

In that yawam (day) there will be a masalah (highway) out of Matzarayam (Egypt) to Ashawar (Assyria), and the Ashawar (Assyrian) shall bawaa (come) into Matzarayam (Egypt), and the Matzarayam (Egyptian) into Ashawar (Assyria); and the Matzarayam (Egyptians) will ibad (servant) with the Ashawar (Assyrians).
In that yawam (day), Yasharaal (Israel) will be the shalayashay (third) with Matzarayam (Egypt) and with Ashawar (Assyria), a barakah (blessing) in the qarab (among / near) of the aratz (Earth/land);

Because Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) has barak (blessed) them, amar (spoke), barak (blessed) be Matzarayam (Egypt) my im (people / nation), Ashawar (Assyria) the maishah (work) of my yad (hand), and Yasharaal (Israel) my nachalah (inheritance).

In the shanah (year) that tharathan (tartan) bawaa (come) Ashadawad (to) Ashdod, when Saragawan (Sargon) the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) shalach (send) him, and he lacham (fought) Ashadawad (against) Ashdod and lakad (took) it;

At that ith (time) Yahawah dabar (word / matter) by Yashaiyah (Isaiah) the ban (son) of Amawatz (Amoz), amar (spoke), "yalak (go), and loosen the sackcloth from off your waist, and take your nail (shoes) from off your ragal (feet / foot)." He ishah (make) so, halak (move) irawam (naked) and yachap (barefoot).

Yahawah amar (spoke), As my ibad (servant) Yashaiyah (Isaiah) has halak (move) irawam (naked) and yachap (barefoot) shalawash (three) shanah (years) for a awath (sign / mark / miracle) and a mawapath (wonder) concerning Matzarayam (Egypt) and concerning Kawash (Ethiopia),

So the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) will nahag (lead) away the shabay (captives) of Matzarayam (Egypt) and the exiles of Kawash (Ethiopia), nair (young) and zaqan (old), irawam (naked) and yachap (barefoot), and with shathah (drinks) chashap (uncovered), to the irawah (shame) of Matzarayam (Egypt).
They will be chathath (dismayed) and bawash (confounded), because of Kawash (Ethiopia) their mabat (expectation), and of Matzarayam (Egypt) their glory.

The yashab (inhabit/dwell) of this coast ay (land) will amar (spoke) in that yawam (day), ‘Behold, kah (this) is our mabat (expectation), where we nawas (fled) for izarah (help) to be natzal (delivered) from the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria). And we, how will we malat (escape)?’

The mashaa (burden) of the madabar (wilderness) of the yam (sea/waters). As sawapah (whirlwinds) in the nagab (south) sweep through, it bawaa (come) from the madabar (wilderness), from an awesome aratz (Earth/land).

A qashah (rough / hard) chazawath (vision) is nagad (declared) to me. The treacherous bagad (man) bagad (deals) treacherously, and the shadad (destroyer) shadad (destroys). Ilah (go up / offer) up, Iyalam (Elam); attack! I have stopped all of Maday (Media's) anachah (sighing).

Therefore my thighs are malaa (filled) with anguish. Chalachalah (pains) achaz (have) taken hold on me, like the tzayar (pains) of a yalad (birth / begot) in labor. I am in so much pain that I can't shamai (hearken / hear). I so am bahal (dismayed) that I can't raah (see).
My labab (heart) flutters. Palatzawath (horror) has frightened me. The nashap (twilight) that I chashaq (desired) has been shawam (place / establish / appoint) into charadah (trembling) for me.
They irak (prepare) the shalachan (table). They irak (set) the watch. They akal (eat). They shathah (drinks). Qawam (rise up) up, you shar (prince / ruler), mashach (oil) the magan (shield)!
For the Adanay amar (spoke) to me, yalak (go), imad (set) a tzapah (watchman / keep watch). Let him nagad (declare) what he raah (see).
When he raah (see) a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of donkeys, a troop of gamal (camels), he shall listen qashab (diligently) with rab (great) attentiveness.
He qaraa (called) like a aray (lion): "Adanay, I imad (stand) continually on the watchtower in the yawamam (by day), and every layal (night) I stay at my post.

Behold, here bawaa (come) a troop of ayash (husband/individual man), horsemen in pairs." He inah (answer / respond), "napal (fall / be cast down), napal (fall / be cast down) is Babal (Babylon); and all the engraved pasayal (images) of her Alahayam are shabar (broken) to the aratz (Earth/land).

You are my madashah (threshing), and the grain of my garan (floor)!" That which I have shamai (hearken / hear) from Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), I have nagad (declared) to you.
The mashaa (burden) of Dawamah (Dumah). One qaraa (called) to me out of Shaiyar (Seir), shamar (keep/guard), what of the layal (night)? Shamar (keep/guard), what of the layal (night)?
The shamar (keep/guard) amar (spoke), The baqar (morning) athah (comes), and also the layal (night). If you will baih (inquire), baih (inquire). Athah (come) shawab (turn back / repent) again.
The mashaa (burden) on Irab (Arabia). In the yair (forest) in Irab (Arabia) you will lawan (lodge), you caravans of Dedanites.
They athah (brought) mayam (Waters) to him who was thirsty. The yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the aratz (Earth/land) of Thayamaa (Tema) qadam (met) the fugitives with their lacham (bread).
For they nadad (fled) away from the charab (sword), from the natash (drawn) charab (sword), from the bent qashath (bow), and from the heat of malachamah (battle).
For the Adanay amar (spoke) to me, Within a shanah (year), as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the kabawad (glory) of Qadar (Kedar) will kalah (complete / finish),

And the shaar (residue) of the masapar (number) of the qashath (archers), the gabawar (mighty) men of the ban (son) of Qadar (Kedar), will be mait (few); for Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), has dabar (word / matter) it.
The mashaa (burden) of the gayaa (valley) of chazayawan (vision). What ails you apaw (now), that you have all ilah (go up / offer) up to the housetops?

You that are full of thashaah (shouting), a hamah (they) iyar (city), a ilayaz (joyous) town; your chalal (slain) are not chalal (slain) with the charab (sword), neither are they mawath (death) in malachamah (battle).

All your qatzayan (rulers) nadad (fled) away yachad (together). They were asar (bound) by the qashath (archers). All who were matzaa (found) by you were asar (bound) yachad (together). They barach (fled) rachawaq (far) away.

Therefore I amar (spoke), shaih (look) away from me. I will bakay (weep) bitterly. Don't awatz (labor) to nacham (turn away / repent) me for the shad (destruction) of the bath (daughter) of my im (people / nation).

For it is a yawam (day) of mahawamah (confusion), and of mabawasah (treading) down, and of mabawakah (perplexity), from the Adanay, Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), in the gayaa (valley) of chazayawan (vision); a qawar (breaking) down of the qayar (walls), and a shawai (crying) to the har (mountain).
Iyalam (Elam) nashaa (lift) his ashapah (quiver), with rakab (chariots) of adam (men) and horsemen; and Qayar (Kir) irah (uncovered) the magan (shield).

It happened that your mabachar (choicest) imaq (valleys) were malaa (full) of rakab (chariots), and the horsemen shayath (put / appoint / make) themselves in shayath (put / appoint / make) at the shair (gate).
He took away the masak (covering) of Yahawadah (Judah); and you nabat (looked) in that yawam (day) to the armor in the bayath (house) of the yair (forest).
You raah (see) the breaches of the iyar (city) of Dawad (David), that they were many; and you qabatz (gathered) together the mayam (Waters) of the thachathawan (lower) barakah (pool).
You sapar (book) the bayath (house) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and you nathatz (broke) down the bayath (house) to batzar (fortify) the chawamah (wall).

You also ishah (make) a reservoir between the two chawamah (walls) for the mayam (Waters) of the yashan (old) barakah (pool). But you didn't nabat (look) to him who ishah (make) done this, neither did you raah (see) respect for him who yatzar (purposed) it rachawaq (long) ago.
In that yawam (day), the Adanay, Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), qaraa (called) to bakay (weeping), and to masapad (mourning), and to qarachah (baldness), and to dressing in sackcloth:

And behold, shashawan (joy) and shamachah (gladness), harag (killing) cattle and shachat (killing) tzaan (sheep), akal (eat) bashar (flesh) and shathah (drinks) yayan (wine): Let us akal (eat) and shathah (drinks), for machar (tomorrow) we will mawath (death).

Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) galah (revealed) himself in my azan (ears), "Surely this iwan (guilt/iniquity) will not be kapar (forgiven) you until you mawath (death)," amar (spoke) the Adanay, Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).
Thus amar (spoke) the Adanay, Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), yalak (go), bawaa (come) yourself to this sakan (treasurer), even to Shabanaa (Shebna), who is over the bayath (house), and say,

‘What are you doing here? Who has you here, that you have chatzab (dug) out a tomb here?’ Chatzab (cutting) himself out a tomb on marawam (high), chiseling a mashakan (habitation) for himself in the salai (rock)!
Behold, Yahawah will overcome you and hurl you tawal (away) violently. Yes, he will grasp you firmly.

He will tzanap (surely) tzanap (wind) you around and around, and throw you like a dawar (ball) into a rachab (large) aratz (Earth/land). There you will mawath (death), and there the marakabah (chariots) of your kabawad (glory) will be, you qalawan (shame) of your adawan (master / lord) bayath (house).
I will hadap (thrust) you from your office. You will be haras (pulled) down from your station.
It will happen in that yawam (day) that I will qaraa (called) my ibad (servant) Alayaqayam (Eliakim) the ban (son) Chalaqayah (of) Hilkiah,

And I will labash (clothe) him with your kathanath (robe), and chazaq (strengthen) him with your belt. I will nathan (give) your mamashalah (government) into his yad (hand); and he will be a ab (father) to the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and to the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah).

I will nathan (give) the mapathach (key) of the bayath (house) of Dawad (David) on his shakam (shoulder). He will pathach (open), and no one will sagar (shut). He will sagar (shut), and no one will pathach (open).
I will thaqai (blow / sound alarm) him like a yathad (nail) in a aman (believe / have faith) maqawam (place). He will be for a kasaa (throne) of kabawad (glory) to his ab (father) bayath (house).

They will thalah (hang) on him all the kabawad (glory) of his ab (father) bayath (house), the tzaatzaa (offspring) and the tzapaih (issue), every qatan (small/young/least) kalay (vessel), from the agan (cups) even to all the nabal (pitchers).

"In that yawam (day)," naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the yathad (nail) that was thaqai (blow / sound alarm) in a aman (believe / have faith) maqawam (place) will give mawash (way). It will be gadai (cut) down, and napal (fall / be cast down). The mashaa (burden) that was on it will be karath (cut) off, for Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) it.

The mashaa (burden) of Tzar (Tyre). Yalal (howl), you anayah (ships) of Tharashayash (Tarshish)! For it is laid shadad (waste), so that there is no bayath (house), no bawaa (come) in. From the aratz (Earth/land) of Kathay (Kittim) it is galah (revealed) to them.
Be still, you yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the coast, you whom the sachar (merchants) of Tzayadawan (Sidon), that ibar (pass over/through) over the yam (sea/waters), malaa (have) replenished.
On rab (great) mayam (Waters), the zarai (seed) of the Shayachawar (Shihor), the qatzayar (harvest) of the Nile, was her thabawaah (revenue). She was the market of gaway (nation / people).

Be bawash (ashamed), Tzayadawan (Sidon); for the yam (sea/waters) has amar (spoke), the stronghold of the yam (sea/waters), amar (spoke), I have not chawal (travailed), nor yalad (birth / begot) forth, neither have I gadal (nourished) bachawar (young) men, nor gadal (brought) up bathawalah (virgins).
When the shamai (report) comes to Matzarayam (Egypt), they will be in anguish at the shamai (report) of Tzar (Tyre).
Ibar (pass over/through) over to Tharashayash (Tarshish)! Wail, you yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the coast!
Is this your ilayaz (joyous) city, whose qadamah (antiquity) is of qadam (ancient) yawam (day), whose ragal (feet / foot) yabal (carried) her rachawaq (far) away to travel?
Who has planned this against Tzar (Tyre), the giver of itar (crowns), whose sachar (merchants) are shar (prince / ruler), whose Kanain (traffickers) are the honorable of the aratz (Earth/land)?
Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) has planned it, to chalal (stain) the gaawan (pride) of all glory, to qalal (bring) into contempt all the honorable of the aratz (Earth/land).
Ibar (pass over/through) through your aratz (Earth/land) like the Nile, bath (daughter) of Tharashayash (Tarshish). There is no restraint any more.
He has natah (stretched) out his yad (hand) over the yam (sea/waters). He has ragaz (shaken) the mamalakah (kingdoms). Yahawah has tzawah (ordered) the destruction of Kanain (Canaan's) strongholds.

He amar (spoke), You shall ilaz (rejoice) no more, you ishaq (oppressed) bathawalah (virgin) bath (daughter) of Tzayadawan (Sidon). Qawam (rise up), ibar (pass over/through) over to Kathay (Kittim). Even there you will have no nawach (rest).

Behold, the aratz (Earth/land) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans). This im (people / nation) was not. The Ashawar (Assyrians) founded it for those who dwell in the tzayay (wilderness). They qawam (rise up) up their bachayan (towers). They overthrew its aramawan (palaces). They shawam (place / establish / appoint) it a mapalah (ruin).
Yalal (howl), you anayah (ships) of Tharashayash (Tarshish), for your stronghold is laid shadad (waste)!

It will come to pass in that yawam (day) that Tzar (Tyre) will be shakach (forgotten) shabaiyam (seventy) shanah (years), according to the yawam (day) of achad (one) malak (king). Qatz (after) the end of shabaiyam (seventy) shanah (years) it will be to Tzar (Tyre) like in the shayar (song) of the prostitute.

Laqach (take / seized) a kanawar (harp); sabab (go) about the iyar (city), you prostitute that has been shakach (forgotten). Yatab (make) sweet nagan (melody). Sing many shayar (song), that you may be zakar (remembrance/memory).

It will happen qatz (after) the end of shabaiyam (seventy) shanah (years) that Yahawah will paqad (visit) Tzar (Tyre), and she shall shawab (turn back / repent) to her wages, and will zanah (play) the prostitute with all the mamalakah (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land) on the surface of the adamah (earth).

Her sachar (merchandise) and her wages will be qadash (set apart/make holy) to Yahawah. It will not be atzar (treasured) nor chasan (laid) up; for her sachar (merchandise) will be for those who yashab (inhabit/dwell) panayam (before) Yahawah, to akal (eat) shabaih (seven), and for ithayaq (durable) makasah (clothing).
Behold, Yahawah makes the aratz (Earth/land) baqaq (empty), makes it balaq (waste), iwah (turns) it panayam (upside) down, and pawatz (scatters) its yashab (inhabit/dwell).

It will be as with the im (people / nation), so with the kahan (priest); as with the ibad (servant), so with his adawan (master / lord); as with the shapachah (maid), so with her gabarath (mistress); as with the qanah (buyer), so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the nashaa (lift) of interest.
The aratz (Earth/land) will be baqaq (utterly) baqaq (emptied) and bazaz (utterly) laid waste; for Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) this dabar (word / matter).
The aratz (Earth/land) abal (mourns) and nabal (fades) away. The thabal (world) languishes and nabal (fades) away. The lofty im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land) amal (languish).

The aratz (Earth/land) also is chanap (polluted) under its yashab (inhabit/dwell), because they ibar (pass over/through) transgressed the thawarah (instruction), violated the chaq (statute), and parar (broken) the iwalam (forever) barayath (covenant).

Therefore the alah (these) has akal (eat) the aratz (Earth/land), and those who yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein are asham (found) guilty. Therefore the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the aratz (Earth/land) are charar (burned), and mazair (few) anawash (men) shaar (left).
The new thayarawash (wine) abal (mourns). The gapan (vine) languishes. All the shamach (merry-hearted) anach (sigh).
The mashawash (mirth) of tambourines shabath (shabath/rest). The sound of those who ilayaz (rejoice) chadal (ends). The mashawash (joy) of the kanawar (harp) shabath (shabath/rest).
They will not shathah (drinks) yayan (wine) with a shayar (song). Shakar (strong) drink will be marar (bitter) to those who shathah (drinks) it.
The confused qarayah (city) is shabar (broken) down. Every bayath (house) is sagar (shut) up, that no man may bawaa (come) in.
There is a tzawachah (crying) in the chawatz (streets) because of the yayan (wine). All shamachah (joy) is irab (evening). The mashawash (mirth) of the aratz (Earth/land) is galah (gone).
The iyar (city) is shaar (left) in shamah (desolation), and the shair (gate) is struck with shaayah (destruction).

For it will be so in the qarab (among / near) of the aratz (Earth/land) thawak (midst) the im (people / nation), as the naqap (shaking) of an zayath (olive) tree, as the gleanings when the batzayar (vintage) is kalah (complete / finish).
These shall nashaa (lift) up their qawal (sound / voice). They will ranan (shout) for the gaawan (majesty) of Yahawah. They tzahal (cry) aloud from the yam (sea/waters).
Therefore kabad (glorify) Yahawah in the east, even the sham (name) of Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), in the ay (islands) of the yam (sea/waters)!

From the kanap (uttermost) part of the aratz (Earth/land) have we shamai (hearken / hear) zamayar (songs). Glory to the tzadayaq (righteous)! But I amar (spoke), "I pine away! I pine away! Away (woe) is me!" The bagad (treacherous) have dealt bagad (treacherously). Yes, the bagad (treacherous) have dealt very bagad (treacherously).
Pachad (fear / dread), the pachath (pit), and the pach (snare), are on you who yashab (inhabit/dwell) the aratz (Earth/land).

It will happen that he who nawas (flees) from the qawal (sound / voice) of the pachad (fear / dread) will napal (fall / be cast down) into the pachath (pit); and he who ilah (go up / offer) up out of the thawak (midst) of the pachath (pit) will be lakad (taken) in the pach (snare); for the arabah (windows) on marawam (high) are pathach (opened), and the mawasadah (foundations) of the aratz (Earth/land) raish (tremble).
The aratz (Earth/land) is utterly raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil). The aratz (Earth/land) is torn apart. The aratz (Earth/land) is mawat (shaken) violently.

The aratz (Earth/land) will nawai (stagger) like a shakawar (drunken) nawai (man), and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be kabad (heavy) on it, and it will napal (fall / be cast down) and not qawam (rise up) again.
It shall happen in that yawam (day) that Yahawah will paqad (visit) the tzabaa (troop) of the marawam (high) ones on marawam (high), and the malak (king) of the adamah (earth) on the adamah (earth).

They shall be asap (gathered) together, as asayar (prisoners) are gathered in the bawar (pit), and shall be sagar (shut) up in the masagar (prison); and after many yawam (day) shall they be paqad (visit).
