Then the labanah (moon) shall be chapar (confounded), and the chamah (sun) bawash (ashamed); for Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) will malak (king) on har (mountain) Tzayawan (Zion), and in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and before his zaqan (elders) will be kabawad (glory).

Yahawah, you are my Alahayam. I will rawam (will lift up) you! I will yadah (praise) your sham (name), for you ishah (make) done wonderful things, things planned rachawaq (long) ago, in complete amawanah (faithfulness) and aman (believe / have faith).

For you have shawam (place / establish / appoint) a iyar (city) into a gal (heap), a batzar (fortified) qarayah (city) into a mapalah (ruin), a aramawan (palace) of strangers to be no iyar (city). It will iwalam (forever) be banah (built).
Therefore a iz (strong) im (people / nation) will kabad (glorify) you. A qarayah (city) of awesome gaway (nation / people) will yaraa (fear / be afraid) you.

For you have been a stronghold to the dal (poor), a stronghold to the abayawan (needy) in his tzar (oppressor / distressor), a machasah (refuge) from the zaram (storm), a tzal (shade) from the charab (heat), when the rawach (spirit / wind) of the dreaded irayatz (ones) is like a zaram (storm) against the qayar (wall).

As the charab (heat) in a tzayawan (dry) place will you kanai (bring) down the shaawan (noise) of strangers; as the charab (heat) by the tzal (shade) of a ib (cloud), the song of the dreaded irayatz (ones) will be inah (answer / respond) low.

In this har (mountain), Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) will ishah (make) all im (people / nation) a mashathah (feast) of shaman (fat) things, a mashathah (feast) of choice shamar (keep/guard), of shaman (fat) things machah (full) of marrow, of well zaqaq (refined) choice shamar (keep/guard).

He will balai (destroy) in this har (mountain) the surface of the lawat (covering) that covers all im (people / nation), and the masakah (veil) that is nasak (spread) over all gaway (nation / people).

He has balai (swallowed) up mawath (death) natzach (forever)! The Adanay Yahawah will machah (wipe) away damaih (tears) from off all panayam (faces). He will take the charapah (reproach) of his im (people / nation) sawar (away) from off all the aratz (Earth/land), for Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) it.

It shall be amar (spoke) in that yawam (day), Behold, this is our Alahayam! We have qawah (gather/wait) for him, and he will yashai (salvation) us! This is Yahawah! We have qawah (gather/wait) for him. We will be gayal (glad) and shamach (rejoice) in his yashawaih (salvation)!

For in this har (mountain) the yad (hand) of Yahawah will nawach (rest). Mawaab (Moab) will be dawash (trodden) down in his place, even like mathaban (straw) is dawash (trodden) down in the water of the madamanah (dunghill).

He will parash (spread) out his yad (hand) in its qarab (among / near), like one who shachah (swims) parash (spreads) out hands to shachah (swim), but his gaawah (pride) will be shapal (humbled) together with the craft of his yad (hand).
He has brought the high mabatzar (fortress) of your chawamah (walls) down, shapal (laid) low, and nagai (brought) to the aratz (Earth/land), even to the ipar (dust).

In that yawam (day), this shayar (song) will be shayar (sung) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah): We have a iz (strong) iyar (city). Alahayam appoints yashawaih (salvation) for chawamah (walls) and chayal (bulwarks).
Pathach (open) the shair (gates), that the tzadayaq (righteous) gaway (nation / people) may bawaa (come): the one which shamar (keep/guard) amawan (faith).
You will natzar (keep) whoever's yatzar (mind) is steadfast in shalawam (peace / safety) shalawam (peace / safety), because he batach (trusts) in you.
Batach (trust) in Yahawah id (forever); for in Yah, Yahawah, is an iwalam (forever) tzawar (rock).

For he has shachach (brought) down those who yashab (inhabit/dwell) on marawam (high), the shagab (lofty) qarayah (city). He shapal (lays) it low. He shapal (lays) it low even to the aratz (Earth/land). He nagai (brings) it even to the ipar (dust).
The ragal (feet / foot) shall ramas (tread) it down; Even the ragal (feet / foot) of the inay (poor), and the paim (steps) of the dal (needy).
The arach (way) of the tzadayaq (righteous) is uprightness. You who are yashar (upright) palas (make) the maigal (path) of the tzadayaq (righteous) level.
Yes, in the arach (way) of your mashapat (judgments), Yahawah, have we qawah (gather/wait) for you. Your sham (name) and your renown are the thaawah (desire) of our napash (living being/soul).

With my napash (living being/soul) have I awah (desired) you in the layal (night). Yes, with my rawach (spirit / wind) qarab (among / near) me will I shachar (seek) you earnestly; for when your mashapat (judgments) are in the aratz (Earth/land), the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the thabal (world) lamad (teach/instruct) tzadaq (righteous / just / fair).

Let favor be shown to the rashai (wicked), yet he will not lamad (teach/instruct) tzadaq (righteous / just / fair). In the aratz (Earth/land) of nakachah (uprightness) he will iwal (deal) wrongfully, and will not raah (see) yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) gaawath (majesty).

Yahawah, your yad (hand) is rawam (will lift up) up, yet they don't chazah (see); but they will chazah (see) your qanaah (zeal) for the im (people / nation), and be disappointed. Yes, ash (fire) will akal (eat) your tzar (oppressor / distressor).
Yahawah, you will shapath (ordain) shalawam (peace / safety) for us, for you have also pail (worked) all our maishah (works) for us.

Yahawah our Alahayam, other yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) zawalah (besides) you bail (have) had dominion over us, but by you only will we zakar (remembrance/memory) mention of your sham (name).

The mawath (death) shall not chayah (live). The rapaa (deceased) shall not qawam (rise up). Therefore paqad (visit) you visited and destroyed them, and caused all zakar (remembrance/memory) of them to abad (destroy/perish).

You have yasap (increased) the gaway (nation / people), O Yahawah. You have yasap (increased) the gaway (nation / people)! You are kabad (glorified)! You have enlarged all the borders of the aratz (Earth/land).
Yahawah, in tzar (oppressor / distressor) they paqad (visit) visited you. They tzawaq (poured) out a lachash (prayer) when your mawasar (chastening) was on them.

Kamaw (like) as a harah (woman) with child, who qarab (come close) near the yalad (birth / begot) of her delivery, is in chawal (pain) and zaiq (cries) out in her chabal (pangs); so we have been panayam (before) you, Yahawah.

We have harah (been) with child. We have been in chawal (pain). We gave yalad (birth / begot), it seems, only to rawach (spirit / wind). We ishah (make) not worked any yashawaih (salvation) in the aratz (Earth/land); bal (neither) have the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the thabal (world) napal (fall / be cast down).

Your mawath (death) shall chayah (live). My nabalah (dead) bodies shall qawam (rise up). Qawatz (awake) and ranan (sing), you who shakan (dwell) in the ipar (dust); for your tal (dew) is like the tal (dew) of awarah (herbs), and the aratz (Earth/land) will napal (fall / be cast down) forth the rapaa (dead).

Yalak (come), my im (people / nation), bawaa (come) into your rooms, and sagar (shut) your dalath (doors) behind you. Chabah (hide) yourself for a mait (little) ragai (in an instance), until the zaim (indignation) is past.

For, behold, Yahawah yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of his maqawam (place) to paqad (visit) the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the aratz (Earth/land) for their iwan (guilt/iniquity). The aratz (Earth/land) also will galah (disclose) her dam (blood), and will no longer kasah (cover) her harag (slain).

In that yawam (day), Yahawah with his qashah (rough / hard) and gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and chazaq (strong) charab (sword) will paqad (visit) lawayathan (leviathan), the fleeing nachash (serpent), and lawayathan (leviathan) the twisted nachash (serpent); and he will harag (kill) the thanayan (dragon) that is in the yam (sea/waters).
In that yawam (day), inah (answer / respond) to her, A pleasant karam (vineyard)!
I, Yahawah, am its keeper. I will shaqah (water) it every ragai (in an instance). Lest anyone damage it, I will natzar (keep) it layal (night) and yawam (day).

Chamah (wrath) is not in me, but if I should find shamayar (briers) and shayath (thorns), I nathan (give) do malachamah (battle)! I would march on them and I would tzawath (burn) them yachad (together).

Or else let him chazaq (take) hold of my maiwaz (stronghold / fortress / protection), that he may ishah (make) shalawam (peace / safety) with me. Let him ishah (make) shalawam (peace / safety) with me.

In days to bawaa (come), Yaiqab (Jacob) will sharash (take) root. Yasharaal (Israel) will tzawatz (blossom) and parach (bud). They will malaa (fill) the surface of the thabal (world) with thanawabah (fruit).
Has he nakah (struck) them as he struck those who nakah (struck) them? Or are they harag (killed) like those who harag (killed) them were harag (killed)?

In saasaah (measure), when you shalach (send) them away, you rayab (contend) with them. He has removed them with his qashah (rough / hard) rawach (spirit / wind) in the yawam (day) of the east qadayam (wind).

Zaath (this), by this the iwan (guilt/iniquity) of Yaiqab (Jacob) will be kapar (forgiven), and zaath (this) is all the paray (fruit) of sawar (taking) away his chataah (sin): that he shawam (place / establish / appoint) all the aban (stone) of the mazabach (altar) as chalk aban (stone) that are napatz (beaten) in pieces, so that the Asharah (Asherim) and the incense altars shall rise no more.

For the batzar (fortified) iyar (city) is badad (solitary), a nawah (habitation) deserted and forsaken, like the madabar (wilderness). The igal (calf) will raih (feed) there, and there he will rabatz (lie) down, and kalah (complete / finish) its branches.

When its qatzayar (boughs) are yabash (dry land), they will be shabar (broken) off. The ashah (wife/individual woman) will bawaa (come) and set them on awar (light), for they are a im (people / nation) of no bayanah (understanding). Therefore he who ishah (make) them will not racham (have) compassion on them, and he who yatzar (formed) them will show them no favor.

It will happen in that yawam (day), that Yahawah will chabat (thresh) from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the nachal (stream / river) of Matzarayam (Egypt); and you will be laqat (gathered) achad (one) by achad (one), ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel).

It will happen in that yawam (day) that a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) shawapar (Shawapar(Shofar) - Ram's horn (instrument)) will be thaqai (blow / sound alarm); and those who were ready to abad (destroy/perish) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Ashawar (Assyria), and those who were nadach (outcasts) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), shall bawaa (come); and they will shachah (worship) Yahawah in the qadash (set apart/make holy) har (mountain) at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Haway (Alas/Woe!) To the itarah (crown) of gaawath (pride) of the drunkards of Aparayam (Ephraim), and to the nabal (fading) tzayatz (flower) of his tzabay (glorious) thapaarah (beauty), which is on the raash (head) of the fertile gayaa (valley) of those who are halam (overcome) with yayan (wine)!

Behold, the Adanay has a chazaq (mighty) and amayatz (strong) one. Like a zaram (storm) of barad (hail), a qatab (destroying) shair (storm), and like a zaram (storm) of kabayar (mighty) mayam (Waters) shatap (overflowing), he will yanach (cast) them down to the aratz (Earth/land) with his yad (hand).
The itarah (crown) of gaawath (pride) of the drunkards of Aparayam (Ephraim) will be ramas (trodden) under ragal (feet / foot).

The nabal (fading) tzayatzah (flower) of his tzabay (glorious) thapaarah (beauty), which is on the raash (head) of the fertile gayaa (valley), shall be like the first-ripe fig before the qayatz (summer); which someone picks and balai (eats) as soon as he raah (see) it.
In that yawam (day), Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) will become a itarah (crown) of glory, and a tzapayarah (diadem) of thapaarah (beauty), to the shaar (residue) of his im (people / nation);

And a rawach (spirit / wind) of mashapat (justice) to him who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in mashapat (judgment), and gabawarah (strength) to those who shawab (turn back / repent) back the malachamah (battle) at the shair (gate).

They also reel with yayan (wine), and thaih (stagger) with shakar (strong) drink. The kahan (priest) and the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) reel with shakar (strong) drink. They are balai (swallowed) up by yayan (wine). They thaih (stagger) with shakar (strong) drink. They shagah (err) in raah (visible/appear). They pawaq (stumble) in palayalayah (judgment).
For all shalachan (tables) are completely malaa (full) of filthy qaa (vomit) and tzawaah (filthiness).
Whom will he yarah (teach) daih (knowledge)? To whom will he explain the message? Those who are weaned from the chalab (milk), and ithayaq (drawn) from the shad (breasts)?
For it is tzaw (precept) on tzaw (precept), tzaw (precept) on tzaw (precept); qaw (line) on qaw (line), qaw (line) on qaw (line); here a zaiyar (little), there a zaiyar (little).
But he will dabar (word / matter) to this im (people / nation) with laig (stammering) shapah (lips) and in achar (other) lashawan (tongue/language);
To whom he amar (spoke), "This is the nawach (resting) place. Give manawachah (rest) to iyap (weary);" and "This is the maragaih (refreshing);" yet they would not shamai (hearken / hear).

Therefore the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah will be to them tzaw (precept) on tzaw (precept), tzaw (precept) on tzaw (precept); qaw (line) on qaw (line), qaw (line) on qaw (line); here a zaiyar (little), there a zaiyar (little); that they may yalak (go), kashal (stumble / stagger) backward, be shabar (broken), be yaqash (snared), and be lakad (taken).
Therefore shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, you latzawan (scoffers), that mashal (rule/have dominion) this ayash (husband/individual man) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem):

Because you have amar (spoke), ‘We have karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) with mawath (death), and with shaawal (Shaawal/afterlife) are we in chazah (agreement). When the shatap (overflowing) shayat (scourge) passes ibar (pass over/through), it won't bawaa (come) to us; for we have shawam (place / establish / appoint) kazab (lies) our machasah (refuge), and we have sathar (hidden) ourselves under falsehood.’

Therefore thus amar (spoke) the Adanay Yahawah, Behold, I yasad (lay) in Tzayawan (Zion) for a foundation a aban (stone), a bachan (tried) aban (stone), a yaqar (precious) cornerstone of a yasad (sure) mawasad (foundation). He who aman (believe / have faith) shall not act hastily.

I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) mashapat (justice) the measuring qaw (line), and tzadaqah (righteousness) the plumb line. The barad (hail) will yaih (sweep) away the machasah (refuge) of kazab (lies), and the mayam (Waters) will shatap (overflow) the sathar (secret / hidden) place.

Your barayath (covenant) with mawath (death) shall be annulled, and your chazawath (agreement) with shaawal (Shaawal/afterlife) shall not qawam (rise up). When the shatap (overflowing) shawat (scourge) passes ibar (pass over/through), then you will be trampled down by it.

As often as it passes ibar (pass over/through), it will laqach (take / seized) you; for baqar (morning) by baqar (morning) it will ibar (pass over/through) through, by yawam (day) and by layal (night); and it will be nothing but terror to bayan (between) the message.
For the matzai (bed) is too qatzar (short) to sharai (stretch) out on, and the blanket is too narrow to kanas (wrap) oneself in.

For Yahawah will qawam (rise up) up as on har (mountain) Paratzayam (Perazim). He will be angry as in the imaq (valley) of Gabaiwan (Gibeon); that he may ishah (make) his maishah (work), his unusual maishah (work), and ibad (servant) to pass his ibadah (act), his extraordinary ibadah (act).

Now therefore don't be lawatz (scoffers), lest your mawasar (bonds) be chazaq (made) strong; for I have shamai (hearken / hear) a charatz (decree) of destruction from the Adanay, Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), on the whole aratz (Earth/land).
Azan (give) ear, and shamai (hearken / hear) my qawal (sound / voice)! Listen, and shamai (hearken / hear) my amarah (sayings)!
Does he who charash (plows) to zarai (sow) charash (plow) yawam (day)? Does he keep turning the soil and shadad (breaking) the clods?

When he has leveled its surface, doesn't he plant the dill, and zaraq (scatter) the cumin seed, and shawam (place / establish / appoint) in the chatah (wheat) in rows, the shairah (barley) in the saman (appointed) place, and the spelt in its gabawalah (place)?
For his Alahayam yasar (instructs) him in right mashapat (judgment), and teaches him.

For the dill are not dawash (threshed) with a charawatz (sharp) instrument, neither is a igalah (cart) awapan (wheel) sabab (turned) over the cumin; but the dill is chabat (beaten) out with a stick, and the cumin with a shabat (rod).

Lacham (bread) flour must be daqaq (ground); so he will not natzach (always) be adash (threshing) it. Although he drives the galagal (wheel) of his threshing igalah (cart) over it, his horses don't grind it.
This also yatzaa (go out / come out) forth from Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), who is palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) in itzah (counsel), and gadal (excellent) in thawashayah (wisdom).
Haway (Alas/Woe!) To Arayaal (Ariel)! Arayaal (Ariel), the qarayah (city) where Dawad (David) chanah (encamped)! Sapah (add) shanah (year) to shanah (year); let the chag (feast/festival) come around;
Then I will tzawaq (distress) Arayaal (Ariel), and there will be thaanayah (mourning) and anayah (lamentation). She shall be Arayaal (to) me as an altar hearth.
I will chanah (encamp) against you all around you, and will tzawar (lay) siege against you with posted troops. I will qawam (rise up) siege works qawam (rise up) you.

You will be shapal (brought) down, and will dabar (word / matter) out of the aratz (Earth/land). Your amarah (sayings) will mumble out of the ipar (dust). Your qawal (sound / voice) will be as of one who has a familiar awab (spirit), out of the aratz (Earth/land), and your amarah (sayings) will tzapap (whisper) out of the ipar (dust).

But the hamawan (multitude) of your foes will be like fine abaq (dust), and the hamawan (multitude) of the ruthless irayatz (ones) like matz (chaff) that blows ibar (pass over/through). Yes, it will be in an pathai (instant), pathaawam (suddenly).

She will be paqad (visit) by Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) with raim (thunder), with raish (earthquake), with gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qawal (sound / voice), with sawapah (whirlwind) and sair (storm), and with the lahab (flame) of a akal (eat) ash (fire).

The hamawan (multitude) of all the gaway (nation / people) that tzabaa (troop) against Arayaal (Ariel), even all who tzabaa (troop) against her and her stronghold, and who tzawaq (distress) her, will be like a chalawam (dream), a chazawan (vision) of the layal (night).

It will be like when a raib (hungry) chalam (dream) dreams, and behold, he akal (eat); but he qawatz (awakes), and his hunger isn't satisfied; or like when a thirsty tzamaa (man) dreams, and behold, he shathah (drinks); but he qawatz (awakes), and behold, he is iyap (faint), and he is still thirsty. The hamawan (multitude) of all the gaway (nation / people) that tzabaa (troop) against har (mountain) Tzayawan (Zion) will be like that.
Pause and thamah (wonder)! Blind yourselves and be blind! They are shakar (drunken), but not with yayan (wine); they nawai (stagger), but not with shakar (strong) drink.

For Yahawah has nasak (poured) out on you a rawach (spirit / wind) of tharadamah (deep) sleep, and has itzam (closed) your iyan (eye), the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy); and he has kasah (covered) your raash (head), the chazah (seers).

All chazawath (vision) has become to you like the dabar (word / matter) of a sapar (book / scribed document) that is chatham (sealed), which men nathan (give) to yadai (one) who is educated, amar (spoke), "qaraa (called) this, please;" and he amar (spoke), I can't, for it is chatham (sealed):
And the sapar (book / scribed document) is nathan (give) to yadai (one) who is not educated, amar (spoke), "qaraa (called) this, please;" and he amar (spoke), I can't read.

The Adanay amar (spoke), yain (because) this im (people / nation) nagash (draws) near with their pah (mouth) and with their shapah (lips) to honor me, but they have rachaq (removed) their lab (heart) rachaq (far) from me, and their yaraa (fear) of me is a commandment of im (people / nation) which has been lamad (teach/instruct);

Therefore, behold, I will yasap (proceed) to do a marvelous palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) among this im (people / nation), even a marvelous palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) and a palaa (wonder); and the chakamah (wisdom) of their chakam (wise) men will abad (destroy/perish), and the bayanah (understanding) of their bayan (between) men will be sathar (hidden).

Haway (Alas/Woe!) To those who imaq (deeply) sathar (hide) their itzah (counsel) from Yahawah, and whose maishah (works) are in the machashak (dark), and who amar (spoke), "Who raah (see) us?" And Who yadai (knows) us?

You turn things hapak (upside) down! Should the yatzar (potter) be chashab (thought) to be like chamar (clay); that the thing ishah (make) should amar (spoke) ishah (make) him who made it, "He didn't ishah (make) me;" or the thing formed amar (spoke) of him who yatzar (formed) it, He has no bayan (between)?

Isn't it yet a very mait (little) while, and Labanawan (Lebanon) will be shawab (turn back / repent) into a karamal (fruitful) field, and the karamal (fruitful) field will be chashab (regarded) as a yair (forest)?

In that yawam (day), the charash (deaf) will shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of the sapar (book / scribed document), and the iyan (eye) of the iwar (blind) will raah (see) out of apal (obscurity) and out of chashak (darkness).
The inaw (humble) also will yasap (increase) their shamachah (joy) in Yahawah, and the abayawan (poor) among adam (men) will gayal (rejoice) in the qadawash (holy) One of Yasharaal (Israel).
For the ruthless is apas (brought) to nothing, and the lawatz (scoffer) kalah (complete / finish), and all those who are alert to do awan (evil) are karath (cut) off—
Who cause a adam (person) to be indicted by a dabar (word / matter), and qawash (lay) a snare for the arbiter in the shair (gate), and who deprive the innocent of justice with false testimony.

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, who padah (redeemed) Abaraham (Abraham), concerning the bayath (house) of Yaiqab (Jacob): Yaiqab (Jacob) shall no longer be bawash (ashamed), neither shall his panayam (face) grow chawar (pale).

But when he raah (see) his yalad (birth / begot), the maishah (work) of my yad (hand), in the qarab (among / near) of him, they will qadash (set apart/make holy) my sham (name). Yes, they will qadash (set apart/make holy) the qadawash (holy) One of Yaiqab (Jacob), and will stand in awe of the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel).
They also who thaih (err) in rawach (spirit / wind) yadai (will) come to bayanah (understanding), and those who grumble will receive instruction.

"Haway (Alas/Woe!) To the sarar (rebellious) ban (son)," naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, who ishah (make) itzah (counsel), but not from me; and who make an alliance, but not with my rawach (spirit / wind), that they may sapah (add) chataah (sin) to chataah (sin),

Who set out to yarad (go) down into Matzarayam (Egypt), and have not shaal (asked) my advice; to izaz (strengthen) themselves in the maiwaz (stronghold / fortress / protection) of Paraih (Pharaoh), and to take chasah (refuge) in the tzal (shadow) of Matzarayam (Egypt)!
Therefore the maiwaz (stronghold / fortress / protection) of Paraih (Pharaoh) will be your bashath (shame), and the refuge in the tzal (shadow) of Matzarayam (Egypt) your kalamah (confusion).
For their shar (prince / ruler) are at Tzain (Zoan), and their malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) have nagai (come) to Chanas (Hanes).

They shall all be bashath (ashamed) because of a im (people / nation) that can't yail (profit) them, that are not a izar (help) nor yail (profit), but a bashath (shame), and also a charapah (reproach).

The mashaa (burden) of the animals of the nagab (south). Through the aratz (Earth/land) of tzarah (trouble) and tzawaq (anguish), of the lioness and the layash (lion), the apaih (viper) and sharap (fiery) iwap (flying) serpent, they nashaa (lift) their riches on the kathap (shoulders) of iyar (young) donkeys, and their awatzar (treasures) on the humps of gamal (camels), to an unprofitable im (people / nation).
For Matzarayam (Egypt) izar (helps) in habal (vain), and to no rayaq (purpose); therefore have I qaraa (called) her rahab (rahab) who shabath (shabath/rest) still.

Now bawaa (come), kathab (write) it before them on a tablet, and inscribe it in a sapar (book / scribed document), that it may be for the yawam (day) to acharawan (come) iwalam (forever) and yawam (day).
For it is a rebellious im (people / nation), kachash (lying) ban (son), ban (son) who abah (be willing / desire) not shamai (hearken / hear) the thawarah (instruction) of Yahawah;

Who amar (spoke) the seers, "Don't raah (see)!" And to the chazah (prophets), Don't chazah (prophesy) to us nakachah (right) things. Dabar (word / matter) us pleasant things. Chazah (prophesy) mahathalah (deceits).
Sawar (get) out of the darak (way). Natah (turn) aside from the arach (path). Cause the qadawash (holy) One of Yasharaal (Israel) to shabath (shabath/rest) from panayam (before) us.

Therefore thus amar (spoke) the qadawash (holy) One of Yasharaal (Israel), Because you maas (despise) this dabar (word / matter), and batach (trust) in ishaq (oppression) and lawaz (perverseness), and shain (rely) on it;

Therefore this iwan (guilt/iniquity) shall be to you like a paratz (breach) napal (fall / be cast down) to fall, baih (swelling) out in a shagab (high) chawamah (wall), whose shabar (breaking) bawaa (come) pathaawam (suddenly) in an pathai (instant).

He will shabar (break) it as a yatzar (potter's) nabal (vessel) is shabar (broken), breaking it in kathath (pieces) without chamal (sparing), so that there won't be matzaa (found) among the broken piece a piece good enough to chathah (take) ash (fire) from the yaqad (hearth), or to dip up mayam (Waters) out of the cistern.

For thus amar (spoke) the Adanay Yahawah, the qadawash (holy) One of Yasharaal (Israel), "You will be yashai (salvation) in shawabah (returning) and nachath (rest). Your gabawarah (strength) will be in shaqat (quietness) and in batachah (confidence)." You refused,

But you amar (spoke), "No, for we will nawas (flee) on sawas (horses);" therefore you will nawas (flee); and, "We will rakab (ride) on the qal (swift);" therefore those who radap (pursue) you will be qalal (swift).

Achad (one) alap (thousand) will flee at the threat of achad (one). At the threat of chamash (five), you will nawas (flee) until you are yathar (left) like a tharan (beacon) on the raash (head) of a har (mountain), and like a nas (banner) on a gabaih (hill).

Therefore Yahawah will chakah (wait), that he may be gracious to you; and therefore he will be rawam (will lift up), that he may have racham (mercy) on you, for Yahawah is a Alahayam of mashapat (justice). Ashar (who/that) are all those who chakah (wait) for him.

For the im (people / nation) will yashab (inhabit/dwell) in Tzayawan (Zion) at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). You will bakah (weep) no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the qawal (sound / voice) of your qawal (sound / voice). When he shamai (hearken / hear) you, he will inah (answer / respond) you.

Though the Adanay may nathan (give) you the lacham (bread) of adversity and the mayam (Waters) of lachatz (affliction), yet your teachers won't be hidden anymore, but your iyan (eye) will raah (see) your teachers;

And when you aman (believe / have faith) to the right hand, and when you shamaal (turn) to the left, your azan (ears) will shamai (hearken / hear) a dabar (word / matter) achar (other) you, amar (spoke), This is the darak (way). Yalak (walk) in it.

You shall tamaa (defile) the tzapaway (overlaying) of your engraved pasayal (images) of kasap (silver), and the plating of your masakah (molten) images of zahab (gold). You shall zarah (cast) them away as an dawah (unclean) thing. You shall amar (spoke) it, yatzaa (go out / come out) away!

He will nathan (give) the matar (rain) for your zarai (seed), with which you will zarai (sow) the adamah (ground); and lacham (bread) of the thabawaah (increase) of the adamah (ground) will be rich and plentiful. In that yawam (day), your livestock will raih (feed) in rachab (large) kar (pastures).

The alap (oxen) likewise and the iyar (young) donkeys that ibad (servant) the adamah (ground) will akal (eat) savory balayal (provender), which has been zarah (winnowed) with the rachath (shovel) and with the fork.

There shall be brooks and yabal (streams) of mayam (Waters) on every gabah (lofty) har (mountain) and on every nashaa (lift) gabaih (hill) in the yawam (day) of the rab (great) harag (slaughter), when the magadal (towers) napal (fall / be cast down).

Moreover the awar (light) of the labanah (moon) will be like the awar (light) of the chamah (sun), and the awar (light) of the chamah (sun) will be shabai (seven) times brighter, like the awar (light) of shabai (seven) yawam (day), in the yawam (day) that Yahawah chabash (binds) up the fracture of his im (people / nation), and rapaa (heals) the makah (wound) they were struck with.

Behold, the sham (name) of Yahawah bawaa (come) from marachaq (far) bair (away), burning with his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), and in thick rising kabad (smoke). His shapah (lips) are malaa (full) of zaim (indignation), and his lashawan (tongue/language) is as a akal (eat) ash (fire).

His rawach (spirit / wind) is as an shatap (overflowing) nachal (stream / river) that reaches even to the tzawaar (neck), to nawap (sift) the gaway (nation / people) with the napah (sieve) of destruction; and a rasan (bridle) that leads to ruin will be in the lachay (jaws) of the im (people / nation).

You will have a shayar (song), as in the layal (night) when a qadash (set apart/make holy) chag (feast/festival) is qadash (set apart/make holy); and shamachah (gladness) of labab (heart), as when one halak (move) with a flute to bawaa (come) to yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) har (mountain), to Yasharaal (Israel's) tzawar (rock).

Yahawah will cause his hawad (glorious) qawal (sound / voice) to be shamai (hearken / hear), and will show the descent of his zarawai (arm), with the zaip (indignation) of his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), and the lahab (flame) of a akal (eat) ash (fire), with a blast, zaram (storm), and hailstones.
For through the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah the Ashawar (Assyrian) will be chathath (dismayed). He will nakah (strike) him with his shabat (rod).

Kal (every) stroke of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of punishment, which Yahawah will nawach (lay) on him, will be with the sound of tambourines and kanawar (harps). He will lacham (fight) with them in malachamah (battles), brandishing weapons.

Thapathah (For) his burning place has long been ready. Yes, for the malak (king) it is kawan (prepared). He has made its pyre imaq (deep) and rachab (large) with ash (fire) and much itz (wood). Yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) nashamah (breathing thing), like a nachal (stream / river) of sulfur, bair (kindles) it.

Haway (Alas/Woe!) To those who yarad (go) down to Matzarayam (Egypt) for izarah (help), and shain (rely) on sawas (horses), and batach (trust) in rakab (chariots) because they are many, and in horsemen because they are very itzam (strong), but they don't shaih (look) to the qadawash (holy) One of Yasharaal (Israel), and they don't darash (seek) Yahawah!

Yet he also is chakam (wise), and will bawaa (come) disaster, and will not sawar (call) back his dabar (word / matter), but will qawam (rise up) against the bayath (house) of the evildoers, and against the izarah (help) of those who pail (work) awan (iniquity).

Now the Matzarayam (Egyptians) are adam (men), and not Al; and their sawas (horses) bashar (flesh), and not rawach (spirit / wind). When Yahawah stretches out his yad (hand), both he who izar (helps) shall kashal (stumble / stagger), and he who is izar (helped) shall napal (fall / be cast down), and they all shall be kalah (complete / finish) yachad (together).

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah to me, As the aray (lion) and the young kapayar (lion) growling over his tarap (prey), if a malaa (multitude) of raih (shepherds) is qaraa (called) together against him, will not be chathath (dismayed) at their qawal (sound / voice), nor inah (oppress / afflict) himself for their hamawan (noise), so Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) will yarad (come) down to tzabaa (troop) on har (mountain) Tzayawan (Zion) and on its heights.
As tzapawar (birds) hovering, so Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) will protect Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). He will protect and natzal (deliver) it. He will pasach (pass) over and malat (preserve) it.
Shawab (turn back / repent) to him from whom you imaq (have) deeply sarah (revolted), ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel).
For in that yawam (day) everyone shall maas (cast) away his alayal (idols) of kasap (silver) and his alayal (idols) of zahab (gold) — chataa (sin) which your own yad (hand) ishah (make) made for you.

"The Ashawar (Assyrian) will napal (fall / be cast down) by the charab (sword), not of ayash (husband/individual man); and the charab (sword), not of mankind, shall akal (eat) him. He will nawas (flee) from the charab (sword), and his bachawar (young) men will become subject to forced mas (labor).

His salai (rock) will ibar (pass over/through) away by reason of magawar (terror), and his shar (prince / ruler) will be afraid of the nas (banner)," naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, whose awar (light) is in Tzayawan (Zion), and his thanawar (furnace) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
Behold, a malak (king) shall malak (king) in tzadaq (righteous / just / fair), and shar (prince / ruler) shall sharar (rule) in mashapat (justice).

A ayash (husband/individual man) shall be as a machabaa (hiding) place from the rawach (spirit / wind), and a sathar (secret / hidden) from the zaram (storm), as palag (streams) of mayam (Waters) in a tzayawan (dry) place, as the tzal (shade) of a large salai (rock) in a iyap (weary) aratz (Earth/land).
The iyan (eye) of those who raah (see) will not be shaih (dim), and the azan (ears) of those who shamai (hearken / hear) will listen.

The labab (heart) of the mahar (rash) will bayan (between) yadai (knowledge), and the lashawan (tongue/language) of the ilag (stammerers) will be mahar (ready) to dabar (word / matter) tzach (plainly).
The nabal (fool) will no longer be qaraa (called) nadayab (noble), nor the scoundrel be highly respected.

For the nabal (fool) will dabar (word / matter) nabalah (folly), and his lab (heart) will ishah (make) awan (iniquity), to practice profanity, and to dabar (word / matter) thawaih (error) against Yahawah, To make rawaq (empty) the napash (living being/soul) of the raib (hungry), and to cause the mashaqah (drink) of the thirsty to chasar (fail).

The kalay (ways) of the scoundrel are rai (evil). He yaitz (devises) zamah (wicked) devices to chabal (destroy) the inaw (humble) with shaqar (lying) amar (spoke), even when the abayawan (needy) dabar (word / matter) mashapat (right).
But the nadayab (noble) yaitz (devises) nadayab (noble) things; and he will continue in nadayab (noble) things.

Qawam (rise up) up, you ashah (wife/individual woman) who are at shaanan (ease)! Shamai (hearken / hear) my qawal (sound / voice)! You batach (careless) bath (daughter), azan (give) ear to my amarah (sayings)!
For yawam (day) beyond a shanah (year) you will be ragaz (troubled), you batach (careless) women; for the batzayar (vintage) shall kalah (complete / finish). The harvest won't bawaa (come).
Charad (tremble), you women who are at shaanan (ease)! Be ragaz (troubled), you batach (careless) ones! Pashat (strip) yourselves, irar (make) yourselves naked, and put sackcloth on your waist.
Beat your shad (breasts) for the chamad (pleasant) shadah (fields), for the parah (fruitful) gapan (vine).
Qawatz (thorns) and briars will ilah (go up / offer) up on my im (people / nation) adamah (land); yes, on all the bayath (house) of mashawash (joy) in the ilayaz (joyous) qarayah (city).

For the aramawan (palace) will be forsaken. The populous iyar (city) will be deserted. The hill and the watchtower will be for mairah (dens) id (forever), a delight for paraa (wild) donkeys, a maraih (pasture) of idar (flocks);

Until the rawach (spirit / wind) is irah (poured) on us from on marawam (high), and the madabar (wilderness) becomes a karamal (fruitful) field, and the karamal (fruitful) field is chashab (considered) a yair (forest).
Then mashapat (justice) will shakan (dwell) in the madabar (wilderness); and tzadaqah (righteousness) will yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the karamal (fruitful) field.
The maishah (work) of tzadaqah (righteousness) will be shalawam (peace / safety); and the ibadah (effect) of tzadaqah (righteousness), shaqat (quietness) and batach (confidence) iwalam (forever).
My im (people / nation) will live in a peaceful nawah (habitation), in safe mashakan (dwellings), and in shaanan (quiet) manawachah (resting) places.
Though barad (hail) flattens the yair (forest), and the iyar (city) is leveled completely.
Ashar (who/that) are you who zarai (sow) beside all mayam (Waters), who shalach (send) out the ragal (feet / foot) of the shawar (ox) and the donkey.

Haway (Alas/Woe!) To you who shadad (destroy), but you weren't shadad (destroyed); and who betray, but nobody betrayed you! When you thamam (have) finished shadad (destroying), you will be shadad (destroyed); and when you have nalah (made) an end of betrayal, you will be betrayed.
Yahawah, be gracious to us. We have qawah (gather/wait) for you. Be our zarawai (strength) every baqar (morning), our yashawaih (salvation) also in the ith (time) of tzarah (trouble).
At the qawal (sound / voice) of the thunder, the im (people / nation) have nadad (fled). When you lift yourself up, the gaway (nation / people) are napatz (scattered).
Your shalal (spoil) will be asap (gathered) as the chasayal (caterpillar) gathers. Men will leap on it as gab (locusts) leap.
Yahawah is shagab (exalted), for he shakan (dwells) on marawam (high). He malaa (has) filled Tzayawan (Zion) with mashapat (justice) and tzadaqah (righteousness).
There will be amawanah (stability) in your ith (times), abundance of yashawaih (salvation), chakamah (wisdom), and daith (knowledge). The yaraah (fear) of Yahawah is your awatzar (treasure).
Behold, their araal (valiant) ones tzaiq (cry) outside; the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of shalawam (peace / safety) bakah (weep) bitterly.

The masalah (highways) are shamam (desolate). The traveling ibar (pass over/through) shabath (shabath/rest). The barayath (covenant) is parar (broken). He has maas (despised) the iyar (cities). He doesn't respect anawash (man).

The aratz (Earth/land) abal (mourns) and languishes. Labanawan (Lebanon) is chapar (confounded) and qamal (withers) away. Sharawan (Sharon) is like a irabah (desert), and Bashan (Bashan) and Karamal (Carmel) are stripped bare.
"Now I will qawam (rise up)," amar (spoke) Yahawah; Now I will nashaa (lift) myself up. Now I will be nashaa (lift).
You will harah (conceive) chashash (chaff). You will yalad (birth / begot) forth qash (stubble). Your rawach (spirit / wind) is a ash (fire) that will akal (eat) you.
The im (people / nation) will be like the burning of shayad (lime), like qawatz (thorns) that are kasach (cut) down and yatzath (burned) in the ash (fire).
Shamai (hearken / hear), you who are rachawaq (far) off, what I ishah (make) done; and, you who are qarawab (near), yadai (acknowledge) my gabawarah (might).

The chataa (sinners) in Tzayawan (Zion) are pachad (fear / dread). Trembling achaz (has) seized the godless gawar (ones). Who among us can live with the akal (eat) ash (fire)? Who among us can live with iwalam (forever) mawaqad (burning)?

He who halak (move) righteously, and dabar (word / matter) blamelessly; He who maas (despises) the batzai (gain) of maishaqah (oppressions), who gestures with his kap (hands), refusing to thamak (take) a shachad (bribe), who atam (stops) his azan (ears) from shamai (hearken / hear) of dam (blood), and itzam (shuts) his iyan (eye) from raah (see) at rai (evil)—
He will shakan (dwell) on marawam (high). His place of defense will be the fortress of salai (rocks). His lacham (bread) will be supplied. His mayam (Waters) will be aman (believe / have faith).
Your iyan (eye) will chazah (see) the malak (king) in his yapay (beauty). They will raah (see) a distant aratz (Earth/land).
Your lab (heart) will hagah (meditate) on the ayamah (terror). Where is he who sapar (book)? Where is he who shaqal (weighed)? Where is he who sapar (book) the magadal (towers)?

You will no longer raah (see) the yaiz (fierce) im (people / nation), a im (people / nation) of a deep shapah (speech) that you can't comprehend, with a strange lashawan (tongue/language) that you can't understand.

Chazah (look) at Tzayawan (Zion), the qarayah (city) of our mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) festivals. Your iyan (eye) will raah (see) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), a shaanan (quiet) nawah (habitation), a ahal (tent) that won't be removed. Its yathad (stakes) will never be plucked up, nor will any of its chabal (cords) be nathaq (broken).

But there Yahawah will be with us in majesty, a maqawam (place) of rachab (broad) nahar (rivers) and yaar (streams), in which no anay (galley) with shayat (oars) will yalak (go), neither will any adayar (gallant) tzay (ship) ibar (pass over/through) by there.
For Yahawah is our shapat (judge). Yahawah is our chaqaq (lawgiver). Yahawah is our malak (king). He will yashai (salvation) us.

Your rigging is untied. They couldn't chazaq (strengthen) the kan (for sure) of their tharan (mast). They couldn't parash (spread) the nas (sail). Then the id (prey) of a marabah (great) shalal (spoil) was chalaq (divided). The pasach (lame) bazaz (took) the baz (prey).
The shakan (inhabitant) won't amar (spoke), "I am chalah (afflict)." The im (people / nation) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein will be nashaa (lift) their iwan (guilt/iniquity).

Qarab (come close) near, you gaway (nation / people), to shamai (hearken / hear)! Listen, you laam (peoples). Let the aratz (Earth/land) and malaa (all) it contains shamai (hearken / hear); the thabal (world), and everything that comes from it.

For Yahawah is enraged against all the gaway (nation / people), and angry with all their tzabaa (troop). He charam (has) utterly destroyed them. He nathan (give) given them over for tabach (slaughter).
Their chalal (slain) will also be shalak (cast) out, and the stench of their pagar (dead) bodies will ilah (go up / offer) up; and the har (mountain) will masas (melt) in their dam (blood).

All of the tzabaa (troop) of the sky will be maqaq (dissolved). The sky will be galal (rolled) up like a sapar (book / scribed document), and all its tzabaa (troop) will nabal (fade) away, as a ilah (leaf) nabal (fades) from off a gapan (vine) or a thaan (fig) tree.
For my charab (sword) has rawah (drunk) its fill in the sky. Behold, it will yarad (come) down on Adam (Edom), and on the im (people / nation) of my charam (curse), for mashapat (judgment).

Yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) charab (sword) is malaa (filled) with dam (blood). It is covered with dashan (fat), with the dam (blood) of kar (lambs) and ithawad (goats), with the chalab (fat) of the kalayah (kidneys) of ayal (rams); for Yahawah has a zabach (sacrifice) in Batzarah (Bozrah), And a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) tabach (slaughter) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Adam (Edom).

The wild oxen will yarad (come) down with them, and the young par (bulls) with the abayar (mighty) bulls; and their aratz (Earth/land) will be rawah (drunken) with dam (blood), and their ipar (dust) dashan (made) greasy with chalab (fat).
For Yahawah has a yawam (day) of naqam (vengeance), a shanah (year) of shalawam (peace / safety) for the rayab (cause) of Tzayawan (Zion).
Its nachal (stream / river) will be hapak (turned) into zapath (pitch), its ipar (dust) into sulfur, And its aratz (Earth/land) will become bair (burning) zapath (pitch).

It won't be kabah (quenched) layal (night) nor yawamam (by day). Its ishan (smoke) will ilah (go up / offer) up iwalam (forever). From dawar (generation / age / period) to dawar (generation / age / period), it will charab (lie) waste. No one will ibar (pass over/through) through it natzach (forever) and natzach (ever).

But the pelican and the porcupine will yarash (possess) it. The yanashawap (owl) and the irab (evening) will shakan (dwell) in it. He will natah (stretch) the qaw (line) of thahaw (formless) over it, and the plumb qaw (line) of bahaw (void).
They shall qaraa (called) its char (nobles) to the malawakah (kingdom), but none shall be there; and all its shar (prince / ruler) shall be apas (nothing).

Sayar (thorns) will ilah (go up / offer) up in its aramawan (palaces), qamawash (nettles) and chawach (thistles) in its fortresses; and it will be a nawah (habitation) of jackals, a chatzayar (court) for ostriches.

The tzayay (wild) animals of the desert will pagash (meet) with the wolves, and the wild shaiyar (goat) will qaraa (called) to his rai (neigbor/another person). Yes, the layalayath (night creature) creature shall settle there, and shall matzaa (find) herself a place of manawach (rest).

The arrow snake will qanan (make) her nest there, and malat (lay), baqai (hatch), and dagar (gather) under her tzal (shade). Yes, the kites will be qabatz (gathered) there, ashah (wife/individual woman) one with her raiwath (mate).

Darash (search) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of Yahawah, and qaraa (called): not achad (one) of these will be missing. Ashah (wife/individual woman) will paqad (visit) her raiwath (mate). For my pah (mouth) has tzawah (commanded), and his rawach (spirit / wind) has qabatz (gathered) them.

He napal (fall / be cast down) cast the gawaral (lot) for them, and his yad (hand) chalaq (has) divided it to them with a measuring qaw (line). They shall yarash (possess) it iwalam (forever). From dawar (generation / age / period) to dawar (generation / age / period) they will shakan (dwell) in it.
The madabar (wilderness) and the dry tzayah (land) will be shawash (glad). The irabah (desert) will gayal (rejoice) and parach (blossom) like a chabatzalath (rose).

It will parach (blossom) parach (abundantly), and gayal (rejoice) even with gayalah (joy) and ranan (singing). Labanawan (Lebanon's) kabawad (glory) Lebanon will be nathan (give) to it, the excellence of Karamal (Carmel) and Sharawan (Sharon). They will raah (see) yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) kabawad (glory), the excellence of our Alahayam.
Chazaq (strengthen) the rapah (weak) yad (hand), and amatz (make) firm the kashal (stumble / stagger) barak (knees).

Amar (spoke) those who have a mahar (fearful) lab (heart), Be chazaq (strong). Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid). Behold, your Alahayam will bawaa (come) with naqam (vengeance), alahayam (Alahayam) retribution. He will bawaa (come) and yashai (salvation) you.
Then the iyan (eye) of the iwar (blind) will be paqach (opened), and the azan (ears) of the charash (deaf) will be pathach (unstopped).

Then the pasach (lame) man will dalag (leap) like a deer, and the lashawan (tongue/language) of the mute will ranan (sing); for mayam (Waters) will baqai (break) out in the madabar (wilderness), and nachal (stream / river) in the irabah (desert).

The burning sand will become a agam (pool), and the thirsty tzamaawan (ground) mabawai (springs) of mayam (Waters). Chatzayar (grass) with qanah (reeds) and rushes will be in the nawah (habitation) of jackals, rabatz (where) they lay.

A masalawal (highway) will be there, a road, and it will be qaraa (called) The qadash (set apart/make holy) darak (way). The tamaa (unclean) shall not ibar (pass over/through) over it, but it will be for those who walk in the Way. Wicked awayal (fools) will not thaih (go) there.
No aray (lion) will be there, nor will any parayatz (ravenous) animal ilah (go up / offer) up on it. They will not be matzaa (found) there; but the gaal (redeemed) will halak (move) there.

The yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) padah (ransomed) ones will shawab (turn back / repent), and bawaa (come) with ranah (singing) to Tzayawan (Zion); and iwalam (forever) shamachah (joy) will be on their raash (head). They will obtain shamachah (gladness) and shashawan (joy), and yagawan (sorrow) and anachah (sighing) will nawas (flee) away.

Now it happened in the fourteenth shanah (year) of malak (king) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), that Sanacharayab (Sennacherib) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) attacked all of the batzar (fortified) iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and captured them.

The malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) shalach (send) Rabashaqah (Rabshakeh) from Lakayash (Lachish) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to malak (king) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) with a large chayal (army). He imad (stood) by the aqueduct from the ilayawan (upper) barakah (pool) in the kabas (fuller's) shadah (field) masalah (highway).

Then Alayaqayam (Eliakim) the ban (son) Chalaqayah (of) Hilkiah, who was over the bayath (house), and Shabanaa (Shebna) the sapar (book), and Yawaach (Joah), the ban (son) of Asap (Asaph), the zakar (remembrance/memory) yatzaa (go out / come out) out to him.

Rabashaqah (Rabshakeh) amar (spoke) to them, Now amar (spoke) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), ‘Thus amar (spoke) the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) malak (king), the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), What batachawan (confidence) is this in which you trust?

I amar (spoke) that your itzah (counsel) and gabawarah (strength) for the malachamah (war) are only vain dabar (word / matter). Now in whom do you batach (trust), that you have marad (rebelled) against me?

Behold, you batach (trust) in the mashainah (staff) of this ratzatz (bruised) qanah (reed), even in Matzarayam (Egypt), which if a ayash (husband/individual man) samak (leans) on it, it will bawaa (come) into his kap (hand) and naqab (pierce) it. So is Paraih (Pharaoh) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt) to all who batach (trust) in him.

But if you amar (spoke) me, ‘We batach (trust) in Yahawah our Alahayam,’ isn't that he whose bamah (high) places and whose mazabach (altars) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) has sawar (taken) away, and has amar (spoke) to Yahawadah (Judah) and to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), ‘You shall shachah (worship) panayam (before) this mazabach (altar)?’

Now therefore, please make a irab (evening) to my adawan (master / lord) the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), and I will nathan (give) you two alap (thousand) sawas (horses), if you are yakal (able) on your part to nathan (give) riders on them.

How then can you shawab (turn back / repent) away the panayam (face) of achad (one) pachah (captain) of the qatan (small/young/least) of my adawan (master / lord) ibad (servant), and batach (put) your trust on Matzarayam (Egypt) for rakab (chariots) and for horsemen?

Have I ilah (go up / offer) up now balaiday (without) Yahawah against this aratz (Earth/land) to shachath (destroy) it? Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, "ilah (go up / offer) up against this aratz (Earth/land), and shachath (destroy) it."'

Then Alayaqayam (Eliakim), Shabanaa (Shebna) and Yawaach (Joah) amar (spoke) to Rabashaqah (Rabshakeh), Please dabar (word / matter) to your ibad (servant) in Aramaic, for we shamai (hearken / hear) it; and don't dabar (word / matter) to us in the Yahawadayath (Jews)' language in the azan (hearing) of the im (people / nation) who are on the chawamah (wall).

But Rabashaqah (Rabshakeh) amar (spoke), Has my adawan (master / lord) shalach (send) me only to your adawan (master / lord) and to you, to dabar (word / matter) these dabar (word / matter), and not to the ayash (husband/individual man) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the chawamah (wall), who will akal (eat) their own charaa (dung) and shathah (drinks) their own urine with you?

Then Rabashaqah (Rabshakeh) imad (stood), and qaraa (called) out with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qawal (sound / voice) in the Yahawadayath (Jews)' language, and amar (spoke), shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) malak (king), the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria)!
Thus amar (spoke) the malak (king), ‘Don't let Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) nashaa (lift) you; for he will not be yakal (able) to natzal (deliver) you.

Don't let Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) batach (make) you trust in Yahawah, amar (spoke), "Yahawah will natzal (surely) natzal (deliver) us. This iyar (city) won't be nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria)."’

Don't shamai (hearken / hear) to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), for thus amar (spoke) the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), ‘ishah (make) your barakah (peace) with me, and yatzaa (go out / come out) out to me; and ayash (husband/individual man) of you akal (eat) from his gapan (vine), and ayash (husband/individual man) one from his thaan (fig) tree, and ayash (husband/individual man) one of you shathah (drinks) the mayam (Waters) of his own bawar (cistern);

Until I bawaa (come) and laqach (take / seized) you away to a aratz (Earth/land) like your own aratz (Earth/land), a aratz (Earth/land) of grain and new thayarawash (wine), a aratz (Earth/land) of lacham (bread) and karam (vineyards).

Beware lest Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) sawath (persuade) you, amar (spoke), "Yahawah will natzal (deliver) us." Have any of the Alahayam of the gaway (nation / people) natzal (delivered) their aratz (Earth/land) from the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria)?
Where are the Alahayam of Chamath (Hamath) and Arapad (Arpad)? Where are the Alahayam of Saparawayam (Sepharvaim)? Have they natzal (delivered) Shamarawan (Samaria) from my yad (hand)?

Who are they among all the Alahayam of these aratz (Earth/land) that have natzal (delivered) their aratz (Earth/land) out of my yad (hand), that Yahawah should natzal (deliver) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) out of my yad (hand)?’
But they remained charash (silent), and inah (answer / respond) nothing in reply, for the malak (king) matzawah (commandment) was, Don't dabar (word / matter) him.

Then Alayaqayam (Eliakim) the ban (son) Chalaqayah (of) Hilkiah, who was over the bayath (house), and Shabanaa (Shebna) the sapar (book), and Yawaach (Joah), the ban (son) of Asap (Asaph), the zakar (remembrance/memory), bawaa (come) to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) with their clothes qarai (torn), and nagad (told) him the dabar (word / matter) of Rabashaqah (Rabshakeh).

It happened, when malak (king) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) shamai (hearken / hear) it, that he qarai (tore) his clothes, kasah (covered) himself with sackcloth, and bawaa (come) into yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) bayath (house).

He shalach (send) Alayaqayam (Eliakim), who was over the bayath (house), and Shabanaa (Shebna) the sapar (book), and the zaqan (elders) of the kahan (priest), kasah (covered) with sackcloth, to Yashaiyah (Isaiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), the ban (son) of Amawatz (Amoz).

They amar (spoke) to him, Thus amar (spoke) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), ‘This yawam (day) is a yawam (day) of tzarah (trouble), and of thawakachah (rebuke), and of rejection; for the ban (son) bawaa (come) come to the mashabar (birth), and there is no kach (strength / mighty / power) to yalad (birth / begot) forth.

It may be Yahawah your Alahayam will shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Rabashaqah (Rabshakeh), whom the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) his adawan (master / lord) has shalach (send) to charap (defy) the chay (life) Alahayam, and will yakach (rebuke) the dabar (word / matter) which Yahawah your Alahayam has shamai (hearken / hear). Therefore nashaa (lift) up your thapalah (prayer) for the shaarayath (remnant) that is matzaa (left).’
So the ibad (servant) of malak (king) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) bawaa (come) to Yashaiyah (Isaiah).

Yashaiyah (Isaiah) amar (spoke) to them, amar (spoke) your adawan (master / lord), ‘Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, "Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid) of the dabar (word / matter) that you have shamai (hearken / hear), with which the nair (servants) of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) have gadap (blasphemed) me.

Behold, I will nathan (give) a rawach (spirit / wind) in him and he will shamai (hearken / hear) shamawaih (news), and will shawab (turn back / repent) to his own aratz (Earth/land). I will napal (fall / be cast down) him to fall by the charab (sword) in his own aratz (Earth/land)."’

So Rabashaqah (Rabshakeh) shawab (turn back / repent), and matzaa (found) the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) lacham (warring) against Labanah (Libnah), for he had shamai (hearken / hear) that he was departed from Lakayash (Lachish).

He shamai (hearken / hear) news concerning Tharahaqah (Tirhakah) malak (king) of Kawash (Ethiopia), "He yatzaa (go out / come out) come out to lacham (fight) against you." When he shamai (hearken / hear) it, he shalach (send) malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), amar (spoke),

Thus you shall amar (spoke) to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), amar (spoke), ‘Don't let your Alahayam in whom you batach (trust) nashaa (lift) you, amar (spoke), Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) won't be nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria).
Behold, you have shamai (hearken / hear) what the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) ishah (make) done to all aratz (Earth/land), by charam (destroying) them utterly. Shall you be natzal (delivered)?

Have the Alahayam of the gaway (nation / people) natzal (delivered) them, which my ab (father) have shachath (destroyed), Gawazan (Gozan), Charan (Haran), Ratzap (Rezeph), and the ban (son) of Idan (Eden) who were in Thalaashar (Telassar)?
Where is the malak (king) of Chamath (Hamath), and the malak (king) of Arapad (Arpad), and the malak (king) of the iyar (city) of Saparawayam (Sepharvaim), of Hanai (Hena), and Iwah (Ivvah)?’

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) laqach (take / seized) the sapar (book / scribed document) from the yad (hand) of the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) and qaraa (called) it. Then Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) ilah (go up / offer) up to yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) bayath (house), and parash (spread) it panayam (before) Yahawah.
Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) palal (prayed) to Yahawah, amar (spoke),

Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), who is enthroned among the karawab (cherubim), you are the Alahayam, even you alone, of all the mamalakah (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land). You ishah (make) made shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) and aratz (Earth/land).

Natah (turn) your azan (ear), Yahawah, and shamai (hearken / hear). Paqach (open) your iyan (eye), Yahawah, and raah (see). Shamai (hearken / hear) all of the dabar (word / matter) of Sanacharayab (Sennacherib), who has shalach (send) to charap (defy) the chay (life) Alahayam.
Truly, Yahawah, the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) have charab (destroyed) all the aratz (Earth/land) and their aratz (Earth/land),

And nathan (give) cast their Alahayam into the ash (fire); for they were no Alahayam, but the maishah (work) of adam (men's) yad (hand), itz (wood) and aban (stone); therefore they abad (destroy/perish) destroyed them.
Now therefore, Yahawah our Alahayam, yashai (salvation) us from his yad (hand), that all the mamalakah (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land) may yadai (know) that you are Yahawah, even you only.

Then Yashaiyah (Isaiah) the ban (son) of Amawatz (Amoz) shalach (send) to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), ‘Because you have palal (prayed) to me against Sanacharayab (Sennacherib) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria),

This is the dabar (word / matter) which Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) concerning him. The bathawalah (virgin) bath (daughter) of Tzayawan (Zion) has bazah (despised) you and ridiculed you. The bath (daughter) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) has nawai (shaken) her raash (head) at you.

Whom have you charap (defied) and gadap (blasphemed)? Against whom have you rawam (will lift up) your qawal (sound / voice) and nashaa (lift) up your iyan (eye) on marawam (high)? Against the qadawash (holy) One of Yasharaal (Israel).

By your ibad (servant), have you charap (defied) the Adanay, and have amar (spoke), With the rab (multitude) of my rakab (chariots) I have ilah (go up / offer) up to the marawam (height) of the har (mountain), to the innermost yarakah (parts) of Labanawan (Lebanon). I will karath (cut) down its qawamah (tall) araz (cedars) and its mabachar (choice) barawash (fir) trees. I will bawaa (come) into its farthest marawam (height), the yair (forest) of its Karamal (fruitful) field.
I have qawar (dug) and shathah (drinks) mayam (Waters), and with the kap (sole) of my paim (feet) I will charab (dry) up all the yaar (rivers) Matzawar (of) Egypt.

Have you not shamai (hearken / hear) how I ishah (make) done it rachawaq (long) ago, and yatzar (formed) it in qadam (ancient) yawam (day)? Now I bawaa (come) brought it to pass, that it should be yours to shaah (destroy) batzar (fortified) iyar (cities), turning them into ruinous gal (heaps).

Therefore their yashab (inhabit/dwell) had little yad (hand). They were chathath (dismayed) and bawash (confounded). They were like the ishab (grass) of the shadah (field), and like the yaraq (green) dashaa (herb), like the chatzayar (grass) on the housetops, and like a field panayam (before) its crop has qamah (grown).
But I yadai (know) your sitting down, your yatzaa (go out / come out) out, your bawaa (come) in, and your ragaz (raging) against me.

Because of your ragaz (raging) against me, and because your arrogance has ilah (go up / offer) up into my azan (ears), therefore will I shawam (place / establish / appoint) my chach (hook) in your ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) and my mathag (bridle) in your shapah (lips), and I will shawab (turn back / repent) you back by the darak (way) by which you bawaa (come).

This shall be the awath (sign / mark / miracle) to you. You will akal (eat) this shanah (year) that which sapayach (grows) of itself, and in the shanay (second) shanah (year) that which springs from the same; and in the shalayashay (third) shanah (year) zarai (sow) and qatzar (reap) and natai (plant) karam (vineyards), and akal (eat) their paray (fruit).
The shaar (remnant) that is palayatah (escaped) of the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah) will again take sharash (root) matah (downward), and ishah (make) paray (fruit) upward.

For out of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) a shaarayath (remnant) will yatzaa (go out / come out) forth, and survivors will palayatah (escape) from har (mountain) Tzayawan (Zion). The qanaah (zeal) of Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) will ishah (make) this.’

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah concerning the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), ‘He will not bawaa (come) to this iyar (city), nor yarah (shoot) an chatz (arrow) there, neither will he qadam (come) before it with magan (shield), nor shapak (cast) up a mound against it.
By the darak (way) that he bawaa (come), by the same he shall shawab (turn back / repent), and he shall not bawaa (come) to this iyar (city),’ naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.
‘For I will ganan (defend) this iyar (city) to yashai (salvation) it, for my own sake, and for my ibad (servant) Dawad (David's) sake.’

The malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah yatzaa (go out / come out) out and nakah (struck) one maah (hundred) and shamanayam (eighty) - chamash (five) alap (thousand) men in the machanah (camp) of the Ashawar (Assyrians). When men arose shakam (early) in the baqar (morning), behold, these were all mawath (death) pagar (bodies).
So Sanacharayab (Sennacherib) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) departed, yalak (went) shawab (turn back / repent), returned to Nayanawah (Nineveh), and stayed there.

It happened, as he was shachah (worshipping) in the bayath (house) of Nasarak (Nisroch) his Alahayam, that Adaramalak (Adrammelech) and Sharaatzar (Sharezer) his ban (son) nakah (struck) him with the charab (sword); and they malat (escaped) into the aratz (Earth/land) of Ararat (Ararat). Asarachadawan (Esar) Haddon his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

In those yawam (day) was Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) chalah (afflict) and near mawath (death). Yashaiyah (Isaiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), the ban (son) of Amawatz (Amoz), bawaa (come) to him, and amar (spoke) to him, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, ‘Set your bayath (house) in tzawah (order), for you will mawath (death), and not chayah (live).’
Then Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) sabab (turned) his panayam (face) to the qayar (wall) and palal (prayed) to Yahawah,

And amar (spoke), "zakar (remembrance/memory) now, Yahawah, I beg you, how I have halak (move) panayam (before) you in amath (truth) and with a shalam (full / whole / complete) lab (heart), and ishah (make) done that which is tawab (pleasant/functional) in your iyan (eye)." Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) bakah (wept) bitterly.
Then the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Yashaiyah (Isaiah), amar (spoke),

Halak (move), and amar (spoke) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), ‘Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Dawad (David) your ab (father), “I have shamai (hearken / hear) your thapalah (prayer). I raah (see) seen your damaih (tears). Behold, I will yasap (add) chamash (fifteen) shanah (years) to your yawam (day).
I will natzal (deliver) you and this iyar (city) out of the kap (hand) of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), and I will ganan (defend) this iyar (city).
This shall be the awath (sign / mark / miracle) to you from Yahawah, that Yahawah will ishah (make) this thing that he has dabar (word / matter).

Behold, I will cause the tzal (shadow) on the sundial, which has yarad (gone) down on the sundial of Achaz (Ahaz) with the sun, to shawab (turn back / repent) backward ishar (ten) mailah (ascent/climbing up). So the shamash (sun) shawab (turn back / repent) ishar (ten) mailah (ascent/climbing up) on the sundial on which it had yarad (gone) down.”’
The makathab (writing) of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), when he had been chalah (afflict), and had chayah (recovered) of his chalay (sickness).
I amar (spoke), In the middle of my yawam (day) I yalak (go) into the shair (gates) of shaawal (Shaawal/afterlife). I am deprived of the yathar (residue) of my shanah (years).
I amar (spoke), I won't raah (see) Yah, Yah in the aratz (Earth/land) of the chay (life). I will nabat (see) adam (man) no more with the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the chadal (world).

My dwelling is nasai (removed), and is galah (carried) away from me like a shepherd's ahal (tent). I have rolled up, like a arag (weaver), my chay (life). He will batzai (cut) me off from the loom. From yawam (day) even to layal (night) you will shalam (make) an end of me.
I waited patiently until baqar (morning). He shabar (breaks) all my itzam (bones) like a aray (lion). From yawam (day) even to layal (night) you will shalam (make) an end of me.
I tzapap (chattered) like a igawar (swallow) or a sawas (crane). I moaned like a yawanah (dove). My iyan (eye) weaken looking marawam (upward). Adawan, I am ishaqah (oppressed). Be my security.

What will I dabar (word / matter)? He has both amar (spoke) to me, and himself ishah (make) done it. I will walk carefully all my shanah (years) because of the anguish of my napash (living being/soul).
Adanay, men chayah (live) by these things; and my rawach (spirit / wind) finds chay (life) in all of them: you chalam (dream) me, and cause me to chayah (live).

Behold, for shalawam (peace / safety) I had mar (great) anguish, but you have in chashaq (love) for my napash (living being/soul) delivered it from the shachath (pit) of balay (corruption); for you have shalak (cast) all my chataa (sins) achar (other) your gaw (back).
For shaawal (Shaawal/afterlife) can't yadah (praise) you. Mawath (death) can't halal (praise) you. Those who yarad (go) down into the bawar (pit) can't shabar (hope) for your amath (truth).
The chay (life), the chay (life), he shall yadah (praise) you, as I do this yawam (day). The ab (father) shall yadai (make) known your amath (truth) to the ban (son).
Yahawah will yashai (salvation) me. Therefore we will sing my nagayanah (songs) with nagan (stringed) instruments all the yawam (day) of our chay (life) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah.
Now Yashaiyah (Isaiah) had amar (spoke), Let them nashaa (lift) a dabalah (fig cake) of thaan (figs), and marach (lay) it for a poultice on the shachayan (boil), and he shall chayah (recover).
Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) also had amar (spoke), What is the awath (sign / mark / miracle) that I will ilah (go up / offer) up to the bayath (house) of Yahawah?

At that ith (time), Merodach Balaadan (Baladan) the ban (son) of Balaadan (Baladan), malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), shalach (send) sapar (book / scribed document) and a manachah (present) to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah); for he shamai (hearken / hear) that he had been chalah (afflict), and had chazaq (recovered).

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) was pleased with them, and showed them the bayath (house) of his nakath (precious) things, the kasap (silver), and the zahab (gold), the basham (spices), and the tawab (pleasant/functional) shaman (oil), and all the bayath (house) of his armor, and all that was matzaa (found) in his awatzar (treasures). There was nothing in his bayath (house), nor in all his mamashalah (dominion), that Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) didn't show them.

Then Yashaiyah (Isaiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) bawaa (come) to malak (king) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), and asked him, "What did these ayash (husband/individual man) amar (spoke)? Ayan (where) did they bawaa (come) from to you?" Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) amar (spoke), They bawaa (come) come from a aratz (Earth/land) rachawaq (far) from me, even from Babal (Babylon).

Then he asked, "What raah (see) they seen in your bayath (house)?" Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) amar (spoke), They raah (see) seen all that is in my bayath (house). There is nothing among my awatzar (treasures) that I raah (see) not shown them.
Then Yashaiyah (Isaiah) amar (spoke) to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah of tzabaa (troop):

‘Behold, the yawam (day) are bawaa (come) when all that is in your bayath (house), and that which your ab (father) have atzar (stored) up until this yawam (day), will be nashaa (lift) to Babal (Babylon). Nothing will be yathar (left),’ amar (spoke) Yahawah.

‘They will laqach (take / seized) away your ban (son) who will yatzaa (go out / come out) from you, whom you shall yalad (birth / begot), and they will be sarayas (eunuchs) in the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon's) hayakal (palace).’

Then Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) amar (spoke) to Yashaiyah (Isaiah), "yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) dabar (word / matter) which you have dabar (word / matter) is tawab (pleasant/functional)." He amar (spoke) moreover, For there will be shalawam (peace / safety) and amath (truth) in my yawam (day).
"Nacham (turn away / repent), nacham (turn away / repent) my im (people / nation)," amar (spoke) your Alahayam.

Dabar (word / matter) lab (heart) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and qaraa (called) out to her that her tzabaa (troop) is malaa (accomplished), that her iwan (guilt/iniquity) is ratzah (pardoned), that she has laqach (take / seized) of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) yad (hand) kapal (double) for all her chataah (sin).

The qawal (sound / voice) of one who qaraa (called) out, panah (prepare) the darak (way) of Yahawah in the irabah (wilderness)! Yashar (make) a level masalah (highway) in the irabah (desert) for our Alahayam.

Every gayaa (valley) shall be nashaa (lift), and every har (mountain) and gabaih (hill) shall be shapal (made) low. The uneven shall be made mayashawar (level), and the rakas (rough) places a baqaih (plain).
The kabawad (glory) of Yahawah shall be galah (revealed), and all bashar (flesh) shall raah (see) it yachad (together); for the pah (mouth) of Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) it.

The qawal (sound / voice) of one amar (spoke), "qaraa (called)!" One amar (spoke), "What shall I qaraa (called)?" All bashar (flesh) is like chatzayar (grass), and all its glory is like the tzayatz (flower) of the shadah (field).

The chatzayar (grass) yabash (dry land), the tzayatz (flower) nabal (fades), because yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) rawach (spirit / wind) nashab (blows) on it. Akan (surely) the im (people / nation) are like chatzayar (grass).
The chatzayar (grass) yabash (dry land), the tzayatz (flower) nabal (fades); but the dabar (word / matter) of our Alahayam qawam (rise up) iwalam (forever).

You who tell bashar (good) news to Tzayawan (Zion), ilah (go up / offer) up on a gabah (high) har (mountain). You who tell bashar (good) news to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), rawam (will lift up) up your qawal (sound / voice) with kach (strength / mighty / power). Rawam (will lift up) it up. Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid). Amar (spoke) to the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), Behold, your Alahayam!

Behold, the Adanay Yahawah will bawaa (come) as a chazaq (mighty) one, and his zarawai (arm) will mashal (rule/have dominion) for him. Behold, his shakar (reward) is with him, and his recompense panayam (before) him.

He will raih (feed) his idar (flock) like a raih (shepherd). He will qabatz (gather) the talaa (lambs) in his zarawai (arm), and nashaa (lift) them in his chayaq (bosom). He will nahal (gently) lead those who have their iwal (young).

Who has madad (measured) the mayam (Waters) in the hollow of his shail (hand), and marked off the sky with his zarath (span), and calculated the ipar (dust) of the aratz (Earth/land) in a shalayash (measure), and shaqal (weighed) the har (mountain) in palas (scales), and the gabaih (hills) in a maazan (balance)?
Who has thakan (directed) the rawach (spirit / wind) of Yahawah, or yadai (has) taught him as his counselor?

Who did he take yaitz (counsel) with, and who bayan (between) him, and lamad (teach/instruct) him in the arach (path) of mashapat (justice), and lamad (teach/instruct) him daith (knowledge), and showed him the darak (way) of thabawan (understanding)?

Behold, the gaway (nation / people) are like a mar (drop) in a dalay (bucket), and are chashab (regarded) as a speck of shachaq (dust) on a maazan (balance). Behold, he lifts up the ay (islands) like a very daq (little) thing.
Labanawan (Lebanon) is not day (sufficient) to bair (burn), nor its animals day (sufficient) for a burnt ilah (offering).
All the gaway (nation / people) are chashab (like) nothing before him. They are regarded by him as apas (less) than nothing, and thahaw (formless).
To whom then will you damah (liken) Al? Or what damawath (likeness) will you irak (compare) to him?
A charash (workman) has cast an pasal (idol/graven image), and the tzarap (goldsmith) overlays it with zahab (gold), and tzarap (casts) kasap (silver) rathaqah (chains) for it.

He who is too sakan (impoverished) for such an tharawamah (offering) bachar (chooses) a itz (tree) that will not raqab (rot). He baqash (seeks) a skillful charash (workman) to kawan (set) up an engraved pasal (idol/graven image) for him that will not be mawat (moved).

Haven't you yadai (known)? Haven't you shamai (hearken / hear), yet? Haven't you been nagad (told) from the raash (head)? Haven't you bayan (between) from the mawasadah (foundations) of the aratz (Earth/land)?

It is he who yashab (inhabit/dwell) above the chawag (circle) of the aratz (Earth/land), and its yashab (inhabit/dwell) are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) like a daq (curtain), and mathach (spreads) them out like a ahal (tent) to yashab (inhabit/dwell) in;
Who nathan (give) razan (princes) to nothing; who ishah (make) the shapat (judges) of the aratz (Earth/land) like meaningless.

They are natai (planted) scarcely. They are zarai (sown) scarcely. Their gazai (stock) has scarcely sharash (taken) root in the aratz (Earth/land). He merely nashap (blows) on them, and they yabash (dry land), and the sair (whirlwind) nashaa (lift) them away as qash (stubble).
"To whom then will you damah (liken) me? Who is my shawah (equal)?" Amar (spoke) the qadawash (holy) One.

Nashaa (lift) up your iyan (eye) on marawam (high), and raah (see) who has baraa (created) these, who yatzaa (go out / come out) out their tzabaa (troop) by masapar (number). He qaraa (called) them all by sham (name). By the greatness of his awan (might), and because he is amayatz (strong) in kach (strength / mighty / power), Not ayash (husband/individual man) is idar (lacking).

Why do you amar (spoke), Yaiqab (Jacob), and dabar (word / matter), Yasharaal (Israel), My darak (way) is sathar (hidden) from Yahawah, and the mashapat (justice) due me is disregarded by my Alahayam?

Haven't you yadai (known)? Haven't you shamai (hearken / hear)? The iwalam (forever) Alahayam, Yahawah, The Creator of the ends of the aratz (Earth/land), doesn't yaip (faint). He isn't yagai (weary). His thabawan (understanding) is unsearchable.
He nathan (give) kach (strength / mighty / power) to the weak. He rabah (increases) the itzamah (strength) of him who has no awan (might).
Even the youths yaip (faint) and get yagai (weary), and the bachawar (young) men kashal (stumble / stagger) kashal (stumble / stagger);

But those who qawah (gather/wait) for Yahawah will chalap (renew) their kach (strength / mighty / power). They will ilah (go up / offer) up with abar (wings) like nashar (eagles). They will rawatz (run), and not be yagai (weary). They will yalak (walk), and not yaip (faint).

Charash (keep) silent before me, ay (islands), and let the laam (peoples) chalap (renew) their kach (strength / mighty / power). Let them nagash (come) near, then let them dabar (word / matter). Let's meet yachad (together) for mashapat (judgment).

Who has iwar (rouse / awaken) up one from the mazarach (east)? Who qaraa (called) him to his ragal (feet / foot) in tzadaq (righteous / just / fair)? He nathan (give) over gaway (nation / people) to him, and radah (rule over / have dominion of / subdue) him rule over malak (king). He nathan (give) them like the ipar (dust) to his charab (sword), like the nadap (driven) qash (stubble) to his qashath (bow).
He radap (pursues) them, and passes by safely, Even by a arach (way) that he bawaa (come) not gone with his ragal (feet / foot).
Who has pail (worked) and ishah (make) it, qaraa (called) the dawar (generation / age / period) from the raash (head)? I, Yahawah, the raashawan (first), and with the acharawan (last), I am he.
