Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, imad (stand) in the darak (ways) and raah (see), and shaal (ask) for the iwalam (forever) nathayab (paths), ‘Where is the tawab (pleasant/functional) darak (way)?’ And yalak (walk) in it, and you will matzaa (find) maragawai (rest) for your napash (living being/soul). But they amar (spoke), ‘We will not yalak (walk) in it.’
I qawam (rise up) watchmen over you, saying, ‘Listen to the qawal (sound / voice) of the shawapar (Shawapar(Shofar) - Ram's horn (instrument))!’ But they amar (spoke), ‘We will not listen!’
Therefore shamai (hearken / hear), you gaway (nation / people), and yadai (know), idah (congregation), what is among them.

Shamai (hearken / hear), aratz (Earth/land)! Behold, I will bawaa (come) rai (evil) on this im (people / nation), even the paray (fruit) of their machashabah (thoughts), because they have not listened to my dabar (word / matter); and as for my thawarah (instruction), they have maas (rejected) it.

To what purpose bawaa (come) there to me labawanah (frankincense) from Shabaa (Sheba), and the tawab (pleasant/functional) qanah (cane) from a marachaq (far) aratz (Earth/land)? Your burnt ilah (offerings) are not ratzawan (acceptable), nor your zabach (sacrifices) irab (evening) to me.

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Behold, I will nathan (give) makashawal (stumbling) blocks before this im (people / nation). The ab (father) and the ban (son) yachad (together) shall kashal (stumble / stagger) against them. The neighbor and his rai (neigbor/another person) shall abad (destroy/perish).

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Behold, a im (people / nation) bawaa (come) from the tzapawan (north) aratz (Earth/land). A gadawal (very great/important/mighty) gaway (nation / people) shall be iwar (rouse / awaken) up from the uttermost yarakah (parts) of the aratz (Earth/land).

They chazaq (take) hold of qashath (bow) and kayadawan (spear). They are akazaray (cruel), and have no racham (mercy). Their qawal (sound / voice) hamah (they) like the yam (sea/waters), and they rakab (ride) on sawas (horses), everyone irak (set) in array, as a ayash (husband/individual man) to the malachamah (battle), against you, bath (daughter) of Tzayawan (Zion).
We have shamai (hearken / hear) its report; our yad (hand) become rapah (feeble): tzarah (anguish) has chazaq (taken) hold of us, and chayal (pains) as of a yalad (birth / begot) in labor.

Don't yatzaa (go out / come out) forth into the shadah (field), nor yalak (walk) by the darak (way); for the charab (sword) of the ayab (enemy) and magawar (terror), are on sabayab (surrounding) side.

Bath (daughter) of my im (people / nation), clothe yourself with sackcloth, and wallow in ashes! Mourn, as for an only yachayad (son), most thamarawar (bitter) masapad (lamentation); for the shadad (destroyer) shall pathaawam (suddenly) bawaa (come) on us.
I nathan (give) made you a tester of metals and a mabatzar (fortress) among my im (people / nation); that you may yadai (know) and bachan (try) their darak (way).
They are all sawar (grievous) rebels, halak (move) about with rakayal (slanders); they are nachashath (brass) and barazal (iron): they all of them deal corruptly.

The mapach (bellows) blow fiercely; the iwaparath (lead) is consumed of the ashah (wife/individual woman): in shawaa (vanity) do they go on tzarap (refining); for the rai (wicked) are not nathaq (plucked) away.
Men will qaraa (called) them maas (rejected) kasap (silver), because Yahawah has maas (rejected) them.
The dabar (word / matter) that came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Yahawah, amar (spoke),

Imad (stand) in the shair (gate) of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) bayath (house), and qaraa (called) there this dabar (word / matter), and amar (spoke), ‘shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, all you of Yahawadah (Judah), who bawaa (come) in at these shair (gates) to shachah (worship) Yahawah.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), yatab (amend) your darak (ways) and your mailal (doings), and I will shakan (cause) you to dwell in this maqawam (place).
Don't batach (trust) in shaqar (lying) dabar (word / matter), amar (spoke), The hayakal (temple) of Yahawah, the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah, the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah, are these.
For if you yatab (thoroughly) yatab (amend) your darak (ways) and your mailal (doings); if you ishah (make) ishah (make) mashapat (justice) between a ayash (husband/individual man) and his neighbor;

If you don't ishaq (oppress) the foreigner, the yathawam (fatherless), and the alamanah (widow), and don't shapak (shed) naqay (innocent) dam (blood) in this maqawam (place), neither yalak (walk) achar (other) other Alahayam to your own rai (hurt):
Then will I shakan (cause) you to dwell in this maqawam (place), in the aratz (Earth/land) that I nathan (give) to your ab (father), from of iwalam (forever) even forevermore.
Behold, you batach (trust) in shaqar (lying) dabar (word / matter), that can't yail (profit).

Will you ganab (steal), ratzach (murder), and naap (commit) adultery, and shabai (swear / take oath) falsely, and qatar (burn) incense to Bail (Baal), and halak (move) achar (other) other Alahayam that you yadai (have) not known,

And bawaa (come) and imad (stand) panayam (before) me in this bayath (house), which is qaraa (called) by my sham (name), and amar (spoke), We are natzal (delivered); that you may ishah (make) all these thawaibah (abominations)?

Is this bayath (house), which is qaraa (called) by my sham (name), become a mairah (den) of parayatz (robbers) in your iyan (eye)? Raah (see), I, even I, have seen it, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

But yalak (go) now to my maqawam (place) which was in Shayalah (Shiloh), where I caused my sham (name) to shakan (dwell) at the raashawan (first), and raah (see) what I ishah (make) to it for the rai (wickedness) of my im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel).

Now, because you ishah (make) done all these maishah (works), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, and I dabar (word / matter) to you, shakam (rising) up early and dabar (word / matter), but you didn't shamai (hearken / hear); and I qaraa (called) you, but you didn't inah (answer / respond):

Therefore will I ishah (make) to the bayath (house) which is qaraa (called) by my sham (name), in which you batach (trust), and to the maqawam (place) which I nathan (give) to you and to your ab (father), as I ishah (make) to Shayalah (Shiloh).
I will shalak (cast) you out of my panayam (sight), as I have shalak (cast) out all your ach (brother/kinsman), even the whole zarai (seed) of Aparayam (Ephraim).

Therefore don't palal (pray) for this im (people / nation), neither nashaa (lift) up a ranah (cry) nor thapalah (prayer) for them, neither pagai (make) intercession to me; for I will not shamai (hearken / hear) you.
Don't you raah (see) what they ishah (make) in the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah) and in the chawatz (streets) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)?

The ban (son) laqat (gather) itz (wood), and the ab (father) bair (kindle) the ash (fire), and the ashah (wife/individual woman) lawash (knead) the batzaq (dough), to ishah (make) kawan (cakes) to the malakath (queen) of the sky, and to nasak (pour) out drink nasak (offerings) to other Alahayam, that they may provoke me to kais (anger).
Do they provoke me to kais (anger)? Naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah. Don't they provoke themselves, to the bashath (confusion) of their own panayam (faces)?

Therefore thus amar (spoke) the Adanay Yahawah: Behold, my ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) and my chamah (wrath) shall be nathak (poured) out on this maqawam (place), on adam (man), and on animal, and on the itz (trees) of the shadah (field), and on the paray (fruit) of the adamah (ground); and it shall bair (burn), and shall not be kabah (quenched).
Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): sapah (add) your burnt ilah (offerings) to your zabach (sacrifices), and akal (eat) meat.

For I didn't dabar (word / matter) to your ab (father), nor tzawah (command) them in the yawam (day) that I yatzaa (go out / come out) them out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), dabar (word / matter) burnt ilah (offerings) or zabach (sacrifices):

But this thing I tzawah (commanded) them, amar (spoke), shamai (hearken / hear) to my qawal (sound / voice), and I will be your Alahayam, and you shall be my im (people / nation); and halak (move) in all the darak (way) that I tzawah (command) you, that it may be yatab (well) with you.

But they didn't shamai (hearken / hear) nor natah (turn) their azan (ear), but yalak (walked) in their own mawaitzah (counsels) and in the stubbornness of their rai (evil) lab (heart), and went backward, and not forward.

Since the yawam (day) that your ab (father) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) to this yawam (day), I have shalach (send) to you all my ibad (servant) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), yawam (day) shakam (rising) up early and shalach (send) them:

Yet they didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to me, nor natah (inclined) their azan (ear), but made their irap (neck) qashah (rough / hard): they raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil) worse than their ab (father).

You shall dabar (word / matter) all these dabar (word / matter) to them; but they will not shamai (hearken / hear) to you: you shall also qaraa (called) to them; but they will not inah (answer / respond) you.

You shall amar (spoke) them, This is the gaway (nation / people) that has not shamai (hearken / hear) to the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah their Alahayam, nor laqach (take / seized) mawasar (instruction): amawanah (truth) is abad (destroy/perish), and is karath (cut) off from their pah (mouth).

Gazaz (cut) off your nazar (crown / consecrate), and shalak (throw) it away, and nashaa (lift) up a qayanah (lamentation) on the bare heights; for Yahawah has maas (rejected) and forsaken the dawar (generation / age / period) of his ibarah (wrath).

For the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah) ishah (make) done that which is rai (evil) in my iyan (eye), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah: they have shawam (place / establish / appoint) their shaqawatz (abominations) in the bayath (house) which is qaraa (called) by my sham (name), to tamaa (defile) it.

They have banah (built) the bamah (high) places of Thapath (Topheth), which is in the gayaa (valley) of the ban (son) of Hanam (Hinnom), to sharap (burn) their ban (son) and their bath (daughter) in the ash (fire); which I didn't tzawah (command), nor did it ilah (go up / offer) into my lab (heart).

Therefore, behold, the yawam (day) bawaa (come), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, that it shall no more be amar (spoke) Thapath (Topheth), nor The gayaa (valley) of the ban (son) of Hanam (Hinnom), but The gayaa (valley) of haragah (slaughter): for they shall qabar (bury) in Thapath (Topheth), until there is no maqawam (place) to bury.
The nabalah (dead) bodies of this im (people / nation) shall be maakal (food) for the iwap (flying) of the sky, and for the animals of the aratz (Earth/land); and none shall frighten them away.

Then will I shabath (shabath/rest) to cease from the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and from the chawatz (streets) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), the qawal (sound / voice) of shashawan (mirth) and the qawal (sound / voice) of shamachah (gladness), the qawal (sound / voice) of the chathan (bridegroom) and the qawal (sound / voice) of the kalah (complete / finish); for the aratz (Earth/land) shall become a charabah (waste).

At that ith (time), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, they shall yatzaa (go out / come out) out the itzam (bones) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and the itzam (bones) of his shar (prince / ruler), and the itzam (bones) of the kahan (priest), and the itzam (bones) of the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), and the itzam (bones) of the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), out of their qabar (grave / tomb / sepulcher);

And they shall shatach (spread) them before the shamash (sun), and the yarach (moon), and all the tzabaa (troop) of the sky, which they have ahab (love), and which they have ibad (servant), and achar (other) which they have halak (move), and which they have darash (sought), and which they have shachah (worshiped): they shall not be asap (gathered), nor be qabar (bury), they shall be for daman (dung) on the surface of the adamah (earth).

Mawath (death) shall be bachar (chosen) rather than chay (life) by all the shaarayath (residue) that shaar (remain) of this rai (evil) mashapachah (tribe/clan/family), that shaar (remain) in all the maqawam (place) where I have nadach (driven) them, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).

Moreover you shall amar (spoke) them, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Shall men napal (fall / be cast down), and not qawam (rise up) up again? Shall one shawab (turn back / repent) away, and not shawab (turn back / repent)?

Why then is this im (people / nation) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) slidden shawab (turn back / repent) by a perpetual mashawabah (backsliding)? They chazaq (hold) fast tharamah (deceit), they maan (refuse) to shawab (turn back / repent).

I listened and shamai (hearken / hear), but they didn't dabar (word / matter) aright: no ayash (husband/individual man) nacham (turn away / repent) him of his rai (wickedness), amar (spoke), What ishah (make) I done? Everyone shawab (turn back / repent) to his marawatzah (course), as a sawas (horse) that rushes headlong in the malachamah (battle).

Yes, the chasayadah (stork) in the sky yadai (knows) her mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) times; and the turtledove and the igawar (swallow) and the sawas (crane) shamar (keep/guard) the ith (time) of their bawaa (come); but my im (people / nation) don't yadai (know) yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) mashapat (law).
How do you amar (spoke), We are chakam (wise), and the thawarah (instruction) of Yahawah is with us? But, behold, the shaqar (false) it (pen) of the sapar (book) ishah (make) worked falsely.

The chakam (wise) men are disappointed, they are chathath (dismayed) and lakad (taken): behold, they have maas (rejected) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah; and what kind of chakamah (wisdom) is in them?

Therefore will I nathan (give) their wives to others, and their shadah (fields) to those who shall yarash (possess) them: for everyone from the qatan (small/young/least) even to the greatest is batzai (given) to batzai (covetousness); from the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) even to the kahan (priest) every one ishah (make) falsely.

They have rapaa (healed) the shabar (hurt) of the bath (daughter) of my im (people / nation) qalal (slightly), amar (spoke), shalawam (peace / safety), shalawam (peace / safety); when there is no shalawam (peace / safety).

Were they yabash (dry land) when they ishah (make) committed thawaibah (abomination)? Nay, they were not at all bawash (ashamed), neither yadai (could) they kalam (blush): therefore shall they napal (fall / be cast down) among those who napal (fall / be cast down); in the ith (time) of their paqadah (visitation) they shall be kashal (stumble / stagger) down, amar (spoke) Yahawah.

I will asap (utterly) sawap (consume) them, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah: no inab (grapes) shall be on the gapan (vine), nor thaan (figs) on the thaan (fig) tree, and the ilah (leaf) shall nabal (fade); and the things that I nathan (give) given them shall ibar (pass over/through) away from them.

Why do we yashab (inhabit/dwell) still? Asap (assemble) yourselves, and bawaa (come) us enter into the fortified iyar (cities), and let us be damam (silent) there; for Yahawah our Alahayam has put us to damam (silence), and given us mayam (Waters) of raash (head) to shaqah (drink), because we have chataa (sinned) against Yahawah.
We qawah (gather/wait) for shalawam (peace / safety), but no tawab (pleasant/functional) came; and for a ith (time) of marapaa (healing), and behold, baithah (dismay)!

The nachar (snorting) of his sawas (horses) is shamai (hearken / hear) Dan (from) Dan: at the qawal (sound / voice) of the matzahalah (neighing) of his abayar (strong) ones the whole aratz (Earth/land) raish (trembles); for they bawaa (come) come, and have akal (eat) the aratz (Earth/land) and malaa (all) that is in it; the iyar (city) and those who yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein.
For, behold, I will shalach (send) nachash (serpents), tzapai (adders), among you, which will not be lachash (charmed); and they shall nashak (bite) you, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.
Oh that I could mabalayagayath (comfort) myself against yagawan (sorrow)! My lab (heart) is daway (faint) within me.

Behold, the qawal (sound / voice) of the cry of the bath (daughter) of my im (people / nation) from a aratz (Earth/land) that is very marachaq (far) off: isn't Yahawah in Tzayawan (Zion)? Isn't her malak (king) in her? Why have they provoked me to kais (anger) with their engraved pasayal (images), and with foreign habal (vanities)?
The qatzayar (harvest) is past, the qayatz (summer) is kalah (complete / finish), and we are not yashai (salvation).
For the shabar (hurt) of the bath (daughter) of my im (people / nation) am I shabar (hurt): I qadar (mourn); shamah (dismay) has chazaq (taken) hold on me.
Is there no tzaray (balm) in Galaid (Gilead)? Is there no rapaa (physician) there? Why then isn't the arawakah (health) of the bath (daughter) of my im (people / nation) ilah (go up / offer)?
Oh that my head were waters, and my eyes a spring of tears, that I might nathan (give) day and night for the slain of the daughter of my im (people / nation)!

Oh that I had in the aratz (Earth/land) a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my naam (declares (prophetically)), and darak (go) from them! For they are all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.
They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood; and they are grown strong in the land, but not for truth: for they proceed from evil to evil, and they don't know me, says Yahawah.
Take heed everyone of his neighbor, and don't trust in any rai (neigbor/another person); for every rai (neigbor/another person) will utterly supplant, and every neighbor will go about with slanders.
They will deceive everyone his neighbor, and will not speak the truth: they have yadai (taught) their tongue to speak yadai (lies); they weary themselves to commit iniquity.
Your habitation is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, amar (spoke) Yahawah.
Therefore thus dabar (word / matter) Yahawah of Armies, Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how should I deal with the daughter of my people?
Their tongue is a deadly arrow; it speaks deceit: one speaks peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth, but in his napash (living being/soul) he paqad (visit) wait for him.
Shall I not visit them for these things? Says Yahawah; shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

For the mountains will I nathan (give) up a nathan (give) and wailing, and for the pastures of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that balay (none) passes through; neither can men hear the voice of the livestock; both the birds of the sky and the animals are fled, they are gone.
I will bayan (between) Jerusalem heaps, a dwelling place of jackals; and I will bayan (between) the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.

Who is the wise halak (move), that may shamai (hearken / hear) this? Who is he to whom the panayam (mouth) of Yahawah has amar (spoke), that he may amar (spoke) it? Why is the land perished and burned up like a wilderness, so that none passes il (over)?
Yahawah says, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither yalak (walked) therein,
But have walked kan (for sure) the stubbornness of their own heart, and kan (for sure) the Baals, which their fathers taught them;
Therefore thus says Yahawah of Armies, the Alahayam of Israel, Behold, I will feed them, even this gaway (nation / people), with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.
I will scatter them also among the nations, whom neither they nor their fathers bayan (between) known; and I will shalach (send) the sword al (after) them, until I bayan (between) consumed them.
Thus says Yahawah of Armies, Consider, and call for the mourning women, that they may yarad (come); and send for the skillful women, that they may yarad (come):
And let them shamai (hearken / hear) haste, and take up a nahay (wailing) for us, that our eyes may run down with tears, and our eyelids gush out with waters.
For a voice of nahay (wailing) is shamai (hearken / hear) out of Zion, How are we ruined! We are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because they have cast down our dwellings.
Yet hear the word of Yahawah, you women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth; and teach your daughters wailing, and everyone her neighbor lamentation.
For death has come up into our windows, it is entered into our palaces; to qatzar (cut) off the children from outside, and the young men from the panayam (streets).
Amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, The dead bodies of chakam (men) shall fall as dung on the open field, and as the handful after the harvester; and none shall gather them.

Thus naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, Don't let the shakal (wise) halal (praise) glory in his shakal (wisdom), neither let the mighty halal (praise) glory in his might, don't let the rich halal (praise) glory in his riches;

But let him who glories glory in this, that he has understanding, and knows me, that I am Yahawah who exercises loving kindness, justice, and naam (declares (prophetically)), in the earth: for in these things I delight, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.
Behold, the days ban (son), says Yahawah, that I will punish all those who are circumcised in uncircumcision:

Matzarayam (Egypt), and Yahawadah (Judah), and Adam (Edom), and the ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon), and Mawaab (Moab), and all that have the paah (corners) of their hair qatzatz (cut) off, who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the madabar (wilderness); for all the gaway (nation / people) are iral (uncircumcised), and all the bayath (house) of Yasharaal (Israel) are iral (uncircumcised) in lab (heart).
Shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) which Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to you, bayath (house) of Yasharaal (Israel)!

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Don't lamad (teach/instruct) the darak (way) of the gaway (nation / people), and don't be chathath (dismayed) at the awath (sign / mark / miracle) of the sky; for the gaway (nation / people) are chathath (dismayed) at them.

For the chaqah (customs) of the im (people / nation) are habal (vanity); for one karath (cut) a itz (tree) out of the yair (forest), the maishah (work) of the yad (hand) of the charash (workman) with the axe.
They yapah (deck) it with kasap (silver) and with zahab (gold); they chazaq (fasten) it with masamar (nails) and with maqabah (hammers), that it not pawaq (move).

They are like a thamar (palm) tree, of turned dabar (word / matter), and don't speak: they must be nashaa (lift), because they can't tzaid (go). Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid) of them; for they can't do raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil), neither is it in them to do yatab (good).
There is none like you, Yahawah; you are gadawal (very great/important/mighty), and your sham (name) is gadawal (very great/important/mighty) in gabawarah (might).

Who should not yaraa (fear / be afraid) you, malak (king) of the gaway (nation / people)? For it yaah (appertains) to you; because among all the chakam (wise) men of the gaway (nation / people), and in all their malakawath (royal) estate, there is none like you.
But they are achad (one) bair (brutish) and kasal (foolish): the mawasar (instruction) of idols! It is but a itz (stock).

There is kasap (silver) raqai (beaten) into plates, which is bawaa (come) from Tharashayash (Tarshish), and zahab (gold) from Awapaz (Uphaz), the maishah (work) of the charash (artificer) and of the yad (hand) of the tzarap (goldsmith); thakalath (blue) and aragaman (purple) for their labawash (clothing); they are all the maishah (work) of skillful chakam (men).

But Yahawah is the amath (truth) Alahayam; he is the chay (life) Alahayam, and an iwalam (forever) malak (king): at his qatzap (wrath) the aratz (Earth/land) raish (trembles), and the gaway (nation / people) are not kawal (all/every/entire) to withstand his zaim (indignation).

You shall amar (spoke) this to them: The Alahayam that have not ibad (servant) the shamayan (heavens) and the araq (earth), these shall abad (destroy/perish) from the arai (earth), and from under the shamayan (heavens).

He ishah (make) made the aratz (Earth/land) by his kach (strength / mighty / power), he has kawan (established) the thabal (world) by his chakamah (wisdom), and by his chakamah (understanding) has he natah (stretched) out the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)):

When he nathan (give) his qawal (sound / voice), there is a hamawan (tumult) of mayam (Waters) in the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), and he causes the vapors to ilah (go up / offer) from the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the aratz (Earth/land); he ishah (make) baraq (lightnings) for the matar (rain), and yatzaa (go out / come out) forth the rawach (spirit / wind) out of his awatzar (treasuries).

Every adam (man) has become bair (brutish) and without daith (knowledge); every tzarap (goldsmith) is disappointed by his engraved pasal (idol/graven image); for his molten nasak (image) is falsehood, and there is no rawach (spirit / wind) in them.
They are habal (vanity), a maishah (work) of delusion: in the ith (time) of their paqadah (visitation) they shall abad (destroy/perish).

The chalaq (portion) of Yaiqab (Jacob) is not like these; for he is the former of all things; and Yasharaal (Israel) is the shabat (tribe) of his nachalah (inheritance): Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) is his sham (name).
Asap (gather) up your kanaih (wares) out of the aratz (Earth/land), you who live under matzawar (siege).
For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Behold, I will qalai (sling) out the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the aratz (Earth/land) at paim (this) time, and will tzarar (distress) them, that they may feel it.
Away (woe) is me because of my shabar (hurt)! My makah (wound) is chalah (afflict): but I amar (spoke), ak (truly) this is my chalay (grief), and I must nashaa (lift) it.

My ahal (tent) is shadad (destroyed), and all my mayathar (cords) are nathaq (broken): my ban (son) are yatzaa (go out / come out) forth from me, and they are no more: there is none to natah (spread) my ahal (tent) any more, and to qawam (rise up) up my yarayaih (curtains).
For the raih (shepherds) are become bair (brutish), and have not darash (inquired) of Yahawah: therefore they shakal (have) not prospered, and all their maraiyath (flocks) are pawatz (scattered).

The qawal (sound / voice) of shamawaih (news), behold, it bawaa (come), and a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) raish (commotion) out of the tzapawan (north) aratz (Earth/land), to shawam (place / establish / appoint) the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah) a shamamah (desolation), a maiwan (dwelling) place of jackals.
Yahawah, I yadai (know) that the darak (way) of adam (man) is not in himself: it is not in ayash (husband/individual man) who halak (move) to kawan (direct) his tzaid (steps).
Yahawah, yasar (correct) me, but in mashapat (measure): not in your ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), lest you mait (bring) me to nothing.

Shapak (pour) out your chamah (wrath) on the gaway (nation / people) that don't yadai (know) you, and on the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) that don't qaraa (called) on your sham (name): for they have akal (eat) Yaiqab (Jacob), yes, they have akal (eat) him and kalah (complete / finish) him, and have shamam (laid) waste his nawah (habitation).
The dabar (word / matter) that came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Yahawah, amar (spoke),

Shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of this barayath (covenant), and dabar (word / matter) to the ayash (husband/individual man) of Yahawadah (Judah), and to the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem);

And amar (spoke) to them, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): arar (cursed) is the ayash (husband/individual man) who doesn't shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of this barayath (covenant),

Which I tzawah (commanded) your ab (father) in the yawam (day) that I yatzaa (go out / come out) them forth out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), out of the barazal (iron) kawar (furnace), amar (spoke), shamai (hearken / hear) my qawal (sound / voice), and ishah (make) them, according to all which I tzawah (command) you: so you shall be my im (people / nation), and I will be your Alahayam;

That I may qawam (rise up) the shabawaih (oath) which I shabai (swear / take oath) to your ab (father), to nathan (give) them a aratz (Earth/land) zawab (flow) with chalab (milk) and dabash (honey), as at this yawam (day). Then inah (answer / respond) I, and amar (spoke), aman (believe / have faith), Yahawah.

Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, qaraa (called) all these dabar (word / matter) in the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and in the chawatz (streets) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), amar (spoke), shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of this barayath (covenant), and ishah (make) them.

For I iwad (admonish/bear witness against) iwad (admonish/bear witness against) to your ab (father) in the yawam (day) that I ilah (go up / offer) them up out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), even to this yawam (day), shakam (rising) early and iwad (admonish/bear witness against), amar (spoke), shamai (hearken / hear) my qawal (sound / voice).

Yet they didn't shamai (hearken / hear), nor natah (turn) their azan (ear), but yalak (walked) everyone in the stubbornness of their rai (evil) lab (heart): therefore I bawaa (come) on them all the dabar (word / matter) of this barayath (covenant), which I tzawah (commanded) them to ishah (make), but they didn't ishah (make) them.
Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, A qashar (conspiracy) is matzaa (found) among the ayash (husband/individual man) of Yahawadah (Judah), and among the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

They are shawab (turn back / repent) back to the iwan (guilt/iniquity) of their raashawan (forefathers), who maan (refused) to shamai (hearken / hear) my dabar (word / matter); and they are halak (move) achar (other) other Alahayam to ibad (servant) them: the bayath (house) of Yasharaal (Israel) and the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah) have parar (broken) my barayath (covenant) which I karath (cut) with their ab (father).

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Behold, I will bawaa (come) rai (evil) on them, which they shall not be yakal (able) to yatzaa (go out / come out); and they shall zaiq (cry) to me, but I will not shamai (hearken / hear) to them.

Then shall the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah) and the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) halak (move) and zaiq (cry) to the Alahayam to which they qatar (offer) incense: but they will not yashai (salvation) them at yashai (salvation) in the ith (time) of their rai (trouble).

For according to the masapar (number) of your iyar (cities) are your Alahayam, Yahawadah (Judah); and according to the masapar (number) of the chawatz (streets) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) have you shawam (place / establish / appoint) up mazabach (altars) to the shameful thing, even mazabach (altars) to qatar (burn) incense to Bail (Baal).

Therefore don't palal (pray) for this im (people / nation), neither nashaa (lift) up ranah (cry) nor thapalah (prayer) for them; for I will not shamai (hearken / hear) them in the ith (time) that they qaraa (called) to me because of their rai (trouble).

What has my yadayad (beloved) to do in my bayath (house), since she ishah (make) worked mazamah (lewdness) with many, and the qadash (set apart/make holy) bashar (flesh) is ibar (pass over/through) from you? When you do rai (evil), then you ilaz (rejoice).

Yahawah qaraa (called) your sham (name), A rainan (green) zayath (olive) tree, yapah (beautiful) with thaar (goodly) paray (fruit): with the qawal (sound / voice) of a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) hamalah (tumult) he has yatzath (kindled) ash (fire) on it, and its branches are raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil).

For Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), who natai (planted) you, has dabar (word / matter) rai (evil) against you, galal (because) of the rai (evil) of the bayath (house) of Yasharaal (Israel) and of the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah), which they ishah (make) worked for themselves in provoking me to kais (anger) by qatar (offering) incense to Bail (Baal).
Yahawah gave me yadai (knowledge) of it, and I yadai (knew) it: then you showed me their mailal (doings).

But I was like a gentle kabash (lamb) that is yabal (led) to the tabach (slaughter); and I didn't yadai (know) that they had chashab (devised) machashabah (devices) against me, saying, Let us shachath (destroy) the itz (tree) with its lacham (fruit), and let us karath (cut) him off from the aratz (Earth/land) of the chay (life), that his sham (name) may be no more zakar (remembrance/memory).

But, Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), who shapat (judges) righteously, who tests the kalayah (heart) and the lab (heart), I shall raah (see) your naqamah (vengeance) on them; for to you have I galah (revealed) my rayab (cause).

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah concerning the ayash (husband/individual man) of Inathawath (Anathoth), who baqash (seek) your napash (living being/soul), amar (spoke), You shall not nabaa (prophesy) in the sham (name) of Yahawah, that you not mawath (death) by our yad (hand);

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), Behold, I will paqad (visit) them: the bachawar (young) men shall mawath (death) by the charab (sword); their ban (son) and their bath (daughter) shall mawath (death) by raib (famine);
And there shall be no shaarayath (remnant) to them: for I will bawaa (come) rai (evil) on the rai (men) of Inathawath (Anathoth), even the shanah (year) of their paqadah (visitation).

You are tzadayaq (righteous), Yahawah, when I rayab (contend) with you; yet I would reason the cause with you: why does the darak (way) of the rashai (wicked) tzalach (prosper)? Why are all they at ease who deal very bagad (treacherously)?

You have natai (planted) them, yes, they have sharash (taken) root; they yalak (grow), yes, they ishah (make) forth paray (fruit): you are qarawab (near) in their pah (mouth), and rachawaq (far) from their kalayah (heart).

But you, Yahawah, yadai (know) me; you raah (see) me, and bachan (try) my lab (heart) toward you: nathaq (pull) them out like tzaan (sheep) for the tabachah (slaughter), and qadash (set apart/make holy) them for the yawam (day) of haragah (slaughter).

How long shall the aratz (Earth/land) abal (mourn), and the ishab (herbs) of the whole shadah (country) yabash (dry land)? For the rai (wickedness) of those who yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein, the animals are sapah (consumed), and the iwap (flying); because they amar (spoke), He shall not raah (see) our acharayath (latter) end.

If you have rawatz (run) with the footmen, and they have laah (wearied) you, then how can you thacharah (contend) with sawas (horses)? And though in a aratz (Earth/land) of shalawam (peace / safety) you are batach (secure), yet how will you ishah (make) in the pride of the Yaradan (Jordan)?

For even your ach (brother/kinsman), and the bayath (house) of your ab (father), even they have dealt bagad (treacherously) with you; even they have qaraa (called) aloud achar (other) you: don't aman (believe / have faith) them, though they dabar (word / matter) tawab (pleasant/functional) words to you.

I have forsaken my bayath (house), I have natash (cast) off my nachalah (heritage); I nathan (give) given the yadadawath (dearly) beloved of my napash (living being/soul) into the kap (hand) of her ayab (enemy).
My nachalah (heritage) has become to me as a aray (lion) in the yair (forest): she nathan (give) uttered her voice against me; therefore I have shanaa (hate) her.

Is my nachalah (heritage) to me as a tzabawai (speckled) iyat (bird) of prey? Are the iyat (birds) of prey against her all around? Yalak (go), asap (assemble) all the animals of the shadah (field), athah (bring) them to akalah (devour).

Many raih (shepherds) have shachath (destroyed) my karam (vineyard), they have bawas (trodden) my chalaqah (portion) under bawas (foot), they nathan (give) made my chamadah (pleasant) chalaqah (portion) a shamamah (desolate) madabar (wilderness).

They have shawam (place / establish / appoint) it a desolation; it abal (mourns) to me, being shamamah (desolate); the whole aratz (Earth/land) is shamam (made) desolate, because no ayash (husband/individual man) shawam (place / establish / appoint) it to lab (heart).

Shadad (destroyers) bawaa (come) come on all the bare heights in the madabar (wilderness); for the charab (sword) of Yahawah akal (eat) from the one qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the aratz (Earth/land) even to the other qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the aratz (Earth/land): no bashar (flesh) has shalawam (peace / safety).

They have zarai (sown) chatah (wheat), and have qatzar (reaped) qawatz (thorns); they have chalah (afflict) themselves to pain, and yail (profit) nothing: and you shall be bawash (ashamed) of your thabawaah (fruits), because of the charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah against all my rai (evil) neighbors, who nagai (touch) the nachalah (inheritance) which I have caused my im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel) to nachal (inherit): behold, I will nathash (pluck) them up from off their adamah (land), and will nathash (pluck) up the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah) from thawak (midst) them.

It shall happen, achar (other) that I have nathash (plucked) them up, I will shawab (turn back / repent) and racham (have) compassion on them; and I will shawab (turn back / repent) them again, every ayash (husband/individual man) to his nachalah (heritage), and every ayash (husband/individual man) to his aratz (Earth/land).

It shall happen, if they will lamad (teach/instruct) lamad (teach/instruct) the darak (ways) of my im (people / nation), to shabai (swear / take oath) by my sham (name), As Yahawah chay (life); even as they lamad (teach/instruct) my im (people / nation) to shabai (swear / take oath) by Bail (Baal); then shall they be banah (built) up in the thawak (midst) of my im (people / nation).
But if they will not shamai (hearken / hear), then will I nathash (pluck) up that gaway (nation / people), nathash (plucking) up and destroying it, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah to me, halak (move), and qanah (buy) yourself a pashathah (linen) belt, and shawam (place / establish / appoint) it on your waist, and don't bawaa (come) it in mayam (Waters).
So I bought a belt according to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, and shawam (place / establish / appoint) it on my waist.
The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to me the shanay (second) time, amar (spoke),
Laqach (take / seized) the belt that you have bought, which is on your waist, and qawam (rise up), yalak (go) to the Parath (Euphrates), and taman (hide) it there in a cleft of the salai (rock).
So I yalak (went), and taman (hid) it by the Parath (Euphrates), as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) me.

It happened qatz (after) many yawam (day), that Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, qawam (rise up), yalak (go) to the Parath (Euphrates), and laqach (take / seized) the belt from there, which I tzawah (commanded) you to taman (hide) there.

Then I yalak (went) to the Parath (Euphrates), and chapar (dug), and laqach (take / seized) the belt from the maqawam (place) where I had taman (hidden) it; and behold, the belt was shachath (marred), it was tzalach (profitable) for nothing.
Then the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to me, amar (spoke),
Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, In this way I will shachath (mar) the gaawan (pride) of Yahawadah (Judah), and the rab (great) gaawan (pride) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

This rai (evil) im (people / nation), who maan (refuse) to shamai (hearken / hear) my dabar (word / matter), who halak (move) in the stubbornness of their lab (heart), and are yalak (gone) achar (other) other Alahayam to ibad (servant) them, and to shachah (worship) them, shall even be as this belt, which is tzalach (profitable) for nothing.

For as the belt clings to the waist of a ayash (husband/individual man), so have I caused to cling to me the whole bayath (house) of Yasharaal (Israel) and the whole bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah; that they may be to me for a im (people / nation), and for a sham (name), and for a thahalah (praise), and for a glory: but they would not shamai (hearken / hear).

Therefore you shall amar (spoke) to them this dabar (word / matter): Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), Every nabal (bottle) shall be malaa (filled) with yayan (wine): and they shall amar (spoke) you, Do we not yadai (certainly) yadai (know) that every nabal (bottle) shall be malaa (filled) with yayan (wine)?

Then you shall amar (spoke) them, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Behold, I will malaa (fill) all the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of this aratz (Earth/land), even the malak (king) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) on Dawad (David's) kasaa (throne), and the kahan (priest), and the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), and all the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), with shakarawan (drunkenness).

I will napatz (dash) them ayash (husband/individual man) against ach (brother/kinsman), even the ab (father) and the ban (son) yachad (together), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah: I will not chamal (pity), nor chawas (spare), nor racham (have) compassion, that I should not shachath (destroy) them.
Shamai (hearken / hear), and azan (give) ear; don't be gabah (proud); for Yahawah has dabar (word / matter).

Nathan (give) kabawad (glory) to Yahawah your Alahayam, before he causes chashak (darkness), and before your ragal (feet / foot) nagap (stumble) on the nashap (dark) har (mountain), and, while you qawah (gather/wait) for awar (light), he shawam (place / establish / appoint) it into the shadow of tzalamawath (death), and shayath (put / appoint / make) it irapal (gross) darkness.

But if you will not shamai (hearken / hear) it, my napash (living being/soul) shall bakah (weep) in masathar (secret) for your gawah (pride); and my iyan (eye) shall damai (weep) bitterly, and yarad (run) down with damaih (tears), because yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) idar (flock) is shabah (taken) captive.

Amar (spoke) to the malak (king) and to the gabayarah (queen) mother, shapal (humble) yourselves, yashab (inhabit/dwell) down; for your headdresses have yarad (come) down, even the itarah (crown) of your glory.

The iyar (cities) of the nagab (south) are sagar (shut) up, and there is none to pathach (open) them: Yahawadah (Judah) is galah (carried) away captive, shalawam (peace / safety) of it; it is wholly galah (carried) away captive.
Nashaa (lift) up your iyan (eye), and raah (see) those who bawaa (come) from the tzapawan (north): where is the idar (flock) that was nathan (give) you, your thapaarah (beautiful) tzaan (flock)?

What will you amar (spoke), when he shall paqad (visit) over you as raash (head) those whom you have yourself lamad (teach/instruct) to be alawap (friends) to you? Shall not chabal (sorrows) achaz (take) hold of you, as of a ashah (wife/individual woman) in yalad (birth / begot)?

If you amar (spoke) in your labab (heart), Why are these things qaraa (called) on me? For the greatness of your iwan (guilt/iniquity) are your shawal (skirts) galah (uncovered), and your iqab (heels) suffer chamas (violence).

Can the Kawashay (Ethiopian) hapak (change) his iwar (skin), or the namar (leopard) his chabarabarah (spots)? Then may you also do yatab (good), who are lamawad (accustomed) to do raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil).
Therefore will I pawatz (scatter) them, as the qash (stubble) that passes ibar (pass over/through), by the rawach (spirit / wind) of the madabar (wilderness).
This is your gawaral (lot), the manah (portion) mad (measured) to you from me, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah; because you have shakach (forgotten) me, and batach (trusted) in falsehood.
Therefore will I also chashap (uncover) your shawal (skirts) on your panayam (face), and your qalawan (shame) shall raah (see).

I raah (see) seen your shaqawatz (abominations), even your naap (adulteries), and your matzahalah (neighing), the lewdness of your prostitution, on the gabaih (hills) in the shadah (field). Away (woe) to you, Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)! You will not be made tahar (clean); how iwad (more/again) shall it yet be?
The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah that came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) dabar (word / matter) the batzarath (drought).

Yahawadah (Judah) abal (mourns), and its shair (gates) amal (languish), they sit in qadar (black) on the aratz (Earth/land); and the tzawachah (cry) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) is ilah (go up / offer) up.

Their adayar (nobles) shalach (send) their tzaiyar (little) ones to the mayam (Waters): they bawaa (come) to the cisterns, and matzaa (find) no mayam (Waters); they shawab (turn back / repent) with their kalay (vessels) rayaqam (empty); they are disappointed and bawash (confounded), and chapah (cover) their raash (head).
Because of the adamah (ground) which is cracked, because no gasham (rain) has been in the aratz (Earth/land), the plowmen are disappointed, they chapah (cover) their raash (head).
Yes, the ayalath (hind) also in the shadah (field) yalad (birth / begot), and izab (forsakes) her young, because there is no dashaa (grass).
The paraa (wild) donkeys imad (stand) on the bare heights, they shaap (pant) for rawach (spirit / wind) like jackals; their iyan (eye) kalah (complete / finish), because there is no herbage.
Though our iwan (guilt/iniquity) inah (answer / respond) against us, ishah (make) for your sham (name) sake, Yahawah; for our mashawabah (backslidings) are many; we have chataa (sinned) against you.

You maqawah (gathering/collection) of Yasharaal (Israel), its Savior in the ith (time) of tzarah (trouble), why should you be as a foreigner in the aratz (Earth/land), and as a arach (wayfaring) man who natah (turns) aside to stay for a lawan (night)?

Why should you be like a scared ayash (husband/individual man), as a gabawar (mighty) man who can't yashai (salvation)? Yet you, Yahawah, are in the qarab (among / near) of us, and we are qaraa (called) by your sham (name); don't yanach (leave) us.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah to this im (people / nation), Even so have they ahab (love) to nawai (wander); they have not chashak (darkness) their ragal (feet / foot): therefore Yahawah does not ratzah (accept) them; now he will zakar (remembrance/memory) their iwan (guilt/iniquity), and paqad (visit) their chataah (sin).
Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, Don't palal (pray) for this im (people / nation) for their tawab (pleasant/functional).

When they tzawam (fast), I will not shamai (hearken / hear) their ranah (cry); and when they ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilah (offering) and meal manachah (offering), I will not ratzah (accept) them; but I will kalah (complete / finish) them by the charab (sword), and by the raib (famine), and by the dabar (word / matter).

Then I amar (spoke), ahah (ah), Adanay Yahawah! Behold, the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) amar (spoke) them, You shall not raah (see) the charab (sword), neither shall you have raib (famine); but I will nathan (give) you amath (truth) shalawam (peace / safety) in this maqawam (place).

Then Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, The nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) nabaa (prophesy) shaqar (lies) in my sham (name); I didn't shalach (send) them, neither have I tzawah (commanded) them, neither dabar (word / matter) I to them: they nabaa (prophesy) to you a shaqar (lying) chazawan (vision), and qasam (divination), and a thing of nothing, and the tharamah (deceit) of their own lab (heart).

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah concerning the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) who nabaa (prophesy) in my sham (name), and I didn't shalach (send) them, yet they amar (spoke), charab (sword) and raib (famine) shall not be in this aratz (Earth/land): By charab (sword) and raib (famine) shall those nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) be thamam (consumed).

The im (people / nation) to whom they nabaa (prophesy) shall be shalak (cast) out in the chawatz (streets) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) panayam (because) of the raib (famine) and the charab (sword); and they shall have none to qabar (bury) them—them, their wives, nor their ban (son), nor their bath (daughter): for I will shapak (pour) their rai (wickedness) on them.

You shall amar (spoke) this dabar (word / matter) to them, Let my iyan (eye) yarad (run) down with damaih (tears) layal (night) and yawamam (by day), and let them not damah (cease); for the bathawalah (virgin) bath (daughter) of my im (people / nation) is shabar (broken) with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) shabar (breach), with a very chalah (afflict) makah (wound).

If I yatzaa (go out / come out) forth into the shadah (field), then, behold, the chalal (slain) with the charab (sword)! And if I bawaa (come) into the iyar (city), then, behold, those who are thachalawaa (sick) with raib (famine)! For both the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) and the kahan (priest) sachar (go) about in the aratz (Earth/land), and have no yadai (knowledge).

Have you maas (utterly) maas (rejected) Yahawadah (Judah)? Has your napash (living being/soul) loathed Tzayawan (Zion)? Why have you nakah (struck) us, and there is no marapaa (healing) for us? We qawah (gather/wait) for shalawam (peace / safety), but no tawab (pleasant/functional) came; and for a ith (time) of marapaa (healing), and behold, baithah (dismay)!
We yadai (acknowledge), Yahawah, our rashai (wickedness), and the iwan (guilt/iniquity) of our ab (father); for we have chataa (sinned) against you.

Do not naatz (abhor) us, for your sham (name) sake; nabal (do) not disgrace the kasaa (throne) of your kabawad (glory): zakar (remembrance/memory), don't parar (break) your barayath (covenant) with us.

Are there any among the habal (vanities) of the gaway (nation / people) that can cause gasham (rain)? Or can the sky nathan (give) rabayab (showers)? Aren't you he, Yahawah our Alahayam? Therefore we will qawah (gather/wait) for you; for you ishah (make) made all these things.

Then Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, Though Mashah (Moses) and Shamawaal (Samuel) imad (stood) panayam (before) me, yet my napash (living being/soul) would not be toward this im (people / nation): shalach (send) them out of my panayam (sight), and yatzaa (go out / come out) them go forth.

It shall happen, when they amar (spoke) you, Where shall we yatzaa (go out / come out) forth? Then you shall amar (spoke) them, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Such as are for mawath (death), to mawath (death); and such as are for the charab (sword), to the charab (sword); and such as are for the raib (famine), to the raib (famine); and such as are for shabay (captivity), to shabay (captivity).

I will paqad (visit) over them arabai (four) mashapachah (tribe/clan/family), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah: the charab (sword) to harag (kill), and the kalab (dogs) to sachab (tear), and the iwap (flying) of the sky, and the animals of the aratz (Earth/land), to akal (eat) and to shachath (destroy).

I will nathan (give) them to be tossed back and forth among all the mamalakah (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land), galal (because) of Manashah (Manasseh), the ban (son) of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), for that which he ishah (make) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
For who will chamal (have) pity on you, Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)? Or who will nawad (bemoan) you? Or who will sawar (turn) aside to shaal (ask) of your shalawam (peace / safety)?

You have rejected me, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, you have yalak (gone) backward: therefore have I natah (stretched) out my yad (hand) against you, and shachath (destroyed) you; I am laah (weary) with nacham (turn away / repent).

I have zarah (winnowed) them with a zarah (fan) in the shair (gates) of the aratz (Earth/land); I have shakal (bereaved) them of children, I abad (destroy/perish) destroyed my im (people / nation); they didn't shawab (turn back / repent) from their darak (ways).

Their alamanah (widows) are itzam (increased) to me above the chawal (sand) of the yam (sea/waters); I bawaa (come) brought on them against the am (mother) of the bachawar (young) men a shadad (destroyer) at noonday: I have caused anguish and bahalah (terrors) to napal (fall / be cast down) on her pathaawam (suddenly).

She who has yalad (birth / begot) shabai (seven) languishes; she has napach (given) up the napash (living being/soul); her shamash (sun) is bawaa (come) down while it was yet yawamam (by day); she has been disappointed and chapar (confounded): and their shaarayath (residue) will I nathan (give) to the charab (sword) panayam (before) their ayab (enemy), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

Away (woe) is me, my am (mother), that you have yalad (birth / begot) me a ayash (husband/individual man) of rayab (strife) and a ayash (husband/individual man) of madawan (contention) to the whole aratz (Earth/land)! I have not nashah (lent), neither have men lent to me; yet everyone of them qalal (curses) me.

Yahawah amar (spoke), Most certainly I will strengthen you for tawab (pleasant/functional); most certainly I will cause the ayab (enemy) to pagai (make) supplication to you in the ith (time) of rai (evil) and in the ith (time) of tzarah (affliction).
Can one raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil) barazal (iron), even barazal (iron) from the tzapawan (north), and nachashath (brass)?

Your chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) and your awatzar (treasures) will I nathan (give) for a baz (spoil) without machayar (price), and that for all your chataah (sin), even in all your gabawal (border/boundary).

I will ibar (pass over/through) them to pass with your ayab (enemy) into a aratz (Earth/land) which you don't yadai (know); for a ash (fire) is qadach (kindled) in my ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), which shall yaqad (burn) on you.

Yahawah, you yadai (know); zakar (remembrance/memory) me, and paqad (visit) me, and naqam (avenge) me of my persecutors; don't laqach (take / seized) me away in your ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting): yadai (know) that for your sake I have nashaa (lift) charapah (reproach).

Your dabar (word / matter) were matzaa (found), and I akal (eat) them; and your dabar (word / matter) were to me a shashawan (joy) and the shamachah (rejoicing) of my labab (heart): for I am qaraa (called) by your sham (name), Yahawah, Alahayam of tzabaa (troop).

I didn't yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the sawad (assembly) of those who shachaq (make) merry, nor ilaz (rejoiced); I yashab (inhabit/dwell) badad (alone) panayam (because) of your yad (hand); for you malaa (have) filled me with zaim (indignation).

Why is my kaab (pain) natzach (perpetual), and my makah (wound) anash (incurable), which maan (refuses) to be rapaa (healed)? Will you indeed be to me as a deceitful brook, as mayam (Waters) that aman (believe / have faith)?

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, If you shawab (turn back / repent), then will I shawab (turn back / repent) you again, that you may imad (stand) panayam (before) me; and if you yatzaa (go out / come out) forth the yaqar (precious) from the zalal (vile), you shall be as my pah (mouth): they shall shawab (turn back / repent) to you, but you shall not shawab (turn back / repent) to them.

I will nathan (give) you to this im (people / nation) a batzar (fortified) bronze chawamah (wall); and they shall lacham (fight) against you, but they shall not yakal (prevail) against you; for I am with you to yashai (salvation) you and to natzal (deliver) you, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.
I will natzal (deliver) you out of the yad (hand) of the rai (wicked), and I will padah (redeem) you out of the kap (hand) of the irayatz (terrible).
The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came also to me, amar (spoke),
You shall not laqach (take / seized) a ashah (wife/individual woman), neither shall you have ban (son) or bath (daughter), in this maqawam (place).

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah concerning the ban (son) and concerning the bath (daughter) who are yalad (birth / begot) in this maqawam (place), and concerning their am (mother) who yalad (birth / begot) them, and concerning their ab (father) who became their ab (father) in this aratz (Earth/land):

They shall mawath (death) thachalawaa (grievous) mamawath (deaths): they shall not be sapad (lamented), neither shall they be qabar (bury); they shall be as daman (dung) on the surface of the adamah (ground); and they shall be kalah (complete / finish) by the charab (sword), and by raib (famine); and their nabalah (dead) bodies shall be maakal (food) for the iwap (flying) of the sky, and for the animals of the aratz (Earth/land).

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Don't bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of marazach (mourning), neither yalak (go) to sapad (lament), neither nawad (bemoan) them; for I have asap (taken) away my shalawam (peace / safety) from this im (people / nation), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, even loving chasad (grace) and tender racham (mercies).

Both gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and qatan (small/young/least) shall mawath (death) in this aratz (Earth/land); they shall not be qabar (bury), neither shall men sapad (lament) for them, nor gadad (cut) themselves, nor qarach (make) themselves bald for them;

Neither shall men break bread for them in abal (mourning), to nacham (turn away / repent) them for the mawath (death); neither shall men give them the kawas (cup) of thanachawam (consolation) to shaqah (drink) for their ab (father) or for their am (mother).
You shall not bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of mashathah (feasting) to yashab (inhabit/dwell) with them, to akal (eat) and to shathah (drinks).

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): Behold, I will shabath (shabath/rest) to cease out of this maqawam (place), before your iyan (eye) and in your yawam (day), the qawal (sound / voice) of shashawan (mirth) and the qawal (sound / voice) of shamachah (gladness), the qawal (sound / voice) of the chathan (bridegroom) and the qawal (sound / voice) of the kalah (complete / finish).

It shall happen, when you shall show this im (people / nation) all these dabar (word / matter), and they shall amar (spoke) you, Why has Yahawah dabar (word / matter) all this gadawal (very great/important/mighty) rai (evil) against us? Or what is our iwan (guilt/iniquity)? Or what is our chataah (sin) that we have chataa (committed) against Yahawah our Alahayam?

Then you shall amar (spoke) them, Because your ab (father) have forsaken me, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, and have yalak (walked) achar (other) other Alahayam, and have ibad (servant) them, and have shachah (worshiped) them, and have forsaken me, and have not shamar (keep/guard) my thawarah (instruction);

And you ishah (make) done raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil) more than your ab (father); for, han (behold), you halak (move) ayash (husband/individual man) one achar (other) the stubbornness of his rai (evil) lab (heart), so that you don't shamai (hearken / hear) to me:

Therefore will I tawal (cast) you forth out of this aratz (Earth/land) into the aratz (Earth/land) that you yadai (have) not known, neither you nor your ab (father); and there you shall ibad (servant) other Alahayam yawamam (by day) and layal (night); for I will show you no favor.

Therefore, behold, the yawam (day) bawaa (come), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, that it shall no more be amar (spoke), As Yahawah chay (life), who ilah (go up / offer) up the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt);

But, As Yahawah chay (life), who ilah (go up / offer) up the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) from the aratz (Earth/land) of the tzapawan (north), and from all the aratz (Earth/land) where he had nadach (driven) them. I will shawab (turn back / repent) them again into their adamah (land) that I nathan (give) to their ab (father).

Behold, I will shalach (send) for many fishermen, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, and they shall dayag (fish) them up; and afterward I will shalach (send) for many tzayad (hunters), and they shall tzawad (hunt) them from every har (mountain), and from every gabaih (hill), and out of the clefts of the salai (rocks).
For my iyan (eye) are on all their darak (ways); they are not sathar (hidden) from my panayam (face), neither is their iwan (guilt/iniquity) concealed from my iyan (eye).

Raashawan (first) I will shalam (recompense) their iwan (guilt/iniquity) and their chataah (sin) mashanah (double), because they have chalal (polluted) my aratz (Earth/land) with the carcasses of their shaqawatz (detestable) things, and malaa (have) filled my nachalah (inheritance) with their thawaibah (abominations).

Yahawah, my iz (strength / might / refuge), and my stronghold, and my manawas (refuge) in the yawam (day) of tzarah (affliction), to you shall the gaway (nation / people) bawaa (come) from the apas (ends) of the aratz (Earth/land), and shall amar (spoke), Our ab (father) nachal (have) inherited nothing but shaqar (lies), habal (vanity) and things in which there is no yail (profit).
Shall a adam (man) ishah (make) to himself Alahayam, which yet are no Alahayam?

Therefore, behold, I yadai (will) cause them to know, paim (this) once yadai (will) I cause them to know my yad (hand) and my gabawarah (might); and they shall yadai (know) that my sham (name) is Yahawah.

The chataah (sin) of Yahawadah (Judah) is kathab (written) with a it (pen) of barazal (iron), and with the tzaparan (point) of a shamayar (diamond): it is engraved on the tablet of their lab (heart), and on the qaran (horn) of your mazabach (altars);
While their ban (son) zakar (remembrance/memory) their mazabach (altars) and their Asharah (Asherim) by the rainan (green) itz (trees) on the gabah (high) gabaih (hills).

My harar (mountain) in the shadah (field), I will nathan (give) your chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) and all your awatzar (treasures) for a baz (spoil), and your bamah (high) places, because of chataah (sin), throughout all your gabawal (border/boundary).

You, even of yourself, shall shamat (discontinue) from your nachalah (heritage) that I nathan (give) you; and I will cause you to ibad (servant) your ayab (enemy) in the aratz (Earth/land) which you don't yadai (know): for you have qadach (kindled) a ash (fire) in my ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) which shall yaqad (burn) iwalam (forever).

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: arar (cursed) is the gabar (man) who batach (trusts) in adam (man), and shawam (place / establish / appoint) bashar (flesh) his zarawai (arm), and whose lab (heart) sawar (departs) from Yahawah.

For he shall be like the heath in the irabah (desert), and shall not raah (see) when tawab (pleasant/functional) bawaa (come), but shall shakan (inhabit) the charar (parched) places in the madabar (wilderness), a malachah (salt) aratz (Earth/land) and not yashab (inhabit/dwell).
Barak (blessed) is the gabar (man) who batach (trusts) in Yahawah, and whose mabatach (trust) Yahawah is.

For he shall be as a itz (tree) shathal (planted) by the mayam (Waters), who shalach (send) out its sharash (roots) by the yawabal (river), and shall not yaraa (fear / be afraid) when cham (heat) bawaa (come), but its ilah (leaf) shall be rainan (green); and shall not be daag (careful) in the shanah (year) of batzarath (drought), neither shall mawash (cease) from ishah (make) paray (fruit).
The lab (heart) is iqab (deceitful) above all things, and it is exceedingly corrupt: who yadai (can) know it?

I, Yahawah, chaqar (search) the lab (heart), I bachan (try) the lab (heart), even to nathan (give) every ayash (husband/individual man) according to his darak (ways), according to the paray (fruit) of his mailal (doings).

As the qaraa (called) that dagar (sits) on eggs which she has not laid, so is he who ishah (make) riches, and not by mashapat (right); in the chatzay (midst) of his yawam (day) they shall izab (leave) him, and at his acharayath (end) he shall be a nabal (fool).
A kabawad (glorious) kasaa (throne), set on marawam (high) from the raashawan (beginning), is the maqawam (place) of our maqadash (sanctuary).

Yahawah, the maqawah (gathering/collection) of Yasharaal (Israel), all who izab (forsake) you shall be disappointed. Those who depart from me shall be kathab (written) in the aratz (Earth/land), because they have forsaken Yahawah, the maqawar (spring) of chay (life) mayam (Waters).
Rapaa (heal) me, O Yahawah, and I shall be rapaa (healed); yashai (salvation) me, and I shall be yashai (salvation): for you are my thahalah (praise).
Behold, they amar (spoke) me, Where is the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah? Bawaa (come) it come now.

As for me, I have not hurried from being a raih (shepherd) achar (other) you; neither have I awah (desired) the anash (woeful) yawam (day); you yadai (know): that which mawatzaa (came) out of my shapah (lips) was nakach (before) your panayam (face).
Don't be a machathah (terror) to me: you are my machasah (refuge) in the yawam (day) of rai (evil).

Let them be disappointed who radap (persecute) me, but let not me be disappointed; let them be chathath (dismayed), but don't let me be chathath (dismayed); bawaa (come) on them the yawam (day) of rai (evil), and shabar (destroy) them with mashanah (double) shabarawan (destruction).

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah to me: halak (move), and imad (stand) in the shair (gate) of the ban (son) of the im (people / nation), through which the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) bawaa (come) in, and by which they yatzaa (go out / come out) out, and in all the shair (gates) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem);

And amar (spoke) them, shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, you malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and all Yahawadah (Judah), and all the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), that bawaa (come) in by these shair (gates):

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, shamar (keep/guard) heed to yourselves, and nashaa (lift) no mashaa (burden) on the shabath (shabath/rest) yawam (day), nor bawaa (come) it in by the shair (gates) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem);

Neither yatzaa (go out / come out) forth a mashaa (burden) out of your bayath (house) on the shabath (shabath/rest) yawam (day) qadash (set apart/make holy), neither ishah (make) any malaakah (work): but make the shabath (shabath/rest) yawam (day), as I tzawah (commanded) your ab (father).

But they didn't listen, neither natah (turn) their azan (ear), but made their irap (neck) qashah (rough / hard), that they might not shamai (hearken / hear), and might not laqach (take / seized) mawasar (instruction).

It shall happen, if you shamai (hearken / hear) shamai (hearken / hear) to me, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, to bawaa (come) in no mashaa (burden) through the shair (gates) of this iyar (city) on the shabath (shabath/rest) yawam (day), but to make the shabath (shabath/rest) yawam (day) qadash (set apart/make holy), to ishah (make) no malaakah (work) therein;

Then shall there bawaa (come) in by the shair (gates) of this iyar (city) malak (king) and shar (prince / ruler) sitting on the kasaa (throne) of Dawad (David), rakab (riding) in rakab (chariots) and on sawas (horses), they, and their shar (prince / ruler), the ayash (husband/individual man) of Yahawadah (Judah), and the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and this iyar (city) shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) iwalam (forever).

They shall bawaa (come) from the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and from the sabayab (surrounding) around Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and from the aratz (Earth/land) of Banayamayan (Benjamin), and from the lowland, and from the har (mountain) country, and from the nagab (south), bawaa (come) burnt ilah (offerings), and zabach (sacrifices), and meal manachah (offerings), and labawanah (frankincense), and bawaa (come) thawadah (sacrifices) of thanksgiving, to the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

But if you will not shamai (hearken / hear) to me to make the shabath (shabath/rest) yawam (day) qadash (set apart/make holy), and not to nashaa (lift) a mashaa (burden) and bawaa (come) in at the shair (gates) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) on the shabath (shabath/rest) yawam (day); then will I yatzath (kindle) a ash (fire) in its shair (gates), and it shall akal (eat) the aramawan (palaces) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and it shall not be kabah (quenched).
The dabar (word / matter) which came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Yahawah, amar (spoke),
Qawam (rise up), and yarad (go) down to the yatzar (potter's) bayath (house), and there I will shamai (hearken / hear) you to hear my dabar (word / matter).
Then I yarad (went) down to the yatzar (potter's) bayath (house), and hanah (Behold), he was ishah (make) a malaakah (work) on the aban (stone).

When the kalay (vessel) that he ishah (make) of the chamar (clay) was shachath (marred) in the yad (hand) of the yatzar (potter), he ishah (make) it again achar (other) kalay (vessel), as seemed yashar (good) to the yatzar (potter) to ishah (make) it.
Then the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to me, amar (spoke),

Bayath (house) of Yasharaal (Israel), can't I ishah (make) with you as this yatzar (potter)? Naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah. Behold, as the chamar (clay) in the yatzar (potter's) yad (hand), so are you in my yad (hand), bayath (house) of Yasharaal (Israel).

At what ragai (in an instance) I shall dabar (word / matter) concerning a gaway (nation / people), and concerning a mamalakah (kingdom), to nathash (pluck) up and to nathatz (break) down and to abad (destroy/perish) it;

If that gaway (nation / people), concerning which I have dabar (word / matter), shawab (turn back / repent) from their rai (evil), I will nacham (turn away / repent) of the rai (evil) that I chashab (thought) to ishah (make) to them.
At what ragai (in an instance) I shall dabar (word / matter) concerning a gaway (nation / people), and concerning a mamalakah (kingdom), to banah (build) and to natai (plant) it;

If they ishah (make) that which is rai (evil) in my iyan (eye), that they not shamai (hearken / hear) my qawal (sound / voice), then I will nacham (turn away / repent) of the tawab (pleasant/functional), with which I amar (spoke) I would yatab (benefit) them.

Now therefore, amar (spoke) to the ayash (husband/individual man) of Yahawadah (Judah), and to the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Behold, I yatzar (frame) rai (evil) against you, and chashab (devise) a machashabah (device) against you: shawab (turn back / repent) you now everyone from his rai (evil) darak (way), and yatab (amend) your darak (ways) and your mailal (doings).
But they amar (spoke), It is in vain; for we will yalak (walk) achar (other) our own machashabah (devices), and we will ishah (make) everyone after the stubbornness of his rai (evil) lab (heart).

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: shaal (ask) now among the gaway (nation / people), who has shamai (hearken / hear) such things; the bathawalah (virgin) of Yasharaal (Israel) ishah (make) done a very shairawarah (horrible) thing.
Shall the shalag (snow) of Labanawan (Lebanon) izab (fail) from the tzawar (rock) of the shadah (field)? Shall the qar (cold) mayam (Waters) that nazal (flow) down from afar be dried up?

For my im (people / nation) have shakach (forgotten) me, they have qatar (burned) incense to shawaa (vanity) Alahayam; and they have been made to stumble in their darak (ways), in the iwalam (forever) shabayal (paths), to yalak (walk) in byways, in a darak (way) not built up;

To shawam (place / establish / appoint) their aratz (Earth/land) an shamah (astonishment), and a iwalam (forever) sharawaqah (hissing); everyone who passes thereby shall be shamam (astonished), and nawad (shake) his raash (head).

I will pawatz (scatter) them as with an qadayam (east) rawach (spirit / wind) panayam (before) the ayab (enemy); I will show them the irap (neck), and not the panayam (face), in the yawam (day) of their ayad (calamity).

Then they amar (spoke), yalak (come), and let us chashab (devise) machashabah (devices) against Yaramayah (Jeremiah); for the thawarah (instruction) shall not abad (destroy/perish) from the kahan (priest), nor itzah (counsel) from the chakam (wise), nor the dabar (word / matter) from the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy). Yalak (come), and let us nakah (strike) him with the lashawan (tongue/language), and let us not qashab (give) heed to any of his dabar (word / matter).
Qashab (give) heed to me, Yahawah, and shamai (hearken / hear) to the qawal (sound / voice) of those who contend with me.

Shall rai (evil) be shalam (recompensed) for tawab (pleasant/functional)? For they have karah (dug) a shawachah (pit) for my napash (living being/soul). Zakar (remembrance/memory) how I imad (stood) panayam (before) you to dabar (word / matter) tawab (pleasant/functional) for them, to shawab (turn back / repent) away your chamah (wrath) from them.

Therefore nathan (give) up their ban (son) to the raib (famine), and give them over to the yad (hand) of the charab (sword); and let their wives become childless, and alamanah (widows); and let their ban (son) be slain of mawath (death), and their bachawar (young) men nakah (struck) of the charab (sword) in malachamah (battle).

Let a zaiq (cry) be shamai (hearken / hear) from their bayath (house), when you shall bawaa (come) a gadawad (troop) pathaawam (suddenly) on them; for they have karah (dug) a shayachah (pit) to lakad (take) me, and taman (hid) pach (snares) for my ragal (feet / foot).

Yet, Yahawah, you yadai (know) all their itzah (counsel) against me to kill me; don't kapar (forgive) their iwan (guilt/iniquity), neither machah (blot) out their chataah (sin) from your panayam (sight); but let them be kashal (stumble / stagger) panayam (before) you; ishah (make) you with them in the ith (time) of your ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting).

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, halak (move), and qanah (buy) a yatzar (potter's) charash (earthen) baqabaq (bottle), and take some of the zaqan (elders) of the im (people / nation), and of the zaqan (elders) of the kahan (priest);

And yatzaa (go out / come out) forth to the gayaa (valley) of the ban (son) of Hanam (Hinnom), which is by the entry of the shair (gate) Harsith, and qaraa (called) there the dabar (word / matter) that I shall dabar (word / matter) you;

And amar (spoke), shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), Behold, I will bawaa (come) rai (evil) on this maqawam (place), which whoever shamai (hearken / hear), his azan (ears) shall tzalal (tingle).

Because they have forsaken me, and have nakar (estranged) this maqawam (place), and have qatar (burned) incense in it to other Alahayam, that they didn't yadai (know), they and their ab (father) and the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah); and malaa (have) filled this maqawam (place) with the dam (blood) of naqay (innocents),

And have banah (built) the bamah (high) places of Bail (Baal), to sharap (burn) their ban (son) in the ash (fire) for burnt ilah (offerings) to Bail (Baal); which I didn't tzawah (command), nor dabar (word / matter) it, neither ilah (go up / offer) it into my lab (heart):

Therefore, behold, the yawam (day) bawaa (come), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, that this maqawam (place) shall no more be qaraa (called) Thapath (Topheth), nor The gayaa (valley) of the ban (son) of Hanam (Hinnom), but The gayaa (valley) of haragah (slaughter).

I will baqaq (make) void the itzah (counsel) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) in this maqawam (place); and I will napal (fall / be cast down) them to fall by the charab (sword) panayam (before) their ayab (enemy), and by the yad (hand) of those who baqash (seek) their napash (living being/soul): and their nabalah (dead) bodies will I nathan (give) to be maakal (food) for the iwap (flying) of the sky, and for the animals of the aratz (Earth/land).

I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) this iyar (city) an shamah (astonishment), and a sharaqah (hissing); everyone who passes thereby shall be shamam (astonished) and sharaq (hiss) because of all its makah (plagues).

I will cause them to akal (eat) the bashar (flesh) of their ban (son) and the bashar (flesh) of their bath (daughter); and they shall akal (eat) everyone the bashar (flesh) of his rai (neigbor/another person), in the matzawar (siege) and in the matzawaq (distress), with which their ayab (enemy), and those who baqash (seek) their napash (living being/soul), shall tzawaq (distress) them.
Then you shall shabar (break) the baqabaq (bottle) in the iyan (eye) of the ayash (husband/individual man) who halak (move) with you,

And shall amar (spoke) them, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop): Even so will I shabar (break) this im (people / nation) and this iyar (city), as one shabar (breaks) a yatzar (potter's) kalay (vessel), that can't be rapaa (made) whole again; and they shall qabar (bury) in Thapath (Topheth), until there is no maqawam (place) to qabar (bury).
Thus will I ishah (make) to this maqawam (place), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, and to its yashab (inhabit/dwell), even nathan (give) this iyar (city) as Thapath (Topheth):

And the bayath (house) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and the bayath (house) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), which are tamaa (defiled), shall be as the maqawam (place) of Thapath (Topheth), even all the bayath (house) on whose gag (roofs) they have qatar (burned) incense to all the tzabaa (troop) of the sky, and have nasak (poured) out drink nasak (offerings) to other Alahayam.

Then bawaa (come) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Thapath (Topheth), where Yahawah had shalach (send) him to nabaa (prophesy); and he imad (stood) in the chatzar (court) of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) bayath (house), and amar (spoke) to all the im (people / nation):

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), Behold, I will bawaa (come) on this iyar (city) and on all its iyar (towns) all the rai (evil) that I have dabar (word / matter) against it; because they have made their irap (neck) qashah (rough / hard), that they may not shamai (hearken / hear) my dabar (word / matter).

Pashachawar (Now) Pashhur, the ban (son) of Amar (Immer) the kahan (priest), who paqayad (was) chief officer in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, shamai (hearken / hear) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) nabaa (prophesying) these things.
