Then Pashachawar (Pashhur) nakah (struck) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), and nathan (give) him in the mahapakath (stocks) that were in the ilayawan (upper) shair (gate) of Banayamayan (Benjamin), which was in the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

It happened on the next macharath (day), that Pashachawar (Pashhur) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth Yaramayah (Jeremiah) out of the mahapakath (stocks). Then Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke) to him, Yahawah has not qaraa (called) your sham (name) Pashachawar (Pashhur), but magawaramasabayab (magormissabib).

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Behold, I will nathan (give) you a magawar (terror) to yourself, and to all your ahab (love); and they shall napal (fall / be cast down) by the charab (sword) of their ayab (enemy), and your iyan (eye) shall raah (see) it; and I will nathan (give) all Yahawadah (Judah) into the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and he shall galah (carry) them captive to Babal (Babylon), and shall nakah (kill) them with the charab (sword).

Moreover I will nathan (give) all the riches of this iyar (city), and all its gains, and all the yaqar (precious) things of it, yes, all the awatzar (treasures) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) will I nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of their ayab (enemy); and they shall make them a bazaz (prey), and laqach (take / seized) them, and bawaa (come) them to Babal (Babylon).

You, Pashachawar (Pashhur), and all who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in your bayath (house) shall yalak (go) into shabay (captivity); and you shall bawaa (come) to Babal (Babylon), and there you shall mawath (death), and there you shall be qabar (bury), you, and all your ahab (love), to whom you have nabaa (prophesied) falsely.

Yahawah, you have pathah (persuaded) me, and I was pathah (persuaded); you are chazaq (stronger) than I, and yakal (have) prevailed: I am become a laughing-stock all the yawam (day), every one laig (mocks) me.

For as often as I dabar (word / matter), I qaraa (called) out; I qaraa (called), chamas (violence) and destruction! Because the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah is made a charapah (reproach) to me, and a qalas (derision), all the yawam (day).

If I amar (spoke), I will not zakar (remembrance/memory) mention of him, nor dabar (word / matter) any more in his sham (name), then there is in my lab (heart) as it were a bair (burning) ash (fire) itzar (shut) up in my itzam (bones), and I am laah (weary) with kawal (all/every/entire), and I can't.

For I have shamai (hearken / hear) the dabah (defaming) of many, magawar (terror) on sabayab (surrounding) side. Nagad (denounce), and we will nagad (denounce) him, say all my familiar friends, those who shamar (keep/guard) for my fall; perhaps he will be pathah (persuaded), and we shall yakal (prevail) against him, and we shall laqach (take / seized) our naqamah (revenge) on him.

But Yahawah is with me as an awesome gabawar (mighty) irayatz (one): therefore my persecutors shall kashal (stumble / stagger), and they shall not yakal (prevail); they shall be maad (utterly) disappointed, because they shakal (have) not dealt wisely, even with an iwalam (forever) dishonor which shall never be shakach (forgotten).

But, Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), who tests the tzadayaq (righteous), who raah (see) the kalayah (heart) and the lab (heart), raah (see) me see your naqamah (vengeance) on them; for to you have I galah (revealed) my rayab (cause).
Shayar (sing) to Yahawah, halal (praise) Yahawah; for he has natzal (delivered) the napash (living being/soul) of the abayawan (needy) from the yad (hand) of evildoers.
Arar (cursed) is the yawam (day) in which I was yalad (birth / begot): don't let the yawam (day) in which my am (mother) yalad (birth / begot) me be barak (blessed).
Arar (cursed) is the ayash (husband/individual man) who bashar (brought) news to my ab (father), amar (spoke), A boy is yalad (birth / begot) to you; shamach (making) him very shamach (glad).

Let that ayash (husband/individual man) be as the iyar (cities) which Yahawah overthrew, and didn't nacham (turn away / repent): and shamai (hearken / hear) him hear a zaiq (cry) in the baqar (morning), and tharawaih (shouting) at noontime;
Because he didn't mawath (death) me from the racham (womb); and so my am (mother) would have been my qabar (grave / tomb / sepulcher), and her racham (womb) iwalam (forever) harah (great).
Why yatzaa (go out / come out) I forth out of the racham (womb) to raah (see) imal (labor) and yagawan (sorrow), that my yawam (day) should be kalah (complete / finish) with bashath (shame)?

The dabar (word / matter) which came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Yahawah, when malak (king) Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) shalach (send) Pashachawar (to) him Pashhur the ban (son) of Malakayah (Malchijah), and Tzapanayah (Zephaniah) the ban (son) of Maishayah (Maaseiah), the kahan (priest), amar (spoke),

Please darash (inquire) of Yahawah for us; for Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) makes lacham (war) against us: perhaps Yahawah will ishah (make) with us according to all his wondrous palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous), that he may ilah (go up / offer) up from us.
Then Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke) to them, You shall amar (spoke) Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah):

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), Behold, I will sabab (turn) back the kalay (weapons) of malachamah (war) that are in your yad (hand), with which you lacham (fight) against the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and against the Kashaday (Chaldeans) who tzawar (besiege) you, chawatz (without) the chawamah (walls); and I will asap (gather) them into the thawak (midst) of this iyar (city).

I myself will lacham (fight) against you with an natah (outstretched) yad (hand) and with a chazaq (strong) zarawai (arm), even in ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), and in chamah (wrath), and in gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qatzap (indignation).
I will nakah (strike) the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of this iyar (city), both adam (man) and animal: they shall mawath (death) of a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) dabar (word / matter).

Afterward, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, I will nathan (give) Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and his ibad (servant), and the im (people / nation), even such as are shaar (left) in this iyar (city) from the dabar (word / matter), from the charab (sword), and from the raib (famine), into the yad (hand) of Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and into the yad (hand) of their ayab (enemy), and into the yad (hand) of those who baqash (seek) their napash (living being/soul): and he shall nakah (strike) them with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword); he shall not chawas (spare) them, neither chamal (have) pity, nor have racham (mercy).
To this im (people / nation) you shall amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Behold, I nathan (give) panayam (before) you the darak (way) of chay (life) and the darak (way) of mawath (death).

He who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in this iyar (city) shall mawath (death) by the charab (sword), and by the raib (famine), and by the dabar (word / matter); but he who yatzaa (go out / come out) out, and passes over to the Kashaday (Chaldeans) who tzawar (besiege) you, he shall chayah (live), and his napash (living being/soul) shall be to him for a shalal (prey).

For I have shawam (place / establish / appoint) my panayam (face) on this iyar (city) for rai (evil), and not for tawab (pleasant/functional), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah: it shall be nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and he shall sharap (burn) it with ash (fire).
Touching the bayath (house) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah:

Bayath (house) of Dawad (David), thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Execute mashapat (justice) in the baqar (morning), and natzal (deliver) him who is gazal (robbed) out of the yad (hand) of the oppressor, lest my chamah (wrath) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth like ash (fire), and bair (burn) so that none can kabah (quench) it, panayam (because) of the rai (evil) of your mailal (doings).

Behold, I am against you, O yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the imaq (valley), and of the tzawar (rock) of the mayashawar (plain), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah; you that amar (spoke), Who shall nachath (come) down bawaa (come) us? Or who shall enter into our maiwanah (habitations)?

I will paqad (visit) you according to the paray (fruit) of your mailal (doings), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah; and I will yatzath (kindle) a ash (fire) in her yair (forest), and it shall akal (eat) all that is around her.
Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: yarad (go) down to the bayath (house) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and dabar (word / matter) there this dabar (word / matter),

Amar (spoke), shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), who yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the kasaa (throne) of Dawad (David), you, and your ibad (servant), and your im (people / nation) who bawaa (come) in by these shair (gates).

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: ishah (make) mashapat (justice) and tzadaqah (righteousness), and natzal (deliver) him who is gazal (robbed) out of the yad (hand) of the ishawaq (oppressor): and yanah (do) no wrong, chamas (do) no violence, to the foreigner, the yathawam (fatherless), nor the alamanah (widow); neither shapak (shed) naqay (innocent) dam (blood) in this maqawam (place).

For if you ishah (make) this thing ishah (make), then shall there bawaa (come) in by the shair (gates) of this bayath (house) malak (king) sitting on the kasaa (throne) of Dawad (David), rakab (riding) in rakab (chariots) and on sawas (horses), he, and his ibad (servant), and his im (people / nation).

But if you will not shamai (hearken / hear) these dabar (word / matter), I shabai (swear / take oath) by myself, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, that this bayath (house) shall become a desolation.

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah concerning the bayath (house) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah): You are Galaid (Gilead) to me, the raash (head) of Labanawan (Lebanon). Yet surely I will shayath (put / appoint / make) you a madabar (wilderness), iyar (cities) which are not yashab (inhabit/dwell).

I will qadash (set apart/make holy) destroyers against you, everyone with his kalay (weapons); and they shall karath (cut) down your mabachar (choice) araz (cedars), and napal (fall / be cast down) them into the ash (fire).

Many gaway (nation / people) shall ibar (pass over/through) by this iyar (city), and they shall amar (spoke) every ayash (husband/individual man) to his neighbor, Why has Yahawah ishah (make) thus to this gadawal (very great/important/mighty) iyar (city)?
Then they shall amar (spoke), Because they forsook the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah their Alahayam, and shachah (worshiped) other Alahayam, and ibad (servant) them.

Don't bakah (weep) for the mawath (death), neither nawad (bemoan) him; but bakah (weep) bitterly for him who halak (move) away; for he shall shawab (turn back / repent) no more, nor raah (see) his mawaladath (kindred / native land) aratz (Earth/land).

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah touching Shalawam (Shallum) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), who malak (king) instead of Yaashayah (Josiah) his ab (father), and who yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of this maqawam (place): He shall not shawab (turn back / repent) there any more.
But in the maqawam (place) where they have galah (led) him captive, there shall he mawath (death), and he shall raah (see) this aratz (Earth/land) no more.

Haway (Alas/Woe!) To him who banah (builds) his bayath (house) by unrighteousness, and his rooms by injustice; who uses his neighbor's ibad (servant) chanam (without) wages, and doesn't nathan (give) him his hire;

Who amar (spoke), I will banah (build) me a madah (wide) bayath (house) and spacious rooms, and qarai (cuts) him out chalawan (windows); and it is ceiling with araz (cedar), and mashach (painted) with vermilion.

Shall you malak (king), because you strive to excel in araz (cedar)? Didn't your ab (father) akal (eat) and shathah (drinks), and ishah (make) mashapat (justice) and tzadaqah (righteousness)? Then it was tawab (pleasant/functional) with him.
He dayan (judge) the dayan (judge) of the inay (poor) and abayawan (needy); then it was tawab (pleasant/functional). Wasn't this to daith (know) me? Naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

But your iyan (eye) and your lab (heart) are not but for your batzai (covetousness), and for shapak (shedding) naqay (innocent) dam (blood), and for ishaq (oppression), and for maratzah (violence), to ishah (make) it.

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah concerning Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah): they shall not sapad (lament) for him, saying, haway (Alas/Woe!) My ach (brother/kinsman)! Or, haway (Alas/Woe!) Achawath (sister)! They shall not sapad (lament) for him, saying haway (Alas/Woe!) Adawan! Or, haway (Alas/Woe!) His glory!
He shall be qabar (bury) with the qabawarah (burial) of a donkey, sachab (drawn) and shalak (cast) forth halaah (beyond) the shair (gates) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Ilah (go up / offer) up to Labanawan (Lebanon), and tzaiq (cry); and nathan (give) up your qawal (sound / voice) in Bashan (Bashan), and tzaiq (cry) from Abarim; for all your lovers are shabar (destroyed).

I dabar (word / matter) to you in your shalawah (prosperity); but you amar (spoke), I will not shamai (hearken / hear). This has been your darak (way) from your naiwar (youth), that you didn't shamai (hearken / hear) my qawal (sound / voice).

The rawach (spirit / wind) shall raih (feed) all your raih (shepherds), and your lovers shall yalak (go) into shabay (captivity): surely then you will be bawash (ashamed) and kalam (confounded) for all your rai (wickedness).

Yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Labanawan (Lebanon), who qanan (makes) your nest in the araz (cedars), how greatly to be chanan (pitied) you will be when chabal (pangs) bawaa (come) on you, the chayal (pain) as of a yalad (birth / begot) in travail!

As I chay (life), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, though Kanayahaw (Coniah) the ban (son) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) were the chawatham (signet) on my yamayan (right hand) yad (hand), yet would I nathaq (pluck) you there;

And I will nathan (give) you into the yad (hand) of those who baqash (seek) your napash (living being/soul), and into the yad (hand) of them of whom you are yagawar (afraid), even into the yad (hand) of Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and into the yad (hand) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans).
I will tawal (cast) you out, and your am (mother) who yalad (birth / begot) you, into achar (other) aratz (Earth/land), where you were not yalad (birth / begot); and there you will mawath (death).
But to the aratz (Earth/land) whereunto their nashaa (lift) longs to shawab (turn back / repent), there shall they not shawab (turn back / repent).

Is this ayash (husband/individual man) Kanayahaw (Coniah) a bazah (despised) napatz (broken) vessel? Is he a kalay (vessel) in which none chapatz (delights)? Why are they shalak (cast) out, he and his zarai (seed), and are tawal (cast) into the aratz (Earth/land) which they don't yadai (know)?
O aratz (Earth/land), aratz (Earth/land), aratz (Earth/land), shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, kathab (write) you this ayash (husband/individual man) irayaray (childless), a gabar (man) who shall not tzalach (prosper) in his yawam (day); for no more shall a ayash (husband/individual man) of his zarai (seed) tzalach (prosper), sitting on the kasaa (throne) of Dawad (David), and mashal (rule/have dominion) in Yahawadah (Judah).
Haway (Alas/Woe!) To the raih (shepherds) who abad (destroy/perish) and pawatz (scatter) the tzaan (sheep) of my maraiyath (pasture)! Naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), against the raih (shepherds) who raih (feed) my im (people / nation): You have pawatz (scattered) my tzaan (flock), and nadach (driven) them away, and paqad (visit) not visited them; behold, I will paqad (visit) on you the rai (evil) of your mailal (doings), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

I will qabatz (gather) the shaarayath (remnant) of my tzaan (flock) out of all the aratz (Earth/land) where I have nadach (driven) them, and will shawab (turn back / repent) them again to their nawah (habitation); and they shall be parah (fruitful) and rabah (multiply).

I will qawam (rise up) up raih (shepherds) over them, who shall raih (feed) them; and they shall yaraa (fear / be afraid) no more, nor be chathath (dismayed), neither shall any be paqad (visit), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

Behold, the yawam (day) bawaa (come), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, that I will qawam (rise up) to Dawad (David) a tzadayaq (righteous) tzamach (branch), and he shall malak (king) as malak (king) and deal shakal (wisely), and shall ishah (make) mashapat (justice) and tzadaqah (righteousness) in the aratz (Earth/land).

In his yawam (day) Yahawadah (Judah) shall be yashai (salvation), and Yasharaal (Israel) shall shakan (dwell) safely; and this is his sham (name) by which he shall be qaraa (called): Yahawah our righteousness.

Therefore, behold, the yawam (day) bawaa (come), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, that they shall no more amar (spoke), As Yahawah chay (life), who ilah (go up / offer) up the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt);

But, As Yahawah chay (life), who ilah (go up / offer) up and who bawaa (come) the zarai (seed) of the bayath (house) of Yasharaal (Israel) out of the tzapawan (north) aratz (Earth/land), and from all the aratz (Earth/land) where I had nadach (driven) them. They shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) in their own adamah (land).

Concerning the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy). My lab (heart) qarab (among / near) me is shabar (broken), all my itzam (bones) rachap (hover); I am like a shakawar (drunken) ayash (husband/individual man), and like a gabar (man) whom yayan (wine) ibar (pass over/through) overcome, panayam (because) of Yahawah, and because of his qadash (set apart/make holy) dabar (word / matter).

For the aratz (Earth/land) is malaa (full) of naap (adulterers); for panayam (because) of alah (these) the aratz (Earth/land) abal (mourns); the naah (pastures) of the madabar (wilderness) are yabash (dry land) up. Their marawatzah (course) is rai (evil), and their gabawarah (might) is not right;
For both nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) and kahan (priest) are chanap (profane); yes, in my bayath (house) matzaa (have) I found their rai (wickedness), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

Therefore their darak (way) shall be to them as chalaqalaqah (slippery) places in the apalah (darkness): they shall be dachah (driven) on, and napal (fall / be cast down) therein; for I will bawaa (come) rai (evil) on them, even the shanah (year) of their paqadah (visitation), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

I raah (see) seen thapalah (folly) in the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) of Shamarawan (Samaria); they nabaa (prophesied) by Bail (Baal), and caused my im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel) to thaih (err).

In the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) also I raah (see) seen a shairawarah (horrible) thing: they naap (commit) adultery, and halak (move) in shaqar (lies); and they chazaq (strengthen) the yad (hand) of evildoers, so that ayash (husband/individual man) does shawab (turn back / repent) from his rai (wickedness): they are all of them become to me as Sadam (Sodom), and its yashab (inhabit/dwell) as Imarah (Gomorrah).

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) concerning the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy): Behold, I will akal (eat) them with lainah (wormwood), and shaqah (make) them drink the mayam (Waters) of raash (head); for from the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) is ungodliness yatzaa (go out / come out) forth into all the aratz (Earth/land).

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), Don't shamai (hearken / hear) to the dabar (word / matter) of the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) who nabaa (prophesy) to you: they teach you vanity; they dabar (word / matter) a chazawan (vision) of their own lab (heart), and not out of the pah (mouth) of Yahawah.

They amar (spoke) continually to those who naatz (despise) me, Yahawah has dabar (word / matter), You shall have shalawam (peace / safety); and to everyone who halak (move) in the stubbornness of his own lab (heart) they amar (spoke), No rai (evil) shall bawaa (come) on you.

For who has imad (stood) in the council of Yahawah, that he should raah (see) and shamai (hearken / hear) his dabar (word / matter)? Who has qashab (marked) my dabar (word / matter), and shamai (hearken / hear) it?
Behold, the sair (storm) of Yahawah, his chamah (wrath), yatzaa (go out / come out) gone forth. Yes, a whirling sair (storm). It shall burst on the raash (head) of the rashai (wicked).

The ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah shall not shawab (turn back / repent), until he ishah (make) executed, and until he have qawam (rise up) the mazamah (intents) of his lab (heart): in the acharayath (latter) yawam (day) you shall bayan (between) it bayanah (perfectly).
I shalach (send) not these nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), yet they rawatz (ran): I didn't dabar (word / matter) to them, yet they nabaa (prophesied).

But if they had imad (stood) in my council, then had they caused my im (people / nation) to shamai (hearken / hear) my dabar (word / matter), and had shawab (turn back / repent) them from their rai (evil) darak (way), and from the rai (evil) of their mailal (doings).
Am I a Alahayam at qarawab (hand), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, and not a Alahayam rachawaq (afar) off?

Can any sathar (hide) himself in masathar (secret) places so that I shall not raah (see) him? Naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah. Don't I malaa (fill) shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) and aratz (Earth/land)? Naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.
I have shamai (hearken / hear) what the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) have amar (spoke), who nabaa (prophesy) shaqar (lies) in my sham (name), amar (spoke), I have chalam (dream), I have chalam (dream).

How long yash (shall) this be in the lab (heart) of the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) who nabaa (prophesy) shaqar (lies), even the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) of the tharamah (deceit) of their own lab (heart)?

Who chashab (think) to cause my im (people / nation) to shakach (forget) my sham (name) by their chalawam (dreams) which they sapar (book) every ayash (husband/individual man) to his neighbor, as their ab (father) shakach (forgot) my sham (name) for Bail (Baal).

The nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) who has a chalawam (dream), let him sapar (book) a chalawam (dream); and he who has my dabar (word / matter), let him dabar (word / matter) my dabar (word / matter) faithfully. What is the thaban (straw) to the bar (wheat)? Naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.
Isn't my dabar (word / matter) kah (like) ash (fire)? Naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah; and like a patayash (hammer) that pawatz (breaks) the salai (rock) in pawatz (pieces)?
Therefore, behold, I am against the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, who ganab (steal) my dabar (word / matter) everyone from his neighbor.

Behold, I am against the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, who use their lashawan (tongue/language), and naam (declares (prophetically)), He naam (declares (prophetically)).

Behold, I am against those who nabaa (prophesy) shaqar (lying) chalawam (dreams), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, and do sapar (book) them, and cause my im (people / nation) to thaih (err) by their shaqar (lies), and by their vain boasting: yet I didn't shalach (send) them, nor tzawah (commanded) them; neither yail (do) they profit this im (people / nation) at yail (all), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

When this im (people / nation), or the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), or a kahan (priest), shall shaal (ask) you, amar (spoke), What is the mashaa (burden) of Yahawah? Then you shall amar (spoke) them, What mashaa (burden)! I will natash (cast) you off, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

As for the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), and the kahan (priest), and the im (people / nation), who shall amar (spoke), The mashaa (burden) of Yahawah, I will even paqad (visit) that ayash (husband/individual man) and his bayath (house).
You shall amar (spoke) everyone to his neighbor, and everyone to his ach (brother/kinsman), What has Yahawah inah (answer / respond)? And, What has Yahawah dabar (word / matter)?

You shall zakar (remembrance/memory) the mashaa (burden) of Yahawah no more: for every ayash (husband/individual man) own dabar (word / matter) shall be his mashaa (burden); for you have perverted the dabar (word / matter) of the chay (life) Alahayam, of Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) our Alahayam.
You shall amar (spoke) to the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), What has Yahawah inah (answer / respond) you? And, What has Yahawah dabar (word / matter)?

But if you amar (spoke), The mashaa (burden) of Yahawah; therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Because you amar (spoke) this dabar (word / matter), The mashaa (burden) of Yahawah, and I have shalach (send) to you, amar (spoke), You shall not amar (spoke), The mashaa (burden) of Yahawah;

Therefore, behold, I will nashaa (lift) nashah (forget) you, and I will natash (cast) you off, and the iyar (city) that I nathan (give) to you and to your ab (father), away from my panayam (presence):
And I will nathan (give) an iwalam (forever) charapah (reproach) on you, and a iwalam (forever) kalamawath (shame), which shall not be shakach (forgotten).

Yahawah showed me, and behold, shanayam (two) dawaday (baskets) of thaan (figs) yaid (set) panayam (before) the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah, achar (other) that Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) had galah (carried) away captive Yakanayah (Jeconiah) the ban (son) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and the shar (prince / ruler) of Yahawadah (Judah), with the craftsmen and masagar (smiths), from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and bawaa (come) brought them to Babal (Babylon).

Achad (one) dawad (basket) had very tawab (pleasant/functional) thaan (figs), like the thaan (figs) that are bakarah (first-ripe); and the other dawad (basket) had very rai (bad) thaan (figs), which could not be akal (eat), they were so rai (bad).

Then Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, What do you raah (see), Yaramayah (Jeremiah)? I amar (spoke), thaan (figs); the tawab (pleasant/functional) thaan (figs), very tawab (pleasant/functional); and the rai (bad), very rai (bad), that can't be akal (eat), they are so rai (bad).
The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to me, amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): Like these tawab (pleasant/functional) thaan (figs), so will I nakar (regard) the galawath (captives) of Yahawadah (Judah), whom I have shalach (send) out of this maqawam (place) into the aratz (Earth/land) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans), for tawab (pleasant/functional).

For I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) my iyan (eye) on them for tawab (pleasant/functional), and I will shawab (turn back / repent) them again to this aratz (Earth/land): and I will banah (build) them, and not haras (pull) them down; and I will natai (plant) them, and not nathash (pluck) them up.

I will nathan (give) them a lab (heart) to yadai (know) me, that I am Yahawah: and they shall be my im (people / nation), and I will be their Alahayam; for they shall shawab (turn back / repent) to me with their whole lab (heart).

As the rai (bad) thaan (figs), which can't be akal (eat), they are so rai (bad), surely thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, So will I nathan (give) up Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and his shar (prince / ruler), and the shaarayath (residue) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), who shaar (remain) in this aratz (Earth/land), and those who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt),

I will even nathan (give) them up to be tossed back and forth among all the mamalakah (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land) for rai (evil); to be a charapah (reproach) and a mashal (proverb), a shanayanah (taunt) and a qalalah (curse), in all maqawam (place) where I shall nadach (drive) them.

I will shalach (send) the charab (sword), the raib (famine), and the dabar (word / matter), among them, until they be thamam (consumed) from off the adamah (land) that I nathan (give) to them and to their ab (father).

The dabar (word / matter) that came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) concerning all the im (people / nation) of Yahawadah (Judah), in the rabayaiy (fourth) shanah (year) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) (the same was the raashanay (first) shanah (year) of Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon)),

Which Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) dabar (word / matter) to all the im (people / nation) of Yahawadah (Judah), and to all the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), amar (spoke):

From the thirteenth shanah (year) of Yaashayah (Josiah) the ban (son) of Amawan (Amon), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), even to this yawam (day), these isharayam (twenty) - shalawash (three) shanah (years), the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah has come to me, and I have dabar (word / matter) to you, shakam (rising) up early and dabar (word / matter); but you have not shamai (hearken / hear).

Yahawah has shalach (send) to you all his ibad (servant) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), shakam (rising) up early and shalach (send) them (but you have not shamai (hearken / hear), nor natah (inclined) your azan (ear) to shamai (hearken / hear))

Amar (spoke), shawab (turn back / repent) now everyone from his rai (evil) darak (way), and from the rai (evil) of your mailal (doings), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the adamah (land) that Yahawah nathan (give) given to you and to your ab (father), from of iwalam (forever) and even forevermore;

And don't yalak (go) achar (other) other Alahayam to ibad (servant) them or shachah (worship) them, and don't provoke me to kais (anger) with the maishah (work) of your yad (hand); and I will raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil) you no harm.
Yet you have not shamai (hearken / hear) to me, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah; that you may provoke me to kais (anger) with the maishah (work) of your yad (hand) to your own rai (hurt).
Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop): Because you have not shamai (hearken / hear) my dabar (word / matter),

Behold, I will shalach (send) and laqach (take / seized) all the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the tzapawan (north), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, and I will send to Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), my ibad (servant), and will bawaa (come) them against this aratz (Earth/land), and against its yashab (inhabit/dwell), and against all these gaway (nation / people) around; and I will utterly charam (destroy) them, and shawam (place / establish / appoint) them an shamah (astonishment), and a sharaqah (hissing), and iwalam (forever) desolations.

Moreover I will abad (destroy/perish) from them the qawal (sound / voice) of shashawan (mirth) and the qawal (sound / voice) of shamachah (gladness), the qawal (sound / voice) of the chathan (bridegroom) and the qawal (sound / voice) of the kalah (complete / finish), the qawal (sound / voice) of the millstones, and the awar (light) of the nayar (lamp).

This whole aratz (Earth/land) shall be a desolation, and an shamah (astonishment); and these gaway (nation / people) shall ibad (servant) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) shabaiyam (seventy) shanah (years).

It shall happen, when shabaiyam (seventy) shanah (years) are malaa (accomplished), that I will paqad (visit) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and that gaway (nation / people), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, for their iwan (guilt/iniquity), and the aratz (Earth/land) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans); and I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) it shamamah (desolate) iwalam (forever).

I will bawaa (come) on that aratz (Earth/land) all my dabar (word / matter) which I have dabar (word / matter) against it, even all that is kathab (written) in this sapar (book / scribed document), which Yaramayah (Jeremiah) has nabaa (prophesied) against all the gaway (nation / people).

For many gaway (nation / people) and gadawal (very great/important/mighty) malak (king) shall ibad (servant) bondservants of them, even of them; and I will shalam (recompense) them according to their pail (deeds), and according to the maishah (work) of their yad (hand).

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), to me: laqach (take / seized) this kawas (cup) of the yayan (wine) of chamah (wrath) at my yad (hand), and cause all the gaway (nation / people), to whom I shalach (send) you, to shaqah (drink) it.
They shall shathah (drinks), and reel back and forth, and be halal (praise), panayam (because) of the charab (sword) that I will shalach (send) among them.
Then laqach (take / seized) I the kawas (cup) at yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) yad (hand), and made all the gaway (nation / people) to shaqah (drink), to whom Yahawah had shalach (send) me:

Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and its malak (king), and its shar (prince / ruler), to nathan (give) them a desolation, an shamah (astonishment), a sharaqah (hissing), and a qalalah (curse), as it is this yawam (day);
Paraih (Pharaoh) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and his ibad (servant), and his shar (prince / ruler), and all his im (people / nation);

And all the mixed people, and all the malak (king) of the aratz (Earth/land) of the Iwatz (Uz), and all the malak (king) of the Palashathay (Philistines), and Ashaqalawan (Ashkelon), and Izah (Gaza), and Iqarawan (Ekron), and the shaarayath (remnant) Ashadawad (of) Ashdod;
Adam (Edom), and Mawaab (Moab), and the ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon);
And all the malak (king) of Tzar (Tyre), and all the malak (king) of Tzayadawan (Sidon), and the malak (king) of the ay (isle) which is ibar (beyond) the yam (sea/waters);
Dadan (Dedan), and Thayamaa (Tema), and Bawaz (Buz), and all who have the paah (corners) of their beard qatzatz (cut) off;
And all the malak (king) of Irab (Arabia), and all the malak (king) of the mixed irab (evening) who shakan (dwell) in the madabar (wilderness);
And all the malak (king) of Zamaray (Zimri), and all the malak (king) of Iyalam (Elam), and all the malak (king) of the Maday (Medes);

And all the malak (king) of the tzapawan (north), rachawaq (far) and qarawab (near), ayash (husband/individual man) with ach (brother/kinsman); and all the mamalakah (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land), which are on the surface of the adamah (earth): and the malak (king) of Shashak (Sheshach) shall shathah (drinks) achar (other) them.

You shall amar (spoke) them, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): shathah (drinks), and be shakar (drunk), vomit, napal (fall / be cast down), and qawam (rise up) no more, panayam (because) of the charab (sword) which I will shalach (send) among you.

It shall be, if they maan (refuse) to laqach (take / seized) the kawas (cup) at your yad (hand) to shathah (drinks), then you shall amar (spoke) them, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop): You shall shathah (drinks) shathah (drinks).

For, behold, I chalal (begin) to work raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil) at the iyar (city) which is qaraa (called) by my sham (name); and should you be naqah (clean/innocent) naqah (clean/innocent)? You shall not be naqah (clean/innocent); for I will qaraa (called) for a charab (sword) on all the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the aratz (Earth/land), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).

Therefore nabaa (prophesy) you against them all these dabar (word / matter), and amar (spoke) them, Yahawah will shaag (roar) from on marawam (high), and nathan (give) his qawal (sound / voice) from his qadash (set apart/make holy) maiwan (habitation); he will shaag (mightily) shaag (roar) against his nawah (habitation); he will inah (answer / respond) a hayadad (shout), as those who darak (tread) grapes, against all the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the aratz (Earth/land).

A shaawan (noise) shall bawaa (come) even to the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the aratz (Earth/land); for Yahawah has a rayab (controversy) with the gaway (nation / people); he will enter into shapat (judgment) with all bashar (flesh): as for the rashai (wicked), he will nathan (give) them to the charab (sword), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), Behold, rai (evil) shall yatzaa (go out / come out) forth from gaway (nation / people) to gaway (nation / people), and a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) sair (storm) shall be iwar (rouse / awaken) up from the uttermost yarakah (parts) of the aratz (Earth/land).

The chalal (slain) of Yahawah shall be at that yawam (day) from one qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the aratz (Earth/land) even to the other qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the aratz (Earth/land): they shall not be sapad (lamented), neither asap (gathered), nor qabar (bury); they shall be daman (dung) on the surface of the adamah (ground).

Wail, you raih (shepherds), and zaiq (cry); and wallow in dust, you adayar (principal) of the tzaan (flock); for the yawam (day) of your tabach (slaughter) and of your thapawatzah (dispersions) are fully come, and you shall napal (fall / be cast down) like a chamadah (goodly) kalay (vessel).
The raih (shepherds) shall have no manawas (way) to abad (destroy/perish), nor the adayar (principal) of the tzaan (flock) to palayatah (escape).
A qawal (sound / voice) of the tzaiqah (cry) of the raih (shepherds), and the wailing of the adayar (principal) of the tzaan (flock)! For Yahawah lays shadad (waste) their maraiyath (pasture).
The peaceable folds are brought to damam (silence) panayam (because) of the charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah.

He has izab (left) his sak (covert), as the kapayar (lion); for their aratz (Earth/land) has become an shamah (astonishment) panayam (because) of the charawan (fierceness) of the oppression, and panayam (because) of his charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting).

In the raashayath (beginning) of the mamalakawath (reign) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), came this dabar (word / matter) from Yahawah, amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: imad (stand) in the chatzar (court) of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) bayath (house), and dabar (word / matter) to all the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), which bawaa (come) to shachah (worship) in yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) bayath (house), all the dabar (word / matter) that I tzawah (command) you to dabar (word / matter) to them; don't garai (diminish) a dabar (word / matter).

It may be they will shamai (hearken / hear), and shawab (turn back / repent) every ayash (husband/individual man) from his rai (evil) darak (way); that I may nacham (turn away / repent) me of the rai (evil) which I chashab (purpose) to ishah (make) to them panayam (because) of the rai (evil) of their mailal (doings).
You shall amar (spoke) them, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: If you will not shamai (hearken / hear) to me, to yalak (walk) in my thawarah (instruction), which I nathan (give) set panayam (before) you,

To shamai (hearken / hear) to the dabar (word / matter) of my ibad (servant) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), whom I shalach (send) to you, even shakam (rising) up early and shalach (send) them, but you have not shamai (hearken / hear);
Then will I nathan (give) this bayath (house) like Shayalah (Shiloh), and will nathan (give) this iyar (city) a qalalah (curse) to all the gaway (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land).

The kahan (priest) and the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) and all the im (people / nation) shamai (hearken / hear) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) dabar (word / matter) these dabar (word / matter) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

It happened, when Yaramayah (Jeremiah) kalah (complete / finish) made an end of dabar (word / matter) all that Yahawah had tzawah (commanded) him to dabar (word / matter) to all the im (people / nation), that the kahan (priest) and the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) and all the im (people / nation) thapash (laid) hold on him, amar (spoke), You shall mawath (death) mawath (death).

Why have you nabaa (prophesied) in the sham (name) of Yahawah, amar (spoke), This bayath (house) shall be like Shayalah (Shiloh), and this iyar (city) shall be charab (desolate), without yashab (inhabit/dwell)? All the im (people / nation) were qahal (gathered) to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

When the shar (prince / ruler) of Yahawadah (Judah) shamai (hearken / hear) these things, they ilah (go up / offer) up from the malak (king) bayath (house) to the bayath (house) of Yahawah; and they yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the entry of the chadash (new) shair (gate) of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) house.

Then amar (spoke) the kahan (priest) and the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) to the shar (prince / ruler) and to all the im (people / nation), amar (spoke), This ayash (husband/individual man) is mashapat (worthy) of mawath (death); for he has nabaa (prophesied) against this iyar (city), as you have shamai (hearken / hear) with your azan (ears).

Then amar (spoke) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) to all the shar (prince / ruler) and to all the im (people / nation), amar (spoke), Yahawah shalach (send) me to nabaa (prophesy) against this bayath (house) and against this iyar (city) all the dabar (word / matter) that you have shamai (hearken / hear).

Now therefore yatab (amend) your darak (ways) and your mailal (doings), and shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah your Alahayam; and Yahawah will nacham (turn away / repent) him of the rai (evil) that he has dabar (word / matter) against you.
But as for me, behold, I am in your yad (hand): ishah (make) with me as is tawab (pleasant/functional) and yashar (right) in your eyes.

Only yadai (know) for certain that, if you put me to mawath (death), you will nathan (give) naqay (innocent) dam (blood) on yourselves, and on this iyar (city), and on its yashab (inhabit/dwell); for of a amath (truth) Yahawah has shalach (send) me to you to dabar (word / matter) all these dabar (word / matter) in your azan (ears).

Then the shar (prince / ruler) and all the im (people / nation) amar (spoke) to the kahan (priest) and to the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy): This ayash (husband/individual man) is not mashapat (worthy) of mawath (death); for he has dabar (word / matter) to us in the sham (name) of Yahawah our Alahayam.
Then qawam (rise up) up ayash (husband/individual man) of the zaqan (elders) of the aratz (Earth/land), and amar (spoke) to all the qahal (assembly) of the im (people / nation), amar (spoke),

Mayakayah (Micah) the Morashtite nabaa (prophesied) in the yawam (day) of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah); and he amar (spoke) to all the im (people / nation) of Yahawadah (Judah), amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop): Tzayawan (Zion) shall be charash (plowed) as a shadah (field), and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) shall become iy (heaps), and the har (mountain) of the bayath (house) as the bamah (high) places of a yair (forest).

Did Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) and mawath (death) Yahawadah (Judah) put him to mawath (death)? Didn't he yaraa (fear) Yahawah, and entreat the favor of Yahawah, and Yahawah relented of the disaster which he had dabar (word / matter) against them? Thus should we ishah (make) gadawal (very great/important/mighty) rai (evil) against our own napash (living being/soul).

There was also a ayash (husband/individual man) who nabaa (prophesied) in the sham (name) of Yahawah, Awarayah (Uriah) the ban (son) of Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) of Kiriath Qarayathayairayam (Jearim); and he nabaa (prophesied) against this iyar (city) and against this aratz (Earth/land) according to all the dabar (word / matter) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah):

And when Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the malak (king), with all his gabawar (mighty) men, and all the shar (prince / ruler), shamai (hearken / hear) his dabar (word / matter), the malak (king) baqash (sought) to put him to mawath (death); but when Awarayah (Uriah) shamai (hearken / hear) it, he was yaraa (fear / be afraid), and barach (fled), and bawaa (come) into Matzarayam (Egypt):

And Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the malak (king) shalach (send) ayash (husband/individual man) into Matzarayam (Egypt), Alanathan (Elnathan) the ban (son) of Ikabawar (Achbor), and ayash (husband/individual man) men with him, into Matzarayam (Egypt);

And they yatzaa (go out / come out) forth Awarayah (Uriah) out of Matzarayam (Egypt), and bawaa (come) him to Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the malak (king), who nakah (killed) him with the charab (sword), and shalak (cast) his nabalah (dead) body into the qabar (grave / tomb / sepulcher) of the ban (son) im (people / nation).

But the yad (hand) of Achayaqam (Ahikam) the ban (son) Shapan (of) Shaphan was with Yaramayah (Jeremiah), that they should not nathan (give) him into the yad (hand) of the im (people / nation) to put him to mawath (death).

In the raashayath (beginning) of the mamalakah (reign) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), came this dabar (word / matter) to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Yahawah, amar (spoke),
Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah to me: ishah (make) mawasar (bonds) and bars, and nathan (give) them on your tzawaar (neck);

And shalach (send) them to the malak (king) of Adam (Edom), and to the malak (king) of Mawaab (Moab), and to the malak (king) of the ban (son) of Ammon, and to the malak (king) of Tzar (Tyre), and to the malak (king) of Tzayadawan (Sidon), by the yad (hand) of the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) who bawaa (come) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah);

And give them a tzawah (command) to their adawan (master / lord), amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), You shall amar (spoke) your adawan (master / lord):

I ishah (make) made the aratz (Earth/land), the adam (men) and the animals that are on the surface of the aratz (Earth/land), by my gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kach (strength / mighty / power) and by my natah (outstretched) zarawai (arm); and I nathan (give) it to whom it seems yashar (right) to me.

Now nathan (give) I given all these aratz (Earth/land) into the yad (hand) of Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), my ibad (servant); and the animals of the shadah (field) also nathan (give) I given him to ibad (servant) him.

All the gaway (nation / people) shall ibad (servant) him, and his ban (son), and his ban (son) ban (son), until the ith (time) of his own aratz (Earth/land) bawaa (come): and then many gaway (nation / people) and gadawal (very great/important/mighty) malak (king) shall ibad (servant) him their bondservant.

It shall happen, that the gaway (nation / people) and the mamalakah (kingdom) which will not ibad (servant) the same Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and that will not nathan (give) their tzawaar (neck) under the il (over) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), that gaway (nation / people) will I paqad (visit), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, with the charab (sword), and with the raib (famine), and with the dabar (word / matter), until I thamam (have) consumed them by his yad (hand).

But as for you, don't you shamai (hearken / hear) to your nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), nor to your diviners, nor to your chalawam (dreams), nor to your inan (cloud intepreting / soothsaying / astrology), nor to your kashap (sorcerers), who amar (spoke) to you, amar (spoke), You shall not ibad (servant) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon):
For they nabaa (prophesy) a shaqar (lie) to you, to rachaq (remove) you far from your adamah (land), and that I should nadach (drive) you out, and you should abad (destroy/perish).

But the gaway (nation / people) that shall bawaa (come) their tzawaar (neck) under the il (over) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and ibad (servant) him, that nation will I yanach (let) remain in their own adamah (land), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah; and they shall ibad (servant) it, and yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein.

I dabar (word / matter) to Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) according to all these dabar (word / matter), amar (spoke), bawaa (come) your tzawaar (necks) under the il (over) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and ibad (servant) him and his im (people / nation), and chayah (live).

Why will you mawath (death), you and your im (people / nation), by the charab (sword), by the raib (famine), and by the dabar (word / matter), as Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) concerning the gaway (nation / people) that will not ibad (servant) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon)?

Don't shamai (hearken / hear) to the dabar (word / matter) of the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) who amar (spoke) to you, amar (spoke), You shall not ibad (servant) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon); for they nabaa (prophesy) a shaqar (lie) to you.

For I have not shalach (send) them, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, but they nabaa (prophesy) falsely in my sham (name); that I may nadach (drive) you out, and that you may abad (destroy/perish), you, and the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) who nabaa (prophesy) to you.

Also I dabar (word / matter) to the kahan (priest) and to all this im (people / nation), amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Don't shamai (hearken / hear) to the dabar (word / matter) of your nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) who nabaa (prophesy) to you, amar (spoke), Behold, the kalay (vessels) of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) bayath (house) shall now maharah (shortly) be shawab (turn back / repent) again from Babal (Babylon); for they nabaa (prophesy) a shaqar (lie) to you.
Don't shamai (hearken / hear) to them; ibad (servant) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and chayah (live): why should this iyar (city) become a desolation?

But if they be nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), and if the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah be with them, let them now pagai (make) intercession to Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), that the kalay (vessels) which are yathar (left) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and in the bayath (house) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), don't bawaa (come) to Babal (Babylon).

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) concerning the imawad (pillar), and concerning the yam (sea/waters), and concerning the makawanah (bases), and concerning the yathar (residue) of the kalay (vessels) that are yathar (left) in this iyar (city),

Which Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) didn't laqach (take / seized), when he galah (carried) away captive Yakanayah (Jeconiah) the ban (son) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to Babal (Babylon), and all the char (nobles) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem);

Yes, thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), concerning the kalay (vessels) that are yathar (left) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and in the bayath (house) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem):

They shall be bawaa (come) to Babal (Babylon), and there shall they be, until the yawam (day) that I paqad (visit) them, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah; then will I ilah (go up / offer) them up, and shawab (turn back / repent) them to this maqawam (place).

It happened the same shanah (year), in the raashayath (beginning) of the mamalakah (reign) of Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), in the rabayaiy (fourth) shanah (year), in the chamayashay (fifth) chadash (month), that Chananayah (Hananiah) the ban (son) of Izawar (Azzur), the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), who was of Gabaiwan (Gibeon), amar (spoke) to me in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, in the iyan (eye) of the kahan (priest) and of all the im (people / nation), amar (spoke),
Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), amar (spoke), I have shabar (broken) the il (over) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon).

Within yawam (day) full shanah (years) will I shawab (turn back / repent) again into this maqawam (place) all the kalay (vessels) of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) bayath (house), that Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) laqach (take / seized) away from this maqawam (place), and bawaa (come) to Babal (Babylon):

And I will shawab (turn back / repent) again to this maqawam (place) Yakanayah (Jeconiah) the ban (son) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), with all the galawath (captives) of Yahawadah (Judah), who bawaa (come) to Babal (Babylon), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah; for I will shabar (break) the il (over) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon).

Then the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke) to the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) Chananayah (Hananiah) in the iyan (eye) of the kahan (priest), and in the iyan (eye) of all the im (people / nation) who imad (stood) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah,

Even the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke), aman (believe / have faith): Yahawah ishah (make) so; Yahawah qawam (rise up) your dabar (word / matter) which you have nabaa (prophesied), to shawab (turn back / repent) again the kalay (vessels) of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) bayath (house), and all them of the gawalah (captivity), from Babal (Babylon) to this maqawam (place).
Nevertheless shamai (hearken / hear) you now this dabar (word / matter) that I dabar (word / matter) in your azan (ears), and in the azan (ears) of all the im (people / nation):

The nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) who have been panayam (before) me and panayam (before) you of iwalam (forever) nabaa (prophesied) against many aratz (Earth/land), and against gadawal (very great/important/mighty) mamalakah (kingdoms), of malachamah (war), and of rai (evil), and of dabar (word / matter).

The nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) who prophesies of shalawam (peace / safety), when the dabar (word / matter) of the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) shall happen, then shall the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) be yadai (known), that Yahawah has truly shalach (send) him.
Then Chananayah (Hananiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) laqach (take / seized) the bar from off the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) Yaramayah (Jeremiah's) tzawaar (neck), and shabar (broke) it.

Chananayah (Hananiah) amar (spoke) in the iyan (eye) of all the im (people / nation), amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Even so will I shabar (break) the il (over) of Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) within yawam (day) full shanah (years) from off the tzawaar (neck) of all the gaway (nation / people). The nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) yalak (went) his darak (way).

Then the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), achar (other) that Chananayah (Hananiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) had shabar (broken) the bar from off the tzawaar (neck) of the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) Yaramayah (Jeremiah), amar (spoke),

Halak (move), and amar (spoke) Chananayah (Hananiah), amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: You have shabar (broken) the bars of itz (wood); but you ishah (make) made in their place bars of barazal (iron).

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): I nathan (give) put a il (over) of barazal (iron) on the tzawaar (neck) of all these gaway (nation / people), that they may ibad (servant) Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon); and they shall ibad (servant) him: and I nathan (give) given him the animals of the shadah (field) also.

Then the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke) to Chananayah (Hananiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), shamai (hearken / hear) now, Chananayah (Hananiah): Yahawah has not shalach (send) you; but you make this im (people / nation) to batach (trust) in a shaqar (lie).

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Behold, I will shalach (send) you away from off the surface of the adamah (earth): this shanah (year) you shall mawath (death), because you have dabar (word / matter) sarah (rebellion) against Yahawah.
So Chananayah (Hananiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) mawath (death) the same shanah (year) in the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month).

Now these are the dabar (word / matter) of the sapar (book / scribed document) that Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) shalach (send) from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to the yathar (residue) of the zaqan (elders) of the gawalah (captivity), and to the kahan (priest), to the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), and to all the im (people / nation), whom Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) had galah (carried) away captive from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to Babal (Babylon),

(Achar (other) that Yakanayah (Jeconiah) the malak (king), the gabayarah (queen) mother, the sarayas (eunuchs), the shar (prince / ruler) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), the craftsmen, and the masagar (smiths), yatzaa (go out / come out) departed from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)),

By the yad (hand) of Alaishah (Elasah) the ban (son) Shapan (of) Shaphan, and Gamarayah (Gemariah) the ban (son) Chalaqayah (of) Hilkiah, (whom Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) shalach (send) to Babal (Babylon) to Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon)), amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), to all the captivity, whom I have caused to be galah (carried) away gawalah (captive) from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to Babal (Babylon):
Banah (build) bayath (house), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) in them; and natai (plant) ganah (gardens), and akal (eat) their paray (fruit).

Laqach (take / seized) wives, and yalad (birth / begot) ban (son) and bath (daughter); and laqach (take / seized) wives for your ban (son), and nathan (give) your bath (daughter) to ayash (husband/individual man), that they may yalad (birth / begot) ban (son) and ban (son); and rabah (multiply) there, and don't be mait (diminished).

Darash (seek) the shalawam (peace / safety) of the iyar (city) where I have caused you to be galah (carried) away captive, and palal (pray) to Yahawah for it; for in its shalawam (peace / safety) you shall have shalawam (peace / safety).

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): Don't let your nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) who are in the qarab (among / near) of you, and your diviners, nashaa (lift) you; neither shamai (hearken / hear) to your chalawam (dreams) which you cause to be chalam (dream).
For they nabaa (prophesy) falsely to you in my sham (name): I have not shalach (send) them, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, pah (after) shabaiyam (seventy) shanah (years) are malaa (accomplished) for Babal (Babylon), I will paqad (visit) you, and qawam (rise up) my tawab (pleasant/functional) dabar (word / matter) toward you, in causing you to shawab (turn back / repent) to this maqawam (place).

For I yadai (know) the machashabah (thoughts) that I chashab (think) toward you, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, machashabah (thoughts) of shalawam (peace / safety), and not of rai (evil), to nathan (give) you thaqawah (hope) and a future.
You shall qaraa (called) on me, and you shall halak (move) and palal (pray) to me, and I will shamai (hearken / hear) to you.
You shall baqash (seek) me, and matzaa (find) me, when you shall darash (search) for me with all your labab (heart).

I will be matzaa (found) by you, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, and I will shawab (turn back / repent) again your shabawath (captivity), and I will qabatz (gather) you from all the gaway (nation / people), and from all the maqawam (place) where I have nadach (driven) you, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah; and I will shawab (turn back / repent) you again to the maqawam (place) from where I caused you to be galah (carried) away captive.
Because you have amar (spoke), Yahawah has qawam (rise up) us up nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) in Babal (Babylon);

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah concerning the malak (king) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the kasaa (throne) of Dawad (David), and concerning all the im (people / nation) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in this iyar (city), your ach (brother/kinsman) who haven't yatzaa (go out / come out) forth with you into gawalah (captivity);

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop); Behold, I will shalach (send) on them the charab (sword), the raib (famine), and the dabar (word / matter), and will nathan (give) them like shair (vile) thaan (figs), that can't be akal (eat), they are so rai (bad).

I will radap (pursue) achar (other) them with the charab (sword), with the raib (famine), and with the dabar (word / matter), and will nathan (give) them to be tossed back and forth among all the mamalakah (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land), to be an object of horror, and an shamah (astonishment), and a sharaqah (hissing), and a charapah (reproach), among all the gaway (nation / people) where I have nadach (driven) them;

Because they have not shamai (hearken / hear) to my dabar (word / matter), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, with which I shalach (send) to them my ibad (servant) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), shakam (rising) up early and shalach (send) them; but you would not shamai (hearken / hear), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.
Shamai (hearken / hear) therefore the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, all you of the gawalah (captivity), whom I have shalach (send) away from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to Babal (Babylon).

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), concerning Achaab (Ahab) the ban (son) of Qawalayah (Kolaiah), and concerning Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the ban (son) of Maishayah (Maaseiah), who nabaa (prophesy) a shaqar (lie) to you in my sham (name): Behold, I will nathan (give) them into the yad (hand) of Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon); and he shall nakah (kill) them before your iyan (eye);

And of them shall be laqach (take / seized) up a qalalah (curse) by all the galawath (captives) of Yahawadah (Judah) who are in Babal (Babylon), amar (spoke), Yahawah shawam (place / establish / appoint) you like Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) and like Achaab (Ahab), whom the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) qalah (roasted) in the ash (fire);

Because they ishah (make) worked nabalah (folly) in Yasharaal (Israel), and ishah (make) committed naap (adultery) with their neighbors' wives, and have dabar (word / matter) dabar (word / matter) in my sham (name) falsely, which I didn't tzawah (command) them; and I am he who yadai (knows), and am id (witness), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.
Concerning Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) the nachalamay (nehelamite) you shall amar (spoke), amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), amar (spoke), Because you have shalach (send) sapar (book / scribed document) in your own sham (name) to all the im (people / nation) who are at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and to Tzapanayah (Zephaniah) the ban (son) of Maishayah (Maaseiah), the kahan (priest), and to all the kahan (priest), amar (spoke),

Yahawah nathan (give) made you kahan (priest) in the place of Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the kahan (priest), that there may be officers in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, for every ayash (husband/individual man) who is shagai (mad), and makes himself a nabaa (prophet), that you should nathan (give) him in the tzayanaq (stocks) and in shackles.
Now therefore, why have you not gair (rebuked) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) of inathathay (anathoth), who makes himself a nabaa (prophet) to you,

Because he has shalach (send) to us in Babal (Babylon), amar (spoke), The captivity is arak (long): banah (build) bayath (house), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) in them; and natai (plant) ganah (gardens), and akal (eat) their paray (fruit)?
Tzapanayah (Zephaniah) the kahan (priest) qaraa (called) this sapar (book / scribed document) in the azan (ears) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy).
Then came the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), amar (spoke),

Shalach (send) to all them of the gawalah (captivity), amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah concerning Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) the nachalamay (nehelamite): Because Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) has nabaa (prophesied) to you, and I didn't shalach (send) him, and he has caused you to batach (trust) in a shaqar (lie);

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Behold, I will paqad (visit) Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) the nachalamay (nehelamite), and his zarai (seed); he shall not have a ayash (husband/individual man) to yashab (inhabit/dwell) thawak (midst) this im (people / nation), neither shall he raah (see) the tawab (pleasant/functional) that I will ishah (make) to my im (people / nation), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, because he has dabar (word / matter) sarah (rebellion) against Yahawah.
The dabar (word / matter) that came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Yahawah, amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), amar (spoke), kathab (write) all the dabar (word / matter) that I have dabar (word / matter) to you in a sapar (book / scribed document).

For, behold, the yawam (day) bawaa (come), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, that I will shawab (turn back / repent) again the shabawath (captivity) of my im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel) and Yahawadah (Judah), amar (spoke) Yahawah; and I will cause them to shawab (turn back / repent) to the aratz (Earth/land) that I nathan (give) to their ab (father), and they shall yarash (possess) it.
These are the dabar (word / matter) that Yahawah dabar (word / matter) concerning Yasharaal (Israel) and concerning Yahawadah (Judah).
For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: We have shamai (hearken / hear) a qawal (sound / voice) of charadah (trembling), of pachad (fear / dread), and not of shalawam (peace / safety).

Shaal (ask) now, and raah (see) whether a zakar (remembrance/memory) does yalad (birth / begot) with child: why do I raah (see) every gabar (man) with his yad (hand) on his waist, as a yalad (birth / begot) in travail, and all panayam (faces) are hapak (turned) into paleness?

Haway (Alas/Woe!)! For that yawam (day) is gadawal (very great/important/mighty), so that none is like it: it is even the ith (time) of Yaiqab (Jacob's) tzarah (trouble); but he shall be yashai (salvation) out of it.

It shall come to pass in that yawam (day), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), that I will shabar (break) his il (over) from off your tzawaar (neck), and will nathaq (burst) your mawasar (bonds); and strangers shall no more ibad (servant) him their bondservant;
But they shall ibad (servant) Yahawah their Alahayam, and Dawad (David) their malak (king), whom I will qawam (rise up) up to them.

Therefore don't you be yaraa (fear / be afraid), O Yaiqab (Jacob) my ibad (servant), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah; neither be chathath (dismayed), Yasharaal (Israel): for, behold, I will yashai (salvation) you from rachawaq (afar), and your zarai (seed) from the aratz (Earth/land) of their shabay (captivity); and Yaiqab (Jacob) shall shawab (turn back / repent), and shall be shaqat (quiet) and at shaan (ease), and none shall make him charad (afraid).

For I am with you, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, to yashai (salvation) you: for I will ishah (make) a kalah (complete / finish) end of all the gaway (nation / people) where I have pawatz (scattered) you, but I will not ishah (make) a kalah (complete / finish) end of you; but I will yasar (correct) you in mashapat (measure), and will in no naqah (clean/innocent) leave you naqah (clean/innocent).
For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Your shabar (hurt) is anash (incurable), and your makah (wound) chalah (afflict).
There is none to plead your dayan (judge), that you may be mazawar (bound) up: you have no thailah (healing) rapaah (medicines).

All your lovers have shakach (forgotten) you; they don't darash (seek) you: for I have wounded you with the makah (wound) of an ayab (enemy), with the mawasar (chastisement) of a akazaray (cruel) one, for the greatness of your iwan (guilt/iniquity), because your chataah (sin) were itzam (increased).

Why do you zaiq (cry) for your shabar (hurt)? Your makaab (pain) is anash (incurable): for the greatness of your iwan (guilt/iniquity), because your chataah (sin) were itzam (increased), I ishah (make) done these things to you.

Therefore akal (eat) those who devour you shall be akal (eat); and all your tzar (oppressor / distressor), everyone of them, shall yalak (go) into shabay (captivity); and those who despoil you shall be a shaas (spoil), and all who bazaz (prey) on you will I nathan (give) for a baz (prey).

For I will ilah (go up / offer) arawakah (health) to you, and I will rapaa (heal) you of your makah (wounds), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah; because they have qaraa (called) you an nadach (outcast), saying, It is Tzayawan (Zion), whom no man darash (seeks) after.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Behold, I will shawab (turn back / repent) again the shabawath (captivity) of Yaiqab (Jacob's) ahal (tents), and racham (have) compassion on his mashakan (dwelling) places; and the iyar (city) shall be banah (built) on its own hill, and the aramawan (palace) shall be yashab (inhabit/dwell) in its own mashapat (way).

Out of them shall yatzaa (go out / come out) thanksgiving and the qawal (sound / voice) of those who shachaq (make) merry: and I will rabah (multiply) them, and they shall not be mait (few); I will also kabad (glorify) them, and they shall not be tzair (small).
Their ban (son) also shall be as qadam (before), and their idah (congregation) shall be kawan (established) panayam (before) me; and I will paqad (visit) all who lachatz (oppress) them.

Their adayar (prince) shall be of themselves, and their mashal (rule/have dominion) shall yatzaa (go out / come out) from their qarab (among / near); and I will cause him to qarab (come close) near, and he shall nagash (approach) to me: for who is he who has had boldness to nagash (approach) to me? Naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.
You shall be my im (people / nation), and I will be your Alahayam.
Behold, the sair (storm) of Yahawah, his chamah (wrath), yatzaa (go out / come out) gone forth, a sweeping sair (storm): it shall burst on the raash (head) of the rashai (wicked).

The charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah will not shawab (turn back / repent), until he ishah (make) executed, and until he has qawam (rise up) the intentions of his lab (heart). In the acharayath (latter) yawam (day) you will bayan (between) it.
At that ith (time), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, will I be the Alahayam of all the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of Yasharaal (Israel), and they shall be my im (people / nation).

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, The im (people / nation) who were sharayad (left) of the charab (sword) matzaa (found) favor in the madabar (wilderness); even Yasharaal (Israel), when I halak (move) to cause him to ragai (rest).
Yahawah raah (see) of rachawaq (old) to me, saying, Yes, I have ahab (love) you with an iwalam (forever) ahabah (love): therefore with ahabah (loving) chasad (grace) have I mashak (drawn) you.

Again will I banah (build) you, and you shall be banah (built), O bathawalah (virgin) of Yasharaal (Israel): again you shall be idah (adorned) with your tambourines, and shall yatzaa (go out / come out) forth in the machawal (dances) of those who shachaq (make) merry.
Again you shall natai (plant) karam (vineyards) on the har (mountain) of Shamarawan (Samaria); the natai (planters) shall natai (plant), and shall enjoy its fruit.

For there yash (shall) be a yawam (day), that the watchmen on the har (mountain) of Aparayam (Ephraim) shall qaraa (called), qawam (rise up), and let us ilah (go up / offer) up to Tzayawan (Zion) to Yahawah our Alahayam.

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, ranan (sing) with shamachah (gladness) for Yaiqab (Jacob), and tzahal (shout) for the raash (head) of the gaway (nation / people): shamai (hearken / hear), halal (praise), and amar (spoke), Yahawah, yashai (salvation) your im (people / nation), the shaarayath (remnant) of Yasharaal (Israel).

Behold, I will bawaa (come) them from the tzapawan (north) aratz (Earth/land), and qabatz (gather) them from the uttermost yarakah (parts) of the aratz (Earth/land), along with the iwar (blind) and the pasach (lame), the harah (woman) with child and her who yalad (birth / begot) with child yachad (together): a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qahal (company) shall they shawab (turn back / repent) here.

They shall bawaa (come) with bakay (weeping); and with petitions will I yabal (lead) them: I will yalak (cause) them to walk by nachal (stream / river) of mayam (Waters), in a yashar (straight) darak (way) in which they shall not kashal (stumble / stagger); for I am a ab (father) to Yasharaal (Israel), and Aparayam (Ephraim) is my bakawar (firstborn).

Shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, you gaway (nation / people), and nagad (declare) it in the ay (islands) afar off; and amar (spoke), He who zarah (scattered) Yasharaal (Israel) will qabatz (gather) him, and shamar (keep/guard) him, as raih (shepherd) does his idar (flock).
For Yahawah has gaal (ransomed) Yaiqab (Jacob), and padah (redeemed) him from the yad (hand) of him who was chazaq (stronger) than he.

They shall bawaa (come) and ranan (sing) in the marawam (height) of Tzayawan (Zion), and shall nahar (flow) to the goodness of Yahawah, to the grain, and to the new thayarawash (wine), and to the yatzahar (fresh oil), and to the ban (son) of the tzaan (flock) and of the baqar (morning): and their napash (living being/soul) shall be as a rawah (watered) gan (garden); and they shall not daab (sorrow) any more at all.

Then shall the bathawalah (virgin) shamach (rejoice) in the machawal (dance), and the bachawar (young) men and the zaqan (old) yachad (together); for I will hapak (turn) their abal (mourning) into shashawan (joy), and will nacham (turn away / repent) them, and shamach (make) them rejoice from their yagawan (sorrow).

I will rawah (satiate) the napash (living being/soul) of the kahan (priest) with dashan (fatness), and my im (people / nation) shall be shabai (satisfied) with my goodness, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: A qawal (sound / voice) is shamai (hearken / hear) in Ramah (Ramah), nahay (lamentation), and thamarawar (bitter) bakay (weeping), Rachal (Rachel) bakah (weeping) for her ban (son); she maan (refuses) to be nacham (turn away / repent) for her ban (son), because they are no more.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: manai (refrain) your qawal (sound / voice) from bakay (weeping), and your iyan (eye) from damaih (tears); for your pailah (work) yash (shall) be shakar (rewarded), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah; and they shall shawab (turn back / repent) again from the aratz (Earth/land) of the ayab (enemy).
There is thaqawah (hope) for your acharayath (latter) end, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah; and your ban (son) shall shawab (turn back / repent) again to their own gabawal (border/boundary).

I have shamai (hearken / hear) shamai (hearken / hear) Aparayam (Ephraim) nawad (bemoaning) himself thus, You have yasar (chastised) me, and I was yasar (chastised), as an untrained igal (calf): shawab (turn back / repent) me, and I shall be shawab (turn back / repent); for you are Yahawah my Alahayam.

Surely achar (other) that I was shawab (turn back / repent), I nacham (turn away / repent); and achar (other) that I was yadai (instructed), I sapaq (struck) on my yarak (thigh): I was bawash (ashamed), yes, even kalam (confounded), because I nashaa (lift) the charapah (reproach) of my naiwar (youth).

Is Aparayam (Ephraim) my yaqayar (dear) ban (son)? Is he a darling yalad (birth / begot)? For as often as I dabar (word / matter) against him, I do zakar (remembrance/memory) zakar (remembrance/memory) him still: therefore my maih (heart) yearns for him; I will racham (surely) have racham (mercy) on him, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

Natzab (set) up road tzayawan (visible marker/identifier/landmark), shawam (place / establish / appoint) guideposts; shayath (put / appoint / make) your lab (heart) toward the masalah (highway), even the darak (way) by which you halak (move): shawab (turn back / repent) again, bathawalah (virgin) of Yasharaal (Israel), shawab (turn back / repent) again to these your iyar (cities).

How long will you chamaq (go) here and there, you shawabab (backsliding) bath (daughter)? For Yahawah has baraa (created) a chadash (new) thing in the aratz (Earth/land): a naqabah (woman) shall encompass a gabar (man).

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), Yet again shall they use this dabar (word / matter) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah) and in its iyar (cities), when I shall shawab (turn back / repent) again their shabawath (captivity): Yahawah barak (bless) you, nawah (habitation) of tzadaq (righteous / just / fair), har (mountain) of qadash (set apart/make holy).
Yahawadah (Judah) and all its iyar (cities) shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein yachad (together), the farmers, and those who nasai (go) about with idar (flocks).
For I have rawah (satiated) the iyap (weary) napash (living being/soul), and every daab (sorrowful) napash (living being/soul) malaa (have) I replenished.
On this I awakened, and raah (see); and my shanah (sleep) was irab (evening) to me.

Behold, the yawam (day) bawaa (come), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, that I will zarai (sow) the bayath (house) of Yasharaal (Israel) and the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah) with the zarai (seed) of adam (man), and with the zarai (seed) of animal.
