It shall happen that, like as I have shaqad (watched) over them to nathash (pluck) up and to nathatz (break) down and to haras (overthrow) and to abad (destroy/perish) and to raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil), so will I shaqad (watch) over them to banah (build) and to natai (plant), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.
In those yawam (day) they shall amar (spoke) no more, The ab (father) have akal (eat) basar (sour) grapes, and the ban (son) shan (teeth) are qahah (set) on edge.
But everyone shall mawath (death) for his own iwan (guilt/iniquity): every adam (man) who akal (eat) the basar (sour) grapes, his shan (teeth) shall be qahah (set) on edge.

Behold, the yawam (day) bawaa (come), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, that I will karath (cut) a chadash (new) barayath (covenant) with the bayath (house) of Yasharaal (Israel), and with the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah):

Not according to the barayath (covenant) that I karath (cut) with their ab (father) in the yawam (day) that I chazaq (took) them by the yad (hand) to yatzaa (go out / come out) them out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt); which my barayath (covenant) they parar (broke), although I was a bail (husband) to them, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

But this is the barayath (covenant) that I will karath (cut) with the bayath (house) of Yasharaal (Israel) achar (other) those yawam (day), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah: I will nathan (give) my thawarah (instruction) in their qarab (among / near) parts, and in their lab (heart) will I kathab (write) it; and I will be their Alahayam, and they shall be my im (people / nation):

And they shall lamad (teach/instruct) no more every ayash (husband/individual man) his neighbor, and every ayash (husband/individual man) his ach (brother/kinsman), amar (spoke), yadai (know) Yahawah; for they shall all yadai (know) me, from their qatan (small/young/least) to their greatest, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah: for I will salach (forgive/pardon/make clean) their iwan (guilt/iniquity), and their chataah (sin) will I zakar (remembrance/memory) no more.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, who nathan (give) the shamash (sun) for a awar (light) by yawamam (by day), and the chaqah (ordinances) of the yarach (moon) and of the kawakab (star) for a awar (light) by layal (night), who stirs up the yam (sea/waters), so that its gal (waves) hamah (they); Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) is his sham (name):

If these chaq (statute) depart from panayam (before) me, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, then the zarai (seed) of Yasharaal (Israel) also shall shabath (shabath/rest) from being a gaway (nation / people) panayam (before) me yawam (day).

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: If shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) mail (top/above) can be madad (measured), and the mawasadah (foundations) of the aratz (Earth/land) chaqar (searched) out matah (beneath), then will I also maas (cast) off all the zarai (seed) of Yasharaal (Israel) for all that they ishah (make) done, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

Behold, the yawam (day) come, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, that the iyar (city) shall be banah (built) to Yahawah from the magadal (tower) Chananaal (of) Hananel to the shair (gate) of the panah (corner).
The madah (measuring) qawah (gather/wait) shall yatzaa (go out / come out) out further straight onward to the gabaih (hill) Garab (Gareb), and shall sabab (turn) about Gaih (to) Goah.

The whole imaq (valley) of the pagar (dead) bodies and of the ashes, and all the sharamah (fields) to the nachal (stream / river) Qadarawan (Kidron), to the panah (corner) of the sawas (horse) shair (gate) toward the mazarach (east), shall be qadash (set apart/make holy) to Yahawah; it shall not be nathash (plucked) up, nor haras (thrown) down any more iwalam (forever).

The dabar (word / matter) that came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Yahawah in the ishayaray (tenth) shanah (year) of Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), which was the eighteenth shanah (year) of Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar).

Now at that time the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon's) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) was tzawar (besieging) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) was kalaa (shut) up in the chatzar (court) of the guard, which was in the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah's) bayath (house).

For Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) had kalaa (shut) him up, amar (spoke), Why do you nabaa (prophesy), and amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Behold, I will nathan (give) this iyar (city) into the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and he shall lakad (take) it;

And Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) shall not malat (escape) out of the yad (hand) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans), but shall nathan (give) be nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and shall dabar (word / matter) with him pah (mouth) to pah (mouth), and his iyan (eye) shall raah (see) his iyan (eye);

And he shall yalak (bring) Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) to Babal (Babylon), and he shall be there until I paqad (visit) him, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah: though you lacham (fight) with the Kashaday (Chaldeans), you shall not tzalach (prosper)?
Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke), The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to me, amar (spoke),

Behold, Chanamaal (Hanamel) the ban (son) of Shalawam (Shallum) your dawad (uncle) shall bawaa (come) to you, amar (spoke), qanah (buy) my shadah (field) that is in Inathawath (Anathoth); for the mashapat (right) of gaalah (redemption) is yours to qanah (buy) it.

So Chanamaal (Hanamel) my dawad (uncle's) ban (son) bawaa (come) to me in the chatzar (court) of the guard according to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, and amar (spoke) to me, Please qanah (buy) my shadah (field) that is in Inathawath (Anathoth), which is in the aratz (Earth/land) of Banayamayan (Benjamin); for the mashapat (right) of yarashah (inheritance) is yours, and the gaalah (redemption) is yours; qanah (buy) it for yourself. Then I yadai (knew) that this was the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah.

I bought the shadah (field) that was in Inathawath (Anathoth) of Chanamaal (Hanamel) my dawad (uncle's) ban (son), and shaqal (weighed) him the kasap (money), even seventeen shaqal (shekels) of kasap (silver).
I kathab (subscribed) the deed, and chatham (sealed) it, and iwad (admonish/bear witness against) witnesses, and shaqal (weighed) him the kasap (money) in the maazan (balances).
So I laqach (take / seized) the deed of the maqanah (purchase), both that which was chatham (sealed), containing the terms and conditions, and that which was galah (open);

And I nathan (give) the deed of the maqanah (purchase) to Barawak (Baruch) the ban (son) of Narayah (Neriah), the ban (son) Machasayah (of) Mahseiah, in the iyan (eye) of Chanamaal (Hanamel) my dawad (uncle's) son, and in the iyan (eye) of the witnesses who kathab (subscribed) the deed of the maqanah (purchase), iyan (eye) all the Yahawaday (Jews) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the chatzar (court) of the guard.
I tzawah (commanded) Barawak (Baruch) iyan (eye) them, amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): laqach (take / seized) these deeds, this deed of the maqanah (purchase) which is chatham (sealed), and this deed which is galah (open), and nathan (give) them in an charash (earthen) kalay (vessel); that they may imad (continue) many yawam (day).
For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): bayath (house) and shadah (fields) and karam (vineyards) shall yet again be bought in this aratz (Earth/land).
Now achar (other) I nathan (give) delivered the deed of the maqanah (purchase) to Barawak (Baruch) the ban (son) of Narayah (Neriah), I palal (prayed) to Yahawah, amar (spoke),

Ahah (ah) Adanay Yahawah! Behold, you ishah (make) made the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) and the aratz (Earth/land) by your gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kach (strength / mighty / power) and by your natah (outstretched) zarawai (arm); there is nothing palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) hard for you,

Who show loving chasad (grace) to alap (thousands), and shalam (recompense) the iwan (guilt/iniquity) of the ab (father) into the chayaq (bosom) of their ban (son) achar (other) them; the gadawal (very great/important/mighty), the gabawar (mighty) Al, Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) is his sham (name);

Gadawal (very great/important/mighty) in itzah (counsel), and rab (mighty) in ilayalayah (work); whose iyan (eye) are paqach (open) on all the darak (ways) of the ban (son) of adam (men), to nathan (give) everyone according to his darak (ways), and according to the paray (fruit) of his mailal (doings):

Who performed awath (sign / mark / miracle) and mawapath (wonders) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), even to this yawam (day), both in Yasharaal (Israel) and among other adam (men); and ishah (make) yourself a sham (name), as in this yawam (day);

And yatzaa (go out / come out) forth your im (people / nation) Yasharaal (Israel) out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) with awath (sign / mark / miracle), and with mawapath (wonders), and with a chazaq (strong) yad (hand), and with an outstretched azarawai (arm), and with gadawal (very great/important/mighty) mawaraa (terror);

And nathan (give) them this aratz (Earth/land), which you shabai (swear / take oath) to their ab (father) to nathan (give) them, a aratz (Earth/land) zawab (flow) with chalab (milk) and dabash (honey);

And they bawaa (come) in, and yarash (possessed) it, but they didn't shamai (hearken / hear) your qawal (sound / voice), neither halak (move) in your thawarah (instruction); they ishah (make) done nothing of all that you tzawah (commanded) them to ishah (make): therefore you have caused all this rai (evil) to qaraa (called) on them.

Behold, the mounds, they bawaa (come) come to the iyar (city) to lakad (take) it; and the iyar (city) is nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans) who lacham (fight) panayam (against) it, because of the charab (sword), and of the raib (famine), and of the dabar (word / matter); and what you have dabar (word / matter) raah (see) happened; and behold, you see it.

You have amar (spoke) to me, Adanay Yahawah, qanah (buy) the shadah (field) for kasap (money), and iwad (admonish/bear witness against) witnesses; whereas the iyar (city) is nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans).
Then came the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), amar (spoke),
Behold, I am Yahawah, the Alahayam of all bashar (flesh): is there anything palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) hard for me?

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Behold, I will nathan (give) this iyar (city) into the yad (hand) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans), and into the yad (hand) of Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and he shall lakad (take) it:

And the Kashaday (Chaldeans), who lacham (fight) against this iyar (city), shall bawaa (come) and yatzath (set) this iyar (city) on ash (fire), and sharap (burn) it, with the bayath (house), on whose gag (roofs) they have qatar (offered) incense to Bail (Baal), and nasak (poured) out drink nasak (offerings) to other Alahayam, to provoke me to kais (anger).

For the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) and the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah) ishah (make) done only that which was rai (evil) in my iyan (eye) from their naiwar (youth); for the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) have only provoked me to kais (anger) with the maishah (work) of their yad (hand), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

For this iyar (city) has been to me a provocation of my ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) and of my chamah (wrath) from the yawam (day) that they banah (built) it even to this yawam (day); that I should sawar (remove) it from before my panayam (face),

Because of all the rai (evil) of the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) and of the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah), which they ishah (make) done to provoke me to kais (anger), they, their malak (king), their shar (prince / ruler), their kahan (priest), and their nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), and the ayash (husband/individual man) of Yahawadah (Judah), and the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

They have panah (turned) to me the irap (neck), and not the panayam (face): and though I lamad (teach/instruct) them, shakam (rising) up early and lamad (teach/instruct) them, yet they have not shamai (hearken / hear) to laqach (take / seized) mawasar (instruction).
But they shawam (place / establish / appoint) their shaqawatz (abominations) in the bayath (house) which is qaraa (called) by my sham (name), to tamaa (defile) it.

They banah (built) the bamah (high) places of Bail (Baal), which are in the gayaa (valley) of the ban (son) of Hanam (Hinnom), to cause their ban (son) and their bath (daughter) to ibar (pass over/through) through fire to Malak (Molech); which I didn't tzawah (command) them, neither did it ilah (go up / offer) into my lab (heart), that they should ishah (make) this thawaibah (abomination), to cause Yahawadah (Judah) to chataa (sin).

Now therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), concerning this iyar (city), about which you amar (spoke), It is nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) by the charab (sword), and by the raib (famine), and by the dabar (word / matter):

Behold, I will qabatz (gather) them out of all the aratz (Earth/land), where I have nadach (driven) them in my ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), and in my chamah (wrath), and in gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qatzap (indignation); and I will shawab (turn back / repent) them again to this maqawam (place), and I will yashab (inhabit/dwell) them to dwell safely:
And they shall be my im (people / nation), and I will be their Alahayam:

And I will nathan (give) them achad (one) lab (heart) and achad (one) darak (way), that they may yaraa (fear / be afraid) me yawam (day), for their tawab (pleasant/functional), and of their ban (son) achar (other) them:

And I will karath (cut) an iwalam (forever) barayath (covenant) with them, that I will not shawab (turn back / repent) away from achar (other) them, to do them yatab (good); and I will nathan (give) my yaraah (fear) in their labab (hearts), that they may not sawar (depart) from me.

Yes, I will shawash (rejoice) over them to do them tawab (pleasant/functional), and I will natai (plant) them in this aratz (Earth/land) amath (truth) with my whole lab (heart) and with my whole napash (living being/soul).

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Like as I bawaa (come) brought all this gadawal (very great/important/mighty) rai (evil) on this im (people / nation), so will I bawaa (come) on them all the tawab (pleasant/functional) that I have dabar (word / matter) them.

Shadah (fields) shall be bought in this aratz (Earth/land), about which you amar (spoke), It is shamamah (desolate), without adam (man) or animal; it is nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans).

Men shall qanah (buy) shadah (fields) for kasap (money), and kathab (subscribe) the deeds, and chatham (seal) them, and iwad (admonish/bear witness against) witnesses, in the aratz (Earth/land) of Banayamayan (Benjamin), and in the sabayab (surrounding) about Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and in the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and in the iyar (cities) of the har (mountain) country, and in the iyar (cities) of the lowland, and in the iyar (cities) of the nagab (south): for I will cause their shabawath (captivity) to shawab (turn back / repent), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.
Moreover the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the shanay (second) time, while he was yet itzar (shut) up in the chatzar (court) of the guard, amar (spoke),
Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah who ishah (make) it, Yahawah who yatzar (forms) it to kawan (establish) it; Yahawah is his sham (name):
Qaraa (called) to me, and I will inah (answer / respond) you, and will show you gadawal (very great/important/mighty) things, and difficult, which you don't yadai (know).

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), concerning the bayath (house) of this iyar (city), and concerning the bayath (house) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), which are nathatz (broken) down to make a defense against the mounds and against the charab (sword);

While men bawaa (come) to lacham (fight) with the Kashaday (Chaldeans), and to malaa (fill) them with the pagar (dead) bodies of adam (men), whom I have nakah (killed) in my ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) and in my chamah (wrath), and for all whose rai (wickedness) I have sathar (hidden) my panayam (face) from this iyar (city):

Behold, I will ilah (go up / offer) it arawakah (health) and marapaa (cure), and I will rapaa (cure) them; and I will galah (reveal) to them itharath (abundance) of shalawam (peace / safety) and amath (truth).

I will cause the shabawath (captivity) of Yahawadah (Judah) and the shabawath (captivity) of Yasharaal (Israel) to shawab (turn back / repent), and will banah (build) them, as at the raashawan (first).

I will tahar (cleanse) them from all their iwan (guilt/iniquity), by which they have chataa (sinned) against me; and I will salach (forgive/pardon/make clean) all their iwan (guilt/iniquity), by which they have chataa (sinned) against me, and by which they have pashai (transgressed) against me.

This city shall be to me for a sham (name) of shashawan (joy), for a thahalah (praise) and for a glory, before all the gaway (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land), which shall shamai (hearken / hear) all the tawab (pleasant/functional) that I ishah (make) to them, and shall pachad (fear / dread) and ragaz (tremble) for all the tawab (pleasant/functional) and for all the shalawam (peace / safety) that I ishah (make) to it.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Yet again there shall be shamai (hearken / hear) in this maqawam (place), about which you amar (spoke), It is charab (waste), without adam (man) and without animal, even in the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and in the chawatz (streets) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), that are shamam (desolate), without adam (man) and without yashab (inhabit/dwell) and without animal,

The qawal (sound / voice) of shashawan (joy) and the qawal (sound / voice) of shamachah (gladness), the qawal (sound / voice) of the chathan (bridegroom) and the qawal (sound / voice) of the kalah (complete / finish), the qawal (sound / voice) of those who amar (spoke), Give yadah (thanks) to Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), for Yahawah is tawab (pleasant/functional), for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever); who bawaa (come) thanksgiving into the bayath (house) of Yahawah. For I will cause the shabawath (captivity) of the aratz (Earth/land) to shawab (turn back / repent) as at the raashawan (first), amar (spoke) Yahawah.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop): Yet again shall there be in this maqawam (place), which is charab (waste), without adam (man) and without animal, and in all its iyar (cities), a nawah (habitation) of raih (shepherds) causing their tzaan (flocks) to rabatz (lie) down.

In the iyar (cities) of the har (mountain) country, in the iyar (cities) of the lowland, and in the iyar (cities) of the nagab (south), and in the aratz (Earth/land) of Banayamayan (Benjamin), and in the sabayab (surrounding) about Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and in the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), shall the tzaan (flocks) again pass under the yad (hand) of him who manah (numbers) them, amar (spoke) Yahawah.

Behold, the yawam (day) bawaa (come), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, that I will qawam (rise up) that tawab (pleasant/functional) dabar (word / matter) which I have dabar (word / matter) concerning the bayath (house) of Yasharaal (Israel) and concerning the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah).

In those yawam (day), and at that ith (time), will I cause a tzamach (branch) of tzadaqah (righteousness) to tzamach (grow) up to Dawad (David); and he shall ishah (make) mashapat (justice) and tzadaqah (righteousness) in the aratz (Earth/land).

In those yawam (day) shall Yahawadah (Judah) be yashai (salvation), and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) shall shakan (dwell) safely; and this is the qaraa (called) by which she shall be called: Yahawah our righteousness.
For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Dawad (David) shall laa (NOT) karath (cut) a ayash (husband/individual man) to yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the kasaa (throne) of the bayath (house) of Yasharaal (Israel);

Neither shall the kahan (priest) the Lawayay (Levites) karath (cut) a ayash (husband/individual man) panayam (before) me to ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilah (offerings), and to qatar (burn) meal manachah (offerings), and to ishah (make) zabach (sacrifice) yawam (day).
The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: If you can parar (break) my barayath (covenant) of the yawam (day), and my barayath (covenant) of the layal (night), so that there shall not be yawamam (by day) and layal (night) in their ith (season);

Then may also my barayath (covenant) be parar (broken) with Dawad (David) my ibad (servant), that he shall not have a ban (son) to malak (king) on his kasaa (throne); and with the Lawayay (Levites) the kahan (priest), my sharath (ministers).

As the tzabaa (troop) of the sky can't be sapar (book), neither the chawal (sand) of the yam (sea/waters) madad (measured); so will I rabah (multiply) the zarai (seed) of Dawad (David) my ibad (servant), and the Lawayay (Levites) who sharath (minister) to me.
The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), amar (spoke),

Don't raah (see) what this im (people / nation) has dabar (word / matter), amar (spoke), The shanayam (two) mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) which Yahawah bachar (chose), he has maas (cast) them off? Thus do they naatz (despise) my im (people / nation), that they should be no more a gaway (nation / people) panayam (before) them.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: If my barayath (covenant) of yawamam (by day) and layal (night) fails, if I have not shawam (place / establish / appoint) the chaqah (ordinances) of shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) and aratz (Earth/land);

Then will I also maas (cast) away the zarai (seed) of Yaiqab (Jacob), and of Dawad (David) my ibad (servant), so that I will not laqach (take / seized) of his zarai (seed) to be mashal (rule/have dominion) over the zarai (seed) of Abaraham (Abraham), Yashachaq (Isaac), and Yaiqab (Jacob): for I will cause their shabawath (captivity) to shawab (turn back / repent), and will have racham (mercy) on them.

The dabar (word / matter) which came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Yahawah, when Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and all his chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), and all the mamalakah (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land) that were under his yad (hand), and all the im (people / nation), were lacham (fighting) against Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and against all the iyar (cities) of it, amar (spoke):

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), halak (move), and amar (spoke) to Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and amar (spoke) him, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Behold, I will nathan (give) this iyar (city) into the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and he shall sharap (burn) it with ash (fire):

And you shall not malat (escape) out of his yad (hand), but shall thapash (surely) be thapash (taken), and nathan (give) into his yad (hand); and your iyan (eye) shall raah (see) the iyan (eye) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and he shall dabar (word / matter) with you pah (mouth) to pah (mouth), and you shall bawaa (come) to Babal (Babylon).

Yet shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, O Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah): thus amar (spoke) Yahawah concerning you, You shall not mawath (death) by the charab (sword);

You shall mawath (death) in shalawam (peace / safety); and with the masharapah (burnings) of your ab (father), the raashawan (former) malak (king) who were panayam (before) you, so shall they sharap (make) a burning for you; and they shall sapad (lament) you, saying, haway (Alas/Woe!) Adawan! For I have dabar (word / matter) the dabar (word / matter), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.
Then Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) dabar (word / matter) all these dabar (word / matter) to Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem),

When the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon's) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) was lacham (fighting) against Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and against all the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah) that were yathar (left), against Lakayash (Lachish) and against Izaqah (Azekah); for these alone shaar (remained) of the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah) as fortified iyar (cities).

The dabar (word / matter) that came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Yahawah, achar (other) that the malak (king) Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) had karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) with all the im (people / nation) who were at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), to qaraa (called) darawar (liberty) to them;

That every ayash (husband/individual man) should let his male servant, and every ayash (husband/individual man) his female servant, who is a ibaray (hebrew) or a Hebrewess, shalach (send) chapashay (free); that none should ibad (servant) bondservants of them, of a Yahawaday (Jew) his ach (brother/kinsman).

All the shar (prince / ruler) and all the im (people / nation) obeyed, who bawaa (come) entered into the barayath (covenant), that everyone should let his male ayash (husband/individual man), and everyone his female servant, shalach (send) chapashay (free), that none should ibad (servant) bondservants of them any more; they shamai (hearken / hear), and shalach (send) them go:

But afterwards they shawab (turn back / repent), and caused the ibad (servant) and the handmaids, whom they had shalach (send) go chapashay (free), to shawab (turn back / repent), and kabash (brought) them into subjection for ibad (servant) and for handmaids.
Therefore the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Yahawah, amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): I karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) with your ab (father) in the yawam (day) that I yatzaa (go out / come out) them forth out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), out of the bayath (house) of ibad (servant), amar (spoke),

At the qatz (end) of shabai (seven) shanah (years) you shall shalach (send) go every ayash (husband/individual man) his ach (brother/kinsman) who is a ibaray (hebrew), who has been makar (sold) to you, and has ibad (servant) you shash (six) shanah (years), you shall shalach (send) him go chapashay (free) from you: but your ab (father) didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to me, neither natah (inclined) their azan (ear).

You had yawam (day) shawab (turn back / repent), and ishah (make) done that which is yashar (right) in my iyan (eye), in qaraa (called) darawar (liberty) every ayash (husband/individual man) to his neighbor; and you had karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) panayam (before) me in the bayath (house) which is qaraa (called) by my sham (name):

But you shawab (turn back / repent) and chalal (profaned) my sham (name), and caused every ayash (husband/individual man) his ibad (servant), and every ayash (husband/individual man) his handmaid, whom you had shalach (send) go chapashay (free) at their napash (living being/soul), to shawab (turn back / repent); and you kabash (brought) them into subjection, to be to you for ibad (servant) and for handmaids.

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: you have not shamai (hearken / hear) to me, to qaraa (called) darawar (liberty), every ayash (husband/individual man) to his ach (brother/kinsman), and every ayash (husband/individual man) to his neighbor: behold, I qaraa (called) to you a darawar (liberty), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, to the charab (sword), to the dabar (word / matter), and to the raib (famine); and I will nathan (give) you to be tossed back and forth among all the mamalakah (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land).

I will nathan (give) the ayash (husband/individual man) who ibar (pass over/through) transgressed my barayath (covenant), who have not qawam (rise up) the dabar (word / matter) of the barayath (covenant) which they karath (cut) panayam (before) me, when they karath (cut) the igal (calf) in shanayam (two) and ibar (pass over/through) between its bathar (parts);

The shar (prince / ruler) of Yahawadah (Judah), and the shar (prince / ruler) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), the sarayas (eunuchs), and the kahan (priest), and all the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land), who ibar (pass over/through) between the bathar (parts) of the igal (calf);

I will even nathan (give) them into the yad (hand) of their ayab (enemy), and into the yad (hand) of those who baqash (seek) their napash (living being/soul); and their nabalah (dead) bodies shall be for maakal (food) to the iwap (flying) of the sky, and to the animals of the aratz (Earth/land).

Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) and his shar (prince / ruler) will I nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of their ayab (enemy), and into the yad (hand) of those who baqash (seek) their napash (living being/soul), and into the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon's) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), who have ilah (go up / offer) away from you.

Behold, I will tzawah (command), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, and cause them to shawab (turn back / repent) to this iyar (city); and they shall lacham (fight) against it, and lakad (take) it, and sharap (burn) it with ash (fire): and I will nathan (give) the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah) a shamamah (desolation), without yashab (inhabit/dwell).

The dabar (word / matter) which came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Yahawah in the yawam (day) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), amar (spoke),

Halak (move) to the bayath (house) of the Rakah (Rechabites), and dabar (word / matter) to them, and bawaa (come) them into the bayath (house) of Yahawah, into achad (one) of the rooms, and give them yayan (wine) to shaqah (drink).

Then I laqach (take / seized) Yaazanayah (Jaazaniah) the ban (son) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah), the ban (son) Chabatzanayah (of) Habazziniah, and his ach (brother/kinsman), and all his ban (son), and the whole bayath (house) of the Rakah (Rechabites);

And I bawaa (come) them into the bayath (house) of Yahawah, into the room of the ban (son) Chanan (of) Hanan the ban (son) of Yagadalayahaw (Igdaliah), the ayash (husband/individual man) of Alahayam, which was by the room of the shar (prince / ruler), which was mail (top/above) the room of Maishayah (Maaseiah) the ban (son) of Shalawam (Shallum), the keeper of the sap (threshold).

I nathan (give) panayam (before) the ban (son) of the bayath (house) of the Rakah (Rechabites) bowls malaa (full) of yayan (wine), and kawas (cups); and I amar (spoke) to them, shathah (drinks) yayan (wine)!

But they amar (spoke), We will shathah (drinks) no yayan (wine); for Yawanadab (Jonadab) the ban (son) of Rakab (Rechab), our ab (father), tzawah (commanded) us, amar (spoke), You shall shathah (drinks) no yayan (wine), neither you, nor your ban (son), iwalam (forever):

Neither shall you banah (build) bayath (house), nor zarai (sow) zarai (seed), nor natai (plant) karam (vineyard), nor have any; but all your yawam (day) you shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) in ahal (tents); that you may chayah (live) many yawam (day) in the adamah (land) in which you live.

We have shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawanadab (Jonadab) the ban (son) of Rakab (Rechab), our ab (father), in all that he tzawah (commanded) us, to shathah (drinks) no yayan (wine) all our yawam (day), we, our wives, our ban (son), or our bath (daughter);
Nor to banah (build) bayath (house) for us to yashab (inhabit/dwell) in; neither have we karam (vineyard), nor shadah (field), nor zarai (seed):
But we have lived in ahal (tents), and have shamai (hearken / hear), and ishah (make) according to all that Yawanadab (Jonadab) our ab (father) tzawah (commanded) us.

But it happened, when Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) ilah (go up / offer) up into the aratz (Earth/land), that we amar (spoke), bawaa (come), and bawaa (come) us go to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) for panayam (fear) of the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans), and for panayam (fear) of the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of the Aram (Syrians); so we yashab (inhabit/dwell) at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
Then came the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): halak (move), and amar (spoke) the ayash (husband/individual man) of Yahawadah (Judah) and the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), Will you not laqach (take / seized) mawasar (instruction) to shamai (hearken / hear) to my dabar (word / matter)? Naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawanadab (Jonadab) the ban (son) of Rakab (Rechab), that he tzawah (commanded) his ban (son), not to shathah (drinks) yayan (wine), are qawam (rise up); and to this yawam (day) they shathah (drinks) none, for they shamai (hearken / hear) their ab (father) matzawah (commandment): but I have dabar (word / matter) to you, shakam (rising) up early and dabar (word / matter); and you have not shamai (hearken / hear) to me.

I have shalach (send) also to you all my ibad (servant) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), shakam (rising) up early and shalach (send) them, amar (spoke), shawab (turn back / repent) now every ayash (husband/individual man) from his rai (evil) darak (way), and yatab (amend) your mailal (doings), and don't yalak (go) achar (other) other Alahayam to ibad (servant) them, and you shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the adamah (land) which I nathan (give) given to you and to your ab (father): but you have not natah (inclined) your azan (ear), nor shamai (hearken / hear) to me.

Because the ban (son) of Yahawanadab (Jonadab) the ban (son) of Rakab (Rechab) have qawam (rise up) the matzawah (commandment) of their ab (father) which he tzawah (commanded) them, but this im (people / nation) has not shamai (hearken / hear) to me;

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): Behold, I will bawaa (come) on Yahawadah (Judah) and on all the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) all the rai (evil) that I have dabar (word / matter) against them; because I have dabar (word / matter) to them, but they have not shamai (hearken / hear); and I have qaraa (called) to them, but they have not inah (answer / respond).

Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke) to the bayath (house) of the Rakah (Rechabites), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): Because you have shamai (hearken / hear) the matzawah (commandment) of Yahawanadab (Jonadab) your ab (father), and shamar (keep/guard) all his matzawah (precepts), and ishah (make) according to all that he tzawah (commanded) you;

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): Yawanadab (Jonadab) the ban (son) of Rakab (Rechab) shall not karath (cut) a ayash (husband/individual man) to imad (stand) panayam (before) me yawam (day).

It happened in the rabayaiy (fourth) shanah (year) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), that this dabar (word / matter) came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Yahawah, amar (spoke),

Laqach (take / seized) a scroll of a sapar (book / scribed document), and kathab (write) therein all the dabar (word / matter) that I have dabar (word / matter) to you against Yasharaal (Israel), and against Yahawadah (Judah), and against all the gaway (nation / people), from the yawam (day) I dabar (word / matter) to you, from the yawam (day) of Yaashayah (Josiah), even to this yawam (day).

It may be that the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah) will shamai (hearken / hear) all the rai (evil) which I chashab (purpose) to ishah (make) to them; that they may shawab (turn back / repent) every ayash (husband/individual man) from his rai (evil) darak (way); that I may salach (forgive/pardon/make clean) their iwan (guilt/iniquity) and their chataah (sin).

Then Yaramayah (Jeremiah) qaraa (called) Barawak (Baruch) the ban (son) of Narayah (Neriah); and Barawak (Baruch) kathab (wrote) from the pah (mouth) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah) all the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, which he had dabar (word / matter) to him, on a scroll of a sapar (book / scribed document).
Yaramayah (Jeremiah) tzawah (commanded) Barawak (Baruch), amar (spoke), I am itzar (shut) up; I can't bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah:

Therefore you bawaa (come), and qaraa (called) in the scroll, which you have kathab (written) from my pah (mouth), the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah in the azan (ears) of the im (people / nation) in yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) bayath (house) on the tzawam (fast) yawam (day); and also you shall qaraa (called) them in the azan (ears) of all Yahawadah (Judah) who bawaa (come) out of their iyar (cities).

It may be they will napal (fall / be cast down) their thachanah (supplication) panayam (before) Yahawah, and will shawab (turn back / repent) everyone from his rai (evil) darak (way); for gadawal (very great/important/mighty) is the ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) and the chamah (wrath) that Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) against this im (people / nation).

Barawak (Baruch) the ban (son) of Narayah (Neriah) ishah (make) according to all that Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) tzawah (commanded) him, qaraa (called) in the sapar (book / scribed document) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah in yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) bayath (house).

Now it happened in the chamayashay (fifth) shanah (year) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), in the thashayaiy (ninth) chadash (month), that all the im (people / nation) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and all the im (people / nation) who bawaa (come) from the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), qaraa (called) a tzawam (fast) panayam (before) Yahawah.

Then qaraa (called) Barawak (Baruch) in the sapar (book / scribed document) the dabar (word / matter) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, in the room of Gamarayah (Gemariah) the ban (son) Shapan (of) Shaphan, the sapar (book), in the ilayawan (upper) chatzar (court), at the entry of the chadash (new) shair (gate) of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) bayath (house), in the azan (ears) of all the im (people / nation).

When Mayakayahaw (Micaiah) the ban (son) of Gamarayah (Gemariah), the ban (son) Shapan (of) Shaphan, had shamai (hearken / hear) out of the sapar (book / scribed document) all the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah,

He yarad (went) down into the malak (king) bayath (house), into the sapar (book) room: and behold, all the shar (prince / ruler) were sitting there, Alayashamai (Elishama) the sapar (book), and Dalayah (Delaiah) the ban (son) of Shamaiyah (Shemaiah), and Alanathan (Elnathan) the ban (son) of Ikabawar (Achbor), and Gamarayah (Gemariah) the ban (son) Shapan (of) Shaphan, and Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the ban (son) of Chananayah (Hananiah), and all the shar (prince / ruler).

Then Mayakayahaw (Micaiah) nagad (declared) to them all the dabar (word / matter) that he had shamai (hearken / hear), when Barawak (Baruch) qaraa (called) the sapar (book / scribed document) in the azan (ears) of the im (people / nation).

Therefore all the shar (prince / ruler) shalach (send) Yahawaday (Jehudi) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah), the ban (son) of Shalamayah (Shelemiah), the ban (son) of Kawashay (Cushi), to Barawak (Baruch), amar (spoke), laqach (take / seized) in your yad (hand) the scroll in which you have qaraa (called) in the azan (ears) of the im (people / nation), and yalak (come). So Barawak (Baruch) the ban (son) of Narayah (Neriah) laqach (take / seized) the scroll in his yad (hand), and bawaa (come) to them.
They amar (spoke) to him, yashab (inhabit/dwell) down now, and qaraa (called) it in our azan (ears). So Barawak (Baruch) qaraa (called) it in their azan (ears).

Now it happened, when they had shamai (hearken / hear) all the dabar (word / matter), they turned in pachad (fear / dread) ayash (husband/individual man) al (toward) rai (neigbor/another person), and amar (spoke) to Barawak (Baruch), We will nagad (surely) nagad (tell) the malak (king) of all these dabar (word / matter).
They shaal (asked) Barawak (Baruch), amar (spoke), nagad (tell) us now, How did you kathab (write) all these dabar (word / matter) at his pah (mouth)?

Then Barawak (Baruch) amar (spoke) them, He qaraa (called) all these dabar (word / matter) to me with his pah (mouth), and I kathab (wrote) them with dayaw (ink) in the sapar (book / scribed document).

Then the shar (prince / ruler) amar (spoke) to Barawak (Baruch), yalak (go), sathar (hide), you and Yaramayah (Jeremiah); and let no ayash (husband/individual man) yadai (know) ayapah (where) you are.

They bawaa (come) in to the malak (king) into the chatzar (court); but they paqad (visit) laid up the scroll in the room of Alayashamai (Elishama) the sapar (book); and they nagad (told) all the dabar (word / matter) in the azan (ears) of the malak (king).

So the malak (king) shalach (send) Yahawaday (Jehudi) to laqach (take / seized) the scroll; and he laqach (take / seized) it out of the room of Alayashamai (Elishama) the sapar (book). Yahawaday (Jehudi) qaraa (called) it in the azan (ears) of the malak (king), and in the azan (ears) of all the shar (prince / ruler) who imad (stood) il (over) the malak (king).
Now the malak (king) was sitting in the winter bayath (house) in the thashayaiy (ninth) chadash (month): and there was a ach (brother/kinsman) in the brazier bair (burning) panayam (before) him.

It happened, when Yahawaday (Jehudi) had qaraa (called) shalawash (three) or arabai (four) leaves, that the king qarai (cut) it with the thair (razor), and shalak (cast) it into the ash (fire) that was in the brazier, until all the scroll was thamam (consumed) in the ash (fire) that was in the brazier.
They were not pachad (fear / dread), nor qarai (tore) their bagad (garments), neither the malak (king), nor any of his ibad (servant) who shamai (hearken / hear) all these dabar (word / matter).

Moreover Alanathan (Elnathan) and Dalayah (Delaiah) and Gamarayah (Gemariah) had pagai (made) intercession to the malak (king) that he would not sharap (burn) the scroll; but he would not shamai (hearken / hear) them.

The malak (king) tzawah (commanded) Yarachamaal (Jerahmeel) the malak (king) ban (son), and Sharayah (Seraiah) the ban (son) of Izarayaal (Azriel), and Shalamayah (Shelemiah) the ban (son) of Ibadaal (Abdeel), to laqach (take / seized) Barawak (Baruch) the sapar (book) and Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy); but Yahawah sathar (hid) them.

Then the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), achar (other) that the malak (king) had sharap (burned) the scroll, and the dabar (word / matter) which Barawak (Baruch) kathab (wrote) at the pah (mouth) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah), amar (spoke),

Laqach (take / seized) again achar (other) scroll, and kathab (write) in it all the raashawan (former) dabar (word / matter) that were in the raashawan (first) scroll, which Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) has sharap (burned).

Concerning Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) you shall amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: You have sharap (burned) this scroll, amar (spoke), Why have you kathab (written) therein, amar (spoke), The malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) shall bawaa (come) bawaa (come) and shachath (destroy) this aratz (Earth/land), and shall shabath (shabath/rest) to cease from there adam (man) and animal?

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah concerning Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah): He shall have none to yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the kasaa (throne) of Dawad (David); and his nabalah (dead) body shall be shalak (cast) out in the yawam (day) to the charab (heat), and in the layal (night) to the qarach (frost).

I will paqad (visit) him and his zarai (seed) and his ibad (servant) for their iwan (guilt/iniquity); and I will bawaa (come) on them, and on the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and on the ayash (husband/individual man) of Yahawadah (Judah), all the rai (evil) that I have dabar (word / matter) against them, but they didn't shamai (hearken / hear).

Then laqach (take / seized) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) achar (other) scroll, and nathan (give) it to Barawak (Baruch) the sapar (book), the ban (son) of Narayah (Neriah), who kathab (wrote) therein from the pah (mouth) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah) all the dabar (word / matter) of the sapar (book / scribed document) which Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) had sharap (burned) in the ash (fire); and there were yasap (added) besides to them many like dabar (word / matter).

Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah) malak (king) as malak (king), instead of Kanayahaw (Coniah) the ban (son) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim), whom Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) made malak (king) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah).

But neither he, nor his ibad (servant), nor the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land), shamai (hearken / hear) to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, which he dabar (word / matter) by the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) Yaramayah (Jeremiah).

Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the malak (king) shalach (send) Yahawakal (Jehucal) the ban (son) of Shalamayah (Shelemiah), and Tzapanayah (Zephaniah) the ban (son) of Maishayah (Maaseiah), the kahan (priest), to the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) Yaramayah (Jeremiah), amar (spoke), palal (pray) now to Yahawah our Alahayam for us.
Now Yaramayah (Jeremiah) bawaa (come) in and yatzaa (go out / come out) out thawak (midst) the im (people / nation); for they nathan (give) not put him into bayath (house).

Paraih (Pharaoh's) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) yatzaa (go out / come out) come forth out of Matzarayam (Egypt); and when the Kashaday (Chaldeans) who were tzawar (besieging) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) shamai (hearken / hear) news of them, they broke up from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
Then came the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah to the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) Yaramayah (Jeremiah), amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), You shall amar (spoke) the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), who shalach (send) you to me to darash (inquire) of me: Behold, Paraih (Pharaoh's) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), which yatzaa (go out / come out) come forth to izarah (help) you, shall shawab (turn back / repent) to Matzarayam (Egypt) into their own aratz (Earth/land).
The Kashaday (Chaldeans) shall shawab (turn back / repent) again, and lacham (fight) against this iyar (city); and they shall lakad (take) it, and sharap (burn) it with ash (fire).
Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Don't nashaa (lift) yourselves, amar (spoke), The Kashaday (Chaldeans) shall halak (move) depart from us; for they shall not depart.

For though you had nakah (struck) the whole chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans) who lacham (fight) against you, and there shaar (remained) but wounded chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) among them, yes would they qawam (rise up) up every ayash (husband/individual man) in his ahal (tent), and sharap (burn) this iyar (city) with ash (fire).

It happened that, when the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans) was ilah (go up / offer) up from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) for panayam (fear) of Paraih (Pharaoh's) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor),

Then Yaramayah (Jeremiah) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to yalak (go) into the aratz (Earth/land) of Banayamayan (Benjamin), to receive his portion there, in the thawak (midst) of the im (people / nation).

When he was in the shair (gate) of Banayamayan (Benjamin), a bail (captain) of the guard was there, whose sham (name) was Yaraayayah (Irijah), the ban (son) of Shalamayah (Shelemiah), the ban (son) of Chananayah (Hananiah); and he thapash (laid) hold on Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), amar (spoke), You are napal (fall / be cast down) away to the Kashaday (Chaldeans).

Then Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke), It is shaqar (false); I am not napal (fall / be cast down) away to the Kashaday (Chaldeans). But he didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to him; so Yaraayayah (Irijah) thapash (laid) hold on Yaramayah (Jeremiah), and brought him to the shar (prince / ruler).

The shar (prince / ruler) were qatzap (angry) with Yaramayah (Jeremiah), and nakah (struck) him, and nathan (give) him in asawar (prison) in the bayath (house) of Yahawanathan (Jonathan) the sapar (book); for they ishah (make) made that the kalaa (prison).
When Yaramayah (Jeremiah) bawaa (come) come into the bayath (house) chanawath (house), and into the cells, and Yaramayah (Jeremiah) had yashab (inhabit/dwell) there many yawam (day);

Then Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the malak (king) shalach (send), and laqach (take / seized) him: and the malak (king) shaal (asked) him secretly in his bayath (house), and amar (spoke), Is there any dabar (word / matter) from Yahawah? Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke), There is. He amar (spoke) also, You shall be nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon).

Moreover Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke) to malak (king) Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah), Wherein have I chataa (sinned) against you, or against your ibad (servant), or against this im (people / nation), that you nathan (give) put me in bayath (house)?

Ay (where) now are your nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) who nabaa (prophesied) to you, amar (spoke), The malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) shall not bawaa (come) against you, nor against this aratz (Earth/land)?

Now please shamai (hearken / hear), my Adawan the malak (king): please let my thachanah (supplication) be napal (fall / be cast down) panayam (before) you, that you not cause me to shawab (turn back / repent) to the bayath (house) of Yahawanathan (Jonathan) the sapar (book), lest I mawath (death) there.

Then Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the malak (king) tzawah (commanded), and they paqad (visit) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) into the chatzar (court) of the guard; and they nathan (give) him yawam (day) a kakar (loaf) of lacham (bread) out of the bakers' chawatz (street), until all the lacham (bread) in the iyar (city) was thamam (spent). Thus Yaramayah (Jeremiah) yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the chatzar (court) of the guard.

Shapatayah (Shephatiah) the ban (son) of Mathan (Mattan), and Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) Pashachawar (of) Pashhur, and Yawakal (Jucal) the ban (son) of Shalamayah (Shelemiah), and Pashachawar (Pashhur) the ban (son) of Malakayah (Malchijah), shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) that Yaramayah (Jeremiah) dabar (word / matter) to all the im (people / nation), amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, He who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in this iyar (city) shall mawath (death) by the charab (sword), by the raib (famine), and by the dabar (word / matter); but he who yatzaa (go out / come out) forth to the Kashaday (Chaldeans) shall chayah (live), and his napash (living being/soul) shall be to him for a shalal (prey), and he shall chayah (live).

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, This iyar (city) shall nathan (give) be nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and he shall lakad (take) it.

Then the shar (prince / ruler) amar (spoke) to the malak (king), Please let this ayash (husband/individual man) be put to mawath (death); because he rapah (weakens) the yad (hand) of the mawath (death) of malachamah (war) who shaar (remain) in this iyar (city), and the yad (hand) of all the im (people / nation), in dabar (word / matter) such dabar (word / matter) to them: for this ayash (husband/individual man) doesn't darash (seek) the shalawam (peace / safety) of this im (people / nation), but the rai (hurt).
Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the malak (king) amar (spoke), Behold, he is in your yad (hand); for the malak (king) is not he who yakal (can) dabar (word / matter) anything against you.

Then laqach (take / seized) they Yaramayah (Jeremiah), and shalak (cast) him into the bawar (dungeon) of Malakayah (Malchijah) the king's ban (son), that was in the chatzar (court) of the guard: and they shalach (send) down Yaramayah (Jeremiah) with chabal (cords). In the bawar (dungeon) there was no mayam (Waters), but tayat (mire); and Yaramayah (Jeremiah) tabai (sank) in the tayat (mire).

Now when Ibadamalak (Ebedmelech) the Kawashay (Ethiopian), a sarayas (eunuch), who was in the malak (king) bayath (house), shamai (hearken / hear) that they nathan (give) put Yaramayah (Jeremiah) in the bawar (dungeon) (the malak (king) then sitting in the shair (gate) of Banayamayan (Benjamin)),
Ibadamalak (Ebedmelech) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of the malak (king) bayath (house), and dabar (word / matter) to the malak (king), amar (spoke),

My Adawan the malak (king), these raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil) have done raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil) in all that they ishah (make) done to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), whom they have shalak (cast) into the bawar (dungeon); and he is likely to mawath (death) in the thachath (under) where he is, panayam (because) of the raib (famine); for there is no more lacham (bread) in the iyar (city).

Then the malak (king) tzawah (commanded) Ibadamalak (Ebedmelech) the Kawashay (Ethiopian), amar (spoke), laqach (take / seized) from here shalawashayam (thirty) zah (this/that/these) with you, and ilah (go up / offer) up Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) out of the bawar (dungeon), before he mawath (death).

So Ibadamalak (Ebedmelech) laqach (take / seized) the ayash (husband/individual man) with him, and bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of the malak (king) under the awatzar (treasury), and laqach (take / seized) there rags and worn-out garments, and shalach (send) them down by chabal (cords) into the bawar (dungeon) to Yaramayah (Jeremiah).

Ibadamalak (Ebedmelech) the Kawashay (Ethiopian) amar (spoke) to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), shawam (place / establish / appoint) now these rags and worn-out garments under your armpits under the chabal (cords). Yaramayah (Jeremiah) ishah (make) so.

So they mashak (drew) up Yaramayah (Jeremiah) with the chabal (cords), and ilah (go up / offer) him up out of the bawar (dungeon): and Yaramayah (Jeremiah) yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the chatzar (court) of the guard.

Then Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the malak (king) shalach (send), and laqach (take / seized) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) to him into the shalayashay (third) mabawaa (entry) that is in the bayath (house) of Yahawah: and the malak (king) amar (spoke) to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), I will shaal (ask) you something. Kachad (hide) nothing from me.

Then Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke) to Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah), If I nagad (declare) it to you, will you not mawath (death) put me to mawath (death)? And if I give you yaitz (counsel), you will not shamai (hearken / hear) to me.

So Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the malak (king) shabai (swear / take oath) secretly to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), amar (spoke), As Yahawah chay (life), who ishah (make) us this napash (living being/soul), I will not put you to mawath (death), neither will I nathan (give) you into the yad (hand) of these ishah (make) who baqash (seek) your napash (living being/soul).

Then Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke) to Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): If you will yatzaa (go out / come out) forth to the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon's) shar (prince / ruler), then your napash (living being/soul) shall chayah (live), and this iyar (city) shall not be sharap (burned) with ash (fire); and you shall chayah (live), and your bayath (house).

But if you will not yatzaa (go out / come out) forth to the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon's) shar (prince / ruler), then shall this iyar (city) be nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans), and they shall sharap (burn) it with ash (fire), and you shall not malat (escape) out of their yad (hand).

Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the malak (king) amar (spoke) to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), I am daag (afraid) of the Yahawaday (Jews) who are napal (fall / be cast down) away to the Kashaday (Chaldeans), lest they nathan (give) me into their yad (hand), and they ilal (mock) me.

But Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke), They shall not nathan (give) you. Shamai (hearken / hear), I beg you, the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah, in that which I dabar (word / matter) to you: so it shall be yatab (well) with you, and your napash (living being/soul) shall chayah (live).
But if you maan (refuse) to yatzaa (go out / come out) forth, this is the dabar (word / matter) that Yahawah raah (see) shown me:

Behold, all the ashah (wife/individual woman) who are shaar (left) in the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah's) bayath (house) shall be yatzaa (go out / come out) forth to the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon's) shar (prince / ruler), and those women shall amar (spoke), Your familiar friends have sawath (set) you on, and yakal (have) prevailed over you. Your ragal (feet / foot) are tabai (sunk) in the batz (mire), they have sawag (turned) away achawar (back).

They shall yatzaa (go out / come out) out all your wives and your ban (son) to the Kashaday (Chaldeans); and you shall not malat (escape) out of their yad (hand), but shall be thapash (taken) by the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon): and you shall cause this iyar (city) to be sharap (burned) with ash (fire).
Then Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) amar (spoke) to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), Let no ayash (husband/individual man) yadai (know) of these dabar (word / matter), and you shall not mawath (death).

But if the shar (prince / ruler) shamai (hearken / hear) that I have dabar (word / matter) with you, and they bawaa (come) to you, and amar (spoke) you, nagad (declare) to us now what you have dabar (word / matter) to the malak (king); don't kachad (hide) it from us, and we will not put you to mawath (death); also what the malak (king) dabar (word / matter) to you:

Then you shall amar (spoke) them, I napal (fall / be cast down) my thachanah (supplication) panayam (before) the malak (king), that he would not cause me to shawab (turn back / repent) to Yahawanathan (Jonathan's) bayath (house), to mawath (death) there.

Then bawaa (come) all the shar (prince / ruler) to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), and shaal (asked) him; and he nagad (told) them according to all these dabar (word / matter) that the malak (king) had tzawah (commanded). So they charash (left) off speaking with him; for the dabar (word / matter) was not shamai (hearken / hear).
So Yaramayah (Jeremiah) stayed in the chatzar (court) of the guard until the yawam (day) that Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) was lakad (taken).

It happened when Jerusalem was taken, (in the thashayaiy (ninth) shanah (year) of Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), in the ishayaray (tenth) chadash (month), bawaa (come) Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) and all his chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) against Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and tzawar (besieged) it;

In the ishathay (eleven) shanah (year) of Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah), in the rabayaiy (fourth) chadash (month), the thashai (nine) day of the chadash (month), a baqai (breach) was made in the iyar (city)),

That all the shar (prince / ruler) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) bawaa (come) in, and yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the thawak (midst) shair (gate), Naragalasharaatzar (Nergal) Sharezer, Samagaranabaw (Samgarnebo), Sharasakayam (Sarsechim), rabasarayas (rabsaris), Naragalasharaatzar (Nergal) Sharezer, rabamag (rabmag), with all the rest of the shar (prince / ruler) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon).

It happened that, when Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) and all the ayash (husband/individual man) of malachamah (war) raah (see) them, then they barach (fled), and yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of the iyar (city) by layal (night), by the darak (way) of the malak (king) gan (garden), through the shair (gate) between the two chawamah (walls); and he yatzaa (go out / come out) out toward the irabah (arabah).

But the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans) radap (pursued) achar (other) them, and overtook Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) in the irabah (plains) of Yarayachaw (Jericho): and when they had laqach (take / seized) him, they ilah (go up / offer) him up to Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) to Rabalah (Riblah) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Chamath (Hamath); and he dabar (word / matter) mashapat (judgment) on him.

Then the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) shachat (killed) the ban (son) of Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) in Rabalah (Riblah) before his iyan (eye): also the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) shachat (killed) all the char (nobles) of Yahawadah (Judah).
Moreover he iwar (put) out Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah's) iyan (eye), and asar (bound) him in nachashath (fetters), to bawaa (come) him to Babal (Babylon).

The Kashaday (Chaldeans) sharap (burned) the malak (king) bayath (house), and the bayath (house) of the im (people / nation), with ash (fire), and nathatz (broke) down the chawamah (walls) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Then Nabawazaraadan (Nebuzaradan) the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) galah (carried) away captive into Babal (Babylon) the yathar (residue) of the im (people / nation) who shaar (remained) in the iyar (city), the deserters also who napal (fall / be cast down) napal (fall / be cast down) to him, and the yathar (residue) of the im (people / nation) who shaar (remained).

But Nabawazaraadan (Nebuzaradan) the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) shaar (left) of the dal (poor) of the im (people / nation), who had maawamah (nothing), in the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah), and nathan (give) them karam (vineyards) and yagab (fields) at the same yawam (day).

Now Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) tzawah (commanded) Nabawazaraadan (Nebuzaradan) the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) concerning Yaramayah (Jeremiah), amar (spoke),
Laqach (take / seized) him, and iyan (eye) well to him, and ishah (make) him no harm; but ishah (make) to him even as he shall dabar (word / matter) you.

So Nabawazaraadan (Nebuzaradan) the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) shalach (send), and Nabawashazaban (Nebushazban), rabasarayas (rabsaris), and Naragalasharaatzar (Nergal) Sharezer, rabamag (rabmag), and all the chief rab (officers) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon);

They shalach (send), and laqach (take / seized) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) out of the chatzar (court) of the guard, and nathan (give) him to Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam), the ban (son) Shapan (of) Shaphan, that he should yatzaa (go out / come out) him bayath (house): so he lived thawak (midst) the im (people / nation).
Now the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), while he was itzar (shut) up in the chatzar (court) of the guard, amar (spoke),

Halak (move), and amar (spoke) to Ibadamalak (Ebedmelech) the Kawashay (Ethiopian), amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): Behold, I will bawaa (come) my dabar (word / matter) on this iyar (city) for rai (evil), and not for tawab (pleasant/functional); and they shall be accomplished panayam (before) you in that yawam (day).

But I will natzal (deliver) you in that yawam (day), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah; and you shall not be nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the ayash (husband/individual man) of whom you are yagawar (afraid).

For I will malat (surely) malat (save) you, and you shall not napal (fall / be cast down) by the charab (sword), but your napash (living being/soul) shall be for a shalal (prey) to you; because you have batach (put) your trust in me, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

The dabar (word / matter) which came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Yahawah, achar (other) that Nabawazaraadan (Nebuzaradan) the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) had shalach (send) him go from Ramah (Ramah), when he had laqach (take / seized) him being asar (bound) in azaqayam (chains) thawak (midst) all the galawath (captives) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) and Yahawadah (Judah), who were galah (carried) away captive to Babal (Babylon).
The rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) laqach (take / seized) Yaramayah (Jeremiah), and amar (spoke) to him, Yahawah your Alahayam dabar (word / matter) this rai (evil) on this maqawam (place);

And Yahawah bawaa (come) brought it, and ishah (make) according as he dabar (word / matter): because you have chataa (sinned) against Yahawah, and have not shamai (hearken / hear) his qawal (sound / voice), therefore this thing has come on you.

Now, behold, I release you this yawam (day) from the azaqayam (chains) which are on your yad (hand). If it seems tawab (pleasant/functional) to you to bawaa (come) with me into Babal (Babylon), bawaa (come), and I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) care of you; but if it seems bad to you to bawaa (come) with me into Babal (Babylon), don't: raah (see), all the aratz (Earth/land) is panayam (before) you; where it seems tawab (pleasant/functional) and yashar (right) to you to yalak (go), there yalak (go).

Now while he had not yet shawab (turn back / repent) back, shawab (turn back / repent) back then, he said, to Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam), the ban (son) Shapan (of) Shaphan, whom the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) paqad (visit) made governor over the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) with him thawak (midst) the im (people / nation); or yalak (go) wherever it seems yashar (right) to you to yalak (go). So the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) nathan (give) him food and a present, and shalach (send) him go.

Then bawaa (come) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) to Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam) Matzapah (to) Mizpah, and lived with him thawak (midst) the im (people / nation) who were shaar (left) in the aratz (Earth/land).

Now when all the shar (prince / ruler) of the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) who were in the shadah (fields), even they and their chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), shamai (hearken / hear) that the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) had made Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam) governor in the aratz (Earth/land), and paqad (visit) committed to him chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), and ashah (wife/individual woman), and tap (children), and of the poorest of the aratz (Earth/land), of those who were not galah (carried) away captive to Babal (Babylon);

Then they bawaa (come) to Gadalayah (Gedaliah) Matzapah (to) Mizpah, Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah), and Yawachanan (Johanan) and Yawanathan (Jonathan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah), and Sharayah (Seraiah) the ban (son) of Thanachamath (Tanhumeth), and the ban (son) of Iwapay (Ephai) the Natapathay (Netophathite), and Yazanayah (Jezaniah) the ban (son) of the Maikathay (Maacathite), they and their ban (son).

Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam) the ban (son) Shapan (of) Shaphan shabai (swear / take oath) to them and to their ban (son), amar (spoke), Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid) to ibad (servant) the Kashaday (Chaldeans): yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the aratz (Earth/land), and ibad (servant) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and it shall be yatab (well) with you.

As for me, behold, I will yashab (inhabit/dwell) Matzapah (at) Mizpah, to imad (stand) before the Kashaday (Chaldeans) who shall bawaa (come) to us: but you, asap (gather) yayan (wine) and qayatz (summer) fruits and shaman (oil), and shawam (place / establish / appoint) them in your kalay (vessels), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) in your iyar (cities) that you have thapash (taken).

Likewise when all the Yahawaday (Jews) who were in Mawaab (Moab), and among the children of Imawan (Ammon), and in Adam (Edom), and who were in all the aratz (Earth/land), shamai (hearken / hear) that the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) nathan (give) left a shaarayath (remnant) of Yahawadah (Judah), and that he paqad (visit) set over them Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam), the ban (son) Shapan (of) Shaphan;

Then all the Yahawaday (Jews) shawab (turn back / repent) out of all maqawam (place) where they were nadach (driven), and bawaa (come) to the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah), to Gadalayah (Gedaliah), Matzapah (to) Mizpah, and asap (gathered) yayan (wine) and qayatz (summer) fruits very much.

Moreover Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah), and all the shar (prince / ruler) of the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) who were in the shadah (fields), bawaa (come) to Gadalayah (Gedaliah) Matzapah (to) Mizpah,

And amar (spoke) to him, Do you yadai (know) that Bailayas (Baalis) the malak (king) of the ban (son) of Ammon has shalach (send) Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah) to take your life? But Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam) didn't aman (believe / have faith) them.

Then Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah) amar (spoke) to Gadalayah (Gedaliah) Matzapah (in) Mizpah secretly, amar (spoke), Please yalak (let) me go, and I will nakah (kill) Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah), and no ayash (husband/individual man) shall yadai (know) it: why should he take your life, that all the Jews who are qabatz (gathered) to you should be pawatz (scattered), and the shaarayath (remnant) of Yahawadah (Judah) abad (destroy/perish)?

But Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam) amar (spoke) to Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah), You shall not ishah (make) this thing; for you dabar (word / matter) falsely of Yashamaial (Ishmael).

Now it happened in the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month), that Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah), the ban (son) of Alayashamai (Elishama), of the zarai (seed) malawakah (royal) and one of the chief rab (officers) of the malak (king), and ishar (ten) ban (son) with him, bawaa (come) to Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam) Matzapah (to) Mizpah; and there they akal (eat) lacham (bread) yachad (together) in Mizpah.

Then qawam (rise up) Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah), and the ishar (ten) ban (son) who were with him, and nakah (struck) Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam) the ban (son) Shapan (of) Shaphan with the charab (sword), and mawath (death) him, whom the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) paqad (visit) made governor over the aratz (Earth/land).

Yashamaial (Ishmael) also nakah (killed) all the Yahawaday (Jews) who were with him, with Gadalayah (Gedaliah), Matzapah (at) Mizpah, and the Kashaday (Chaldeans) who were matzaa (found) there, the ayash (husband/individual man) of malachamah (war).
It happened the shanay (second) yawam (day) after he had mawath (death) Gadalayah (Gedaliah), and no ayash (husband/individual man) yadai (knew) it,

That there bawaa (come) ayash (husband/individual man) from Shakam (Shechem), from Shayalah (Shiloh), and from Shamarawan (Samaria), even shamanayam (eighty) ayash (husband/individual man), having their zaqan (beards) galach (shaved) and their clothes qarai (torn), and having gadad (cut) themselves, with meal manachah (offerings) and labawanah (frankincense) in their yad (hand), to bawaa (come) them to the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth Matzapah (from) Mizpah to qaraah (meet) them, bakah (weeping) all halak (move) as he halak (move): and it happened, as he pagash (met) them, he amar (spoke) to them, bawaa (come) to Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam).

It was so, when they bawaa (come) into the thawak (midst) of the iyar (city), that Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah) shachat (killed) them, and cast them into the thawak (midst) of the bawar (pit), he, and the ban (son) who were with him.

But ishar (ten) ayash (husband/individual man) were matzaa (found) among those who amar (spoke) to Yashamaial (Ishmael), Don't mawath (death) us; for we yash (have) stores hidden in the shadah (field), of chatah (wheat), and of shairah (barley), and of shaman (oil), and of dabash (honey). So he stopped, and didn't mawath (death) them thawak (midst) their ach (brother/kinsman).

Now the bawar (pit) in which Yashamaial (Ishmael) shalak (cast) all the pagar (dead) bodies of the ayash (husband/individual man) whom he had nakah (killed), by the yad (hand) of Gadalayah (Gedaliah) (the same was who which Asaa (Asa) the malak (king) ishah (make) made for panayam (fear) of Baishaa (Baasha) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel)), Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah) malaa (filled) it with those who were chalal (killed).

Then Yashamaial (Ishmael) shabah (carried) away captive all the shaarayath (residue) of the im (people / nation) who were Matzapah (in) Mizpah, even the malak (king) bath (daughter), and all the im (people / nation) who shaar (remained) Matzapah (in) Mizpah, whom Nabawazaraadan (Nebuzaradan) the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) paqad (visit) committed to Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam); Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah) shabah (carried) them away captive, and departed to ibar (pass over/through) over to the ban (son) of Ammon.

But when Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah), and all the shar (prince / ruler) of the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) who were with him, shamai (hearken / hear) of all the rai (evil) that Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah) ishah (make) done,

Then they laqach (take / seized) all the ayash (husband/individual man), and yalak (went) to lacham (fight) with Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah), and matzaa (found) him by the rab (great) mayam (Waters) that are in Gabaiwan (Gibeon).

Now it happened that, when all the im (people / nation) who were with Yashamaial (Ishmael) raah (see) Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah), and all the shar (prince / ruler) of the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) who were with him, then they were shamach (glad).

So all the im (people / nation) who Yashamaial (Ishmael) had shabah (carried) away captive Matzapah (from) Mizpah shawab (turn back / repent) sabab (about) and yalak (came) back, and went to Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah).
But Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah) malat (escaped) from Yawachanan (Johanan) with shamanah (eight) ban (son), and yalak (went) to the ban (son) of Ammon.

Then laqach (take / seized) Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah), and all the shar (prince / ruler) of the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) who were with him, all the shaarayath (remnant) of the im (people / nation) whom he had shawab (turn back / repent) from Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah), Matzapah (from) Mizpah, achar (other) that he had nakah (killed) Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam), the ban (son) of malachamah (war), and the ashah (wife/individual woman), and the tap (children), and the sarayas (eunuchs), whom he had shawab (turn back / repent) back from Gabaiwan (Gibeon):
And they departed, and lived in Geruth Kamaham (Chimham), which is by Bayathalacham (Bethlehem), to yalak (go) to bawaa (come) into Matzarayam (Egypt),

Panayam (because) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans); for they were yaraa (fear / be afraid) of them, because Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah) had nakah (killed) Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam), whom the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) paqad (visit) governor over the aratz (Earth/land).

Then all the shar (prince / ruler) of the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), and Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah), and Yazanayah (Jezaniah) the ban (son) of Hawashaiyah (Hoshaiah), and all the im (people / nation) from the qatan (small/young/least) even to the greatest, nagash (came) near,

And amar (spoke) to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), Please let our thachanah (supplication) be napal (fall / be cast down) panayam (before) you, and palal (pray) for us to Yahawah your Alahayam, even for all this shaarayath (remnant); for we are shaar (left) but a mait (few) of many, as your iyan (eye) do raah (see) us:
That Yahawah your Alahayam may show us the darak (way) in which we should yalak (walk), and the thing that we should ishah (make).

Then Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) amar (spoke) to them, I have shamai (hearken / hear) you; behold, I will palal (pray) to Yahawah your Alahayam according to your dabar (word / matter); and it shall happen that whatever thing Yahawah shall inah (answer / respond) you, I will nagad (declare) it to you; I will manai (keep) nothing back from you.

Then they amar (spoke) to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), Yahawah be a amath (truth) and aman (believe / have faith) id (witness) among us, if we don't ishah (make) according to all the dabar (word / matter) with which Yahawah your Alahayam shall shalach (send) you to us.

Whether it be tawab (pleasant/functional), or whether it be rai (evil), we will shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah our Alahayam, to whom we shalach (send) you; that it may be yatab (well) with us, when we shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah our Alahayam.
It happened qatz (after) ishar (ten) yawam (day), that the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah).
