Then qaraa (called) he Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah), and all the shar (prince / ruler) of the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) who were with him, and all the im (people / nation) from the qatan (small/young/least) even to the greatest,

And amar (spoke) to them, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), to whom you shalach (send) me to napal (fall / be cast down) your thachanah (supplication) panayam (before) him:

If you will still live in this aratz (Earth/land), then will I banah (build) you, and not haras (pull) you down, and I will natai (plant) you, and not nathash (pluck) you up; for I grieve over the rai (distress) that I ishah (make) brought on you.

Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), of whom you are yaraa (afraid); don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid) of him, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah: for I am with you to yashai (salvation) you, and to natzal (deliver) you from his yad (hand).
I will nathan (give) you racham (mercy), that he may have racham (mercy) on you, and cause you to shawab (turn back / repent) to your own adamah (land).
But if you amar (spoke), We will not yashab (inhabit/dwell) in this aratz (Earth/land); so that you don't shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah your Alahayam,

Amar (spoke), No; but we will bawaa (come) into the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), where we shall raah (see) no malachamah (war), nor shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of the shawapar (Shawapar(Shofar) - Ram's horn (instrument)), nor raib (have) hunger of lacham (bread); and there will we yashab (inhabit/dwell):

Now therefore shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, O shaarayath (remnant) of Yahawadah (Judah): Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), If you indeed shawam (place / establish / appoint) your panayam (faces) to bawaa (come) into Matzarayam (Egypt), and bawaa (come) to live there;

Then it shall happen, that the charab (sword), which you yaraa (fear / be afraid), shall nashag (overtake) you there in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt); and the raib (famine), about which you are daag (afraid), shall dabaq (follow) close achar (other) you there in Matzarayam (Egypt); and there you shall mawath (death).

So shall it be with all the ayash (husband/individual man) who shawam (place / establish / appoint) their panayam (faces) to bawaa (come) into Matzarayam (Egypt) to live there: they shall mawath (death) by the charab (sword), by the raib (famine), and by the dabar (word / matter); and none of them shall sharayad (remain) or palayat (escape) from the rai (evil) that I will bawaa (come) on them.

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): As my ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) and my chamah (wrath) has been nathak (poured) forth on the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), so shall my chamah (wrath) be nathak (poured) forth on you, when you shall bawaa (come) into Matzarayam (Egypt); and you shall be an object of horror, and an shamah (astonishment), and a qalalah (curse), and a charapah (reproach); and you shall raah (see) this maqawam (place) no more.

Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) concerning you, shaarayath (remnant) of Yahawadah (Judah), Don't you bawaa (come) into Matzarayam (Egypt): yadai (know) yadai (certainly) that I have iwad (admonish/bear witness against) to you this yawam (day).

For you have dealt deceitfully against your own napash (living being/soul); for you shalach (send) me to Yahawah your Alahayam, amar (spoke), palal (pray) for us to Yahawah our Alahayam; and according to all that Yahawah our Alahayam shall amar (spoke), so nagad (declare) to us, and we will ishah (make) it:

And I have this yawam (day) nagad (declared) it to you; but you have not shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah your Alahayam in anything for which he has shalach (send) me to you.

Now therefore yadai (know) yadai (certainly) that you shall mawath (death) by the charab (sword), by the raib (famine), and by the dabar (word / matter), in the maqawam (place) where you chapatz (desire) to bawaa (come) to live there.

It happened that, when Yaramayah (Jeremiah) kalah (complete / finish) made an end of dabar (word / matter) to all the im (people / nation) all the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah their Alahayam, with which Yahawah their Alahayam had shalach (send) him to them, even all these dabar (word / matter),

Then amar (spoke) Izarayah (Azariah) the ban (son) of Hawashaiyah (Hoshaiah), and Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah), and all the zad (proud) ban (son), amar (spoke) to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), You dabar (word / matter) falsely: Yahawah our Alahayam has not shalach (send) you to amar (spoke), You shall not bawaa (come) into Matzarayam (Egypt) to live there;

But Barawak (Baruch) the ban (son) of Narayah (Neriah) sawath (sets) you on against us, to nathan (give) us into the yad (hand) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans), that they may put us to mawath (death), and galah (carry) us away captive to Babal (Babylon).

So Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah), and all the shar (prince / ruler) of the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), and all the im (people / nation), didn't shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah, to yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah).

But Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah), and all the shar (prince / ruler) of the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), laqach (take / seized) all the shaarayath (remnant) of Yahawadah (Judah), who were shawab (turn back / repent) from all the gaway (nation / people) where they had been nadach (driven), to live in the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah);

The gabar (men), and the ashah (wife/individual woman), and the tap (children), and the malak (king) bath (daughter), and every napash (living being/soul) who Nabawazaraadan (Nebuzaradan) the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) had yanach (left) with Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam), the ban (son) Shapan (of) Shaphan; and Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), and Barawak (Baruch) the ban (son) of Narayah (Neriah);

And they bawaa (come) into the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt); for they didn't shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah: and they bawaa (come) to Thachapanachas (Tahpanhes).
Then came the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) in Thachapanachas (Tahpanhes), amar (spoke),

Laqach (take / seized) gadawal (very great/important/mighty) aban (stone) in your yad (hand), and taman (hide) them in mortar in the brick malaban (work), which is at the entry of Paraih (Pharaoh's) bayath (house) in Thachapanachas (Tahpanhes), in the iyan (eye) of the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) of Yahawaday (Judah);

And amar (spoke) them, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): Behold, I will shalach (send) and laqach (take / seized) Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), my ibad (servant), and will shawam (place / establish / appoint) his kasaa (throne) on these aban (stone) that I have taman (hidden); and he shall natah (spread) his shaparawar (royal) pavilion over them.

He shall bawaa (come), and shall nakah (strike) the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt); such as are for mawath (death) shall be put to mawath (death), and such as are for shabay (captivity) to shabay (captivity), and such as are for the charab (sword) to the charab (sword).

I will yatzath (kindle) a ash (fire) in the bayath (house) of the Alahayam of Matzarayam (Egypt); and he shall sharap (burn) them, and shabah (carry) them away captive: and he shall itah (array) himself with the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), as a raih (shepherd) itah (puts) on his bagad (garment); and he shall yatzaa (go out / come out) forth from there in shalawam (peace / safety).

He shall also shabar (break) the matzabah (pillars) of Bayathashamash (Beth) Shemesh, that is in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt); and the bayath (house) of the Alahayam of Matzarayam (Egypt) shall he sharap (burn) with ash (fire).

The dabar (word / matter) that came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) concerning all the Yahawaday (Jews) who lived in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), who lived at Magadawal (Migdol), and at Thachapanachas (Tahpanhes), and Nap (at) Memphis, and in the aratz (Earth/land) of Patharawas (Pathros), amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): You raah (see) seen all the rai (evil) that I bawaa (come) brought on Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and on all the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah); and behold, this yawam (day) they are a desolation, and no man yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein,

Panayam (because) of their rai (wickedness) which they ishah (make) committed to provoke me to kais (anger), in that they yalak (went) to qatar (burn) incense, to ibad (servant) other Alahayam, that they didn't yadai (know), neither they, nor you, nor your ab (father).

However I shalach (send) to you all my ibad (servant) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), shakam (rising) up early and shalach (send) them, amar (spoke), Oh, don't ishah (make) this thawaibah (abominable) thing that I shanaa (hate).
But they didn't shamai (hearken / hear), nor natah (inclined) their azan (ear) to shawab (turn back / repent) from their rai (wickedness), to qatar (burn) no incense to other Alahayam.

Therefore my chamah (wrath) and my ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) was nathak (poured) forth, and was bair (kindled) in the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah) and in the chawatz (streets) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and they are charabah (wasted) and shamamah (desolate), as it is this yawam (day).

Therefore now thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): Why ishah (make) you commit gadawal (very great/important/mighty) rai (evil) against your own napash (living being/soul), to karath (cut) off from yourselves ayash (husband/individual man) and ashah (wife/individual woman), iwalal (infant) and yanaq (nursing) child out of the midst of Yahawadah (Judah), to yathar (leave) yourselves none shaarayath (remaining);

In that you provoke me to kais (anger) with the maishah (works) of your yad (hand), qatar (burning) incense to other Alahayam in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), where you bawaa (come) gone to live; that you may be karath (cut) off, and that you may be a qalalah (curse) and a charapah (reproach) among all the gaway (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land)?

Have you shakach (forgotten) the rai (wickedness) of your ab (father), and the rai (wickedness) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and the rai (wickedness) of their wives, and your own rai (wickedness), and the rai (wickedness) of your wives which they ishah (make) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah), and in the chawatz (streets) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)?

They are not dakaa (humbled) even to this yawam (day), neither have they yaraa (fear / be afraid), nor halak (move) in my thawarah (instruction), nor in my chaqah (statutes), that I nathan (give) panayam (before) you and panayam (before) your ab (father).

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): Behold, I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) my panayam (face) against you for rai (evil), even to karath (cut) off all Yahawadah (Judah).

I will laqach (take / seized) the shaarayath (remnant) of Yahawadah (Judah), that have shawam (place / establish / appoint) their panayam (faces) to bawaa (come) into the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) to live there, and they shall thamam (all) be consumed; in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) shall they napal (fall / be cast down); they shall be thamam (consumed) by the charab (sword) and by the raib (famine); they shall mawath (death), from the qatan (small/young/least) even to the greatest, by the charab (sword) and by the raib (famine); and they shall be an object of horror, an shamah (astonishment), and a qalalah (curse), and a charapah (reproach).

For I will paqad (visit) those who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), as I paqad (visit) punished Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), by the charab (sword), by the raib (famine), and by the dabar (word / matter);

So that none of the shaarayath (remnant) of Yahawadah (Judah), who bawaa (come) gone into the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) to live there, shall palayat (escape) or be sharayad (left), to shawab (turn back / repent) into the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah), to which they have a napash (living being/soul) to shawab (turn back / repent) to yashab (inhabit/dwell) there: for none shall shawab (turn back / repent) save such as shall palayat (escape).

Then all the ayash (husband/individual man) who yadai (knew) that their wives qatar (burned) incense to other Alahayam, and all the ashah (wife/individual woman) who imad (stood) by, a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qahal (assembly), even all the im (people / nation) who lived in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), in Patharawas (Pathros), inah (answer / respond) Yaramayah (Jeremiah), amar (spoke),
As for the dabar (word / matter) that you have dabar (word / matter) to us in the sham (name) of Yahawah, we will not shamai (hearken / hear) to you.

But we will ishah (make) ishah (make) every dabar (word / matter) that is yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of our pah (mouth), to qatar (burn) incense to the malakath (queen) of the sky, and to nasak (pour) out drink nasak (offerings) to her, as we ishah (make) done, we and our ab (father), our malak (king) and our shar (prince / ruler), in the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and in the chawatz (streets) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); for then shabai (had) we plenty of lacham (food), and were tawab (pleasant/functional), and raah (see) no rai (evil).

But since we chadal (left) off qatar (burning) incense to the malakath (queen) of the sky, and nasak (pouring) out drink nasak (offerings) to her, we have chasar (wanted) thamam (all) things, and have been consumed by the charab (sword) and by the raib (famine).

When we qatar (burned) incense to the malakath (queen) of the sky, and nasak (poured) out drink nasak (offerings) to her, ishah (make) we make her kawan (cakes) to itzab (worship) her, and nasak (pour) out drink nasak (offerings) to her, balaiday (without) our ayash (husband/individual man)?

Then Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke) to all the im (people / nation), to the gabar (men), and to the ashah (wife/individual woman), even to all the im (people / nation) who had given him an dabar (word / matter), amar (spoke),

The qatar (incense) that you qatar (burned) in the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and in the chawatz (streets) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), you and your ab (father), your malak (king) and your shar (prince / ruler), and the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land), didn't Yahawah zakar (remembrance/memory) them, and didn't it ilah (go up / offer) into his lab (heart)?

So that Yahawah yakal (could) no longer nashaa (lift), panayam (because) of the rai (evil) of your mailal (doings), and panayam (because) of the thawaibah (abominations) which you ishah (make) committed; therefore your aratz (Earth/land) has become a desolation, and an shamah (astonishment), and a qalalah (curse), without yashab (inhabit/dwell), as it is this yawam (day).

Panayam (because) you have qatar (burned) incense, and because you have chataa (sinned) against Yahawah, and have not shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah, nor halak (move) in his thawarah (instruction), nor in his chaqah (statutes), nor in his idawath (testimonies); therefore this rai (evil) has qaraa (called) to you, as it is this yawam (day).

Moreover Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke) to all the im (people / nation), and to all the ashah (wife/individual woman), shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, all Yahawadah (Judah) who are in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt):

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), amar (spoke), You and your wives have both dabar (word / matter) with your pah (mouths), and with your yad (hand) malaa (have) fulfilled it, amar (spoke), We will ishah (make) ishah (make) our nadar (vow) that we have nadar (make vow), to qatar (burn) incense to the malakath (queen) of the sky, and to nasak (pour) out drink nasak (offerings) to her: qawam (rise up) then your nadar (vow), and ishah (make) your nadar (vow).

Therefore shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, all Yahawadah (Judah) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt): Behold, I have shabai (swear / take oath) by my gadawal (very great/important/mighty) sham (name), amar (spoke) Yahawah, that my sham (name) shall no more be qaraa (called) in the pah (mouth) of any ayash (husband/individual man) of Yahawadah (Judah) in all the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), amar (spoke), As the Adanay Yahawah chay (life).

Behold, I shaqad (watch) over them for rai (evil), and not for tawab (pleasant/functional); and all the ayash (husband/individual man) of Yahawadah (Judah) who are in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) shall be thamam (consumed) by the charab (sword) and by the raib (famine), until they are all gone.

Those who palayat (escape) the charab (sword) shall shawab (turn back / repent) out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) into the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah), math (few) in masapar (number); and all the shaarayath (remnant) of Yahawadah (Judah), who bawaa (come) gone into the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) to live there, shall yadai (know) whose dabar (word / matter) shall qawam (rise up), mine, or theirs.

This shall be the awath (sign / mark / miracle) to you, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, that I will paqad (visit) you in this maqawam (place), that you may yadai (know) that my dabar (word / matter) shall qawam (rise up) qawam (rise up) against you for rai (evil):

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Behold, I will nathan (give) Paraihachaparai (Pharaoh) Hophra malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt) into the yad (hand) of his ayab (enemy), and into the yad (hand) of those who baqash (seek) his napash (living being/soul); as I nathan (give) Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) into the yad (hand) of Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), who was his ayab (enemy), and baqash (sought) his napash (living being/soul).

The dabar (word / matter) that Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) dabar (word / matter) to Barawak (Baruch) the ban (son) of Narayah (Neriah), when he kathab (wrote) these dabar (word / matter) in a sapar (book / scribed document) at the pah (mouth) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah), in the rabayaiy (fourth) shanah (year) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), amar (spoke),
Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), to you, Barawak (Baruch):
You amar (spoke), away (woe) is me now! For Yahawah has yasap (added) yagawan (sorrow) to my makaab (pain); I am yagai (weary) with my anachah (groaning), and I matzaa (find) no manawachah (rest).

You shall amar (spoke) him, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Behold, that which I have banah (built) will I haras (break) down, and that which I have natai (planted) I will nathash (pluck) up; and this in the whole aratz (Earth/land).

Do you baqash (seek) gadawal (very great/important/mighty) things for yourself? Don't baqash (seek) them; for, behold, I will bawaa (come) rai (evil) on all bashar (flesh), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah; but your napash (living being/soul) will I nathan (give) to you for a shalal (prey) in all maqawam (place) where you yalak (go).
The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah which came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) concerning the gaway (nation / people).

Of Matzarayam (Egypt): concerning the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of Paraihanakah (Pharaoh) Necoh malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt), which was by the nahar (river) Parath (Euphrates) in Karakamayash (Carchemish), which Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) nakah (struck) in the rabayaiy (fourth) shanah (year) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah).
Irak (prepare) the magan (shield) and tzanah (shield), and nagash (draw) near to malachamah (battle)!

Asar (harness) the sawas (horses), and ilah (go up / offer) up, you horsemen, and yatzab (stand) forth with your kawabai (helmets); maraq (furbish) the ramach (spears), labash (put) on the coats of mail.

Why raah (see) I seen it? They are chath (dismayed) and are sawag (turned) backward; and their gabawar (mighty) ones are kathath (beaten) down, and have nawas (fled) manawas (apace), and don't panah (look) back: magawar (terror) is on sabayab (surrounding) side, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

Don't let the qal (swift) nawas (flee) away, nor the gabawar (mighty) man malat (escape); in the tzapawan (north) by the nahar (river) Parath (Euphrates) have they kashal (stumble / stagger) and napal (fall / be cast down).
Who is this who ilah (go up / offer) up like the Nile, whose mayam (Waters) gaish (toss) themselves like the nahar (rivers)?

Matzarayam (Egypt) ilah (go up / offer) up like the Nile, and his mayam (Waters) gaish (toss) themselves like the nahar (rivers): and he amar (spoke), I will ilah (go up / offer) up, I will kasah (cover) the aratz (Earth/land); I will abad (destroy/perish) iyar (cities) and its yashab (inhabit/dwell).

Ilah (go up / offer) up, you sawas (horses); and halal (praise), you rakab (chariots); and let the gabawar (mighty) men yatzaa (go out / come out) forth: Kawash (Cush) and Pawat (Put), who thapash (handle) the magan (shield); and the Lawaday (Ludim), who thapash (handle) and darak (bend) the qashath (bow).

For that yawam (day) is of the Adanay, Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), a yawam (day) of naqamah (vengeance), that he may naqam (avenge) him of his tzar (oppressor / distressor): and the charab (sword) shall akal (eat) and be shabai (satiate), and shall rawah (drink) its fill of their dam (blood); for the Adanay, Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), has a zabach (sacrifice) in the tzapawan (north) aratz (Earth/land) by the nahar (river) Parath (Euphrates).

Ilah (go up / offer) up into Galaid (Gilead), and laqach (take / seized) tzaray (balm), bathawalah (virgin) bath (daughter) of Matzarayam (Egypt): in shawaa (vanity) do you use many rapaah (medicines); there is no thailah (healing) for you.

The gaway (nation / people) have shamai (hearken / hear) of your qalawan (shame), and the aratz (Earth/land) is full of your tzawachah (cry); for the gabawar (mighty) gabawar (man) has kashal (stumble / stagger) against the gabawar (mighty), they are napal (fall / be cast down) shanayam (two) of them yachad (together).

The dabar (word / matter) that Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), how that Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) should bawaa (come) and nakah (strike) the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt).

Nagad (declare) in Matzarayam (Egypt), and shamai (hearken / hear) in Magadawal (Migdol), and shamai (hearken / hear) Nap (in) Memphis and in Thachapanachas (Tahpanhes): amar (spoke), yatzab (stand) forth, and kawan (prepare); for the charab (sword) has akal (eat) around you.
Why are your abayar (strong) ones sachap (swept) away? They didn't imad (stand), because Yahawah pushed them.

He rabah (made) many to kashal (stumble / stagger), yes, they napal (fall / be cast down) ayash (husband/individual man) on rai (neigbor/another person): and they amar (spoke), qawam (rise up), and shawab (turn back / repent) us go again to our own im (people / nation), and to the aratz (Earth/land) of our birth, from the yanah (oppressing) charab (sword).
They qaraa (called) there, Paraih (Pharaoh) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt) is but a shaawan (noise); he has let the mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) time ibar (pass over/through) by.

As I chay (life), naam (declares (prophetically)) the malak (king), whose sham (name) is Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), surely like Thabawar (Tabor) among the har (mountain), and like Karamal (Carmel) by the yam (sea/waters), so shall he bawaa (come).

You bath (daughter) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in Matzarayam (Egypt), ishah (make) yourself to go into captivity; Nap (for) Memphis shall become a shamah (desolation), and shall be burnt up, without yashab (inhabit/dwell).
Matzarayam (Egypt) is a very beautiful igalah (heifer); but qaratz (destruction) out of the tzapawan (north) bawaa (come) come, it has come.

Also her shakayar (hired) men in the qarab (among / near) of her are like calves of the marabaq (stall); for they also are panah (turned) back, they are nawas (fled) away yachad (together), they didn't imad (stand): for the yawam (day) of their ayad (calamity) bawaa (come) come on them, the ith (time) of their paqadah (visitation).

The qawal (sound / voice) of it shall yalak (go) like the nachash (serpent); for they shall yalak (march) with an chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), and bawaa (come) against her with axes, as itz (wood) cutters.
They shall karath (cut) down her yair (forest), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, though it can't be chaqar (searched); because they are more than the arabah (locusts), and are innumerable.
The bath (daughter) of Matzarayam (Egypt) shall be disappointed; she shall be nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the im (people / nation) of the tzapawan (north).

Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), amar (spoke): Behold, I will paqad (visit) Amon Naa (of) No, and Paraih (Pharaoh), and Matzarayam (Egypt), with her Alahayam, and her malak (king); even Paraih (Pharaoh), and those who batach (trust) in him:

And I will nathan (give) them into the yad (hand) of those who baqash (seek) their lives, and into the yad (hand) of Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and into the yad (hand) of his ibad (servant); and afterwards it shall be shakan (inhabited), as in the yawam (day) of qadam (old), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

But don't you be yaraa (fear / be afraid), Yaiqab (Jacob) my ibad (servant), neither be chathath (dismayed), Yasharaal (Israel): for, behold, I will yashai (salvation) you from rachawaq (afar), and your zarai (seed) from the aratz (Earth/land) of their shabay (captivity); and Yaiqab (Jacob) shall shawab (turn back / repent), and shall be shaqat (quiet) and at shaan (ease), and none shall make him charad (afraid).

Don't you be yaraa (fear / be afraid), O Yaiqab (Jacob) my ibad (servant), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah; for I am with you: for I will ishah (make) a kalah (complete / finish) end of all the gaway (nation / people) where I have nadach (driven) you; but I will not ishah (make) a kalah (complete / finish) end of you, but I will yasar (correct) you in mashapat (measure), and will in no naqah (clean/innocent) leave you naqah (clean/innocent).

The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah that came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) concerning the Palashathay (Philistines), before that Paraih (Pharaoh) nakah (struck) Izah (Gaza).

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Behold, mayam (Waters) ilah (go up / offer) up out of the tzapawan (north), and shall become an shatap (overflowing) nachal (stream / river), and shall shatap (overflow) the aratz (Earth/land) and malaa (all) that is therein, the iyar (city) and those who yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein; and the adam (men) shall zaiq (cry), and all the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the aratz (Earth/land) shall wail.

At the qawal (sound / voice) of the shaitah (stamping) of the parasah (hoofs) of his abayar (strong) ones, at the raish (rushing) of his rakab (chariots), at the hamawan (rumbling) of his galagal (wheels), the ab (father) don't panah (look) back to their ban (son) for rapayawan (feebleness) of yad (hand);

Because of the yawam (day) that bawaa (come) to shadad (destroy) all the Palashathay (Philistines), to karath (cut) off from Tzar (Tyre) and Tzayadawan (Sidon) every helper who sharayad (remains): for Yahawah will shadad (destroy) the Palashathay (Philistines), the shaarayath (remnant) of the ay (isle) of Kapathar (Caphtor).
Qarachah (baldness) bawaa (come) come on Izah (Gaza); Ashaqalawan (Ashkelon) is damah (brought) to nothing, the shaarayath (remnant) of their imaq (valley): how long will you gadad (cut) yourself?
You charab (sword) of Yahawah, how long will it be laa (NOT) you be shaqat (quiet)? Asap (put) up yourself into your thair (razor); ragai (rest), and be still.
How can you be shaqat (quiet), since Yahawah has given you a tzawah (command)? Against Ashaqalawan (Ashkelon), and against the seashore, there has he yaid (appointed) it.

Of Mawaab (Moab). Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): haway (Alas/Woe!) To Nabaw (Nebo)! For it is laid shadad (waste); Qarayathayam (Kiriathaim) is disappointed, it is lakad (taken); mashagab (misgab) is put to yabash (dry land) and broken down.

The thahalah (praise) of Mawaab (Moab) is no more; in Chashabawan (Heshbon) they have chashab (devised) rai (evil) against her: yalak (come), and let us karath (cut) her off from being a gaway (nation / people). You also, Madaman (Madmen), shall be brought to silence: the charab (sword) shall yalak (pursue) you.
The qawal (sound / voice) of a qawal (sound / voice) from Charanayam (Horonaim), shad (desolation) and gadawal (very great/important/mighty) shad (destruction)!
Mawaab (Moab) is shabar (destroyed); her tzaiyar (little) ones have caused a zaiq (cry) to be shamai (hearken / hear).

For by the mailah (ascent) of Lawachayath (Luhith) with continual bakay (weeping) shall they ilah (go up / offer) up; for at the descent of Charanayam (Horonaim) they have shamai (hearken / hear) the distress of the tzaiqah (cry) of shabar (destruction).
Nawas (flee), malat (save) your lives, and be like the heath in the madabar (wilderness).

For, because you have batach (trusted) in your maishah (works) and in your awatzar (treasures), you also shall be lakad (taken): and Kamawash (Chemosh) shall yatzaa (go out / come out) forth into gawalah (captivity), his kahan (priest) and his shar (prince / ruler) yachad (together).

The shadad (destroyer) shall bawaa (come) on every iyar (city), and no iyar (city) shall malat (escape); the imaq (valley) also shall abad (destroy/perish), and the mayashawar (plain) shall be destroyed; as Yahawah has amar (spoke).

Nathan (give) tzayatz (wings) to Mawaab (Moab), that she may fly and yatzaa (go out / come out) her away: and her iyar (cities) shall become a shamah (desolation), without any to yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein.
Arar (cursed) is he who ishah (make) the malaakah (work) of Yahawah negligently; and arar (cursed) is he who manai (keeps) back his charab (sword) from dam (blood).

Mawaab (Moab) has been at shaan (ease) from his naiwar (youth), and he shaqat (has) settled on his shamar (keep/guard), and has not been rawaq (emptied) from kalay (vessel) to kalay (vessel), neither has he halak (move) into gawalah (captivity): therefore his taim (taste) imad (remains) in him, and his rayach (scent) is not mawar (changed).

Therefore, behold, the yawam (day) bawaa (come), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, that I will shalach (send) to him those who pour off, and they shall pour him off; and they shall rawaq (empty) his kalay (vessels), and napatz (break) their nabal (bottles) in pieces.
Mawaab (Moab) shall be bawash (ashamed) of Kamawash (Chemosh), as the bayath (house) of Yasharaal (Israel) was bawash (ashamed) of Bayathaal (Bethel) their mabatach (confidence).
How do you amar (spoke), We are gabawar (mighty) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), and valiant gabawar (men) for the malachamah (war)?

Mawaab (Moab) is laid shadad (waste), and they are ilah (go up / offer) up into his iyar (cities), and his mabachar (chosen) bachawar (young) men are yarad (gone) down to the tabach (slaughter), naam (declares (prophetically)) the malak (king), whose sham (name) is Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).
The ayad (calamity) of Mawaab (Moab) is qarawab (near) to bawaa (come), and his rai (affliction) hurries maad (fast).

All you who are around him, nawad (bemoan) him, and all you who yadai (know) his sham (name); amar (spoke), How is the iz (strength / might / refuge) matah (staff / rod / tribe) shabar (broken), the thapaarah (beautiful) maqal (rod)!

You bath (daughter) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in Dayabawan (Dibon), yarad (come) down from your kabawad (glory), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) in tzamaa (thirst); for the shadad (destroyer) of Mawaab (Moab) has ilah (go up / offer) up against you, he has shachath (destroyed) your strongholds.

Yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Irawair (Aroer), imad (stand) by the darak (way), and tzapah (watchman / keep watch): shaal (ask) him who nawas (flees), and her who malat (escapes); amar (spoke), What hayah (came to pass) been done?
Mawaab (Moab) is disappointed; for it is broken down: wail and zaiq (cry); nagad (tell) it by the Aranawan (Arnon), that Mawaab (Moab) is laid shadad (waste).
Mashapat (judgment) bawaa (come) come on the mayashawar (plain) aratz (Earth/land), on Chalawan (Holon), and on Yahatz (Jahzah), and on Mawapaith (Mephaath),
And on Dayabawan (Dibon), and on Nabaw (Nebo), and on Bayathadabalathayam (Beth) Diblathaim,
And on Qarayathayam (Kiriathaim), and on Bayathagamawal (Beth) Gamul, and on Bayathabailamaiwan (Beth) Meon,
And on Qarayawath (Kerioth), and on Batzarah (Bozrah), and on all the iyar (cities) of the aratz (Earth/land) of Mawaab (Moab), rachawaq (far) or qarawab (near).
The qaran (horn) of Mawaab (Moab) is gadai (cut) off, and his zarawai (arm) is shabar (broken), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.
Shakar (make) him drunken; for he gadal (magnified) himself against Yahawah: and Mawaab (Moab) shall sapaq (wallow) in his qaa (vomit), and he also shall be in shachawaq (laughter/joking matter).
For wasn't Yasharaal (Israel) a shachawaq (laughter/joking matter) to you? Was he matzaa (found) among thieves? For as often as you dabar (word / matter) of him, you nawad (shake) your head.

You yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Mawaab (Moab), izab (leave) the iyar (cities), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the salai (rock); and be like the yawanah (dove) that qanan (makes) her nest over the pah (mouth) of the abyss.

We have shamai (hearken / hear) of the gaawan (pride) of Mawaab (Moab). He is very gaah (proud); his gabah (loftiness), and his gaawan (pride), and his arrogance, and the rawam (will lift up) of his lab (heart).
I yadai (know) his ibarah (wrath), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, that it is nothing; his boastings ishah (make) worked nothing.
Therefore will I wail for Mawaab (Moab); yes, I will zaiq (cry) out for all Mawaab (Moab): for the ayash (husband/individual man) of Qayaracharash (Kir) Heres shall they hagah (mourn).

With more than the bakay (weeping) of Yaizayar (Jazer) will I bakah (weep) for you, gapan (vine) of Shabam (Sibmah): your branches ibar (pass over/through) over the yam (sea/waters), they nagai (reached) even to the yam (sea/waters) of Yaizayar (Jazer): on your qayatz (summer) fruits and on your batzayar (vintage) the shadad (destroyer) is napal (fall / be cast down).

Gayal (gladness) and shamachah (joy) is asap (taken) away from the karamal (fruitful) field and from the aratz (Earth/land) of Mawaab (Moab); and I have caused yayan (wine) to shabath (shabath/rest) from the yaqab (wine) presses: none shall darak (tread) with hayadad (shouting); the hayadad (shouting) shall be no hayadad (shouting).

From the zaiq (cry) of Chashabawan (Heshbon) even to Alailaa (Elealeh), even to Yahatz (Jahaz) nathan (give) they uttered their qawal (sound / voice), from Tzair (Zoar) even to Charanayam (Horonaim), to Eglath Shelishiyah: for the mayam (Waters) of Namarayam (Nimrim) also shall become mashamah (desolate).

Moreover I will shabath (shabath/rest) to cease in Mawaab (Moab), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, him who ilah (go up / offer) in the bamah (high) place, and him who qatar (burns) incense to his Alahayam.

Therefore my lab (heart) hamah (they) for Mawaab (Moab) like chalayal (pipes), and my lab (heart) hamah (they) like chalayal (pipes) for the ayash (husband/individual man) of Qayaracharash (Kir) Heres: therefore the yatharah (abundance) that he ishah (make) gotten is abad (destroy/perish).
For every raash (head) is qarachah (bald), and every zaqan (beard) garai (clipped): on all the yad (hand) are cuttings, and on the waist sackcloth.

On all the housetops of Mawaab (Moab) and in its rachab (streets) there is masapad (lamentation) every where; for I have shabar (broken) Mawaab (Moab) like a kalay (vessel) in which none chapatz (delights), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

How it is broken down! How they wail! How Mawaab (Moab) has panah (turned) the irap (neck) with shame! So shall Mawaab (Moab) become a shachawaq (laughter/joking matter) and a machathah (terror) to all who are around him.
For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Behold, he shall daah (fly) as an nashar (eagle), and shall parash (spread) out his kanap (wings) against Mawaab (Moab).

Qarayawath (Kerioth) is lakad (taken), and the strongholds are seized, and the lab (heart) of the gabawar (mighty) men of Mawaab (Moab) at that yawam (day) shall be as the lab (heart) of a ashah (wife/individual woman) in her tzarar (pangs).
Mawaab (Moab) shall be destroyed from being a im (people / nation), because he has gadal (magnified) himself against Yahawah.
Pachad (fear / dread), and the pachath (pit), and the pach (snare), are on you, yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Mawaab (Moab), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

He who flees from the pachad (fear / dread) shall napal (fall / be cast down) into the pachath (pit); and he who ilah (go up / offer) up out of the pachath (pit) shall be lakad (taken) in the pach (snare): for I will bawaa (come) on him, even on Mawaab (Moab), the shanah (year) of their paqadah (visitation), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

Those who nawas (fled) imad (stand) without kach (strength / mighty / power) under the tzal (shadow) of Chashabawan (Heshbon); for a ash (fire) is yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of Chashabawan (Heshbon), and a lahabah (flame) from the midst of Sayachawan (Sihon), and has akal (eat) the paah (corner) of Mawaab (Moab), and the qadaqad (crown) of the head of the tumultuous ban (son).

Away (woe) to you, O Mawaab (Moab)! The im (people / nation) of Kamawash (Chemosh) is abad (destroy/perish); for your ban (son) are laqach (take / seized) shabay (away) captive, and your bath (daughter) into shabayah (captivity).

Yet will I shawab (turn back / repent) back the shabawath (captivity) of Mawaab (Moab) in the acharayath (latter) yawam (day), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah. Hanah (here) far is the mashapat (judgment) of Mawaab (Moab).

Of the ban (son) of Ammon. Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Has Yasharaal (Israel) no ban (son)? Has he no heir? Why then does Malcam yarash (possess) Gad (Gad), and his im (people / nation) yashab (inhabit/dwell) in its iyar (cities)?

Therefore, behold, the yawam (day) bawaa (come), amar (spoke) Yahawah, that I will cause an tharawaih (alarm) of malachamah (war) to be shamai (hearken / hear) against Rabah (Rabbah) of the ban (son) of Ammon; and it shall become a shamamah (desolate) thal (heap), and her bath (daughter) shall be yatzath (burned) with ash (fire): then shall Yasharaal (Israel) yarash (possess) those who yarash (possessed) him, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

Wail, Chashabawan (Heshbon), for Iy (Ai) is laid shadad (waste); tzaiq (cry), you bath (daughter) of Rabah (Rabbah), clothe yourself in sackcloth: sapad (lament), and shawat (run) back and forth among the fences; for Malcam shall yalak (go) into gawalah (captivity), his kahan (priest) and his shar (prince / ruler) yachad (together).
Why do you glory in the imaq (valleys), your zawab (flow) imaq (valley), shawabab (backsliding) bath (daughter)? Who batach (trusted) in her awatzar (treasures), saying, Who shall bawaa (come) to me?

Behold, I will bawaa (come) a pachad (fear / dread) on you, naam (declares (prophetically)) the Adanay, Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), from all who are around you; and you shall be nadach (driven) out every ayash (husband/individual man) panayam (right) forth, and there shall be none to qabatz (gather) together the fugitives.
But afterward I will shawab (turn back / repent) back the shabawath (captivity) of the ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

Of Adam (Edom). Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop): Is chakamah (wisdom) no more in Thayaman (Teman)? Is itzah (counsel) abad (destroy/perish) from the bayan (between)? Is their chakamah (wisdom) vanished?

Nawas (flee), panah (turn) back, yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the imaq (depths), yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Dadan (Dedan); for I will bawaa (come) the ayad (calamity) of Ishaw (Esau) on him, the ith (time) that I shall paqad (visit) him.
If grape batzar (gatherers) bawaa (come) to you, would they not shaar (leave) some gleaning ilalah (grapes)? If thieves by layal (night), wouldn't they shachath (destroy) until they had day (enough)?

But I have made Ishaw (Esau) chashap (bare), I have galah (uncovered) his masathar (secret) places, and he shall not be yakal (able) to chabah (hide) himself: his zarai (seed) is shadad (destroyed), and his ach (brother/kinsman), and his neighbors; and he is no more.
Izab (leave) your yathawam (fatherless) children, I will chayah (preserve) them alive; and let your alamanah (widows) batach (trust) in me.

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Behold, they to whom it didn't pertain to shathah (drinks) of the kawas (cup) shall shathah (drinks) shathah (drinks); and are you he who shall naqah (clean/innocent) go naqah (clean/innocent)? You shall not go naqah (clean/innocent), but you shall shathah (drinks) shathah (drinks).

For I have shabai (swear / take oath) by myself, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, that Batzarah (Bozrah) shall become an shamah (astonishment), a charapah (reproach), a charab (waste), and a qalalah (curse); and all its iyar (cities) shall be iwalam (forever) charabah (wastes).

I have shamai (hearken / hear) shamawaih (news) from Yahawah, and an tzayar (ambassador) is shalach (send) among the gaway (nation / people), saying, qabatz (gather) yourselves together, and bawaa (come) against her, and qawam (rise up) up to the malachamah (battle).
For, behold, I nathan (give) made you qatan (small/young/least) among the gaway (nation / people), and bazah (despised) among adam (men).

As for your terror, the zadawan (pride) of your lab (heart) has nashaa (lift) you, O you who shakan (dwell) in the chagaw (clefts) of the salai (rock), who thapash (hold) the marawam (height) of the gabaih (hill): though you should make your qan (nest) as gabah (high) as the nashar (eagle), I will yarad (bring) you down from there, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.
Adam (Edom) shall become an shamah (astonishment): everyone who passes by it shall be shamam (astonished), and shall sharaq (hiss) at all its makah (plagues).

As in the mahapakah (overthrow) of Sadam (Sodom) and Imarah (Gomorrah) and the neighbor cities of it, amar (spoke) Yahawah, no ayash (husband/individual man) shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) there, neither shall any ban (son) of adam (man) live therein.

Behold, he shall ilah (go up / offer) up like a aray (lion) from the gaawan (pride) of the Yaradan (Jordan) against the ayathan (strong) nawah (habitation): for I will ragai (suddenly) make them rawatz (run) away from it; and whoever is bachar (chosen), him will I paqad (visit) over it: for who is like me? And who will yaid (appoint) me a time? And who is the raih (shepherd) who will imad (stand) panayam (before) me?

Therefore shamai (hearken / hear) the itzah (counsel) of Yahawah, that he has yaitz (taken) against Adam (Edom); and his machashabah (purposes), that he has chashab (purposed) against the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Thayaman (Teman): Surely they shall drag them away, the tzaiyar (little) ones of the tzaan (flock); surely he shall make their nawah (habitation) shamam (desolate) over them.

The aratz (Earth/land) raish (trembles) at the qawal (sound / voice) of their napal (fall / be cast down); there is a tzaiqah (cry), the qawal (sound / voice) which is shamai (hearken / hear) in the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters).

Behold, he shall ilah (go up / offer) up and daah (fly) as the nashar (eagle), and parash (spread) out his kanap (wings) against Batzarah (Bozrah): and the lab (heart) of the gabawar (mighty) men of Adam (Edom) at that yawam (day) shall be as the lab (heart) of a ashah (wife/individual woman) in her tzarar (pangs).

Of Damashaq (Damascus). Chamath (Hamath) is bawash (confounded), and Arapad (Arpad); for they have shamai (hearken / hear) rai (evil) shamawaih (news), they are mawag (melted) away: there is daagah (sorrow) on the yam (sea/waters); it can't be shaqat (quiet).

Damashaq (Damascus) has grown rapah (feeble), she panah (turns) herself to nawas (flee), and trembling has chazaq (seized) on her: tzarah (anguish) and chabal (sorrows) achaz (have) taken hold of her, as of a yalad (birth / begot) in travail.
How is the iyar (city) of thahalah (praise) not forsaken, the qarayah (city) of my mashawash (joy)?

Therefore her bachawar (young) men shall napal (fall / be cast down) in her rachab (streets), and all the ayash (husband/individual man) of malachamah (war) shall be brought to damam (silence) in that yawam (day), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).
I will yatzath (kindle) a ash (fire) in the chawamah (wall) of Damashaq (Damascus), and it shall akal (eat) the aramawan (palaces) Banahadad (of) Ben Hadad.

Of Qadar (Kedar), and of the mamalakah (kingdoms) of Chatzawar (Hazor), which Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) nakah (struck). Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: qawam (rise up), ilah (go up / offer) up to Qadar (Kedar), and shadad (destroy) the ban (son) of the qadam (east).

Their ahal (tents) and their tzaan (flocks) shall they nashaa (lift); they shall nashaa (lift) away for themselves their yarayaih (curtains), and all their kalay (vessels), and their gamal (camels); and they shall qaraa (called) to them, magawar (terror) on sabayab (surrounding) side!

Nawas (flee), wander maad (far) off, yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the imaq (depths), you yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Chatzawar (Hazor), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah; for Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) has taken itzah (counsel) against you, and has chashab (conceived) a machashabah (purpose) against you.

Qawam (rise up), ilah (go up / offer) up to a gaway (nation / people) that is at shalaw (ease), that yashab (inhabit/dwell) without batach (care), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah; that have neither dalath (gates) nor barayach (bars), that shakan (dwell) badad (alone).

Their gamal (camels) shall be a baz (booty), and the hamawan (multitude) of their livestock a shalal (spoil): and I will zarah (scatter) to all rawach (spirit / wind) those who have the paah (corners) of their beards cut off; and I will bawaa (come) their ayad (calamity) from every ibar (side) of them, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

Chatzawar (Hazor) shall be a maiwan (dwelling) place of jackals, a shamamah (desolation) iwalam (forever): no ayash (husband/individual man) shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) there, neither shall any ban (son) of adam (man) live therein.

The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah that came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) concerning Iyalam (Elam), in the raashayath (beginning) of the malakawath (reign) of Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), amar (spoke),
Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop): Behold, I will shabar (break) the qashath (bow) of Iyalam (Elam), the raashayath (beginning) of their gabawarah (might).

On Iyalam (Elam) will I bawaa (come) the arabai (four) rawach (spirit / wind) from the arabai (four) quarters of the sky, and will zarah (scatter) them toward all those rawach (spirit / wind); and there shall be no gaway (nation / people) where the nadach (outcasts) of Iyalam (Elam) shall not bawaa (come).

I will cause Iyalam (Elam) to be chathath (dismayed) panayam (before) their ayab (enemy), and panayam (before) those who baqash (seek) their napash (living being/soul); and I will bawaa (come) rai (evil) on them, even my charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah; and I will shalach (send) the charab (sword) achar (other) them, until I kalah (complete / finish) consumed them;

And I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) my kasaa (throne) in Iyalam (Elam), and will abad (destroy/perish) from there malak (king) and shar (prince / ruler), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.
But it shall happen in the acharayath (latter) yawam (day), that I will shawab (turn back / repent) back the shabawath (captivity) of Iyalam (Elam), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

The dabar (word / matter) that Yahawah dabar (word / matter) concerning Babal (Babylon), concerning the aratz (Earth/land) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans), by Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy).

Nagad (declare) among the gaway (nation / people) and shamai (hearken / hear), and nashaa (lift) up a nas (standard); shamai (hearken / hear), and don't kachad (conceal): amar (spoke), Babal (Babylon) is lakad (taken), Bal (Bel) is disappointed, Maradak (Merodach) is chathath (dismayed); her itzab (images) are disappointed, her galawal (idols) are chathath (dismayed).

For out of the tzapawan (north) there ilah (go up / offer) up a gaway (nation / people) against her, which shall shayath (put / appoint / make) her aratz (Earth/land) shamah (desolate), and none shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein: they are nawad (fled), they are halak (move), both adam (man) and animal.

In those yawam (day), and in that ith (time), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, the ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) shall bawaa (come), they and the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah) yachad (together); they shall halak (move) on their yalak (way) bakah (weeping), and shall baqash (seek) Yahawah their Alahayam.

They shall inquire concerning Tzayawan (Zion) with their panayam (faces) turned toward it, saying, bawaa (come), and lawah (join) yourselves to Yahawah in an iwalam (forever) barayath (covenant) that shall not be shakach (forgotten).

My im (people / nation) abad (destroy/perish) been lost tzaan (sheep): their raih (shepherds) have thaih (caused) them to go astray; they have shawabab (turned) them away on the har (mountain); they have halak (move) from har (mountain) to gabaih (hill); they have shakach (forgotten) their rabatz (resting) place.

All who matzaa (found) them have akal (eat) them; and their tzar (oppressor / distressor) amar (spoke), We are not asham (guilty), because they have chataa (sinned) against Yahawah, the nawah (habitation) of tzadaq (righteous / just / fair), even Yahawah, the maqawah (gathering/collection) of their ab (father).

Nawad (flee) out of the thawak (midst) of Babal (Babylon), and yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of the aratz (Earth/land) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans), and be as the male ithawad (goats) panayam (before) the tzaan (flocks).

For, behold, I will ilah (go up / offer) up and ilah (go up / offer) to come up against Babal (Babylon) a qahal (company) of gadawal (very great/important/mighty) gaway (nation / people) from the tzapawan (north) aratz (Earth/land); and they shall irak (set) themselves in array against her; from there she shall be lakad (taken): their chatz (arrows) shall be as of an expert gabawar (mighty) shakal (man); none shall shawab (turn back / repent) in rayaqam (vain).
Kashaday (Chaldea) shall be a shalal (prey): all who shalal (prey) on her shall be shabai (satisfied), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

Because you are shamach (glad), because you shamach (rejoice), O you who plunder my nachalah (heritage), because you are wanton as a igalah (heifer) that treads out the grain, and tzahal (neigh) as abayar (strong) horses;

Your am (mother) shall be maad (utterly) disappointed; she who yalad (birth / begot) you shall be chapar (confounded): behold, she shall be the least of the gaway (nation / people), a madabar (wilderness), a dry tzayah (land), and a irabah (desert).

Because of the qatzap (wrath) of Yahawah she shall not be yashab (inhabit/dwell), but she shall be wholly shamamah (desolate): everyone who ibar (pass over/through) by Babal (Babylon) shall be shamam (astonished), and sharaq (hiss) at all her makah (plagues).

Irak (set) yourselves in array against Babal (Babylon) all around, all you who darak (bend) the qashath (bow); yadah (shoot) at her, chamal (spare) no chatz (arrows): for she has chataa (sinned) against Yahawah.

Rawai (shout) against her all around: she nathan (give) submitted herself; her bulwarks are napal (fall / be cast down), her chawamah (walls) are haras (thrown) down; for it is the naqamah (vengeance) of Yahawah: naqam (take) vengeance on her; as she ishah (make) done, ishah (make) to her.

Karath (cut) off the zarai (sower) from Babal (Babylon), and him who thapash (handles) the magal (sickle) in the ith (time) of qatzayar (harvest): for panayam (fear) of the yanah (oppressing) charab (sword) they shall panah (turn) everyone to his im (people / nation), and they shall nawas (flee) everyone to his own aratz (Earth/land).

Yasharaal (Israel) is a hunted shah (sheep); the aray (lions) have nadach (driven) him away: raashawan (first), the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) akal (eat) him; and now at acharawan (last) Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) has itzam (broken) his bones.

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): Behold, I will paqad (visit) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) and his aratz (Earth/land), as I paqad (visit) punished the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria).

I will shawab (turn back / repent) Yasharaal (Israel) again to his pasture, and he shall raih (feed) on Karamal (Carmel) and Bashan (Bashan), and his napash (living being/soul) shall be shabai (satisfied) on the har (mountain) of Aparayam (Ephraim) and in Galaid (Gilead).

In those yawam (day), and in that ith (time), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, the iwan (guilt/iniquity) of Yasharaal (Israel) shall be baqash (sought) for, and there shall be none; and the chataah (sin) of Yahawadah (Judah), and they shall not be matzaa (found): for I will salach (forgive/pardon/make clean) them whom I leave as a shaar (remnant).

Ilah (go up / offer) up against the aratz (Earth/land) of Marathayam (Merathaim), even against it, and against the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Paqawad (Pekod): kill and utterly charam (destroy) achar (other) them, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, and ishah (make) according to all that I have tzawah (commanded) you.
A qawal (sound / voice) of malachamah (battle) is in the aratz (Earth/land), and of gadawal (very great/important/mighty) shabar (destruction).
How is the patayash (hammer) of the whole aratz (Earth/land) gadai (cut) apart and shabar (broken)! How is Babal (Babylon) become a shamah (desolation) among the gaway (nation / people)!

I have laid a yaqash (snare) for you, and you are also lakad (taken), Babal (Babylon), and you weren't yadai (aware): you are matzaa (found), and also thapash (caught), because you have garah (striven) against Yahawah.

Yahawah pathach (has) opened his awatzar (armory), and yatzaa (go out / come out) brought forth the kalay (weapons) of his zaim (indignation); for the Adanay, Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), has a malaakah (work) to do in the aratz (Earth/land) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans).

Bawaa (come) against her from the utmost qatz (border); pathach (open) her maabawas (storehouses); salal (cast) her up as iram (heaps), and charam (destroy) her utterly; let nothing of her be shaarayath (left).
Kill all her par (bulls); yarad (let) them go down to the tabach (slaughter): haway (Alas/Woe!) To them! For their yawam (day) bawaa (come) come, the ith (time) of their paqadah (visitation).

The qawal (sound / voice) of those who nawas (flee) and palayat (escape) out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Babal (Babylon), to nagad (declare) in Tzayawan (Zion) the naqamah (vengeance) of Yahawah our Alahayam, the naqamah (vengeance) of his hayakal (temple).

Shamai (hearken / hear) together the rab (archers) against Babal (Babylon), all those who darak (bend) the qashath (bow); chanah (encamp) against her all around; let none of it palayatah (escape): shalam (recompense) her according to her pail (work); according to all that she ishah (make) done, ishah (make) to her; for she has been zawad (proud) against Yahawah, against the qadawash (holy) One of Yasharaal (Israel).

Therefore her bachawar (young) men will napal (fall / be cast down) in her rachab (streets), and all her ayash (husband/individual man) of malachamah (war) will be brought to damam (silence) in that yawam (day), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

Behold, I am against you, you zadawan (proud) one, naam (declares (prophetically)) the Adanay, Yahawah of tzabaa (troop); for your yawam (day) bawaa (come) come, the ith (time) that I will paqad (visit) you.

The zadawan (proud) one shall kashal (stumble / stagger) and napal (fall / be cast down), and none shall qawam (rise up) him up; and I will yatzath (kindle) a ash (fire) in his iyar (cities), and it shall akal (eat) all who are around him.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop): The ban (son) of Yasharaal (Israel) and the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah) are ishaq (oppressed) yachad (together); and all who shabah (took) them captive chazaq (hold) them fast; they maan (refuse) to shalach (send) them go.

Their gaal (redeemer) is chazaq (strong); Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) is his sham (name): he will rayab (thoroughly) rayab (plead) their rayab (cause), that he may give ragai (rest) to the aratz (Earth/land), and ragaz (disquiet) the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Babal (Babylon).

A charab (sword) is on the Kashaday (Chaldeans), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, and on the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Babal (Babylon), and on her shar (prince / ruler), and on her chakam (wise) men.
A charab (sword) is on the boasters, and they shall yaal (become) fools; a charab (sword) is on her gabawar (mighty) men, and they shall be chathath (dismayed).

A charab (sword) is on their sawas (horses), and on their rakab (chariots), and on all the mixed irab (evening) who are in the thawak (midst) of her; and they shall become as ashah (wife/individual woman): a charab (sword) is on her awatzar (treasures), and they shall be bazaz (robbed).
A charab (drought) is on her mayam (Waters), and they shall be yabash (dry land) up; for it is a aratz (Earth/land) of engraved pasayal (images), and they are halal (praise) over ayamah (idols).

Therefore the tzayay (wild) animals of the desert with the wolves shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) there, and the ostriches shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein: and it shall be no more yashab (inhabit/dwell) natzach (forever); neither shall it be lived in from dawar (generation / age / period) to dawar (generation / age / period).

As when Alahayam mahapakah (overthrew) Sadam (Sodom) and Imarah (Gomorrah) and the neighbor cities of it, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, so shall no ayash (husband/individual man) yashab (inhabit/dwell) there, neither shall any ban (son) of adam (man) live therein.

Behold, a im (people / nation) bawaa (come) from the tzapawan (north); and a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) gaway (nation / people) and many malak (king) shall be iwar (rouse / awaken) up from the uttermost yarakah (parts) of the aratz (Earth/land).

They lay chazaq (hold) on qashath (bow) and kayadawan (spear); they are akazaray (cruel), and have no racham (mercy); their qawal (sound / voice) hamah (they) like the yam (sea/waters); and they rakab (ride) on sawas (horses), everyone irak (set) in array, as a ayash (husband/individual man) to the malachamah (battle), against you, bath (daughter) of Babal (Babylon).

The malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) has shamai (hearken / hear) the news of them, and his yad (hand) wax rapah (feeble): tzarah (anguish) has chazaq (taken) hold of him, chayal (pains) as of a yalad (birth / begot) in labor.

Behold, the enemy shall ilah (go up / offer) up like a aray (lion) from the gaawan (pride) of the Yaradan (Jordan) against the ayathan (strong) nawah (habitation): for I will ragai (suddenly) make them rawatz (run) away from it; and whoever is bachawar (chosen), him will I paqad (visit) over it: for who is like me? And who will yaid (appoint) me a time? And who is the raih (shepherd) who can imad (stand) panayam (before) me?

Therefore shamai (hearken / hear) the itzah (counsel) of Yahawah, that he has yaitz (taken) against Babal (Babylon); and his machashabah (purposes), that he has chashab (purposed) against the aratz (Earth/land) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans): Surely they shall drag them away, even the tzaiyar (little) ones of the tzaan (flock); surely he shall make their nawah (habitation) shamam (desolate) over them.
At the qawal (sound / voice) of the thapash (taking) of Babal (Babylon) the aratz (Earth/land) raish (trembles), and the zaiq (cry) is shamai (hearken / hear) among the gaway (nation / people).
Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Behold, I will iwar (rouse / awaken) up against Babal (Babylon), and against those who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in Lebkamai, a shachath (destroying) rawach (spirit / wind).

I will shalach (send) to Babal (Babylon) strangers, who shall zarah (winnow) her; and they shall baqaq (empty) her aratz (Earth/land): for in the yawam (day) of rai (trouble) they shall be against her around.

Against him who darak (bends) let the darak (archer) darak (bend) his qashath (bow), and against him who ilah (go up / offer) himself up in his coat of mail: and don't chamal (spare) her bachawar (young) men; charam (utterly) destroy all her tzabaa (troop).
They shall napal (fall / be cast down) down chalal (slain) in the aratz (Earth/land) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans), and thrust daqar (through) in her chawatz (streets).

For Yasharaal (Israel) is not alaman (forsaken), nor Yahawadah (Judah), of his Alahayam, of Yahawah of tzabaa (troop); though their aratz (Earth/land) is malaa (full) of asham (guilt) against the qadawash (holy) One of Yasharaal (Israel).

Nawas (flee) out of the thawak (midst) of Babal (Babylon), and malat (save) every ayash (husband/individual man) his napash (living being/soul); don't be damam (cut) off in her iwan (guilt/iniquity): for it is the ith (time) of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) naqamah (vengeance); he will shalam (render) to her a gamawal (recompense).

Babal (Babylon) has been a zahab (gold) kawas (cup) in yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) yad (hand), who made all the aratz (Earth/land) shakar (drunken): the gaway (nation / people) have shathah (drinks) of her yayan (wine); therefore the gaway (nation / people) are halal (praise).

Babal (Babylon) is pathaawam (suddenly) napal (fall / be cast down) and shabar (destroyed): wail for her; laqach (take / seized) tzaray (balm) for her makaab (pain), if so be she may be rapaa (healed).

We would have rapaa (healed) Babal (Babylon), but she is not rapaa (healed): izab (forsake) her, and yalak (let) us go everyone into his own aratz (Earth/land); for her mashapat (judgment) reaches to shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), and is nashaa (lift) up even to the shachaq (skies).
Yahawah yatzaa (go out / come out) brought forth our tzadaqah (righteousness): bawaa (come), and let us sapar (book) in Tzayawan (Zion) the maishah (work) of Yahawah our Alahayam.

Barar (make) sharp the chatz (arrows); hold firm the shalat (shields): Yahawah has iwar (rouse / awaken) up the rawach (spirit / wind) of the malak (king) of the Maday (Medes); because his purpose is against Babal (Babylon), to shachath (destroy) it: for it is the naqamah (vengeance) of Yahawah, the naqamah (vengeance) of his hayakal (temple).

Nashaa (lift) up a nas (standard) against the chawamah (walls) of Babal (Babylon), make the mashamar (watch) chazaq (strong), kawan (set) the watchmen, kawan (prepare) the ambushes; for Yahawah has both zamam (purposed) and ishah (make) that which he dabar (word / matter) concerning the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Babal (Babylon).
You who shakan (dwell) on many mayam (Waters), abundant in awatzar (treasures), your qatz (end) bawaa (come) come, the amah (measure) of your batzai (covetousness).

Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) has shabai (swear / take oath) by himself, saying, Surely I will malaa (fill) you with adam (men), as with the canker worm; and they shall inah (answer / respond) up a hayadad (shout) against you.

He ishah (make) made the aratz (Earth/land) by his kach (strength / mighty / power), he has kawan (established) the thabal (world) by his chakamah (wisdom), and by his thabawan (understanding) has he natah (stretched) out the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)):

When he nathan (give) his qawal (sound / voice), there is a hamawan (tumult) of mayam (Waters) in the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), and he causes the vapors to ilah (go up / offer) from the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the aratz (Earth/land); he ishah (make) baraq (lightning) for the matar (rain), and yatzaa (go out / come out) forth the rawach (spirit / wind) out of his awatzar (treasuries).

Every adam (man) has become bair (brutish) without daith (knowledge). Every tzarap (goldsmith) is disappointed by his pasal (idol/graven image); for his molten nasak (image) is falsehood, and there is no rawach (spirit / wind) in them.
They are habal (vanity), a maishah (work) of delusion: in the ith (time) of their paqadah (visitation) they shall abad (destroy/perish).
The chalaq (portion) of Yaiqab (Jacob) is not like these; for he is the former of all things; and is the shabat (tribe) of his nachalah (inheritance): Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) is his sham (name).

You are my mapatz (battle) axe and kalay (weapons) of malachamah (war): and with you will I napatz (break) in pieces the gaway (nation / people); and with you will I shachath (destroy) mamalakah (kingdoms);
And with you will I napatz (break) in pieces the sawas (horse) and his rider;

And with you will I napatz (break) in pieces the chariot and him who rides therein; and with you will I napatz (break) in pieces ayash (husband/individual man) and ashah (wife/individual woman); and with you will I napatz (break) in pieces the zaqan (old) nair (man) and the youth; and with you will I napatz (break) in pieces the bachawar (young) man and the bathawalah (virgin);

And with you will I napatz (break) in pieces the raih (shepherd) and his idar (flock); and with you will I napatz (break) in pieces the farmer and his tzamad (yoke); and with you will I napatz (break) in pieces pachah (governors) and deputies.

I will shalam (render) to Babal (Babylon) and to all the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Kashaday (Chaldea) all their rai (evil) that they ishah (make) done in Tzayawan (Zion) in your iyan (eye), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

Behold, I am against you, mashachayath (destroying) har (mountain), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, which shachath (destroys) all the aratz (Earth/land); and I will natah (stretch) out my yad (hand) on you, and galal (roll) you down from the salai (rocks), and will nathan (give) you a burnt har (mountain).

They shall not laqach (take / seized) of you a aban (stone) for a panah (corner), nor a aban (stone) for mawasadah (foundations); but you shall be shamamah (desolate) for iwalam (forever), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

Nashaa (lift) up a nas (standard) in the aratz (Earth/land), thaqai (blow / sound alarm) the shawapar (Shawapar(Shofar) - Ram's horn (instrument)) among the gaway (nation / people), qadash (set apart/make holy) the gaway (nation / people) against her, shamai (hearken / hear) together against her the mamalakah (kingdoms) of Ararat (Ararat), Manay (Minni), and Ashakanaz (Ashkenaz): paqad (visit) a marshal against her; cause the sawas (horses) to ilah (go up / offer) up as the samar (rough) canker worm.

Qadash (set apart/make holy) against her the gaway (nation / people), the malak (king) of the Maday (Medes), its pachah (governors), and all its deputies, and all the aratz (Earth/land) of their mamashalah (dominion).

The aratz (Earth/land) raish (trembles) and is in chawal (pain); for the machashabah (purposes) of Yahawah against Babal (Babylon) do qawam (rise up), to shawam (place / establish / appoint) the aratz (Earth/land) of Babal (Babylon) a shamah (desolation), without yashab (inhabit/dwell).

The gabawar (mighty) men of Babal (Babylon) have forborne to lacham (fight), they yashab (inhabit/dwell) in their strongholds; their gabawarah (might) has nashath (failed); they are become as ashah (wife/individual woman): her mashakan (dwelling) places are set on yatzath (fire); her barayach (bars) are shabar (broken).

Rawatz (one) runner will rawatz (run) to qaraah (meet) another, and one nagad (messenger) to qaraah (meet) another, to show the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) that his iyar (city) is lakad (taken) on every qatzah (end / extremity / border):
And the maibar (passages) are seized, and the reeds they have sharap (burned) with ash (fire), and the ayash (husband/individual man) of malachamah (war) are frightened.

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel): The bath (daughter) of Babal (Babylon) is like a garan (threshing) floor at the ith (time) when it is trodden; yet a mait (little) while, and the ith (time) of qatzayar (harvest) shall bawaa (come) for her.

Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) has akal (eat) me, he has hamam (crushed) me, he has yatzag (made) me an rayaq (empty) kalay (vessel), he has, like a thanayan (monster), balai (swallowed) me up, he malaa (has) filled his maw with my delicacies; he has dawach (cast) me out.

The chamas (violence) done to me and to my shaar (flesh) be on Babal (Babylon), shall the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Tzayawan (Zion) amar (spoke); and, My dam (blood) be on the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Kashaday (Chaldea), shall Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) amar (spoke).

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Behold, I will rayab (plead) your rayab (cause), and naqam (take) vengeance for you; and I will charab (dry) up her yam (sea/waters), and make her maqawar (fountain) yabash (dry land).
Babal (Babylon) shall become gal (heaps), a maiwan (dwelling) place for jackals, an shamah (astonishment), and a sharaqah (hissing), without yashab (inhabit/dwell).
They shall shaag (roar) yachad (together) like young kapayar (lions); they shall growl as aray (lions)' cubs.

When they are cham (heated), I will shayath (put / appoint / make) their mashathah (feast), and I will shakar (make) them drunken, that they may ilaz (rejoice), and sleep a iwalam (forever) shanah (sleep), and not qawatz (wake), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.
I will yarad (bring) them down like kar (lambs) to the tabach (slaughter), like ayal (rams) with male ithawad (goats).
How is Shashak (Sheshach) lakad (taken)! And the thahalah (praise) of the whole aratz (Earth/land) seized! How is Babal (Babylon) become a shamah (desolation) among the gaway (nation / people)!
The yam (sea/waters) has ilah (go up / offer) up on Babal (Babylon); she is kasah (covered) with the hamawan (multitude) of its gal (waves).

Her iyar (cities) are become a shamah (desolation), a tzayah (dry) aratz (Earth/land), and a irabah (desert), a aratz (Earth/land) in which no ayash (husband/individual man) yashab (inhabit/dwell), neither does any ban (son) of adam (man) ibar (pass over/through) thereby.

I will execute paqad (visit) on Bal (Bel) in Babal (Babylon), and I will yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of his pah (mouth) that which he has balai (swallowed) up; and the gaway (nation / people) shall not flow any more to him: yes, the chawamah (wall) of Babal (Babylon) shall napal (fall / be cast down).

My im (people / nation), go away from the thawak (midst) of her, and malat (save) yourselves every ayash (husband/individual man) from the charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah.

Don't let your labab (heart) rakak (faint), neither yaraa (fear / be afraid) for the shamawaih (news) that shall be shamai (hearken / hear) in the aratz (Earth/land); for shamawaih (news) shall bawaa (come) one shanah (year), and achar (other) that in another shanah (year) shall come shamawaih (news), and chamas (violence) in the aratz (Earth/land), mashal (rule/have dominion) against mashal (rule/have dominion).

Therefore, behold, the yawam (day) bawaa (come), that I will execute paqad (visit) on the engraved pasayal (images) of Babal (Babylon); and her whole aratz (Earth/land) shall be bawash (confounded); and all her chalal (slain) shall napal (fall / be cast down) in the thawak (midst) of her.

Then the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) and the aratz (Earth/land), and all that is therein, shall ranan (sing) for joy over Babal (Babylon); for the shadad (destroyers) shall bawaa (come) to her from the tzapawan (north), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

As Babal (Babylon) has caused the chalal (slain) of Yasharaal (Israel) to napal (fall / be cast down), so at Babal (Babylon) shall napal (fall / be cast down) the chalal (slain) of all the aratz (Earth/land).

You who have palayat (escaped) the charab (sword), halak (move), don't imad (stand) still; zakar (remembrance/memory) Yahawah from rachawaq (afar), and let Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) ilah (go up / offer) into your labab (mind).

We are bawash (confounded), because we have shamai (hearken / hear) charapah (reproach); kalamah (confusion) has kasah (covered) our panayam (faces): for strangers bawaa (come) come into the maqadash (sanctuaries) of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) bayath (house).

Therefore, behold, the yawam (day) bawaa (come), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, that I will execute paqad (visit) on her engraved pasayal (images); and through all her aratz (Earth/land) the chalal (wounded) shall anaq (groan).

Though Babal (Babylon) should ilah (go up / offer) up to the sky, and though she should batzar (fortify) the marawam (height) of her iz (strength / might / refuge), yet from me shall shadad (destroyers) bawaa (come) to her, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.
The qawal (sound / voice) of a zaiq (cry) from Babal (Babylon), and of gadawal (very great/important/mighty) shabar (destruction) from the aratz (Earth/land) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans)!

For Yahawah lays Babal (Babylon) shadad (waste), and abad (destroy/perish) out of her the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qawal (sound / voice); and their gal (waves) hamah (they) like many mayam (Waters); the shaawan (noise) of their qawal (sound / voice) is nathan (give):

For the shadad (destroyer) bawaa (come) come on her, even on Babal (Babylon), and her gabawar (mighty) men are lakad (taken), their qashath (bows) are broken in pieces; for Yahawah is a Al of gamawalah (recompenses), he will shalam (surely) shalam (requite).

I will shakar (make) drunk her shar (prince / ruler) and her chakam (wise) men, her pachah (governors) and her deputies, and her gabawar (mighty) men; and they shall sleep a iwalam (forever) shanah (sleep), and not qawatz (wake) up, naam (declares (prophetically)) the malak (king), whose sham (name) is Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop): The rachab (broad) chawamah (walls) of Babal (Babylon) shall be irar (utterly) overthrown, and her gabah (high) shair (gates) shall be yatzath (burned) with ash (fire); and the im (people / nation) shall yagai (labor) for rayaq (vanity), and the laam (nations) for the ash (fire); and they shall be yaip (weary).

The dabar (word / matter) which Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) tzawah (commanded) Sharayah (Seraiah) the ban (son) of Narayah (Neriah), the ban (son) Machasayah (of) Mahseiah, when he yalak (went) with Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) to Babal (Babylon) in the rabayaiy (fourth) shanah (year) of his malak (king). Now Sharayah (Seraiah) was chief quartermaster.

Yaramayah (Jeremiah) kathab (wrote) in a sapar (book / scribed document) all the rai (evil) that should bawaa (come) on Babal (Babylon), even all these dabar (word / matter) that are kathab (written) concerning Babal (Babylon).
Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke) to Sharayah (Seraiah), When you bawaa (come) to Babal (Babylon), then raah (see) that you qaraa (called) all these dabar (word / matter),

And amar (spoke), Yahawah, you have dabar (word / matter) concerning this maqawam (place), to karath (cut) it off, that none shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein, neither adam (man) nor animal, but that it shall be shamamah (desolate) iwalam (forever).

It shall be, when you kalah (complete / finish) made an end of qaraa (called) this sapar (book / scribed document), that you shall qashar (bind) a aban (stone) to it, and shalak (cast) it into the thawak (midst) of the Parath (Euphrates):

And you shall amar (spoke), Thus shall Babal (Babylon) shaqai (sink), and shall not qawam (rise up) again panayam (because) of the rai (evil) that I will bawaa (come) on her; and they shall be yaip (weary). Thus far are the dabar (word / matter) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah).

Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) was isharayam (twenty) - achad (one) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) achad (one) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Chamawatal (Hamutal) the bath (daughter) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah) of Labanah (Libnah).
He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, according to all that Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) ishah (make) done.

For il (over) the ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah it happened in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) and Yahawadah (Judah), until he had shalak (cast) them out from his panayam (presence). Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) marad (rebelled) against the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon).
