I sabab (went) down to the bottoms of the mountains. The earth barred me in forever: yet have you sabab (brought) up my napash (living being/soul) from the pit, Yahawah my Alahayam.
When my soul fainted within me, I remembered Yahawah. My prayer yarad (came) in to you, into your holy temple.
Those who regard lying vanities forsake their own mercy.
But I will sacrifice to you with the voice of thanksgiving. I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation belongs to Yahawah.
Yahawah spoke to the fish, and it vomited out on the dry land.
The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Yawanah (Jonah) the shanay (second) time, amar (spoke),
Qawam (rise up), yalak (go) to Nayanawah (Nineveh), that gadawal (very great/important/mighty) iyar (city), and qaraa (called) to it the message that I dabar (word / matter) you.

So Yawanah (Jonah) qawam (rise up), and yalak (went) to Nayanawah (Nineveh), according to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah. Now Nayanawah (Nineveh) was an exceedingly gadawal (very great/important/mighty) iyar (city), shalawash (three) yawam (day)' mahalak (journey) across.

He chalal (began) to bawaa (come) into the iyar (city) a yawam (day) mahalak (journey), and he qaraa (called) out, and amar (spoke), In arabaiyam (forty) yawam (day), Nayanawah (Nineveh) will be overthrown!

The ayash (husband/individual man) of Nayanawah (Nineveh) aman (believe / have faith) Alahayam; and they qaraa (called) a tzawam (fast), and labash (put) on sackcloth, from their greatest even to their qatan (small/young/least).

The news nagai (reached) the malak (king) of Nayanawah (Nineveh), and he qawam (rise up) from his kasaa (throne), and ibar (pass over/through) off his royal adarath (robe), kasah (covered) himself with sackcloth, and yashab (inhabit/dwell) in ashes.

He made a proclamation and amar (spoke) through Nayanawah (Nineveh) by the taim (decree) of the malak (king) and his gadawal (very great/important/mighty), amar (spoke), Let neither adam (man) nor animal, baqar (morning) nor tzaan (flock), taim (taste) anything; let them not raih (feed), nor shathah (drinks) mayam (Waters);

But let them be kasah (covered) with sackcloth, both adam (man) and animal, and let them qaraa (called) chazaqah (mightily) to Alahayam. Yes, let them shawab (turn back / repent) everyone from his rai (evil) darak (way), and from the chamas (violence) that is in his kap (hands).

Who yadai (knows) whether Alahayam will not shawab (turn back / repent) and relent, and shawab (turn back / repent) shawab (turn back / repent) from his charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), so that we might not abad (destroy/perish)?

Alahayam raah (see) their maishah (works), that they shawab (turn back / repent) from their rai (evil) darak (way). Alahayam relented of the disaster which he dabar (word / matter) he would ishah (make) to them, and he didn't ishah (make) it.
But it displeased Yawanah (Jonah) gadawal (very great/important/mighty), and he was charah (hot with anger).

He palal (prayed) to Yahawah, and amar (spoke), Please, Yahawah, wasn't this dabar (word / matter) I said when I was still in my own adamah (country)? Therefore I hurried to flee to Tharashayash (Tarshish), for I yadai (knew) that you are a chanawan (gracious) Al, and rachawam (merciful), arak (slow) to ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), and abundant in loving chasad (grace), and you relent of doing rai (harm).
Therefore now, Yahawah, laqach (take / seized), I beg you, my napash (living being/soul) from me; for it is tawab (pleasant/functional) for me to mawath (death) than to chay (life).
Yahawah amar (spoke), Is it right for you to be charah (hot with anger)?

Then Yawanah (Jonah) yatzaa (go out / come out) out of the iyar (city), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the qadam (east) side of the iyar (city), and there ishah (make) himself a sakah (booth), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) under it in the tzal (shade), until he might raah (see) what would become of the iyar (city).

Yahawah Alahayam manah (prepared) a vine, and ilah (go up / offer) it to come up over Yawanah (Jonah), that it might be a tzal (shade) over his raash (head), to natzal (deliver) him from his discomfort. So he was gadawal (very great/important/mighty) shamach (glad) because of the vine.
But Alahayam manah (prepared) a thawalai (worm) at dawn the next macharath (day), and it chewed on the vine, so that it yabash (dry land).

It happened, when the shamash (sun) arose, that Alahayam manah (prepared) a sultry qadayam (east) rawach (spirit / wind); and the shamash (sun) nakah (beat) on Yawanah (Jonah's) raash (head), so that he ilap (fainted), and shaal (requested) for himself that he might mawath (death), and amar (spoke), It is tawab (pleasant/functional) for me to mawath (death) than to chay (life).
Alahayam amar (spoke) to Yawanah (Jonah), "Is it right for you to be charah (hot with anger) about the vine?" He amar (spoke), I am right to be charah (hot with anger), even to mawath (death).
Yahawah amar (spoke), You have been concerned for the vine, for which you have not labored, neither gadal (made) it grow; which ban (son) up in a night, and abad (destroy/perish) in a ban (son).

Shouldn't I be concerned for Nayanawah (Nineveh), that gadawal (very great/important/mighty) iyar (city), in which are more than one hundred shanayam (two) rabaw (thousand) adam (persons) who can't yadai (discern) between their right yamayan (right hand) and their left shamaawal (left hand); and also much livestock?

The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah that came to Mayakah (Micah) the Morashtite in the yawam (day) of Yawatham (Jotham), Achaz (Ahaz), and Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), which he chazah (saw) concerning Shamarawan (Samaria) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Shamai (hearken / hear), you im (people / nation), all of you. Listen, O aratz (Earth/land), and malaa (all) that is therein: and let the Adanay Yahawah be id (witness) against you, the Adanay from his qadash (set apart/make holy) hayakal (temple).
For, behold, Yahawah yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of his maqawam (place), and will yarad (come) down and darak (tread) on the bamah (high) places of the aratz (Earth/land).

The har (mountain) masas (melt) under him, and the imaq (valleys) split apart, like dawanag (wax) panayam (before) the ash (fire), like mayam (Waters) that are nagar (poured) down a mawarad (steep) place.

All this is for the disobedience of Yaiqab (Jacob), and for the chataah (sin) of the bayath (house) of Yasharaal (Israel). What is the disobedience of Yaiqab (Jacob)? Isn't it Shamarawan (Samaria)? And what are the bamah (high) places of Yahawadah (Judah)? Aren't they Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)?

Therefore I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) Shamarawan (Samaria) like a rubble iy (heap) of the shadah (field), like places for planting karam (vineyards); and I will nagar (pour) down its aban (stone) into the gayaa (valley), and I will galah (uncover) its yasawad (foundations).

All her idols will be kathath (beaten) to pieces, and all her temple gifts will be sharap (burned) with ash (fire), and all her itzab (images) I will shamamah (destroy); for of the athanan (hire) of a prostitute has she qabatz (gathered) them, and to the athanan (hire) of a prostitute shall they shawab (turn back / repent).
For this I will sapad (lament) and wail; I will yalak (go) shawalal (stripped) and irawam (naked); I will howl like the jackals, and moan like the bath (daughter) of owls.
For her makah (wounds) are anash (incurable); for it bawaa (come) come even to Yahawadah (Judah). It reaches to the shair (gate) of my im (people / nation), even to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
Don't nagad (tell) it in gath (gath). Don't bakah (weep) at bakah (all). At Beth Ophrah I have palash (rolled) myself in the ipar (dust).

Ibar (pass over/through) on, yashab (inhabit/dwell) Shapayar (of) Shaphir, in nakedness and bashath (shame). The yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Tzaanan (Zaanan) won't yatzaa (go out / come out) out. The sapad (wailing) of bayathahaatzal (beth) Ezel will laqach (take / seized) from you his protection.

For the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Marawath (Maroth) chawal (waits) anxiously for tawab (pleasant/functional), because rai (evil) has yarad (come) down from Yahawah to the shair (gate) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Harness the marakabah (chariot) to the rakash (swift) steed, yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Lakayash (Lachish). She was the raashayath (beginning) of chataah (sin) to the bath (daughter) of Tzayawan (Zion); For the pashai (transgressions) of Yasharaal (Israel) were matzaa (found) in you.

Therefore you will nathan (give) a parting shalawach (gift) to Mawarashathagath (Moresheth) Gath. The bayath (house) of Akazayab (Achzib) will be a deceitful thing to the malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel).
I will yet bawaa (come) to you, yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Maraashah (Mareshah). He who is the kabawad (glory) of Yasharaal (Israel) will bawaa (come) to Idalam (Adullam).
Shave your heads, and gazaz (cut) off your hair for the ban (son) of your thainawag (delight). Enlarge your qarachah (baldness) like the vulture; for they have galah (gone) into captivity from you!

Haway (Alas/Woe!) To those who chashab (devise) awan (iniquity) and pail (work) rai (evil) on their mashakab (beds)! When the baqar (morning) is awar (light), they practice it, because it is in the al (power) of their yad (hand).

They chamad (covet) shadah (fields), and seize them; and bayath (house), and nashaa (lift) them away: and they ishaq (oppress) a gabar (man) and his bayath (house), even a ayash (husband/individual man) and his nachalah (heritage).

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Behold, I am planning against these mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) a disaster, from which you will not mawash (remove) your tzawaar (necks), neither will you yalak (walk) rawamah (haughtily); for it is an rai (evil) ith (time).

In that yawam (day) they will nashaa (lift) up a mashal (parable) against you, and nahah (lament) with a nahayah (doleful) nahay (lamentation), amar (spoke), ‘We are shadad (utterly) ruined! My im (people / nation) chalaq (possession) is divided up. Indeed he mawash (takes) it from me and assigns our shadah (fields) to traitors!’
Therefore you will have no shalak (one) who divides the chabal (land) by gawaral (lot) in the qahal (assembly) of Yahawah.
"Don't natap (prophesy)!" They natap (prophesy). Don't natap (prophesy) about these things. Disgrace won't overtake us.

Shall it be amar (spoke), O bayath (house) of Yaiqab (Jacob): Is the rawach (spirit / wind) of Yahawah angry? Are these his mailal (doings)? Don't my dabar (word / matter) do yatab (good) to him who halak (move) blamelessly?

But lately my im (people / nation) have qawam (rise up) up as an ayab (enemy). You pashat (strip) the adar (robe) and clothing from those who ibar (pass over/through) by without a batach (care), shawab (turn back / repent) from malachamah (battle).

You drive the ashah (wife/individual woman) of my im (people / nation) out from their thainawag (pleasant) bayath (house); from their young iwalal (children) you laqach (take / seized) away my hadar (glory / majesty / splendor) iwalam (forever).
Qawam (rise up), and depart! For this is not your manawachah (resting) place, because of uncleanness that chabal (destroys), even with a maratz (grievous) chabal (destruction).

If a ayash (husband/individual man) halak (move) in a rawach (spirit / wind) of falsehood kazab (lies): "I will natap (prophesy) to you of yayan (wine) and of shakar (strong) drink;" he would be the natap (prophet) of this im (people / nation).

I will asap (surely) asap (assemble), Yaiqab (Jacob), all of you; I will qabatz (surely) qabatz (gather) the shaarayath (remnant) of Yasharaal (Israel); I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) them yachad (together) as the tzaan (sheep) of batzarah (bozrah), as a idar (flock) in the thawak (midst) of their pasture; they will swarm with adam (people).

He who paratz (breaks) open the way ilah (go up / offer) up panayam (before) them. They paratz (break) ibar (pass over/through) the shair (gate), and yatzaa (go out / come out) out. And their malak (king) passes on panayam (before) them, with Yahawah at their raash (head).

I amar (spoke), Please shamai (hearken / hear), you raash (head) of Yaiqab (Jacob), and qatzayan (rulers) of the bayath (house) of Yasharaal (Israel): Isn't it for you to yadai (know) mashapat (justice)?
You who shanaa (hate) the tawab (pleasant/functional), and ahab (love) the rai (evil); who gazal (tear) off their iwar (skin), and their shaar (flesh) from off their itzam (bones);

Who also akal (eat) the shaar (flesh) of my im (people / nation), and pashat (flay) their iwar (skin) from off them, and patzach (break) their itzam (bones), and parash (chop) them in pieces, as for the sayar (pot), and as bashar (flesh) thawak (midst) the qalachath (caldron).

Then they will zaiq (cry) to Yahawah, but he will not inah (answer / respond) them. Yes, he will sathar (hide) his panayam (face) from them at that ith (time), because they made their deeds raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil).

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah concerning the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) who lead my im (people / nation) thaih (astray); for those who feed their shan (teeth), they qaraa (called), "shalawam (peace / safety)!" And whoever doesn't provide for their pah (mouths), they qadash (set apart/make holy) malachamah (war) against him:

Therefore layal (night) is over you, with no chazawan (vision), and it is chashak (darkness) to you, that you may not qasam (divine); and the shamash (sun) will bawaa (come) down on the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), and the yawam (day) will be qadar (black) over them.
The chazah (seers) shall be disappointed, and the diviners chapar (confounded). Yes, they shall all itah (cover) their shapam (lips); for there is no mainah (answer) from Alahayam.

But as for me, I am malaa (full) of kach (strength / mighty / power) by the rawach (spirit / wind) of Yahawah, and of mashapat (judgment), and of gabawarah (might), to nagad (declare) to Yaiqab (Jacob) his disobedience, and to Yasharaal (Israel) his chataah (sin).

Please shamai (hearken / hear) to this, you raash (head) of the bayath (house) of Yaiqab (Jacob), and qatzayan (rulers) of the bayath (house) of Yasharaal (Israel), who thaib (abhor) mashapat (justice), and iqash (pervert) all yashar (equity).
They banah (build) up Tzayawan (Zion) with dam (blood), and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) with iwal (iniquity).

Her leaders shapat (judge) for shachad (bribes), and her kahan (priest) yarah (teach) for a machayar (price), and her nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) of it tell fortunes for kasap (money): yet they shain (lean) on Yahawah, and amar (spoke), Isn't Yahawah in the qarab (among / near) of us? No disaster will bawaa (come) on us.

Therefore Tzayawan (Zion) for your sake will be charash (plowed) like a shadah (field), and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) will become iy (heaps) of rubble, and the har (mountain) of the bayath (house) like the bamah (high) places of a yair (forest).

But in the acharayath (latter) yawam (day), it will happen that the har (mountain) of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) bayath (house) will be kawan (established) on the raash (head) of the har (mountain), and it will be nashaa (lift) above the gabaih (hills); and im (people / nation) will stream to it.

Many gaway (nation / people) will halak (move) and amar (spoke), "yalak (come), and let us ilah (go up / offer) up to the har (mountain) of Yahawah, and to the bayath (house) of the Alahayam of Yaiqab (Jacob); and he will yarah (teach) us of his darak (ways), and we will yalak (walk) in his arach (paths)." For out of Tzayawan (Zion) will yatzaa (go out / come out) forth the thawarah (instruction), and the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem);

And he will shapat (judge) between many im (people / nation), and will decide concerning itzawam (strong) gaway (nation / people) rachawaq (afar) off. They will kathath (beat) their charab (sword) into ath (entirety), and their chanayath (spears) into mazamarah (pruning) hooks. Gaway (nation / people) will not nashaa (lift) up charab (sword) against gaway (nation / people), neither will they lamad (teach/instruct) malachamah (war) any more.

But they will yashab (inhabit/dwell) every ayash (husband/individual man) under his gapan (vine) and under his thaan (fig) tree; and no one will make them charad (afraid): For the pah (mouth) of Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) has dabar (word / matter).
Indeed all the im (people / nation) may yalak (walk) in the sham (name) of their Alahayam; but we will yalak (walk) in the sham (name) of Yahawah our Alahayam iwalam (forever) and id (ever).

"In that yawam (day)," naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, I will asap (assemble) that which is lame, and I will qabatz (gather) that which is nadach (driven) away, and that which I have raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil);

And I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) that which was lame a shaarayath (remnant), and that which was halaa (cast) far off a itzawam (strong) gaway (nation / people): and Yahawah will malak (king) over them on har (mountain) Tzayawan (Zion) from then on, even iwalam (forever).

You, magadal (tower) of the idar (flock), the hill of the bath (daughter) of Tzayawan (Zion), to you it will athah (come), yes, the raashawan (former) mamashalah (dominion) will bawaa (come), the mamalakah (kingdom) of the bath (daughter) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Now why do you rawai (cry) out rai (aloud)? Is there no malak (king) in you? Has your yaitz (counselor) abad (destroy/perish), that chayal (pains) have chazaq (taken) hold of you as of a yalad (birth / begot) in travail?

Be in chawal (pain), and gayach (labor) to bring forth, bath (daughter) of Tzayawan (Zion), like a yalad (birth / begot) in travail; for now you will yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of the qarayah (city), and will shakan (dwell) in the shadah (field), and will come even to Babal (Babylon). There you will be natzal (rescued). There Yahawah will gaal (redeem) you from the kap (hand) of your ayab (enemy).
Now many gaway (nation / people) have asap (assembled) amar (spoke) you, that say, Let her be chanap (defiled), and let our iyan (eye) gloat over Tzayawan (Zion).

But they don't yadai (know) the machashabah (thoughts) of Yahawah, neither do they bayan (between) his itzah (counsel); for he has qabatz (gathered) them like the sheaves to the garan (threshing) floor.

Qawam (rise up) and dawash (thresh), bath (daughter) of Tzayawan (Zion); for I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) your qaran (horn) barazal (iron), and I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) your parasah (hoofs) nachawashah (brass); and you will daqaq (beat) in pieces many im (people / nation): and I will charam (devote) their batzai (gain) to Yahawah, and their chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) to the Adawan of the whole aratz (Earth/land).
Now you shall gather yourself in troops, daughter of troops. He has yatzaa (go out / come out) siege against us. They will strike the judge of Yasharaal (Israel) with a rod on the cheek.

But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will nathan (give) forth to me that is to be ruler in Yasharaal (Israel); whose shawab (turn back / repent) forth are from of ban (son), from everlasting.
Therefore he will abandon them until the ithah (now / present moment) that she who is in labor gives birth. Then the rest of his brothers will yashab (inhabit/dwell) to the children of Israel.

He shall qawam (rise up), and shall raih (shepherd) in the strength of Yahawah, in the majesty of the name of Yahawah his Alahayam: and they will live, for then he will be shalawam (peace / safety) to the ends of the aratz (Earth/land).

He will be our peace when Ashawar (Assyria) bawaa (come) our aratz (Earth/land), and when he marches through our fortresses, then we will raise against him seven raih (shepherds), and eight leaders of men.
They will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in its gates. He will deliver us from the Ban (Assyrian), when he invades our land, and when he marches within our border.

The shaarayath (remnant) of Yaiqab (Jacob) will be in the qarab (among / near) of many im (people / nation), like dew from Yahawah, like showers on the grass, that don't wait for rab (man), nor wait for the sons of im (people / nation).

The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the animals of the forest, like a young lion among the flocks of sheep; who, if he rawam (will lift up) through, treads down and tears in pieces, and there is no one to deliver.
Let your hand be lifted up above your adversaries, and let all of your enemies be karath (cut) off.
"It will happen in that day," says Yahawah, That I will karath (cut) off your horses out of the midst of you, and will karath (cut) your chariots.
I will karath (cut) off the cities of your land, and will tear down all your strongholds.
I will karath (cut) witchcraft from your yad (hand); and you shall have no soothsayers.
I will cut off your engraved images and your pillars out of your qarab (among / near); and you shall no more worship the work of your hands.
I will uproot your Asherim out of your midst; and I will destroy your cities.
I will ishah (make) naqam (vengeance) in ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), and chamah (wrath) on the gaway (nation / people) that didn't shamai (hearken / hear).
Shamai (hearken / hear) now to what Yahawah amar (spoke): qawam (rise up), rayab (plead) your case before the har (mountain), and let the gabaih (hills) shamai (hearken / hear) what you have to say.

Shamai (hearken / hear), you har (mountain), yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) rayab (controversy), and you enduring mawasadah (foundations) of the aratz (Earth/land); for Yahawah has a rayab (controversy) with his im (people / nation), and he will contend with Yasharaal (Israel).
My im (people / nation), what ishah (make) I done to you? How have I burdened you? Inah (answer / respond) me!

For I ilah (go up / offer) you up out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and padah (redeemed) you out of the bayath (house) of ibad (servant). I shalach (send) panayam (before) you Mashah (Moses), Aharawan (Aaron), and Marayam (Miriam).

My im (people / nation), zakar (remembrance/memory) now what Balaq (Balak) malak (king) of Mawaab (Moab) yaitz (devised), and what Balaim (Balaam) the ban (son) of Baiwar (Beor) inah (answer / respond) him from Shatayam (Shittim) to Galagal (Gilgal), that you may yadai (know) the tzadaqah (righteousness) acts of Yahawah.
How shall I qadam (come) before Yahawah, and kapap (bow) myself before the exalted Alahayam? Shall I qadam (come) before him with burnt ilah (offerings), with calves a shanah (year) ban (son)?

Will Yahawah be ratzah (pleased) with alap (thousands) of ayal (rams)? With rababah (tens) of thousands of nachal (stream / river) of shaman (oil)? Shall I nathan (give) my bakawar (firstborn) for my disobedience? The paray (fruit) of my batan (body) for the chataah (sin) of my napash (living being/soul)?

He has shown you, O adam (man), what is tawab (pleasant/functional). What does Yahawah darash (require) of you, but to act justly, to ahabah (love) chasad (grace), and to yalak (walk) tzanai (humbly) with your Alahayam?

Yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) qawal (sound / voice) qaraa (called) to the iyar (city), and thawashayah (wisdom) yaraa (fear / be afraid) your sham (name): shamai (hearken / hear) to the matah (staff / rod / tribe), and he who yaid (appointed) it.
Are there yet awatzar (treasures) of rashai (wickedness) in the bayath (house) of the rashai (wicked), and a short ayapah (ephah) that is accursed?
Shall I be zakah (pure) with dishonest scales, and with a kayas (bag) of deceitful aban (stone)?
Her ishayar (rich) men are malaa (full) of chamas (violence), her yashab (inhabit/dwell) dabar (word / matter) shaqar (lies), and their lashawan (tongue/language) is deceitful in their pah (speech).
Therefore I also have struck you with a grievous nakah (wound). I have shamam (made) you desolate because of your chataah (sin).

You shall akal (eat), but not be shabai (satisfied). Your humiliation will be in your qarab (among / near). You will store up, but not palat (save); and that which you palat (save) I will nathan (give) up to the charab (sword).

You will zarai (sow), but won't qatzar (reap). You will darak (tread) the zayath (olive), but won't sawak (anoint) yourself with shaman (oil); and thayarawash (crush) grapes, but won't shathah (drinks) the thayarawash (wine).

For the chaqah (statutes) of Imaray (Omri) are shamar (keep/guard), and all the maishah (works) of the bayath (house) of Achaab (Ahab). You yalak (walk) in their mawaitzah (counsels), that I may nathan (give) you a ruin, and her yashab (inhabit/dwell) a sharaqah (hissing); And you will nashaa (lift) the charapah (reproach) of my im (people / nation).

Misery is mine! Indeed, I am like asap (one) who gathers the qayatz (summer) fruits, as gleanings of the vineyard: There is no ashakawal (cluster) of grapes to akal (eat). My napash (living being/soul) awah (desires) to eat the early fig.

The chasayad (godly) man abad (destroy/perish) perished out of the aratz (Earth/land), and there is no one yashar (upright) among adam (men). They all lie in arab (wait) for dam (blood); every ayash (husband/individual man) tzawad (hunts) his ach (brother/kinsman) with a charam (net).

Their kap (hands) are on that which is rai (evil) to yatab (do) it diligently. The shar (prince / ruler) and shapat (judge) shaal (ask) for a bribe; and the powerful dabar (word / matter) dictates the hawah (calamity/destruction) napash (living being/soul) of his ibath (soul). Thus they conspire together.

The tawab (pleasant/functional) of them is like a chadaq (brier). The most yashar (upright) is worse than a masawakah (thorn) hedge. The yawam (day) of your watchmen, even your paqadah (visitation), bawaa (come) come; now is the time of their mabawakah (confusion).

Don't aman (believe / have faith) in a neighbor. Don't batach (put) confidence in a rai (neigbor/another person). With the shakab (woman) lying in your embrace, be careful of the pathach (words) of your pah (mouth)!

For the ban (son) dishonors the ab (father), the bath (daughter) qawam (rise up) up against her am (mother), the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; a ayash (husband/individual man) ayab (enemy) are the ban (son) of his own bayath (house).
But as for me, I will tzapah (watchman / keep watch) to Yahawah. I will yachal (wait) for the Alahayam of my yashai (salvation). My Alahayam will shamai (hearken / hear) me.

Don't shamach (rejoice) against me, my ayab (enemy). When I napal (fall / be cast down), I will qawam (rise up). When I yashab (inhabit/dwell) in chashak (darkness), Yahawah will be a awar (light) to me.

I will nashaa (lift) the zaip (indignation) of Yahawah, because I have chataa (sinned) against him, until he rayab (pleads) my case, and ishah (make) mashapat (judgment) for me. He will yatzaa (go out / come out) me forth to the awar (light). I will raah (see) his tzadaqah (righteousness).

Then my ayab (enemy) will raah (see) it, and bawashah (shame) will kasah (cover) her who amar (spoke) to me, where is Yahawah your Alahayam? Then my enemy will raah (see) me and will cover her shame. Now she will be maramas (trodden) down like the tayat (mire) of the chawatz (streets).
A yawam (day) to banah (build) your gadar (walls)— In that yawam (day), he will extend your boundary.

In that yawam (day) they will bawaa (come) to you from Ashawar (Assyria) and the iyar (cities) Matzawar (of) Egypt, and Matzawar (from) Egypt even to the nahar (river), and from yam (sea/waters) to yam (sea/waters), and har (mountain) to har (mountain).
Yet the aratz (Earth/land) will be shamamah (desolate) because of those who live in it, for the paray (fruit) of their mailal (doings).

Raih (shepherd) your im (people / nation) with your shabat (staff), the tzaan (flock) of your nachalah (heritage), who live by themselves in a yair (forest), in the thawak (midst) Karamal (of) fertile pasture land, let them raih (feed); in Bashan (Bashan) and Galaid (Gilead), as in the yawam (day) of iwalam (forever).
As in the yawam (day) of your yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), I will show them palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) things.

The gaway (nation / people) will raah (see) and be bawash (ashamed) of all their gabawarah (might). They will shawam (place / establish / appoint) their yad (hand) on their pah (mouth). Their azan (ears) will be charash (deaf).

They will lachak (lick) the ipar (dust) like a nachash (serpent). Like crawling things of the aratz (Earth/land) they shall come ragaz (trembling) out of their dens. They will come with yaraa (fear / be afraid) to Yahawah our Alahayam, and will be yaraa (fear / be afraid) because of you.

Who is a Al like you, who nashaa (lift) iwan (guilt/iniquity), and passes over the disobedience of the shaarayath (remnant) of his nachalah (heritage)? He doesn't chazaq (retain) his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) id (forever), because he chapatz (delights) in loving chasad (grace).

He will again racham (have) compassion on us. He will tread our iwan (guilt/iniquity) under foot; and you will shalak (cast) all their chataah (sin) into the matzawalah (depths) of the yam (sea/waters).
You will nathan (give) amath (truth) to Yaiqab (Jacob), and chasad (grace) to Abaraham (Abraham), as you have shabai (swear / take oath) to our ab (father) from the yawam (day) of qadam (old).
An oracle about Nayanawah (Nineveh). The sapar (book / scribed document) of the chazawan (vision) of Nachawam (Nahum) the alaqashay (elkoshite).

Yahawah is a qanawaa (jealous) Al and naqam (avenges). Yahawah naqam (avenges) and is full of bail (wrath). Yahawah naqam (takes) vengeance on his tzar (oppressor / distressor), and he maintains wrath against his ayab (enemy).

Yahawah is arak (slow) to ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), and gadawal (very great/important/mighty) in kach (strength / mighty / power), and will by no naqah (clean/innocent) leave the guilty naqah (clean/innocent). Yahawah has his darak (way) in the sawapah (whirlwind) and in the shairah (storm), and the inan (cloud) are the abaq (dust) of his ragal (feet / foot).

He gair (rebukes) the yam (sea/waters), and charab (makes) it dry, and yabash (dry land) up all the nahar (rivers). Bashan (Bashan) languishes, and Karamal (Carmel); and the parach (flower) of Labanawan (Lebanon) languishes.

The har (mountain) raish (quake) before him, and the gabaih (hills) mawag (melt) away. The aratz (Earth/land) trembles at his panayam (presence), yes, the thabal (world), and all who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in it.

Who can imad (stand) panayam (before) his zaim (indignation)? Who can qawam (rise up) the charawan (fierceness) of his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting)? His chamah (wrath) is nathak (poured) out like ash (fire), and the tzawar (rocks) are nathatz (broken) apart by him.
Yahawah is tawab (pleasant/functional), a stronghold in the yawam (day) of tzarah (trouble); and he yadai (knows) those who take chasah (refuge) in him.
But with an overflowing shatap (flood), he will ishah (make) a kalah (complete / finish) end of her maqawam (place), and will radap (pursue) his ayab (enemy) into chashak (darkness).
What do you plot against Yahawah? He will ishah (make) a kalah (complete / finish) end. Tzarah (affliction) won't qawam (rise up) up the paim (second) time.
For entangled like sayar (thorns), and drunken as with their sabaa (drink), they are akal (eat) utterly like yabash (dry land) qash (stubble).
There is one yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of you, who chashab (devises) rai (evil) against Yahawah, who yaitz (counsels) balayail (wickedness).

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Though they be in shalam (full / whole / complete) strength, and likewise many, even so they will be gazaz (cut) down, and he shall ibar (pass over/through) away. Though I have inah (oppress / afflict) you, I will inah (oppress / afflict) you no more.
Now will I shabar (break) his mawat (yoke) from off you, and will nathaq (burst) your mawasar (bonds) apart.

Yahawah has tzawah (commanded) concerning you: No more descendants will bear your sham (name). Out of the bayath (house) of your Alahayam, will I karath (cut) off the engraved pasal (idol/graven image) and the masakah (molten) image. I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) your qabar (grave / tomb / sepulcher), for you are qalal (vile).

Behold, on the har (mountain) the ragal (feet / foot) of him who brings bashar (good) news, who publishes shalawam (peace / safety)! Chagag (keep) your chag (feast/festival), Yahawadah (Judah)! Shalam (perform) your nadar (vow), for the balayail (wicked) yasap (one) will no more ibar (pass over/through) through you. He is karath (cut) cut off.
He who dashes in pieces has yasap (come) up il (over) you. Chagag (keep) the fortress! Watch the ibar (pass over/through)! Strengthen your waist! Fortify your power mightily!
For Yahawah ilah (go up / offer) the excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Israel; for the destroyers have destroyed them, and ruined their vine branches.
The shield of his mighty men is shawab (turn back / repent) red. The valiant men are in scarlet. The chariots flash with steel in the day of his preparation, and the pine spears are brandished.
The rakab (chariots) rage in the streets. They rush back and forth in the broad ways. Their appearance is like torches. They run like the lightnings.
He summons his picked troops. They stumble on their way. They dash to its wall, and the protective shield is put in place.
The gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace is dissolved.
It is decreed: she is uncovered, she is carried away; and her handmaids moan as with the voice of doves, beating on their breasts.
But Nineveh has been from of old like a pool of water, yet they flee away. "Stop! Stop!" They cry, but no one looks back.
Take the spoil of silver. Take the spoil of gold, for there is no yawam (day) of the store, the glory of all goodly furniture.
She is empty, void, and waste. The heart melts, the knees knock together, their bodies and faces have grown pale.
Where is the den of the lions, and the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion and the lioness walked, the lion's cubs, and no one made them afraid?
The aray (lion) tore in pieces enough for his cubs, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his caves with the kill, and his maiwan (dens) with prey.

"Behold, I am against you," says Yahawah of Armies, and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword will devour your young aray (lions); and I will cut off your tarap (prey) from the earth, and the voice of your messengers will no longer be heard.
Haway (Alas/Woe!) To the bloody iyar (city)! It is all full of kachash (lies) and paraq (robbery). The tarap (prey) doesn't depart.
The qawal (sound / voice) of the shawat (whip), the qawal (sound / voice) of the raish (rattling) of awapan (wheels), prancing sawas (horses), and bounding marakabah (chariots),

The parash (horseman) ilah (go up / offer), and the flashing charab (sword), the baraq (glittering) chanayath (spear), and a rab (multitude) of chalal (slain), and a kabad (great) heap of pagar (corpses), and there is no qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the pagar (bodies). They kashal (stumble / stagger) on their gawayah (corpse),

Because of the rab (multitude) of the prostitution of the alluring prostitute, the bailah (mistress) of kashap (witchcraft), who makar (sells) gaway (nation / people) through her prostitution, and mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) through her kashap (witchcraft).

"Behold, I am against you," naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), and I will lift your shawal (skirts) over your panayam (face). I will show the gaway (nation / people) your mair (nakedness), and the mamalakah (kingdoms) your qalawan (shame).
I will shalak (throw) shaqawatz (abominable) filth on you, and nabal (make) you vile, and will shawam (place / establish / appoint) you a spectacle.

It will happen that all those who raah (see) at you will nadad (flee) from you, and amar (spoke), ‘Nayanawah (Nineveh) is laid shadad (waste)! Who will nawad (mourn) for her?’ Ayan (where) will I baqash (seek) comforters for you?

Are you yatab (better) Naa (than) No - Amon, who was situated among the yaar (rivers), who had the mayam (Waters) around her; whose chayal (rampart) was the yam (sea/waters), and her chawamah (wall) was of the yam (sea/waters)?
Kawash (Cush) and Matzarayam (Egypt) were her boundless itzamah (strength). Pawat (Put) and Libya were her helpers.

Yet was she carried away. She halak (move) into shabay (captivity). Her young iwalal (children) also were ratash (dashed) in pieces at the raash (head) of all the chawatz (streets), and they yadad (cast) gawaral (lots) for her honorable men, and all her gadawal (very great/important/mighty) men were rathaq (bound) in zayaqah (chains).
You also will be shakar (drunken). You will be ilam (hidden). You also will baqash (seek) a stronghold because of the ayab (enemy).
All your fortresses will be like thaan (fig) trees with the first-ripe figs: if they are nawai (shaken), they napal (fall / be cast down) into the pah (mouth) of the eater.

Behold, your troops in your qarab (among / near) are ashah (wife/individual woman). The shair (gates) of your aratz (Earth/land) are pathach (set) wide pathach (open) to your ayab (enemy). The ash (fire) has akal (eat) your barayach (bars).
Shaab (draw) mayam (Waters) for the matzawar (siege). Chazaq (strengthen) your fortresses. Bawaa (come) into the tayat (clay), and ramas (tread) the mortar. Make the brick kiln chazaq (strong).
There the ash (fire) will akal (eat) you. The charab (sword) will karath (cut) you off. It will akal (eat) you like the grasshopper. Multiply like grasshoppers. Multiply like the arabah (locust).
You rabah (have) increased your rakal (merchants) more than the kawakab (star) of the skies. The grasshopper pashat (strips), and iwap (flying) away.

Your guards are like the arabah (locusts), and your officials like the swarms of locusts, which settle on the gadarah (walls) on a qarah (cold) yawam (day), but when the shamash (sun) appears, they nadad (flee) away, and their maqawam (place) is not yadai (known) ay (where) they are.

Your raih (shepherds) nawam (slumber), malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria). Your adayar (nobles) lie down. Your im (people / nation) are pawash (scattered) on the har (mountain), and there is no one to qabatz (gather) them.

There is no kahah (healing) your wound, for your injury is fatal. All who shamai (hearken / hear) the shamai (report) of you thaqai (blow / sound alarm) their kap (hands) over you; for who hasn't felt your endless cruelty?
The oracle which Chabaqawaq (Habakkuk) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) chazah (saw).
Yahawah, how long will I shawai (cry), and you will not shamai (hearken / hear)? I zaiq (cry) out to you "chamas (violence)!" And will you not yashai (salvation)?
Why do you show me awan (iniquity), and nabat (look) at perversity? For shad (destruction) and chamas (violence) are before me. There is rayab (strife), and madawan (contention) nashaa (lift) up.

Therefore the thawarah (instruction) is paralyzed, and mashapat (justice) never yatzaa (go out / come out) forth; for the rashai (wicked) surround the tzadayaq (righteous); therefore mashapat (justice) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth perverted.

Raah (see) among the gaway (nation / people), watch, and thamah (wonder) thamah (marvelously); for I am pail (working) a pail (work) in your yawam (day), which you will not aman (believe / have faith) though it is sapar (book) you.

For, behold, I qawam (rise up) up the Kashaday (Chaldeans), that mar (bitter) and mahar (hasty) gaway (nation / people), that halak (move) through the marachab (breadth) of the aratz (Earth/land), to yarash (possess) mashakan (dwelling) places that are not theirs.
They are feared and yaraa (fear / be afraid). Their mashapat (judgment) and their shaath (dignity) yatzaa (go out / come out) from themselves.

Their sawas (horses) also are qalal (swifter) than namar (leopards), and are more chadad (fierce) than the irab (evening) wolves. Their horsemen press proudly on. Yes, their horsemen bawaa (come) from rachawaq (afar). They iwap (flying) as an nashar (eagle) that hurries to akal (eat).
All of them bawaa (come) for chamas (violence). Their hordes panayam (face) the desert. He asap (gathers) shabay (prisoners) like chawal (sand).
Yes, he qalas (scoffs) at malak (king), and razan (princes) are a derision to him. He shachaq (laughs) at every stronghold, for he builds up an earthen ramp, and lakad (takes) it.
Then he sweeps by like the rawach (spirit / wind), and ibar (pass over/through) on. He is indeed asham (guilty), whose kach (strength / mighty / power) is his Alawah.

Aren't you from qadam (everlasting), Yahawah my Alahayam, my qadawash (holy) One? We will not mawath (death). Yahawah, you have shawam (place / establish / appoint) him for mashapat (judgment). You, tzawar (rock), have yasad (established) him to punish.

You who have purer iyan (eye) than to raah (see) rai (evil), and who cannot nabat (look) on perversity, why do you tolerate those who bagad (deal) treacherously, and charash (keep) silent when the rashai (wicked) balai (swallows) up the man who is more tzadayaq (righteous) than he,
And ishah (make) adam (men) like the dag (fish) of the yam (sea/waters), like the ramash (creeping) things, that mashal (rule/have dominion) no ruler over them?
He ilah (go up / offer) up all of them with the chakah (hook). He catches them in his charam (net), and asap (gathers) them in his dragnet. Therefore he shamach (rejoices) and is gayal (glad).
Therefore he zabach (sacrifices) to his charam (net), and qatar (burns) incense to his dragnet, because by them his chalaq (life) is luxurious, and his food is barayaa (good).
Will he therefore continually rawaq (empty) his charam (net), and harag (kill) the gaway (nation / people) without chamal (mercy)?

I will imad (stand) at my mashamarath (duty / watch), and yatzab (set) myself on the ramparts, and will raah (see) out to raah (see) what he will dabar (word / matter) to me, and what I will shawab (turn back / repent) concerning my complaint.
Yahawah inah (answer / respond) me, kathab (write) the chazawan (vision), and make it baar (plain) on tablets, that he who rawatz (runs) may qaraa (called) it.

For the chazawan (vision) is yet for the mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) time, and it hurries toward the qatz (end), and won't prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it; because it will bawaa (come) bawaa (come). It won't achar (other).
Behold, his napash (living being/soul) is puffed up. It is not yashar (upright) in him, but the tzadayaq (righteous) will chayah (live) by his amawanah (faith).

Yes, moreover, yayan (wine) is bagad (treacherous). A yahayar (haughty) gabar (man) who doesn't stay at nawah (habitation), who enlarges his napash (living being/soul) as shaawal (Shaawal/afterlife), and he is like mawath (death), and can't be shabai (satisfied), but asap (gathers) to himself all gaway (nation / people), and qabatz (heaps) to himself all im (people / nation).

Won't all these nashaa (lift) up a mashal (parable) against him, and a malayatzah (taunting) chayadah (proverb) amar (spoke) him, and say, ‘haway (Alas/Woe!) To him who rabah (increases) that which is not his, and who enriches himself by extortion! How long?’
Won't your debtors qawam (rise up) up pathai (suddenly), and wake up those who make you zawai (tremble), and you will be their victim?

Because you have plundered many gaway (nation / people), all the yathar (remnant) of the im (people / nation) will plunder you, because of adam (men's) dam (blood), and for the chamas (violence) done to the aratz (Earth/land), to the qarayah (city) and to all who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in it.

Haway (Alas/Woe!) To him who batzai (gets) an rai (evil) batzai (gain) for his bayath (house), that he may shawam (place / establish / appoint) his qan (nest) on marawam (high), that he may be natzal (delivered) from the kap (hand) of rai (evil)!
You have yaitz (devised) bashath (shame) to your bayath (house), by qatzah (end / extremity / border) off many im (people / nation), and have chataa (sinned) against your napash (living being/soul).
For the aban (stone) will zaiq (cry) out of the qayar (wall), and the beam out of the woodwork will inah (answer / respond) it.
Haway (Alas/Woe!) To him who banah (builds) a iyar (town) with dam (blood), and establishes a qarayah (city) by iwal (iniquity)!
Behold, isn't it of Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) that the im (people / nation) yagai (labor) for the ash (fire), and the laam (nations) yaip (weary) themselves for rayaq (vanity)?
For the aratz (Earth/land) will be malaa (filled) with the yadai (knowledge) of the kabawad (glory) of Yahawah, as the mayam (Waters) kasah (cover) the yam (sea/waters).
Haway (Alas/Woe!) To him who gives his neighbor shaqah (drink), pouring your inflaming chamath (wine) until they are shakar (drunk), so that you may gaze at their naked bodies!

You are shabai (filled) with qalawan (shame), and not kabawad (glory). You will also shathah (drinks), and be exposed! The kawas (cup) of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) right yamayan (right hand) will sabab (come) around to you, and disgrace will cover your kabawad (glory).

For the chamas (violence) done to Labanawan (Lebanon) will kasah (overwhelm) you, and the shad (destruction) of the animals, which made them chathath (afraid); because of adam (men's) dam (blood), and for the chamas (violence) done to the aratz (Earth/land), to every qarayah (city) and to those who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in them.

What value does the engraved pasal (idol/graven image) have, that its yatzar (maker) has engraved it; the masakah (molten) image, even the teacher of shaqar (lies), that he who yatzar (fashions) its form batach (trusts) in it, to ishah (make) mute alayal (idols)?

Haway (Alas/Woe!) To him who amar (spoke) to the itz (wood), ‘qawatz (awake)!’ Or to the mute aban (stone), ‘Arise!’ Shall this yarah (teach)? Behold, it is overlaid with zahab (gold) and kasap (silver), and there is no rawach (spirit / wind) at all in its qarab (among / near).
But Yahawah is in his qadash (set apart/make holy) hayakal (temple). Let all the aratz (Earth/land) be hasah (silent) panayam (before) him!
A thapalah (prayer) of Chabaqawaq (Habakkuk), the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), Shagayawan (set) to victorious music.

Yahawah, I have shamai (hearken / hear) of your shamai (fame). I stand in awe of your pail (deeds), Yahawah. Renew your pail (work) in the qarab (among / near) of the shanah (years). In the qarab (among / near) of the shanah (years) yadai (make) it known. In ragaz (wrath), you zakar (remembrance/memory) racham (mercy).

Alawah bawaa (come) from Thayaman (Teman), the qadawash (holy) One from har (mountain) Paaran (Paran). Salah (selah). His glory kasah (covered) the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), and his thahalah (praise) malaa (filled) the aratz (Earth/land).
His splendor is like the sunrise. Rays shine from his yad (hand), where his iz (strength / might / refuge) is hidden.
Dabar (word / matter) yalak (went) panayam (before) him, and pestilence followed his ragal (feet / foot).

He imad (stood), and shook the aratz (Earth/land). He raah (see), and made the gaway (nation / people) tremble. The ancient harar (mountains) were crumbled. The age-old gabaih (hills) collapsed. His halayakah (ways) are iwalam (forever).
I raah (see) the ahal (tents) of Kawashan (Cushan) in awan (affliction). The dwellings of the aratz (Earth/land) of Madayan (Midian) ragaz (trembled).

Was Yahawah charah (hot with anger) with the nahar (rivers)? Was your ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) against the nahar (rivers), or your ibarah (wrath) against the yam (sea/waters), that you rakab (rode) on your sawas (horses), on your marakabah (chariots) of yashawaih (salvation)?
You uncovered your qashath (bow). You called for your shabawaih (sworn) arrows. Salah (selah). You split the aratz (Earth/land) with nahar (rivers).

The har (mountain) raah (see) you, and were afraid. The zaram (storm) of mayam (Waters) ibar (pass over/through) by. The thahawam (depths) roared and nashaa (lift) up its yad (hand) on rawam (will lift up).

The shamash (sun) and yarach (moon) imad (stood) still in the sky, at the awar (light) of your chatz (arrows) as they halak (move), at the nagah (shining) of your baraq (glittering) chanayath (spear).
You tzaid (marched) through the aratz (Earth/land) in zaim (wrath). You dawash (threshed) the gaway (nation / people) in ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting).

You yatzaa (go out / come out) forth for the yashai (salvation) of your im (people / nation), for the yashai (salvation) of your mashayach (anointed one). You crushed the raash (head) of the bayath (house) of rashai (wickedness). You stripped them tzawaar (head) to yasawad (foot). Salah (selah).
You naqab (pierced) the raash (head) of his warriors with their own spears. They sair (came) as a whirlwind to pawatz (scatter) me, gloating as if to akal (eat) the wretched in masathar (secret).
You trampled the yam (sea/waters) with your sawas (horses), churning rab (mighty) mayam (Waters).

I shamai (hearken / hear), and my batan (body) ragaz (trembled). My shapah (lips) tzalal (quivered) at the qawal (sound / voice). Raqab (rottenness) bawaa (come) into my itzam (bones), and I ragaz (tremble) in my place, because I must wait quietly for the yawam (day) of tzarah (trouble), for the ilah (go up / offer) up of the im (people / nation) who gawad (invade) us.

For though the thaan (fig) tree doesn't parach (flourish), nor yabawal (fruit) be in the gapan (vines); the maishah (labor) of the zayath (olive) kachash (fails), the shadamah (fields) ishah (make) no akal (food); the tzaan (flocks) are gazar (cut) off from the makalaah (fold), and there is no baqar (morning) in the rapath (stalls):
Yet I will ilaz (rejoice) in Yahawah. I will be gayal (joyful) in the Alahayam of my yashai (salvation)!

Yahawah, the Adanay, is my chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor). He shawam (place / establish / appoint) my ragal (feet / foot) like deer's feet, and enables me to darak (go) in bamah (high) places. For the music director, on my nagayanah (stringed) instruments.

The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah which came to Tzapanayah (Zephaniah), the ban (son) of Kawashay (Cushi), the ban (son) of Gadalayah (Gedaliah), the ban (son) of Amarayah (Amariah), the ban (son) of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), in the yawam (day) of Yaashayah (Josiah), the ban (son) of Amawan (Amon), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah).
I will asap (utterly) sweep away everything off of the surface of the panayam (earth), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

I will sweep away adam (man) and animal. I will sweep away the iwap (flying) of the sky, the dag (fish) of the yam (sea/waters), and the heaps of rubble with the rashai (wicked). I will karath (cut) off adam (man) from the surface of the adamah (earth), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

I will natah (stretch) out my yad (hand) against Yahawadah (Judah), and against all the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). I will karath (cut) off the shaar (remnant) of Bail (Baal) from this maqawam (place): the sham (name) of the idolatrous and pagan kahan (priest),
Those who shachah (worship) the tzabaa (troop) of the sky on the housetops, those who shachah (worship) and shabai (swear / take oath) by Yahawah and also shabai (swear / take oath) by Malcam,
Those who have sawag (turned) back from following Yahawah, and those who haven't baqash (sought) Yahawah nor darash (inquired) after him.

Be hasah (silent) at the panayam (presence) of the Adanay Yahawah, for the yawam (day) of Yahawah is at qarawab (hand). For Yahawah has kawan (prepared) a zabach (sacrifice). He has qadash (set apart/make holy) his qaraa (called).

It will happen in the yawam (day) of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) zabach (sacrifice), that I will paqad (visit) the shar (prince / ruler), the malak (king) ban (son), and all those who are labash (clothed) with foreign clothing.

In that yawam (day), I will paqad (visit) all those who dalag (leap) over the mapathan (threshold), who malaa (fill) their adawan (master / lord) bayath (house) with chamas (violence) and maramah (deceit).

In that yawam (day), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, there will be the qawal (sound / voice) of a tzaiqah (cry) from the dag (fish) shair (gate), a wailing from the mashanah (second) quarter, and a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) shabar (crashing) from the gabaih (hills).
Wail, you yashab (inhabit/dwell) of makathash (maktesh), for all the im (people / nation) of Kanain (Canaan) are damah (undone)! All those who were loaded with kasap (silver) are karath (cut) off.

It will happen at that ith (time), that I will chapash (search) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) with nayar (lamps), and I will paqad (visit) the ayash (husband/individual man) who are qapaa (settled) on their shamar (keep/guard), who amar (spoke) in their labab (heart), Yahawah will not do yatab (good), neither will he do raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil).

Their wealth will become a mashasah (spoil), and their bayath (house) a shamamah (desolation). Yes, they will banah (build) bayath (house), but won't yashab (inhabit/dwell) them. They will natai (plant) karam (vineyards), but won't shathah (drinks) their yayan (wine).

The gadawal (very great/important/mighty) yawam (day) of Yahawah is qarawab (near). It is qarawab (near), and hurries maad (greatly), the qawal (sound / voice) of the yawam (day) of Yahawah. The gabawar (mighty) man tzarach (cries) there bitterly.

That yawam (day) is a yawam (day) of ibarah (wrath), a yawam (day) of matzawaqah (distress) and tzarah (anguish), a yawam (day) of tzarah (trouble) and ruin, a yawam (day) of chashak (darkness) and gloom, a yawam (day) of inan (cloud) and blackness,
A yawam (day) of the shawapar (Shawapar(Shofar) - Ram's horn (instrument)) and tharawaih (alarm), against the batzar (fortified) iyar (cities), and against the gabah (high) battlements.

I will tzarar (bring) distress on adam (men), that they will halak (move) like iwar (blind) men, because they have chataa (sinned) against Yahawah, and their dam (blood) will be shapak (poured) out like ipar (dust), and their lachawam (flesh) like galal (dung).

Neither their kasap (silver) nor their zahab (gold) will be yakal (able) to natzal (deliver) them in the yawam (day) of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) ibarah (wrath), but the whole aratz (Earth/land) will be akal (eat) by the ash (fire) of his qanaah (jealousy); for he will ishah (make) an end, yes, a terrible kalah (complete / finish), of all those who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the aratz (Earth/land).
Qashash (gather) yourselves together, yes, qashash (gather) together, you gaway (nation / people) that has no shame,

Before the chaq (statute) yalad (birth / begot) when the yawam (day) passes as the matz (chaff), laa (NOT) the charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah bawaa (come) on you, before the yawam (day) of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) bawaa (come) on you.

Baqash (seek) Yahawah, all you inaw (humble) of the aratz (Earth/land), who have kept his mashapat (ordinances). Baqash (seek) tzadaq (righteous / just / fair). Baqash (seek) inawah (humility). It awalay (perhaps) be that you will be sathar (hidden) in the yawam (day) of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting).
For Izah (Gaza) will be forsaken, and Ashaqalawan (Ashkelon) a shamamah (desolation). They will garash (drive) out Ashadawad (Ashdod) at noonday, and Iqarawan (Ekron) will be iqar (rooted) up.

Haway (Alas/Woe!) To the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the yam (sea/waters) chabal (coast), the gaway (nation / people) of the Karathay (Cherethites)! The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah is against you, Kanain (Canaan), the aratz (Earth/land) of the Palashathay (Philistines). I will abad (destroy/perish) you, that there will be no yashab (inhabit/dwell).
The yam (sea/waters) chabal (coast) will be pastures, with karah (cottages) for raih (shepherds) and folds for tzaan (flocks).

The chabal (coast) will be for the shaarayath (remnant) of the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah). They will find pasture. In the bayath (house) of Ashaqalawan (Ashkelon), they will rabatz (lie) down in the irab (evening), for Yahawah, their Alahayam, will paqad (visit) them, and shawab (turn back / repent) them.

I have shamai (hearken / hear) the charapah (reproach) of Mawaab (Moab), and the insults of the ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon), with which they have charap (reproached) my im (people / nation), and gadal (magnified) themselves against their gabawal (border/boundary).

Therefore as I chay (life), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), surely Mawaab (Moab) will be as Sadam (Sodom), and the ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon) as Imarah (Gomorrah), a mamashaq (possession) of charawal (nettles), and salt makarah (pits), and a perpetual shamamah (desolation). The shaarayath (remnant) of my im (people / nation) will plunder them, and the survivors of my gaway (nation / people) will nachal (inherit) them.
This they will have for their gaawan (pride), because they have charap (reproached) and gadal (magnified) themselves against the im (people / nation) of Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).

Yahawah will be awesome to them, for he will razah (famish) all the Alahayam of the aratz (Earth/land). Men will shachah (worship) him, everyone from his maqawam (place), even all the shores of the gaway (nation / people).
You Cushites also, you will be chalal (killed) by my charab (sword).

He will natah (stretch) out his yad (hand) against the tzapawan (north), abad (destroy/perish) Ashawar (Assyria), and will shawam (place / establish / appoint) Nayanawah (Nineveh) a shamamah (desolation), as tzayah (dry) as the madabar (wilderness).

Idar (herds) will rabatz (lie) down in the thawak (midst) of her, all the animals of the gaway (nation / people). Both the pelican and the porcupine will lawan (lodge) in its capitals. Their calls will echo through the chalawan (windows). Charab (desolation) will be in the sap (thresholds), for he has laid bare the arazah (cedar) beams.

This is the ilayaz (joyous) iyar (city) that lived carelessly, that amar (spoke) in her labab (heart), "I am, and there is apas (none) besides me." How she has become a shamah (desolation), a place for animals to marabatz (lie) down in! Everyone who passes by her will sharaq (hiss), and nawai (shake) their fists.
Haway (Alas/Woe!) To her who is rebellious and gaal (polluted), the yanah (oppressing) iyar (city)!

She didn't shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice). She didn't laqach (take / seized) mawasar (correction). She didn't batach (trust) in Yahawah. She didn't qarab (come close) near to her Alahayam.
Her shar (prince / ruler) in the qarab (among / near) of her are shaag (roaring) aray (lions). Her shapat (judges) are irab (evening) wolves. They leave nothing until the next baqar (morning).

Her nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) are arrogant and bagadawath (treacherous) ayash (husband/individual man). Her kahan (priest) have chalal (profaned) the qadash (set apart/make holy). They have chamas (done) violence to the thawarah (instruction).

Yahawah, in the qarab (among / near) of her, is tzadayaq (righteous). He will ishah (make) no wrong. Every baqar (morning) he nathan (give) his mashapat (justice) to awar (light). He doesn't idar (fail), but the iwal (unjust) yadai (know) no bashath (shame).

I have karath (cut) off gaway (nation / people). Their battlements are shamam (desolate). I have made their chawatz (streets) charab (waste), so that no ibar (pass over/through) passes by. Their iyar (cities) are tzadah (destroyed), so that there is no ayash (husband/individual man), so that there is no yashab (inhabit/dwell).

I amar (spoke), "Just yaraa (fear / be afraid) me. Laqach (take / seized) mawasar (correction), so that her dwelling won't be karath (cut) off, according to paqad (visit) that I have appointed concerning her." But they shakam (rose) early and shachath (corrupted) all their ilayalah (doings).

"Therefore chakah (wait) for me," naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, until the yawam (day) that I qawam (rise up) up to the id (prey), for my mashapat (determination) is to asap (gather) the gaway (nation / people), that I may qabatz (assemble) the mamalakah (kingdoms), to shapak (pour) on them my zaim (indignation), even all my charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), for all the aratz (Earth/land) will be akal (eat) with the ash (fire) of my qanaah (jealousy).
For then I will barar (purify) the shapah (lips) of the im (people / nation), that they may all qaraa (called) on the sham (name) of Yahawah, to ibad (servant) him shoulder to shakam (shoulder).
From ibar (beyond) the nahar (rivers) of Kawash (Cush), my worshipers, even the bath (daughter) of my pawatz (dispersed) people, will yabal (bring) my manachah (offering).

In that yawam (day) you will not be disappointed for all your ilayalah (doings), in which you have pashai (transgressed) against me; for then I will sawar (take) away out of the qarab (among / near) of you your gaawah (proudly) exulting yasap (ones), and you will no more be gabah (haughty) in my qadash (set apart/make holy) har (mountain).
But I will shaar (leave) in the qarab (among / near) of you an inay (afflicted) and dal (poor) im (people / nation), and they will take chasah (refuge) in the sham (name) of Yahawah.

The shaarayath (remnant) of Yasharaal (Israel) will not ishah (make) iwal (iniquity), nor dabar (word / matter) kazab (lies), neither will a tharamah (deceitful) lashawan (tongue/language) be matzaa (found) in their pah (mouth), for they will raih (feed) and rabatz (lie) down, and no one will make them charad (afraid).
Ranan (sing), bath (daughter) of Tzayawan (Zion)! Rawai (shout), Yasharaal (Israel)! Be shamach (glad) and ilaz (rejoice) with all your lab (heart), bath (daughter) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Yahawah has sawar (taken) away your mashapat (judgments). He has thrown out your ayab (enemy). The malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel), Yahawah, is in the qarab (among / near) of you. You will not be afraid of rai (evil) any more.
In that yawam (day), it will be amar (spoke) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid), Tzayawan (Zion). Don't let your yad (hand) be rapah (weak).

Yahawah, your Alahayam, is in the qarab (among / near) of you, a gabawar (mighty) one who will yashai (salvation). He will shawash (rejoice) over you with shamachah (joy). He will calm you in his ahabah (love). He will gayal (rejoice) over you with ranah (singing).
I will remove those who yagah (grieve) about the mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) feasts from you. They are a mashaath (burden) and a charapah (reproach) to you.

Behold, at that ith (time) I will ishah (make) with all those who inah (oppress / afflict) you, and I will yashai (salvation) those who are lame, and qabatz (gather) those who were nadach (driven) away. I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) them thahalah (praise) and honor, whose bashath (shame) has been in all the aratz (Earth/land).

At that ith (time) will I bawaa (come) you in, and at that ith (time) will I qabatz (gather) you; for I will nathan (give) you honor and thahalah (praise) among all the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land), when I shawab (turn back / repent) your fortunes before your iyan (eye), amar (spoke) Yahawah.

In the shanayam (two) shanah (year) of Darayawash (Darius) the malak (king), in the shashay (sixth) chadash (month), in the achad (one) yawam (day) of the chadash (month), the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came by Chagay (Haggai), the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), to Zarababal (Zerubbabel), the ban (son) of Shaalathayaal (Shealtiel), pachah (governor) of Yahawadah (Judah), and to Yahawashawai (Joshua), the ban (son) of Yahawatzadaq (Jehozadak), the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest), amar (spoke),

This is what Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) amar (spoke): These im (people / nation) amar (spoke), ‘The ith (time) hasn't yet bawaa (come), the ith (time) for yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) bayath (house) to be banah (built).’
Then the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came by Chagay (Haggai), the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), amar (spoke),
Is it a ith (time) for you yourselves to yashab (inhabit/dwell) in your paneled bayath (house), while this bayath (house) lies charab (waste)?
Now therefore this is what Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) amar (spoke): shawam (place / establish / appoint) your darak (ways).

You have zarai (sown) much, and bawaa (come) in mait (little). You akal (eat), but you don't have shabaih (seven). You shathah (drinks), but you aren't filled with shakar (drink). You labash (clothe) yourselves, but no cham (one) is warm, and he who shakar (earns) wages shakar (earns) wages to put them into a tzarawar (bag) with naqab (holes) in it.
This is what Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) amar (spoke): "shawam (place / establish / appoint) your darak (ways).

Ilah (go up / offer) up to the har (mountain), bawaa (come) itz (wood), and banah (build) the bayath (house). I will ratzah (take) pleasure in it, and I will be kabad (glorified)," amar (spoke) Yahawah.

"You panah (looked) for much, and, behold, it came to mait (little); and when you bawaa (come) it bayath (house), I napach (blew) it away. Why?" Naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), yain (because) of my bayath (house) that lies charab (waste), while each of you is busy with his own bayath (house).
Therefore for your sake the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) kalaa (withhold) the tal (dew), and the aratz (Earth/land) kalaa (withholds) its yabawal (fruit).

I qaraa (called) for a charab (drought) on the aratz (Earth/land), on the har (mountain), on the grain, on the new thayarawash (wine), on the yatzahar (fresh oil), on that which the adamah (ground) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth, on adam (men), on livestock, and on all the yagayai (labor) of the kap (hands).

Then Zarababal (Zerubbabel), the ban (son) of Shaalathayaal (Shealtiel), and Yahawashawai (Joshua), the ban (son) of Yahawatzadaq (Jehozadak), the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest), with all the shaarayath (remnant) of the im (people / nation), shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah, their Alahayam, and the dabar (word / matter) of Chagay (Haggai), the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), as Yahawah, their Alahayam, had shalach (send) him; and the im (people / nation) yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah.

Then Chagay (Haggai), yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) malaak (angel / messenger of Yah), amar (spoke) yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) malaakawath (message) to the im (people / nation), amar (spoke), "I am with you," naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

Yahawah iwar (rouse / awaken) up the rawach (spirit / wind) of Zarababal (Zerubbabel), the ban (son) of Shaalathayaal (Shealtiel), pachah (governor) of Yahawadah (Judah), and the rawach (spirit / wind) of Yahawashawai (Joshua), the ban (son) of Yahawatzadaq (Jehozadak), the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest), and the rawach (spirit / wind) of all the shaarayath (remnant) of the im (people / nation); and they bawaa (come) and malaakah (worked) on the bayath (house) of Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), their Alahayam,
In the isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) yawam (day) of the month, in the shashay (sixth) chadash (month), in the shanayam (two) shanah (year) of Darayawash (Darius) the malak (king).

In the shabayaiy (seventh) month, in the isharayam (twenty) - achad (one) day of the chadash (month), the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came by Chagay (Haggai) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), amar (spoke),

Amar (spoke) now to Zarababal (Zerubbabel), the ban (son) of Shaalathayaal (Shealtiel), pachah (governor) of Yahawadah (Judah), and to Yahawashawai (Joshua), the ban (son) of Yahawatzadaq (Jehozadak), the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest), and to the shaarayath (remnant) of the im (people / nation), amar (spoke),
‘Who is shaar (left) among you who raah (see) this bayath (house) in its raashawan (former) kabawad (glory)? How do you raah (see) it now? Isn't it in your iyan (eye) as nothing?

Yet now be chazaq (strong), Zarababal (Zerubbabel),’ naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah. ‘Be chazaq (strong), Yahawashawai (Joshua), ban (son) of Yahawatzadaq (Jehozadak), the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest). Be chazaq (strong), all you im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land),’ naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, ‘and ishah (make), for I am with you,’ naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).

This is the dabar (word / matter) that I karath (cut) with you when you yatzaa (go out / come out) out of Matzarayam (Egypt), and my rawach (spirit / wind) lived thawak (midst) you. ‘Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid).’

For this is what Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) amar (spoke): ‘Yet achad (one), it is a mait (little) while, and I will raish (shake) the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), the aratz (Earth/land), the yam (sea/waters), and the dry charabah (land);

And I will raish (shake) all gaway (nation / people). The precious things of all gaway (nation / people) will bawaa (come), and I will malaa (fill) this bayath (house) with kabawad (glory), amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).
The kasap (silver) is mine, and the zahab (gold) is mine,’ naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).

‘The acharawan (latter) kabawad (glory) of this bayath (house) will be greater than the raashawan (former),’ naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop); ‘and in this maqawam (place) will I nathan (give) shalawam (peace / safety),’ amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).

In the isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) day of the thashayaiy (ninth) month, in the shanayam (two) shanah (year) of Darayawash (Darius), the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came by Chagay (Haggai) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), amar (spoke),
"Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop): shaal (ask) now the kahan (priest) concerning the thawarah (instruction), amar (spoke),

‘If someone nashaa (lift) qadash (set apart/make holy) meat in the fold of his bagad (garment), and with his fold touches lacham (bread), stew, yayan (wine), shaman (oil), or any maakal (food), will it become qadash (set apart/make holy)?’" The kahan (priest) inah (answer / respond), No.

Then Chagay (Haggai) amar (spoke), "If one who is tamaa (unclean) by reason of a napash (living being/soul) body nagai (touch) any of these, will it be tamaa (unclean)?" The kahan (priest) inah (answer / respond), It will be tamaa (unclean).

Then Chagay (Haggai) inah (answer / respond), ‘So is this im (people / nation), and so is this gaway (nation / people) panayam (before) me,’ naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah; ‘and so is every maishah (work) of their yad (hand). That which they qarab (come close) there is tamaa (unclean).

Now, please shawam (place / establish / appoint) from this yawam (day) and backward, taram (before) a aban (stone) was shawam (place / establish / appoint) on a aban (stone) in the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah.

Through all that time, when one bawaa (come) to a iram (heap) of isharayam (twenty) measures, there were only ishar (ten). When one bawaa (come) to the yaqab (wine) vat to chashap (draw) out chamashayam (fifty), there were only isharayam (twenty).
I nakah (struck) you with blight, mildew, and barad (hail) in all the maishah (work) of your yad (hand); yet you didn't turn to me,’ naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.

‘Shawam (place / establish / appoint), please, from this yawam (day) and backward, from the isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) yawam (day) of the thashayaiy (ninth) month, since the yawam (day) that the yasad (foundation) of yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) hayakal (temple) was shawam (place / establish / appoint), consider it.

Is the zarai (seed) yet in the magawarah (barn)? Yes, the gapan (vine), the thaan (fig) tree, the ramawan (pomegranate), and the zayath (olive) itz (tree) haven't nashaa (lift) forth. From this yawam (day) will I barak (bless) you.’
The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came the shanay (second) time to Chagay (Haggai) in the isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) day of the chadash (month), amar (spoke),
Amar (spoke) to Zarababal (Zerubbabel), pachah (governor) of Yahawadah (Judah), amar (spoke), ‘I will raish (shake) the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) and the aratz (Earth/land).

I will hapak (overthrow) the kasaa (throne) of mamalakah (kingdoms). I will shamad (destroy) the chazaq (strength) of the mamalakah (kingdoms) of the gaway (nation / people). I will hapak (overthrow) the marakabah (chariots), and those who rakab (ride) in them. The sawas (horses) and their riders will yarad (come) down, everyone by the charab (sword) of his ach (brother/kinsman).

In that yawam (day), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), will I laqach (take / seized) you, Zarababal (Zerubbabel), my ibad (servant), the ban (son) of Shaalathayaal (Shealtiel),’ naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, ‘and will shawam (place / establish / appoint) you as a chawatham (signet), for I have bachar (chosen) you,’ naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).

In the shamayanay (eighth) chadash (month), in the shanayam (two) shanah (year) of Darayawash (Darius), the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Zakarayah (Zechariah) the ban (son) of Barakayah (Berechiah), the ban (son) of Idaw (Iddo), the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), amar (spoke),
Yahawah was very qatzap (displeased) with your ab (father).

Therefore amar (spoke) them: Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop): ‘shawab (turn back / repent) to me,’ amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), ‘and I will shawab (turn back / repent) to you,’ naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).

Don't you be like your ab (father), to whom the raashawan (former) nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) qaraa (called), amar (spoke): Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), ‘shawab (turn back / repent) now from your rai (evil) darak (ways), and from your rai (evil) mailal (doings);’ but they did not shamai (hearken / hear), nor listen to me, naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.
Your ab (father), where are they? And the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), do they chayah (live) iwalam (forever)?

But my dabar (word / matter) and my chaq (statute), which I tzawah (commanded) my ibad (servant) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), didn't they nashag (overtake) your ab (father)? Then they repented and amar (spoke), ‘Just as Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) determined to ishah (make) to us, according to our darak (ways), and according to our practices, so he ishah (make) dealt with us.’

On the isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) yawam (day) of the ishathay (eleven) chadash (month), which is the chadash (month) Shabat (Shebat), in the shanayam (two) shanah (year) of Darayawash (Darius), the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Zakarayah (Zechariah) the ban (son) of Barakayah (Berechiah), the ban (son) of Idaw (Iddo), the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), amar (spoke),

"I raah (see) a vision in the layal (night), and behold, a ayash (husband/individual man) rakab (riding) on a adam (red) sawas (horse), and he imad (stood) among the hadas (myrtle) trees that were in a ravine; and achar (other) him there were adam (red), brown, and laban (white) sawas (horses).
Then I asked, ‘My Adawan, what are these?’" The malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) who dabar (word / matter) with me amar (spoke) to me, I will show you what these are.

The ayash (husband/individual man) who imad (stood) among the hadas (myrtle) trees inah (answer / respond), They are the ones Yahawah has shalach (send) to halak (move) back and forth through the aratz (Earth/land).

They reported to the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah who imad (stood) among the hadas (myrtle) trees, and amar (spoke), We have halak (move) back and forth through the aratz (Earth/land), and behold, all the aratz (Earth/land) is at yashab (inhabit/dwell) and in shaqat (peace).

Then the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah replied, O Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), how long will you not have racham (mercy) on Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) and on the iyar (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), against which you have had zaim (indignation) these shabaiyam (seventy) shanah (years)?
Yahawah inah (answer / respond) the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) who dabar (word / matter) with me with kind and nachawam (comforting) dabar (word / matter).

So the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) who dabar (word / matter) with me amar (spoke) to me, qaraa (called), amar (spoke), ‘Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop): I am qanaa (jealous) for Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) and for Tzayawan (Zion) with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qanaah (jealousy).
I am very qatzap (angry) with the gaway (nation / people) that are at shaanan (ease); for I was but a mait (little) qatzap (displeased), but they added to the rai (calamity).

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: "I have shawab (turn back / repent) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) with racham (mercy). My bayath (house) shall be banah (built) in it," naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), "and a qawah (gather/wait) shall be natah (stretched) forth over Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)."’

Qaraa (called) further, amar (spoke), ‘Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop): "My iyar (cities) will again overflow with tawab (pleasant/functional), and Yahawah will again nacham (turn away / repent) Tzayawan (Zion), and will again bachar (choose) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)."’
I nashaa (lift) up my iyan (eye), and raah (see), and behold, arabai (four) qaran (horn).

I asked the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) who dabar (word / matter) with me, "What are these?" He amar (spoke) me, These are the qaran (horn) which have zarah (scattered) Yahawadah (Judah), Yasharaal (Israel), and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
Yahawah showed me arabai (four) craftsmen.

Then I asked, "What are these bawaa (come) to ishah (make)?" He amar (spoke), These are the qaran (horn) which zarah (scattered) Yahawadah (Judah), so that no ayash (husband/individual man) nashaa (lift) up his raash (head); but these bawaa (come) come to terrify them, to yadah (cast) down the qaran (horn) of the gaway (nation / people), which nashaa (lift) up their qaran (horn) against the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah) to zarah (scatter) it.
I nashaa (lift) up my iyan (eye), and raah (see), and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.
Then I asked, "Where are you going?" He amar (spoke) to me, To measure Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), to see mah (what) is its breadth and what is its length.
Behold, the angel who talked with me went forth, and raah (see) angel went out to raah (see) him,
