And amar (spoke) to him, bawaa (come), amar (spoke) to alah (these) young man, amar (spoke), ‘Jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls, because of the multitude of ishah (make) and livestock in it.
For I,’ says Yahawah, ‘will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the midst of her.
Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north,’ amar (spoke) Yahawah; ‘for I have halak (move) you abroad as the four winds of the sky,’ amar (spoke) Yahawah.
‘Come, Zion! Yatzaa (go out / come out), you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.’
For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of Armies: ‘For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for he who touches you touches the apple of his eye.
For, behold, I will shake my hand over them, and they will be a spoil to those who served them; and you will know that Yahawah of Armies has sent me.
Sing and rejoice, daughter of Zion; for, behold, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of you,’ naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.
Many nations shall join themselves to Yahawah in that day, and shall be my people; and I will yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the midst of you, and you shall know that Yahawah of Armies has sent me to you.
Yahawah will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and will again choose Jerusalem.
Be silent, all flesh, before Yahawah; for he has roused himself from his holy habitation!

He showed me Yahawashawai (Joshua) the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest) imad (standing) panayam (before) the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah, and shatan (satan) imad (standing) at his right yamayan (right hand) to be his shatan (adversary).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to shatan (satan), Yahawah gair (rebuke) you, shatan (satan)! Yes, Yahawah who has bachar (chosen) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) gair (rebuke) you! Isn't this a burning stick natzal (plucked) out of the ash (fire)?
Now Yahawashawai (Joshua) was labash (clothed) with tzawaa (filthy) bagad (garments), and was imad (standing) panayam (before) the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah).

He inah (answer / respond) and amar (spoke) to those who imad (stood) panayam (before) him, amar (spoke), "Take the tzawaa (filthy) bagad (garments) off of him." To him he amar (spoke), raah (see), I have caused your iwan (guilt/iniquity) to ibar (pass over/through) from you, and I will labash (clothe) you with rich clothing.

I amar (spoke), "Let them shawam (place / establish / appoint) a tahawar (clean) turban on his raash (head)." So they shawam (place / establish / appoint) a tahawar (clean) turban on his raash (head), and labash (clothed) him; and the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah was imad (standing) by.
The malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah iwad (admonish/bear witness against) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop): ‘If you will yalak (walk) in my darak (ways), and if you will follow my instructions, then you also shall dayan (judge) my bayath (house), and shall also shamar (keep/guard) my chatzar (courts), and I will nathan (give) you a mahalak (place) of access among these who imad (stand) by.

Shamai (hearken / hear) now, Yahawashawai (Joshua) the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest), you and your rai (neigbor/another person) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) panayam (before) you; for they are gadawal (very great/important/mighty) who are a mawapath (sign): for, behold, I will bawaa (come) forth my ibad (servant), the tzamach (branch).

For, behold, the aban (stone) that I nathan (give) set panayam (before) Yahawashawai (Joshua); on achad (one) aban (stone) are shabai (seven) iyan (eye): behold, I will pathach (engrave) its engraving,’ naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), ‘and I will mawash (remove) the iwan (guilt/iniquity) of that aratz (Earth/land) in achad (one) yawam (day).

In that yawam (day),’ naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), ‘you will qaraa (called) every ayash (husband/individual man) his neighbor under the gapan (vine) and under the thaan (fig) tree.’

The malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) who dabar (word / matter) with me shawab (turn back / repent) again, and wakened me, as a ayash (husband/individual man) who is wakened out of his shanah (sleep).

He amar (spoke) to me, "What do you raah (see)?" I amar (spoke), I raah (see) seen, and behold, a lampstand all of zahab (gold), with its galah (spring / basin / bowl) on the raash (head) of it, and its shabai (seven) nayar (lamps) thereon; there are shabai (seven) mawatzaqah (spout) to each of the nayar (lamps), which are on the raash (head) of it;
And shanayam (two) zayath (olive) trees by it, achad (one) on the yamayan (right hand) side of the galah (spring / basin / bowl), and the other on the shamaawal (left hand) side of it.
I inah (answer / respond) and amar (spoke) to the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) who dabar (word / matter) with me, amar (spoke), What are these, my Adawan?
Then the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) who dabar (word / matter) with me inah (answer / respond) me, "Don't you yadai (know) what these are?" I amar (spoke), No, my Adawan.

Then he inah (answer / respond) and amar (spoke) to me, amar (spoke), This is the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah to Zarababal (Zerubbabel), amar (spoke), ‘Not by chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), nor by kach (strength / mighty / power), but by my rawach (spirit / wind),’ amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).

Who are you, gadawal (very great/important/mighty) har (mountain)? Panayam (before) Zarababal (Zerubbabel) you are a mayashawar (plain); and he will yatzaa (go out / come out) out the capstone with shouts of ‘chan (grace), chan (grace), to it!’
Moreover the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to me, amar (spoke),

The yad (hand) of Zarababal (Zerubbabel) have yasad (laid) the foundation of this bayath (house). His yad (hand) shall also batzai (finish) it; and you yadai (will) know that Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) has shalach (send) me to you.

Indeed, who bawaz (despises) the yawam (day) of qatan (small/young/least) things? For these seven shall shamach (rejoice), and shall raah (see) the plumb line in the yad (hand) of Zarababal (Zerubbabel). These are the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, which shawat (run) back and forth through the whole aratz (Earth/land).
Then I asked him, What are these shanayam (two) zayath (olive) trees on the yamayan (right hand) side of the lampstand and on the shamaawal (left hand) side of it?

I asked him the shanay (second) time, What are these shanayam (two) zayath (olive) branches, which are yad (hand) the shanayam (two) zahab (gold) spouts, that rawaq (pour) the zahab (gold) oil out of themselves?
He amar (spoke) me, "Don't you yadai (know) what these are?" I amar (spoke), No, my Adawan.
Then he amar (spoke), These are the shanayam (two) yatzahar (fresh oil) ban (son) who imad (stand) by the Adawan of the whole aratz (Earth/land).
Then again I nashaa (lift) up my iyan (eye), and raah (see), and behold, a iwap (flying) scroll.

He amar (spoke) to me, "What do you raah (see)?" I amar (spoke), I raah (see) a iwap (flying) scroll; its arak (length) is isharayam (twenty) amah (cubits), and its rachab (breadth) ishar (ten) amah (cubits).

Then he amar (spoke) to me, "This is the alah (these) that yatzaa (go out / come out) out over the surface of the whole aratz (Earth/land); for everyone who ganab (steals) shall be naqah (clean/innocent) off kamaw (according) to it on the one side; and everyone who shabai (swear / take oath) falsely shall be naqah (clean/innocent) off kamaw (according) to it on the other side.

I will yatzaa (go out / come out) it to go out," naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), and it will bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of the ganab (thief), and into the bayath (house) of him who shabai (swear / take oath) falsely by my sham (name); and it will lawan (remain) in the thawak (midst) of his bayath (house), and will kalah (complete / finish) it with its itz (timber) and its aban (stone).

Then the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) who dabar (word / matter) with me yatzaa (go out / come out) forward, and amar (spoke) to me, nashaa (lift) up now your iyan (eye), and raah (see) what is this that is yatzaa (go out / come out).
I amar (spoke), "What is it?" He amar (spoke), "This is the ayapah (ephah) basket that is appearing." He amar (spoke) moreover, This is their iyan (eye) in all the aratz (Earth/land)
(And behold, a kakar (talent) of iwaparath (lead) was nashaa (lift) up); and this is a ashah (wife/individual woman) sitting in the thawak (midst) of the ayapah (ephah) basket.

He amar (spoke), "This is rashaih (wickedness);" and he shalak (threw) her down into the thawak (midst) of the ayapah (ephah) basket; and he shalak (threw) the aban (stone) of iwaparath (lead) on its pah (mouth).

Then nashaa (lift) I up my iyan (eye), and raah (see), and behold, there were shanayam (two) ashah (wife/individual woman), and the rawach (spirit / wind) was in their kanap (wings). Now they had kanap (wings) like the kanap (wings) of a chasayadah (stork), and they nashaa (lift) up the ayapah (ephah) basket between aratz (Earth/land) and the sky.
Then I amar (spoke) to the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) who dabar (word / matter) with me, Where are these yalak (carrying) the ayapah (ephah) basket?
He amar (spoke) to me, To banah (build) her a bayath (house) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Shanair (Shinar). When it is kawan (prepared), she will be yanach (set) there in her own place.

Again I nashaa (lift) up my iyan (eye), and raah (see), and behold, arabai (four) marakabah (chariots) yatzaa (go out / come out) out from between shanayam (two) har (mountain); and the har (mountain) were har (mountain) of nachashath (brass).
In the raashawan (first) marakabah (chariot) were adam (red) sawas (horses); in the shanay (second) marakabah (chariot) shachar (black) sawas (horses);
In the shalayashay (third) marakabah (chariot) laban (white) sawas (horses); and in the rabayaiy (fourth) marakabah (chariot) dappled sawas (horses), all of them powerful.
Then I asked the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) who dabar (word / matter) with me, What are these, my Adawan?

The malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) inah (answer / respond) me, These are the arabai (four) rawach (spirit / wind) of the sky, which yatzaa (go out / come out) forth from yatzab (standing) before the Adawan of all the aratz (Earth/land).

The one with the shachar (black) sawas (horses) yatzaa (go out / come out) out toward the tzapawan (north) aratz (Earth/land); and the laban (white) yatzaa (go out / come out) out achar (other) them; and the dappled yatzaa (go out / come out) forth toward the thayaman (south) aratz (Earth/land).

The strong yatzaa (go out / come out) out, and baqash (sought) to yalak (go) that they might halak (move) back and forth through the aratz (Earth/land): and he amar (spoke), "yalak (go) around and through the aratz (Earth/land)!" So they halak (move) back and forth through the aratz (Earth/land).

Then he zaiq (called) to me, and dabar (word / matter) to me, amar (spoke), raah (see), those who yatzaa (go out / come out) toward the tzapawan (north) aratz (Earth/land) nawach (have) quieted my rawach (spirit / wind) in the tzapawan (north) aratz (Earth/land).
The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to me, amar (spoke),

Laqach (take / seized) of them of the gawalah (captivity), even of Chaladay (Heldai), of Tawabayah (Tobijah), and of Yadaiyah (Jedaiah); and bawaa (come) the same yawam (day), and bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of Yaashayah (Josiah) the ban (son) of Tzapanayah (Zephaniah), where they bawaa (come) come from Babal (Babylon).

Yes, laqach (take / seized) kasap (silver) and zahab (gold), and ishah (make) itarah (crowns), and shawam (place / establish / appoint) them on the raash (head) of Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Yahawatzadaq (Jehozadak), the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest);

And amar (spoke) to him, amar (spoke), ‘Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), “Behold, the ayash (husband/individual man) whose sham (name) is the tzamach (branch): and he shall tzamach (grow) up out of his place; and he shall banah (build) the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah;

Even he shall banah (build) the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah; and he shall nashaa (lift) the glory, and shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) and mashal (rule/have dominion) on his kasaa (throne); and he shall be a kahan (priest) on his kasaa (throne); and the itzah (counsel) of shalawam (peace / safety) shall be between them shanayam (two).

The itarah (crowns) shall be to Chalam (Helem), and to Tawabayah (Tobijah), and to Yadaiyah (Jedaiah), and to Chan (Hen) the ban (son) of Tzapanayah (Zephaniah), for a zakarawan (memorial) in the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah.

Those who are rachawaq (far) off shall bawaa (come) and banah (build) in the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah; and you shall yadai (know) that Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) has shalach (send) me to you. This will happen, if you will shamai (hearken / hear) shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah your Alahayam.”’

It happened in the arabai (four) shanah (year) of malak (king) Darayawash (Darius) that the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Zakarayah (Zechariah) in the arabai (four) day of the thashayaiy (ninth) chadash (month), the Kasalaw (month) of Chislev.

The ayash (husband/individual man) of Bethel shalach (send) Sharaatzar (Sharezer) and Ragamamalak (Regem) Melech, and their ayash (husband/individual man), to entreat yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) favor,

And to amar (spoke) to the kahan (priest) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), and to the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), amar (spoke), Should I bakah (weep) in the chamayashay (fifth) chadash (month), nazar (crown / consecrate) myself, as I ishah (make) done these so many shanah (years)?
Then the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) came to me, amar (spoke),

Amar (spoke) to all the im (people / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land), and to the kahan (priest), amar (spoke), ‘When you tzawam (fasted) and sapad (mourned) in the chamayashay (fifth) and in the shabayaiy (seventh) month for these shabaiyam (seventy) shanah (years), did you at tzawam (all) tzawam (fast) to me, really to me?
When you akal (eat), and when you shathah (drinks), don't you akal (eat) for yourselves, and shathah (drinks) for yourselves?

Aren't these the dabar (word / matter) which Yahawah qaraa (called) by the raashawan (former) nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), when Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) was yashab (inhabit/dwell) and in shalaw (prosperity), and its iyar (cities) around her, and the nagab (south) and the lowland were yashab (inhabit/dwell)?’
The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Zakarayah (Zechariah), amar (spoke),

“Thus has Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) amar (spoke), amar (spoke), ‘shapat (execute) amath (truth) mashapat (judgment), and show chasad (grace) and racham (compassion) every ayash (husband/individual man) to his ach (brother/kinsman).

Don't ishaq (oppress) the alamanah (widow), nor the yathawam (fatherless), the foreigner, nor the inay (poor); and let none of you chashab (devise) rai (evil) against his ach (brother/kinsman) in your labab (heart).’
But they maan (refused) to listen, and nathan (give) their backs, and kabad (stopped) their azan (ears), that they might not shamai (hearken / hear).

Yes, they shawam (place / establish / appoint) their lab (heart) as hard as flint, lest they might shamai (hearken / hear) the thawarah (instruction), and the dabar (word / matter) which Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) had shalach (send) by his rawach (spirit / wind) by the raashawan (former) nabayaa (prophet/prophecy). Therefore gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qatzap (wrath) came from Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).

It has come to pass that, as he qaraa (called), and they refused to shamai (hearken / hear), so they will qaraa (called), and I will not shamai (hearken / hear),” amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop);

But I will sair (scatter) them with a whirlwind among all the gaway (nation / people) which they yadai (have) not known. Thus the aratz (Earth/land) was shamah (desolate) achar (other) them, so that no ibar (pass over/through) passed through nor shawab (turn back / repent): for they shawam (place / establish / appoint) the chamadah (pleasant) aratz (Earth/land) shamah (desolate).
The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) came to me.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop): I am qanaa (jealous) for Tzayawan (Zion) with gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qanaah (jealousy), and I am qanaa (jealous) for her with gadawal (very great/important/mighty) chamah (wrath).

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: I have shawab (turn back / repent) to Tzayawan (Zion), and will shakan (dwell) in the thawak (midst) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) shall be qaraa (called) ‘The iyar (city) of amath (truth);’ and the har (mountain) of Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), ‘The qadash (set apart/make holy) har (mountain).’

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop): zaqan (old) men and zaqan (old) women will again yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the rachab (streets) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), every ayash (husband/individual man) with his mashainah (staff) in his yad (hand) for very yawam (day).
The rachab (streets) of the iyar (city) will be malaa (full) of yalad (birth / begot) and yaladah (girls) shachaq (playing) in its rachab (streets).

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop): "If it is palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) in the iyan (eye) of the shaarayath (remnant) of this im (people / nation) in those yawam (day), should it also be palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) in my iyan (eye)?" Naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).
Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop): Behold, I will yashai (salvation) my im (people / nation) from the mazarach (east) aratz (Earth/land), and from the west aratz (Earth/land);

And I will bawaa (come) them, and they will shakan (dwell) in the thawak (midst) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and they will be my im (people / nation), and I will be their Alahayam, in amath (truth) and in tzadaqah (righteousness).

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop): “Let your yad (hand) be chazaq (strong), you who shamai (hearken / hear) in these yawam (day) these dabar (word / matter) from the pah (mouth) of the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) who were in the yawam (day) that the yasad (foundation) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) was yasad (laid), even the hayakal (temple), that it might be banah (built).

For panayam (before) those yawam (day) there was no shakar (wages) for adam (man), nor any shakar (wages) for an animal; neither was there any shalawam (peace / safety) to him who yatzaa (go out / come out) out or bawaa (come) in, because of the tzar (oppressor / distressor). For I shalach (send) all adam (men) everyone against his neighbor.
But now I will not be to the shaarayath (remnant) of this im (people / nation) as in the raashawan (former) yawam (day),” naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).

For the zarai (seed) of shalawam (peace / safety) and the gapan (vine) will nathan (give) its paray (fruit), and the aratz (Earth/land) will nathan (give) its yabawal (increase), and the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)) will nathan (give) their tal (dew); and I will cause the shaarayath (remnant) of this im (people / nation) to nachal (inherit) all these things.

It shall come to pass that, as you were a qalalah (curse) among the gaway (nation / people), bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah) and bayath (house) of Yasharaal (Israel), so will I yashai (salvation) you, and you shall be a barakah (blessing). Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid). Let your yad (hand) be chazaq (strong).

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop): "As I zamam (thought) to do raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil) to you, when your ab (father) provoked me to qatzap (wrath)," amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), “and I didn't nacham (turn away / repent);
So again have I zamam (thought) in these yawam (day) to do yatab (good) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) and to the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah). Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid).

These are the things that you shall ishah (make): dabar (word / matter) every ayash (husband/individual man) the amath (truth) with his neighbor. Shapat (execute) the mashapat (judgment) of amath (truth) and shalawam (peace / safety) in your shair (gates),

And let ayash (husband/individual man) of you chashab (devise) rai (evil) in your labab (hearts) against his neighbor, and ahab (love) no shaqar (false) shabawaih (oath): for all these are things that I shanaa (hate),” naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.
The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) came to me.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop): The tzawam (fasts) of the rabayaiy (fourth) chamayashay (fifth), shabayaiy (seventh), and ishayaray (tenth) months shall be for the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah) shashawan (joy) and shamachah (gladness), and tawab (pleasant/functional) mawaid (Feast/Holy Day). Therefore ahab (love) amath (truth) and shalawam (peace / safety).
Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop): Many im (people / nation), and the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of many iyar (cities) will yet bawaa (come);

And the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of achad (one) shall halak (move) to another, amar (spoke), ‘yalak (let) us go halak (move) to entreat the favor of Yahawah, and to baqash (seek) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop). I will yalak (go) also.’

Yes, many im (people / nation) and itzawam (strong) gaway (nation / people) will bawaa (come) to baqash (seek) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and to entreat the favor of Yahawah.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop): In those yawam (day), ishar (ten) chazaq (men) will chazaq (take) hold, out of all the lashawan (tongue/language) of the gaway (nation / people), they will chazaq (take) hold of the kanap (skirt) of him who is a Jew, amar (spoke), ‘We will yalak (go) with you, for we have shamai (hearken / hear) that Alahayam is with you.’

An oracle. The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah is against the aratz (Earth/land) of Chadarak (Hadrach), and will manawachah (rest) upon Damashaq (Damascus); for the iyan (eye) of adam (man) and of all the shabat (tribes) of Yasharaal (Israel) is toward Yahawah;
And Chamath (Hamath), also, which gabal (borders) on it; Tzar (Tyre) and Tzayadawan (Sidon), because they are very chakam (wise).
Tzar (Tyre) banah (built) herself a stronghold, and tzabar (heaped) up kasap (silver) like the ipar (dust), and fine charawatz (gold) like the tayat (mire) of the chawatz (streets).
Behold, the Adanay will yarash (dispossess) her, and he will nakah (strike) her chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) in the yam (sea/waters); and she will be akal (eat) with ash (fire).

Ashaqalawan (Ashkelon) will raah (see) it, and yaraa (fear / be afraid); Izah (Gaza) also, and will writhe in agony; as will Iqarawan (Ekron), for her mabat (expectation) will be disappointed; and the malak (king) will abad (destroy/perish) from Izah (Gaza), and Ashaqalawan (Ashkelon) will not be yashab (inhabit/dwell).
Foreigners will yashab (inhabit/dwell) Ashadawad (in) Ashdod, and I will karath (cut) off the gaawan (pride) of the Palashathay (Philistines).

I will sawar (take) away his dam (blood) out of his pah (mouth), and his shaqawatz (abominations) from between his shan (teeth); and he also will be a shaar (remnant) for our Alahayam; and he will be as a chieftain in Yahawadah (Judah), and Iqarawan (Ekron) as a Yabawasay (Jebusite).

I will chanah (encamp) around my bayath (house) against the matzabah (army), that none ibar (pass over/through) through or shawab (turn back / repent); and no nagash (oppressor) will ibar (pass over/through) through them any more: for now I raah (see) seen with my iyan (eye).

Gayal (rejoice) maad (greatly), bath (daughter) of Tzayawan (Zion)! Rawai (shout), bath (daughter) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)! Behold, your malak (king) bawaa (come) to you! He is tzadayaq (righteous), and having yashai (salvation); inay (lowly), and rakab (riding) on a donkey, even on a iyar (colt), the ban (son) of a donkey.

I will karath (cut) off the rakab (chariot) from Aparayam (Ephraim), and the sawas (horse) from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and the malachamah (battle) qashath (bow) will be karath (cut) off; and he will dabar (word / matter) shalawam (peace / safety) to the gaway (nation / people): and his mashal (dominion) will be from yam (sea/waters) to yam (sea/waters), and from the nahar (river) to the apas (ends) of the aratz (Earth/land).
As for you also, because of the dam (blood) of your barayath (covenant), I have shalach (send) free your asayar (prisoners) from the bawar (pit) in which is no mayam (Waters).
Shawab (turn back / repent) to the batzarawan (stronghold), you asayar (prisoners) of thaqawah (hope)! Even today I nagad (declare) that I will shawab (turn back / repent) mashanah (double) to you.

For indeed I bend Yahawadah (Judah) as a qashath (bow) for me. I malaa (have) filled the qashath (bow) with Aparayam (Ephraim); and I will iwar (rouse / awaken) up your ban (son), Tzayawan (Zion), against your ban (son), Yawan (Greece), and will shawam (place / establish / appoint) you like the charab (sword) of a gabawar (mighty) man.

Yahawah will be raah (see) over them; and his chatz (arrow) will yatzaa (go out / come out) flash like baraq (lightning); and the Adanay Yahawah will thaqai (blow / sound alarm) the shawapar (Shawapar(Shofar) - Ram's horn (instrument)), and will halak (move) with sair (whirlwinds) of the thayaman (south).

Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) will ganan (defend) them; and they will akal (eat) and overcome with qalai (sling) aban (stone); and they will shathah (drinks), and hamah (they) as through yayan (wine); and they will be malaa (filled) like mazaraq (bowls), like the zawayath (corners) of the mazabach (altar).

Yahawah their Alahayam will yashai (salvation) them in that yawam (day) as the tzaan (flock) of his im (people / nation); for they are like the jewels of a nazar (crown / consecrate), nasas (lifted) on high over his adamah (land).
For how great is his goodness, and how great is his yapay (beauty)! Grain will make the bachawar (young) men flourish, and new thayarawash (wine) the bathawalah (virgins).

Shaal (ask) of Yahawah matar (rain) in the spring ith (time), Yahawah who ishah (make) storm chazayaz (clouds), and he nathan (give) malaqawash (rain) gasham (showers) to everyone for the plants in the shadah (field).

For the tharapayam (teraphim) have dabar (word / matter) awan (vanity), and the diviners have chazah (seen) a shaqar (lie); and they have dabar (word / matter) shawaa (vanity) chalawam (dreams). They nacham (turn away / repent) in habal (vain). Therefore they nasai (go) their way like tzaan (sheep). They are oppressed, because there is no raih (shepherd).

My ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) is charah (hot with anger) against the raih (shepherds), and I will paqad (visit) the male ithawad (goats); For Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) paqad (visit) visited his idar (flock), the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah), and will shawam (place / establish / appoint) them as his majestic sawas (horse) in the malachamah (battle).
From him will yatzaa (go out / come out) forth the cornerstone, from him the yathad (nail), from him the malachamah (battle) qashath (bow), from him every nagash (ruler) yachad (together).

They shall be as gabawar (mighty) men, bawas (treading) down muddy chawatz (streets) in the malachamah (battle); and they shall lacham (fight), because Yahawah is with them; and the riders on sawas (horses) will be yabash (dry land).

“I will gabar (strengthen) the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah), and I will yashai (salvation) the bayath (house) of Yawasap (Joseph), and I will bring them back; for I have racham (mercy) on them; and they will be as ashar (who/that) I had not zanach (cast) them off: for I am Yahawah their Alahayam, and I will inah (answer / respond) them.

Aparayam (Ephraim) will be like a gabawar (mighty) man, and their lab (heart) will shamach (rejoice) as through yayan (wine); yes, their ban (son) will raah (see) it, and gayal (rejoice). Their lab (heart) will be shamach (glad) in Yahawah.
I will signal for them, and qabatz (gather) them; for I have padah (redeemed) them; and they will rabah (increase) as they rabah (have) increased.

I will zarai (sow) them among the im (people / nation); and they will zakar (remembrance/memory) me in marachaq (far) countries; and they will chayah (live) with their ban (son), and will shawab (turn back / repent).

I will shawab (turn back / repent) them again also out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and qabatz (gather) them out of Ashawar (Assyria); and I will bawaa (come) them into the aratz (Earth/land) of Galaid (Gilead) and Labanawan (Lebanon); and there won't be room matzaa (enough) for them.

He will ibar (pass over/through) through the yam (sea/waters) of tzarah (affliction), and will nakah (strike) the gal (waves) in the yam (sea/waters), and all the matzawalah (depths) of the Nile will yabash (dry land) up; and the gaawan (pride) of Ashawar (Assyria) will be yarad (brought) down, and the scepter of Matzarayam (Egypt) will sawar (depart).
I will gabar (strengthen) them in Yahawah; and they will halak (move) up and down in his sham (name),” naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah.
Pathach (open) your dalath (doors), Labanawan (Lebanon), that the ash (fire) may akal (eat) your araz (cedars).

Wail, barawash (fir) tree, for the araz (cedar) napal (fall / be cast down) fallen, because the stately ones are shadad (destroyed). Wail, you alawan (oaks) of Bashan (Bashan), for the strong yair (forest) has yarad (come) down.

A qawal (sound / voice) of the wailing of the raih (shepherds)! For their glory is shadad (destroyed): a qawal (sound / voice) of the shaagah (roaring) of young kapayar (lions)! For the gaawan (pride) of the Yaradan (Jordan) is ruined.
Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah my Alahayam: "raih (feed) the tzaan (flock) of haragah (slaughter).

Their qanah (buyers) slaughter them, and go unpunished. Those who makar (sell) them amar (spoke), ‘barak (blessed) be Yahawah, for I am ishar (rich);’ and their own raih (shepherds) don't chamal (pity) them.

For I will no more chamal (pity) the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the aratz (Earth/land)," naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah; but, behold, I will matzaa (deliver) the adam (men) everyone into his neighbor's yad (hand), and into the yad (hand) of his malak (king). They will strike the aratz (Earth/land), and out of their yad (hand) I will not natzal (deliver) them.

So I raih (fed) the tzaan (flock) of haragah (slaughter), especially the oppressed of the tzaan (flock). I laqach (take / seized) for myself shanayam (two) maqal (staffs). The achad (one) I qaraa (called) "Favor," and the other I qaraa (called) "Union," and I raih (fed) the tzaan (flock).
I kachad (cut) off the shalawash (three) raih (shepherds) in achad (one) yarach (month); for my napash (living being/soul) was weary of them, and their napash (living being/soul) also loathed me.

Then I amar (spoke), I will not raih (feed) you. That which mawath (death), let it mawath (death); and that which is to be kachad (cut) off, let it be kachad (cut) off; and shaar (let) those who are left akal (eat) ashah (wife/individual woman) other's bashar (flesh).
I laqach (take / seized) my maqal (staff) Favor, and gadai (cut) it apart, that I might parar (break) my barayath (covenant) that I had karath (cut) with all the im (people / nation).
It was parar (broken) in that yawam (day); and thus the inay (poor) of the tzaan (flock) that listened to me yadai (knew) that it was the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah.

I amar (spoke) to them, "If you iyan (eye) it best, yahab (give) me my shakar (wages); and if not, keep them." So they shaqal (weighed) for my shakar (wages) shalawashayam (thirty) pieces of kasap (silver).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, "shalak (throw) it to the yatzar (potter), the handsome yaqar (price) that I was valued at by them!" I laqach (take / seized) the shalawashayam (thirty) pieces of kasap (silver), and shalak (threw) them to the yatzar (potter), in the bayath (house) of Yahawah.
Then I gadai (cut) apart my other maqal (staff), even Union, that I might parar (break) the achawah (brotherhood) between Yahawadah (Judah) and Yasharaal (Israel).
Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, laqach (take / seized) for yourself yet again the equipment of a awalay (foolish) raih (shepherd).

For, behold, I will qawam (rise up) up a raih (shepherd) in the aratz (Earth/land), who will not paqad (visit) those who are kachad (cut) off, neither will baqash (seek) those who are scattered, nor rapaa (heal) that which is shabar (broken), nor kawal (all/every/entire) that which is sound; but he will akal (eat) the bashar (flesh) of the barayaa (fat) sheep, and will paraq (tear) their parasah (hoofs) in paraq (pieces).

Haway (Alas/Woe!) To the worthless shepherd who izab (leaves) the tzaan (flock)! The charab (sword) will be on his zarawai (arm), and on his yamayan (right hand) iyan (eye). His zarawai (arm) will be completely yabash (dry land), and his yamayan (right hand) iyan (eye) will be totally blinded!

An oracle. The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah concerning Yasharaal (Israel). Yahawah, who stretches out the shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), and yasad (lays) the foundation of the aratz (Earth/land), and yatzar (forms) the rawach (spirit / wind) of adam (man) qarab (among / near) him naam (declares (prophetically)):

“Behold, I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) a sap (cup) of reeling to all the surrounding im (people / nation), and on Yahawadah (Judah) also will it be in the matzawar (siege) against Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

It will happen in that yawam (day), that I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) a maimasah (burdensome) aban (stone) for all the im (people / nation). All who imas (burden) themselves with it will be severely wounded, and all the gaway (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land) will be asap (gathered) together against it.

In that yawam (day),” naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, I will nakah (strike) every sawas (horse) with terror, and his rider with shagaiwan (madness); and I will paqach (open) my iyan (eye) on the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah), and will nakah (strike) every sawas (horse) of the im (people / nation) with iwarawan (blindness).

The chieftains of Yahawadah (Judah) will amar (spoke) in their lab (heart), ‘The yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) are my amatzah (strength) in Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) their Alahayam.’

In that yawam (day) I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) the chieftains of Yahawadah (Judah) like a kayawar (pan) of ash (fire) among itz (wood), and like a ash (fire) lapayad (torch) among sheaves; and they will akal (eat) all the surrounding im (people / nation), on the right yamayan (right hand) and on the shamaawal (left hand); and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) will yet again yashab (inhabit/dwell) in their own place, even in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Yahawah also will yashai (salvation) the ahal (tents) of Yahawadah (Judah) raashawan (first), that the glory of the bayath (house) of Dawad (David) and the glory of the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) not be gadal (magnified) above Yahawadah (Judah).

In that yawam (day) Yahawah will ganan (defend) the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). He who is kashal (stumble / stagger) among them at that yawam (day) will be like Dawad (David), and the bayath (house) of Dawad (David) will be like Alahayam, like the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah panayam (before) them.
It will happen in that yawam (day), that I will baqash (seek) to shamad (destroy) all the gaway (nation / people) that bawaa (come) against Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

I will shapak (pour) on the bayath (house) of Dawad (David), and on the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), the rawach (spirit / wind) of chan (grace) and of thachanawan (supplication); and they will nabat (look) to me whom they have daqar (pierced); and they shall mourn for him, as one sapad (mourns) for his only marar (son), and will grieve bitterly for him, as marar (one) grieves for his bakawar (firstborn).

In that yawam (day) there will be a gadal (great) masapad (mourning) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), like the masapad (mourning) of Hadadaramawan (Hadadrimmon) in the baqaih (valley) of Magadawan (Megiddon).

The aratz (Earth/land) will sapad (mourn), every mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) bad (apart); the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the bayath (house) of Dawad (David) apart, and their wives apart; the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the bayath (house) of Nathan (Nathan) apart, and their wives apart;
The mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the bayath (house) of Laway (Levi) apart, and their wives apart; the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the Shimeites apart, and their wives apart;
All the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) who shaar (remain), every mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) apart, and their wives apart.

In that yawam (day) there will be a maqawar (spring) pathach (opened) to the bayath (house) of Dawad (David) and to the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), for chataah (sin) and for uncleanness.

It will come to pass in that yawam (day), naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), that I will karath (cut) off the sham (name) of the itzab (idols) out of the aratz (Earth/land), and they will be zakar (remembrance/memory) no more. I will also cause the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) and the rawach (spirit / wind) of impurity to ibar (pass over/through) out of the aratz (Earth/land).

It will happen that, when anyone still nabaa (prophesies), then his ab (father) and his am (mother) who yalad (birth / begot) him will amar (spoke) him, ‘You must chayah (die), because you amar (spoke) shaqar (lies) in the sham (name) of Yahawah;’ and his yalad (birth / begot) and his am (mother) who yalad (birth / begot) him will stab him when he nabaa (prophesies).

It will happen in that yawam (day), that the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) will ayash (husband/individual man) be bawash (ashamed) of his chazayawan (vision), when he nabaa (prophesies); neither will they labash (wear) a shair (hair) adarath (mantle) to kachash (deceive):
But he will amar (spoke), ‘I am no nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), I am a ibad (servant) of the adam (ground); for I have been made a bondservant from my naiwar (youth).’
One will amar (spoke) to him, ‘What are these makah (wounds) between your arms?’ Then he will amar (spoke), ‘Those with which I was wounded in the bayath (house) of my ahab (love).’

"Iwar (rouse / awaken), charab (sword), against my raih (shepherd), and against the gabar (man) who is close to me," naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop). "Nakah (strike) the raih (shepherd), and the tzaan (sheep) will be pawatz (scattered); and I will shawab (turn back / repent) my yad (hand) against the tzair (little) ones.

It shall happen that in all the aratz (Earth/land)," naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah, shanayam (two) pah (parts) in it will be karath (cut) off and gawai (die); but the shalayashay (third) will be yathar (left) in it.

I will bawaa (come) the shalayashay (third) part into the ash (fire), and will tzarap (refine) them as kasap (silver) is tzarap (refined), and will test them like zahab (gold) is tested. They will qaraa (called) on my sham (name), and I will inah (answer / respond) them. I will amar (spoke), ‘It is my im (people / nation);’ and they will amar (spoke), ‘Yahawah is my Alahayam.’
Behold, a yawam (day) of Yahawah bawaa (come), when your shalal (spoil) will be chalaq (divided) in your qarab (among / near).

For I will asap (gather) all gaway (nation / people) against Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to malachamah (battle); and the iyar (city) will be lakad (taken), the bayath (house) shasas (rifled), and the ashah (wife/individual woman) shagal (ravished). Chatzay (half) of the iyar (city) will yatzaa (go out / come out) out into gawalah (captivity), and the yathar (rest) of the im (people / nation) will not be karath (cut) off from the iyar (city).
Then Yahawah will yatzaa (go out / come out) out and lacham (fight) against those gaway (nation / people), as when he lacham (fought) in the yawam (day) of qarab (battle).

His ragal (feet / foot) will imad (stand) in that yawam (day) on the har (mountain) of zayath (olive), which is panayam (before) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) on the qadam (east); and the har (mountain) of zayath (olive) will be split in chatzay (two), from mazarach (east) to yam (sea/waters), making a very gadawal (very great/important/mighty) gayaa (valley). Chatzay (half) of the har (mountain) will move toward the tzapawan (north), and chatzay (half) of it toward the nagab (south).

You shall nawas (flee) by the gayaa (valley) of my har (mountain); for the gayaa (valley) of the har (mountain) shall nagai (reach) to Atzal (Azel); yes, you shall nawas (flee), just like you nawas (fled) from panayam (before) the raish (earthquake) in the yawam (day) of Izayah (Uzziah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah). Yahawah my Alahayam will bawaa (come), and all the qadawash (holy) ones with you.
It will happen in that yawam (day), that there will not be awar (light), cold, or frost.
It will be a unique yawam (day) which is yadai (known) to Yahawah; not yawam (day), and not layal (night); but it will come to pass, that at irab (evening) ith (time) there will be awar (light).

It will happen in that yawam (day), that chay (life) mayam (Waters) will yatzaa (go out / come out) out from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); chatzay (half) of them toward the eastern yam (sea/waters), and chatzay (half) of them toward the western yam (sea/waters); in qayatz (summer) and in charap (winter) will it be.
Yahawah will be malak (king) over all the aratz (Earth/land). In that yawam (day) Yahawah will be achad (one), and his sham (name) achad (one).

All the aratz (Earth/land) will be made like the irabah (arabah), from Gabai (Geba) to Ramawan (Rimmon) nagab (south) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and she will be raam (lifted) up, and will yashab (inhabit/dwell) in her maqawam (place), from Banayamayan (Benjamin's) shair (gate) to the maqawam (place) of the raashawan (first) shair (gate), to the pan (face) shair (gate), and from the magadal (tower) Chananaal (of) Hananel to the malak (king) winepresses.
Men will yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein, and there will be no more charam (curse); but Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) will yashab (inhabit/dwell) safely.

This will be the magapah (plague) with which Yahawah will nagap (strike) all the im (people / nation) who have tzabaa (troop) against Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): their bashar (flesh) will maqaq (consume) away while they imad (stand) on their ragal (feet / foot), and their iyan (eye) will maqaq (consume) away in their sockets, and their lashawan (tongue/language) will maqaq (consume) away in their pah (mouth).

It will happen in that yawam (day), that a rab (great) panic from Yahawah will be among them; and they will lay chazaq (hold) everyone on the yad (hand) of his neighbor, and his yad (hand) will ilah (go up / offer) up against the yad (hand) of his neighbor.

Yahawadah (Judah) also will lacham (fight) at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and the wealth of all the surrounding gaway (nation / people) will be asap (gathered) together: zahab (gold), and kasap (silver), and bagad (clothing), in maad (great) rab (abundance).

So will be the magapah (plague) of the sawas (horse), of the parad (mule), of the gamal (camel), and of the donkey, and of all the animals that will be in ham (those) machanah (camps), as that magapah (plague).

It will happen that everyone who is yathar (left) of all the gaway (nation / people) that bawaa (come) against Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) will ilah (go up / offer) up from shanah (year) to shanah (year) to shachah (worship) the malak (king), Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), and to chagag (keep) the chag (feast/festival) of sakah (tents).

It will be, that whoever of all the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of the aratz (Earth/land) doesn't ilah (go up / offer) up to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to shachah (worship) the malak (king), Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), on them there will be no gasham (rain).

If the mashapachah (tribe/clan/family) of Matzarayam (Egypt) doesn't ilah (go up / offer) up, and doesn't bawaa (come), neither will it rain on them. This will be the magapah (plague) with which Yahawah will nagap (strike) the gaway (nation / people) that don't ilah (go up / offer) up to chagag (keep) the chag (feast/festival) of sakah (tents).

This will be the chataah (sin) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and the chataah (sin) of all the gaway (nation / people) that don't ilah (go up / offer) up to chagag (keep) the chag (feast/festival) of sakah (tents).

In that yawam (day) there will be on the matzalah (bells) of the sawas (horses), "qadash (set apart/make holy) TO Yahawah;" and the sayar (pots) in yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) bayath (house) will be like the mazaraq (bowls) panayam (before) the mazabach (altar).

Yes, every sayar (pot) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) and in Yahawadah (Judah) will be qadash (set apart/make holy) to Yahawah of tzabaa (troop); and all those who zabach (sacrifice) will bawaa (come) and laqach (take / seized) of them, and cook in them. In that yawam (day) there will no longer be a Kanainay (Canaanite) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).
An oracle: the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah to Yasharaal (Israel) by Malaakay (Malachi).

"I have ahab (love) you," naam (declares (prophetically)) Yahawah. Yet you amar (spoke), "How have you ahab (love) us?" "Wasn't Ishaw (Esau) Yaiqab (Jacob's) ach (brother/kinsman)?" Amar (spoke) Yahawah, Yet I ahab (love) Yaiqab (Jacob);
But Ishaw (Esau) I shanaa (hate), and shawam (place / establish / appoint) his har (mountain) a shamamah (desolation), and gave his nachalah (heritage) to the jackals of the madabar (wilderness).

Whereas Adam (Edom) amar (spoke), "We are beaten down, but we will shawab (turn back / repent) and banah (build) the charabah (waste) places;" thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), They shall banah (build), but I will haras (throw) down; and men will qaraa (called) them ‘The rashaih (wicked) gabawal (border/boundary),’ even the im (people / nation) against whom Yahawah shows zaim (wrath) iwalam (forever).
Your iyan (eye) will raah (see), and you will amar (spoke), Yahawah is gadal (great)— even beyond the gabawal (border/boundary) of Yasharaal (Israel)!

“A ban (son) honors his ab (father), and a ibad (servant) his adawan (master / lord). If I am a ab (father), then where is my honor? And if I am a adawan (master / lord), where is the respect due me? Amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop) to you, kahan (priest), who bazah (despise) my sham (name). You amar (spoke), ‘How have we bazah (despised) your sham (name)?’

You nagash (offer) gaal (polluted) lacham (bread) on my mazabach (altar). You amar (spoke), ‘How have we gaal (polluted) you?’ In that you amar (spoke), ‘yahawah (Yahawah (Alahay of Yasharaal)) shalachan (table) bazah (contemptible).’

When you nagash (offer) the iwar (blind) for zabach (sacrifice), isn't that rai (evil)? And when you nagash (offer) the pasach (lame) and chalah (afflict), isn't that rai (evil)? Qarab (come close) it now to your pachah (governor)! Will he be ratzah (pleased) with you? Or will he nashaa (lift) your panayam (person)?” Amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).
"Now, please entreat the favor of Al, that he may be gracious to us. With this, will he nashaa (lift) any of you?" Amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).

"Oh that there were one among you who would sagar (shut) the dalath (doors), that you might not awar (light) fire on my mazabach (altar) in chanam (vain)! I have no chapatz (pleasure) in you," amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), "neither will I ratzah (accept) an manachah (offering) at your yad (hand).

For from the mazarach (rising) of the shamash (sun) even to the mabawaa (going) down of the same, my sham (name) is gadawal (very great/important/mighty) among the gaway (nation / people), and in every maqawam (place) qatar (incense) will be nagash (offered) to my sham (name), and a tahawar (pure) manachah (offering): for my sham (name) is gadawal (very great/important/mighty) among the gaway (nation / people)," amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).
"But you chalal (profane) it, in that you amar (spoke), ‘Yahweh's shalachan (table) is gaal (polluted), and its nawab (fruit), even its akal (food), is bazah (contemptible).’

You amar (spoke) also, ‘Behold, mathalaah (what) a weariness it is!’ And you have sniffed at it," amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop); "and you bawaa (come) brought that which was gazal (taken) by violence, the pasach (lame), and the chalah (afflict); thus you bawaa (come) the manachah (offering). Should I ratzah (accept) this at your yad (hand)?" Amar (spoke) Yahawah.

"But the nakal (deceiver) is arar (cursed), who has in his idar (flock) a zakar (remembrance/memory), and nadar (make vow), and zabach (sacrifices) to the Adanay a blemished thing; for I am a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) malak (king)," amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), and my sham (name) is awesome among the gaway (nation / people).
"Now, you kahan (priest), this matzawah (commandment) is for you.

If you will not shamai (hearken / hear), and if you will not shawam (place / establish / appoint) it to lab (heart), to nathan (give) kabawad (glory) to my sham (name)," amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), "then will I shalach (send) the maarah (curse) on you, and I will arar (curse) your barakah (blessings). Indeed, I have arar (cursed) them already, because you shawam (place / establish / appoint) not lay it to lab (heart).

Behold, I will gair (rebuke) your zarai (seed), and will zarah (spread) parash (dung) on your panayam (faces), even the parash (dung) of your chag (feast/festival); and you will be nashaa (lift) away with it.
You yadai (will) know that I have shalach (send) this matzawah (commandment) to you, that my barayath (covenant) may be with Laway (Levi)," amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).

“My barayath (covenant) was with him of chay (life) and shalawam (peace / safety); and I nathan (give) them to him that he might be reverent toward me; and he was reverent panayam (toward) me, and stood in awe of my sham (name).

The thawarah (instruction) of amath (truth) was in his pah (mouth), and iwal (unrighteousness) was not matzaa (found) in his shapah (lips). He halak (move) with me in shalawam (peace / safety) and mayashawar (uprightness), and shawab (turn back / repent) many shawab (turn back / repent) from iwan (guilt/iniquity).

For the kahan (priest) shapah (lips) should shamar (keep/guard) daith (knowledge), and they should baqash (seek) the thawarah (instruction) at his pah (mouth); for he is the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).

But you have sawar (turned) aside out of the darak (way). You rab (have) caused many to kashal (stumble / stagger) in the thawarah (instruction). You have shachath (corrupted) the barayath (covenant) of Laway (Levi),” amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).

“Therefore I nathan (give) also made you bazah (contemptible) and shapal (base) before all the im (people / nation), pah (according) to the way you have not shamar (keep/guard) my darak (ways), but have had nashaa (lift) for persons in the thawarah (instruction).

Don't we all have achad (one) ab (father)? Hasn't achad (one) Al baraa (created) us? Why do we bagad (deal) treacherously every ayash (husband/individual man) against his ach (brother/kinsman), chalal (profaning) the barayath (covenant) of our ab (father)?

Yahawadah (Judah) has dealt bagad (treacherously), and an thawaibah (abomination) is ishah (make) in Yasharaal (Israel) and in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); for Yahawadah (Judah) has chalal (profaned) the qadash (set apart/make holy) of Yahawah which he ahab (love), and bail (has) married the bath (daughter) of a foreign Al.

Yahawah will karath (cut) off, to the ayash (husband/individual man) who ishah (make) this, him who iwar (rouse / awaken) and him who inah (answer / respond), out of the ahal (tents) of Yaiqab (Jacob), and him who nagash (offers) an manachah (offering) to Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).

This again you ishah (make): you kasah (cover) the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah with damaih (tears), with bakay (weeping), and with anaqah (sighing), because he doesn't panah (regard) the manachah (offering) any more, neither laqach (take / seized) it with good ratzawan (will) at your yad (hand).

Yet you amar (spoke), ‘mah (why)?’ Because Yahawah has been iwad (admonish/bear witness against) between you and the ashah (wife/individual woman) of your naiwar (youth), against whom you have dealt bagad (treacherously), though she is your chabarath (companion), and the ashah (wife/individual woman) of your barayath (covenant).

Ishah (make) he not make you achad (one), although he had the shaar (residue) of the rawach (spirit / wind)? Why achad (one)? He baqash (sought) a godly zarai (seed). Therefore shamar (keep/guard) heed to your rawach (spirit / wind), and let no one bagad (deal) treacherously against the ashah (wife/individual woman) of his naiwar (youth).

For I shanaa (hate) divorce,” amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), "and him who kasah (covers) his labawash (garment) with chamas (violence)!" Amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop). Therefore shamar (keep/guard) heed to your rawach (spirit / wind), that you don't bagad (deal) treacherously.

You have yagai (wearied) Yahawah with your dabar (word / matter). Yet you amar (spoke), ‘How have we yagai (wearied) him?’ In that you amar (spoke), ‘Everyone who ishah (make) rai (evil) is tawab (pleasant/functional) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, and he chapatz (delights) in them;’ or ‘Where is the Alahayam of mashapat (justice)?’

"Behold, I shalach (send) my malaak (angel / messenger of Yah), and he will panah (prepare) the darak (way) panayam (before) me; and the Adawan, whom you baqash (seek), will pathaawam (suddenly) bawaa (come) to his hayakal (temple); and the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of the barayath (covenant), whom you chapatz (desire), behold, he bawaa (come)!" Amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).
“But who kawal (all/every/entire) endure the yawam (day) of his bawaa (come)? And who will imad (stand) when he raah (see)? For he is like a refiner's ash (fire), and like launderer's soap;

And he will yashab (inhabit/dwell) as a refiner and purifier of kasap (silver), and he will tahar (purify) the ban (son) of Laway (Levi), and zaqaq (refine) them as zahab (gold) and kasap (silver); and they shall nagash (offer) to Yahawah manachah (offerings) in tzadaqah (righteousness).

Then the manachah (offering) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) will be irab (evening) to Yahawah, as in the yawam (day) of iwalam (forever), and as in qadamawanay (ancient) shanah (years).

I will qarab (come close) near to you to mashapat (judgment); and I will be a mahar (swift) id (witness) against the kashap (sorcerers), and against the naap (adulterers), and against the perjurers, and against those who ishaq (oppress) the shakayar (hireling) in his shakar (wages), the alamanah (widow), and the yathawam (fatherless), and who deprive the foreigner of justice, and don't yaraa (fear / be afraid) me,” amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).
"For I, Yahawah, don't shanah (change); therefore you, ban (son) of Yaiqab (Jacob), are not kalah (complete / finish).

From the yawam (day) of your ab (father) you have sawar (turned) aside from my chaq (statute), and have not shamar (keep/guard) them. Shawab (turn back / repent) to me, and I will shawab (turn back / repent) to you," amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop). "But you amar (spoke), ‘How shall we shawab (turn back / repent)?’
Will a adam (man) qabai (rob) Alahayam? Yet you qabai (rob) me! But you amar (spoke), ‘How have we qabai (robbed) you?’ In maishar (tithes) and tharawamah (offerings).
You are arar (cursed) with the maarah (curse); for you qabai (rob) me, even this whole gaway (nation / people).

Bawaa (come) the whole maishar (tithe) into the awatzar (storehouse), that there may be food in my bayath (house), and test me now in zaath (this)," amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), "if I will not pathach (open) you the arabah (windows) of shamayam (Shamayam/(Heavens)), and rawaq (pour) you out a barakah (blessing), that there shall not be room day (enough) for.

I will gair (rebuke) the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not shachath (destroy) the paray (fruits) of your adamah (ground); neither shall your gapan (vine) shakal (cast) its fruit before its time in the shadah (field)," amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).
"All gaway (nation / people) shall ashar (who/that) you blessed, for you will be a delightful aratz (Earth/land)," amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).
"Your dabar (word / matter) have been chazaq (stout) amar (spoke) me," says Yahawah. “Yet you amar (spoke), ‘What have we dabar (word / matter) against you?’

You have amar (spoke), ‘It is shawaa (vanity) to ibad (servant) Alahayam;’ and ‘What batzai (profit) is it that we have followed his instructions, and that we have halak (move) qadaranayath (mournfully) panayam (before) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop)?
Now we ashar (who/that) the zad (proud) ashar (who/that); yes, those who ishah (make) rashaih (wickedness) are banah (built) up; yes, they bachan (tempt) Alahayam, and malat (escape).’

Then those who yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah dabar (word / matter) ayash (husband/individual man) with rai (neigbor/another person); and Yahawah listened, and shamai (hearken / hear), and a sapar (book / scribed document) of memory was kathab (written) panayam (before) him, for those who yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah, and who honored his sham (name).

They shall be mine,” amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), my own sagalah (possession) in the yawam (day) that I ishah (make), and I will chamal (spare) them, as a ayash (husband/individual man) chamal (spares) his own ban (son) who ibad (servant) him.
Then you shall shawab (turn back / repent) and raah (see) between the tzadayaq (righteous) and the rashai (wicked), between him who ibad (servant) Alahayam and him who doesn't ibad (servant) him.

"For, behold, the yawam (day) bawaa (come), it bair (burns) as a thanawar (furnace); and all the zad (proud), and all who ishah (make) rashaih (wickedness), will be qash (stubble); and the yawam (day) that bawaa (come) will lahat (burn) them up," amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop), "that it shall izab (leave) them neither sharash (root) nor inap (branch).

But to you who yaraa (fear) my sham (name) shall the shamash (sun) of tzadaqah (righteousness) arise with marapaa (healing) in its kanap (wings). You will yatzaa (go out / come out) out, and leap like calves of the marabaq (stall).

You shall isas (tread) down the rashai (wicked); for they will be ashes under the kap (soles) of your ragal (feet / foot) in the yawam (day) that I ishah (make)," amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaa (troop).

Zakar (remembrance/memory) the thawarah (instruction) of Mashah (Moses) my ibad (servant), which I tzawah (commanded) to him in Charab (Horeb) for all Yasharaal (Israel), even chaq (statute) and mashapat (ordinances).

Behold, I will shalach (send) you Alayah (Elijah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) panayam (before) the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and yaraa (fear / be afraid) yawam (day) of Yahawah bawaa (come).

He will shawab (turn back / repent) the lab (heart) of the ab (father) to the ban (son), and the lab (heart) of the ban (son) to their ab (father), lest I bawaa (come) and nakah (strike) the aratz (Earth/land) with a charam (curse).
